verses.textZh: 以上就是被数点的人数，是摩西和亚伦，以及以色列的首领十二人 所数点的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上就是被数点的人数，是摩西和亚伦，以及以色列的首领十二人 所数点的。
verses.textZhCuv: 以上就是被数点的人数，是摩西和亚伦，以及以色列的首领十二人 所数点的。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the men counted by Moses and Aaron and the twelve leaders of Israel, each one representing his family.
verses.textEnEsv: These are those who were listed, whom Moses and Aaron listed with the help of the chiefs of Israel, twelve men, each representing his fathers’ house.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the ones who were numbered, whom Moses and Aaron numbered, with the leaders of Israel, twelve men, each one representing his father’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the men counted by Moses and Aaron and the twelve leaders of Israel, each one representing his family.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the ones who were numbered, whom Moses and Aaron counted, with the leaders of Israel, twelve men, each of whom was of his father’s household.
verses.textEn: These were the men counted by Moses and Aaron and the twelve leaders of Israel, each one representing his family.

verses.textZh: 这样，在以色列中，按着父家，二十岁及以上，凡是能出去打仗的以色列人，都登记了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，在以色列中，按着父家，二十岁及以上，凡是能出去打仗的以色列人，都登记了；
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，在以色列中，按着父家，二十岁及以上，凡是能出去打仗的以色列人，都登记了；
verses.textEnNiv: All the Israelites twenty years old or more who were able to serve in Israel’s army were counted according to their families.
verses.textEnEsv: So all those listed of the people of Israel, by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and upward, every man able to go to war in Israel—
verses.textEnNkjv: So all who were numbered of the children of Israel, by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and above, all who wereableto go to war in Israel—
verses.textEnNlt: All the Israelites twenty years old or more who were able to serve in Israel’s army were counted according to their families.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the numbered men of the sons of Israel by their fathers’ households, from twenty years old and upward, whoever was able to go to war in Israel,
verses.textEn: All the Israelites twenty years old or more who were able to serve in Israel’s army were counted according to their families.

verses.textZh: 被数点的，共有六十万零三千五百五十人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 被数点的，共有六十万零三千五百五十人。
verses.textZhCuv: 被数点的，共有六十万零三千五百五十人。
verses.textEnNiv: The total number was 603,550.
verses.textEnEsv: all those listed were 603,550.
verses.textEnNkjv: all who were numbered were six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.
verses.textEnNlt: The total number was 603,550.
verses.textEnNasb: all the numbered men were 603,550.
verses.textEn: The total number was 603,550.

verses.textZh: 只有利未人没有按着他们家族的支派，数点在其中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有利未人没有按着他们家族的支派，数点在其中。
verses.textZhCuv: 只有利未人没有按着他们家族的支派，数点在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: The ancestral tribe of the Levites, however, was not counted along with the others.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Levites were not listed along with them by their ancestral tribe.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Levites were not numbered among them by their fathers’ tribe;
verses.textEnNlt: The ancestral tribe of the Levites, however, was not counted along with the others.
verses.textEnNasb: The Levites, however, were not counted among them by their fathers’ tribe.
verses.textEn: The ancestral tribe of the Levites, however, was not counted along with the others.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华曾对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华曾对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华曾对摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord had said to Moses:
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: for the Lord had spoken to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord had said to Moses:
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord had spoken to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord had said to Moses:

verses.textZh: "只有利未支派，你不可数点，也不可把他们的总数列入以色列人中。
verses.textZhCnvs: "只有利未支派，你不可数点，也不可把他们的总数列入以色列人中。
verses.textZhCuv: "只有利未支派，你不可数点，也不可把他们的总数列入以色列人中。
verses.textEnNiv: "You must not count the tribe of Levi or include them in the census of the other Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: "Only the tribe of Levi you shall not list, and you shall not take a census of them among the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Only the tribe of Levi you shall not number, nor take a census of them among the children of Israel;
verses.textEnNlt: "You must not count the tribe of Levi or include them in the census of the other Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: "Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, nor shall you take their census among the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: "You must not count the tribe of Levi or include them in the census of the other Israelites.

verses.textZh: 只要派利未人管理法柜的帐幕，和其中的一切器具，以及一切属于帐幕的事物；他们要抬帐幕和其中的一切器具；他们要办理帐幕的事，在帐幕四周安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只要派利未人管理法柜的帐幕，和其中的一切器具，以及一切属于帐幕的事物；他们要抬帐幕和其中的一切器具；他们要办理帐幕的事，在帐幕四周安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 只要派利未人管理法柜的帐幕，和其中的一切器具，以及一切属于帐幕的事物；他们要抬帐幕和其中的一切器具；他们要办理帐幕的事，在帐幕四周安营。
verses.textEnNiv: Instead, appoint the Levites to be in charge of the tabernacle of the covenant law—over all its furnishings and everything belonging to it. They are to carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; they are to take care of it and encamp around it.
verses.textEnEsv: But appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They are to carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings, and they shall take care of it and shall camp around the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNkjv: but you shall appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the Testimony, over all its furnishings, and over all things that belong to it; they shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; they shall attend to it and camp around the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, appoint the Levites to be in charge of the tabernacle of the covenant law—over all its furnishings and everything belonging to it. They are to carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; they are to take care of it and encamp around it.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the testimony, and over all its furnishings and over everything that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings, and they shall take care of it; they shall also camp around the tabernacle.
verses.textEn: Instead, appoint the Levites to be in charge of the tabernacle of the covenant law—over all its furnishings and everything belonging to it. They are to carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; they are to take care of it and encamp around it.

verses.textZh: 帐幕要起行的时候，利未人要把它拆卸下来；帐幕要支搭的时候，利未人要把它竖立起来；如果有外人走近，必须处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 帐幕要起行的时候，利未人要把它拆卸下来；帐幕要支搭的时候，利未人要把它竖立起来；如果有外人走近，必须处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 帐幕要起行的时候，利未人要把它拆卸下来；帐幕要支搭的时候，利未人要把它竖立起来；如果有外人走近，必须处死。
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever the tabernacle is to move, the Levites are to take it down, and whenever the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall do it. Anyone else who approaches it is to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: When the tabernacle is to set out, the Levites shall take it down, and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up. And if any outsider comes near, he shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the tabernacle is to go forward, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The outsider who comes near shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: Whenever the tabernacle is to move, the Levites are to take it down, and whenever the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall do it. Anyone else who approaches it is to be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: So when the tabernacle is to move on, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle encamps, the Levites shall set it up. But the layman who comes near it shall be put to death.
verses.textEn: Whenever the tabernacle is to move, the Levites are to take it down, and whenever the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall do it. Anyone else who approaches it is to be put to death.

verses.textZh: 以色列人安营，要依照他们的队伍，各归本营，各归本旗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人安营，要依照他们的队伍，各归本营，各归本旗。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人安营，要依照他们的队伍，各归本营，各归本旗。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites are to set up their tents by divisions, each of them in their own camp under their standard.
verses.textEnEsv: The people of Israel shall pitch their tents by their companies, each man in his own camp and each man by his own standard.
verses.textEnNkjv: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, everyone by his own camp, everyone by his own standard, according to their armies;
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites are to set up their tents by divisions, each of them in their own camp under their standard.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Israel shall camp, each man by his own camp, and each man by his own flag, according to their armies.
verses.textEn: The Israelites are to set up their tents by divisions, each of them in their own camp under their standard.

verses.textZh: 但利未人要在法柜帐幕的四周安营，免得神的忿怒临到以色列的会众；利未人要负看守法柜的帐幕的责任。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但利未人要在法柜帐幕的四周安营，免得神的忿怒临到以色列的会众；利未人要负看守法柜的帐幕的责任。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但利未人要在法柜帐幕的四周安营，免得神的忿怒临到以色列的会众；利未人要负看守法柜的帐幕的责任。"
verses.textEnNiv: The Levites, however, are to set up their tents around the tabernacle of the covenant law so that my wrath will not fall on the Israelite community. The Levites are to be responsible for the care of the tabernacle of the covenant law."
verses.textEnEsv: But the Levites shall camp around the tabernacle of the testimony, so that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the people of Israel. And the Levites shall keep guard over the tabernacle of the testimony."
verses.textEnNkjv: but the Levites shall camp around the tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel; and the Levites shall keep charge of the tabernacle of the Testimony."
verses.textEnNlt: The Levites, however, are to set up their tents around the tabernacle of the covenant law so that my wrath will not fall on the Israelite community. The Levites are to be responsible for the care of the tabernacle of the covenant law."
verses.textEnNasb: But the Levites shall camp around the tabernacle of the testimony, so that there will be no divine wrath against the congregation of the sons of Israel. So the Levites shall be responsible for service to the tabernacle of the testimony."
verses.textEn: The Levites, however, are to set up their tents around the tabernacle of the covenant law so that my wrath will not fall on the Israelite community. The Levites are to be responsible for the care of the tabernacle of the covenant law."

verses.textZh: 以色列人就这样行了，耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，他们就怎样行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人就这样行了，耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，他们就怎样行。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人就这样行了，耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，他们就怎样行。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites did all this just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus did the people of Israel; they did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus the children of Israel did; according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so they did.
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites did all this just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Israel did so; in accordance with all that the Lord had commanded Moses, so they did.
verses.textEn: The Israelites did all this just as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西、亚伦说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron:
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord gave these instructions to Moses and Aaron:
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron:

verses.textZh: "以色列人要各归自己的旗下，在自己父家的旗号下安营；他们要在会幕四周稍远的地方安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以色列人要各归自己的旗下，在自己父家的旗号下安营；他们要在会幕四周稍远的地方安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 「以色列人要各归自己的纛下，在本族的旗号那里，对着会幕的四围安营。
verses.textEnNiv: "The Israelites are to camp around the tent of meeting some distance from it, each of them under their standard and holding the banners of their family."
verses.textEnEsv: "The people of Israel shall camp each by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers’ houses. They shall camp facing the tent of meeting on every side.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Everyone of the children of Israel shall camp by his own standard, beside the emblems of his father’s house; they shall camp some distance from the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: "When the Israelites set up camp, each tribe will be assigned its own area. The tribal divisions will camp beneath their family banners on all four sides of the Tabernacle, but at some distance from it.
verses.textEnNasb: "The sons of Israel shall camp, each by his own flag, with the banners of their fathers’ households; they shall camp around the tent of meeting at a distance.
verses.textEn: "The Israelites are to camp around the tent of meeting some distance from it, each of them under their standard and holding the banners of their family."

verses.textZh: 在东方向着日出之地，按着队伍安营的，是犹大营的旗号；犹大人的领袖是亚米拿达的儿子拿顺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在东方向着日出之地，按着队伍安营的，是犹大营的旗号；犹大人的领袖是亚米拿达的儿子拿顺。
verses.textZhCuv: 在东边，向日出之地，照着军队安营的是犹大营的纛。有亚米拿达的儿子拿顺作犹大人的首领。
verses.textEnNiv: On the east, toward the sunrise, the divisions of the camp of Judah are to encamp under their standard. The leader of the people of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab.
verses.textEnEsv: Those to camp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah by their companies, the chief of the people of Judah being Nahshon the son of Amminadab,
verses.textEnNkjv: On the east side, toward the rising of the sun, those of the standard of the forces with Judah shall camp according to their armies; and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shallbe the leader of the children of Judah."
verses.textEnNlt: Tribe Leader NumberJudah Nahshon son of Amminadab 74,600
verses.textEnNasb: Now those who camp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the flag of the camp of Judah, by their armies; and the leader of the sons of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab,
verses.textEn: On the east, toward the sunrise, the divisions of the camp of Judah are to encamp under their standard. The leader of the people of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab.

verses.textZh: 他的队伍被数点的，共有七万四千六百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的队伍被数点的，共有七万四千六百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他军队被数的，共有七万四千六百名。
verses.textEnNiv: His division numbers 74,600.
verses.textEnEsv: his company as listed being 74,600.
verses.textEnNkjv: And his army was numbered at seventy-four thousand six hundred.
verses.textEnNlt: So the total of all the troops on Judah’s side of the camp is 186,400. These three tribes are to lead the way whenever the Israelites travel to a new campsite.
verses.textEnNasb: and his army, their numbered men: 74,600.
verses.textEn: His division numbers 74,600.

verses.textZh: 在他旁边安营的，是以萨迦支派；以萨迦人的领袖是苏押的儿子拿坦业，
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他旁边安营的，是以萨迦支派；以萨迦人的领袖是苏押的儿子拿坦业，
verses.textZhCuv: 挨着他安营的是以萨迦支派。有苏押的儿子拿坦业作以萨迦人的首领。
verses.textEnNiv: The tribe of Issachar will camp next to them. The leader of the people of Issachar is Nethanel son of Zuar.
verses.textEnEsv: Those to camp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar, the chief of the people of Issachar being Nethanel the son of Zuar,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Those who camp next to him shallbe the tribe of Issachar, and Nethanel the son of Zuar shallbe the leader of the children of Issachar."
verses.textEnNlt: Tribe Leader NumberReuben Elizur son of Shedeur 46,500
verses.textEnNasb: Those who camp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar; and the leader of the sons of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar,
verses.textEn: The tribe of Issachar will camp next to them. The leader of the people of Issachar is Nethanel son of Zuar.

verses.textZh: 他的队伍被数点的，共有五万四千四百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的队伍被数点的，共有五万四千四百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他军队被数的，共有五万四千四百名。
verses.textEnNiv: His division numbers 54,400.
verses.textEnEsv: his company as listed being 54,400.
verses.textEnNkjv: And his army was numbered at fifty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.textEnNlt: So the total of all the troops on Reuben’s side of the camp is 151,450. These three tribes will be second in line whenever the Israelites travel.
verses.textEnNasb: and his army, their numbered men: 54,400.
verses.textEn: His division numbers 54,400.

verses.textZh: 又有西布伦支派；西布伦人的领袖是希伦的儿子以利押。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有西布伦支派；西布伦人的领袖是希伦的儿子以利押。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有西布伦支派。希伦的儿子以利押作西布伦人的首领。
verses.textEnNiv: The tribe of Zebulun will be next. The leader of the people of Zebulun is Eliab son of Helon.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the tribe of Zebulun, the chief of the people of Zebulun being Eliab the son of Helon,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then comes the tribe of Zebulun, and Eliab the son of Helon shallbe the leader of the children of Zebulun."
verses.textEnNlt: "Then the Tabernacle, carried by the Levites, will set out from the middle of the camp. All the tribes are to travel in the same order that they camp, each in position under the appropriate family banner.
verses.textEnNasb: Then follows the tribe of Zebulun; and the leader of the sons of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon,
verses.textEn: The tribe of Zebulun will be next. The leader of the people of Zebulun is Eliab son of Helon.

verses.textZh: 他的队伍被数点的，共有五万七千四百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的队伍被数点的，共有五万七千四百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他军队被数的，共有五万七千四百名。
verses.textEnNiv: His division numbers 57,400.
verses.textEnEsv: his company as listed being 57,400.
verses.textEnNkjv: And his army was numbered at fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
verses.textEnNlt: Tribe Leader NumberEphraim Elishama son of Ammihud 40,500
verses.textEnNasb: and his army, his numbered men: 57,400.
verses.textEn: His division numbers 57,400.

verses.textZh: 凡是属犹大营，按着队伍被数点的，共有十八万六千四百人；他们要首先出发。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是属犹大营，按着队伍被数点的，共有十八万六千四百人；他们要首先出发。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡属犹大营、按着军队被数的，共有十八万六千四百名，要作第一队往前行。
verses.textEnNiv: All the men assigned to the camp of Judah, according to their divisions, number 186,400. They will set out first.
verses.textEnEsv: All those listed of the camp of Judah, by their companies, were 186,400. They shall set out first on the march.
verses.textEnNkjv: "All who were numbered according to their armies of the forces with Judah, one hundred and eighty-six thousand four hundred— these shall break camp first.
verses.textEnNlt: So the total of all the troops on Ephraim’s side of the camp is 108,100. These three tribes will be third in line whenever the Israelites travel.
verses.textEnNasb: The total of the numbered men of the camp of Judah: 186,400, by their armies. They shall set out first.
verses.textEn: All the men assigned to the camp of Judah, according to their divisions, number 186,400. They will set out first.

verses.textZh: "在南方，按着队伍，是流本营的旗号；流本人的领袖是示丢珥的儿子以利蓿。
verses.textZhCnvs: "在南方，按着队伍，是流本营的旗号；流本人的领袖是示丢珥的儿子以利蓿。
verses.textZhCuv: 「在南边，按着军队是吕便营的纛。有示丢珥的儿子以利蓿作吕便人的首领。
verses.textEnNiv: On the south will be the divisions of the camp of Reuben under their standard. The leader of the people of Reuben is Elizur son of Shedeur.
verses.textEnEsv: "On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben by their companies, the chief of the people of Reuben being Elizur the son of Shedeur,

verses.textEnEsv: But the Levites were not listed among the people of Israel, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: The Levites, however, were not counted along with the other Israelites, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: The Levites, however, were not counted among the sons of Israel, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: The Levites, however, were not counted along with the other Israelites, as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 以色列人就照着耶和华吩咐摩西的一切行了，他们随着自己的旗号安营，各人按着自己的宗族和父家起行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人就照着耶和华吩咐摩西的一切行了，他们随着自己的旗号安营，各人按着自己的宗族和父家起行。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人就这样行，各人照他们的家室、宗族归于本纛，安营起行，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Israelites did everything the Lord commanded Moses; that is the way they encamped under their standards, and that is the way they set out, each of them with their clan and family.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus did the people of Israel. According to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so they camped by their standards, and so they set out, each one in his clan, according to his fathers’ house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses; so they camped by their standards and so they broke camp, each one by his family, according to their fathers’ houses.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Israelites did everything the Lord commanded Moses; that is the way they encamped under their standards, and that is the way they set out, each of them with their clan and family.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Israel did all this; according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so they camped by their flags, and so they set out, everyone by his family according to his father’s household.
verses.textEn: So the Israelites did everything the Lord commanded Moses; that is the way they encamped under their standards, and that is the way they set out, each of them with their clan and family.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在西奈山上与摩西说话的日子，亚伦和摩西的后代如下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在西奈山上与摩西说话的日子，亚伦和摩西的后代如下。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在西奈山晓谕摩西的日子，亚伦和摩西的后代如下：
verses.textEnNiv: This is the account of the family of Aaron and Moses at the time the Lord spoke to Moses at Mount Sinai.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the generations of Aaron and Moses at the time when the Lord spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now these are the records of Aaron and Moses when the Lord spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the family line of Aaron and Moses as it was recorded when the Lord spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai:
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the records of the generations of Aaron and Moses at the time when the Lord spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.
verses.textEn: This is the account of the family of Aaron and Moses at the time the Lord spoke to Moses at Mount Sinai.

verses.textZh: 亚伦的儿子的名字如下：长子是拿答，还有亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦的儿子的名字如下：长子是拿答，还有亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦的儿子，长子名叫拿答，还有亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。
verses.textEnNiv: The names of the sons of Aaron were Nadab the firstborn and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.textEnNkjv: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab, the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.textEnNlt: The names of Aaron’s sons were Nadab (the oldest), Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.textEnNasb: These then are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.textEn: The names of the sons of Aaron were Nadab the firstborn and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

verses.textZh: 这就是亚伦的儿子的名字，他们是受膏的祭司，是摩西叫他们承受圣职担任祭司的职分的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就是亚伦的儿子的名字，他们是受膏的祭司，是摩西叫他们承受圣职担任祭司的职分的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是亚伦儿子的名字，都是受膏的祭司，是摩西叫他们承接圣职供祭司职分的。
verses.textEnNiv: Those were the names of Aaron’s sons, the anointed priests, who were ordained to serve as priests.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the anointed priests, whom he ordained to serve as priests.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the anointed priests, whom he consecrated to minister as priests.
verses.textEnNlt: These sons of Aaron were anointed and ordained to minister as priests.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the anointed priests, whom he ordained to serve as priests.
verses.textEn: Those were the names of Aaron’s sons, the anointed priests, who were ordained to serve as priests.

verses.textZh: 拿答和亚比户在西奈旷野把凡火献在耶和华面前的时候，死在耶和华面前；他们没有儿子；以利亚撒和以他玛，就在他们的父亲亚伦面前，担任祭司的职分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿答和亚比户在西奈旷野把凡火献在耶和华面前的时候，死在耶和华面前；他们没有儿子；以利亚撒和以他玛，就在他们的父亲亚伦面前，担任祭司的职分。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿答、亚比户在西奈的旷野向耶和华献凡火的时候就死在耶和华面前了。他们也没有儿子。以利亚撒、以他玛在他们的父亲亚伦面前供祭司的职分。
verses.textEnNiv: Nadab and Abihu, however, died before the Lord when they made an offering with unauthorized fire before him in the Desert of Sinai. They had no sons, so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests during the lifetime of their father Aaron.
verses.textEnEsv: But Nadab and Abihu died before the Lord when they offered unauthorized fire before the Lord in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. So Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests in the lifetime of Aaron their father.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nadab and Abihu had died before the Lord when they offered profane fire before the Lord in the Wilderness of Sinai; and they had no children. So Eleazar and Ithamar ministered as priests in the presence of Aaron their father.
verses.textEnNlt: But Nadab and Abihu died in the Lord ’s presence in the wilderness of Sinai when they burned before the Lord the wrong kind of fire, different than he had commanded. Since they had no sons, this left only Eleazar and Ithamar to serve as priests with their father, Aaron.
verses.textEnNasb: But Nadab and Abihu died in the presence of the Lord when they offered strange fire before the Lord in the wilderness of Sinai; and they had no children. So Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests in the lifetime of their father Aaron.
verses.textEn: Nadab and Abihu, however, died before the Lord when they made an offering with unauthorized fire before him in the Desert of Sinai. They had no sons, so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests during the lifetime of their father Aaron.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要叫利未支派近前来，使他们站在亚伦祭司面前，可以服事他。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要叫利未支派近前来，使他们站在亚伦祭司面前，可以服事他。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你使利未支派近前来，站在祭司亚伦面前好服事他，
verses.textEnNiv: "Bring the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron the priest to assist him.
verses.textEnEsv: "Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may serve him.
verses.textEnNlt: "Call forward the tribe of Levi, and present them to Aaron the priest to serve as his assistants.
verses.textEnNasb: "Bring the tribe of Levi forward and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may serve him.
verses.textEn: "Bring the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron the priest to assist him.

verses.textZh: 他们要替亚伦和全体会众，在会幕前尽上本分，办理帐幕的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要替亚伦和全体会众，在会幕前尽上本分，办理帐幕的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 替他和会众在会幕前守所吩咐的，办理帐幕的事。
verses.textEnNiv: They are to perform duties for him and for the whole community at the tent of meeting by doing the work of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall keep guard over him and over the whole congregation before the tent of meeting, as they minister at the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall attend to his needs and the needs of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of meeting, to do the work of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: They will serve Aaron and the whole community, performing their sacred duties in and around the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall perform the duties for him and for the whole congregation in front of the tent of meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.textEn: They are to perform duties for him and for the whole community at the tent of meeting by doing the work of the tabernacle.

verses.textZh: 他们又要看守管理会幕里的一切器具，也要替以色列人尽上本分，办理帐幕的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又要看守管理会幕里的一切器具，也要替以色列人尽上本分，办理帐幕的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要看守会幕的器具，并守所吩咐以色列人的，办理帐幕的事。
verses.textEnNiv: They are to take care of all the furnishings of the tent of meeting, fulfilling the obligations of the Israelites by doing the work of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall guard all the furnishings of the tent of meeting, and keep guard over the people of Israel as they minister at the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also they shall attend to all the furnishings of the tabernacle of meeting, and to the needs of the children of Israel, to do the work of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: They will also maintain all the furnishings of the sacred tent, serving in the Tabernacle on behalf of all the Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall also take care of all the furnishings of the tent of meeting, along with the duties of the sons of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.textEn: They are to take care of all the furnishings of the tent of meeting, fulfilling the obligations of the Israelites by doing the work of the tabernacle.

verses.textZh: 你要把利未人派给亚伦和他的儿子，因为他们是从以色列人中选出来完全给他的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把利未人派给亚伦和他的儿子，因为他们是从以色列人中选出来完全给他的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要将利未人给亚伦和他的儿子，因为他们是从以色列人中选出来给他的。
verses.textEnNiv: Give the Levites to Aaron and his sons; they are the Israelites who are to be given wholly to him.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall give the Levites to Aaron and his sons; they are wholly given to him from among the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall give the Levites to Aaron and his sons; they are given entirely to him from among the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Assign the Levites to Aaron and his sons. They have been given from among all the people of Israel to serve as their assistants.
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall assign the Levites to Aaron and to his sons; they are exclusively assigned to him from the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: Give the Levites to Aaron and his sons; they are the Israelites who are to be given wholly to him.

verses.textZh: 你要委派亚伦和他的儿子，使他们谨守自己祭司的职分；外人走近，必被治死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要委派亚伦和他的儿子，使他们谨守自己祭司的职分；外人走近，必被治死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你要嘱咐亚伦和他的儿子谨守自己祭司的职任。近前来的外人必被治死。」
verses.textEnNiv: Appoint Aaron and his sons to serve as priests; anyone else who approaches the sanctuary is to be put to death."
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall guard their priesthood. But if any outsider comes near, he shall be put to death."
verses.textEnNkjv: So you shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall attend to their priesthood; but the outsider who comes near shall be put to death."
verses.textEnNlt: Appoint Aaron and his sons to carry out the duties of the priesthood. But any unauthorized person who goes too near the sanctuary must be put to death."
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall appoint Aaron and his sons that they may keep their priesthood, but the layman who comes near shall be put to death."
verses.textEn: Appoint Aaron and his sons to serve as priests; anyone else who approaches the sanctuary is to be put to death."

verses.textZh: 耶和华告诉摩西：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华告诉摩西：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord also said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Again the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord also said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "看哪，我从以色列人中，拣选了利未人，代替以色列人所有头生的，就是他们的长子，所以利未人要归我。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪，我从以色列人中，拣选了利未人，代替以色列人所有头生的，就是他们的长子，所以利未人要归我。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我从以色列人中拣选了利未人，代替以色列人一切头生的；利未人要归我。
verses.textEnNiv: "I have taken the Levites from among the Israelites in place of the first male offspring of every Israelite woman. The Levites are mine,
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the people of Israel instead of every firstborn who opens the womb among the people of Israel. The Levites shall be mine,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now behold, I Myself have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of every firstborn who opens the womb among the children of Israel. Therefore the Levites shall be Mine,
verses.textEnNlt: "Look, I have chosen the Levites from among the Israelites to serve as substitutes for all the firstborn sons of the people of Israel. The Levites belong to me,
verses.textEnNasb: "Now, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the sons of Israel instead of every firstborn, the firstborn of the womb among the sons of Israel. So the Levites shall be Mine.
verses.textEn: "I have taken the Levites from among the Israelites in place of the first male offspring of every Israelite woman. The Levites are mine,

verses.textZh: 因为所有头生的，都是我的；我在埃及地击杀所有头生的那天，就把以色列中所有头生的，无论人畜，都分别为圣归我；他们要归我，我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为所有头生的，都是我的；我在埃及地击杀所有头生的那天，就把以色列中所有头生的，无论人畜，都分别为圣归我；他们要归我，我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为凡头生的是我的；我在埃及地击杀一切头生的那日就把以色列中一切头生的，连人带牲畜都分别为圣归我；他们定要属我。我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: for all the firstborn are mine. When I struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, I set apart for myself every firstborn in Israel, whether human or animal. They are to be mine. I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: for all the firstborn are mine. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated for my own all the firstborn in Israel, both of man and of beast. They shall be mine: I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: because all the firstborn are Mine. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified to Myself all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast. They shall be Mine: I am the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: for all the firstborn males are mine. On the day I struck down all the firstborn sons of the Egyptians, I set apart for myself all the firstborn in Israel, both of people and of animals. They are mine; I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: For all the firstborn are Mine; on the day that I fatally struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified to Myself all the firstborn in Israel, from the human firstborn to animals. They shall be Mine; I am the Lord."
verses.textEn: for all the firstborn are mine. When I struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, I set apart for myself every firstborn in Israel, whether human or animal. They are to be mine. I am the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 耶和华在西奈旷野对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在西奈旷野对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在西奈的旷野晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses in the Desert of Sinai,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord spoke again to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai. He said,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses in the Desert of Sinai,

verses.textZh: "你要照着利未人的父家、宗族，数点他们；所有男丁，一个月及以上的，你都要数点。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要照着利未人的父家、宗族，数点他们；所有男丁，一个月及以上的，你都要数点。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要照利未人的宗族、家室数点他们。凡一个月以外的男子都要数点。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Count the Levites by their families and clans. Count every male a month old or more."
verses.textEnEsv: "List the sons of Levi, by fathers’ houses and by clans; every male from a month old and upward you shall list."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Number the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families; you shall number every male from a month old and above."
verses.textEnNlt: "Record the names of the members of the tribe of Levi by their families and clans. List every male who is one month old or older."
verses.textEnNasb: " Count the sons of Levi by their fathers’ households, by their families; every male from a month old and upward you shall count."
verses.textEn: "Count the Levites by their families and clans. Count every male a month old or more."

verses.textZh: 于是，摩西照着耶和华的命令，就是耶和华吩咐他的，数点了利未人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，摩西照着耶和华的命令，就是耶和华吩咐他的，数点了利未人。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是摩西照耶和华所吩咐的数点他们。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses counted them, as he was commanded by the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses listed them according to the word of the Lord , as he was commanded.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses numbered them according to the word of the Lord, as he was commanded.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses listed them, just as the Lord had commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses counted them according to the word of the Lord, just as he had been commanded.
verses.textEn: So Moses counted them, as he was commanded by the word of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 利未众子的名字是：革顺、哥辖、米拉利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未众子的名字是：革顺、哥辖、米拉利。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未众子的名字是革顺、哥辖、米拉利。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the names of the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.
verses.textEnEsv: And these were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon and Kohath and Merari.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.textEnNlt: Levi had three sons, whose names were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.textEnNasb: These, then, are the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.textEn: These were the names of the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

verses.textZh: 革顺儿子的名字，按着宗族，是立尼和示每。
verses.textZhCnvs: 革顺儿子的名字，按着宗族，是立尼和示每。
verses.textZhCuv: 革顺的儿子，按着家室，是立尼、示每。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the names of the Gershonite clans: Libni and Shimei.
verses.textEnEsv: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their clans: Libni and Shimei.
verses.textEnNkjv: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.
verses.textEnNlt: The clans descended from Gershon were named after two of his descendants, Libni and Shimei.
verses.textEnNasb: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei;
verses.textEn: These were the names of the Gershonite clans: Libni and Shimei.

verses.textZh: 哥辖的儿子，按着宗族，是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦、乌薛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哥辖的儿子，按着宗族，是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦、乌薛。
verses.textZhCuv: 哥辖的儿子，按着家室，是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦、乌薛。
verses.textEnNiv: The Kohathite clans: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
verses.textEnEsv: And the sons of Kohath by their clans: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.textEnNlt: The clans descended from Kohath were named after four of his descendants, Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.textEnNasb: and the sons of Kohath by their families: Amram and Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel;
verses.textEn: The Kohathite clans: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.

verses.textZh: 米拉利的儿子，按着宗族，是抹利、母示。这些人按着他们的父家，都是利未人的宗族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米拉利的儿子，按着宗族，是抹利、母示。这些人按着他们的父家，都是利未人的宗族。
verses.textZhCuv: 米拉利的儿子，按着家室，是抹利、母示。这些按着宗族是利未人的家室。
verses.textEnNiv: The Merarite clans: Mahli and Mushi. These were the Levite clans, according to their families.
verses.textEnEsv: And the sons of Merari by their clans: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites, by their fathers’ houses.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites by their fathers’ houses.
verses.textEnNlt: The clans descended from Merari were named after two of his descendants, Mahli and Mushi. These were the Levite clans, listed according to their family groups.
verses.textEnNasb: and the sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.
verses.textEn: The Merarite clans: Mahli and Mushi. These were the Levite clans, according to their families.

verses.textZh: 属革顺的，有立尼家族和示每家族；这是革顺人的家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属革顺的，有立尼家族和示每家族；这是革顺人的家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 属革顺的，有立尼族、示每族。这是革顺的二族。
verses.textEnNiv: To Gershon belonged the clans of the Libnites and Shimeites; these were the Gershonite clans.
verses.textEnEsv: To Gershon belonged the clan of the Libnites and the clan of the Shimeites; these were the clans of the Gershonites.
verses.textEnNkjv: From Gershon came the family of the Libnites and the family of the Shimites; these were the families of the Gershonites.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Gershon were composed of the clans descended from Libni and Shimei.
verses.textEnNasb: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites and the family of the Shimeites; these were the families of the Gershonites.
verses.textEn: To Gershon belonged the clans of the Libnites and Shimeites; these were the Gershonite clans.

verses.textZh: 根据所有男丁的数目，一个月及以上，被数点的，共有七千五百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 根据所有男丁的数目，一个月及以上，被数点的，共有七千五百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中被数、从一个月以外所有的男子共有七千五百名。
verses.textEnNiv: The number of all the males a month old or more who were counted was 7,500.
verses.textEnEsv: Their listing according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward was 7,500.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who were numbered, according to the number of all the males from a month old and above—of those who were numbered therewere seven thousand five hundred.
verses.textEnNlt: There were 7,500 males one month old or older among these Gershonite clans.
verses.textEnNasb: Their numbered men, in the counting of every male from a month old and upward, their numbered men were 7,500.
verses.textEn: The number of all the males a month old or more who were counted was 7,500.

verses.textZh: 革顺人的家族，要在帐幕的后面，就是西方安营；
verses.textZhCnvs: 革顺人的家族，要在帐幕的后面，就是西方安营；
verses.textZhCuv: 这革顺的二族要在帐幕后西边安营。
verses.textEnNiv: The Gershonite clans were to camp on the west, behind the tabernacle.
verses.textEnEsv: The clans of the Gershonites were to camp behind the tabernacle on the west,
verses.textEnNkjv: The families of the Gershonites were to camp behind the tabernacle westward.
verses.textEnNlt: They were assigned the area to the west of the Tabernacle for their camp.
verses.textEnNasb: The families of the Gershonites were to camp behind the tabernacle westward,
verses.textEn: The Gershonite clans were to camp on the west, behind the tabernacle.

verses.textZh: 革顺人家族的领袖是拉伊勒的儿子以利雅萨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 革顺人家族的领袖是拉伊勒的儿子以利雅萨。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉伊勒的儿子以利雅萨作革顺人宗族的首领。
verses.textEnNiv: The leader of the families of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael.
verses.textEnEsv: with Eliasaph, the son of Lael as chief of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the leader of the father’s house of the Gershonites was Eliasaph the son of Lael.
verses.textEnNlt: The leader of the Gershonite clans was Eliasaph son of Lael.
verses.textEnNasb: and the leader of the fathers’ households of the Gershonites: Eliasaph the son of Lael.
verses.textEn: The leader of the families of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael.

verses.textZh: 革顺的子孙在会幕中的职分，是看守帐幕、罩棚、罩棚的顶盖和会幕门口的帘子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 革顺的子孙在会幕中的职分，是看守帐幕、罩棚、罩棚的顶盖和会幕门口的帘子，
verses.textZhCuv: 革顺的子孙在会幕中所要看守的，就是帐幕和罩棚，并罩棚的盖与会幕的门帘，
verses.textEnNiv: At the tent of meeting the Gershonites were responsible for the care of the tabernacle and tent, its coverings, the curtain at the entrance to the tent of meeting,
verses.textEnEsv: And the guard duty of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting involved the tabernacle, the tent with its covering, the screen for the entrance of the tent of meeting,
verses.textEnNkjv: The duties of the children of Gershon in the tabernacle of meeting included the tabernacle, the tent with its covering, the screen for the door of the tabernacle of meeting,
verses.textEnNlt: These two clans were responsible to care for the Tabernacle, including the sacred tent with its layers of coverings, the curtain at its entrance,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the duties of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting included the tabernacle and the tent, its covering, and the curtain for the entrance of the tent of meeting,
verses.textEn: At the tent of meeting the Gershonites were responsible for the care of the tabernacle and tent, its coverings, the curtain at the entrance to the tent of meeting,

verses.textZh: 还有院子的帷幔、院子门口的帘子 ，以及院子使用的一切绳子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有院子的帷幔、院子门口的帘子 ，以及院子使用的一切绳子。
verses.textZhCuv: 院子的帷子和门帘（院子是围帐幕和坛的），并一切使用的绳子。
verses.textEnNiv: the curtains of the courtyard, the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard surrounding the tabernacle and altar, and the ropes—and everything related to their use.
verses.textEnEsv: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the court that is around the tabernacle and the altar, and its cords—all the service connected with these.
verses.textEnNkjv: the screen for the door of the court, the hangings of the court which are around the tabernacle and the altar, and their cords, according to all the work relating to them.
verses.textEnNlt: the curtains of the courtyard that surrounded the Tabernacle and altar, the curtain at the courtyard entrance, the ropes, and all the equipment related to their use.
verses.textEnNasb: and the curtains of the courtyard, the curtain for the entrance of the courtyard which is around the tabernacle and the altar, and its ropes, according to all the service concerning them.
verses.textEn: the curtains of the courtyard, the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard surrounding the tabernacle and altar, and the ropes—and everything related to their use.

verses.textZh: 属哥辖的，有暗兰家族、以斯哈家族、希伯伦家族和乌薛家族；这是哥辖人的家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属哥辖的，有暗兰家族、以斯哈家族、希伯伦家族和乌薛家族；这是哥辖人的家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 属哥辖的，有暗兰族、以斯哈族、希伯伦族、乌薛族。这是哥辖的诸族。
verses.textEnNiv: To Kohath belonged the clans of the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites and Uzzielites; these were the Kohathite clans.
verses.textEnEsv: To Kohath belonged the clan of the Amramites and the clan of the Izharites and the clan of the Hebronites and the clan of the Uzzielites; these are the clans of the Kohathites.
verses.textEnNkjv: From Kohath came the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites; these were the families of the Kohathites.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Kohath were composed of the clans descended from Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.textEnNasb: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites; these were the families of the Kohathites.
verses.textEn: To Kohath belonged the clans of the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites and Uzzielites; these were the Kohathite clans.

verses.textZh: 根据所有男丁的数目，一个月及以上的，共有八千六百人；他们要尽看守圣所的职分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 根据所有男丁的数目，一个月及以上的，共有八千六百人；他们要尽看守圣所的职分。
verses.textZhCuv: 按所有男子的数目，从一个月以外看守圣所的，共有八千六百名。
verses.textEnNiv: The number of all the males a month old or more was 8,600. The Kohathites were responsible for the care of the sanctuary.
verses.textEnEsv: According to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, there were 8,600, keeping guard over the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNkjv: According to the number of all the males, from a month old and above, therewere eight thousand six hundred keeping charge of the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNlt: There were 8,600 males one month old or older among these Kohathite clans. They were responsible for the care of the sanctuary,
verses.textEnNasb: In the counting of every male from a month old and upward, there were 8,600, performing the duties of the sanctuary.
verses.textEn: The number of all the males a month old or more was 8,600. The Kohathites were responsible for the care of the sanctuary.

verses.textZh: 哥辖子孙的家族要在帐幕的南方安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哥辖子孙的家族要在帐幕的南方安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 哥辖儿子的诸族要在帐幕的南边安营。
verses.textEnNiv: The Kohathite clans were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnEsv: The clans of the sons of Kohath were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle,
verses.textEnNkjv: The families of the children of Kohath were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: and they were assigned the area south of the Tabernacle for their camp.
verses.textEnNasb: The families of the sons of Kohath were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle,
verses.textEn: The Kohathite clans were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle.

verses.textZh: 哥辖家族的领袖是乌薛的儿子以利撒反。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哥辖家族的领袖是乌薛的儿子以利撒反。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌薛的儿子以利撒反作哥辖宗族家室的首领。
verses.textEnNiv: The leader of the families of the Kohathite clans was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
verses.textEnEsv: with Elizaphan the son of Uzziel as chief of the fathers’ house of the clans of the Kohathites.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the leader of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites was Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
verses.textEnNlt: The leader of the Kohathite clans was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
verses.textEnNasb: and the leader of the fathers’ households of the Kohathite families: Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
verses.textEn: The leader of the families of the Kohathite clans was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.

verses.textZh: 他们的职分是管理约柜、桌子、灯台、两座坛，以及他们在圣所内使用的器具、帘子和帐幕里使用的一切东西。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的职分是管理约柜、桌子、灯台、两座坛，以及他们在圣所内使用的器具、帘子和帐幕里使用的一切东西。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们所要看守的是约柜、桌子、灯台、两座坛与圣所内使用的器皿，并帘子和一切使用之物。
verses.textEnNiv: They were responsible for the care of the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the articles of the sanctuary used in ministering, the curtain, and everything related to their use.
verses.textEnEsv: And their guard duty involved the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which the priests minister, and the screen; all the service connected with these.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their duty included the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the utensils of the sanctuary with which they ministered, the screen, and all the work relating to them.
verses.textEnNlt: These four clans were responsible for the care of the Ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the various articles used in the sanctuary, the inner curtain, and all the equipment related to their use.
verses.textEnNasb: Now their duties included the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the utensils of the sanctuary with which they minister, the curtain, and all the service concerning them;
verses.textEn: They were responsible for the care of the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the articles of the sanctuary used in ministering, the curtain, and everything related to their use.

verses.textZh: 亚伦祭司的儿子以利亚撒要作利未人众领袖中的领袖，要监察那些尽看守圣所职分的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦祭司的儿子以利亚撒要作利未人众领袖中的领袖，要监察那些尽看守圣所职分的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司亚伦的儿子以利亚撒作利未人众首领的领袖，要监察那些看守圣所的人。
verses.textEnNiv: The chief leader of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest. He was appointed over those who were responsible for the care of the sanctuary.
verses.textEnEsv: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest was to be chief over the chiefs of the Levites, and to have oversight of those who kept guard over the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest wastobe chief over the leaders of the Levites, with oversight of those who kept charge of the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNlt: Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, was the chief administrator over all the Levites, with special responsibility for the oversight of the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNasb: and Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest was the head of the leaders of Levi, and he had the supervision of those who performed the duties of the sanctuary.
verses.textEn: The chief leader of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest. He was appointed over those who were responsible for the care of the sanctuary.

verses.textZh: 属米拉利的，有抹利家族和母示家族；这些是米拉利的家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属米拉利的，有抹利家族和母示家族；这些是米拉利的家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 属米拉利的，有抹利族、母示族。这是米拉利的二族。
verses.textEnNiv: To Merari belonged the clans of the Mahlites and the Mushites; these were the Merarite clans.
verses.textEnEsv: To Merari belonged the clan of the Mahlites and the clan of the Mushites: these are the clans of Merari.
verses.textEnNkjv: From Merari came the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites; these were the families of Merari.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Merari were composed of the clans descended from Mahli and Mushi.
verses.textEnNasb: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites; these were the families of Merari.
verses.textEn: To Merari belonged the clans of the Mahlites and the Mushites; these were the Merarite clans.

verses.textZh: 根据所有男丁的数目，一个月及以上，被数点的，共有六千二百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 根据所有男丁的数目，一个月及以上，被数点的，共有六千二百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们被数的，按所有男子的数目，从一个月以外的，共有六千二百名。
verses.textEnNiv: The number of all the males a month old or more who were counted was 6,200.
verses.textEnEsv: Their listing according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward was 6,200.
verses.textEnNkjv: And those who were numbered, according to the number of all the males from a month old and above, were six thousand two hundred.
verses.textEnNlt: There were 6,200 males one month old or older among these Merarite clans.
verses.textEnNasb: Their numbered men in the counting of every male from a month old and upward: 6,200.
verses.textEn: The number of all the males a month old or more who were counted was 6,200.

verses.textZh: 米拉利二家族的领袖，是亚比亥的儿子苏列；他们要在帐幕的北方安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米拉利二家族的领袖，是亚比亥的儿子苏列；他们要在帐幕的北方安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比亥的儿子苏列作米拉利二宗族的首领。他们要在帐幕的北边安营。
verses.textEnNiv: The leader of the families of the Merarite clans was Zuriel son of Abihail; they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnEsv: And the chief of the fathers’ house of the clans of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNkjv: The leader of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. These were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: They were assigned the area north of the Tabernacle for their camp. The leader of the Merarite clans was Zuriel son of Abihail.
verses.textEnNasb: And the leader of the fathers’ households of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They were to camp on the northward side of the tabernacle.
verses.textEn: The leader of the families of the Merarite clans was Zuriel son of Abihail; they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.

verses.textZh: 米拉利子孙的职分，是看守帐幕的木板、门闩、柱子、插座、一切器具，以及负责一切有关的事务，
verses.textZhCnvs: 米拉利子孙的职分，是看守帐幕的木板、门闩、柱子、插座、一切器具，以及负责一切有关的事务，
verses.textZhCuv: 米拉利子孙的职分是看守帐幕的板、闩、柱子、带卯的座，和帐幕一切所使用的器具，
verses.textEnNiv: The Merarites were appointed to take care of the frames of the tabernacle, its crossbars, posts, bases, all its equipment, and everything related to their use,
verses.textEnEsv: And the appointed guard duty of the sons of Merari involved the frames of the tabernacle, the bars, the pillars, the bases, and all their accessories; all the service connected with these;
verses.textEnNkjv: And the appointed duty of the children of Merari included the boards of the tabernacle, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, its utensils, all the work relating to them,
verses.textEnNlt: These two clans were responsible for the care of the frames supporting the Tabernacle, the crossbars, the pillars, the bases, and all the equipment related to their use.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the appointment of duties of the sons of Merari included the framework of the tabernacle, its bars, its pillars, its bases, all its equipment, and all the service concerning them,
verses.textEn: The Merarites were appointed to take care of the frames of the tabernacle, its crossbars, posts, bases, all its equipment, and everything related to their use,

verses.textZh: 还有看守院子四周的柱子、插座、橛子和绳子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有看守院子四周的柱子、插座、橛子和绳子。
verses.textZhCuv: 院子四围的柱子、带卯的座、橛子，和绳子。
verses.textEnNiv: as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs and ropes.
verses.textEnEsv: also the pillars around the court, with their bases and pegs and cords.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the pillars of the court all around, with their sockets, their pegs, and their cords.
verses.textEnNlt: They were also responsible for the posts of the courtyard and all their bases, pegs, and ropes.
verses.textEnNasb: and the pillars around the courtyard with their bases, their pegs, and their ropes.
verses.textEn: as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs and ropes.

verses.textZh: 在帐幕前面东边，就是在会幕前向日出的方向安营的，是摩西、亚伦和亚伦的儿子；他们代替以色列人应尽的职责，看守圣所；外人近前来，必被治死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在帐幕前面东边，就是在会幕前向日出的方向安营的，是摩西、亚伦和亚伦的儿子；他们代替以色列人应尽的职责，看守圣所；外人近前来，必被治死。
verses.textZhCuv: 在帐幕前东边，向日出之地安营的是摩西、亚伦，和亚伦的儿子。他们看守圣所，替以色列人守耶和华所吩咐的。近前来的外人必被治死。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses and Aaron and his sons were to camp to the east of the tabernacle, toward the sunrise, in front of the tent of meeting. They were responsible for the care of the sanctuary on behalf of the Israelites. Anyone else who approached the sanctuary was to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who were to camp before the tabernacle on the east, before the tent of meeting toward the sunrise, were Moses and Aaron and his sons, guarding the sanctuary itself, to protect the people of Israel. And any outsider who came near was to be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover those who were to camp before the tabernacle on the east, before the tabernacle of meeting, were Moses, Aaron, and his sons, keeping charge of the sanctuary, to meet the needs of the children of Israel; but the outsider who came near was to be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: The area in front of the Tabernacle, in the east toward the sunrise, was reserved for the tents of Moses and of Aaron and his sons, who had the final responsibility for the sanctuary on behalf of the people of Israel. Anyone other than a priest or Levite who went too near the sanctuary was to be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: Now those who were to camp in front of the tabernacle eastward, in front of the tent of meeting toward the sunrise, were Moses and Aaron and his sons, performing the duties of the sanctuary for the obligation of the sons of Israel; but the layman coming near was to be put to death.
verses.textEn: Moses and Aaron and his sons were to camp to the east of the tabernacle, toward the sunrise, in front of the tent of meeting. They were responsible for the care of the sanctuary on behalf of the Israelites. Anyone else who approached the sanctuary was to be put to death.

verses.textZh: 摩西和亚伦照着耶和华的命令，数点了所有的利未人；按着家族，凡是男丁，一个月及以上被数点的，共有二万二千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和亚伦照着耶和华的命令，数点了所有的利未人；按着家族，凡是男丁，一个月及以上被数点的，共有二万二千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡被数的利未人，就是摩西、亚伦照耶和华吩咐所数的，按着家室，从一个月以外的男子，共有二万二千名。
verses.textEnNiv: The total number of Levites counted at the Lord ’s command by Moses and Aaron according to their clans, including every male a month old or more, was 22,000.
verses.textEnEsv: All those listed among the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron listed at the commandment of the Lord , by clans, all the males from a month old and upward, were 22,000.
verses.textEnNkjv: All who were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the Lord, by their families, all the males from a month old and above, were twenty-two thousand.
verses.textEnNlt: When Moses and Aaron counted the Levite clans at the Lord ’s command, the total number was 22,000 males one month old or older.
verses.textEnNasb: All the numbered men of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the command of the Lord by their families, every male from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.
verses.textEn: The total number of Levites counted at the Lord ’s command by Moses and Aaron according to their clans, including every male a month old or more, was 22,000.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："以色列人中所有头生的男子，一个月及以上的，你都要数点；登记他们的姓名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："以色列人中所有头生的男子，一个月及以上的，你都要数点；登记他们的姓名。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你要从以色列人中数点一个月以外、凡头生的男子，把他们的名字记下。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses, "Count all the firstborn Israelite males who are a month old or more and make a list of their names.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "List all the firstborn males of the people of Israel, from a month old and upward, taking the number of their names.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses: "Number all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from a month old and above, and take the number of their names.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Now count all the firstborn sons in Israel who are one month old or older, and make a list of their names.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Count every firstborn male of the sons of Israel from a month old and upward, and make a list of their names.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses, "Count all the firstborn Israelite males who are a month old or more and make a list of their names.

verses.textZh: 我是耶和华，你要把利未人归我，代替以色列人所有头生的；也要把利未人的牲畜归我，代替以色列人中一切头生的牲畜。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是耶和华，你要把利未人归我，代替以色列人所有头生的；也要把利未人的牲畜归我，代替以色列人中一切头生的牲畜。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我是耶和华。你要拣选利未人归我，代替以色列人所有头生的，也取利未人的牲畜代替以色列所有头生的牲畜。」
verses.textEnNiv: Take the Levites for me in place of all the firstborn of the Israelites, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the livestock of the Israelites. I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall take the Levites for me—I am the Lord —instead of all the firstborn among the people of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the cattle of the people of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall take the Levites for Me—I am the Lord—instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: The Levites must be reserved for me as substitutes for the firstborn sons of Israel; I am the Lord . And the Levites’ livestock must be reserved for me as substitutes for the firstborn livestock of the whole nation of Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall take the Levites for Me—I am the Lord—instead of all the firstborn among the sons of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the cattle of the sons of Israel."
verses.textEn: Take the Levites for me in place of all the firstborn of the Israelites, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the livestock of the Israelites. I am the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 摩西就照着耶和华吩咐他的，把以色列人所有头生的都数点了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西就照着耶和华吩咐他的，把以色列人所有头生的都数点了。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西就照耶和华所吩咐的把以色列人头生的都数点了。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses counted all the firstborn of the Israelites, as the Lord commanded him.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses listed all the firstborn among the people of Israel, as the Lord commanded him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses numbered all the firstborn among the children of Israel, as the Lord commanded him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses counted the firstborn sons of the people of Israel, just as the Lord had commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses counted all the firstborn among the sons of Israel, just as the Lord had commanded him;
verses.textEn: So Moses counted all the firstborn of the Israelites, as the Lord commanded him.

verses.textZh: 根据人名的数目，一个月及以上，凡是头生的男子，被数点的，共有二万二千二百七十三个。
verses.textZhCnvs: 根据人名的数目，一个月及以上，凡是头生的男子，被数点的，共有二万二千二百七十三个。
verses.textZhCuv: 按人名的数目，从一个月以外、凡头生的男子，共有二万二千二百七十三名。
verses.textEnNiv: The total number of firstborn males a month old or more, listed by name, was 22,273.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the firstborn males, according to the number of names, from a month old and upward as listed were 22,273.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the firstborn males, according to the number of names from a month old and above, of those who were numbered of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred and seventy-three.
verses.textEnNlt: The number of firstborn sons who were one month old or older was 22,273.
verses.textEnNasb: and all the firstborn males, by the number of names from a month old and upward for their numbered men, were 22,273.
verses.textEn: The total number of firstborn males a month old or more, listed by name, was 22,273.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord also said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord also said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要拣选利未人代替以色列人所有头生的，也要拣选利未人的牲畜代替以色列人的牲畜；利未人要归我，我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要拣选利未人代替以色列人所有头生的，也要拣选利未人的牲畜代替以色列人的牲畜；利未人要归我，我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你拣选利未人代替以色列人所有头生的，也取利未人的牲畜代替以色列人的牲畜。利未人要归我；我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: "Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock. The Levites are to be mine. I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the people of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle. The Levites shall be mine: I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock. The Levites shall be Mine: I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Take the Levites as substitutes for the firstborn sons of the people of Israel. And take the livestock of the Levites as substitutes for the firstborn livestock of the people of Israel. The Levites belong to me; I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the sons of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites in place of their cattle. And the Levites shall be Mine; I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock. The Levites are to be mine. I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 至于那超过利未人总数的二百七十三个，需要赎回的以色列人的长子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于那超过利未人总数的二百七十三个，需要赎回的以色列人的长子，
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人中头生的男子比利未人多二百七十三个，必当将他们赎出来。
verses.textEnNiv: To redeem the 273 firstborn Israelites who exceed the number of the Levites,
verses.textEnEsv: And as the redemption price for the 273 of the firstborn of the people of Israel, over and above the number of the male Levites,
verses.textEnNkjv: And for the redemption of the two hundred and seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel, who are more than the number of the Levites,
verses.textEnNlt: There are 273 more firstborn sons of Israel than there are Levites. To redeem these extra firstborn sons,
verses.textEnNasb: And as a redemption price for the 273 of the firstborn of the sons of Israel who are in excess of the number of the Levites,
verses.textEn: To redeem the 273 firstborn Israelites who exceed the number of the Levites,

verses.textZh: 你要每人收取赎银五十七克，要按照人数，根据圣所的秤收取，就是按照圣所的标准重量 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要每人收取赎银五十七克，要按照人数，根据圣所的秤收取，就是按照圣所的标准重量 。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要按人丁，照圣所的平，每人取赎银五舍客勒（一舍客勒是二十季拉），
verses.textEnNiv: collect five shekels for each one, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs.
verses.textEnEsv: you shall take five shekels per head; you shall take them according to the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel of twenty gerahs ),
verses.textEnNkjv: you shall take five shekels for each one individually; you shall take them in the currency of the shekel of the sanctuary, the shekel of twenty gerahs.
verses.textEnNlt: collect five pieces of silver for each of them (each piece weighing the same as the sanctuary shekel, which equals twenty gerahs).
verses.textEnNasb: you shall take five shekels apiece, per head; you shall take them in terms of the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs),
verses.textEn: collect five shekels for each one, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs.

verses.textZh: 你要把那超额人数的赎银，交给亚伦和他的儿子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把那超额人数的赎银，交给亚伦和他的儿子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 把那多余之人的赎银交给亚伦和他的儿子。」
verses.textEnNiv: Give the money for the redemption of the additional Israelites to Aaron and his sons."
verses.textEnEsv: and give the money to Aaron and his sons as the redemption price for those who are over."
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall give the money, with which the excess number of them is redeemed, to Aaron and his sons."
verses.textEnNlt: Give the silver to Aaron and his sons as the redemption price for the extra firstborn sons."
verses.textEnNasb: and you shall give the money, the redemption price of those who are in excess among them, to Aaron and to his sons."
verses.textEn: Give the money for the redemption of the additional Israelites to Aaron and his sons."

verses.textZh: 于是，摩西就从那些被利未人赎回以外的人收取赎银；
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，摩西就从那些被利未人赎回以外的人收取赎银；
verses.textZhCuv: 于是摩西从那被利未人所赎以外的人取了赎银。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses collected the redemption money from those who exceeded the number redeemed by the Levites.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses took the redemption money from those who were over and above those redeemed by the Levites.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses took the redemption money from those who were over and above those who were redeemed by the Levites.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses collected the silver for redeeming the firstborn sons of Israel who exceeded the number of Levites.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses took the redemption money from those who were in excess of the number of those redeemed by the Levites;
verses.textEn: So Moses collected the redemption money from those who exceeded the number redeemed by the Levites.

verses.textZh: 从头生的以色列人收取的银子，根据圣所的秤，共有约十五公斤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从头生的以色列人收取的银子，根据圣所的秤，共有约十五公斤。
verses.textZhCuv: 从以色列人头生的所取之银，按圣所的平，有一千三百六十五舍客勒。
verses.textEnNiv: From the firstborn of the Israelites he collected silver weighing 1,365 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
verses.textEnEsv: From the firstborn of the people of Israel he took the money, 1,365 shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNkjv: From the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, one thousand three hundred and sixty-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNlt: He collected 1,365 pieces of silver on behalf of these firstborn sons of Israel (each piece weighing the same as the sanctuary shekel).
verses.textEnNasb: from the firstborn of the sons of Israel he took the money in terms of the shekel of the sanctuary, 1,365.
verses.textEn: From the firstborn of the Israelites he collected silver weighing 1,365 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.

verses.textZh: 摩西照着耶和华的吩咐，把这赎银交给了亚伦和他的儿子，正如耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西照着耶和华的吩咐，把这赎银交给了亚伦和他的儿子，正如耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西照耶和华的话把这赎银给亚伦和他的儿子，正如耶和华所吩咐的。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons, as he was commanded by the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons, according to the word of the Lord , as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses gave their redemption money to Aaron and his sons, according to the word of the Lord, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: And Moses gave the silver for the redemption to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons, at the command of the Lord, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons, as he was commanded by the word of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西、亚伦说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron:
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron:

verses.textZh: "你要从利未人中，登记哥辖子孙的总数，照着他们的家族、父家，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要从利未人中，登记哥辖子孙的总数，照着他们的家族、父家，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你从利未人中，将哥辖子孙的总数，照他们的家室、宗族，
verses.textEnNiv: "Take a census of the Kohathite branch of the Levites by their clans and families.
verses.textEnEsv: "Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their clans and their fathers’ houses,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the children of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ house,
verses.textEnNlt: "Record the names of the members of the clans and families of the Kohathite division of the tribe of Levi.
verses.textEnNasb: "Take a census of the descendants of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ households,
verses.textEn: "Take a census of the Kohathite branch of the Levites by their clans and families.

verses.textZh: 从三十岁以上，直到五十岁，能进来供职，在会幕里工作的，你都要登记。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从三十岁以上，直到五十岁，能进来供职，在会幕里工作的，你都要登记。
verses.textZhCuv: 从三十岁直到五十岁，凡前来任职、在会幕里办事的，全都计算。
verses.textEnNiv: Count all the men from thirty to fifty years of age who come to serve in the work at the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: from thirty years old up to fifty years old, all who can come on duty, to do the work in the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNkjv: from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, all who enter the service to do the work in the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: List all the men between the ages of thirty and fifty who are eligible to serve in the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: from thirty years old and upward, even to fifty years old, everyone who can enter the service of ministry to do work in the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: Count all the men from thirty to fifty years of age who come to serve in the work at the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 哥辖子孙在会幕里的工作就是管理至圣之物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哥辖子孙在会幕里的工作就是管理至圣之物。
verses.textZhCuv: 哥辖子孙在会幕搬运至圣之物，所办的事乃是这样：
verses.textEnNiv: "This is the work of the Kohathites at the tent of meeting: the care of the most holy things.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting: the most holy things.
verses.textEnNkjv: "This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of meeting, relatingto the most holy things:
verses.textEnNlt: "The duties of the Kohathites at the Tabernacle will relate to the most sacred objects.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the work of the descendants of Kohath in the tent of meeting, concerning the most holy things.
verses.textEn: "This is the work of the Kohathites at the tent of meeting: the care of the most holy things.

verses.textZh: 起营出发的时候，亚伦和他的儿子要进去，把遮盖至圣所的幔子卸下来，用来遮盖约柜；
verses.textZhCnvs: 起营出发的时候，亚伦和他的儿子要进去，把遮盖至圣所的幔子卸下来，用来遮盖约柜；
verses.textZhCuv: 起营的时候，亚伦和他儿子要进去摘下遮掩柜的幔子，用以蒙盖法柜，
verses.textEnNiv: When the camp is to move, Aaron and his sons are to go in and take down the shielding curtain and put it over the ark of the covenant law.
verses.textEnEsv: When the camp is to set out, Aaron and his sons shall go in and take down the veil of the screen and cover the ark of the testimony with it.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the camp prepares to journey, Aaron and his sons shall come, and they shall take down the covering veil and cover the ark of the Testimony with it.
verses.textEnNlt: When the camp moves, Aaron and his sons must enter the Tabernacle first to take down the inner curtain and cover the Ark of the Covenant with it.
verses.textEnNasb: "When the camp sets out, Aaron and his sons shall go in and take down the veil of the curtain, and cover the ark of the testimony with it;
verses.textEn: When the camp is to move, Aaron and his sons are to go in and take down the shielding curtain and put it over the ark of the covenant law.

verses.textZh: 又把海狗皮罩盖在上面，再铺上纯蓝色的布，然后把杠穿上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把海狗皮罩盖在上面，再铺上纯蓝色的布，然后把杠穿上。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用海狗皮盖在上头，再蒙上纯蓝色的毯子，把杠穿上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they are to cover the curtain with a durable leather, spread a cloth of solid blue over that and put the poles in place.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they shall put on it a covering of goatskin and spread on top of that a cloth all of blue, and shall put in its poles.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they shall put on it a covering of badger skins, and spread over that a cloth entirely of blue; and they shall insert its poles.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they must cover the inner curtain with fine goatskin leather and spread over that a single piece of blue cloth. Finally, they must put the carrying poles of the Ark in place.
verses.textEnNasb: and they shall place a covering of fine leather on it, and spread over it a cloth of pure violet, and insert its carrying poles.
verses.textEn: Then they are to cover the curtain with a durable leather, spread a cloth of solid blue over that and put the poles in place.

verses.textZh: 在陈设饼的桌子上，他们要铺上蓝色布，把盘子、碟子、杯和奠酒的爵摆在上面，桌子上也必须有常献饼；
verses.textZhCnvs: 在陈设饼的桌子上，他们要铺上蓝色布，把盘子、碟子、杯和奠酒的爵摆在上面，桌子上也必须有常献饼；
verses.textZhCuv: 又用蓝色毯子铺在陈设饼的桌子上，将盘子、调羹、奠酒的爵，和杯摆在上头。桌子上也必有常设的饼。
verses.textEnNiv: "Over the table of the Presence they are to spread a blue cloth and put on it the plates, dishes and bowls, and the jars for drink offerings; the bread that is continually there is to remain on it.
verses.textEnEsv: And over the table of the bread of the Presence they shall spread a cloth of blue and put on it the plates, the dishes for incense, the bowls, and the flagons for the drink offering; the regular showbread also shall be on it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "On the table of showbread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the pans, the bowls, and the pitchers for pouring; and the showbread shall be on it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Next they must spread a blue cloth over the table where the Bread of the Presence is displayed, and on the cloth they will place the bowls, ladles, jars, pitchers, and the special bread.
verses.textEnNasb: Over the table of the bread of the Presence they shall also spread a cloth of violet and put on it the dishes, the pans, the sacrificial bowls, and the jugs for the drink offering; and the continual bread shall be on it.
verses.textEn: "Over the table of the Presence they are to spread a blue cloth and put on it the plates, dishes and bowls, and the jars for drink offerings; the bread that is continually there is to remain on it.

verses.textZh: 在这些物件上面，他们要铺上朱红色布，再盖上海狗皮罩，然后把杠穿上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这些物件上面，他们要铺上朱红色布，再盖上海狗皮罩，然后把杠穿上。
verses.textZhCuv: 在其上又要蒙朱红色的毯子，再蒙上海狗皮，把杠穿上。
verses.textEnNiv: They are to spread a scarlet cloth over them, cover that with the durable leather and put the poles in place.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they shall spread over them a cloth of scarlet and cover the same with a covering of goatskin, and shall put in its poles.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall spread over them a scarlet cloth, and cover the same with a covering of badger skins; and they shall insert its poles.
verses.textEnNlt: They must spread a scarlet cloth over all of this, and finally a covering of fine goatskin leather on top of the scarlet cloth. Then they must insert the carrying poles into the table.
verses.textEnNasb: And they shall spread over them a cloth of scarlet material, and cover the same with a covering of fine leather, and they shall insert its carrying poles.
verses.textEn: They are to spread a scarlet cloth over them, cover that with the durable leather and put the poles in place.

verses.textZh: 他们要拿蓝色布，把灯台和灯台上的灯盏、剪子、蜡花盘，以及为灯台所用一切盛油的器具遮盖起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要拿蓝色布，把灯台和灯台上的灯盏、剪子、蜡花盘，以及为灯台所用一切盛油的器具遮盖起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 要拿蓝色毯子，把灯台和灯台上所用的灯盏、剪子、蜡花盘，并一切盛油的器皿，全都遮盖。
verses.textEnNiv: "They are to take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand that is for light, together with its lamps, its wick trimmers and trays, and all its jars for the olive oil used to supply it.
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall take a cloth of blue and cover the lampstand for the light, with its lamps, its tongs, its trays, and all the vessels for oil with which it is supplied.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand of the light, with its lamps, its wick-trimmers, its trays, and all its oil vessels, with which they service it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Next they must cover the lampstand with a blue cloth, along with its lamps, lamp snuffers, trays, and special jars of olive oil.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they shall take a violet cloth and cover the lampstand for the light, along with its lamps, its tongs, its trays, and all its oil containers, by which they attend to it;
