verses.textEn: "They are to take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand that is for light, together with its lamps, its wick trimmers and trays, and all its jars for the olive oil used to supply it.

verses.textZh: 他们又要把灯台和灯台的一切器具，都包在海狗皮里，然后放在抬架上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又要把灯台和灯台的一切器具，都包在海狗皮里，然后放在抬架上。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要把灯台和灯台的一切器具包在海狗皮里，放在抬架上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they are to wrap it and all its accessories in a covering of the durable leather and put it on a carrying frame.
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall put it with all its utensils in a covering of goatskin and put it on the carrying frame.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they shall put it with all its utensils in a covering of badger skins, and put it on a carrying beam.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they must cover the lampstand and its accessories with fine goatskin leather and place the bundle on a carrying frame.
verses.textEnNasb: and they shall put it and all its utensils in a covering of fine leather, and put it on the carrying bars.
verses.textEn: Then they are to wrap it and all its accessories in a covering of the durable leather and put it on a carrying frame.

verses.textZh: 在金坛上面，他们要铺上蓝色布，再盖上海狗皮罩，然后把杠穿上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在金坛上面，他们要铺上蓝色布，再盖上海狗皮罩，然后把杠穿上。
verses.textZhCuv: 在金坛上要铺蓝色毯子，蒙上海狗皮，把杠穿上。
verses.textEnNiv: "Over the gold altar they are to spread a blue cloth and cover that with the durable leather and put the poles in place.
verses.textEnEsv: And over the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue and cover it with a covering of goatskin, and shall put in its poles.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Over the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of badger skins; and they shall insert its poles.
verses.textEnNlt: "Next they must spread a blue cloth over the gold incense altar and cover this cloth with fine goatskin leather. Then they must attach the carrying poles to the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Over the golden altar they shall spread a violet cloth, and cover it with a covering of fine leather, and they shall insert its carrying poles;
verses.textEn: "Over the gold altar they are to spread a blue cloth and cover that with the durable leather and put the poles in place.

verses.textZh: 他们又要把圣所里供职使用的一切器具，都包在蓝色布里，再盖上海狗皮罩，然后放在抬架上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又要把圣所里供职使用的一切器具，都包在蓝色布里，再盖上海狗皮罩，然后放在抬架上。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要把圣所用的一切器具包在蓝色毯子里，用海狗皮蒙上，放在抬架上。
verses.textEnNiv: "They are to take all the articles used for ministering in the sanctuary, wrap them in a blue cloth, cover that with the durable leather and put them on a carrying frame.
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall take all the vessels of the service that are used in the sanctuary and put them in a cloth of blue and cover them with a covering of goatskin and put them on the carrying frame.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they shall take all the utensils of service with which they minister in the sanctuary, put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of badger skins, and put them on a carrying beam.
verses.textEnNlt: They must take all the remaining furnishings of the sanctuary and wrap them in a blue cloth, cover them with fine goatskin leather, and place them on the carrying frame.
verses.textEnNasb: and they shall take all the utensils of service, with which they serve in the sanctuary, and put them in a violet cloth and cover them with a covering of fine leather, and put them on the carrying bars.
verses.textEn: "They are to take all the articles used for ministering in the sanctuary, wrap them in a blue cloth, cover that with the durable leather and put them on a carrying frame.

verses.textZh: 他们要清除坛上的灰，把紫色布铺在坛上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要清除坛上的灰，把紫色布铺在坛上。
verses.textZhCuv: 要收去坛上的灰，把紫色毯子铺在坛上；
verses.textEnNiv: "They are to remove the ashes from the bronze altar and spread a purple cloth over it.
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar and spread a purple cloth over it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth over it.
verses.textEnNlt: "They must remove the ashes from the altar for sacrifices and cover the altar with a purple cloth.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they shall clean away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth over it.
verses.textEn: "They are to remove the ashes from the bronze altar and spread a purple cloth over it.

verses.textZh: 又要把在坛上供职使用的一切器具，就是火鼎、肉叉、铲子、盘子，都摆在上面；再盖上海狗皮罩，然后穿上杠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又要把在坛上供职使用的一切器具，就是火鼎、肉叉、铲子、盘子，都摆在上面；再盖上海狗皮罩，然后穿上杠。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要把所用的一切器具，就是火鼎、肉锸子、铲子、盘子，一切属坛的器具都摆在坛上，又蒙上海狗皮，把杠穿上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they are to place on it all the utensils used for ministering at the altar, including the firepans, meat forks, shovels and sprinkling bowls. Over it they are to spread a covering of the durable leather and put the poles in place.
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall put on it all the utensils of the altar, which are used for the service there, the fire pans, the forks, the shovels, and the basins, all the utensils of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of goatskin, and shall put in its poles.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall put on it all its implements with which they minister there—the firepans, the forks, the shovels, the basins, and all the utensils of the altar—and they shall spread on it a covering of badger skins, and insert its poles.
verses.textEnNlt: All the altar utensils—the firepans, meat forks, shovels, basins, and all the containers—must be placed on the cloth, and a covering of fine goatskin leather must be spread over them. Finally, they must put the carrying poles in place.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall also put on it all its utensils by which they serve in connection with it: the firepans, the forks, shovels, and the basins, all the utensils of the altar; and they shall spread a cover of fine leather over it and insert its carrying poles.
verses.textEn: Then they are to place on it all the utensils used for ministering at the altar, including the firepans, meat forks, shovels and sprinkling bowls. Over it they are to spread a covering of the durable leather and put the poles in place.

verses.textZh: 全营出发的时候，亚伦和他的儿子，把圣所和圣所的一切器具遮盖完了以后，哥辖的子孙就要来抬；只是他们不可触摸圣物，免得他们死亡。会幕里这些物件是哥辖的子孙应当抬的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全营出发的时候，亚伦和他的儿子，把圣所和圣所的一切器具遮盖完了以后，哥辖的子孙就要来抬；只是他们不可触摸圣物，免得他们死亡。会幕里这些物件是哥辖的子孙应当抬的。
verses.textZhCuv: 将要起营的时候，亚伦和他儿子把圣所和圣所的一切器具遮盖完了，哥辖的子孙就要来抬，只是不可摸圣物，免得他们死亡。会幕里这些物件是哥辖子孙所当抬的。
verses.textEnNiv: "After Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy furnishings and all the holy articles, and when the camp is ready to move, only then are the Kohathites to come and do the carrying. But they must not touch the holy things or they will die. The Kohathites are to carry those things that are in the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furnishings of the sanctuary, as the camp sets out, after that the sons of Kohath shall come to carry these, but they must not touch the holy things, lest they die. These are the things of the tent of meeting that the sons of Kohath are to carry.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furnishings of the sanctuary, when the camp is set to go, then the sons of Kohath shall come to carry them; but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. " These are the things in the tabernacle of meeting which the sons of Kohath are to carry.
verses.textEnNlt: The camp will be ready to move when Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the sacred articles. The Kohathites will come and carry these things to the next destination. But they must not touch the sacred objects, or they will die. So these are the things from the Tabernacle that the Kohathites must carry.
verses.textEnNasb: When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy objects and all the furnishings of the sanctuary, when the camp is to set out, after that the sons of Kohath shall come to carry them by the poles, so that they will not touch the holy objects and die. These are the things in the tent of meeting that the sons of Kohath are to carry.
verses.textEn: "After Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy furnishings and all the holy articles, and when the camp is ready to move, only then are the Kohathites to come and do the carrying. But they must not touch the holy things or they will die. The Kohathites are to carry those things that are in the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 亚伦祭司的儿子以利亚撒的职务是看管点灯的油、芬芳的香、常献的素祭和膏油，也要看管整个帐幕和其中所有的一切，以及圣所和圣所的器具。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦祭司的儿子以利亚撒的职务是看管点灯的油、芬芳的香、常献的素祭和膏油，也要看管整个帐幕和其中所有的一切，以及圣所和圣所的器具。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「祭司亚伦的儿子以利亚撒所要看守的是点灯的油与香料，并当献的素祭和膏油，也要看守全帐幕与其中所有的，并圣所和圣所的器具。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, is to have charge of the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the regular grain offering and the anointing oil. He is to be in charge of the entire tabernacle and everything in it, including its holy furnishings and articles."
verses.textEnEsv: "And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall have charge of the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the regular grain offering, and the anointing oil, with the oversight of the whole tabernacle and all that is in it, of the sanctuary and its vessels."
verses.textEnNkjv: "The appointed duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest is the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the daily grain offering, the anointing oil, the oversight of all the tabernacle, of all that is in it, with the sanctuary and its furnishings."
verses.textEnNlt: "Eleazar son of Aaron the priest will be responsible for the oil of the lampstand, the fragrant incense, the daily grain offering, and the anointing oil. In fact, Eleazar will be responsible for the entire Tabernacle and everything in it, including the sanctuary and its furnishings."
verses.textEnNasb: "Now the responsibility of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest is the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the continual grain offering, and the anointing oil—the responsibility of all the tabernacle and everything that is in it, with the sanctuary and its furnishings."
verses.textEn: "Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, is to have charge of the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the regular grain offering and the anointing oil. He is to be in charge of the entire tabernacle and everything in it, including its holy furnishings and articles."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西、亚伦说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

verses.textZh: "你们不可把哥辖家族的派系从利未人中剪除；
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们不可把哥辖家族的派系从利未人中剪除；
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们不可将哥辖人的支派从利未人中剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: "See that the Kohathite tribal clans are not destroyed from among the Levites.
verses.textEnEsv: "Let not the tribe of the clans of the Kohathites be destroyed from among the Levites,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Do not cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not let the Kohathite clans be destroyed from among the Levites!
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not let the tribe of the families of the Kohathites be eliminated from among the Levites.
verses.textEn: "See that the Kohathite tribal clans are not destroyed from among the Levites.

verses.textZh: 他们接近至圣之物的时候，亚伦和他的儿子要进去，指定他们各人当办的和当抬的工作；你们要这样待他们，好让他们活着，不至死亡；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们接近至圣之物的时候，亚伦和他的儿子要进去，指定他们各人当办的和当抬的工作；你们要这样待他们，好让他们活着，不至死亡；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们挨近至圣物的时候，亚伦和他儿子要进去派他们各人所当办的，所当抬的。这样待他们，好使他们活着，不致死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: So that they may live and not die when they come near the most holy things, do this for them: Aaron and his sons are to go into the sanctuary and assign to each man his work and what he is to carry.
verses.textEnEsv: but deal thus with them, that they may live and not die when they come near to the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint them each to his task and to his burden,
verses.textEnNkjv: but do this in regard to them, that they may live and not die when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint each of them to his service and his task.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what you must do so they will live and not die when they approach the most sacred objects. Aaron and his sons must always go in with them and assign a specific duty or load to each person.
verses.textEnNasb: Rather, do this for them so that they will live and not die when they approach the most holy objects: Aaron and his sons shall go in and assign each of them to his work and to his load;
verses.textEn: So that they may live and not die when they come near the most holy things, do this for them: Aaron and his sons are to go into the sanctuary and assign to each man his work and what he is to carry.

verses.textZh: 只是他们连片刻也不可进去观看圣物，免得他们死亡。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是他们连片刻也不可进去观看圣物，免得他们死亡。"
verses.textZhCuv: 只是他们连片时不可进去观看圣所，免得他们死亡。」
verses.textEnNiv: But the Kohathites must not go in to look at the holy things, even for a moment, or they will die."
verses.textEnEsv: but they shall not go in to look on the holy things even for a moment, lest they die."
verses.textEnNkjv: But they shall not go in to watch while the holy things are being covered, lest they die."
verses.textEnNlt: The Kohathites must never enter the sanctuary to look at the sacred objects for even a moment, or they will die."
verses.textEnNasb: but they shall not come in to see the holy objects even for a moment, or they will die."
verses.textEn: But the Kohathites must not go in to look at the holy things, even for a moment, or they will die."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你也要登记革顺子孙的总数，照着他们的父家、家族，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你也要登记革顺子孙的总数，照着他们的父家、家族，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要将革顺子孙的总数，照着宗族、家室，
verses.textEnNiv: "Take a census also of the Gershonites by their families and clans.
verses.textEnEsv: "Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses and by their clans.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also take a census of the sons of Gershon, by their fathers’ house, by their families.
verses.textEnNlt: "Record the names of the members of the clans and families of the Gershonite division of the tribe of Levi.
verses.textEnNasb: "Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ households, by their families;
verses.textEn: "Take a census also of the Gershonites by their families and clans.

verses.textZh: 从三十岁以上，直到五十岁，能进来供职，在会幕里工作的，你都要数点。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从三十岁以上，直到五十岁，能进来供职，在会幕里工作的，你都要数点。
verses.textZhCuv: 从三十岁直到五十岁，凡前来任职、在会幕里办事的，全都数点。
verses.textEnNiv: Count all the men from thirty to fifty years of age who come to serve in the work at the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: From thirty years old up to fifty years old, you shall list them, all who can come to do duty, to do service in the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNkjv: From thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, you shall number them, all who enter to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: List all the men between the ages of thirty and fifty who are eligible to serve in the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: from thirty years old and upward to fifty years old you shall count them: all who can enter to perform service, to do the work in the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: Count all the men from thirty to fifty years of age who come to serve in the work at the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 革顺人的家庭所作的事和所抬的物如下：
verses.textZhCnvs: 革顺人的家庭所作的事和所抬的物如下：
verses.textZhCuv: 革顺人各族所办的事、所抬的物乃是这样：
verses.textEnNiv: "This is the service of the Gershonite clans in their carrying and their other work:
verses.textEnEsv: This is the service of the clans of the Gershonites, in serving and bearing burdens:
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and carrying:
verses.textEnNlt: "These Gershonite clans will be responsible for general service and carrying loads.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in carrying:
verses.textEn: "This is the service of the Gershonite clans in their carrying and their other work:

verses.textZh: 他们要抬帐幕的幔子、会幕和会幕的盖，以及盖在上面的海狗皮罩和会幕的门帘、
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要抬帐幕的幔子、会幕和会幕的盖，以及盖在上面的海狗皮罩和会幕的门帘、
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要抬帐幕的幔子和会幕，并会幕的盖与其上的海狗皮，和会幕的门帘，
verses.textEnNiv: They are to carry the curtains of the tabernacle, that is, the tent of meeting, its covering and its outer covering of durable leather, the curtains for the entrance to the tent of meeting,
verses.textEnEsv: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the tent of meeting with its covering and the covering of goatskin that is on top of it and the screen for the entrance of the tent of meeting
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the tabernacle of meeting with its covering, the covering of badger skins that is on it, the screen for the door of the tabernacle of meeting,
verses.textEnNlt: They must carry the curtains of the Tabernacle, the Tabernacle itself with its coverings, the outer covering of fine goatskin leather, and the curtain for the Tabernacle entrance.
verses.textEnNasb: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the tent of meeting with its covering and the covering of fine leather that is on top of it, and the curtain for the entrance of the tent of meeting,
verses.textEn: They are to carry the curtains of the tabernacle, that is, the tent of meeting, its covering and its outer covering of durable leather, the curtains for the entrance to the tent of meeting,

verses.textZh: 院子的帷子、院子的门帘 、绳子，以及一切使用的器具；有关这些器具所当作的，他们都要办理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 院子的帷子、院子的门帘 、绳子，以及一切使用的器具；有关这些器具所当作的，他们都要办理。
verses.textZhCuv: 院子的帷子和门帘（院子是围帐幕和坛的）、绳子，并所用的器具，不论是做什么用的，他们都要经理。
verses.textEnNiv: the curtains of the courtyard surrounding the tabernacle and altar, the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard, the ropes and all the equipment used in the service of the tent. The Gershonites are to do all that needs to be done with these things.
verses.textEnEsv: and the hangings of the court and the screen for the entrance of the gate of the court that is around the tabernacle and the altar, and their cords and all the equipment for their service. And they shall do all that needs to be done with regard to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: the screen for the door of the gate of the court, the hangings of the court which are around the tabernacle and altar, and their cords, all the furnishings for their service and all that is made for these things: so shall they serve.
verses.textEnNlt: They are also to carry the curtains for the courtyard walls that surround the Tabernacle and altar, the curtain across the courtyard entrance, the ropes, and all the equipment related to their use. The Gershonites are responsible for all these items.
verses.textEnNasb: and the curtains of the courtyard, the curtain for the entrance of the gate of the courtyard that is around the tabernacle and the altar, and their ropes and all the equipment for their service; and everything that is to be done by them, they shall perform.
verses.textEn: the curtains of the courtyard surrounding the tabernacle and altar, the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard, the ropes and all the equipment used in the service of the tent. The Gershonites are to do all that needs to be done with these things.

verses.textZh: 革顺的子孙所有的任务，他们在一切当抬的和当办的事上，都要照着亚伦和他儿子的吩咐；他们当抬的，你们都要把职务分派给他们。

verses.textEnNlt: When their names were recorded, as the Lord had commanded through Moses, each man was assigned his task and told what to carry. And so the registration was completed, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: "你要吩咐以色列人，把所有患痲风病的，患漏症的，以及因接触死人而不洁的，都送出营外；

verses.textZhCuv: 「你吩咐以色列人，使一切长大麻风的，患漏症的，并因死尸不洁净的，都出营外去。
verses.textEnNiv: "Command the Israelites to send away from the camp anyone who has a defiling skin disease or a discharge of any kind, or who is ceremonially unclean because of a dead body.
verses.textEnEsv: "Command the people of Israel that they put out of the camp everyone who is leprous or has a discharge and everyone who is unclean through contact with the dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper, everyone who has a discharge, and whoever becomes defiled by a corpse.
verses.textEnNlt: "Command the people of Israel to remove from the camp anyone who has a skin disease or a discharge, or who has become ceremonially unclean by touching a dead person.
verses.textEnNasb: "Command the sons of Israel that they send away from the camp everyone with leprosy, everyone having a discharge, and everyone who is unclean because of contact with a dead person.
verses.textEn: "Command the Israelites to send away from the camp anyone who has a defiling skin disease or a discharge of any kind, or who is ceremonially unclean because of a dead body.

verses.textZh: 无论男女，你们都要送出去；你们要把他们送出营外，免得他们玷污自己的营，这营就是我居住的。"

verses.textZhCuv: 无论男女都要使他们出到营外，免得污秽他们的营；这营是我所住的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Send away male and female alike; send them outside the camp so they will not defile their camp, where I dwell among them."
verses.textEnEsv: You shall put out both male and female, putting them outside the camp, that they may not defile their camp, in the midst of which I dwell."
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall put out both male and female; you shall put them outside the camp, that they may not defile their camps in the midst of which I dwell."
verses.textEnNlt: This command applies to men and women alike. Remove them so they will not defile the camp in which I live among them."
verses.textEnNasb: You shall send away both male and female; you shall send them outside the camp so that they do not defile their camp where I dwell in their midst."
verses.textEn: Send away male and female alike; send them outside the camp so they will not defile their camp, where I dwell among them."

verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel, When a man or woman commits any of the sins that people commit by breaking faith with the Lord , and that person realizes his guilt,

verses.textEnNiv: But if that person has no close relative to whom restitution can be made for the wrong, the restitution belongs to the Lord and must be given to the priest, along with the ram with which atonement is made for the wrongdoer.
verses.textEnEsv: But if the man has no next of kin to whom restitution may be made for the wrong, the restitution for wrong shall go to the Lord for the priest, in addition to the ram of atonement with which atonement is made for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if the man has no relative to whom restitution may be made for the wrong, the restitution for the wrong mustgo to the Lord for the priest, in addition to the ram of the atonement with which atonement is made for him.
verses.textEnNlt: But if the person who was wronged is dead, and there are no near relatives to whom restitution can be made, the payment belongs to the Lord and must be given to the priest. Those who are guilty must also bring a ram as a sacrifice, and they will be purified and made right with the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: But if the person has no redeemer to whom restitution may be made for the wrong, the restitution which is made for the wrong must go to the Lord for the priest, besides the ram of atonement, by which atonement is made for him.
verses.textEn: But if that person has no close relative to whom restitution can be made for the wrong, the restitution belongs to the Lord and must be given to the priest, along with the ram with which atonement is made for the wrongdoer.

verses.textZh: 有人和她同寝，事情瞒过了丈夫，没有被查出，没有见证人指证她，犯罪时也没有被人捉住；
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人和她同寝，事情瞒过了丈夫，没有被查出，没有见证人指证她，犯罪时也没有被人捉住；
verses.textZhCuv: 有人与她行淫，事情严密，瞒过她丈夫，而且她被玷污，没有作见证的人，当她行淫的时候也没有被捉住，
verses.textEnNiv: so that another man has sexual relations with her, and this is hidden from her husband and her impurity is undetected (since there is no witness against her and she has not been caught in the act),
verses.textEnEsv: if a man lies with her sexually, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband, and she is undetected though she has defiled herself, and there is no witness against her, since she was not taken in the act,
verses.textEnNkjv: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband, and it is concealed that she has defiled herself, and therewas no witness against her, nor was she caught—
verses.textEnNlt: and has sex with another man, but neither her husband nor anyone else knows about it. She has defiled herself, even though there was no witness and she was not caught in the act.
verses.textEnNasb: and a man has sexual relations with her and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband and she remains undiscovered, although she has defiled herself, and there is no witness against her and she has not been caught in the act,
verses.textEn: so that another man has sexual relations with her, and this is hidden from her husband and her impurity is undetected (since there is no witness against her and she has not been caught in the act),

verses.textZh: 如果她的丈夫生了疑心，疑忌妻子，而妻子实在是被玷污了；又或者丈夫生了疑心，疑忌妻子，而妻子并没有被玷污，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果她的丈夫生了疑心，疑忌妻子，而妻子实在是被玷污了；又或者丈夫生了疑心，疑忌妻子，而妻子并没有被玷污，
verses.textZhCuv: 她丈夫生了疑恨的心，疑恨她，她是被玷污，或是她丈夫生了疑恨的心，疑恨她，她并没有被玷污，
verses.textEnNiv: and if feelings of jealousy come over her husband and he suspects his wife and she is impure—or if he is jealous and suspects her even though she is not impure—
verses.textEnEsv: and if the spirit of jealousy comes over him and he is jealous of his wife who has defiled herself, or if the spirit of jealousy comes over him and he is jealous of his wife, though she has not defiled herself,
verses.textEnNkjv: if the spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he becomes jealous of his wife, who has defiled herself; or if the spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he becomes jealous of his wife, although she has not defiled herself—
verses.textEnNlt: If her husband becomes jealous and is suspicious of his wife and needs to know whether or not she has defiled herself,
verses.textEnNasb: if an attitude of jealousy comes over him and he is jealous of his wife when she has defiled herself, or if an attitude of jealousy comes over him and he is jealous of his wife when she has not defiled herself,
verses.textEn: and if feelings of jealousy come over her husband and he suspects his wife and she is impure—or if he is jealous and suspects her even though she is not impure—

verses.textEnNiv: then he is to take his wife to the priest. He must also take an offering of a tenth of an ephah of barley flour on her behalf. He must not pour olive oil on it or put incense on it, because it is a grain offering for jealousy, a reminder-offering to draw attention to wrongdoing.

verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall set the woman before the Lord and unbind the hair of the woman’s head and place in her hands the grain offering of remembrance, which is the grain offering of jealousy. And in his hand the priest shall have the water of bitterness that brings the curse.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the priest shall stand the woman before the Lord, uncover the woman’s head, and put the offering for remembering in her hands, which is the grain offering of jealousy. And the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that brings a curse.
verses.textEnNlt: When the priest has presented the woman before the Lord , he must unbind her hair and place in her hands the offering of proof—the jealousy offering to determine whether her husband’s suspicions are justified. The priest will stand before her, holding the jar of bitter water that brings a curse to those who are guilty.
verses.textEnNasb: The priest shall then have the woman stand before the Lord and let down the hair of the woman’s head, and place the grain offering of reminder in her hands, that is, the grain offering of jealousy; and in the hand of the priest is to be the water of bitterness that brings a curse.
verses.textEn: After the priest has had the woman stand before the Lord , he shall loosen her hair and place in her hands the reminder-offering, the grain offering for jealousy, while he himself holds the bitter water that brings a curse.

verses.textZh: 祭司要叫那妇人起誓，对她说：‘如果没有人与你同寝，作妻子时没有背弃丈夫被人玷污，你就免受这使人招致咒诅的苦水。

verses.textZhCuv: 要叫妇人起誓，对她说：『若没有人与你行淫，也未曾背着丈夫做污秽的事，你就免受这致咒诅苦水的灾。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the priest shall put the woman under oath and say to her, "If no other man has had sexual relations with you and you have not gone astray and become impure while married to your husband, may this bitter water that brings a curse not harm you.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the priest shall make her take an oath, saying, ‘If no man has lain with you, and if you have not turned aside to uncleanness while you were under your husband’s authority, be free from this water of bitterness that brings the curse.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priest shall put her under oath, and say to the woman, "If no man has lain with you, and if you have not gone astray to uncleanness while under your husband’s authority, be free from this bitter water that brings a curse.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will then put the woman under oath and say to her, ‘If no other man has had sex with you, and you have not gone astray and defiled yourself while under your husband’s authority, may you be immune from the effects of this bitter water that brings on the curse.
verses.textEnNasb: And the priest shall have her take an oath and shall say to the woman, "If no man has had sexual relations with you and if you have not gone astray into uncleanness, as you are under the authority of your husband, be immune to this water of bitterness that brings a curse;
verses.textEn: Then the priest shall put the woman under oath and say to her, "If no other man has had sexual relations with you and you have not gone astray and become impure while married to your husband, may this bitter water that brings a curse not harm you.

verses.textEnNiv: If she has made herself impure and been unfaithful to her husband, this will be the result: When she is made to drink the water that brings a curse and causes bitter suffering, it will enter her, her abdomen will swell and her womb will miscarry, and she will become a curse.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he has made her drink the water, then, if she has defiled herself and has broken faith with her husband, the water that brings the curse shall enter into her and cause bitter pain, and her womb shall swell, and her thigh shall fall away, and the woman shall become a curse among her people.
verses.textEnNkjv: When he has made her drink the water, then it shall be, if she has defiled herself and behaved unfaithfully toward her husband, that the water that brings a curse will enter her andbecome bitter, and her belly will swell, her thigh will rot, and the woman will become a curse among her people.
verses.textEnNlt: If she has defiled herself by being unfaithful to her husband, the water that brings on the curse will cause bitter suffering. Her abdomen will swell and her womb will shrink, and her name will become a curse among her people.
verses.textEnNasb: When he has made her drink the water, then it will come about, if she has defiled herself and has been unfaithful to her husband, that the water which brings a curse will go into her and cause bitterness, and her belly will swell up and her thigh will shrivel, and the woman will become a curse among her people.
verses.textEn: If she has made herself impure and been unfaithful to her husband, this will be the result: When she is made to drink the water that brings a curse and causes bitter suffering, it will enter her, her abdomen will swell and her womb will miscarry, and she will become a curse.

verses.textZh: 他要戒除淡酒和浓酒；淡酒作的醋和浓酒作的醋，他都不可喝；不可喝任何葡萄汁，也不可吃鲜葡萄或干葡萄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要戒除淡酒和浓酒；淡酒作的醋和浓酒作的醋，他都不可喝；不可喝任何葡萄汁，也不可吃鲜葡萄或干葡萄。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就要远离清酒浓酒，也不可喝什么清酒浓酒做的醋；不可喝什么葡萄汁，也不可吃鲜葡萄和干葡萄。
verses.textEnNiv: they must abstain from wine and other fermented drink and must not drink vinegar made from wine or other fermented drink. They must not drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins.
verses.textEnEsv: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink. He shall drink no vinegar made from wine or strong drink and shall not drink any juice of grapes or eat grapes, fresh or dried.
verses.textEnNkjv: he shall separate himself from wine and similar drink; he shall drink neither vinegar made from wine nor vinegar made from similar drink; neither shall he drink any grape juice, nor eat fresh grapes or raisins.
verses.textEnNlt: they must give up wine and other alcoholic drinks. They must not use vinegar made from wine or from other alcoholic drinks, they must not drink fresh grape juice, and they must not eat grapes or raisins.
verses.textEnNasb: he shall abstain from wine and strong drink; he shall consume no vinegar, whether made from wine or strong drink, nor shall he drink any grape juice nor eat fresh or dried grapes.
verses.textEn: they must abstain from wine and other fermented drink and must not drink vinegar made from wine or other fermented drink. They must not drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins.

verses.textZh: 在他离俗的日子，葡萄树上出产的，无论是葡萄核或是葡萄皮，都不可吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他离俗的日子，葡萄树上出产的，无论是葡萄核或是葡萄皮，都不可吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 在一切离俗的日子，凡葡萄树上结的，自核至皮所做的物，都不可吃。
verses.textEnNiv: As long as they remain under their Nazirite vow, they must not eat anything that comes from the grapevine, not even the seeds or skins.
verses.textEnEsv: All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is produced by the grapevine, not even the seeds or the skins.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is produced by the grapevine, from seed to skin.
verses.textEnNlt: As long as they are bound by their Nazirite vow, they are not allowed to eat or drink anything that comes from a grapevine—not even the grape seeds or skins.
verses.textEnNasb: All the days of his consecration he shall not eat anything that is produced from the grape vine, from the seeds even to the skin.
verses.textEn: As long as they remain under their Nazirite vow, they must not eat anything that comes from the grapevine, not even the seeds or skins.

verses.textZh: "‘在他许愿离俗的日子，不可用剃刀剃头；他要圣洁，直到他离俗归耶和华的日子满了，他要由他的头发长长。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘在他许愿离俗的日子，不可用剃刀剃头；他要圣洁，直到他离俗归耶和华的日子满了，他要由他的头发长长。
verses.textZhCuv: 「在他一切许愿离俗的日子，不可用剃头刀剃头，要由发绺长长了。他要圣洁，直到离俗归耶和华的日子满了。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘During the entire period of their Nazirite vow, no razor may be used on their head. They must be holy until the period of their dedication to the Lord is over; they must let their hair grow long.
verses.textEnEsv: "All the days of his vow of separation, no razor shall touch his head. Until the time is completed for which he separates himself to the Lord , he shall be holy. He shall let the locks of hair of his head grow long.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘All the days of the vow of his separation no razor shall come upon his head; until the days are fulfilled for which he separated himself to the Lord, he shall be holy. Then he shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.
verses.textEnNlt: "They must never cut their hair throughout the time of their vow, for they are holy and set apart to the Lord . Until the time of their vow has been fulfilled, they must let their hair grow long.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘All the days of his vow of consecration no razor shall pass over his head. He shall be holy until the days are fulfilled which he lives as a Nazirite for the Lord; he shall let the locks of hair on his head grow long.
verses.textEn: " ‘During the entire period of their Nazirite vow, no razor may be used on their head. They must be holy until the period of their dedication to the Lord is over; they must let their hair grow long.

verses.textZh: "‘在他离俗归耶和华的日子，不可走近死人。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘在他离俗归耶和华的日子，不可走近死人。
verses.textZhCuv: 在他离俗归耶和华的一切日子，不可挨近死尸。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Throughout the period of their dedication to the Lord , the Nazirite must not go near a dead body.
verses.textEnEsv: "All the days that he separates himself to the Lord he shall not go near a dead body.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the days that he separates himself to the Lord he shall not go near a dead body.
verses.textEnNlt: And they must not go near a dead body during the entire period of their vow to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: ‘All the days of his life as a Nazirite for the Lord he shall not come up to a dead person.
verses.textEn: " ‘Throughout the period of their dedication to the Lord , the Nazirite must not go near a dead body.

verses.textZh: 他的父母、兄弟或是姊妹，死了的时候，他不可因他们玷污自己，因为离俗归他神的记号，在他的头上；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的父母、兄弟或是姊妹，死了的时候，他不可因他们玷污自己，因为离俗归他神的记号，在他的头上；
verses.textZhCuv: 他的父母或是弟兄姊妹死了的时候，他不可因他们使自己不洁净，因为那离俗归神的凭据是在他头上。
verses.textEnNiv: Even if their own father or mother or brother or sister dies, they must not make themselves ceremonially unclean on account of them, because the symbol of their dedication to God is on their head.
verses.textEnEsv: Not even for his father or for his mother, for brother or sister, if they die, shall he make himself unclean, because his separation to God is on his head.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall not make himself unclean even for his father or his mother, for his brother or his sister, when they die, because his separation to God is on his head.
verses.textEnNlt: Even if the dead person is their own father, mother, brother, or sister, they must not defile themselves, for the hair on their head is the symbol of their separation to God.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall not make himself unclean for his father or for his mother, for his brother or for his sister, when they die, because his consecration to God is on his head.
verses.textEn: Even if their own father or mother or brother or sister dies, they must not make themselves ceremonially unclean on account of them, because the symbol of their dedication to God is on their head.

verses.textZh: 在他离俗的日子，他都是归耶和华为圣的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他离俗的日子，他都是归耶和华为圣的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在他一切离俗的日子是归耶和华为圣。
verses.textEnNiv: Throughout the period of their dedication, they are consecrated to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: All the days of his separation he is holy to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: All the days of his separation he shall be holy to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: This requirement applies as long as they are set apart to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: All the days of his consecration he is holy to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Throughout the period of their dedication, they are consecrated to the Lord .

verses.textZh: "‘如果在他身旁，突然有人死了，以致他离俗的头被玷污了，他就要在得洁净的日子剃头，就是在第七日剃头。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘如果在他身旁，突然有人死了，以致他离俗的头被玷污了，他就要在得洁净的日子剃头，就是在第七日剃头。
verses.textZhCuv: 「若在他旁边忽然有人死了，以致沾染了他离俗的头，他要在第七日，得洁净的时候，剃头。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If someone dies suddenly in the Nazirite’s presence, thus defiling the hair that symbolizes their dedication, they must shave their head on the seventh day—the day of their cleansing.
verses.textEnEsv: "And if any man dies very suddenly beside him and he defiles his consecrated head, then he shall shave his head on the day of his cleansing; on the seventh day he shall shave it.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And if anyone dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles his consecrated head, then he shall shave his head on the day of his cleansing; on the seventh day he shall shave it.
verses.textEnNlt: "If someone falls dead beside them, the hair they have dedicated will be defiled. They must wait for seven days and then shave their heads. Then they will be cleansed from their defilement.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘But if someone dies very suddenly beside him and he defiles his consecrated head of hair, then he shall shave his head on the day when he becomes clean; he shall shave it on the seventh day.
verses.textEn: " ‘If someone dies suddenly in the Nazirite’s presence, thus defiling the hair that symbolizes their dedication, they must shave their head on the seventh day—the day of their cleansing.

verses.textZh: 第八天，他要把两只斑鸠，或是两只雏鸽，带到会幕门口交给祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第八天，他要把两只斑鸠，或是两只雏鸽，带到会幕门口交给祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 第八日，他要把两只斑鸠或两只雏鸽带到会幕门口，交给祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: Then on the eighth day they must bring two doves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: On the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two pigeons to the priest to the entrance of the tent of meeting,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then on the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of meeting;
verses.textEnNlt: On the eighth day they must bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: Then on the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young doves to the priest, to the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: Then on the eighth day they must bring two doves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 祭司要献一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭，为他赎那因死人而玷污的罪；他要在当天使他的头成为圣洁，
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要献一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭，为他赎那因死人而玷污的罪；他要在当天使他的头成为圣洁，
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要献一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭，为他赎那因死尸而有的罪，并要当日使他的头成为圣洁。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest is to offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to make atonement for the Nazirite because they sinned by being in the presence of the dead body. That same day they are to consecrate their head again.
verses.textEnEsv: and the priest shall offer one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he sinned by reason of the dead body. And he shall consecrate his head that same day
verses.textEnNkjv: and the priest shall offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he sinned in regard to the corpse; and he shall sanctify his head that same day.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will offer one of the birds for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering. In this way, he will purify them from the guilt they incurred through contact with the dead body. Then they must reaffirm their commitment and let their hair begin to grow again.
verses.textEnNasb: And the priest shall offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, and make atonement for him regarding his sin because of the dead person. And on that same day he shall consecrate his head,
verses.textEn: The priest is to offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to make atonement for the Nazirite because they sinned by being in the presence of the dead body. That same day they are to consecrate their head again.

verses.textZh: 使他重新离俗归耶和华的日子，又要带一只一岁的公羊羔来作赎愆祭；以前的日子无效，因为他的离俗被玷污了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使他重新离俗归耶和华的日子，又要带一只一岁的公羊羔来作赎愆祭；以前的日子无效，因为他的离俗被玷污了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要另选离俗归耶和华的日子，又要牵一只一岁的公羊羔来作赎愆祭；但先前的日子要归徒然，因为他在离俗之间被玷污了。
verses.textEnNiv: They must rededicate themselves to the Lord for the same period of dedication and must bring a year-old male lamb as a guilt offering. The previous days do not count, because they became defiled during their period of dedication.
verses.textEnEsv: and separate himself to the Lord for the days of his separation and bring a male lamb a year old for a guilt offering. But the previous period shall be void, because his separation was defiled.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall consecrate to the Lord the days of his separation, and bring a male lamb in its first year as a trespass offering; but the former days shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.
verses.textEnNlt: The days of their vow that were completed before their defilement no longer count. They must rededicate themselves to the Lord as a Nazirite for the full term of their vow, and each must bring a one-year-old male lamb for a guilt offering.
verses.textEnNasb: and shall live his days of consecration as a Nazirite for the Lord, and shall bring a male lamb a year old as a guilt offering; but the preceding days will not count, because his consecration was defiled.
verses.textEn: They must rededicate themselves to the Lord for the same period of dedication and must bring a year-old male lamb as a guilt offering. The previous days do not count, because they became defiled during their period of dedication.

verses.textZh: "‘拿细耳人的律例是这样：离俗的人的日子满了那天，人要把他带到会幕的门口；
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘拿细耳人的律例是这样：离俗的人的日子满了那天，人要把他带到会幕的门口；
verses.textZhCuv: 「拿细耳人满了离俗的日子乃有这条例：人要领他到会幕门口，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Now this is the law of the Nazirite when the period of their dedication is over. They are to be brought to the entrance to the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: "And this is the law for the Nazirite, when the time of his separation has been completed: he shall be brought to the entrance of the tent of meeting,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Now this is the law of the Nazirite: When the days of his separation are fulfilled, he shall be brought to the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is the ritual law for Nazirites. At the conclusion of their time of separation as Nazirites, they must each go to the entrance of the Tabernacle
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now this is the law of the Nazirite when the days of his consecration are fulfilled: he shall bring his offering to the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: " ‘Now this is the law of the Nazirite when the period of their dedication is over. They are to be brought to the entrance to the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 他要把供物献给耶和华，就是献一只完全没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔作燔祭，一只完全没有残疾、一岁的母羊羔作赎罪祭，一只完全没有残疾的公绵羊作平安祭，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要把供物献给耶和华，就是献一只完全没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔作燔祭，一只完全没有残疾、一岁的母羊羔作赎罪祭，一只完全没有残疾的公绵羊作平安祭，
verses.textZhCuv: 他要将供物奉给耶和华，就是一只没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔作燔祭，一只没有残疾、一岁的母羊羔作赎罪祭，和一只没有残疾的公绵羊作平安祭，
verses.textEnNiv: There they are to present their offerings to the Lord : a year-old male lamb without defect for a burnt offering, a year-old ewe lamb without defect for a sin offering, a ram without defect for a fellowship offering,
verses.textEnEsv: and he shall bring his gift to the Lord , one male lamb a year old without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb a year old without blemish as a sin offering, and one ram without blemish as a peace offering,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall present his offering to the Lord: one male lamb in its first year without blemish as a burnt offering, one ewe lamb in its first year without blemish as a sin offering, one ram without blemish as a peace offering,
verses.textEnNlt: and offer their sacrifices to the Lord : a one-year-old male lamb without defect for a burnt offering, a one-year-old female lamb without defect for a sin offering, a ram without defect for a peace offering,
verses.textEnNasb: And he shall present his offering to the Lord: one male lamb a year old without defect as a burnt offering, one ewe lamb a year old without defect as a sin offering, one ram without defect as a peace offering,
verses.textEn: There they are to present their offerings to the Lord : a year-old male lamb without defect for a burnt offering, a year-old ewe lamb without defect for a sin offering, a ram without defect for a fellowship offering,

verses.textZh: 一篮无酵调油的细面饼和抹油的无酵薄饼，以及同献的素祭和奠祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一篮无酵调油的细面饼和抹油的无酵薄饼，以及同献的素祭和奠祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 并一筐子无酵调油的细面饼，与抹油的无酵薄饼，并同献的素祭和奠祭。
verses.textEnNiv: together with their grain offerings and drink offerings, and a basket of bread made with the finest flour and without yeast—thick loaves with olive oil mixed in, and thin loaves brushed with olive oil.
verses.textEnEsv: and a basket of unleavened bread, loaves of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers smeared with oil, and their grain offering and their drink offerings.
verses.textEnNkjv: a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and their grain offering with their drink offerings.
verses.textEnNlt: a basket of bread made without yeast—cakes of choice flour mixed with olive oil and wafers spread with olive oil—along with their prescribed grain offerings and liquid offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: and a basket of unleavened loaves of fine flour mixed with oil and unleavened wafers spread with oil, along with their grain offering and their drink offering.
verses.textEn: together with their grain offerings and drink offerings, and a basket of bread made with the finest flour and without yeast—thick loaves with olive oil mixed in, and thin loaves brushed with olive oil.

verses.textZh: 祭司要在耶和华面前献上这些供物，又要献上他的赎罪祭和燔祭；
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要在耶和华面前献上这些供物，又要献上他的赎罪祭和燔祭；
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要在耶和华面前献那人的赎罪祭和燔祭；
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘The priest is to present all these before the Lord and make the sin offering and the burnt offering.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall bring them before the Lord and offer his sin offering and his burnt offering,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the priest shall bring them before the Lord and offer his sin offering and his burnt offering;
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will present these offerings before the Lord : first the sin offering and the burnt offering;
verses.textEnNasb: Then the priest shall present them before the Lord and offer his sin offering and his burnt offering.
verses.textEn: " ‘The priest is to present all these before the Lord and make the sin offering and the burnt offering.

verses.textZh: 他又要把那只公绵羊和那一篮无酵饼，献给耶和华作平安祭；祭司也要把同献的素祭和奠祭献上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又要把那只公绵羊和那一篮无酵饼，献给耶和华作平安祭；祭司也要把同献的素祭和奠祭献上。
verses.textZhCuv: 也要把那只公羊和那筐无酵饼献给耶和华作平安祭，又要将同献的素祭和奠祭献上。
verses.textEnNiv: He is to present the basket of unleavened bread and is to sacrifice the ram as a fellowship offering to the Lord , together with its grain offering and drink offering.
verses.textEnEsv: and he shall offer the ram as a sacrifice of peace offering to the Lord , with the basket of unleavened bread. The priest shall offer also its grain offering and its drink offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: and he shall offer the ram as a sacrifice of a peace offering to the Lord, with the basket of unleavened bread; the priest shall also offer its grain offering and its drink offering.
verses.textEnNlt: then the ram for a peace offering, along with the basket of bread made without yeast. The priest must also present the prescribed grain offering and liquid offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: He shall also offer the ram as a sacrifice of peace offerings to the Lord, together with the basket of unleavened bread; the priest shall also offer its grain offering and its drink offering.
verses.textEn: He is to present the basket of unleavened bread and is to sacrifice the ram as a fellowship offering to the Lord , together with its grain offering and drink offering.

verses.textZh: 拿细耳人要在会幕门口剃他离俗的头，把他离俗的头发拿去，放在平安祭下的火上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿细耳人要在会幕门口剃他离俗的头，把他离俗的头发拿去，放在平安祭下的火上。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿细耳人要在会幕门口剃离俗的头，把离俗头上的发放在平安祭下的火上。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Then at the entrance to the tent of meeting, the Nazirite must shave off the hair that symbolizes their dedication. They are to take the hair and put it in the fire that is under the sacrifice of the fellowship offering.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Nazirite shall shave his consecrated head at the entrance of the tent of meeting and shall take the hair from his consecrated head and put it on the fire that is under the sacrifice of the peace offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Nazirite shall shave his consecrated head at the door of the tabernacle of meeting, and shall take the hair from his consecrated head and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offering.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then the Nazirites will shave their heads at the entrance of the Tabernacle. They will take the hair that had been dedicated and place it on the fire beneath the peace-offering sacrifice.
verses.textEnNasb: The Nazirite shall then shave his consecrated head of hair at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and take the consecrated hair of his head and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace offerings.
verses.textEn: " ‘Then at the entrance to the tent of meeting, the Nazirite must shave off the hair that symbolizes their dedication. They are to take the hair and put it in the fire that is under the sacrifice of the fellowship offering.

verses.textZh: 拿细耳人剃去了自己离俗的头发以后，祭司就要取那煮过的公绵羊的一条前腿，又要从篮子里取一个无酵饼和一个无酵薄饼，都放在拿细耳人的手上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿细耳人剃去了自己离俗的头发以后，祭司就要取那煮过的公绵羊的一条前腿，又要从篮子里取一个无酵饼和一个无酵薄饼，都放在拿细耳人的手上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他剃了以后，祭司就要取那已煮的公羊一条前腿，又从筐子里取一个无酵饼和一个无酵薄饼，都放在他手上。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘After the Nazirite has shaved off the hair that symbolizes their dedication, the priest is to place in their hands a boiled shoulder of the ram, and one thick loaf and one thin loaf from the basket, both made without yeast.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall take the shoulder of the ram, when it is boiled, and one unleavened loaf out of the basket and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them on the hands of the Nazirite, after he has shaved the hair of his consecration,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And the priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, one unleavened cake from the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and put them upon the hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved his consecrated hair,
verses.textEnNlt: After the Nazirite’s head has been shaved, the priest will take for each of them the boiled shoulder of the ram, and he will take from the basket a cake and a wafer made without yeast. He will put them all into the Nazirite’s hands.
verses.textEnNasb: And the priest shall take the ram’s shoulder when it has been boiled, and one unleavened loaf from the basket and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them on the hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved his consecrated hair.
verses.textEn: " ‘After the Nazirite has shaved off the hair that symbolizes their dedication, the priest is to place in their hands a boiled shoulder of the ram, and one thick loaf and one thin loaf from the basket, both made without yeast.

verses.textZh: 祭司要把这些作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；这些和作摇祭献上的胸和作举祭的腿，同为圣物归给祭司；然后拿细耳人才可以喝酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要把这些作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；这些和作摇祭献上的胸和作举祭的腿，同为圣物归给祭司；然后拿细耳人才可以喝酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要拿这些作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；这与所摇的胸、所举的腿同为圣物，归给祭司。然后拿细耳人可以喝酒。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest shall then wave these before the Lord as a wave offering; they are holy and belong to the priest, together with the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented. After that, the Nazirite may drink wine.
verses.textEnEsv: and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the Lord . They are a holy portion for the priest, together with the breast that is waved and the thigh that is contributed. And after that the Nazirite may drink wine.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the priest shall wave them as a wave offering before the Lord; they are holy for the priest, together with the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the heave offering. After that the Nazirite may drink wine.’
verses.textEnNlt: Then the priest will lift them up as a special offering before the Lord . These are holy portions for the priest, along with the breast of the special offering and the thigh of the sacred offering that are lifted up before the Lord . After this ceremony the Nazirites may again drink wine.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the priest shall wave them as a wave offering before the Lord. It is holy for the priest, together with the breast offered as a wave offering, and the thigh offered as a contribution; and afterward the Nazirite may drink wine.’
verses.textEn: The priest shall then wave these before the Lord as a wave offering; they are holy and belong to the priest, together with the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented. After that, the Nazirite may drink wine.

verses.textZh: "‘许愿的拿细耳人的律例是这样：他献给耶和华的供物是照着他离俗的愿，不是根据他手上所得的；他怎样许愿，就当怎样照着离俗的律例而行。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘许愿的拿细耳人的律例是这样：他献给耶和华的供物是照着他离俗的愿，不是根据他手上所得的；他怎样许愿，就当怎样照着离俗的律例而行。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 「许愿的拿细耳人为离俗所献的供物，和他以外所能得的献给耶和华，就有这条例。他怎样许愿就当照离俗的条例行。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is the law of the Nazirite who vows offerings to the Lord in accordance with their dedication, in addition to whatever else they can afford. They must fulfill the vows they have made, according to the law of the Nazirite.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "This is the law of the Nazirite. But if he vows an offering to the Lord above his Nazirite vow, as he can afford, in exact accordance with the vow that he takes, then he shall do in addition to the law of the Nazirite."
verses.textEnNkjv: "This is the law of the Nazirite who vows to the Lord the offering for his separation, and besides that, whatever else his hand is able to provide; according to the vow which he takes, so he must do according to the law of his separation."
verses.textEnNlt: "This is the ritual law of the Nazirites, who vow to bring these offerings to the Lord . They may also bring additional offerings if they can afford it. And they must be careful to do whatever they vowed when they set themselves apart as Nazirites."
verses.textEnNasb: "This is the law of the Nazirite who vows his offering to the Lord according to his consecration, in addition to what else he can afford; corresponding to his vow which he makes, so he shall do according to the law of his consecration."
verses.textEn: " ‘This is the law of the Nazirite who vows offerings to the Lord in accordance with their dedication, in addition to whatever else they can afford. They must fulfill the vows they have made, according to the law of the Nazirite.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉亚伦和他的儿子说：‘你们要这样为以色列人祝福，对他们说：
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉亚伦和他的儿子说：‘你们要这样为以色列人祝福，对他们说：
verses.textZhCuv: 「你告诉亚伦和他儿子说：你们要这样为以色列人祝福，说：
verses.textEnNiv: "Tell Aaron and his sons, ‘This is how you are to bless the Israelites. Say to them:
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to Aaron and his sons, saying, Thus you shall bless the people of Israel: you shall say to them,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the way you shall bless the children of Israel. Say to them:
verses.textEnNlt: "Tell Aaron and his sons to bless the people of Israel with this special blessing:
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘In this way you shall bless the sons of Israel. You are to say to them:
verses.textEn: "Tell Aaron and his sons, ‘This is how you are to bless the Israelites. Say to them:

verses.textZh: 愿耶和华赐福你， 保护你；
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿耶和华赐福你， 保护你；
verses.textZhCuv: 『愿耶和华赐福给你，保护你。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘ "The Lord bless you and keep you;
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord bless you and keep you;
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord bless you and keep you;
verses.textEnNlt: ‘May the Lord bless you and protect you.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord bless you, and keep you;
verses.textEn: " ‘ "The Lord bless you and keep you;

verses.textZh: 愿耶和华使他的脸光照你， 赐恩给你；
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿耶和华使他的脸光照你， 赐恩给你；
verses.textZhCuv: 愿耶和华使他的脸光照你，赐恩给你。
verses.textEnNiv: the Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious to you;
verses.textEnEsv: the Lord make his face to shine upon you and be gracious to you;
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord make His face shine upon you, And be gracious to you;
verses.textEnNlt: May the Lord smile on you and be gracious to you.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord cause His face to shine on you, And be gracious to you;
verses.textEn: the Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious to you;

verses.textZh: 愿耶和华敞脸垂顾你， 赐你平安。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿耶和华敞脸垂顾你， 赐你平安。’
verses.textZhCuv: 愿耶和华向你仰脸，赐你平安。』
verses.textEnNiv: the Lord turn his face toward you and give you peace." ’
verses.textEnEsv: the Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord lift up His countenance upon you, And give you peace." ’
verses.textEnNlt: May the Lord show you his favor and give you his peace.’
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord lift up His face to you, And give you peace.’
verses.textEn: the Lord turn his face toward you and give you peace." ’

verses.textZh: 他们要这样奉我的名为以色列人祝福，我也要赐福他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要这样奉我的名为以色列人祝福，我也要赐福他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要如此奉我的名为以色列人祝福；我也要赐福给他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: "So they will put my name on the Israelites, and I will bless them."
verses.textEnEsv: "So shall they put my name upon the people of Israel, and I will bless them."
verses.textEnNkjv: "So they shall put My name on the children of Israel, and I will bless them."
verses.textEnNlt: Whenever Aaron and his sons bless the people of Israel in my name, I myself will bless them."
verses.textEnNasb: So they shall invoke My name on the sons of Israel, and then I will bless them."
verses.textEn: "So they will put my name on the Israelites, and I will bless them."

verses.textZh: 摩西竖立了帐幕的那天，就用膏抹它，使它成圣；又把其中的一切器具、祭坛和祭坛的一切器具，都用膏抹了，使它们成圣；
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西竖立了帐幕的那天，就用膏抹它，使它成圣；又把其中的一切器具、祭坛和祭坛的一切器具，都用膏抹了，使它们成圣；
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西立完了帐幕，就把帐幕用膏抹了，使它成圣，又把其中的器具和坛，并坛上的器具，都抹了，使它成圣。
verses.textEnNiv: When Moses finished setting up the tabernacle, he anointed and consecrated it and all its furnishings. He also anointed and consecrated the altar and all its utensils.
verses.textEnEsv: On the day when Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle and had anointed and consecrated it with all its furnishings and had anointed and consecrated the altar with all its utensils,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, when Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, that he anointed it and consecrated it and all its furnishings, and the altar and all its utensils; so he anointed them and consecrated them.
verses.textEnNlt: On the day Moses set up the Tabernacle, he anointed it and set it apart as holy. He also anointed and set apart all its furnishings and the altar with its utensils.
verses.textEnNasb: Now on the day that Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, he anointed it and consecrated it with all its furnishings, and the altar and all its utensils; he anointed them and consecrated them also.
verses.textEn: When Moses finished setting up the tabernacle, he anointed and consecrated it and all its furnishings. He also anointed and consecrated the altar and all its utensils.

verses.textZh: 以色列的众领袖，就是他们父家的首领，都来奉献；就是众支派的领袖，是管理那些被数点的人的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的众领袖，就是他们父家的首领，都来奉献；就是众支派的领袖，是管理那些被数点的人的。
verses.textZhCuv: 当天，以色列的众首领，就是各族的族长，都来奉献。他们是各支派的首领，管理那些被数的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the leaders of Israel, the heads of families who were the tribal leaders in charge of those who were counted, made offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: the chiefs of Israel, heads of their fathers’ houses, who were the chiefs of the tribes, who were over those who were listed, approached
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the leaders of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ houses, who were the leaders of the tribes and over those who were numbered, made an offering.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the leaders of Israel—the tribal leaders who had registered the troops—came and brought their offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the leaders of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ households, made an offering (they were the leaders of the tribes; they were the supervisors over the numbered men).
verses.textEn: Then the leaders of Israel, the heads of families who were the tribal leaders in charge of those who were counted, made offerings.

verses.textZh: 他们把自己的供物带到耶和华的面前，就是六辆篷车和十二头公牛，每两个领袖奉献一辆篷车，每个领袖奉献一头公牛；他们把这些都送到帐幕的面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把自己的供物带到耶和华的面前，就是六辆篷车和十二头公牛，每两个领袖奉献一辆篷车，每个领袖奉献一头公牛；他们把这些都送到帐幕的面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们把自己的供物送到耶和华面前，就是六辆篷子车和十二只公牛。每两个首领奉献一辆车，每首领奉献一只牛。他们把这些都奉到帐幕前。
verses.textEnNiv: They brought as their gifts before the Lord six covered carts and twelve oxen—an ox from each leader and a cart from every two. These they presented before the tabernacle.
verses.textEnEsv: and brought their offerings before the Lord , six wagons and twelve oxen, a wagon for every two of the chiefs, and for each one an ox. They brought them before the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they brought their offering before the Lord, six covered carts and twelve oxen, a cart for every two of the leaders, and for each one an ox; and they presented them before the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: Together they brought six large wagons and twelve oxen. There was a wagon for every two leaders and an ox for each leader. They presented these to the Lord in front of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: When they brought their offering before the Lord, six covered carts and twelve oxen, a cart for every two of the leaders and an ox for each one, then they presented them in front of the tabernacle.
verses.textEn: They brought as their gifts before the Lord six covered carts and twelve oxen—an ox from each leader and a cart from every two. These they presented before the tabernacle.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要把这些收下，好作会幕事务的使用；你要把这些交给利未人，要按照各人所办的事务给他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要把这些收下，好作会幕事务的使用；你要把这些交给利未人，要按照各人所办的事务给他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要收下这些，好作会幕的使用，都要照利未人所办的事交给他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Accept these from them, that they may be used in the work at the tent of meeting. Give them to the Levites as each man’s work requires."
verses.textEnEsv: "Accept these from them, that they may be used in the service of the tent of meeting, and give them to the Levites, to each man according to his service."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Accept these from them, that they may be used in doing the work of the tabernacle of meeting; and you shall give them to the Levites, to every man according to his service."
verses.textEnNlt: "Receive their gifts, and use these oxen and wagons for transporting the Tabernacle. Distribute them among the Levites according to the work they have to do."
verses.textEnNasb: "Accept these things from them, that they may be used in the service of the tent of meeting, and you shall give them to the Levites, to each man according to his service."
verses.textEn: "Accept these from them, that they may be used in the work at the tent of meeting. Give them to the Levites as each man’s work requires."

verses.textZh: 于是摩西收下了车和牛，交给利未人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是摩西收下了车和牛，交给利未人。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是摩西收了车和牛，交给利未人，
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses took the wagons and the oxen and gave them to the Levites.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses took the carts and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses took the wagons and oxen and presented them to the Levites.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses took the carts and the oxen and gave them to the Levites.
verses.textEn: So Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites.

verses.textZh: 他按着革顺子孙所办的事务，把两辆车和四头牛交给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他按着革顺子孙所办的事务，把两辆车和四头牛交给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 把两辆车，四只牛，照革顺子孙所办的事交给他们，
verses.textEnNiv: He gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites, as their work required,
verses.textEnEsv: Two wagons and four oxen he gave to the sons of Gershon, according to their service.
verses.textEnNkjv: Two carts and four oxen he gave to the sons of Gershon, according to their service;
verses.textEnNlt: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the Gershonite division for their work,
verses.textEnNasb: Two carts and four oxen he gave to the sons of Gershon, according to their service,
verses.textEn: He gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites, as their work required,

verses.textZh: 又按着米拉利子孙所办的事务，把四辆车和八头牛交给他们；他们都受亚伦祭司的儿子以他玛的管理；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又按着米拉利子孙所办的事务，把四辆车和八头牛交给他们；他们都受亚伦祭司的儿子以他玛的管理；
verses.textZhCuv: 又把四辆车，八只牛，照米拉利子孙所办的事交给他们；他们都在祭司亚伦的儿子以他玛手下。
verses.textEnNiv: and he gave four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites, as their work required. They were all under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest.
verses.textEnEsv: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: and four carts and eight oxen he gave to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the authority of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.textEnNlt: and he gave four wagons and eight oxen to the Merarite division for their work. All their work was done under the leadership of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
verses.textEnNasb: and four carts and eight oxen he gave to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.textEn: and he gave four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites, as their work required. They were all under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest.

verses.textZh: 但是没有分给哥辖的子孙，因为他们所办的事是圣所的事，是要用肩头抬的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是没有分给哥辖的子孙，因为他们所办的事是圣所的事，是要用肩头抬的。
verses.textZhCuv: 但车与牛都没有交给哥辖子孙；因为他们办的是圣所的事，在肩头上抬圣物。
verses.textEnNiv: But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were to carry on their shoulders the holy things, for which they were responsible.
verses.textEnEsv: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because they were charged with the service of the holy things that had to be carried on the shoulder.
verses.textEnNkjv: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because theirs was the service of the holy things, which they carried on their shoulders.
verses.textEnNlt: But he gave none of the wagons or oxen to the Kohathite division, since they were required to carry the sacred objects of the Tabernacle on their shoulders.
verses.textEnNasb: But he did not give any to the sons of Kohath, because theirs was the service of the holy objects, which they carried on the shoulder.
verses.textEn: But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were to carry on their shoulders the holy things, for which they were responsible.

verses.textZh: 用膏抹祭坛的日子，众领袖都献上奉献祭坛的礼物；众领袖把自己的供物献在祭坛前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 用膏抹祭坛的日子，众领袖都献上奉献祭坛的礼物；众领袖把自己的供物献在祭坛前。
verses.textZhCuv: 用膏抹坛的日子，首领都来行奉献坛的礼，众首领就在坛前献供物。
verses.textEnNiv: When the altar was anointed, the leaders brought their offerings for its dedication and presented them before the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And the chiefs offered offerings for the dedication of the altar on the day it was anointed; and the chiefs offered their offering before the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the leaders offered the dedication offering for the altar when it was anointed; so the leaders offered their offering before the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: The leaders also presented dedication gifts for the altar at the time it was anointed. They each placed their gifts before the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: And the leaders offered the dedication offering for the altar when it was anointed, so the leaders offered their offering before the altar.
verses.textEn: When the altar was anointed, the leaders brought their offerings for its dedication and presented them before the altar.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："众领袖要献上自己奉献祭坛的供物，每天要有一位领袖来献上供物。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："众领袖要献上自己奉献祭坛的供物，每天要有一位领袖来献上供物。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「众首领为行奉献坛的礼，要每天一个首领来献供物。」
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord had said to Moses, "Each day one leader is to bring his offering for the dedication of the altar."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "They shall offer their offerings, one chief each day, for the dedication of the altar."
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord said to Moses, "They shall offer their offering, one leader each day, for the dedication of the altar."
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses, "Let one leader bring his gift each day for the dedication of the altar."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "They shall present their offering, one leader each day, for the dedication of the altar."
verses.textEn: For the Lord had said to Moses, "Each day one leader is to bring his offering for the dedication of the altar."

verses.textZh: 头一天献上供物的，是犹大支派的亚米拿达的儿子拿顺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 头一天献上供物的，是犹大支派的亚米拿达的儿子拿顺。
verses.textZhCuv: 头一日献供物的是犹大支派的亚米拿达的儿子拿顺。
verses.textEnNiv: The one who brought his offering on the first day was Nahshon son of Amminadab of the tribe of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: He who offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the one who offered his offering on the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, from the tribe of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: On the first day Nahshon son of Amminadab, leader of the tribe of Judah, presented his offering.

verses.textEnNiv: On the twelfth day Ahira son of Enan, the leader of the people of Naphtali, brought his offering.
verses.textEnEsv: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, the chief of the people of Naphtali:
verses.textEnNkjv: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, leader of the children of Naphtali, presentedanoffering.

verses.textEnNasb: On the twelfth day it was Ahira the son of Enan, leader of the sons of Naphtali;
verses.textEn: On the twelfth day Ahira son of Enan, the leader of the people of Naphtali, brought his offering.

verses.textZh: 他的供物是一个银盘，重一公斤半，一个银碗，重八百克，都是按圣所的秤；这两样都盛满调油的细面作素祭；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的供物是一个银盘，重一公斤半，一个银碗，重八百克，都是按圣所的秤；这两样都盛满调油的细面作素祭；
verses.textZhCuv: 他的供物是：一个银盘子，重一百三十舍客勒，一个银碗，重七十舍客勒，都是按圣所的平，也都盛满了调油的细面作素祭；
verses.textEnNiv: His offering was one silver plate weighing a hundred and thirty shekels and one silver sprinkling bowl weighing seventy shekels, both according to the sanctuary shekel, each filled with the finest flour mixed with olive oil as a grain offering;
verses.textEnEsv: his offering was one silver plate whose weight was 130 shekels, one silver basin of 70 shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
verses.textEnNkjv: His offering was one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred and thirty shekels, and one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering;
verses.textEnNlt: His offering consisted of a silver platter weighing 3-1/4 pounds and a silver basin weighing 1-3/4 pounds (as measured by the weight of the sanctuary shekel). These were both filled with grain offerings of choice flour moistened with olive oil.
verses.textEnNasb: his offering was also one silver dish whose weight was 130 shekels, and one silver bowl of seventy shekels in sanctuary shekels, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering;
verses.textEn: His offering was one silver plate weighing a hundred and thirty shekels and one silver sprinkling bowl weighing seventy shekels, both according to the sanctuary shekel, each filled with the finest flour mixed with olive oil as a grain offering;

verses.textEnNlt: He also brought a gold container weighing four ounces, which was filled with incense.
verses.textEnNasb: one gold pan of ten shekels, full of incense;
verses.textEn: one gold dish weighing ten shekels, filled with incense;

verses.textZhCnvs: 作平安祭的，是两头公牛、五只公绵羊、五只公山羊、五只一岁的公羊羔；这是以南的儿子亚希拉的供物。

verses.textEnNiv: and two oxen, five rams, five male goats and five male lambs a year old to be sacrificed as a fellowship offering. This was the offering of Ahira son of Enan.
