verses.textZh: 用膏抹祭坛的日子，以色列的众领袖献上奉献祭坛的供物，共有银盘十二个、银碗十二个、金盂十二个，
verses.textZhCnvs: 用膏抹祭坛的日子，以色列的众领袖献上奉献祭坛的供物，共有银盘十二个、银碗十二个、金盂十二个，
verses.textZhCuv: 用膏抹坛的日子，以色列的众首领为行献坛之礼所献的是：银盘子十二个，银碗十二个，金盂十二个；
verses.textEnNiv: These were the offerings of the Israelite leaders for the dedication of the altar when it was anointed: twelve silver plates, twelve silver sprinkling bowls and twelve gold dishes.
verses.textEnEsv: This was the dedication offering for the altar on the day when it was anointed, from the chiefs of Israel: twelve silver plates, twelve silver basins, twelve golden dishes,
verses.textEnNkjv: This was the dedication offering for the altar from the leaders of Israel, when it was anointed: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, and twelve gold pans.
verses.textEnNlt: So this was the dedication offering brought by the leaders of Israel at the time the altar was anointed: twelve silver platters, twelve silver basins, and twelve gold incense containers.
verses.textEnNasb: This was the dedication offering for the altar from the leaders of Israel when it was anointed: twelve silver dishes, twelve silver bowls, and twelve gold pans,
verses.textEn: These were the offerings of the Israelite leaders for the dedication of the altar when it was anointed: twelve silver plates, twelve silver sprinkling bowls and twelve gold dishes.

verses.textZh: 每个银盘重一公斤半，每个银碗重八百克；一切器皿的银子，按圣所的秤，共有二十七公斤零六百克；
verses.textZhCnvs: 每个银盘重一公斤半，每个银碗重八百克；一切器皿的银子，按圣所的秤，共有二十七公斤零六百克；
verses.textZhCuv: 每盘子重一百三十舍客勒，每碗重七十舍客勒。一切器皿的银子，按圣所的平，共有二千四百舍客勒。
verses.textEnNiv: Each silver plate weighed a hundred and thirty shekels, and each sprinkling bowl seventy shekels. Altogether, the silver dishes weighed two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
verses.textEnEsv: each silver plate weighing 130 shekels and each basin 70, all the silver of the vessels 2,400 shekels according to the shekel of the sanctuary,
verses.textEnNkjv: Each silver platter weighed one hundred and thirty shekels and each bowl seventy shekels. All the silver of the vessels weighed two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNlt: Each silver platter weighed 3-1/4 pounds, and each silver basin weighed 1-3/4 pounds. The total weight of the silver was 60 pounds (as measured by the weight of the sanctuary shekel).
verses.textEnNasb: each silver dish weighing 130 shekels and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the utensils totaled 2,400 in sanctuary shekels;
verses.textEn: Each silver plate weighed a hundred and thirty shekels, and each sprinkling bowl seventy shekels. Altogether, the silver dishes weighed two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.

verses.textZh: 金盂十二个，盛满了香，按圣所的秤，每个金盂重一百一十克；这些金盂的金子，共有一公斤零三百二十克；
verses.textZhCnvs: 金盂十二个，盛满了香，按圣所的秤，每个金盂重一百一十克；这些金盂的金子，共有一公斤零三百二十克；
verses.textZhCuv: 十二个金盂盛满了香，按圣所的平，每盂重十舍客勒，所有的金子共一百二十舍客勒。
verses.textEnNiv: The twelve gold dishes filled with incense weighed ten shekels each, according to the sanctuary shekel. Altogether, the gold dishes weighed a hundred and twenty shekels.
verses.textEnEsv: the twelve golden dishes, full of incense, weighing 10 shekels apiece according to the shekel of the sanctuary, all the gold of the dishes being 120 shekels;
verses.textEnNkjv: The twelve gold pans full of incense weighed ten shekels apiece, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the pans weighed one hundred and twenty shekels.
verses.textEnNlt: Each of the twelve gold containers that was filled with incense weighed four ounces (as measured by the weight of the sanctuary shekel). The total weight of the gold was three pounds.
verses.textEnNasb: the twelve gold pans full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece in sanctuary shekels, all the gold of the pans totaled 120 shekels.
verses.textEn: The twelve gold dishes filled with incense weighed ten shekels each, according to the sanctuary shekel. Altogether, the gold dishes weighed a hundred and twenty shekels.

verses.textZh: 作燔祭的牲畜，共有公牛犊十二头、公绵羊十二只、一岁的公羊羔十二只，还有同献的素祭，以及作赎罪祭的公山羊十二只；
verses.textZhCnvs: 作燔祭的牲畜，共有公牛犊十二头、公绵羊十二只、一岁的公羊羔十二只，还有同献的素祭，以及作赎罪祭的公山羊十二只；
verses.textZhCuv: 作燔祭的，共有公牛十二只，公羊十二只，一岁的公羊羔十二只，并同献的素祭作赎罪祭的公山羊十二只；
verses.textEnNiv: The total number of animals for the burnt offering came to twelve young bulls, twelve rams and twelve male lambs a year old, together with their grain offering. Twelve male goats were used for the sin offering.
verses.textEnEsv: all the cattle for the burnt offering twelve bulls, twelve rams, twelve male lambs a year old, with their grain offering; and twelve male goats for a sin offering;
verses.textEnNkjv: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve young bulls, the rams twelve, the male lambs in their first year twelve, with their grain offering, and the kids of the goats as a sin offering twelve.
verses.textEnNlt: Twelve young bulls, twelve rams, and twelve one-year-old male lambs were donated for the burnt offerings, along with their prescribed grain offerings. Twelve male goats were brought for the sin offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: All the oxen for the burnt offering totaled twelve bulls, all the rams, twelve, the male lambs one year old with their grain offering, twelve, and the male goats as a sin offering, twelve;
verses.textEn: The total number of animals for the burnt offering came to twelve young bulls, twelve rams and twelve male lambs a year old, together with their grain offering. Twelve male goats were used for the sin offering.

verses.textZh: 作平安祭的牲畜，共有公牛二十四头、公绵羊六十只、公山羊六十只、一岁的公羊羔六十只；这就是用膏抹祭坛以后，所献上奉献祭坛的供物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作平安祭的牲畜，共有公牛二十四头、公绵羊六十只、公山羊六十只、一岁的公羊羔六十只；这就是用膏抹祭坛以后，所献上奉献祭坛的供物。
verses.textZhCuv: 作平安祭的，共有公牛二十四只，公绵羊六十只，公山羊六十只，一岁的公羊羔六十只。这就是用膏抹坛之后，为行奉献坛之礼所献的。
verses.textEnNiv: The total number of animals for the sacrifice of the fellowship offering came to twenty-four oxen, sixty rams, sixty male goats and sixty male lambs a year old. These were the offerings for the dedication of the altar after it was anointed.
verses.textEnEsv: and all the cattle for the sacrifice of peace offerings twenty-four bulls, the rams sixty, the male goats sixty, the male lambs a year old sixty. This was the dedication offering for the altar after it was anointed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of peace offerings were twenty-four bulls, the rams sixty, the male goats sixty, and the lambs in their first year sixty. This was the dedication offering for the altar after it was anointed.
verses.textEnNlt: Twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty one-year-old male lambs were donated for the peace offerings. This was the dedication offering for the altar after it was anointed.
verses.textEnNasb: and all the oxen for the sacrifice of peace offerings totaled twenty-four bulls, all the rams, sixty, the male goats, sixty, and the male lambs one year old, sixty. This was the dedication offering for the altar after it was anointed.
verses.textEn: The total number of animals for the sacrifice of the fellowship offering came to twenty-four oxen, sixty rams, sixty male goats and sixty male lambs a year old. These were the offerings for the dedication of the altar after it was anointed.

verses.textZh: 摩西进入会幕要与耶和华说话的时候，就听见法柜的施恩座上，二基路伯中间，有与他说话的声音，是耶和华与他说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西进入会幕要与耶和华说话的时候，就听见法柜的施恩座上，二基路伯中间，有与他说话的声音，是耶和华与他说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西进会幕要与耶和华说话的时候，听见法柜的施恩座以上、二基路伯中间有与他说话的声音，就是耶和华与他说话。
verses.textEnNiv: When Moses entered the tent of meeting to speak with the Lord , he heard the voice speaking to him from between the two cherubim above the atonement cover on the ark of the covenant law. In this way the Lord spoke to him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Moses went into the tent of meeting to speak with the Lord , he heard the voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the testimony, from between the two cherubim; and it spoke to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Moses went into the tabernacle of meeting to speak with Him, he heard the voice of One speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim; thus He spoke to him.
verses.textEnNlt: Whenever Moses went into the Tabernacle to speak with the Lord , he heard the voice speaking to him from between the two cherubim above the Ark’s cover—the place of atonement—that rests on the Ark of the Covenant. The Lord spoke to him from there.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Moses entered the tent of meeting to speak with Him, he heard the voice speaking to him from above the atoning cover that was on the ark of the testimony, from between the two cherubim; so He spoke to him.
verses.textEn: When Moses entered the tent of meeting to speak with the Lord , he heard the voice speaking to him from between the two cherubim above the atonement cover on the ark of the covenant law. In this way the Lord spoke to him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉亚伦：‘你点灯的时候，七盏灯都要照向灯台的前面。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉亚伦：‘你点灯的时候，七盏灯都要照向灯台的前面。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你告诉亚伦说：点灯的时候，七盏灯都要向灯台前面发光。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Speak to Aaron and say to him, ‘When you set up the lamps, see that all seven light up the area in front of the lampstand.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to Aaron and say to him, When you set up the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lampstand."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to Aaron, and say to him, ‘When you arrange the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lampstand.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Give Aaron the following instructions: When you set up the seven lamps in the lampstand, place them so their light shines forward in front of the lampstand."
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to Aaron and say to him, ‘When you mount the lamps, the seven lamps will provide light in the front of the lampstand.’ "
verses.textEn: "Speak to Aaron and say to him, ‘When you set up the lamps, see that all seven light up the area in front of the lampstand.’ "

verses.textZh: 亚伦就这样行了；他把灯台上的灯都点着了，使光照向灯台的前面，正如耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦就这样行了；他把灯台上的灯都点着了，使光照向灯台的前面，正如耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦便这样行。他点灯台上的灯，使灯向前发光，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.textEnNiv: Aaron did so; he set up the lamps so that they faced forward on the lampstand, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: And Aaron did so: he set up its lamps in front of the lampstand, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Aaron did so; he arranged the lamps to face toward the front of the lampstand, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: So Aaron did this. He set up the seven lamps so they reflected their light forward, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore Aaron did so; he mounted its lamps at the front of the lampstand, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: Aaron did so; he set up the lamps so that they faced forward on the lampstand, just as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 这灯台的做法是这样：是用金子锤出来的，从座到花都是锤出来的。摩西制造灯台，是照着耶和华指示的样式做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这灯台的做法是这样：是用金子锤出来的，从座到花都是锤出来的。摩西制造灯台，是照着耶和华指示的样式做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这灯台的做法是用金子锤出来的，连座带花都是锤出来的。摩西制造灯台，是照耶和华所指示的样式。
verses.textEnNiv: This is how the lampstand was made: It was made of hammered gold—from its base to its blossoms. The lampstand was made exactly like the pattern the Lord had shown Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: And this was the workmanship of the lampstand, hammered work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was hammered work; according to the pattern that the Lord had shown Moses, so he made the lampstand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now this workmanship of the lampstand was hammered gold; from its shaft to its flowers it was hammered work. According to the pattern which the Lord had shown Moses, so he made the lampstand.
verses.textEnNlt: The entire lampstand, from its base to its decorative blossoms, was made of beaten gold. It was built according to the exact design the Lord had shown Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: Now this was the workmanship of the lampstand, hammered work of gold; from its base to its flower ornamentation it was hammered work; according to the pattern which the Lord had shown Moses, so he made the lampstand.
verses.textEn: This is how the lampstand was made: It was made of hammered gold—from its base to its blossoms. The lampstand was made exactly like the pattern the Lord had shown Moses.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses:
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Again the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses:

verses.textZh: "你要从以色列人中间选出利未人，洁净他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要从以色列人中间选出利未人，洁净他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你从以色列人中选出利未人来，洁净他们。
verses.textEnNiv: "Take the Levites from among all the Israelites and make them ceremonially clean.
verses.textEnEsv: "Take the Levites from among the people of Israel and cleanse them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Take the Levites from among the children of Israel and cleanse them ceremonially.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now set the Levites apart from the rest of the people of Israel and make them ceremonially clean.
verses.textEnNasb: "Take the Levites from among the sons of Israel and cleanse them.
verses.textEn: "Take the Levites from among all the Israelites and make them ceremonially clean.

verses.textZh: 你洁净他们当这样行：要把除罪水洒在他们身上，又叫他们用剃刀剃全身；把衣服洗净，洁净自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你洁净他们当这样行：要把除罪水洒在他们身上，又叫他们用剃刀剃全身；把衣服洗净，洁净自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 洁净他们当这样行：用除罪水弹在他们身上，又叫他们用剃头刀刮全身，洗衣服，洁净自己。
verses.textEnNiv: To purify them, do this: Sprinkle the water of cleansing on them; then have them shave their whole bodies and wash their clothes. And so they will purify themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus you shall do to them to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of purification upon them, and let them go with a razor over all their body, and wash their clothes and cleanse themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus you shall do to them to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purification on them, and let them shave all their body, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.
verses.textEnNlt: Do this by sprinkling them with the water of purification, and have them shave their entire body and wash their clothing. Then they will be ceremonially clean.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what you shall do to them, for their cleansing: sprinkle purifying water on them, and have them use a razor over their whole body, and they shall wash their clothes and cleanse themselves.
verses.textEn: To purify them, do this: Sprinkle the water of cleansing on them; then have them shave their whole bodies and wash their clothes. And so they will purify themselves.

verses.textZh: 然后，叫他们取一头公牛犊和同献的素祭，就是用油调和的细面；你要另取一头公牛犊，作赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后，叫他们取一头公牛犊和同献的素祭，就是用油调和的细面；你要另取一头公牛犊，作赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 然后叫他们取一只公牛犊，并同献的素祭，就是调油的细面；你要另取一只公牛犊作赎罪祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Have them take a young bull with its grain offering of the finest flour mixed with olive oil; then you are to take a second young bull for a sin offering.
verses.textEnEsv: Then let them take a bull from the herd and its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and you shall take another bull from the herd for a sin offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then let them take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and you shall take another young bull as a sin offering.
verses.textEnNlt: Have them bring a young bull and a grain offering of choice flour moistened with olive oil, along with a second young bull for a sin offering.
verses.textEnNasb: Then have them take a bull with its grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and you shall take a second bull as a sin offering.
verses.textEn: Have them take a young bull with its grain offering of the finest flour mixed with olive oil; then you are to take a second young bull for a sin offering.

verses.textZh: 你要把利未人带到会幕前面，又要召集以色列的全体会众；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把利未人带到会幕前面，又要召集以色列的全体会众；
verses.textZhCuv: 将利未人奉到会幕前，招聚以色列全会众。
verses.textEnNiv: Bring the Levites to the front of the tent of meeting and assemble the whole Israelite community.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall bring the Levites before the tent of meeting and assemble the whole congregation of the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall bring the Levites before the tabernacle of meeting, and you shall gather together the whole congregation of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then assemble the whole community of Israel, and present the Levites at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall present the Levites in front of the tent of meeting. You shall also assemble the whole congregation of the sons of Israel,
verses.textEn: Bring the Levites to the front of the tent of meeting and assemble the whole Israelite community.

verses.textZh: 你要把利未人带到耶和华面前，以色列人要按手在他们身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把利未人带到耶和华面前，以色列人要按手在他们身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 将利未人奉到耶和华面前，以色列人要按手在他们头上。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to bring the Levites before the Lord , and the Israelites are to lay their hands on them.
verses.textEnEsv: When you bring the Levites before the Lord , the people of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,
verses.textEnNkjv: So you shall bring the Levites before the Lord, and the children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites;
verses.textEnNlt: When you present the Levites before the Lord , the people of Israel must lay their hands on them.
verses.textEnNasb: and present the Levites before the Lord; and the sons of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites.
verses.textEn: You are to bring the Levites before the Lord , and the Israelites are to lay their hands on them.

verses.textZh: 亚伦要把利未人献在耶和华面前，作以色列人中的摇祭，使他们办理耶和华的事务。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦要把利未人献在耶和华面前，作以色列人中的摇祭，使他们办理耶和华的事务。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦也将他们奉到耶和华面前，为以色列人当作摇祭，使他们好办耶和华的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Aaron is to present the Levites before the Lord as a wave offering from the Israelites, so that they may be ready to do the work of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before the Lord as a wave offering from the people of Israel, that they may do the service of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before the Lordlike a wave offering from the children of Israel, that they may perform the work of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Raising his hands, Aaron must then present the Levites to the Lord as a special offering from the people of Israel, thus dedicating them to the Lord ’s service.
verses.textEnNasb: Aaron then shall present the Levites before the Lord as a wave offering from the sons of Israel, so that they may qualify to perform the service of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Aaron is to present the Levites before the Lord as a wave offering from the Israelites, so that they may be ready to do the work of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 利未人要按手在那两头牛的头上；你要把一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭，献给耶和华，为利未人赎罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人要按手在那两头牛的头上；你要把一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭，献给耶和华，为利未人赎罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人要按手在那两只牛的头上；你要将一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭，献给耶和华，为利未人赎罪。
verses.textEnNiv: "Then the Levites are to lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, using one for a sin offering to the Lord and the other for a burnt offering, to make atonement for the Levites.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering to the Lord to make atonement for the Levites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the young bulls, and you shall offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to the Lord, to make atonement for the Levites.
verses.textEnNlt: "Next the Levites will lay their hands on the heads of the young bulls. Present one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to the Lord , to purify the Levites and make them right with the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls; then you are to offer the one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to the Lord, to make atonement for the Levites.
verses.textEn: "Then the Levites are to lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, using one for a sin offering to the Lord and the other for a burnt offering, to make atonement for the Levites.

verses.textZh: 你又要叫利未人站在亚伦和他的儿子们面前，把他们作摇祭献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你又要叫利未人站在亚伦和他的儿子们面前，把他们作摇祭献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 你也要使利未人站在亚伦和他儿子面前，将他们当作摇祭奉给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Have the Levites stand in front of Aaron and his sons and then present them as a wave offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall set the Levites before Aaron and his sons, and shall offer them as a wave offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "And you shall stand the Levites before Aaron and his sons, and then offer them like a wave offering to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then have the Levites stand in front of Aaron and his sons, and raise your hands and present them as a special offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall have the Levites stand before Aaron and his sons so as to present them as a wave offering to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Have the Levites stand in front of Aaron and his sons and then present them as a wave offering to the Lord .

verses.textZh: "这样，你要把利未人从以色列人中分别出来，利未人就要归我。
verses.textZhCnvs: "这样，你要把利未人从以色列人中分别出来，利未人就要归我。
verses.textZhCuv: 「这样，你从以色列人中将利未人分别出来，利未人便要归我。
verses.textEnNiv: In this way you are to set the Levites apart from the other Israelites, and the Levites will be mine.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the people of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be Mine.
verses.textEnNlt: In this way, you will set the Levites apart from the rest of the people of Israel, and the Levites will belong to me.
verses.textEnNasb: "So you shall single out the Levites from among the sons of Israel, and the Levites shall be Mine.
verses.textEn: In this way you are to set the Levites apart from the other Israelites, and the Levites will be mine.

verses.textZh: 以后，利未人可以进去办理会幕的事；你要洁净他们，把他们作摇祭献上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以后，利未人可以进去办理会幕的事；你要洁净他们，把他们作摇祭献上。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后利未人要进去办会幕的事，你要洁净他们，将他们当作摇祭奉上；
verses.textEnNiv: "After you have purified the Levites and presented them as a wave offering, they are to come to do their work at the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: And after that the Levites shall go in to serve at the tent of meeting, when you have cleansed them and offered them as a wave offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: After that the Levites shall go in to service the tabernacle of meeting. So you shall cleanse them and offer them like a wave offering.
verses.textEnNlt: After this, they may go into the Tabernacle to do their work, because you have purified them and presented them as a special offering.
verses.textEnNasb: Then after that the Levites may go in to serve the tent of meeting. But you shall cleanse them and present them as a wave offering;
verses.textEn: "After you have purified the Levites and presented them as a wave offering, they are to come to do their work at the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 因为他们是以色列人中完全献给我的；我选出了他们归我，是代替以色列人中所有头生的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们是以色列人中完全献给我的；我选出了他们归我，是代替以色列人中所有头生的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们是从以色列人中全然给我的，我拣选他们归我，是代替以色列人中一切头生的。
verses.textEnNiv: They are the Israelites who are to be given wholly to me. I have taken them as my own in place of the firstborn, the first male offspring from every Israelite woman.
verses.textEnEsv: For they are wholly given to me from among the people of Israel. Instead of all who open the womb, the firstborn of all the people of Israel, I have taken them for myself.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they are wholly given to Me from among the children of Israel; I have taken them for Myself instead of all who open the womb, the firstborn of all the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "Of all the people of Israel, the Levites are reserved for me. I have claimed them for myself in place of all the firstborn sons of the Israelites; I have taken the Levites as their substitutes.
verses.textEnNasb: for they are exclusively given to Me from among the sons of Israel. I have taken them for Myself instead of the firstborn of every womb, the firstborn of all the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: They are the Israelites who are to be given wholly to me. I have taken them as my own in place of the firstborn, the first male offspring from every Israelite woman.

verses.textZh: 因为以色列人中所有头生的，连人带畜都是我的；我在埃及地击杀所有头生的那一天，就把他们分别为圣归我了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为以色列人中所有头生的，连人带畜都是我的；我在埃及地击杀所有头生的那一天，就把他们分别为圣归我了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人中一切头生的，连人带牲畜，都是我的。我在埃及地击杀一切头生的那天，将他们分别为圣归我。
verses.textEnNiv: Every firstborn male in Israel, whether human or animal, is mine. When I struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, I set them apart for myself.
verses.textEnEsv: For all the firstborn among the people of Israel are mine, both of man and of beast. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I consecrated them for myself,
verses.textEnNkjv: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are Mine, both man and beast; on the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them to Myself.
verses.textEnNlt: For all the firstborn males among the people of Israel are mine, both of people and of animals. I set them apart for myself on the day I struck down all the firstborn sons of the Egyptians.
verses.textEnNasb: For every firstborn among the sons of Israel is Mine, among the people and among the animals; on the day that I fatally struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for Myself.
verses.textEn: Every firstborn male in Israel, whether human or animal, is mine. When I struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, I set them apart for myself.

verses.textZh: 我选出了利未人，代替以色列人中所有头生的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我选出了利未人，代替以色列人中所有头生的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我拣选利未人代替以色列人中一切头生的。
verses.textEnNiv: And I have taken the Levites in place of all the firstborn sons in Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: and I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I have claimed the Levites in place of all the firstborn sons of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: But I have taken the Levites instead of every firstborn among the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: And I have taken the Levites in place of all the firstborn sons in Israel.

verses.textZh: 我从以色列人中，把利未人赐给亚伦和他的众子，在会幕里办理以色列人的事务，又为以色列人赎罪，免得他们走近圣所的时候，就有灾祸临到他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我从以色列人中，把利未人赐给亚伦和他的众子，在会幕里办理以色列人的事务，又为以色列人赎罪，免得他们走近圣所的时候，就有灾祸临到他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我从以色列人中将利未人当作赏赐给亚伦和他的儿子，在会幕中办以色列人的事，又为以色列人赎罪，免得他们挨近圣所，有灾殃临到他们中间。」
verses.textEnNiv: From among all the Israelites, I have given the Levites as gifts to Aaron and his sons to do the work at the tent of meeting on behalf of the Israelites and to make atonement for them so that no plague will strike the Israelites when they go near the sanctuary."
verses.textEnEsv: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and his sons from among the people of Israel, to do the service for the people of Israel at the tent of meeting and to make atonement for the people of Israel, that there may be no plague among the people of Israel when the people of Israel come near the sanctuary."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the work for the children of Israel in the tabernacle of meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel, that there be no plague among the children of Israel when the children of Israel come near the sanctuary."
verses.textEnNlt: And of all the Israelites, I have assigned the Levites to Aaron and his sons. They will serve in the Tabernacle on behalf of the Israelites and make sacrifices to purify the people so no plague will strike them when they approach the sanctuary."
verses.textEnNasb: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the sons of Israel, to perform the service of the sons of Israel at the tent of meeting and to make atonement on behalf of the sons of Israel, so that there will be no affliction among the sons of Israel due to their approaching the sanctuary."
verses.textEn: From among all the Israelites, I have given the Levites as gifts to Aaron and his sons to do the work at the tent of meeting on behalf of the Israelites and to make atonement for them so that no plague will strike the Israelites when they go near the sanctuary."

verses.textZh: 摩西、亚伦和以色列的全体会众，就向利未人这样行了；耶和华指着利未人吩咐摩西的，以色列人都照样向他们行了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西、亚伦和以色列的全体会众，就向利未人这样行了；耶和华指着利未人吩咐摩西的，以色列人都照样向他们行了。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西、亚伦，并以色列全会众便向利未人如此行。凡耶和华指着利未人所吩咐摩西的，以色列人就向他们这样行。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses, Aaron and the whole Israelite community did with the Levites just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus did Moses and Aaron and all the congregation of the people of Israel to the Levites. According to all that the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites, the people of Israel did to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Moses and Aaron and all the congregation of the children of Israel did to the Levites; according to all that the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses, Aaron, and the whole community of Israel dedicated the Levites, carefully following all the Lord ’s instructions to Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: So this is what Moses, Aaron, and all the congregation of the sons of Israel did to the Levites; according to everything that the Lord had commanded Moses regarding the Levites, so the sons of Israel did to them.
verses.textEn: Moses, Aaron and the whole Israelite community did with the Levites just as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 于是利未人洁净了自己，把衣服洗净；亚伦把他们作摇祭献在耶和华面前；亚伦又为他们赎罪，洁净他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是利未人洁净了自己，把衣服洗净；亚伦把他们作摇祭献在耶和华面前；亚伦又为他们赎罪，洁净他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是利未人洁净自己，除了罪，洗了衣服；亚伦将他们当作摇祭奉到耶和华面前，又为他们赎罪，洁净他们。
verses.textEnNiv: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes. Then Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the Lord and made atonement for them to purify them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Levites purified themselves from sin and washed their clothes, and Aaron offered them as a wave offering before the Lord , and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes; then Aaron presented them like a wave offering before the Lord, and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.
verses.textEnNlt: The Levites purified themselves from sin and washed their clothes, and Aaron lifted them up and presented them to the Lord as a special offering. He then offered a sacrifice to purify them and make them right with the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The Levites, too, purified themselves from sin and washed their clothes; and Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the Lord. Aaron also made atonement for them to cleanse them.
verses.textEn: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes. Then Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the Lord and made atonement for them to purify them.

verses.textZh: 然后，利未人才进去，在亚伦和他的众子面前，在会幕里办理他们的事务；耶和华指着利未人怎样吩咐摩西，以色列人就怎样向他们行了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后，利未人才进去，在亚伦和他的众子面前，在会幕里办理他们的事务；耶和华指着利未人怎样吩咐摩西，以色列人就怎样向他们行了。
verses.textZhCuv: 然后利未人进去，在亚伦和他儿子面前，在会幕中办事。耶和华指着利未人怎样吩咐摩西，以色列人就怎样向他们行了。
verses.textEnNiv: After that, the Levites came to do their work at the tent of meeting under the supervision of Aaron and his sons. They did with the Levites just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: And after that the Levites went in to do their service in the tent of meeting before Aaron and his sons; as the Lord had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: After that the Levites went in to do their work in the tabernacle of meeting before Aaron and his sons; as the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
verses.textEnNlt: After that the Levites went into the Tabernacle to perform their duties, assisting Aaron and his sons. So they carried out all the commands that the Lord gave Moses concerning the Levites.
verses.textEnNasb: Then after that the Levites went in to perform their service in the tent of meeting before Aaron and his sons; just as the Lord had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
verses.textEn: After that, the Levites came to do their work at the tent of meeting under the supervision of Aaron and his sons. They did with the Levites just as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord also instructed Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.textZh: 这些人对摩西说："我们虽然因为接触死人而不洁净，为甚么我们被拒绝，不能在以色列人中，在指定的时间献耶和华的供物呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人对摩西说："我们虽然因为接触死人而不洁净，为甚么我们被拒绝，不能在以色列人中，在指定的时间献耶和华的供物呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「我们虽因死尸而不洁净，为何被阻止、不得同以色列人在所定的日期献耶和华的供物呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: and said to Moses, "We have become unclean because of a dead body, but why should we be kept from presenting the Lord ’s offering with the other Israelites at the appointed time?"
verses.textEnEsv: And those men said to him, "We are unclean through touching a dead body. Why are we kept from bringing the Lord ’s offering at its appointed time among the people of Israel?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And those men said to him, "We became defiled by a human corpse. Why are we kept from presenting the offering of the Lord at its appointed time among the children of Israel?"
verses.textEnNlt: and said, "We have become ceremonially unclean by touching a dead body. But why should we be prevented from presenting the Lord ’s offering at the proper time with the rest of the Israelites?"
verses.textEnNasb: Those men said to him, "Though we are unclean because of a dead person, why are we kept from presenting the offering of the Lord at its appointed time among the sons of Israel?"
verses.textEn: and said to Moses, "We have become unclean because of a dead body, but why should we be kept from presenting the Lord ’s offering with the other Israelites at the appointed time?"

verses.textZh: 摩西对他们说："你们且等候，我要去听耶和华对你们有甚么吩咐。"

verses.textEnNiv: Moses answered them, "Wait until I find out what the Lord commands concerning you."
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses said to them, "Wait, that I may hear what the Lord will command concerning you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said to them, "Stand still, that I may hear what the Lord will command concerning you."
verses.textEnNlt: Moses answered, "Wait here until I have received instructions for you from the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: Moses then said to them, " Wait, and I will listen to what the Lord will command concerning you."
verses.textEn: Moses answered them, "Wait until I find out what the Lord commands concerning you."

verses.textZh: "你要告诉以色列人说：你们或你们的后代中，如果有人因为接触死人而成为不洁净，或因到远方旅行，他还要向耶和华守逾越节；
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉以色列人说：你们或你们的后代中，如果有人因为接触死人而成为不洁净，或因到远方旅行，他还要向耶和华守逾越节；
verses.textZhCuv: 「你晓谕以色列人说：你们和你们后代中，若有人因死尸而不洁净，或在远方行路，还要向耶和华守逾越节。
verses.textEnNiv: "Tell the Israelites: ‘When any of you or your descendants are unclean because of a dead body or are away on a journey, they are still to celebrate the Lord ’s Passover,
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel, saying, If any one of you or of your descendants is unclean through touching a dead body, or is on a long journey, he shall still keep the Passover to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying: ‘If anyone of you or your posterity is unclean because of a corpse, or is far away on a journey, he may still keep the Lord’s Passover.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel: If any of the people now or in future generations are ceremonially unclean at Passover time because of touching a dead body, or if they are on a journey and cannot be present at the ceremony, they may still celebrate the Lord ’s Passover.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘If any one of you or of your generations becomes unclean because of a dead person, or is on a distant journey, he may, however, celebrate the Passover to the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Tell the Israelites: ‘When any of you or your descendants are unclean because of a dead body or are away on a journey, they are still to celebrate the Lord ’s Passover,

verses.textZh: 他们要在二月十四日，黄昏的时候，守逾越节，同时要吃无酵饼和苦菜；

verses.textEnNiv: but they are to do it on the fourteenth day of the second month at twilight. They are to eat the lamb, together with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

verses.textEnNkjv: On the fourteenth day of the second month, at twilight, they may keep it. They shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

verses.textZh: 一点也不留到早晨，羊羔的骨头，一根也不可折断；他们要照着逾越节的一切律例守节。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一点也不留到早晨，羊羔的骨头，一根也不可折断；他们要照着逾越节的一切律例守节。

verses.textEnNiv: They must not leave any of it till morning or break any of its bones. When they celebrate the Passover, they must follow all the regulations.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break any of its bones; according to all the statute for the Passover they shall keep it.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall leave none of it until morning, nor break one of its bones. According to all the ordinances of the Passover they shall keep it.
verses.textEnNlt: They must not leave any of the lamb until the next morning, and they must not break any of its bones. They must follow all the normal regulations concerning the Passover.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall not leave any of it until morning, nor break a bone of it; they shall celebrate it in accordance with the whole statute of the Passover.
verses.textEn: They must not leave any of it till morning or break any of its bones. When they celebrate the Passover, they must follow all the regulations.

verses.textZh: 但那洁净的，又不在路上旅行的人，如果忽略守逾越节，那人就要从自己的民中被剪除，因为他没有在指定的时间内献上耶和华的供物，那人必担当自己的罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但那洁净的，又不在路上旅行的人，如果忽略守逾越节，那人就要从自己的民中被剪除，因为他没有在指定的时间内献上耶和华的供物，那人必担当自己的罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 那洁净而不行路的人若推辞不守逾越节，那人要从民中剪除；因为他在所定的日期不献耶和华的供物，应该担当他的罪。
verses.textEnNiv: But if anyone who is ceremonially clean and not on a journey fails to celebrate the Passover, they must be cut off from their people for not presenting the Lord ’s offering at the appointed time. They will bear the consequences of their sin.
verses.textEnEsv: But if anyone who is clean and is not on a journey fails to keep the Passover, that person shall be cut off from his people because he did not bring the Lord ’s offering at its appointed time; that man shall bear his sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the man who is clean and is not on a journey, and ceases to keep the Passover, that same person shall be cut off from among his people, because he did not bring the offering of the Lord at its appointed time; that man shall bear his sin.
verses.textEnNlt: "But those who neglect to celebrate the Passover at the regular time, even though they are ceremonially clean and not away on a trip, will be cut off from the community of Israel. If they fail to present the Lord ’s offering at the proper time, they will suffer the consequences of their guilt.
verses.textEnNasb: But the person who is clean and is not on a journey, yet refrains from celebrating the Passover, that person shall then be cut off from his people, because he did not present the offering of the Lord at its appointed time. That person will bear the responsibility for his sin.
verses.textEn: But if anyone who is ceremonially clean and not on a journey fails to celebrate the Passover, they must be cut off from their people for not presenting the Lord ’s offering at the appointed time. They will bear the consequences of their sin.

verses.textZh: 如果有外人寄居在你们中间，想要向耶和华守逾越节，他就必须照着逾越节的条例和典章而行；不论是外人或是本地人，只有一样的条例。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有外人寄居在你们中间，想要向耶和华守逾越节，他就必须照着逾越节的条例和典章而行；不论是外人或是本地人，只有一样的条例。"
verses.textZhCuv: 若有外人寄居在你们中间，愿意向耶和华守逾越节，他要照逾越节的律例典章行，不管是寄居的是本地人，同归一例。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘A foreigner residing among you is also to celebrate the Lord ’s Passover in accordance with its rules and regulations. You must have the same regulations for both the foreigner and the native-born.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And if a stranger sojourns among you and would keep the Passover to the Lord , according to the statute of the Passover and according to its rule, so shall he do. You shall have one statute, both for the sojourner and for the native."
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And if a stranger dwells among you, and would keep the Lord’s Passover, he must do so according to the rite of the Passover and according to its ceremony; you shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger and the native of the land.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And if foreigners living among you want to celebrate the Passover to the Lord , they must follow these same decrees and regulations. The same laws apply both to native-born Israelites and to the foreigners living among you."
verses.textEnNasb: And if a stranger resides among you and celebrates the Passover to the Lord, according to the statute of the Passover and its ordinance, so he shall celebrate it; you shall have the same statute, both for the stranger and for the native of the land.’ "
verses.textEn: " ‘A foreigner residing among you is also to celebrate the Lord ’s Passover in accordance with its rules and regulations. You must have the same regulations for both the foreigner and the native-born.’ "

verses.textZh: 在竖立帐幕的那一天，有云彩遮盖着帐幕，就是法柜的帐幕；到了晚上，云彩在帐幕上，形状像火，直到早晨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在竖立帐幕的那一天，有云彩遮盖着帐幕，就是法柜的帐幕；到了晚上，云彩在帐幕上，形状像火，直到早晨。
verses.textZhCuv: 立起帐幕的那日，有云彩遮盖帐幕，就是法柜的帐幕；从晚上到早晨，云彩在其上，形状如火。
verses.textEnNiv: On the day the tabernacle, the tent of the covenant law, was set up, the cloud covered it. From evening till morning the cloud above the tabernacle looked like fire.
verses.textEnEsv: On the day that the tabernacle was set up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, the tent of the testimony. And at evening it was over the tabernacle like the appearance of fire until morning.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now on the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, the tent of the Testimony; from evening until morning it was above the tabernacle like the appearance of fire.
verses.textEnNlt: On the day the Tabernacle was set up, the cloud covered it. But from evening until morning the cloud over the Tabernacle looked like a pillar of fire.
verses.textEnNasb: Now on the day that the tabernacle was erected, the cloud covered the tabernacle, the tent of the testimony, and in the evening it was like the appearance of fire over the tabernacle until morning.
verses.textEn: On the day the tabernacle, the tent of the covenant law, was set up, the cloud covered it. From evening till morning the cloud above the tabernacle looked like fire.

verses.textZh: 常常是这样：白天 有云彩遮盖帐幕，夜间云彩形状像火。
verses.textZhCnvs: 常常是这样：白天 有云彩遮盖帐幕，夜间云彩形状像火。
verses.textZhCuv: 常是这样，云彩遮盖帐幕，夜间形状如火。
verses.textEnNiv: That is how it continued to be; the cloud covered it, and at night it looked like fire.
verses.textEnEsv: So it was always: the cloud covered it by day and the appearance of fire by night.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was always: the cloud covered it byday, and the appearance of fire by night.
verses.textEnNlt: This was the regular pattern—at night the cloud that covered the Tabernacle had the appearance of fire.
verses.textEnNasb: That is how it was continuously; the cloud would cover it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.
verses.textEn: That is how it continued to be; the cloud covered it, and at night it looked like fire.

verses.textZh: 云彩甚么时候从会幕上收去，以色列人就起行；云彩在甚么地方停住，以色列人就在那里安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 云彩甚么时候从会幕上收去，以色列人就起行；云彩在甚么地方停住，以色列人就在那里安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 云彩几时从帐幕收上去，以色列人就几时起行；云彩在哪里停住，以色列人就在那里安营。
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever the cloud lifted from above the tent, the Israelites set out; wherever the cloud settled, the Israelites encamped.
verses.textEnEsv: And whenever the cloud lifted from over the tent, after that the people of Israel set out, and in the place where the cloud settled down, there the people of Israel camped.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whenever the cloud was taken up from above the tabernacle, after that the children of Israel would journey; and in the place where the cloud settled, there the children of Israel would pitch their tents.
verses.textEnNlt: Whenever the cloud lifted from over the sacred tent, the people of Israel would break camp and follow it. And wherever the cloud settled, the people of Israel would set up camp.
verses.textEnNasb: Whenever the cloud was lifted from over the tent, afterward the sons of Israel would set out; and in the place where the cloud settled down, there the sons of Israel would camp.
verses.textEn: Whenever the cloud lifted from above the tent, the Israelites set out; wherever the cloud settled, the Israelites encamped.

verses.textZh: 以色列人照着耶和华的吩咐起行，也照着耶和华的吩咐安营；云彩在帐幕上停留多久，他们就安营多久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人照着耶和华的吩咐起行，也照着耶和华的吩咐安营；云彩在帐幕上停留多久，他们就安营多久。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人遵耶和华的吩咐起行，也遵耶和华的吩咐安营。云彩在帐幕上停住几时，他们就住营几时。
verses.textEnNiv: At the Lord ’s command the Israelites set out, and at his command they encamped. As long as the cloud stayed over the tabernacle, they remained in camp.
verses.textEnEsv: At the command of the Lord the people of Israel set out, and at the command of the Lord they camped. As long as the cloud rested over the tabernacle, they remained in camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: At the command of the Lord the children of Israel would journey, and at the command of the Lord they would camp; as long as the cloud stayed above the tabernacle they remained encamped.
verses.textEnNlt: In this way, they traveled and camped at the Lord ’s command wherever he told them to go. Then they remained in their camp as long as the cloud stayed over the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: At the command of the Lord the sons of Israel would set out, and at the command of the Lord they would camp; as long as the cloud settled over the tabernacle, they remained camped.
verses.textEn: At the Lord ’s command the Israelites set out, and at his command they encamped. As long as the cloud stayed over the tabernacle, they remained in camp.

verses.textZh: 如果云彩多日停留在帐幕上，以色列人就遵守耶和华的吩咐，不起行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果云彩多日停留在帐幕上，以色列人就遵守耶和华的吩咐，不起行。
verses.textZhCuv: 云彩在帐幕上停留许多日子，以色列人就守耶和华所吩咐的不起行。
verses.textEnNiv: When the cloud remained over the tabernacle a long time, the Israelites obeyed the Lord ’s order and did not set out.
verses.textEnEsv: Even when the cloud continued over the tabernacle many days, the people of Israel kept the charge of the Lord and did not set out.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even when the cloud continued long, many days above the tabernacle, the children of Israel kept the charge of the Lord and did not journey.
verses.textEnNlt: If the cloud remained over the Tabernacle for a long time, the Israelites stayed and performed their duty to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Even when the cloud lingered over the tabernacle for many days, the sons of Israel would comply with the Lord’s ordinance and not set out.
verses.textEn: When the cloud remained over the tabernacle a long time, the Israelites obeyed the Lord ’s order and did not set out.

verses.textZh: 有时云彩停留在帐幕上只有几天，他们就照着耶和华的吩咐安营；也照着耶和华的吩咐起行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有时云彩停留在帐幕上只有几天，他们就照着耶和华的吩咐安营；也照着耶和华的吩咐起行。
verses.textZhCuv: 有时云彩在帐幕上几天，他们就照耶和华的吩咐住营，也照耶和华的吩咐起行。
verses.textEnNiv: Sometimes the cloud was over the tabernacle only a few days; at the Lord ’s command they would encamp, and then at his command they would set out.
verses.textEnEsv: Sometimes the cloud was a few days over the tabernacle, and according to the command of the Lord they remained in camp; then according to the command of the Lord they set out.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when the cloud was above the tabernacle a few days: according to the command of the Lord they would remain encamped, and according to the command of the Lord they would journey.
verses.textEnNlt: Sometimes the cloud would stay over the Tabernacle for only a few days, so the people would stay for only a few days, as the Lord commanded. Then at the Lord ’s command they would break camp and move on.
verses.textEnNasb: If sometimes the cloud remained a few days over the tabernacle, in accordance with the command of the Lord they remained camped. Then in accordance with the command of the Lord they set out.
verses.textEn: Sometimes the cloud was over the tabernacle only a few days; at the Lord ’s command they would encamp, and then at his command they would set out.

verses.textZh: 有时云彩从晚上到早晨停住；到了早晨，云彩一收上去，他们就起行；有时云彩从白昼到晚上都停住；云彩一收上去，他们就起行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有时云彩从晚上到早晨停住；到了早晨，云彩一收上去，他们就起行；有时云彩从白昼到晚上都停住；云彩一收上去，他们就起行。
verses.textZhCuv: 有时从晚上到早晨，有这云彩在帐幕上；早晨云彩收上去，他们就起行。有时昼夜云彩停在帐幕上，收上去的时候，他们就起行。
verses.textEnNiv: Sometimes the cloud stayed only from evening till morning, and when it lifted in the morning, they set out. Whether by day or by night, whenever the cloud lifted, they set out.
verses.textEnEsv: And sometimes the cloud remained from evening until morning. And when the cloud lifted in the morning, they set out, or if it continued for a day and a night, when the cloud lifted they set out.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when the cloud remained only from evening until morning: when the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they would journey; whether by day or by night, whenever the cloud was taken up, they would journey.
verses.textEnNlt: Sometimes the cloud stayed only overnight and lifted the next morning. But day or night, when the cloud lifted, the people broke camp and moved on.
verses.textEnNasb: If sometimes the cloud remained from evening until morning, when the cloud was lifted in the morning they would set out; or if it remained in the daytime and at night, whenever the cloud was lifted, they would set out.
verses.textEn: Sometimes the cloud stayed only from evening till morning, and when it lifted in the morning, they set out. Whether by day or by night, whenever the cloud lifted, they set out.

verses.textZh: 云彩停留在帐幕上不论有多久，或两天、或一月、或一年，以色列人就安营，不起行；云彩一收上去，他们就起行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 云彩停留在帐幕上不论有多久，或两天、或一月、或一年，以色列人就安营，不起行；云彩一收上去，他们就起行。
verses.textZhCuv: 云彩停留在帐幕上，无论是两天，是一月，是一年，以色列人就住营不起行；但云彩收上去，他们就起行。
verses.textEnNiv: Whether the cloud stayed over the tabernacle for two days or a month or a year, the Israelites would remain in camp and not set out; but when it lifted, they would set out.
verses.textEnEsv: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a longer time, that the cloud continued over the tabernacle, abiding there, the people of Israel remained in camp and did not set out, but when it lifted they set out.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whetheritwas two days, a month, or a year that the cloud remained above the tabernacle, the children of Israel would remain encamped and not journey; but when it was taken up, they would journey.
verses.textEnNlt: Whether the cloud stayed above the Tabernacle for two days, a month, or a year, the people of Israel stayed in camp and did not move on. But as soon as it lifted, they broke camp and moved on.
verses.textEnNasb: Whether it was two days, a month, or a year that the cloud lingered over the tabernacle, staying above it, the sons of Israel remained camped and did not set out; but when it was lifted, they did set out.
verses.textEn: Whether the cloud stayed over the tabernacle for two days or a month or a year, the Israelites would remain in camp and not set out; but when it lifted, they would set out.

verses.textZh: 他们照着耶和华的吩咐安营，也照着耶和华的吩咐起行。他们遵守耶和华吩咐的，就是照着耶和华藉摩西吩咐的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们照着耶和华的吩咐安营，也照着耶和华的吩咐起行。他们遵守耶和华吩咐的，就是照着耶和华藉摩西吩咐的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们遵耶和华的吩咐安营，也遵耶和华的吩咐起行。他们守耶和华所吩咐的，都是凭耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textEnNiv: At the Lord ’s command they encamped, and at the Lord ’s command they set out. They obeyed the Lord ’s order, in accordance with his command through Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: At the command of the Lord they camped, and at the command of the Lord they set out. They kept the charge of the Lord , at the command of the Lord by Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: At the command of the Lord they remained encamped, and at the command of the Lord they journeyed; they kept the charge of the Lord, at the command of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: So they camped or traveled at the Lord ’s command, and they did whatever the Lord told them through Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: At the command of the Lord they camped, and at the command of the Lord they set out; they did what the Lord required, in accordance with the command of the Lord through Moses.
verses.textEn: At the Lord ’s command they encamped, and at the Lord ’s command they set out. They obeyed the Lord ’s order, in accordance with his command through Moses.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses:
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Now the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord spoke further to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses:

verses.textZh: "你要用银子作两枝号，要锤出来的，可以用来召集会众，也可以叫会众拔营起行。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要用银子作两枝号，要锤出来的，可以用来召集会众，也可以叫会众拔营起行。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要用银子做两枝号，都要锤出来的，用以招聚会众，并叫众营起行。
verses.textEnNiv: "Make two trumpets of hammered silver, and use them for calling the community together and for having the camps set out.
verses.textEnEsv: "Make two silver trumpets. Of hammered work you shall make them, and you shall use them for summoning the congregation and for breaking camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Make two silver trumpets for yourself; you shall make them of hammered work; you shall use them for calling the congregation and for directing the movement of the camps.
verses.textEnNlt: "Make two trumpets of hammered silver for calling the community to assemble and for signaling the breaking of camp.
verses.textEnNasb: "Make yourself two trumpets of silver, you shall make them of hammered work; and you shall use them for summoning the congregation and breaking camp.
verses.textEn: "Make two trumpets of hammered silver, and use them for calling the community together and for having the camps set out.

verses.textZh: 吹号的时候，全体会众都要到你那里，聚集在会幕的门口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吹号的时候，全体会众都要到你那里，聚集在会幕的门口。
verses.textZhCuv: 吹这号的时候，全会众要到你那里，聚集在会幕门口。
verses.textEnNiv: When both are sounded, the whole community is to assemble before you at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: And when both are blown, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they blow both of them, all the congregation shall gather before you at the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: When both trumpets are blown, everyone must gather before you at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when both are blown, all the congregation shall meet you at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: When both are sounded, the whole community is to assemble before you at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 如果单吹一枝，众领袖，就是以色列的族长，都要到你那里聚集。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果单吹一枝，众领袖，就是以色列的族长，都要到你那里聚集。
verses.textZhCuv: 若单吹一枝，众首领，就是以色列军中的统领，要聚集到你那里。
verses.textEnNiv: If only one is sounded, the leaders—the heads of the clans of Israel—are to assemble before you.
verses.textEnEsv: But if they blow only one, then the chiefs, the heads of the tribes of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if they blow only one, then the leaders, the heads of the divisions of Israel, shall gather to you.
verses.textEnNlt: But if only one trumpet is blown, then only the leaders—the heads of the clans of Israel—must present themselves to you.
verses.textEnNasb: But if only one is blown, then the leaders, the heads of the divisions of Israel, shall meet you.
verses.textEn: If only one is sounded, the leaders—the heads of the clans of Israel—are to assemble before you.

verses.textZh: 你们吹大声的时候，那在东边的营，都要起行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们吹大声的时候，那在东边的营，都要起行。
verses.textZhCuv: 吹出大声的时候，东边安的营都要起行。
verses.textEnNiv: When a trumpet blast is sounded, the tribes camping on the east are to set out.
verses.textEnEsv: When you blow an alarm, the camps that are on the east side shall set out.
verses.textEnNkjv: When you sound the advance, the camps that lie on the east side shall then begin their journey.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you sound the signal to move on, the tribes camped on the east side of the Tabernacle must break camp and move forward.
verses.textEnNasb: And when you blow an alarm, the camps that are pitched on the east side shall set out.
verses.textEn: When a trumpet blast is sounded, the tribes camping on the east are to set out.

verses.textZh: 你们第二次吹大声的时候，那在南边的营，都要起行；他们要起行，必须吹大声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们第二次吹大声的时候，那在南边的营，都要起行；他们要起行，必须吹大声。
verses.textZhCuv: 二次吹出大声的时候，南边安的营都要起行。他们将起行，必吹出大声。
verses.textEnNiv: At the sounding of a second blast, the camps on the south are to set out. The blast will be the signal for setting out.
verses.textEnEsv: And when you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that are on the south side shall set out. An alarm is to be blown whenever they are to set out.
verses.textEnNkjv: When you sound the advance the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall begin their journey; they shall sound the call for them to begin their journeys.
verses.textEnNlt: When you sound the signal a second time, the tribes camped on the south will follow. You must sound short blasts as the signal for moving on.
verses.textEnNasb: Then when you sound an alarm the second time, the camps that are pitched on the south side shall set out; an alarm is to be sounded for them to break camp.
verses.textEn: At the sounding of a second blast, the camps on the south are to set out. The blast will be the signal for setting out.

verses.textZh: 但召集会众的时候，你们要吹号，却不要吹大声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但召集会众的时候，你们要吹号，却不要吹大声。
verses.textZhCuv: 但招聚会众的时候，你们要吹号，却不要吹出大声。
verses.textEnNiv: To gather the assembly, blow the trumpets, but not with the signal for setting out.
verses.textEnEsv: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow a long blast, but you shall not sound an alarm.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but not sound the advance.
verses.textEnNlt: But when you call the people to an assembly, blow the trumpets with a different signal.
verses.textEnNasb: When convening the assembly, however, you shall blow the trumpets without sounding an alarm.
verses.textEn: To gather the assembly, blow the trumpets, but not with the signal for setting out.

verses.textZh: 亚伦的子孙作祭司的要作吹号的；这要作你们世世代代永远的条例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦的子孙作祭司的要作吹号的；这要作你们世世代代永远的条例。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦子孙作祭司的要吹这号；这要作你们世世代代永远的定例。
verses.textEnNiv: "The sons of Aaron, the priests, are to blow the trumpets. This is to be a lasting ordinance for you and the generations to come.
verses.textEnEsv: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. The trumpets shall be to you for a perpetual statute throughout your generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets; and these shall be to you as an ordinance forever throughout your generations.
verses.textEnNlt: Only the priests, Aaron’s descendants, are allowed to blow the trumpets. This is a permanent law for you, to be observed from generation to generation.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Aaron, moreover, the priests, shall blow the trumpets; and this shall be a permanent statute for you throughout your generations.
verses.textEn: "The sons of Aaron, the priests, are to blow the trumpets. This is to be a lasting ordinance for you and the generations to come.

verses.textZh: 你们在本地与欺压你们的仇敌作战的时候，就要吹大声，使你们在耶和华你们的神面前得蒙记念，也得拯救脱离你们的仇敌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们在本地与欺压你们的仇敌作战的时候，就要吹大声，使你们在耶和华你们的神面前得蒙记念，也得拯救脱离你们的仇敌。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们在自己的地，与欺压你们的敌人打仗，就要用号吹出大声，便在耶和华－你们的神面前得蒙纪念，也蒙拯救脱离仇敌。
verses.textEnNiv: When you go into battle in your own land against an enemy who is oppressing you, sound a blast on the trumpets. Then you will be remembered by the Lord your God and rescued from your enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: And when you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets, that you may be remembered before the Lord your God, and you shall be saved from your enemies.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When you go to war in your land against the enemy who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets, and you will be remembered before the Lord your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you arrive in your own land and go to war against your enemies who attack you, sound the alarm with the trumpets. Then the Lord your God will remember you and rescue you from your enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: And when you go to war in your land against the enemy who attacks you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets, so that you will be thought of by the Lord your God, and be saved from your enemies.
verses.textEn: When you go into battle in your own land against an enemy who is oppressing you, sound a blast on the trumpets. Then you will be remembered by the Lord your God and rescued from your enemies.

verses.textZh: 此外，在你们快乐的日子和指定的节期，以及月朔，你们献燔祭和平安祭的时候，也要吹号，这都要在你们的神面前替你们作为记念；我是耶和华你们的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 此外，在你们快乐的日子和指定的节期，以及月朔，你们献燔祭和平安祭的时候，也要吹号，这都要在你们的神面前替你们作为记念；我是耶和华你们的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在你们快乐的日子和节期，并月朔，献燔祭和平安祭，也要吹号，这都要在你们的神面前作为纪念。我是耶和华－你们的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: Also at your times of rejoicing—your appointed festivals and New Moon feasts—you are to sound the trumpets over your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, and they will be a memorial for you before your God. I am the Lord your God."
verses.textEnEsv: On the day of your gladness also, and at your appointed feasts and at the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings. They shall be a reminder of you before your God: I am the Lord your God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Also in the day of your gladness, in your appointed feasts, and at the beginning of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be a memorial for you before your God: I am the Lord your God."
verses.textEnNlt: Blow the trumpets in times of gladness, too, sounding them at your annual festivals and at the beginning of each month. And blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings and peace offerings. The trumpets will remind your God of his covenant with you. I am the Lord your God."
verses.textEnNasb: Also on the day of your joy and at your appointed feasts, and on the first days of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be as a reminder of you before your God. I am the Lord your God."
verses.textEn: Also at your times of rejoicing—your appointed festivals and New Moon feasts—you are to sound the trumpets over your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, and they will be a memorial for you before your God. I am the Lord your God."

verses.textZh: 第二年二月二十日，云彩从法柜的帐幕收上去的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二年二月二十日，云彩从法柜的帐幕收上去的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 第二年二月二十日，云彩从法柜的帐幕收上去。
verses.textEnNiv: On the twentieth day of the second month of the second year, the cloud lifted from above the tabernacle of the covenant law.
verses.textEnEsv: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud lifted from over the tabernacle of the testimony,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from above the tabernacle of the Testimony.
verses.textEnNlt: In the second year after Israel’s departure from Egypt—on the twentieth day of the second month —the cloud lifted from the Tabernacle of the Covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth of the month, the cloud was lifted from above the tabernacle of the testimony;
verses.textEn: On the twentieth day of the second month of the second year, the cloud lifted from above the tabernacle of the covenant law.

verses.textZh: 以色列人就从西奈旷野按站起行；云彩在巴兰旷野停住了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人就从西奈旷野按站起行；云彩在巴兰旷野停住了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人就按站往前行，离开西奈的旷野，云彩停住在巴兰的旷野。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Israelites set out from the Desert of Sinai and traveled from place to place until the cloud came to rest in the Desert of Paran.
verses.textEnEsv: and the people of Israel set out by stages from the wilderness of Sinai. And the cloud settled down in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Israel set out from the Wilderness of Sinai on their journeys; then the cloud settled down in the Wilderness of Paran.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Israelites set out from the wilderness of Sinai and traveled on from place to place until the cloud stopped in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.textEnNasb: and the sons of Israel set out on their journeys from the wilderness of Sinai. Then the cloud settled in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.textEn: Then the Israelites set out from the Desert of Sinai and traveled from place to place until the cloud came to rest in the Desert of Paran.

verses.textZh: 这是他们第一次照着耶和华藉摩西吩咐他们的起程。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是他们第一次照着耶和华藉摩西吩咐他们的起程。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是他们照耶和华藉摩西所吩咐的，初次往前行。
verses.textEnNiv: They set out, this first time, at the Lord ’s command through Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: They set out for the first time at the command of the Lord by Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they started out for the first time according to the command of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: When the people set out for the first time, following the instructions the Lord had given through Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: So they moved on for the first time in accordance with the command of the Lord through Moses.
verses.textEn: They set out, this first time, at the Lord ’s command through Moses.

verses.textZh: 犹大营的旗号，按着他们的队伍，首先起行；统领队伍的，是亚米拿达的儿子拿顺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大营的旗号，按着他们的队伍，首先起行；统领队伍的，是亚米拿达的儿子拿顺。
verses.textZhCuv: 按着军队首先往前行的是犹大营的纛。统领军队的是亚米拿达的儿子拿顺。
verses.textEnNiv: The divisions of the camp of Judah went first, under their standard. Nahshon son of Amminadab was in command.
verses.textEnEsv: The standard of the camp of the people of Judah set out first by their companies, and over their company was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.textEnNkjv: The standard of the camp of the children of Judah set out first according to their armies; over their army was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.textEnNlt: Judah’s troops led the way. They marched behind their banner, and their leader was Nahshon son of Amminadab.
verses.textEnNasb: The flag of the camp of the sons of Judah, by their armies, set out first, with Nahshon the son of Amminadab, over its army,
verses.textEn: The divisions of the camp of Judah went first, under their standard. Nahshon son of Amminadab was in command.

verses.textZh: 统领以萨迦支派队伍的，是苏押的儿子拿坦业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 统领以萨迦支派队伍的，是苏押的儿子拿坦业。
verses.textZhCuv: 统领以萨迦支派军队的是苏押的儿子拿坦业。
verses.textEnNiv: Nethanel son of Zuar was over the division of the tribe of Issachar,
verses.textEnEsv: And over the company of the tribe of the people of Issachar was Nethanel the son of Zuar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethanel the son of Zuar.
verses.textEnNlt: They were joined by the troops of the tribe of Issachar, led by Nethanel son of Zuar,
verses.textEnNasb: and Nethanel the son of Zuar, over the tribal army of the sons of Issachar;
verses.textEn: Nethanel son of Zuar was over the division of the tribe of Issachar,

verses.textZh: 统领西布伦支派队伍的，是希伦的儿子以利押。
verses.textZhCnvs: 统领西布伦支派队伍的，是希伦的儿子以利押。
verses.textZhCuv: 统领西布伦支派军队的是希伦的儿子以利押。
verses.textEnNiv: and Eliab son of Helon was over the division of the tribe of Zebulun.
verses.textEnEsv: And over the company of the tribe of the people of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.textEnNkjv: And over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.textEnNlt: and the troops of the tribe of Zebulun, led by Eliab son of Helon.
verses.textEnNasb: and Eliab the son of Helon over the tribal army of the sons of Zebulun.
verses.textEn: and Eliab son of Helon was over the division of the tribe of Zebulun.

verses.textZh: 帐幕拆下来以后，革顺的子孙和米拉利的子孙，就抬着帐幕起行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 帐幕拆下来以后，革顺的子孙和米拉利的子孙，就抬着帐幕起行。
verses.textZhCuv: 帐幕拆卸，革顺的子孙和米拉利的子孙就抬着帐幕先往前行。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the tabernacle was taken down, and the Gershonites and Merarites, who carried it, set out.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the tabernacle was taken down, the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who carried the tabernacle, set out.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set out, carrying the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Tabernacle was taken down, and the Gershonite and Merarite divisions of the Levites were next in the line of march, carrying the Tabernacle with them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who were carrying the tabernacle, set out.
verses.textEn: Then the tabernacle was taken down, and the Gershonites and Merarites, who carried it, set out.

verses.textZh: 流本营的旗号，按着他们的队伍起行；统领队伍的，是示丢珥的儿子以利蓿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 流本营的旗号，按着他们的队伍起行；统领队伍的，是示丢珥的儿子以利蓿。
verses.textZhCuv: 按着军队往前行的是吕便营的纛。统领军队的是示丢珥的儿子以利蓿。
verses.textEnNiv: The divisions of the camp of Reuben went next, under their standard. Elizur son of Shedeur was in command.
verses.textEnEsv: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set out by their companies, and over their company was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set out according to their armies; over their army was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.textEnNlt: Reuben’s troops went next, marching behind their banner. Their leader was Elizur son of Shedeur.
verses.textEnNasb: Next the flag of the camp of Reuben, by their armies, set out with Elizur the son of Shedeur, over its army,
verses.textEn: The divisions of the camp of Reuben went next, under their standard. Elizur son of Shedeur was in command.

verses.textZh: 统领西缅支派的，是苏利沙代的儿子示路蔑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 统领西缅支派的，是苏利沙代的儿子示路蔑。
verses.textZhCuv: 统领西缅支派军队的是苏利沙代的儿子示路蔑。
verses.textEnNiv: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was over the division of the tribe of Simeon,
verses.textEnEsv: And over the company of the tribe of the people of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.textEnNkjv: Over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.textEnNlt: They were joined by the troops of the tribe of Simeon, led by Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai,
verses.textEnNasb: and Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai over the tribal army of the sons of Simeon,
verses.textEn: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was over the division of the tribe of Simeon,

verses.textZh: 统领迦得支派队伍的，是丢珥的儿子以利雅萨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 统领迦得支派队伍的，是丢珥的儿子以利雅萨。
verses.textZhCuv: 统领迦得支派军队的是丢珥的儿子以利雅萨。
verses.textEnNiv: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was over the division of the tribe of Gad.
verses.textEnEsv: And over the company of the tribe of the people of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.textEnNlt: and the troops of the tribe of Gad, led by Eliasaph son of Deuel.
verses.textEnNasb: and Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the tribal army of the sons of Gad.
verses.textEn: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was over the division of the tribe of Gad.

verses.textZh: 哥辖人抬着圣物起行；他们到达之前，人已经把帐幕竖立起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哥辖人抬着圣物起行；他们到达之前，人已经把帐幕竖立起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 哥辖人抬着圣物先往前行。他们未到以前，抬帐幕的已经把帐幕支好。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Kohathites set out, carrying the holy things. The tabernacle was to be set up before they arrived.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Kohathites set out, carrying the holy things, and the tabernacle was set up before their arrival.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Kohathites set out, carrying the holy things. (The tabernacle would be prepared for their arrival.)
verses.textEnNlt: Next came the Kohathite division of the Levites, carrying the sacred objects from the Tabernacle. Before they arrived at the next camp, the Tabernacle would already be set up at its new location.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Kohathites set out, carrying the holy objects; and the tabernacle was set up before their arrival.
verses.textEn: Then the Kohathites set out, carrying the holy things. The tabernacle was to be set up before they arrived.

verses.textZh: 以法莲营的旗号，按着他们的队伍起行；统领队伍的，是亚米忽的儿子以利沙玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲营的旗号，按着他们的队伍起行；统领队伍的，是亚米忽的儿子以利沙玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 按着军队往前行的是以法莲营的纛，统领军队的是亚米忽的儿子以利沙玛。
verses.textEnNiv: The divisions of the camp of Ephraim went next, under their standard. Elishama son of Ammihud was in command.
verses.textEnEsv: And the standard of the camp of the people of Ephraim set out by their companies, and over their company was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set out according to their armies; over their army was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.textEnNlt: Ephraim’s troops went next, marching behind their banner. Their leader was Elishama son of Ammihud.
verses.textEnNasb: Next the flag of the camp of the sons of Ephraim, by their armies, set out, with Elishama the son of Ammihud over its army,
verses.textEn: The divisions of the camp of Ephraim went next, under their standard. Elishama son of Ammihud was in command.

verses.textZh: 统领玛拿西支派队伍的，是比大蓿的儿子迦玛列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 统领玛拿西支派队伍的，是比大蓿的儿子迦玛列。
verses.textZhCuv: 统领玛拿西支派军队的是比大蓿的儿子迦玛列。
verses.textEnNiv: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was over the division of the tribe of Manasseh,
verses.textEnEsv: And over the company of the tribe of the people of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.textEnNkjv: Over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.textEnNlt: They were joined by the troops of the tribe of Manasseh, led by Gamaliel son of Pedahzur,
verses.textEnNasb: and Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur over the tribal army of the sons of Manasseh;
verses.textEn: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was over the division of the tribe of Manasseh,

verses.textZh: 统领便雅悯支派队伍的，是基多尼的儿子亚比但。
verses.textZhCnvs: 统领便雅悯支派队伍的，是基多尼的儿子亚比但。
verses.textZhCuv: 统领便雅悯支派军队的是基多尼的儿子亚比但。
verses.textEnNiv: and Abidan son of Gideoni was over the division of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.textEnEsv: And over the company of the tribe of the people of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.textEnNkjv: And over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.textEnNlt: and the troops of the tribe of Benjamin, led by Abidan son of Gideoni.
verses.textEnNasb: and Abidan the son of Gideoni over the tribal army of the sons of Benjamin.
verses.textEn: and Abidan son of Gideoni was over the division of the tribe of Benjamin.

verses.textZh: 但营的旗号，作众营的后队，按着他们的队伍起行；统领队伍的，是亚米沙代的儿子亚希以谢。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但营的旗号，作众营的后队，按着他们的队伍起行；统领队伍的，是亚米沙代的儿子亚希以谢。
verses.textZhCuv: 在诸营末后的是但营的纛，按着军队往前行。统领军队的是亚米沙代的儿子亚希以谢。
verses.textEnNiv: Finally, as the rear guard for all the units, the divisions of the camp of Dan set out under their standard. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was in command.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the standard of the camp of the people of Dan, acting as the rear guard of all the camps, set out by their companies, and over their company was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the standard of the camp of the children of Dan (the rear guard of all the camps) set out according to their armies; over their army was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.textEnNlt: Dan’s troops went last, marching behind their banner and serving as the rear guard for all the tribal camps. Their leader was Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the flag of the camp of the sons of Dan, by their armies, which formed the rear guard for all the camps, set out, with Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai over its army,
verses.textEn: Finally, as the rear guard for all the units, the divisions of the camp of Dan set out under their standard. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was in command.

verses.textZh: 统领亚设支派队伍的，是俄兰的儿子帕结。
verses.textZhCnvs: 统领亚设支派队伍的，是俄兰的儿子帕结。
verses.textZhCuv: 统领亚设支派军队的是俄兰的儿子帕结。
verses.textEnNiv: Pagiel son of Okran was over the division of the tribe of Asher,
verses.textEnEsv: And over the company of the tribe of the people of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ochran.
verses.textEnNkjv: Over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.textEnNlt: They were joined by the troops of the tribe of Asher, led by Pagiel son of Ocran,
verses.textEnNasb: and Pagiel the son of Ochran over the tribal army of the sons of Asher;
verses.textEn: Pagiel son of Okran was over the division of the tribe of Asher,

verses.textZh: 统领拿弗他利支派队伍的，是以南的儿子亚希拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 统领拿弗他利支派队伍的，是以南的儿子亚希拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 统领拿弗他利支派军队的是以南的儿子亚希拉。
verses.textEnNiv: and Ahira son of Enan was over the division of the tribe of Naphtali.
verses.textEnEsv: And over the company of the tribe of the people of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.textEnNkjv: And over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.textEnNlt: and the troops of the tribe of Naphtali, led by Ahira son of Enan.
verses.textEnNasb: and Ahira the son of Enan over the tribal army of the sons of Naphtali.
verses.textEn: and Ahira son of Enan was over the division of the tribe of Naphtali.

verses.textZh: 这是以色列人起行的时候，按着他们的队伍起行的次序。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是以色列人起行的时候，按着他们的队伍起行的次序。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人按着军队往前行，就是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: This was the order of march for the Israelite divisions as they set out.
verses.textEnEsv: This was the order of march of the people of Israel by their companies, when they set out.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus was the order of march of the children of Israel, according to their armies, when they began their journey.
verses.textEnNlt: This was the order in which the Israelites marched, division by division.
verses.textEnNasb: This was the order of marching for the sons of Israel by their armies as they set out.
verses.textEn: This was the order of march for the Israelite divisions as they set out.

verses.textZh: 摩西对自己的岳父米甸人流珥的儿子何巴说："我们要起行到耶和华应许的地方去，他曾说：‘我要把那地赐给你们’，现在求你与我们同去，我们必善待你，因为耶和华对以色列已经应许福乐。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对自己的岳父米甸人流珥的儿子何巴说："我们要起行到耶和华应许的地方去，他曾说：‘我要把那地赐给你们’，现在求你与我们同去，我们必善待你，因为耶和华对以色列已经应许福乐。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对他岳父 －米甸人流珥的儿子何巴－说：「我们要行路，往耶和华所应许之地去；他曾说：『我要将这地赐给你们。』现在求你和我们同去，我们必厚待你，因为耶和华指着以色列人已经应许给好处。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now Moses said to Hobab son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, "We are setting out for the place about which the Lord said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us and we will treat you well, for the Lord has promised good things to Israel."
