verses.textEnEsv: And Moses said to Hobab the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, "We are setting out for the place of which the Lord said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will do good to you, for the Lord has promised good to Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Moses said to Hobab the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, "We are setting out for the place of which the Lord said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for the Lord has promised good things to Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: One day Moses said to his brother-in-law, Hobab son of Reuel the Midianite, "We are on our way to the place the Lord promised us, for he said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us and we will treat you well, for the Lord has promised wonderful blessings for Israel!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses said to Hobab the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, "We are setting out to the place of which the Lord said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us and we will do you good, for the Lord has promised good concerning Israel."
verses.textEn: Now Moses said to Hobab son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, "We are setting out for the place about which the Lord said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us and we will treat you well, for the Lord has promised good things to Israel."

verses.textZh: 何巴对摩西说："我不去，我要归回我本地本族那里去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 何巴对摩西说："我不去，我要归回我本地本族那里去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 何巴回答说：「我不去；我要回本地本族那里去。」
verses.textEnNiv: He answered, "No, I will not go; I am going back to my own land and my own people."
verses.textEnEsv: But he said to him, "I will not go. I will depart to my own land and to my kindred."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to him, "I will not go, but I will depart to my own land and to my relatives."
verses.textEnNlt: But Hobab replied, "No, I will not go. I must return to my own land and family."
verses.textEnNasb: But he said to him, "I will not come, but rather will go to my own land and relatives."
verses.textEn: He answered, "No, I will not go; I am going back to my own land and my own people."

verses.textZh: 摩西说："求你不要离开我们，因为你知道我们应怎样在旷野安营，你可以作我们的眼目。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西说："求你不要离开我们，因为你知道我们应怎样在旷野安营，你可以作我们的眼目。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西说：「求你不要离开我们；因为你知道我们要在旷野安营，你可以当作我们的眼目。
verses.textEnNiv: But Moses said, "Please do not leave us. You know where we should camp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Please do not leave us, for you know where we should camp in the wilderness, and you will serve as eyes for us.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses said, "Please do not leave, inasmuch as you know how we are to camp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: "Please don’t leave us," Moses pleaded. "You know the places in the wilderness where we should camp. Come, be our guide.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "Please do not leave us, since you know where we should camp in the wilderness, and you will be as eyes for us.
verses.textEn: But Moses said, "Please do not leave us. You know where we should camp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.

verses.textZh: 如果你与我们同去，将来耶和华用甚么好处待我们，我们也必用甚么好处待你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你与我们同去，将来耶和华用甚么好处待我们，我们也必用甚么好处待你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你若和我们同去，将来耶和华有什么好处待我们，我们也必以什么好处待你。」
verses.textEnNiv: If you come with us, we will share with you whatever good things the Lord gives us."
verses.textEnEsv: And if you do go with us, whatever good the Lord will do to us, the same will we do to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be, if you go with us—indeed it shall be—that whatever good the Lord will do to us, the same we will do to you."
verses.textEnNlt: If you do, we’ll share with you all the blessings the Lord gives us."
verses.textEnNasb: So it will be, if you go with us, that whatever good the Lord does for us, we will do for you."
verses.textEn: If you come with us, we will share with you whatever good things the Lord gives us."

verses.textZh: 以色列人从耶和华的山起行，行了三天的路程，耶和华的约柜在他们前面行了三天的路程，为他们寻找安息的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人从耶和华的山起行，行了三天的路程，耶和华的约柜在他们前面行了三天的路程，为他们寻找安息的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人离开耶和华的山，往前行了三天的路程；耶和华的约柜在前头行了三天的路程，为他们寻找安歇的地方。
verses.textEnNiv: So they set out from the mountain of the Lord and traveled for three days. The ark of the covenant of the Lord went before them during those three days to find them a place to rest.
verses.textEnEsv: So they set out from the mount of the Lord three days’ journey. And the ark of the covenant of the Lord went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they departed from the mountain of the Lord on a journey of three days; and the ark of the covenant of the Lord went before them for the three days’ journey, to search out a resting place for them.
verses.textEnNlt: They marched for three days after leaving the mountain of the Lord , with the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant moving ahead of them to show them where to stop and rest.
verses.textEnNasb: So they moved on from the mountain of the Lord three days’ journey, with the ark of the covenant of the Lord going on in front of them for the three days, to seek out a resting place for them.
verses.textEn: So they set out from the mountain of the Lord and traveled for three days. The ark of the covenant of the Lord went before them during those three days to find them a place to rest.

verses.textZh: 他们拔营起行的时候，日间总有耶和华的云彩在他们上头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们拔营起行的时候，日间总有耶和华的云彩在他们上头。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们拔营往前行，日间有耶和华的云彩在他们以上。
verses.textEnNiv: The cloud of the Lord was over them by day when they set out from the camp.
verses.textEnEsv: And the cloud of the Lord was over them by day, whenever they set out from the camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the cloud of the Lordwas above them by day when they went out from the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: As they moved on each day, the cloud of the Lord hovered over them.
verses.textEnNasb: And the cloud of the Lord was over them by day when they set out from the camp.
verses.textEn: The cloud of the Lord was over them by day when they set out from the camp.

verses.textZh: 约柜起行的时候，摩西就说： "耶和华啊，求你起来， 愿你的仇敌四散； 愿恨你的人从你面前逃跑。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约柜起行的时候，摩西就说： "耶和华啊，求你起来， 愿你的仇敌四散； 愿恨你的人从你面前逃跑。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约柜往前行的时候，摩西就说：「耶和华啊，求你兴起！愿你的仇敌四散！愿恨你的人从你面前逃跑！」
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever the ark set out, Moses said, "Rise up, Lord ! May your enemies be scattered; may your foes flee before you."
verses.textEnEsv: And whenever the ark set out, Moses said, "Arise, O Lord , and let your enemies be scattered, and let those who hate you flee before you."
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, whenever the ark set out, that Moses said: "Rise up, O Lord! Let Your enemies be scattered, And let those who hate You flee before You."
verses.textEnNlt: And whenever the Ark set out, Moses would shout, "Arise, O Lord , and let your enemies be scattered! Let them flee before you!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then it came about when the ark set out that Moses said, "Rise up, Lord! And may Your enemies be scattered, And those who hate You flee from Your presence."
verses.textEn: Whenever the ark set out, Moses said, "Rise up, Lord ! May your enemies be scattered; may your foes flee before you."

verses.textZh: 约柜停住的时候，他就说： "耶和华啊，求你归来， 回到以色列的千万人中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约柜停住的时候，他就说： "耶和华啊，求你归来， 回到以色列的千万人中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约柜停住的时候，他就说：「耶和华啊，求你回到以色列的千万人中！」
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever it came to rest, he said, "Return, Lord , to the countless thousands of Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: And when it rested, he said, "Return, O Lord , to the ten thousand thousands of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when it rested, he said: "Return, O Lord, To the many thousands of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: And when the Ark was set down, he would say, "Return, O Lord , to the countless thousands of Israel!"
verses.textEnNasb: And when it came to rest, he said, "Return, Lord, To the myriad thousands of Israel."
verses.textEn: Whenever it came to rest, he said, "Return, Lord , to the countless thousands of Israel."

verses.textZh: 人民发怨言，恶声达到耶和华的耳中；耶和华听见了，就发烈怒；耶和华的火就在他们中间焚烧，烧毁了营地的边界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人民发怨言，恶声达到耶和华的耳中；耶和华听见了，就发烈怒；耶和华的火就在他们中间焚烧，烧毁了营地的边界。
verses.textZhCuv: 众百姓发怨言，他们的恶语达到耶和华的耳中。耶和华听见了就怒气发作，使火在他们中间焚烧，直烧到营的边界。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the people complained about their hardships in the hearing of the Lord , and when he heard them his anger was aroused. Then fire from the Lord burned among them and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people complained in the hearing of the Lord about their misfortunes, and when the Lord heard it, his anger was kindled, and the fire of the Lord burned among them and consumed some outlying parts of the camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the people complained, it displeased the Lord; for the Lord heard it, and His anger was aroused. So the fire of the Lord burned among them, and consumed some in the outskirts of the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon the people began to complain about their hardship, and the Lord heard everything they said. Then the Lord ’s anger blazed against them, and he sent a fire to rage among them, and he destroyed some of the people in the outskirts of the camp.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the people became like those who complain of adversity in the ears of the Lord; and the Lord heard them and His anger was kindled, and the fire of the Lord burned among them and consumed some at the outskirts of the camp.
verses.textEn: Now the people complained about their hardships in the hearing of the Lord , and when he heard them his anger was aroused. Then fire from the Lord burned among them and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.

verses.textZh: 人民向摩西呼求，摩西恳求耶和华，火就熄了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 人民向摩西呼求，摩西恳求耶和华，火就熄了，
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓向摩西哀求，摩西祈求耶和华，火就熄了。
verses.textEnNiv: When the people cried out to Moses, he prayed to the Lord and the fire died down.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the people cried out to Moses, and Moses prayed to the Lord , and the fire died down.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the people cried out to Moses, and when Moses prayed to the Lord, the fire was quenched.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people screamed to Moses for help, and when he prayed to the Lord , the fire stopped.
verses.textEnNasb: The people then cried out to Moses; and Moses prayed to the Lord, and the fire died out.
verses.textEn: When the people cried out to Moses, he prayed to the Lord and the fire died down.

verses.textZh: 就称那地方作他备拉，因为耶和华的火曾在他们中间焚烧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就称那地方作他备拉，因为耶和华的火曾在他们中间焚烧。
verses.textZhCuv: 那地方便叫做他备拉，因为耶和华的火烧在他们中间。
verses.textEnNiv: So that place was called Taberah, because fire from the Lord had burned among them.
verses.textEnEsv: So the name of that place was called Taberah, because the fire of the Lord burned among them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he called the name of the place Taberah, because the fire of the Lord had burned among them.
verses.textEnNlt: After that, the area was known as Taberah (which means "the place of burning"), because fire from the Lord had burned among them there.
verses.textEnNasb: So that place was named Taberah, because the fire of the Lord burned among them.
verses.textEn: So that place was called Taberah, because fire from the Lord had burned among them.

verses.textZh: 他们中间的闲杂人起了贪欲，甚至连以色列人也哭着说："谁给我们肉吃呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们中间的闲杂人起了贪欲，甚至连以色列人也哭着说："谁给我们肉吃呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 他们中间的闲杂人大起贪欲的心；以色列人又哭号说：「谁给我们肉吃呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The rabble with them began to crave other food, and again the Israelites started wailing and said, "If only we had meat to eat!
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rabble that was among them had a strong craving. And the people of Israel also wept again and said, "Oh that we had meat to eat!
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the mixed multitude who were among them yielded to intense craving; so the children of Israel also wept again and said: "Who will give us meat to eat?
verses.textEnNlt: Then the foreign rabble who were traveling with the Israelites began to crave the good things of Egypt. And the people of Israel also began to complain. "Oh, for some meat!" they exclaimed.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the rabble who were among them had greedy cravings; and the sons of Israel also wept again and said, "Who will give us meat to eat?
verses.textEn: The rabble with them began to crave other food, and again the Israelites started wailing and said, "If only we had meat to eat!

verses.textZh: 我们记得在埃及的时候，可以不花钱吃鱼，还有黄瓜、西瓜、韭菜、葱和蒜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们记得在埃及的时候，可以不花钱吃鱼，还有黄瓜、西瓜、韭菜、葱和蒜。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们记得，在埃及的时候不花钱就吃鱼，也记得有黄瓜、西瓜、韭菜、葱、蒜。
verses.textEnNiv: We remember the fish we ate in Egypt at no cost—also the cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions and garlic.
verses.textEnEsv: We remember the fish we ate in Egypt that cost nothing, the cucumbers, the melons, the leeks, the onions, and the garlic.
verses.textEnNkjv: We remember the fish which we ate freely in Egypt, the cucumbers, the melons, the leeks, the onions, and the garlic;
verses.textEnNlt: "We remember the fish we used to eat for free in Egypt. And we had all the cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions, and garlic we wanted.
verses.textEnNasb: We remember the fish which we used to eat for free in Egypt, the cucumbers, the melons, the leeks, the onions, and the garlic;
verses.textEn: We remember the fish we ate in Egypt at no cost—also the cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions and garlic.

verses.textZh: 现在我们的心都枯干了；除了这吗哪以外，在我们眼前，甚么都没有。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我们的心都枯干了；除了这吗哪以外，在我们眼前，甚么都没有。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我们的心血枯竭了，除这吗哪以外，在我们眼前并没有别的东西。」 （
verses.textEnNiv: But now we have lost our appetite; we never see anything but this manna!"
verses.textEnEsv: But now our strength is dried up, and there is nothing at all but this manna to look at."
verses.textEnNkjv: but now our whole being is dried up; thereis nothing at all except this manna before our eyes!"
verses.textEnNlt: But now our appetites are gone. All we ever see is this manna!"
verses.textEnNasb: but now our appetite is gone. There is nothing at all to look at except this manna!"
verses.textEn: But now we have lost our appetite; we never see anything but this manna!"

verses.textZh: 这吗哪仿佛芫荽子，又好象珍珠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这吗哪仿佛芫荽子，又好象珍珠。
verses.textZhCuv: 这吗哪仿佛芫荽子，又好像珍珠。
verses.textEnNiv: The manna was like coriander seed and looked like resin.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the manna was like coriander seed, and its appearance like that of bdellium.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the manna was like coriander seed, and its color like the color of bdellium.
verses.textEnNlt: The manna looked like small coriander seeds, and it was pale yellow like gum resin.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the manna was like coriander seed, and its appearance like that of bdellium.
verses.textEn: The manna was like coriander seed and looked like resin.

verses.textZh: 人民走来走去，把吗哪拾起来，或用磨磨碎，或用臼捣碎，或用锅煮，或做成饼，它的滋味好象油饼的滋味。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人民走来走去，把吗哪拾起来，或用磨磨碎，或用臼捣碎，或用锅煮，或做成饼，它的滋味好象油饼的滋味。
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓周围行走，把吗哪收起来，或用磨推，或用臼捣，煮在锅中，又做成饼，滋味好像新油。
verses.textEnNiv: The people went around gathering it, and then ground it in a hand mill or crushed it in a mortar. They cooked it in a pot or made it into loaves. And it tasted like something made with olive oil.
verses.textEnEsv: The people went about and gathered it and ground it in handmills or beat it in mortars and boiled it in pots and made cakes of it. And the taste of it was like the taste of cakes baked with oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: The people went about and gathered it, ground it on millstones or beat it in the mortar, cooked it in pans, and made cakes of it; and its taste was like the taste of pastry prepared with oil.
verses.textEnNlt: The people would go out and gather it from the ground. They made flour by grinding it with hand mills or pounding it in mortars. Then they boiled it in a pot and made it into flat cakes. These cakes tasted like pastries baked with olive oil.
verses.textEnNasb: The people would roam about and gather it and grind it between two millstones, or pound it in the mortar, and boil it in the pot and make loaves with it; and its taste was like the taste of cake baked with oil.
verses.textEn: The people went around gathering it, and then ground it in a hand mill or crushed it in a mortar. They cooked it in a pot or made it into loaves. And it tasted like something made with olive oil.

verses.textZh: 夜间露水降在营上的时候，吗哪也随着降下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 夜间露水降在营上的时候，吗哪也随着降下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 夜间露水降在营中，吗哪也随着降下。）
verses.textEnNiv: When the dew settled on the camp at night, the manna also came down.
verses.textEnEsv: When the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell with it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.
verses.textEnNlt: The manna came down on the camp with the dew during the night.
verses.textEnNasb: When the dew came down on the camp at night, the manna would come down with it.
verses.textEn: When the dew settled on the camp at night, the manna also came down.

verses.textZh: 摩西听见人民都在各人的帐棚门口哀哭，耶和华就大发烈怒，摩西也不高兴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西听见人民都在各人的帐棚门口哀哭，耶和华就大发烈怒，摩西也不高兴。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西听见百姓各在各家的帐棚门口哭号。耶和华的怒气便大发作，摩西就不喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses heard the people of every family wailing at the entrance to their tents. The Lord became exceedingly angry, and Moses was troubled.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their clans, everyone at the door of his tent. And the anger of the Lord blazed hotly, and Moses was displeased.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, everyone at the door of his tent; and the anger of the Lord was greatly aroused; Moses also was displeased.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses heard all the families standing in the doorways of their tents whining, and the Lord became extremely angry. Moses was also very aggravated.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, each one at the entrance of his tent; and the anger of the Lord became very hot, and Moses was displeased.
verses.textEn: Moses heard the people of every family wailing at the entrance to their tents. The Lord became exceedingly angry, and Moses was troubled.

verses.textZh: 摩西对耶和华说："你为甚么苦待你的仆人，为甚么我没有在你面前蒙恩呢？竟把管理这人民的重担全放在我身上呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对耶和华说："你为甚么苦待你的仆人，为甚么我没有在你面前蒙恩呢？竟把管理这人民的重担全放在我身上呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对耶和华说：「你为何苦待仆人？我为何不在你眼前蒙恩，竟把这管理百姓的重任加在我身上呢？
verses.textEnNiv: He asked the Lord , "Why have you brought this trouble on your servant? What have I done to displease you that you put the burden of all these people on me?
verses.textEnEsv: Moses said to the Lord , "Why have you dealt ill with your servant? And why have I not found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses said to the Lord, "Why have You afflicted Your servant? And why have I not found favor in Your sight, that You have laid the burden of all these people on me?
verses.textEnNlt: And Moses said to the Lord , "Why are you treating me, your servant, so harshly? Have mercy on me! What did I do to deserve the burden of all these people?
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses said to the Lord, "Why have You been so hard on Your servant? And why have I not found favor in Your sight, that You have put the burden of all this people on me?
verses.textEn: He asked the Lord , "Why have you brought this trouble on your servant? What have I done to displease you that you put the burden of all these people on me?

verses.textZh: 这人民岂是我怀的胎，岂是我生的吗？你竟对我说：‘把他们抱在怀里，像养育之父抱吃奶的孩子，直抱到你起誓应许给他们列祖的地方去。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 这人民岂是我怀的胎，岂是我生的吗？你竟对我说：‘把他们抱在怀里，像养育之父抱吃奶的孩子，直抱到你起誓应许给他们列祖的地方去。’
verses.textZhCuv: 这百姓岂是我怀的胎，岂是我生下来的呢？你竟对我说：『把他们抱在怀里，如养育之父抱吃奶的孩子，直抱到你起誓应许给他们祖宗的地去。』
verses.textEnNiv: Did I conceive all these people? Did I give them birth? Why do you tell me to carry them in my arms, as a nurse carries an infant, to the land you promised on oath to their ancestors?
verses.textEnEsv: Did I conceive all this people? Did I give them birth, that you should say to me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing child,’ to the land that you swore to give their fathers?
verses.textEnNkjv: Did I conceive all these people? Did I beget them, that You should say to me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a guardian carries a nursing child,’ to the land which You swore to their fathers?
verses.textEnNlt: Did I give birth to them? Did I bring them into the world? Why did you tell me to carry them in my arms like a mother carries a nursing baby? How can I carry them to the land you swore to give their ancestors?
verses.textEnNasb: Was it I who conceived all this people? Or did I give birth to them, that You should say to me, ‘Carry them in your arms, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which You swore to their fathers’?
verses.textEn: Did I conceive all these people? Did I give them birth? Why do you tell me to carry them in my arms, as a nurse carries an infant, to the land you promised on oath to their ancestors?

verses.textZh: 我从哪里得肉给这人民吃呢？因为他们都向我哭着说：‘你给我们肉吃吧！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我从哪里得肉给这人民吃呢？因为他们都向我哭着说：‘你给我们肉吃吧！’
verses.textZhCuv: 我从哪里得肉给这百姓吃呢？他们都向我哭号说：『你给我们肉吃吧！』
verses.textEnNiv: Where can I get meat for all these people? They keep wailing to me, ‘Give us meat to eat!’
verses.textEnEsv: Where am I to get meat to give to all this people? For they weep before me and say, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Where am I to get meat to give to all these people? For they weep all over me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’
verses.textEnNlt: Where am I supposed to get meat for all these people? They keep whining to me, saying, ‘Give us meat to eat!’
verses.textEnNasb: Where am I to get meat to give to all this people? For they weep before me, saying, ‘Give us meat so that we may eat!’
verses.textEn: Where can I get meat for all these people? They keep wailing to me, ‘Give us meat to eat!’

verses.textZh: 我不能独自担当管理这人民的责任，因为实在太重了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我不能独自担当管理这人民的责任，因为实在太重了。
verses.textZhCuv: 管理这百姓的责任太重了，我独自担当不起。
verses.textEnNiv: I cannot carry all these people by myself; the burden is too heavy for me.
verses.textEnEsv: I am not able to carry all this people alone; the burden is too heavy for me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am not able to bear all these people alone, because the burden is too heavy for me.
verses.textEnNlt: I can’t carry all these people by myself! The load is far too heavy!
verses.textEnNasb: I am not able to carry all this people by myself, because it is too burdensome for me.
verses.textEn: I cannot carry all these people by myself; the burden is too heavy for me.

verses.textZh: 你既然这样待我，如果我在你面前蒙恩，求你把我杀了，免得我看见自己的苦楚。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你既然这样待我，如果我在你面前蒙恩，求你把我杀了，免得我看见自己的苦楚。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你这样待我，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你立时将我杀了，不叫我见自己的苦情。」
verses.textEnNiv: If this is how you are going to treat me, please go ahead and kill me—if I have found favor in your eyes—and do not let me face my own ruin."
verses.textEnEsv: If you will treat me like this, kill me at once, if I find favor in your sight, that I may not see my wretchedness."
verses.textEnNkjv: If You treat me like this, please kill me here and now—if I have found favor in Your sight—and do not let me see my wretchedness!"
verses.textEnNlt: If this is how you intend to treat me, just go ahead and kill me. Do me a favor and spare me this misery!"
verses.textEnNasb: So if You are going to deal with me this way, please kill me now, if I have found favor in Your sight, and do not let me see my misery."
verses.textEn: If this is how you are going to treat me, please go ahead and kill me—if I have found favor in your eyes—and do not let me face my own ruin."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要从以色列的长老中为我召聚七十个人，就是你认识的民间的长老和官长，领他们到会幕那里，叫他们与你一同站在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要从以色列的长老中为我召聚七十个人，就是你认识的民间的长老和官长，领他们到会幕那里，叫他们与你一同站在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你从以色列的长老中招聚七十个人，就是你所知道作百姓的长老和官长的，到我这里来，领他们到会幕前，使他们和你一同站立。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses: "Bring me seventy of Israel’s elders who are known to you as leaders and officials among the people. Have them come to the tent of meeting, that they may stand there with you.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Gather for me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them, and bring them to the tent of meeting, and let them take their stand there with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord said to Moses: "Gather to Me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them; bring them to the tabernacle of meeting, that they may stand there with you.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Gather before me seventy men who are recognized as elders and leaders of Israel. Bring them to the Tabernacle to stand there with you.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord therefore said to Moses, "Gather for Me seventy men from the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and their officers, and bring them to the tent of meeting, and have them take their stand there with you.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses: "Bring me seventy of Israel’s elders who are known to you as leaders and officials among the people. Have them come to the tent of meeting, that they may stand there with you.

verses.textZh: 我要在那里降临，与你说话，也要把在你身上的灵，分给他们，他们就与你一同担当管理人民的责任，免得你独自担当。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要在那里降临，与你说话，也要把在你身上的灵，分给他们，他们就与你一同担当管理人民的责任，免得你独自担当。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要在那里降临，与你说话，也要把降于你身上的灵分赐他们，他们就和你同当这管百姓的重任，免得你独自担当。
verses.textEnNiv: I will come down and speak with you there, and I will take some of the power of the Spirit that is on you and put it on them. They will share the burden of the people with you so that you will not have to carry it alone.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will come down and talk with you there. And I will take some of the Spirit that is on you and put it on them, and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, so that you may not bear it yourself alone.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit that is upon you and will put thesame upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you may not bear it yourself alone.
verses.textEnNlt: I will come down and talk to you there. I will take some of the Spirit that is upon you, and I will put the Spirit upon them also. They will bear the burden of the people along with you, so you will not have to carry it alone.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I will come down and speak with you there, and I will take away some of the Spirit who is upon you, and put Him upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, so that you will not bear it by yourself.
verses.textEn: I will come down and speak with you there, and I will take some of the power of the Spirit that is on you and put it on them. They will share the burden of the people with you so that you will not have to carry it alone.

verses.textZh: 你要对人民说：‘你们应当自洁，预备明天可以吃肉，因为你们哭着向耶和华说："谁给我们肉吃呢？我们在埃及多好。"所以耶和华必给你们肉吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要对人民说：‘你们应当自洁，预备明天可以吃肉，因为你们哭着向耶和华说："谁给我们肉吃呢？我们在埃及多好。"所以耶和华必给你们肉吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要对百姓说：『你们应当自洁，预备明天吃肉，因为你们哭号说：谁给我们肉吃！我们在埃及很好。这声音达到了耶和华的耳中，所以他必给你们肉吃。
verses.textEnNiv: "Tell the people: ‘Consecrate yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, when you will eat meat. The Lord heard you when you wailed, "If only we had meat to eat! We were better off in Egypt!" Now the Lord will give you meat, and you will eat it.
verses.textEnEsv: And say to the people, ‘Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, and you shall eat meat, for you have wept in the hearing of the Lord , saying, "Who will give us meat to eat? For it was better for us in Egypt." Therefore the Lord will give you meat, and you shall eat.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall say to the people, ‘Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, and you shall eat meat; for you have wept in the hearing of the Lord, saying, "Who will give us meat to eat? For itwas well with us in Egypt." Therefore the Lord will give you meat, and you shall eat.
verses.textEnNlt: "And say to the people, ‘Purify yourselves, for tomorrow you will have meat to eat. You were whining, and the Lord heard you when you cried, "Oh, for some meat! We were better off in Egypt!" Now the Lord will give you meat, and you will have to eat it.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall say to the people, ‘Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, and you shall eat meat; for you have wept in the ears of the Lord, saying, " Oh that someone would give us meat to eat! For we were well-off in Egypt." Therefore the Lord will give you meat and you shall eat.
verses.textEn: "Tell the people: ‘Consecrate yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, when you will eat meat. The Lord heard you when you wailed, "If only we had meat to eat! We were better off in Egypt!" Now the Lord will give you meat, and you will eat it.

verses.textZh: 你们不是吃一天两天，不是吃五天十天，也不是吃二十天，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不是吃一天两天，不是吃五天十天，也不是吃二十天，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不止吃一天、两天、五天、十天、二十天，
verses.textEnNiv: You will not eat it for just one day, or two days, or five, ten or twenty days,
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not eat just one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days,
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall eat, not one day, nor two days, nor five days, nor ten days, nor twenty days,
verses.textEnNlt: And it won’t be for just a day or two, or for five or ten or even twenty.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall eat, not one day, nor two days, nor five days, nor ten days, nor twenty days,
verses.textEn: You will not eat it for just one day, or two days, or five, ten or twenty days,

verses.textZh: 而是吃一个整月，直到肉从你们的鼻孔里喷出来，成为你们厌恶的东西；因为你们轻视了住在你们中间的耶和华，在他面前哭着说："我们为甚么出埃及呢？"’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 而是吃一个整月，直到肉从你们的鼻孔里喷出来，成为你们厌恶的东西；因为你们轻视了住在你们中间的耶和华，在他面前哭着说："我们为甚么出埃及呢？"’"
verses.textZhCuv: 要吃一个整月，甚至肉从你们鼻孔里喷出来，使你们厌恶了，因为你们厌弃住在你们中间的耶和华，在他面前哭号说：我们为何出了埃及呢！』」
verses.textEnNiv: but for a whole month—until it comes out of your nostrils and you loathe it—because you have rejected the Lord , who is among you, and have wailed before him, saying, "Why did we ever leave Egypt?" ’ "
verses.textEnEsv: but a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils and becomes loathsome to you, because you have rejected the Lord who is among you and have wept before him, saying, "Why did we come out of Egypt?"’"
verses.textEnNkjv: but for a whole month, until it comes out of your nostrils and becomes loathsome to you, because you have despised the Lord who is among you, and have wept before Him, saying, "Why did we ever come up out of Egypt?" ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: You will eat it for a whole month until you gag and are sick of it. For you have rejected the Lord , who is here among you, and you have whined to him, saying, "Why did we ever leave Egypt?"’"
verses.textEnNasb: but for a whole month, until it comes out of your nose and makes you nauseated; because you have rejected the Lord who is among you and have wept before Him, saying, "Why did we ever leave Egypt?" ’ "
verses.textEn: but for a whole month—until it comes out of your nostrils and you loathe it—because you have rejected the Lord , who is among you, and have wailed before him, saying, "Why did we ever leave Egypt?" ’ "

verses.textZh: 摩西说："这与我同住的人，能行的男人就有六十万，你还说：‘我要给他们肉吃，使他们可以吃一个整月。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西说："这与我同住的人，能行的男人就有六十万，你还说：‘我要给他们肉吃，使他们可以吃一个整月。’
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对耶和华说：「这与我同住的百姓、步行的男人有六十万，你还说：『我要把肉给他们，使他们可以吃一个整月。』
verses.textEnNiv: But Moses said, "Here I am among six hundred thousand men on foot, and you say, ‘I will give them meat to eat for a whole month!’
verses.textEnEsv: But Moses said, "The people among whom I am number six hundred thousand on foot, and you have said, ‘I will give them meat, that they may eat a whole month!’
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said, "The people whom I am among are six hundred thousand men on foot; yet You have said, ‘I will give them meat, that they may eat for a whole month.’
verses.textEnNlt: But Moses responded to the Lord , "There are 600,000 foot soldiers here with me, and yet you say, ‘I will give them meat for a whole month!’
verses.textEnNasb: But Moses said, "The people, among whom I am included, are six hundred thousand on foot! Yet You have said, ‘I will give them meat, so that they may eat for a whole month.’
verses.textEn: But Moses said, "Here I am among six hundred thousand men on foot, and you say, ‘I will give them meat to eat for a whole month!’

verses.textZh: 难道把羊群和牛群都给他们宰了，就够他们吃吗？或是把海里所有的鱼都给他们聚了来，就够他们吃吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道把羊群和牛群都给他们宰了，就够他们吃吗？或是把海里所有的鱼都给他们聚了来，就够他们吃吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 难道给他们宰了羊群牛群，或是把海中所有的鱼都聚了来，就够他们吃吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Would they have enough if flocks and herds were slaughtered for them? Would they have enough if all the fish in the sea were caught for them?"
verses.textEnEsv: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, and be enough for them? Or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, and be enough for them?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to provide enough for them? Or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to provide enough for them?"
verses.textEnNlt: Even if we butchered all our flocks and herds, would that satisfy them? Even if we caught all the fish in the sea, would that be enough?"
verses.textEnNasb: Are flocks and herds to be slaughtered for them, so that it will be sufficient for them? Or are all the fish of the sea to be caught for them, so that it will be sufficient for them?"
verses.textEn: Would they have enough if flocks and herds were slaughtered for them? Would they have enough if all the fish in the sea were caught for them?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："耶和华的手臂缩短了吗？现在你要看看我的话对你应验不应验。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："耶和华的手臂缩短了吗？现在你要看看我的话对你应验不应验。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「耶和华的膀臂岂是缩短了吗？现在要看我的话向你应验不应验。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord answered Moses, "Is the Lord ’s arm too short? Now you will see whether or not what I say will come true for you."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Is the Lord ’s hand shortened? Now you shall see whether my word will come true for you or not."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Has the Lord’s arm been shortened? Now you shall see whether what I say will happen to you or not."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Has my arm lost its power? Now you will see whether or not my word comes true!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Is the Lord’s power too little? Now you shall see whether My word will come true for you or not."
verses.textEn: The Lord answered Moses, "Is the Lord ’s arm too short? Now you will see whether or not what I say will come true for you."

verses.textZh: 于是摩西出来，把耶和华的话告诉人民，又从民间的长老中召聚了七十个人来，使他们站在会幕的周围。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是摩西出来，把耶和华的话告诉人民，又从民间的长老中召聚了七十个人来，使他们站在会幕的周围。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西出去，将耶和华的话告诉百姓，又招聚百姓的长老中七十个人来，使他们站在会幕的四围。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses went out and told the people what the Lord had said. He brought together seventy of their elders and had them stand around the tent.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses went out and told the people the words of the Lord . And he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people and placed them around the tent.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses went out and told the people the words of the Lord, and he gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people and placed them around the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses went out and reported the Lord ’s words to the people. He gathered the seventy elders and stationed them around the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses went out and told the people the words of the Lord. He also gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and positioned them around the tent.
verses.textEn: So Moses went out and told the people what the Lord had said. He brought together seventy of their elders and had them stand around the tent.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在云中降临，对摩西说话，把摩西身上的灵，分给那七十个长老；灵停在他们身上的时候，他们就说预言，以后却没有再说。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在云中降临，对摩西说话，把摩西身上的灵，分给那七十个长老；灵停在他们身上的时候，他们就说预言，以后却没有再说。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在云中降临，对摩西说话，把降与他身上的灵分赐那七十个长老。灵停在他们身上的时候，他们就受感说话，以后却没有再说。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord came down in the cloud and spoke with him, and he took some of the power of the Spirit that was on him and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied—but did not do so again.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord came down in the cloud and spoke to him, and took some of the Spirit that was on him and put it on the seventy elders. And as soon as the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied. But they did not continue doing it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was upon him, and placed thesame upon the seventy elders; and it happened, when the Spirit rested upon them, that they prophesied, although they never did so again.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord came down in the cloud and spoke to Moses. Then he gave the seventy elders the same Spirit that was upon Moses. And when the Spirit rested upon them, they prophesied. But this never happened again.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord came down in the cloud and spoke to him; and He took away some of the Spirit who was upon him and placed Him upon the seventy elders. And when the Spirit rested upon them, they prophesied. Yet they did not do it again.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord came down in the cloud and spoke with him, and he took some of the power of the Spirit that was on him and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied—but did not do so again.

verses.textZh: 那时还有两个人留在营里；一个名叫伊利达，一个名叫米达；灵也停在他们身上。他们原是在被录取的人中，却没有到会幕那里去；他们就在营里说预言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时还有两个人留在营里；一个名叫伊利达，一个名叫米达；灵也停在他们身上。他们原是在被录取的人中，却没有到会幕那里去；他们就在营里说预言。
verses.textZhCuv: 但有两个人仍在营里，一个名叫伊利达，一个名叫米达。他们本是在那些被录的人中，却没有到会幕那里去。灵停在他们身上，他们就在营里说预言。
verses.textEnNiv: However, two men, whose names were Eldad and Medad, had remained in the camp. They were listed among the elders, but did not go out to the tent. Yet the Spirit also rested on them, and they prophesied in the camp.
verses.textEnEsv: Now two men remained in the camp, one named Eldad, and the other named Medad, and the Spirit rested on them. They were among those registered, but they had not gone out to the tent, and so they prophesied in the camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: But two men had remained in the camp: the name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad. And the Spirit rested upon them. Now they were among those listed, but who had not gone out to the tabernacle; yet they prophesied in the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: Two men, Eldad and Medad, had stayed behind in the camp. They were listed among the elders, but they had not gone out to the Tabernacle. Yet the Spirit rested upon them as well, so they prophesied there in the camp.
verses.textEnNasb: But two men had remained in the camp; the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other, Medad. And the Spirit rested upon them (and they were among those who had been registered, but had not gone out to the tent), and they prophesied in the camp.
verses.textEn: However, two men, whose names were Eldad and Medad, had remained in the camp. They were listed among the elders, but did not go out to the tent. Yet the Spirit also rested on them, and they prophesied in the camp.

verses.textZh: 有个少年人跑来，告诉摩西："伊利达和米达在营中说预言。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有个少年人跑来，告诉摩西："伊利达和米达在营中说预言。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有个少年人跑来告诉摩西说：「伊利达、米达在营里说预言。」
verses.textEnNiv: A young man ran and told Moses, "Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp."
verses.textEnEsv: And a young man ran and told Moses, "Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp."
verses.textEnNkjv: And a young man ran and told Moses, and said, "Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp."
verses.textEnNlt: A young man ran and reported to Moses, "Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!"
verses.textEnNasb: So a young man ran and informed Moses, and said, "Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp."
verses.textEn: A young man ran and told Moses, "Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp."

verses.textZh: 摩西的侍从，嫩的儿子约书亚，就是摩西所拣选的，回答说："我主，摩西，请你制止他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西的侍从，嫩的儿子约书亚，就是摩西所拣选的，回答说："我主，摩西，请你制止他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西的帮手，嫩的儿子约书亚，就是摩西所拣选的一个人，说：「请我主摩西禁止他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: Joshua son of Nun, who had been Moses’ aide since youth, spoke up and said, "Moses, my lord, stop them!"
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua the son of Nun, the assistant of Moses from his youth, said, "My lord Moses, stop them."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ assistant, one of his choice men, answered and said, "Moses my lord, forbid them!"
verses.textEnNlt: Joshua son of Nun, who had been Moses’ assistant since his youth, protested, "Moses, my master, make them stop!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua the son of Nun, the personal servant of Moses from his youth, responded and said, "My lord Moses, restrain them!"
verses.textEn: Joshua son of Nun, who had been Moses’ aide since youth, spoke up and said, "Moses, my lord, stop them!"

verses.textZh: 摩西对他说："你为我的缘故嫉妒吗？但愿耶和华的人民都是先知，但愿耶和华把他的灵降在他们身上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对他说："你为我的缘故嫉妒吗？但愿耶和华的人民都是先知，但愿耶和华把他的灵降在他们身上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对他说：「你为我的缘故嫉妒人吗？惟愿耶和华的百姓都受感说话！愿耶和华把他的灵降在他们身上！」
verses.textEnNiv: But Moses replied, "Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all the Lord ’s people were prophets and that the Lord would put his Spirit on them!"
verses.textEnEsv: But Moses said to him, "Are you jealous for my sake? Would that all the Lord ’s people were prophets, that the Lord would put his Spirit on them!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses said to him, "Are you zealous for my sake? Oh, that all the Lord’s people were prophets and that the Lord would put His Spirit upon them!"
verses.textEnNlt: But Moses replied, "Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all the Lord ’s people were prophets and that the Lord would put his Spirit upon them all!"
verses.textEnNasb: But Moses said to him, "Are you jealous for my sake? If only all the Lord’s people were prophets, that the Lord would put His Spirit upon them!"
verses.textEn: But Moses replied, "Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all the Lord ’s people were prophets and that the Lord would put his Spirit on them!"

verses.textZh: 于是摩西和以色列的长老，都回营去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是摩西和以色列的长老，都回营去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，摩西和以色列的长老都回到营里去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses and the elders of Israel returned to the camp.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses and the elders of Israel returned to the camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses returned to the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses returned to the camp with the elders of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses returned to the camp, both he and the elders of Israel.
verses.textEn: Then Moses and the elders of Israel returned to the camp.

verses.textZh: 有风从耶和华那里吹起，把鹌鹑由海面刮来，散落在营地；鹌鹑在营的四周，这边约有一天的路程，那边约有一天的路程，离地面约有一公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有风从耶和华那里吹起，把鹌鹑由海面刮来，散落在营地；鹌鹑在营的四周，这边约有一天的路程，那边约有一天的路程，离地面约有一公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 有风从耶和华那里刮起，把鹌鹑由海面刮来，飞散在营边和营的四围；这边约有一天的路程，那边约有一天的路程，离地面约有二肘。
verses.textEnNiv: Now a wind went out from the Lord and drove quail in from the sea. It scattered them up to two cubits deep all around the camp, as far as a day’s walk in any direction.
verses.textEnEsv: Then a wind from the Lord sprang up, and it brought quail from the sea and let them fall beside the camp, about a day’s journey on this side and a day’s journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits above the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a wind went out from the Lord, and it brought quail from the sea and left them fluttering near the camp, about a day’s journey on this side and about a day’s journey on the other side, all around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: Now the Lord sent a wind that brought quail from the sea and let them fall all around the camp. For miles in every direction there were quail flying about three feet above the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: Now a wind burst forth from the Lord and it brought quail from the sea, and dropped them beside the camp, about a day’s journey on this side and a day’s journey on the other side all around the camp, and about two cubits deep on the surface of the ground.
verses.textEn: Now a wind went out from the Lord and drove quail in from the sea. It scattered them up to two cubits deep all around the camp, as far as a day’s walk in any direction.

verses.textZh: 人民起来，那一天终日终夜，并次日一整天，都在捕捉鹌鹑，最少的也捕捉了约二千公升；他们都摆在营地的四周。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人民起来，那一天终日终夜，并次日一整天，都在捕捉鹌鹑，最少的也捕捉了约二千公升；他们都摆在营地的四周。
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓起来，终日终夜，并次日一整天，捕取鹌鹑；至少的也取了十贺梅珥，为自己摆列在营的四围。
verses.textEnNiv: All that day and night and all the next day the people went out and gathered quail. No one gathered less than ten homers. Then they spread them out all around the camp.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people rose all that day and all night and all the next day, and gathered the quail. Those who gathered least gathered ten homers. And they spread them out for themselves all around the camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the people stayed up all that day, all night, and all the next day, and gathered the quail (he who gathered least gathered ten homers); and they spread them out for themselves all around the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: So the people went out and caught quail all that day and throughout the night and all the next day, too. No one gathered less than fifty bushels ! They spread the quail all around the camp to dry.
verses.textEnNasb: And the people spent all that day, all night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quail (the one who gathered least gathered ten homers) and spread them out for themselves all around the camp.
verses.textEn: All that day and night and all the next day the people went out and gathered quail. No one gathered less than ten homers. Then they spread them out all around the camp.

verses.textZh: 肉在他们牙齿之间，还没有嚼烂，耶和华的怒气就向人民发作，用极重的灾祸击打他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 肉在他们牙齿之间，还没有嚼烂，耶和华的怒气就向人民发作，用极重的灾祸击打他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 肉在他们牙齿之间尚未嚼烂，耶和华的怒气就向他们发作，用最重的灾殃击杀了他们。
verses.textEnNiv: But while the meat was still between their teeth and before it could be consumed, the anger of the Lord burned against the people, and he struck them with a severe plague.
verses.textEnEsv: While the meat was yet between their teeth, before it was consumed, the anger of the Lord was kindled against the people, and the Lord struck down the people with a very great plague.
verses.textEnNkjv: But while the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, the wrath of the Lord was aroused against the people, and the Lord struck the people with a very great plague.
verses.textEnNlt: But while they were gorging themselves on the meat—while it was still in their mouths—the anger of the Lord blazed against the people, and he struck them with a severe plague.
verses.textEnNasb: While the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, the anger of the Lord was kindled against the people, and the Lord struck the people with a very severe plague.
verses.textEn: But while the meat was still between their teeth and before it could be consumed, the anger of the Lord burned against the people, and he struck them with a severe plague.

verses.textZh: 于是那地方名叫基博罗．哈他瓦，因为他们在那里埋葬起了贪欲的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是那地方名叫基博罗．哈他瓦，因为他们在那里埋葬起了贪欲的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 那地方便叫做基博罗‧哈他瓦 ，因为他们在那里葬埋那起贪欲之心的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore the place was named Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had craved other food.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the name of that place was called Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had the craving.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he called the name of that place Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had yielded to craving.
verses.textEnNlt: So that place was called Kibroth-hattaavah (which means "graves of gluttony") because there they buried the people who had craved meat from Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: So that place was named Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had been greedy.
verses.textEn: Therefore the place was named Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had craved other food.

verses.textZh: 人民从基博罗．哈他瓦起行，到哈洗录去，就住在哈洗录。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人民从基博罗．哈他瓦起行，到哈洗录去，就住在哈洗录。
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓从基博罗‧哈他瓦走到哈洗录，就住在哈洗录。
verses.textEnNiv: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth and stayed there.
verses.textEnEsv: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people journeyed to Hazeroth, and they remained at Hazeroth.
verses.textEnNkjv: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people moved to Hazeroth, and camped at Hazeroth.
verses.textEnNlt: From Kibroth-hattaavah the Israelites traveled to Hazeroth, where they stayed for some time.
verses.textEnNasb: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people set out for Hazeroth, and they remained at Hazeroth.
verses.textEn: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth and stayed there.

verses.textZh: 米利暗和亚伦，为了摩西所娶的古实女子的缘故，就出言反对摩西，因为他娶了一个古实女子为妻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米利暗和亚伦，为了摩西所娶的古实女子的缘故，就出言反对摩西，因为他娶了一个古实女子为妻。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西娶了古实女子为妻。米利暗和亚伦因他所娶的古实女子就毁谤他，说：
verses.textEnNiv: Miriam and Aaron began to talk against Moses because of his Cushite wife, for he had married a Cushite.
verses.textEnEsv: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married, for he had married a Cushite woman.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married; for he had married an Ethiopian woman.
verses.textEnNlt: While they were at Hazeroth, Miriam and Aaron criticized Moses because he had married a Cushite woman.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married (for he had married a Cushite woman);
verses.textEn: Miriam and Aaron began to talk against Moses because of his Cushite wife, for he had married a Cushite.

verses.textZh: 他们说："难道耶和华单单与摩西说话，不也与我们说话吗？"这话耶和华听见了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："难道耶和华单单与摩西说话，不也与我们说话吗？"这话耶和华听见了。
verses.textZhCuv: 「难道耶和华单与摩西说话，不也与我们说话吗？」这话耶和华听见了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Has the Lord spoken only through Moses?" they asked. "Hasn’t he also spoken through us?" And the Lord heard this.
verses.textEnEsv: And they said, "Has the Lord indeed spoken only through Moses? Has he not spoken through us also?" And the Lord heard it.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they said, "Has the Lord indeed spoken only through Moses? Has He not spoken through us also?" And the Lord heard it.
verses.textEnNlt: They said, "Has the Lord spoken only through Moses? Hasn’t he spoken through us, too?" But the Lord heard them.
verses.textEnNasb: and they said, "Is it a fact that the Lord has spoken only through Moses? Has He not spoken through us as well?" And the Lord heard this.
verses.textEn: "Has the Lord spoken only through Moses?" they asked. "Hasn’t he also spoken through us?" And the Lord heard this.

verses.textZh: 摩西为人十分谦和，胜过世上所有的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西为人十分谦和，胜过世上所有的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西为人极其谦和，胜过世上的众人。
verses.textEnNiv: (Now Moses was a very humble man, more humble than anyone else on the face of the earth.)
verses.textEnEsv: Now the man Moses was very meek, more than all people who were on the face of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: (Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all men who were on the face of the earth.)
verses.textEnNlt: (Now Moses was very humble—more humble than any other person on earth.)
verses.textEnNasb: (Now the man Moses was very humble, more than any person who was on the face of the earth.)
verses.textEn: (Now Moses was a very humble man, more humble than anyone else on the face of the earth.)

verses.textZh: 耶和华忽然对摩西、亚伦和米利暗说："你们三个人都出来，到会幕那里去。"他们三个人就出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华忽然对摩西、亚伦和米利暗说："你们三个人都出来，到会幕那里去。"他们三个人就出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华忽然对摩西、亚伦、米利暗说：「你们三个人都出来，到会幕这里。」他们三个人就出来了。
verses.textEnNiv: At once the Lord said to Moses, Aaron and Miriam, "Come out to the tent of meeting, all three of you." So the three of them went out.
verses.textEnEsv: And suddenly the Lord said to Moses and to Aaron and Miriam, "Come out, you three, to the tent of meeting." And the three of them came out.
verses.textEnNkjv: Suddenly the Lord said to Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, "Come out, you three, to the tabernacle of meeting!" So the three came out.
verses.textEnNlt: So immediately the Lord called to Moses, Aaron, and Miriam and said, "Go out to the Tabernacle, all three of you!" So the three of them went to the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord suddenly said to Moses and to Aaron and Miriam, "You three go out to the tent of meeting." So the three of them went out.
verses.textEn: At once the Lord said to Moses, Aaron and Miriam, "Come out to the tent of meeting, all three of you." So the three of them went out.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在云柱中降临，停在会幕门口，呼召亚伦和米利暗；他们二人就前去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在云柱中降临，停在会幕门口，呼召亚伦和米利暗；他们二人就前去。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在云柱中降临，站在会幕门口，召亚伦和米利暗，二人就出来了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord came down in a pillar of cloud; he stood at the entrance to the tent and summoned Aaron and Miriam. When the two of them stepped forward,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord came down in a pillar of cloud and stood at the entrance of the tent and called Aaron and Miriam, and they both came forward.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord came down in the pillar of cloud and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam. And they both went forward.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord descended in the pillar of cloud and stood at the entrance of the Tabernacle. "Aaron and Miriam!" he called, and they stepped forward.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord came down in a pillar of cloud and stood at the entrance of the tent; and He called Aaron and Miriam. When they had both come forward,
verses.textEn: Then the Lord came down in a pillar of cloud; he stood at the entrance to the tent and summoned Aaron and Miriam. When the two of them stepped forward,

verses.textZh: 耶和华说： "现在你们要听我的话， 如果你们中间有先知， 我耶和华必在异象中向他显现， 在梦中与他说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说： "现在你们要听我的话， 如果你们中间有先知， 我耶和华必在异象中向他显现， 在梦中与他说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「你们且听我的话：你们中间若有先知，我－耶和华必在异象中向他显现，在梦中与他说话。
verses.textEnNiv: he said, "Listen to my words: "When there is a prophet among you, I, the Lord , reveal myself to them in visions, I speak to them in dreams.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Hear my words: If there is a prophet among you, I the Lord make myself known to him in a vision; I speak with him in a dream.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said, "Hear now My words: If there is a prophet among you, I, the Lord, make Myself known to him in a vision; I speak to him in a dream.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said to them, "Now listen to what I say: "If there were prophets among you, I, the Lord , would reveal myself in visions. I would speak to them in dreams.
verses.textEnNasb: He said, "Now hear My words: If there is a prophet among you, I, the Lord, will make Myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.
verses.textEn: he said, "Listen to my words: "When there is a prophet among you, I, the Lord , reveal myself to them in visions, I speak to them in dreams.

verses.textZh: 可是，对我的仆人摩西却不是这样， 他是在我全家忠心的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是，对我的仆人摩西却不是这样， 他是在我全家忠心的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的仆人摩西不是这样；他是在我全家尽忠的。
verses.textEnNiv: But this is not true of my servant Moses; he is faithful in all my house.
verses.textEnEsv: Not so with my servant Moses. He is faithful in all my house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Not so with My servant Moses; He is faithful in all My house.
verses.textEnNlt: But not with my servant Moses. Of all my house, he is the one I trust.
verses.textEnNasb: "It is not this way for My servant Moses; He is faithful in all My household;
verses.textEn: But this is not true of my servant Moses; he is faithful in all my house.

verses.textZh: 我要与他面对面说话， 是亲自说的，不是用谜语； 他必看见耶和华的形象， 你们出言反对我的仆人摩西， 为甚么不惧怕呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要与他面对面说话， 是亲自说的，不是用谜语； 他必看见耶和华的形象， 你们出言反对我的仆人摩西， 为甚么不惧怕呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我要与他面对面说话，乃是明说，不用谜语，并且他必见我的形象。你们毁谤我的仆人摩西，为何不惧怕呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: With him I speak face to face, clearly and not in riddles; he sees the form of the Lord . Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?"
verses.textEnEsv: With him I speak mouth to mouth, clearly, and not in riddles, and he beholds the form of the Lord . Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?"
verses.textEnNkjv: I speak with him face to face, Even plainly, and not in dark sayings; And he sees the form of the Lord. Why then were you not afraid To speak against My servant Moses?"
verses.textEnNlt: I speak to him face to face, clearly, and not in riddles! He sees the Lord as he is. So why were you not afraid to criticize my servant Moses?"
verses.textEnNasb: With him I speak mouth to mouth, That is, openly, and not using mysterious language, And he beholds the form of the Lord. So why were you not afraid To speak against My servant, against Moses?"
verses.textEn: With him I speak face to face, clearly and not in riddles; he sees the form of the Lord . Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华向他们发怒，就走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华向他们发怒，就走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华就向他们二人发怒而去。
verses.textEnNiv: The anger of the Lord burned against them, and he left them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against them, and he departed.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the anger of the Lord was aroused against them, and He departed.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord was very angry with them, and he departed.
verses.textEnNasb: And the anger of the Lord burned against them and He departed.
verses.textEn: The anger of the Lord burned against them, and he left them.

verses.textZh: 云彩从会幕上离开，米利暗就长了大痲风，像雪那样白；亚伦转身过来看米利暗，见她长了大痲风。
verses.textZhCnvs: 云彩从会幕上离开，米利暗就长了大痲风，像雪那样白；亚伦转身过来看米利暗，见她长了大痲风。
verses.textZhCuv: 云彩从会幕上挪开了，不料，米利暗长了大麻风，有雪那样白。亚伦一看米利暗长了大麻风，
verses.textEnNiv: When the cloud lifted from above the tent, Miriam’s skin was leprous —it became as white as snow. Aaron turned toward her and saw that she had a defiling skin disease,
verses.textEnEsv: When the cloud removed from over the tent, behold, Miriam was leprous, like snow. And Aaron turned toward Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the cloud departed from above the tabernacle, suddenly Miriam became leprous, as whiteas snow. Then Aaron turned toward Miriam, and there she was, a leper.
verses.textEnNlt: As the cloud moved from above the Tabernacle, there stood Miriam, her skin as white as snow from leprosy. When Aaron saw what had happened to her,
verses.textEnNasb: But when the cloud had withdrawn from above the tent, behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. As Aaron turned toward Miriam, behold, she was leprous.
verses.textEn: When the cloud lifted from above the tent, Miriam’s skin was leprous —it became as white as snow. Aaron turned toward her and saw that she had a defiling skin disease,

verses.textZh: 亚伦就对摩西说："我主啊，求你不要因我们行事愚昧所犯的罪，就把这罪加在我们身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦就对摩西说："我主啊，求你不要因我们行事愚昧所犯的罪，就把这罪加在我们身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 就对摩西说：「我主啊，求你不要因我们愚昧犯罪，便将这罪加在我们身上。
verses.textEnNiv: and he said to Moses, "Please, my lord, I ask you not to hold against us the sin we have so foolishly committed.
verses.textEnEsv: And Aaron said to Moses, "Oh, my lord, do not punish us because we have done foolishly and have sinned.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Aaron said to Moses, "Oh, my lord! Please do not lay this sin on us, in which we have done foolishly and in which we have sinned.
verses.textEnNlt: he cried out to Moses, "Oh, my master! Please don’t punish us for this sin we have so foolishly committed.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Aaron said to Moses, "Oh, my lord, I beg you, do not hold us responsible for this sin by which we have turned out to be foolish, and by which we have sinned.
verses.textEn: and he said to Moses, "Please, my lord, I ask you not to hold against us the sin we have so foolishly committed.

verses.textZh: 求你不要叫她像个死胎，一出母腹，肉就半腐烂了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你不要叫她像个死胎，一出母腹，肉就半腐烂了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 求你不要使她像那出母腹、肉已半烂的死胎。」
verses.textEnNiv: Do not let her be like a stillborn infant coming from its mother’s womb with its flesh half eaten away."
verses.textEnEsv: Let her not be as one dead, whose flesh is half eaten away when he comes out of his mother’s womb."
verses.textEnNkjv: Please do not let her be as one dead, whose flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb!"
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let her be like a stillborn baby, already decayed at birth."
verses.textEnNasb: Oh, do not let her be like a dead person, whose flesh is half eaten away when he comes out of his mother’s womb!"
verses.textEn: Do not let her be like a stillborn infant coming from its mother’s womb with its flesh half eaten away."

verses.textZh: 于是摩西向耶和华哀求，说："神啊，求你医好她。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是摩西向耶和华哀求，说："神啊，求你医好她。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是摩西哀求耶和华说：「神啊，求你医治她！」
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses cried out to the Lord , "Please, God, heal her!"
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses cried to the Lord , "O God, please heal her—please."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses cried out to the Lord, saying, "Please heal her, O God, I pray!"
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses cried out to the Lord , "O God, I beg you, please heal her!"
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses cried out to the Lord, saying, "God, heal her, please!"
verses.textEn: So Moses cried out to the Lord , "Please, God, heal her!"

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："如果她的父亲吐唾沫在她脸上，她不是要蒙羞七天吗？现在把她关在营外七天，然后才让她回来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："如果她的父亲吐唾沫在她脸上，她不是要蒙羞七天吗？现在把她关在营外七天，然后才让她回来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「她父亲若吐唾沫在她脸上，她岂不蒙羞七天吗？现在要把她在营外关锁七天，然后才可以领她进来。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord replied to Moses, "If her father had spit in her face, would she not have been in disgrace for seven days? Confine her outside the camp for seven days; after that she can be brought back."
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord said to Moses, "If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be shamed seven days? Let her be shut outside the camp seven days, and after that she may be brought in again."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "If her father had but spit in her face, would she not be shamed seven days? Let her be shut out of the camp seven days, and afterward she may be received again."
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord said to Moses, "If her father had done nothing more than spit in her face, wouldn’t she be defiled for seven days? So keep her outside the camp for seven days, and after that she may be accepted back."
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord said to Moses, "If her father had only spit in her face, would she not be put to shame for seven days? Have her shut outside the camp for seven days, and afterward she may be received again."
verses.textEn: The Lord replied to Moses, "If her father had spit in her face, would she not have been in disgrace for seven days? Confine her outside the camp for seven days; after that she can be brought back."

verses.textZh: 于是米利暗被关在营外七天；人民没有启程，直到把米利暗接回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是米利暗被关在营外七天；人民没有启程，直到把米利暗接回来。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是米利暗关锁在营外七天。百姓没有行路，直等到把米利暗领进来。
verses.textEnNiv: So Miriam was confined outside the camp for seven days, and the people did not move on till she was brought back.
verses.textEnEsv: So Miriam was shut outside the camp seven days, and the people did not set out on the march till Miriam was brought in again.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Miriam was shut out of the camp seven days, and the people did not journey till Miriam was brought in again.
verses.textEnNlt: So Miriam was kept outside the camp for seven days, and the people waited until she was brought back before they traveled again.
verses.textEnNasb: So Miriam was shut outside the camp for seven days, and the people did not move on until Miriam was received again.
verses.textEn: So Miriam was confined outside the camp for seven days, and the people did not move on till she was brought back.

verses.textZh: 然后，人民从哈洗录起行，在巴兰的旷野安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后，人民从哈洗录起行，在巴兰的旷野安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 以后百姓从哈洗录起行，在巴兰的旷野安营。
verses.textEnNiv: After that, the people left Hazeroth and encamped in the Desert of Paran.
verses.textEnEsv: After that the people set out from Hazeroth, and camped in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.textEnNkjv: And afterward the people moved from Hazeroth and camped in the Wilderness of Paran.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they left Hazeroth and camped in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.textEnNasb: Afterward, however, the people moved on from Hazeroth and camped in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.textEn: After that, the people left Hazeroth and encamped in the Desert of Paran.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord now said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要派人窥探我赐给以色列人的迦南地；按着父家所属的支派，每支派要派一个人，个个都必须是他们的领袖。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要派人窥探我赐给以色列人的迦南地；按着父家所属的支派，每支派要派一个人，个个都必须是他们的领袖。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你打发人去窥探我所赐给以色列人的迦南地，他们每支派中要打发一个人，都要作首领的。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Send some men to explore the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites. From each ancestral tribe send one of its leaders."
verses.textEnEsv: "Send men to spy out the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the people of Israel. From each tribe of their fathers you shall send a man, every one a chief among them."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Send men to spy out the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the children of Israel; from each tribe of their fathers you shall send a man, every one a leader among them."
verses.textEnNlt: "Send out men to explore the land of Canaan, the land I am giving to the Israelites. Send one leader from each of the twelve ancestral tribes."
verses.textEnNasb: "Send out men for yourself to spy out the land of Canaan, which I am going to give the sons of Israel; you shall send a man from each of their fathers’ tribes, every one a leader among them."
verses.textEn: "Send some men to explore the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites. From each ancestral tribe send one of its leaders."

verses.textZh: 摩西就照着耶和华的吩咐，从巴兰的旷野派他们去了；他们都是以色列人的领袖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西就照着耶和华的吩咐，从巴兰的旷野派他们去了；他们都是以色列人的领袖。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西就照耶和华的吩咐从巴兰的旷野打发他们去；他们都是以色列人的族长。
verses.textEnNiv: So at the Lord ’s command Moses sent them out from the Desert of Paran. All of them were leaders of the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran, according to the command of the Lord , all of them men who were heads of the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses sent them from the Wilderness of Paran according to the command of the Lord, all of them men who were heads of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses did as the Lord commanded him. He sent out twelve men, all tribal leaders of Israel, from their camp in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran at the command of the Lord, all of them men who were heads of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: So at the Lord ’s command Moses sent them out from the Desert of Paran. All of them were leaders of the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 以下是他们的名字：属流本支派的是撒刻的儿子沙母亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是他们的名字：属流本支派的是撒刻的儿子沙母亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的名字：属吕便支派的有撒刻的儿子沙母亚。
verses.textEnNiv: These are their names: from the tribe of Reuben, Shammua son of Zakkur;
verses.textEnEsv: And these were their names: From the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur;
verses.textEnNkjv: Now these were their names: from the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur;
verses.textEnNlt: These were the tribes and the names of their leaders: Tribe LeaderReuben Shammua son of Zaccur
verses.textEnNasb: These then were their names: from the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur;
verses.textEn: These are their names: from the tribe of Reuben, Shammua son of Zakkur;

verses.textZh: 属西缅支派的是何利的儿子沙法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属西缅支派的是何利的儿子沙法。
verses.textZhCuv: 属西缅支派的有何利的儿子沙法。
verses.textEnNiv: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat son of Hori;
verses.textEnEsv: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori;
verses.textEnNkjv: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori;
verses.textEnNlt: Simeon Shaphat son of Hori
verses.textEnNasb: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori;
verses.textEn: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat son of Hori;

verses.textZh: 属犹大支派的是耶孚尼的儿子迦勒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属犹大支派的是耶孚尼的儿子迦勒。
verses.textZhCuv: 属犹大支派的有耶孚尼的儿子迦勒。
verses.textEnNiv: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh;
verses.textEnEsv: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh;
verses.textEnNkjv: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh;
verses.textEnNlt: Judah Caleb son of Jephunneh
verses.textEnNasb: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh;
verses.textEn: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh;

verses.textZh: 属以萨迦支派的是约色的儿子以迦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属以萨迦支派的是约色的儿子以迦。
verses.textZhCuv: 属以萨迦支派的有约色的儿子以迦。
verses.textEnNiv: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal son of Joseph;
verses.textEnEsv: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph;
verses.textEnNkjv: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph;
verses.textEnNlt: Issachar Igal son of Joseph
verses.textEnNasb: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph;
verses.textEn: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal son of Joseph;

verses.textZh: 属以法莲支派的是嫩的儿子何西亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属以法莲支派的是嫩的儿子何西亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 属以法莲支派的有嫩的儿子何希阿。
verses.textEnNiv: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Nun;
verses.textEnEsv: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun;
verses.textEnNkjv: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun;
verses.textEnNlt: Ephraim Hoshea son of Nun
verses.textEnNasb: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun;
verses.textEn: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Nun;

verses.textZh: 属便雅悯支派的是拉孚的儿子帕提。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属便雅悯支派的是拉孚的儿子帕提。
verses.textZhCuv: 属便雅悯支派的有拉孚的儿子帕提。
verses.textEnNiv: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti son of Raphu;
verses.textEnEsv: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu;
verses.textEnNkjv: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu;
verses.textEnNlt: Benjamin Palti son of Raphu
verses.textEnNasb: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu;
verses.textEn: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti son of Raphu;

verses.textZh: 属西布伦支派的是梭底的儿子迦叠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属西布伦支派的是梭底的儿子迦叠。
verses.textZhCuv: 属西布伦支派的有梭底的儿子迦叠。
verses.textEnNiv: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel son of Sodi;
verses.textEnEsv: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi;
verses.textEnNkjv: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi;
verses.textEnNlt: Zebulun Gaddiel son of Sodi
verses.textEnNasb: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi;
verses.textEn: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel son of Sodi;

verses.textZh: 属约瑟支派的，就是属玛拿西支派的，是苏西的儿子迦底。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属约瑟支派的，就是属玛拿西支派的，是苏西的儿子迦底。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟的子孙，属玛拿西支派的有稣西的儿子迦底。
verses.textEnNiv: from the tribe of Manasseh (a tribe of Joseph), Gaddi son of Susi;
verses.textEnEsv: from the tribe of Joseph (that is, from the tribe of Manasseh), Gaddi the son of Susi;
verses.textEnNkjv: from the tribe of Joseph, thatis, from the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi;
verses.textEnNlt: Manasseh son of Joseph Gaddi son of Susi
verses.textEnNasb: from the tribe of Joseph, from the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi;
verses.textEn: from the tribe of Manasseh (a tribe of Joseph), Gaddi son of Susi;

verses.textZh: 属但支派的是基玛利的儿子亚米利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属但支派的是基玛利的儿子亚米利。
verses.textZhCuv: 属但支派的有基玛利的儿子亚米利。
verses.textEnNiv: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel son of Gemalli;
verses.textEnEsv: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli;
verses.textEnNkjv: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli;
verses.textEnNlt: Dan Ammiel son of Gemalli
verses.textEnNasb: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli;
verses.textEn: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel son of Gemalli;

verses.textZhCnvs: 属亚设支派的是米迦勒的儿子西帖。
verses.textZhCuv: 属亚设支派的有米迦勒的儿子西帖。
verses.textEnNiv: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael;
verses.textEnEsv: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael;
verses.textEnNkjv: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael;
verses.textEnNlt: Asher Sethur son of Michael
verses.textEnNasb: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael;
verses.textEn: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael;

verses.textZh: 属拿弗他利支派的是瓦缚西的儿子拿比。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属拿弗他利支派的是瓦缚西的儿子拿比。
verses.textZhCuv: 属拿弗他利支派的有缚西的儿子拿比。
verses.textEnNiv: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi son of Vophsi;
verses.textEnEsv: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi;
verses.textEnNkjv: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi;
verses.textEnNlt: Naphtali Nahbi son of Vophsi
verses.textEnNasb: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi;
verses.textEn: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi son of Vophsi;

verses.textZh: 属迦得支派的是玛基的儿子臼利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属迦得支派的是玛基的儿子臼利。
verses.textZhCuv: 属迦得支派的有玛基的儿子臼利。
verses.textEnNiv: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel son of Maki.
verses.textEnEsv: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
verses.textEnNkjv: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
verses.textEnNlt: Gad Geuel son of Maki
verses.textEnNasb: and from the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
verses.textEn: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel son of Maki.

verses.textZh: 以上是摩西派去窥探那地的人的名字。摩西称嫩的儿子何西亚为约书亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上是摩西派去窥探那地的人的名字。摩西称嫩的儿子何西亚为约书亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是摩西所打发、窥探那地之人的名字。摩西就称嫩的儿子何希阿为约书亚。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the names of the men Moses sent to explore the land. (Moses gave Hoshea son of Nun the name Joshua.)
verses.textEnEsv: These were the names of the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun, Joshua.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the names of the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun, Joshua.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the names of the men Moses sent out to explore the land. (Moses called Hoshea son of Nun by the name Joshua.)
verses.textEnNasb: These are the names of the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land; but Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun, Joshua.
verses.textEn: These are the names of the men Moses sent to explore the land. (Moses gave Hoshea son of Nun the name Joshua.)

verses.textZh: 摩西派他们去窥探迦南地，对他们说："你们要从这里上南地，然后上山地去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西派他们去窥探迦南地，对他们说："你们要从这里上南地，然后上山地去。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西打发他们去窥探迦南地，说：「你们从南地上山地去，
verses.textEnNiv: When Moses sent them to explore Canaan, he said, "Go up through the Negev and on into the hill country.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan and said to them, "Go up into the Negeb and go up into the hill country,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, "Go up this way into the South, and go up to the mountains,
verses.textEnNlt: Moses gave the men these instructions as he sent them out to explore the land: "Go north through the Negev into the hill country.
verses.textEnNasb: When Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, he said to them, "Go up there into the Negev; then go up into the hill country.
verses.textEn: When Moses sent them to explore Canaan, he said, "Go up through the Negev and on into the hill country.

verses.textZh: 看看那地怎样，住在那里的人是强是弱，是多是少；
verses.textZhCnvs: 看看那地怎样，住在那里的人是强是弱，是多是少；
verses.textZhCuv: 看那地如何，其中所住的民是强是弱，是多是少，
verses.textEnNiv: See what the land is like and whether the people who live there are strong or weak, few or many.
verses.textEnEsv: and see what the land is, and whether the people who dwell in it are strong or weak, whether they are few or many,
verses.textEnNkjv: and see what the land is like: whether the people who dwell in it are strong or weak, few or many;
verses.textEnNlt: See what the land is like, and find out whether the people living there are strong or weak, few or many.
verses.textEnNasb: See what the land is like, and whether the people who live in it are strong or weak, whether they are few or many.
verses.textEn: See what the land is like and whether the people who live there are strong or weak, few or many.

verses.textZh: 看看他们住的地怎样，是好是坏；看看他们所住的城镇怎样，是营地，还是城堡；
verses.textZhCnvs: 看看他们住的地怎样，是好是坏；看看他们所住的城镇怎样，是营地，还是城堡；
verses.textZhCuv: 所住之地是好是歹，所住之处是营盘是坚城。
verses.textEnNiv: What kind of land do they live in? Is it good or bad? What kind of towns do they live in? Are they unwalled or fortified?
verses.textEnEsv: and whether the land that they dwell in is good or bad, and whether the cities that they dwell in are camps or strongholds,
verses.textEnNkjv: whether the land they dwell in is good or bad; whether the cities they inhabit are like camps or strongholds;
verses.textEnNlt: See what kind of land they live in. Is it good or bad? Do their towns have walls, or are they unprotected like open camps?
verses.textEnNasb: And how is the land in which they live, is it good or bad? And how are the cities in which they live, are the people in open camps or in fortifications?
verses.textEn: What kind of land do they live in? Is it good or bad? What kind of towns do they live in? Are they unwalled or fortified?

verses.textZh: 看看那地怎样，是肥沃还是贫瘠，那里有树木没有。你们要壮胆，把那地的果子带些回来。"那时正是葡萄初熟的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看看那地怎样，是肥沃还是贫瘠，那里有树木没有。你们要壮胆，把那地的果子带些回来。"那时正是葡萄初熟的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 又看那地土是肥美是瘠薄，其中有树木没有。你们要放开胆量，把那地的果子带些来。」（那时正是葡萄初熟的时候。）
verses.textEnNiv: How is the soil? Is it fertile or poor? Are there trees in it or not? Do your best to bring back some of the fruit of the land." (It was the season for the first ripe grapes.)
verses.textEnEsv: and whether the land is rich or poor, and whether there are trees in it or not. Be of good courage and bring some of the fruit of the land." Now the time was the season of the first ripe grapes.
verses.textEnNkjv: whether the land is rich or poor; and whether there are forests there or not. Be of good courage. And bring some of the fruit of the land." Now the time was the season of the first ripe grapes.
verses.textEnNlt: Is the soil fertile or poor? Are there many trees? Do your best to bring back samples of the crops you see." (It happened to be the season for harvesting the first ripe grapes.)
verses.textEnNasb: And how is the land, is it productive or unproductive? Are there trees in it or not? And show yourselves courageous and get some of the fruit of the land." Now the time was the season of the first ripe grapes.
verses.textEn: How is the soil? Is it fertile or poor? Are there trees in it or not? Do your best to bring back some of the fruit of the land." (It was the season for the first ripe grapes.)

verses.textZh: 他们上去窥探了那地，从寻的旷野到利合，直到哈玛关口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们上去窥探了那地，从寻的旷野到利合，直到哈玛关口。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们上去窥探那地，从寻的旷野到利合，直到哈马口。
verses.textEnNiv: So they went up and explored the land from the Desert of Zin as far as Rehob, toward Lebo Hamath.
verses.textEnEsv: So they went up and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, near Lebo-hamath.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they went up and spied out the land from the Wilderness of Zin as far as Rehob, near the entrance of Hamath.
verses.textEnNlt: So they went up and explored the land from the wilderness of Zin as far as Rehob, near Lebo-hamath.
verses.textEnNasb: So they went up and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin as far as Rehob, at Lebo-hamath.
verses.textEn: So they went up and explored the land from the Desert of Zin as far as Rehob, toward Lebo Hamath.

verses.textZh: 他们上到南地，到了希伯仑，在那里有亚衲族人的后裔亚希幔、示筛、挞买。原来希伯仑城比埃及的琐安城早建七年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们上到南地，到了希伯仑，在那里有亚衲族人的后裔亚希幔、示筛、挞买。原来希伯仑城比埃及的琐安城早建七年。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们从南地上去，到了希伯仑；在那里有亚衲族人亚希幔、示筛、挞买。（原来希伯仑城被建造比埃及的锁安城早七年。）
verses.textEnNiv: They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, lived. (Hebron had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
verses.textEnEsv: They went up into the Negeb and came to Hebron. Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, were there. ( Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
