verses.textEnNkjv: And they went up through the South and came to Hebron; Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
verses.textEnNlt: Going north, they passed through the Negev and arrived at Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai—all descendants of Anak—lived. (The ancient town of Hebron was founded seven years before the Egyptian city of Zoan.)
verses.textEnNasb: When they had gone up into the Negev, they came to Hebron where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of Anak were. (Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
verses.textEn: They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, lived. (Hebron had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

verses.textZh: 他们来到以实各谷，从那里砍下了一根葡萄枝子，上头只有一挂葡萄，两个人用杠抬着回来；他们也带了些石榴和无花果回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们来到以实各谷，从那里砍下了一根葡萄枝子，上头只有一挂葡萄，两个人用杠抬着回来；他们也带了些石榴和无花果回来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们到了以实各谷，从那里砍了葡萄树的一枝，上头有一挂葡萄，两个人用杠抬着，又带了些石榴和无花果来。（
verses.textEnNiv: When they reached the Valley of Eshkol, they cut off a branch bearing a single cluster of grapes. Two of them carried it on a pole between them, along with some pomegranates and figs.
verses.textEnEsv: And they came to the Valley of Eshcol and cut down from there a branch with a single cluster of grapes, and they carried it on a pole between two of them; they also brought some pomegranates and figs.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they came to the Valley of Eshcol, and there cut down a branch with one cluster of grapes; they carried it between two of them on a pole. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.
verses.textEnNlt: When they came to the valley of Eshcol, they cut down a branch with a single cluster of grapes so large that it took two of them to carry it on a pole between them! They also brought back samples of the pomegranates and figs.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they came to the Valley of Eshcol, and from there they cut off a branch with a single cluster of grapes; and they carried it on a pole between two men, with some of the pomegranates and the figs.
verses.textEn: When they reached the Valley of Eshkol, they cut off a branch bearing a single cluster of grapes. Two of them carried it on a pole between them, along with some pomegranates and figs.

verses.textZh: 因为以色列人从那里砍来的那挂葡萄，所以那地方叫作以实各谷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为以色列人从那里砍来的那挂葡萄，所以那地方叫作以实各谷。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为以色列人从那里砍来的那挂葡萄，所以那地方叫做以实各谷。）
verses.textEnNiv: That place was called the Valley of Eshkol because of the cluster of grapes the Israelites cut off there.
verses.textEnEsv: That place was called the Valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster that the people of Israel cut down from there.
verses.textEnNkjv: The place was called the Valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the men of Israel cut down there.
verses.textEnNlt: That place was called the valley of Eshcol (which means "cluster"), because of the cluster of grapes the Israelite men cut there.
verses.textEnNasb: That place was called the Valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the sons of Israel cut off from there.
verses.textEn: That place was called the Valley of Eshkol because of the cluster of grapes the Israelites cut off there.

verses.textZh: 四十天以后，他们窥探那地完毕，就回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 四十天以后，他们窥探那地完毕，就回来。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了四十天，他们窥探那地才回来，
verses.textEnNiv: At the end of forty days they returned from exploring the land.
verses.textEnEsv: At the end of forty days they returned from spying out the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they returned from spying out the land after forty days.
verses.textEnNlt: After exploring the land for forty days, the men returned
verses.textEnNasb: When they returned from spying out the land, at the end of forty days,
verses.textEn: At the end of forty days they returned from exploring the land.

verses.textZh: 他们来到了巴兰旷野的加低斯，见摩西、亚伦和以色列的全体会众，向摩西、亚伦及全体会众报告，又把那地的果子给他们看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们来到了巴兰旷野的加低斯，见摩西、亚伦和以色列的全体会众，向摩西、亚伦及全体会众报告，又把那地的果子给他们看。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了巴兰旷野的加低斯，见摩西、亚伦，并以色列的全会众，回报摩西、亚伦，并全会众，又把那地的果子给他们看；
verses.textEnNiv: They came back to Moses and Aaron and the whole Israelite community at Kadesh in the Desert of Paran. There they reported to them and to the whole assembly and showed them the fruit of the land.
verses.textEnEsv: And they came to Moses and Aaron and to all the congregation of the people of Israel in the wilderness of Paran, at Kadesh. They brought back word to them and to all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now they departed and came back to Moses and Aaron and all the congregation of the children of Israel in the Wilderness of Paran, at Kadesh; they brought back word to them and to all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: to Moses, Aaron, and the whole community of Israel at Kadesh in the wilderness of Paran. They reported to the whole community what they had seen and showed them the fruit they had taken from the land.
verses.textEnNasb: they went on and came to Moses and Aaron and to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, in the wilderness of Paran at Kadesh; and they brought back word to them and to all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.
verses.textEn: They came back to Moses and Aaron and the whole Israelite community at Kadesh in the Desert of Paran. There they reported to them and to the whole assembly and showed them the fruit of the land.

verses.textZh: 他们告诉摩西："我们到了你派我们去的那地，果然是流奶与蜜的地，这就是那地的果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们告诉摩西："我们到了你派我们去的那地，果然是流奶与蜜的地，这就是那地的果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 又告诉摩西说：「我们到了你所打发我们去的那地，果然是流奶与蜜之地；这就是那地的果子。
verses.textEnNiv: They gave Moses this account: "We went into the land to which you sent us, and it does flow with milk and honey! Here is its fruit.
verses.textEnEsv: And they told him, "We came to the land to which you sent us. It flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they told him, and said: "We went to the land where you sent us. It truly flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
verses.textEnNlt: This was their report to Moses: "We entered the land you sent us to explore, and it is indeed a bountiful country—a land flowing with milk and honey. Here is the kind of fruit it produces.
verses.textEnNasb: So they reported to him and said, "We came into the land where you sent us, and it certainly does flow with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
verses.textEn: They gave Moses this account: "We went into the land to which you sent us, and it does flow with milk and honey! Here is its fruit.

verses.textZh: 只是住在那地的人强壮，城又坚固又十分高大，并且我们在那里也看见了亚衲族人的后裔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是住在那地的人强壮，城又坚固又十分高大，并且我们在那里也看见了亚衲族人的后裔。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而住那地的民强壮，城邑也坚固宽大，并且我们在那里看见了亚衲族的人。
verses.textEnNiv: But the people who live there are powerful, and the cities are fortified and very large. We even saw descendants of Anak there.
verses.textEnEsv: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. And besides, we saw the descendants of Anak there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless the people who dwell in the land are strong; the cities are fortified and very large; moreover we saw the descendants of Anak there.
verses.textEnNlt: But the people living there are powerful, and their towns are large and fortified. We even saw giants there, the descendants of Anak!
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless, the people who live in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. And indeed, we saw the descendants of Anak there!
verses.textEn: But the people who live there are powerful, and the cities are fortified and very large. We even saw descendants of Anak there.

verses.textZh: 有亚玛力人住在南地；赫人、耶布斯人、亚摩利人住在山地；迦南人住在海边和约旦河沿岸。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有亚玛力人住在南地；赫人、耶布斯人、亚摩利人住在山地；迦南人住在海边和约旦河沿岸。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛力人住在南地；赫人、耶布斯人、亚摩利人住在山地；迦南人住在海边并约旦河旁。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Amalekites live in the Negev; the Hittites, Jebusites and Amorites live in the hill country; and the Canaanites live near the sea and along the Jordan."
verses.textEnEsv: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the Negeb. The Hittites, the Jebusites, and the Amorites dwell in the hill country. And the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and along the Jordan."
verses.textEnNkjv: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the South; the Hittites, the Jebusites, and the Amorites dwell in the mountains; and the Canaanites dwell by the sea and along the banks of the Jordan."
verses.textEnNlt: The Amalekites live in the Negev, and the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites live in the hill country. The Canaanites live along the coast of the Mediterranean Sea and along the Jordan Valley."
verses.textEnNasb: Amalek is living in the land of the Negev, the Hittites, the Jebusites, and the Amorites are living in the hill country, and the Canaanites are living by the sea and by the side of the Jordan."
verses.textEn: The Amalekites live in the Negev; the Hittites, Jebusites and Amorites live in the hill country; and the Canaanites live near the sea and along the Jordan."

verses.textZh: 迦勒在摩西面前使众人镇静，说："我们立刻上去，占领那地吧！因为我们必能得胜。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦勒在摩西面前使众人镇静，说："我们立刻上去，占领那地吧！因为我们必能得胜。"
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒在摩西面前安抚百姓，说：「我们立刻上去得那地吧！我们足能得胜。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Caleb silenced the people before Moses and said, "We should go up and take possession of the land, for we can certainly do it."
verses.textEnEsv: But Caleb quieted the people before Moses and said, "Let us go up at once and occupy it, for we are well able to overcome it."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Caleb quieted the people before Moses, and said, "Let us go up at once and take possession, for we are well able to overcome it."
verses.textEnNlt: But Caleb tried to quiet the people as they stood before Moses. "Let’s go at once to take the land," he said. "We can certainly conquer it!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Caleb quieted the people before Moses and said, "We should by all means go up and take possession of it, for we will certainly prevail over it."
verses.textEn: Then Caleb silenced the people before Moses and said, "We should go up and take possession of the land, for we can certainly do it."

verses.textZh: 但是，那些与他同去的人却说："我们不能上去攻击那民，因为他们比我们强。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，那些与他同去的人却说："我们不能上去攻击那民，因为他们比我们强。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但那些和他同去的人说：「我们不能上去攻击那民，因为他们比我们强壮。」
verses.textEnNiv: But the men who had gone up with him said, "We can’t attack those people; they are stronger than we are."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the men who had gone up with him said, "We are not able to go up against the people, for they are stronger than we are."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the men who had gone up with him said, "We are not able to go up against the people, for they are stronger than we."
verses.textEnNlt: But the other men who had explored the land with him disagreed. "We can’t go up against them! They are stronger than we are!"
verses.textEnNasb: But the men who had gone up with him said, "We are not able to go up against the people, because they are too strong for us."
verses.textEn: But the men who had gone up with him said, "We can’t attack those people; they are stronger than we are."

verses.textZh: 那些探子就他们窥探之地向以色列人报恶信，说："我们经过要窥探的地方，是个吞吃居民的地方；我们在那里看见的人，个个都高大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些探子就他们窥探之地向以色列人报恶信，说："我们经过要窥探的地方，是个吞吃居民的地方；我们在那里看见的人，个个都高大。
verses.textZhCuv: 探子中有人论到所窥探之地，向以色列人报恶信，说：「我们所窥探、经过之地是吞吃居民之地，我们在那里所看见的人民都身量高大。
verses.textEnNiv: And they spread among the Israelites a bad report about the land they had explored. They said, "The land we explored devours those living in it. All the people we saw there are of great size.
verses.textEnEsv: So they brought to the people of Israel a bad report of the land that they had spied out, saying, "The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that devours its inhabitants, and all the people that we saw in it are of great height.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they gave the children of Israel a bad report of the land which they had spied out, saying, "The land through which we have gone as spies is a land that devours its inhabitants, and all the people whom we saw in it are men of great stature.
verses.textEnNlt: So they spread this bad report about the land among the Israelites: "The land we traveled through and explored will devour anyone who goes to live there. All the people we saw were huge.
verses.textEnNasb: So they brought a bad report of the land which they had spied out to the sons of Israel, saying, "The land through which we have gone to spy out is a land that devours its inhabitants; and all the people whom we saw in it are people of great stature.
verses.textEn: And they spread among the Israelites a bad report about the land they had explored. They said, "The land we explored devours those living in it. All the people we saw there are of great size.

verses.textZh: 在那里我们看见了巨人，就是亚衲人的子孙，是巨人的后裔；我们看自己好象是蚱蜢，他们看我们也是这样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里我们看见了巨人，就是亚衲人的子孙，是巨人的后裔；我们看自己好象是蚱蜢，他们看我们也是这样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们在那里看见亚衲族人，就是伟人；他们是伟人的后裔。据我们看，自己就如蚱蜢一样；据他们看，我们也是如此。」
verses.textEnNiv: We saw the Nephilim there (the descendants of Anak come from the Nephilim). We seemed like grasshoppers in our own eyes, and we looked the same to them."
verses.textEnEsv: And there we saw the Nephilim (the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim), and we seemed to ourselves like grasshoppers, and so we seemed to them."
verses.textEnNkjv: There we saw the giants ( the descendants of Anak came from the giants); and we were like grasshoppers in our own sight, and so we were in their sight."
verses.textEnNlt: We even saw giants there, the descendants of Anak. Next to them we felt like grasshoppers, and that’s what they thought, too!"
verses.textEnNasb: We also saw the Nephilim there (the sons of Anak are part of the Nephilim); and we were like grasshoppers in our own sight, and so we were in their sight."
verses.textEn: We saw the Nephilim there (the descendants of Anak come from the Nephilim). We seemed like grasshoppers in our own eyes, and we looked the same to them."

verses.textZh: 当时，全体会众大声喧嚷；那夜众民都哭号。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时，全体会众大声喧嚷；那夜众民都哭号。
verses.textZhCuv: 当下，全会众大声喧嚷；那夜百姓都哭号。
verses.textEnNiv: That night all the members of the community raised their voices and wept aloud.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the congregation raised a loud cry, and the people wept that night.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the congregation lifted up their voices and cried, and the people wept that night.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the whole community began weeping aloud, and they cried all night.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the congregation raised their voices and cried out, and the people wept that night.
verses.textEn: That night all the members of the community raised their voices and wept aloud.

verses.textZh: 以色列人向摩西和亚伦发怨言；全体会众都对他们说："但愿我们早死在埃及地，或死在这旷野。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人向摩西和亚伦发怨言；全体会众都对他们说："但愿我们早死在埃及地，或死在这旷野。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列众人向摩西、亚伦发怨言；全会众对他们说：「巴不得我们早死在埃及地，或是死在这旷野。
verses.textEnNiv: All the Israelites grumbled against Moses and Aaron, and the whole assembly said to them, "If only we had died in Egypt! Or in this wilderness!
verses.textEnEsv: And all the people of Israel grumbled against Moses and Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, "Would that we had died in the land of Egypt! Or would that we had died in this wilderness!
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the children of Israel complained against Moses and Aaron, and the whole congregation said to them, "If only we had died in the land of Egypt! Or if only we had died in this wilderness!
verses.textEnNlt: Their voices rose in a great chorus of protest against Moses and Aaron. "If only we had died in Egypt, or even here in the wilderness!" they complained.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the sons of Israel grumbled against Moses and Aaron; and the entire congregation said to them, "If only we had died in the land of Egypt! Or even if we had died in this wilderness!
verses.textEn: All the Israelites grumbled against Moses and Aaron, and the whole assembly said to them, "If only we had died in Egypt! Or in this wilderness!

verses.textZh: 耶和华为甚么把我们领到这地来，死在刀剑之下呢？我们的妻子和孩子要被掳掠。我们回埃及去，岂不更好吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华为甚么把我们领到这地来，死在刀剑之下呢？我们的妻子和孩子要被掳掠。我们回埃及去，岂不更好吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华为什么把我们领到那地，使我们倒在刀下呢？我们的妻子和孩子必被掳掠。我们回埃及去岂不好吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Why is the Lord bringing us to this land only to let us fall by the sword? Our wives and children will be taken as plunder. Wouldn’t it be better for us to go back to Egypt?"
verses.textEnEsv: Why is the Lord bringing us into this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will become a prey. Would it not be better for us to go back to Egypt?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Why has the Lord brought us to this land to fall by the sword, that our wives and children should become victims? Would it not be better for us to return to Egypt?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Why is the Lord taking us to this country only to have us die in battle? Our wives and our little ones will be carried off as plunder! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return to Egypt?"
verses.textEnNasb: So why is the Lord bringing us into this land to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will become plunder! Would it not be better for us to return to Egypt?"
verses.textEn: Why is the Lord bringing us to this land only to let us fall by the sword? Our wives and children will be taken as plunder. Wouldn’t it be better for us to go back to Egypt?"

verses.textZh: 于是他们彼此说："我们另立一个首领，回埃及去吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们彼此说："我们另立一个首领，回埃及去吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人彼此说：「我们不如立一个首领回埃及去吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: And they said to each other, "We should choose a leader and go back to Egypt."
verses.textEnEsv: And they said to one another, "Let us choose a leader and go back to Egypt."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they said to one another, "Let us select a leader and return to Egypt."
verses.textEnNlt: Then they plotted among themselves, "Let’s choose a new leader and go back to Egypt!"
verses.textEnNasb: So they said to one another, "Let’s appoint a leader and return to Egypt!"
verses.textEn: And they said to each other, "We should choose a leader and go back to Egypt."

verses.textZh: 摩西和亚伦就俯伏在以色列全体会众面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和亚伦就俯伏在以色列全体会众面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西、亚伦就俯伏在以色列全会众面前。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses and Aaron fell facedown in front of the whole Israelite assembly gathered there.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses and Aaron fell face down on the ground before the whole community of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces in the presence of all the assembly of the congregation of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: Then Moses and Aaron fell facedown in front of the whole Israelite assembly gathered there.

verses.textZh: 窥探那地的人中，有嫩的儿子约书亚和耶孚尼的儿子迦勒；他们撕裂衣服，
verses.textZhCnvs: 窥探那地的人中，有嫩的儿子约书亚和耶孚尼的儿子迦勒；他们撕裂衣服，
verses.textZhCuv: 窥探地的人中，嫩的儿子约书亚和耶孚尼的儿子迦勒撕裂衣服，
verses.textEnNiv: Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, who were among those who had explored the land, tore their clothes
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were among those who had spied out the land, tore their clothes
verses.textEnNkjv: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, whowere among those who had spied out the land, tore their clothes;
verses.textEnNlt: Two of the men who had explored the land, Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, tore their clothing.
verses.textEnNasb: And Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, of those who had spied out the land, tore their clothes;
verses.textEn: Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, who were among those who had explored the land, tore their clothes

verses.textZh: 对以色列全体会众说："我们去窥探的那地，是十分美好的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对以色列全体会众说："我们去窥探的那地，是十分美好的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 对以色列全会众说：「我们所窥探、经过之地是极美之地。
verses.textEnNiv: and said to the entire Israelite assembly, "The land we passed through and explored is exceedingly good.
verses.textEnEsv: and said to all the congregation of the people of Israel, "The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceedingly good land.
verses.textEnNkjv: and they spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying: "The land we passed through to spy out is an exceedingly good land.
verses.textEnNlt: They said to all the people of Israel, "The land we traveled through and explored is a wonderful land!
verses.textEnNasb: and they spoke to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, saying, "The land which we passed through to spy out is an exceedingly good land.
verses.textEn: and said to the entire Israelite assembly, "The land we passed through and explored is exceedingly good.

verses.textZh: 耶和华若是喜悦我们，就必把我们领进那地，把那地赐给我们，那地原是流奶与蜜的地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华若是喜悦我们，就必把我们领进那地，把那地赐给我们，那地原是流奶与蜜的地。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华若喜悦我们，就必将我们领进那地，把地赐给我们；那地原是流奶与蜜之地。
verses.textEnNiv: If the Lord is pleased with us, he will lead us into that land, a land flowing with milk and honey, and will give it to us.
verses.textEnEsv: If the Lord delights in us, he will bring us into this land and give it to us, a land that flows with milk and honey.
verses.textEnNkjv: If the Lord delights in us, then He will bring us into this land and give it to us, ‘a land which flows with milk and honey.’
verses.textEnNlt: And if the Lord is pleased with us, he will bring us safely into that land and give it to us. It is a rich land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.textEnNasb: If the Lord is pleased with us, then He will bring us into this land and give it to us—a land which flows with milk and honey.
verses.textEn: If the Lord is pleased with us, he will lead us into that land, a land flowing with milk and honey, and will give it to us.

verses.textZh: 只要你们不背叛耶和华，就不必怕那地的人，因为他们是我们的食物；荫庇他们的，已经离开他们了，耶和华却与我们同在；不要怕他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只要你们不背叛耶和华，就不必怕那地的人，因为他们是我们的食物；荫庇他们的，已经离开他们了，耶和华却与我们同在；不要怕他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但你们不可背叛耶和华，也不要怕那地的居民；因为他们是我们的食物，并且荫庇他们的已经离开他们。有耶和华与我们同在，不要怕他们！」
verses.textEnNiv: Only do not rebel against the Lord . And do not be afraid of the people of the land, because we will devour them. Their protection is gone, but the Lord is with us. Do not be afraid of them."
verses.textEnEsv: Only do not rebel against the Lord . And do not fear the people of the land, for they are bread for us. Their protection is removed from them, and the Lord is with us; do not fear them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Only do not rebel against the Lord, nor fear the people of the land, for they are our bread; their protection has departed from them, and the Lordis with us. Do not fear them."
verses.textEnNlt: Do not rebel against the Lord , and don’t be afraid of the people of the land. They are only helpless prey to us! They have no protection, but the Lord is with us! Don’t be afraid of them!"
verses.textEnNasb: Only do not rebel against the Lord; and do not fear the people of the land, for they will be our prey. Their protection is gone from them, and the Lord is with us; do not fear them."
verses.textEn: Only do not rebel against the Lord . And do not be afraid of the people of the land, because we will devour them. Their protection is gone, but the Lord is with us. Do not be afraid of them."

verses.textZh: 全体会众都说要用石头打死他们二人。这时，耶和华的荣光在会幕中向以色列众人显现。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全体会众都说要用石头打死他们二人。这时，耶和华的荣光在会幕中向以色列众人显现。
verses.textZhCuv: 但全会众说：「拿石头打死他们二人。」忽然，耶和华的荣光在会幕中向以色列众人显现。
verses.textEnNiv: But the whole assembly talked about stoning them. Then the glory of the Lord appeared at the tent of meeting to all the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the congregation said to stone them with stones. But the glory of the Lord appeared at the tent of meeting to all the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the congregation said to stone them with stones. Now the glory of the Lord appeared in the tabernacle of meeting before all the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: But the whole community began to talk about stoning Joshua and Caleb. Then the glorious presence of the Lord appeared to all the Israelites at the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: But all the congregation said to stone them with stones. Then the glory of the Lord appeared in the tent of meeting to all the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: But the whole assembly talked about stoning them. Then the glory of the Lord appeared at the tent of meeting to all the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："这民藐视我要到几时呢？我虽然在他们中间行了这些神迹，他们还是不信我要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："这民藐视我要到几时呢？我虽然在他们中间行了这些神迹，他们还是不信我要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「这百姓藐视我要到几时呢？我在他们中间行了这一切神迹，他们还不信我要到几时呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses, "How long will these people treat me with contempt? How long will they refuse to believe in me, in spite of all the signs I have performed among them?
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "How long will this people despise me? And how long will they not believe in me, in spite of all the signs that I have done among them?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses: "How long will these people reject Me? And how long will they not believe Me, with all the signs which I have performed among them?
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said to Moses, "How long will these people treat me with contempt? Will they never believe me, even after all the miraculous signs I have done among them?
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to Moses, "How long will this people be disrespectful to Me? And how long will they not believe in Me, despite all the signs that I have performed in their midst?
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses, "How long will these people treat me with contempt? How long will they refuse to believe in me, in spite of all the signs I have performed among them?

verses.textZh: 我要用瘟疫击杀他们，除灭他们；我要使你成为大国，比他们还强。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要用瘟疫击杀他们，除灭他们；我要使你成为大国，比他们还强。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我要用瘟疫击杀他们，使他们不得承受那地，叫你的后裔成为大国，比他们强胜。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will strike them down with a plague and destroy them, but I will make you into a nation greater and stronger than they."
verses.textEnEsv: I will strike them with the pestilence and disinherit them, and I will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they."
verses.textEnNkjv: I will strike them with the pestilence and disinherit them, and I will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they."
verses.textEnNlt: I will disown them and destroy them with a plague. Then I will make you into a nation greater and mightier than they are!"
verses.textEnNasb: I will strike them with plague and dispossess them, and I will make you into a nation greater and mightier than they."
verses.textEn: I will strike them down with a plague and destroy them, but I will make you into a nation greater and stronger than they."

verses.textZh: 摩西对耶和华说："这样埃及人必听见这事，因为你曾用大能，把这民从他们中间领上来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对耶和华说："这样埃及人必听见这事，因为你曾用大能，把这民从他们中间领上来；
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对耶和华说：「埃及人必听见这事；因为你曾施展大能，将这百姓从他们中间领上来。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses said to the Lord , "Then the Egyptians will hear about it! By your power you brought these people up from among them.
verses.textEnEsv: But Moses said to the Lord , "Then the Egyptians will hear of it, for you brought up this people in your might from among them,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said to the Lord: "Then the Egyptians will hear it, for by Your might You brought these people up from among them,
verses.textEnNlt: But Moses objected. "What will the Egyptians think when they hear about it?" he asked the Lord . "They know full well the power you displayed in rescuing your people from Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: But Moses said to the Lord, "Then the Egyptians will hear of it, for by Your strength You brought this people up from their midst,
verses.textEn: Moses said to the Lord , "Then the Egyptians will hear about it! By your power you brought these people up from among them.

verses.textZh: 埃及人也必告诉那地的居民。那地的居民也曾听见你耶和华是在这人民中间，你耶和华曾面对面的向人显现，你的云彩常停在他们上面；日间你在云柱中，夜间你在火柱中，走在他们前面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及人也必告诉那地的居民。那地的居民也曾听见你耶和华是在这人民中间，你耶和华曾面对面的向人显现，你的云彩常停在他们上面；日间你在云柱中，夜间你在火柱中，走在他们前面。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及人要将这事传给迦南地的居民；那民已经听见你－耶和华是在这百姓中间；因为你面对面被人看见，有你的云彩停在他们以上。你日间在云柱中，夜间在火柱中，在他们前面行。
verses.textEnNiv: And they will tell the inhabitants of this land about it. They have already heard that you, Lord , are with these people and that you, Lord , have been seen face to face, that your cloud stays over them, and that you go before them in a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night.
verses.textEnEsv: and they will tell the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you, O Lord , are in the midst of this people. For you, O Lord , are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.textEnNkjv: and they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that You, Lord, are among these people; that You, Lord, are seen face to face and Your cloud stands above them, and You go before them in a pillar of cloud by day and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.textEnNlt: Now if you destroy them, the Egyptians will send a report to the inhabitants of this land, who have already heard that you live among your people. They know, Lord , that you have appeared to your people face to face and that your pillar of cloud hovers over them. They know that you go before them in the pillar of cloud by day and the pillar of fire by night.
verses.textEnNasb: and they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that You, Lord, are in the midst of this people, because You, Lord, are seen eye to eye, while Your cloud stands over them; and You go before them in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.textEn: And they will tell the inhabitants of this land about it. They have already heard that you, Lord , are with these people and that you, Lord , have been seen face to face, that your cloud stays over them, and that you go before them in a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night.

verses.textZh: 现在如果你把这人民杀死，像杀死一人，那些听见你名声的万国就必议论说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在如果你把这人民杀死，像杀死一人，那些听见你名声的万国就必议论说：
verses.textZhCuv: 如今你若把这百姓杀了，如杀一人，那些听见你名声的列邦必议论说：
verses.textEnNiv: If you put all these people to death, leaving none alive, the nations who have heard this report about you will say,
verses.textEnEsv: Now if you kill this people as one man, then the nations who have heard your fame will say,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now if You kill these people as one man, then the nations which have heard of Your fame will speak, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Now if you slaughter all these people with a single blow, the nations that have heard of your fame will say,
verses.textEnNasb: Now if You put this people to death all at once, then the nations who have heard of Your fame will say,
verses.textEn: If you put all these people to death, leaving none alive, the nations who have heard this report about you will say,

verses.textZh: ‘因为耶和华不能把这民领进他向他们起誓应许的地，所以在旷野把他们杀了。’
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘因为耶和华不能把这民领进他向他们起誓应许的地，所以在旷野把他们杀了。’
verses.textZhCuv: 『耶和华因为不能把这百姓领进他向他们起誓应许之地，所以在旷野把他们杀了。』
verses.textEnNiv: ‘The Lord was not able to bring these people into the land he promised them on oath, so he slaughtered them in the wilderness.’
verses.textEnEsv: ‘It is because the Lord was not able to bring this people into the land that he swore to give to them that he has killed them in the wilderness.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Because the Lord was not able to bring this people to the land which He swore to give them, therefore He killed them in the wilderness.’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘The Lord was not able to bring them into the land he swore to give them, so he killed them in the wilderness.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Since the Lord could not bring this people into the land which He promised them by oath, He slaughtered them in the wilderness.’
verses.textEn: ‘The Lord was not able to bring these people into the land he promised them on oath, so he slaughtered them in the wilderness.’

verses.textZh: 现在求主大发能力，照着你说过的话：
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在求主大发能力，照着你说过的话：
verses.textZhCuv: 现在求主大显能力，照你所说过的话说：
verses.textEnNiv: "Now may the Lord’s strength be displayed, just as you have declared:
verses.textEnEsv: And now, please let the power of the Lord be great as you have promised, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And now, I pray, let the power of my Lord be great, just as You have spoken, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: "Please, Lord, prove that your power is as great as you have claimed. For you said,
verses.textEnNasb: So now, please, let the power of the Lord be great, just as You have declared, saying,
verses.textEn: "Now may the Lord’s strength be displayed, just as you have declared:

verses.textZh: ‘耶和华不轻易发怒，且有丰盛的慈爱；他赦免罪孽和过犯；绝不以有罪的为无罪，必追讨罪孽，自父到子，直到三四代。’
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘耶和华不轻易发怒，且有丰盛的慈爱；他赦免罪孽和过犯；绝不以有罪的为无罪，必追讨罪孽，自父到子，直到三四代。’
verses.textZhCuv: 『耶和华不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱，赦免罪孽和过犯；万不以有罪的为无罪，必追讨他的罪，自父及子，直到三、四代。』
verses.textEnNiv: ‘The Lord is slow to anger, abounding in love and forgiving sin and rebellion. Yet he does not leave the guilty unpunished; he punishes the children for the sin of the parents to the third and fourth generation.’
verses.textEnEsv: ‘The Lord is slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love, forgiving iniquity and transgression, but he will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, to the third and the fourth generation.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘The Lord is longsuffering and abundant in mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression; but He by no means clears theguilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children to the third and fourth generation.’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘The Lord is slow to anger and filled with unfailing love, forgiving every kind of sin and rebellion. But he does not excuse the guilty. He lays the sins of the parents upon their children; the entire family is affected—even children in the third and fourth generations.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘The Lord is slow to anger and abundant in mercy, forgiving wrongdoing and violation of His Law; but He will by no means leave the guilty unpunished, inflicting the punishment of the fathers on the children to the third and the fourth generations.’
verses.textEn: ‘The Lord is slow to anger, abounding in love and forgiving sin and rebellion. Yet he does not leave the guilty unpunished; he punishes the children for the sin of the parents to the third and fourth generation.’

verses.textZh: 求你照着你的大慈爱，饶恕这人民的罪孽，好象你从埃及直到现在，常赦免这人民一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你照着你的大慈爱，饶恕这人民的罪孽，好象你从埃及直到现在，常赦免这人民一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 求你照你的大慈爱赦免这百姓的罪孽，好像你从埃及到如今常赦免他们一样。」
verses.textEnNiv: In accordance with your great love, forgive the sin of these people, just as you have pardoned them from the time they left Egypt until now."
verses.textEnEsv: Please pardon the iniquity of this people, according to the greatness of your steadfast love, just as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt until now."
verses.textEnNkjv: Pardon the iniquity of this people, I pray, according to the greatness of Your mercy, just as You have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now."
verses.textEnNlt: In keeping with your magnificent, unfailing love, please pardon the sins of this people, just as you have forgiven them ever since they left Egypt."
verses.textEnNasb: Please forgive the guilt of this people in accordance with the greatness of Your mercy, just as You also have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now."
verses.textEn: In accordance with your great love, forgive the sin of these people, just as you have pardoned them from the time they left Egypt until now."

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："我就照着你的话，赦免他们；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："我就照着你的话，赦免他们；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「我照着你的话赦免了他们。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord replied, "I have forgiven them, as you asked.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said, "I have pardoned, according to your word.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said: "I have pardoned, according to your word;
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said, "I will pardon them as you have requested.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord said, "I have forgiven them in accordance with your word;
verses.textEn: The Lord replied, "I have forgiven them, as you asked.

verses.textZh: 但是，我指着我的永生起誓，全地要被耶和华的荣耀充满。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，我指着我的永生起誓，全地要被耶和华的荣耀充满。
verses.textZhCuv: 然我指着我的永生起誓，遍地要被我的荣耀充满。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, as surely as I live and as surely as the glory of the Lord fills the whole earth,
verses.textEnEsv: But truly, as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: but truly, as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the Lord—
verses.textEnNlt: But as surely as I live, and as surely as the earth is filled with the Lord ’s glory,
verses.textEnNasb: however, as I live, all the earth will be filled with the glory of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, as surely as I live and as surely as the glory of the Lord fills the whole earth,

verses.textZh: 这些见过我的荣耀，和我在埃及与旷野所行的神迹的人，仍然试探了我这十次，不听从我的话；
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些见过我的荣耀，和我在埃及与旷野所行的神迹的人，仍然试探了我这十次，不听从我的话；
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人虽看见我的荣耀和我在埃及与旷野所行的神迹，仍然试探我这十次，不听从我的话，
verses.textEnNiv: not one of those who saw my glory and the signs I performed in Egypt and in the wilderness but who disobeyed me and tested me ten times—
verses.textEnEsv: none of the men who have seen my glory and my signs that I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and yet have put me to the test these ten times and have not obeyed my voice,
verses.textEnNkjv: because all these men who have seen My glory and the signs which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have put Me to the test now these ten times, and have not heeded My voice,
verses.textEnNlt: not one of these people will ever enter that land. They have all seen my glorious presence and the miraculous signs I performed both in Egypt and in the wilderness, but again and again they have tested me by refusing to listen to my voice.
verses.textEnNasb: Certainly all the people who have seen My glory and My signs which I performed in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have put Me to the test these ten times and have not listened to My voice,
verses.textEn: not one of those who saw my glory and the signs I performed in Egypt and in the wilderness but who disobeyed me and tested me ten times—

verses.textZh: 他们决不得看见我向他们的祖宗起誓应许之地；藐视我的，一个也不能看见那地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们决不得看见我向他们的祖宗起誓应许之地；藐视我的，一个也不能看见那地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们断不得看见我向他们的祖宗所起誓应许之地。凡藐视我的，一个也不得看见；
verses.textEnNiv: not one of them will ever see the land I promised on oath to their ancestors. No one who has treated me with contempt will ever see it.
verses.textEnEsv: shall see the land that I swore to give to their fathers. And none of those who despised me shall see it.
verses.textEnNkjv: they certainly shall not see the land of which I swore to their fathers, nor shall any of those who rejected Me see it.
verses.textEnNlt: They will never even see the land I swore to give their ancestors. None of those who have treated me with contempt will ever see it.
verses.textEnNasb: shall by no means see the land which I swore to their fathers, nor shall any of those who were disrespectful to Me see it.
verses.textEn: not one of them will ever see the land I promised on oath to their ancestors. No one who has treated me with contempt will ever see it.

verses.textZh: 但是我的仆人迦勒，因他另有一个心志，专心跟从我，我必把他领进他去过的那地；他的子孙也必得着那地为业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是我的仆人迦勒，因他另有一个心志，专心跟从我，我必把他领进他去过的那地；他的子孙也必得着那地为业。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独我的仆人迦勒，因他另有一个心志，专一跟从我，我就把他领进他所去过的那地；他的后裔也必得那地为业。
verses.textEnNiv: But because my servant Caleb has a different spirit and follows me wholeheartedly, I will bring him into the land he went to, and his descendants will inherit it.
verses.textEnEsv: But my servant Caleb, because he has a different spirit and has followed me fully, I will bring into the land into which he went, and his descendants shall possess it.
verses.textEnNkjv: But My servant Caleb, because he has a different spirit in him and has followed Me fully, I will bring into the land where he went, and his descendants shall inherit it.
verses.textEnNlt: But my servant Caleb has a different attitude than the others have. He has remained loyal to me, so I will bring him into the land he explored. His descendants will possess their full share of that land.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for My servant Caleb, because he has had a different spirit and has followed Me fully, I will bring him into the land which he entered, and his descendants shall take possession of it.
verses.textEn: But because my servant Caleb has a different spirit and follows me wholeheartedly, I will bring him into the land he went to, and his descendants will inherit it.

verses.textZh: 现在亚玛力人和迦南人住在山谷中，明天你们要回转，从到红海路上，起行到旷野去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在亚玛力人和迦南人住在山谷中，明天你们要回转，从到红海路上，起行到旷野去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛力人和迦南人住在谷中，明天你们要转回，从红海的路往旷野去。」
verses.textEnNiv: Since the Amalekites and the Canaanites are living in the valleys, turn back tomorrow and set out toward the desert along the route to the Red Sea. "
verses.textEnEsv: Now, since the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwell in the valleys, turn tomorrow and set out for the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwell in the valley; tomorrow turn and move out into the wilderness by the Way of the Red Sea."
verses.textEnNlt: Now turn around, and don’t go on toward the land where the Amalekites and Canaanites live. Tomorrow you must set out for the wilderness in the direction of the Red Sea. "
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites live in the valleys; turn tomorrow and set out for the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea."
verses.textEn: Since the Amalekites and the Canaanites are living in the valleys, turn back tomorrow and set out toward the desert along the route to the Red Sea. "

verses.textZh: 耶和华吩咐摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华吩咐摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西、亚伦说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron:
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron again, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron:

verses.textZh: "这恶会众向我发怨言要到几时呢？以色列人向我所发的怨言，我都听见了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "这恶会众向我发怨言要到几时呢？以色列人向我所发的怨言，我都听见了。
verses.textZhCuv: 「这恶会众向我发怨言，我忍耐他们要到几时呢？以色列人向我所发的怨言，我都听见了。
verses.textEnNiv: "How long will this wicked community grumble against me? I have heard the complaints of these grumbling Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: "How long shall this wicked congregation grumble against me? I have heard the grumblings of the people of Israel, which they grumble against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "How long shallIbearwith this evil congregation who complain against Me? I have heard the complaints which the children of Israel make against Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "How long must I put up with this wicked community and its complaints about me? Yes, I have heard the complaints the Israelites are making against me.
verses.textEnNasb: "How long shall I put up with this evil congregation who are grumbling against Me? I have heard the complaints of the sons of Israel which they are voicing against Me.
verses.textEn: "How long will this wicked community grumble against me? I have heard the complaints of these grumbling Israelites.

verses.textZh: 你要对他们说：‘耶和华说，我指着我的永生起誓，我必照着你们所说给我听的，对待你们：
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要对他们说：‘耶和华说，我指着我的永生起誓，我必照着你们所说给我听的，对待你们：
verses.textZhCuv: 你们告诉他们，耶和华说：『我指着我的永生起誓，我必要照你们达到我耳中的话待你们。
verses.textEnNiv: So tell them, ‘As surely as I live, declares the Lord , I will do to you the very thing I heard you say:
verses.textEnEsv: Say to them, ‘As I live, declares the Lord , what you have said in my hearing I will do to you:
verses.textEnNkjv: Say to them, ‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘just as you have spoken in My hearing, so I will do to you:
verses.textEnNlt: Now tell them this: ‘As surely as I live, declares the Lord , I will do to you the very things I heard you say.
verses.textEnNasb: Say to them, ‘As I live,’ declares the Lord, ‘just as you have spoken in My hearing, so I will do to you;
verses.textEn: So tell them, ‘As surely as I live, declares the Lord , I will do to you the very thing I heard you say:

verses.textZh: 你们的尸体必倒在这旷野；你们中间被数点过的，就是按着你们的数目，从二十岁及以上，向我发过怨言的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的尸体必倒在这旷野；你们中间被数点过的，就是按着你们的数目，从二十岁及以上，向我发过怨言的，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的尸首必倒在这旷野，并且你们中间凡被数点、从二十岁以外、向我发怨言的，
verses.textEnNiv: In this wilderness your bodies will fall—every one of you twenty years old or more who was counted in the census and who has grumbled against me.
verses.textEnEsv: your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness, and of all your number, listed in the census from twenty years old and upward, who have grumbled against me,
verses.textEnNkjv: The carcasses of you who have complained against Me shall fall in this wilderness, all of you who were numbered, according to your entire number, from twenty years old and above.
verses.textEnNlt: You will all drop dead in this wilderness! Because you complained against me, every one of you who is twenty years old or older and was included in the registration will die.
verses.textEnNasb: your dead bodies will fall in this wilderness, all your numbered men according to your complete number from twenty years old and upward, who have grumbled against Me.
verses.textEn: In this wilderness your bodies will fall—every one of you twenty years old or more who was counted in the census and who has grumbled against me.

verses.textZh: 都不得进入我起誓给你们居住的那地；只有耶孚尼的儿子迦勒和嫩的儿子约书亚才可以进去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 都不得进入我起誓给你们居住的那地；只有耶孚尼的儿子迦勒和嫩的儿子约书亚才可以进去。
verses.textZhCuv: 必不得进我起誓应许叫你们住的那地；惟有耶孚尼的儿子迦勒和嫩的儿子约书亚才能进去。
verses.textEnNiv: Not one of you will enter the land I swore with uplifted hand to make your home, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
verses.textEnEsv: not one shall come into the land where I swore that I would make you dwell, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.textEnNkjv: Except for Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun, you shall by no means enter the land which I swore I would make you dwell in.
verses.textEnNlt: You will not enter and occupy the land I swore to give you. The only exceptions will be Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
verses.textEnNasb: By no means will you come into the land where I swore to settle you, except for Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.textEn: Not one of you will enter the land I swore with uplifted hand to make your home, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

verses.textZh: 但是你们的孩子，就是你们所说他们必被掳掠的，我要把他们领进去，他们必得着你们厌弃的那地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是你们的孩子，就是你们所说他们必被掳掠的，我要把他们领进去，他们必得着你们厌弃的那地。
verses.textZhCuv: 但你们的妇人孩子，就是你们所说、要被掳掠的，我必把他们领进去，他们就得知你们所厌弃的那地。
verses.textEnNiv: As for your children that you said would be taken as plunder, I will bring them in to enjoy the land you have rejected.
verses.textEnEsv: But your little ones, who you said would become a prey, I will bring in, and they shall know the land that you have rejected.
verses.textEnNkjv: But your little ones, whom you said would be victims, I will bring in, and they shall know the land which you have despised.
verses.textEnNlt: "‘You said your children would be carried off as plunder. Well, I will bring them safely into the land, and they will enjoy what you have despised.
verses.textEnNasb: Your children, however, whom you said would become plunder—I will bring them in, and they will know the land which you have rejected.
verses.textEn: As for your children that you said would be taken as plunder, I will bring them in to enjoy the land you have rejected.

verses.textZh: 至于你们，你们的尸体必倒在这旷野。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你们，你们的尸体必倒在这旷野。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于你们，你们的尸首必倒在这旷野；
verses.textEnNiv: But as for you, your bodies will fall in this wilderness.
verses.textEnEsv: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: But asfor you, your carcasses shall fall in this wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: But as for you, you will drop dead in this wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for you, your dead bodies will fall in this wilderness.
verses.textEn: But as for you, your bodies will fall in this wilderness.

verses.textZh: 你们的儿女必在旷野飘流四十年，担当你们背信之罪，直到你们的尸体在旷野都灭尽了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的儿女必在旷野飘流四十年，担当你们背信之罪，直到你们的尸体在旷野都灭尽了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的儿女必在旷野飘流四十年，担当你们淫行的罪，直到你们的尸首在旷野消灭。
verses.textEnNiv: Your children will be shepherds here for forty years, suffering for your unfaithfulness, until the last of your bodies lies in the wilderness.
verses.textEnEsv: And your children shall be shepherds in the wilderness forty years and shall suffer for your faithlessness, until the last of your dead bodies lies in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: And your sons shall be shepherds in the wilderness forty years, and bear the brunt of your infidelity, until your carcasses are consumed in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: And your children will be like shepherds, wandering in the wilderness for forty years. In this way, they will pay for your faithlessness, until the last of you lies dead in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: Also, your sons will be shepherds in the wilderness for forty years, and they will suffer for your unfaithfulness, until your bodies perish in the wilderness.
verses.textEn: Your children will be shepherds here for forty years, suffering for your unfaithfulness, until the last of your bodies lies in the wilderness.

verses.textZh: 照着你们窥探那地的日数共四十天，一天算一年，你们要担当罪孽四十年，你们就知道我为甚么与你们作对。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 照着你们窥探那地的日数共四十天，一天算一年，你们要担当罪孽四十年，你们就知道我为甚么与你们作对。’
verses.textZhCuv: 按你们窥探那地的四十日，一年顶一日，你们要担当罪孽四十年，就知道我与你们疏远了，
verses.textEnNiv: For forty years—one year for each of the forty days you explored the land—you will suffer for your sins and know what it is like to have me against you.’
verses.textEnEsv: According to the number of the days in which you spied out the land, forty days, a year for each day, you shall bear your iniquity forty years, and you shall know my displeasure.’
verses.textEnNkjv: According to the number of the days in which you spied out the land, forty days, for each day you shall bear your guilt one year, namely forty years, and you shall know My rejection.
verses.textEnNlt: "‘Because your men explored the land for forty days, you must wander in the wilderness for forty years—a year for each day, suffering the consequences of your sins. Then you will discover what it is like to have me for an enemy.’
verses.textEnNasb: In accordance with the number of days that you spied out the land, forty days, for every day you shall suffer the punishment for your guilt a year, that is, forty years, and you will know My opposition.
verses.textEn: For forty years—one year for each of the forty days you explored the land—you will suffer for your sins and know what it is like to have me against you.’

verses.textZh: 我耶和华已经说了，我必要这样对待这聚集反抗我的恶会众；他们要在这旷野灭尽，在这里死亡。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我耶和华已经说了，我必要这样对待这聚集反抗我的恶会众；他们要在这旷野灭尽，在这里死亡。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我－耶和华说过，我总要这样待这一切聚集敌我的恶会众；他们必在这旷野消灭，在这里死亡。』」
verses.textEnNiv: I, the Lord , have spoken, and I will surely do these things to this whole wicked community, which has banded together against me. They will meet their end in this wilderness; here they will die."
verses.textEnEsv: I, the Lord , have spoken. Surely this will I do to all this wicked congregation who are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall come to a full end, and there they shall die."
verses.textEnNkjv: I the Lord have spoken this. I will surely do so to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against Me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I, the Lord , have spoken! I will certainly do these things to every member of the community who has conspired against me. They will be destroyed here in this wilderness, and here they will die!"
verses.textEnNasb: I, the Lord, have spoken, I certainly will do this to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against Me. They shall be worn out in this wilderness, and there they shall die.’ "
verses.textEn: I, the Lord , have spoken, and I will surely do these things to this whole wicked community, which has banded together against me. They will meet their end in this wilderness; here they will die."

verses.textZh: 摩西派去窥探那地的人回来，因为带回有关那地的恶信，以致全体会众都向摩西发怨言，
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西派去窥探那地的人回来，因为带回有关那地的恶信，以致全体会众都向摩西发怨言，
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西所打发、窥探那地的人回来，报那地的恶信，叫全会众向摩西发怨言，
verses.textEnNiv: So the men Moses had sent to explore the land, who returned and made the whole community grumble against him by spreading a bad report about it—
verses.textEnEsv: And the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation grumble against him by bringing up a bad report about the land—
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation complain against him by bringing a bad report of the land,
verses.textEnNlt: The ten men Moses had sent to explore the land—the ones who incited rebellion against the Lord with their bad report—
verses.textEnNasb: As for the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, and who returned and led all the congregation to grumble against him by bringing a bad report about the land,
verses.textEn: So the men Moses had sent to explore the land, who returned and made the whole community grumble against him by spreading a bad report about it—

verses.textZh: 这些带回有关那地的恶信的人，都遭受瘟疫死在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些带回有关那地的恶信的人，都遭受瘟疫死在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些报恶信的人都遭瘟疫，死在耶和华面前。
verses.textEnNiv: these men who were responsible for spreading the bad report about the land were struck down and died of a plague before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: the men who brought up a bad report of the land— died by plague before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: those very men who brought the evil report about the land, died by the plague before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: were struck dead with a plague before the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: those men who brought the bad report of the land also died by a plague in the presence of the Lord.
verses.textEn: these men who were responsible for spreading the bad report about the land were struck down and died of a plague before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 在那些去窥探那地的人之中，只有嫩的儿子约书亚和耶孚尼的儿子迦勒，仍然活着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那些去窥探那地的人之中，只有嫩的儿子约书亚和耶孚尼的儿子迦勒，仍然活着。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中惟有嫩的儿子约书亚和耶孚尼的儿子迦勒仍然存活。
verses.textEnNiv: Of the men who went to explore the land, only Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh survived.
verses.textEnEsv: Of those men who went to spy out the land, only Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive, of the men who went to spy out the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Of the twelve who had explored the land, only Joshua and Caleb remained alive.
verses.textEnNasb: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive out of those men who went to spy out the land.
verses.textEn: Of the men who went to explore the land, only Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh survived.

verses.textZh: 摩西把这些话告诉以色列众人，他们就非常悲哀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西把这些话告诉以色列众人，他们就非常悲哀。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西将这些话告诉以色列众人，他们就甚悲哀。
verses.textEnNiv: When Moses reported this to all the Israelites, they mourned bitterly.
verses.textEnEsv: When Moses told these words to all the people of Israel, the people mourned greatly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.
verses.textEnNlt: When Moses reported the Lord ’s words to all the Israelites, the people were filled with grief.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Moses spoke these words to all the sons of Israel, the people mourned greatly.
verses.textEn: When Moses reported this to all the Israelites, they mourned bitterly.

verses.textZh: 他们清早起来，上山顶去，说："我们在这里；我们要上耶和华应许的地方去，因为我们犯了罪。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们清早起来，上山顶去，说："我们在这里；我们要上耶和华应许的地方去，因为我们犯了罪。"
verses.textZhCuv: 清早起来，上山顶去，说：「我们在这里，我们有罪了；情愿上耶和华所应许的地方去。」
verses.textEnNiv: Early the next morning they set out for the highest point in the hill country, saying, "Now we are ready to go up to the land the Lord promised. Surely we have sinned!"
verses.textEnEsv: And they rose early in the morning and went up to the heights of the hill country, saying, "Here we are. We will go up to the place that the Lord has promised, for we have sinned."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they rose early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, "Here we are, and we will go up to the place which the Lord has promised, for we have sinned!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then they got up early the next morning and went to the top of the range of hills. "Let’s go," they said. "We realize that we have sinned, but now we are ready to enter the land the Lord has promised us."
verses.textEnNasb: In the morning, however, they got up early and went up to the ridge of the hill country, saying, "Here we are; and we will go up to the place which the Lord has promised, for we have sinned."
verses.textEn: Early the next morning they set out for the highest point in the hill country, saying, "Now we are ready to go up to the land the Lord promised. Surely we have sinned!"

verses.textZh: 摩西说："你们为甚么又违背耶和华的命令呢？这事必不能成功。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西说："你们为甚么又违背耶和华的命令呢？这事必不能成功。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西说：「你们为何违背耶和华的命令呢？这事不能顺利了。
verses.textEnNiv: But Moses said, "Why are you disobeying the Lord ’s command? This will not succeed!
verses.textEnEsv: But Moses said, "Why now are you transgressing the command of the Lord , when that will not succeed?
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said, "Now why do you transgress the command of the Lord? For this will not succeed.
verses.textEnNlt: But Moses said, "Why are you now disobeying the Lord ’s orders to return to the wilderness? It won’t work.
verses.textEnNasb: But Moses said, "Why then are you violating the command of the Lord, when doing so will not succeed?
verses.textEn: But Moses said, "Why are you disobeying the Lord ’s command? This will not succeed!

verses.textZh: 你们不要上去，因为耶和华不在你们中间，免得你们在仇敌面前被杀败。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不要上去，因为耶和华不在你们中间，免得你们在仇敌面前被杀败。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要上去；因为耶和华不在你们中间，恐怕你们被仇敌杀败了。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not go up, because the Lord is not with you. You will be defeated by your enemies,
verses.textEnEsv: Do not go up, for the Lord is not among you, lest you be struck down before your enemies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not go up, lest you be defeated by your enemies, for the Lordis not among you.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not go up into the land now. You will only be crushed by your enemies because the Lord is not with you.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not go up, for the Lord is not among you, to prevent you from being defeated by your enemies.
verses.textEn: Do not go up, because the Lord is not with you. You will be defeated by your enemies,

verses.textZh: 因为亚玛力人和迦南人都在那里，在你们面前，你们必倒在刀下；因为你们转离不跟随耶和华，耶和华不与你们同在。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为亚玛力人和迦南人都在那里，在你们面前，你们必倒在刀下；因为你们转离不跟随耶和华，耶和华不与你们同在。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛力人和迦南人都在你们面前，你们必倒在刀下；因你们退回不跟从耶和华，所以他必不与你们同在。」
verses.textEnNiv: for the Amalekites and the Canaanites will face you there. Because you have turned away from the Lord , he will not be with you and you will fall by the sword."
verses.textEnEsv: For there the Amalekites and the Canaanites are facing you, and you shall fall by the sword. Because you have turned back from following the Lord , the Lord will not be with you."
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and you shall fall by the sword; because you have turned away from the Lord, the Lord will not be with you."
verses.textEnNlt: When you face the Amalekites and Canaanites in battle, you will be slaughtered. The Lord will abandon you because you have abandoned the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites will be there to confront you, and you will fall by the sword, since you have turned back from following the Lord. And the Lord will not be with you."
verses.textEn: for the Amalekites and the Canaanites will face you there. Because you have turned away from the Lord , he will not be with you and you will fall by the sword."

verses.textZh: 他们却擅自上山顶去，但是耶和华的约柜和摩西并没有离开营地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们却擅自上山顶去，但是耶和华的约柜和摩西并没有离开营地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却擅敢上山顶去，然而耶和华的约柜和摩西没有出营。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, in their presumption they went up toward the highest point in the hill country, though neither Moses nor the ark of the Lord ’s covenant moved from the camp.
verses.textEnEsv: But they presumed to go up to the heights of the hill country, although neither the ark of the covenant of the Lord nor Moses departed out of the camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they presumed to go up to the mountaintop. Nevertheless, neither the ark of the covenant of the Lord nor Moses departed from the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: But the people defiantly pushed ahead toward the hill country, even though neither Moses nor the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant left the camp.
verses.textEnNasb: But they foolishly dared to go up to the ridge of the hill country; neither the ark of the covenant of the Lord nor Moses left the camp.
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, in their presumption they went up toward the highest point in the hill country, though neither Moses nor the ark of the Lord ’s covenant moved from the camp.

verses.textZh: 于是，亚玛力人和住在那山上的迦南人就下来，击杀他们，粉碎他们，直到何珥玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，亚玛力人和住在那山上的迦南人就下来，击杀他们，粉碎他们，直到何珥玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是亚玛力人和住在那山上的迦南人都下来击打他们，把他们杀退了，直到何珥玛。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Amalekites and the Canaanites who lived in that hill country came down and attacked them and beat them down all the way to Hormah.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Amalekites and the Canaanites who lived in that hill country came down and defeated them and pursued them, even to Hormah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Amalekites and the Canaanites who dwelt in that mountain came down and attacked them, and drove them back as far as Hormah.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Amalekites and the Canaanites who lived in those hills came down and attacked them and chased them back as far as Hormah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Amalekites and the Canaanites who lived in that hill country came down, and struck them and scattered them as far as Hormah.
verses.textEn: Then the Amalekites and the Canaanites who lived in that hill country came down and attacked them and beat them down all the way to Hormah.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord told Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉以色列人：你们进入我赐给你们居住之地的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉以色列人：你们进入我赐给你们居住之地的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你晓谕以色列人说：你们到了我所赐给你们居住的地，
verses.textEnNiv: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘After you enter the land I am giving you as a home
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel and say to them, When you come into the land you are to inhabit, which I am giving you,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘When you have come into the land you are to inhabit, which I am giving to you,
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. "When you finally settle in the land I am giving you,
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘When you enter the land where you are going to live, which I am giving you,
verses.textEn: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘After you enter the land I am giving you as a home

verses.textZh: 如果要从牛群或羊群，拿牛羊作火祭献给耶和华，无论是燔祭，或是其他的祭，为要还特许的愿，或是作甘心的祭，或是在你们的节期献上的，都要献给耶和华作为馨香的祭；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果要从牛群或羊群，拿牛羊作火祭献给耶和华，无论是燔祭，或是其他的祭，为要还特许的愿，或是作甘心的祭，或是在你们的节期献上的，都要献给耶和华作为馨香的祭；
verses.textZhCuv: 若愿意从牛群羊群中取牛羊作火祭，献给耶和华，无论是燔祭是平安祭，为要还特许的愿，或是作甘心祭，或是逢你们节期献的，都要奉给耶和华为馨香之祭。
verses.textEnNiv: and you present to the Lord food offerings from the herd or the flock, as an aroma pleasing to the Lord —whether burnt offerings or sacrifices, for special vows or freewill offerings or festival offerings—
verses.textEnEsv: and you offer to the Lord from the herd or from the flock a food offering or a burnt offering or a sacrifice, to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering or at your appointed feasts, to make a pleasing aroma to the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: and you make an offering by fire to the Lord, a burnt offering or a sacrifice, to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering or in your appointed feasts, to make a sweet aroma to the Lord, from the herd or the flock,
verses.textEnNlt: you will offer special gifts as a pleasing aroma to the Lord . These gifts may take the form of a burnt offering, a sacrifice to fulfill a vow, a voluntary offering, or an offering at any of your annual festivals, and they may be taken from your herds of cattle or your flocks of sheep and goats.
verses.textEnNasb: and you make an offering by fire to the Lord, a burnt offering or a sacrifice to fulfill a special vow, or as a voluntary offering or at your appointed times, to make a soothing aroma to the Lord from the herd or from the flock,
verses.textEn: and you present to the Lord food offerings from the herd or the flock, as an aroma pleasing to the Lord —whether burnt offerings or sacrifices, for special vows or freewill offerings or festival offerings—

verses.textZh: 那献供物的，要把一公斤细面和一公斤油调和作素祭，献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那献供物的，要把一公斤细面和一公斤油调和作素祭，献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 那献供物的就要将细面伊法十分之一，并油一欣四分之一，调和作素祭，献给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: then the person who brings an offering shall present to the Lord a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of olive oil.
verses.textEnEsv: then he who brings his offering shall offer to the Lord a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour, mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil;
verses.textEnNkjv: then he who presents his offering to the Lord shall bring a grain offering of one-tenth ofanephah of fine flour mixed with one-fourth of a hin of oil;
verses.textEnNlt: When you present these offerings, you must also give the Lord a grain offering of two quarts of choice flour mixed with one quart of olive oil.
verses.textEnNasb: then the one who presents his offering shall present to the Lord a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a fourth of a hin of oil,
verses.textEn: then the person who brings an offering shall present to the Lord a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of olive oil.

verses.textZh: 此外，无论是燔祭或是别的祭，为每只绵羊羔你要一同献上一公升作奠祭的酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 此外，无论是燔祭或是别的祭，为每只绵羊羔你要一同献上一公升作奠祭的酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 无论是燔祭是平安祭，你要为每只绵羊羔，一同预备奠祭的酒一欣四分之一。
verses.textEnNiv: With each lamb for the burnt offering or the sacrifice, prepare a quarter of a hin of wine as a drink offering.
verses.textEnEsv: and you shall offer with the burnt offering, or for the sacrifice, a quarter of a hin of wine for the drink offering for each lamb.
verses.textEnNkjv: and one-fourth of a hin of wine as a drink offering you shall prepare with the burnt offering or the sacrifice, for each lamb.
verses.textEnNlt: For each lamb offered as a burnt offering or a special sacrifice, you must also present one quart of wine as a liquid offering.
verses.textEnNasb: and you shall prepare wine for the drink offering, a fourth of a hin, with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.
verses.textEn: With each lamb for the burnt offering or the sacrifice, prepare a quarter of a hin of wine as a drink offering.

verses.textZh: 或是为每只公绵羊，你要一同献上两公斤细面，用一公升半油调和作素祭；
verses.textZhCnvs: 或是为每只公绵羊，你要一同献上两公斤细面，用一公升半油调和作素祭；
verses.textZhCuv: 为公绵羊预备细面伊法十分之二，并油一欣三分之一，调和作素祭，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘With a ram prepare a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a third of a hin of olive oil,
verses.textEnEsv: Or for a ram, you shall offer for a grain offering two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a third of a hin of oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: Or for a ram you shall prepare as a grain offering two-tenths ofanephah of fine flour mixed with one-third of a hin of oil;
verses.textEnNlt: "If the sacrifice is a ram, give a grain offering of four quarts of choice flour mixed with a third of a gallon of olive oil,
verses.textEnNasb: Or for a ram you shall prepare as a grain offering two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a third of a hin of oil;
verses.textEn: " ‘With a ram prepare a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a third of a hin of olive oil,

verses.textZh: 你也要用一公升半酒作奠祭，献给耶和华作馨香的祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你也要用一公升半酒作奠祭，献给耶和华作馨香的祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用酒一欣三分之一作奠祭，献给耶和华为馨香之祭。
verses.textEnNiv: and a third of a hin of wine as a drink offering. Offer it as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And for the drink offering you shall offer a third of a hin of wine, a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: and as a drink offering you shall offer one-third of a hin of wine as a sweet aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: and give a third of a gallon of wine as a liquid offering. This will be a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: and for the drink offering you shall offer a third of a hin of wine as a soothing aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEn: and a third of a hin of wine as a drink offering. Offer it as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你若是预备公牛犊作燔祭，或是别的祭，为要还特许的愿，或是作平安祭，献给耶和华，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若是预备公牛犊作燔祭，或是别的祭，为要还特许的愿，或是作平安祭，献给耶和华，
verses.textZhCuv: 你预备公牛作燔祭，或是作平安祭，为要还特许的愿，或是作平安祭，献给耶和华，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘When you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering or sacrifice, for a special vow or a fellowship offering to the Lord ,
verses.textEnEsv: And when you offer a bull as a burnt offering or sacrifice, to fulfill a vow or for peace offerings to the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering, or as a sacrifice to fulfill a vow, or as a peace offering to the Lord,
verses.textEnNlt: "When you present a young bull as a burnt offering or as a sacrifice to fulfill a vow or as a peace offering to the Lord ,
verses.textEnNasb: And when you prepare a bull as a burnt offering or a sacrifice, to fulfill a special vow, or for peace offerings to the Lord,
verses.textEn: " ‘When you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering or sacrifice, for a special vow or a fellowship offering to the Lord ,

verses.textZh: 就要把三公斤细面，用两公升油调和作素祭，和公牛犊一同献上；
verses.textZhCnvs: 就要把三公斤细面，用两公升油调和作素祭，和公牛犊一同献上；
verses.textZhCuv: 就要把细面伊法十分之三，并油半欣，调和作素祭，和公牛一同献上，
verses.textEnNiv: bring with the bull a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with half a hin of olive oil,
verses.textEnEsv: then one shall offer with the bull a grain offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour, mixed with half a hin of oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: then shall be offered with the young bull a grain offering of three-tenths ofanephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;
verses.textEnNlt: you must also give a grain offering of six quarts of choice flour mixed with two quarts of olive oil,
verses.textEnNasb: then you shall offer with the bull a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;
verses.textEn: bring with the bull a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with half a hin of olive oil,

verses.textZh: 也要用两公升酒作奠祭，献给耶和华为馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也要用两公升酒作奠祭，献给耶和华为馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用酒半欣作奠祭，献给耶和华为馨香的火祭。
verses.textEnNiv: and also bring half a hin of wine as a drink offering. This will be a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, as a food offering, a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: and you shall bring as the drink offering half a hin of wine as an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: and give two quarts of wine as a liquid offering. This will be a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: and you shall offer as the drink offering half a hin of wine as an offering by fire, as a soothing aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEn: and also bring half a hin of wine as a drink offering. This will be a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

verses.textZh: "献一头公牛，或一只公绵羊，或一只绵羊羔，或一只山羊羔，都要这样办理。
verses.textZhCnvs: "献一头公牛，或一只公绵羊，或一只绵羊羔，或一只山羊羔，都要这样办理。
verses.textZhCuv: 「献公牛、公绵羊、绵羊羔、山羊羔，每只都要这样办理。
verses.textEnNiv: Each bull or ram, each lamb or young goat, is to be prepared in this manner.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus it shall be done for each bull or ram, or for each lamb or young goat.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus it shall be done for each young bull, for each ram, or for each lamb or young goat.
verses.textEnNlt: "Each sacrifice of a bull, ram, lamb, or young goat should be prepared in this way.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is how it shall be done for each ox, or for each ram, or for each of the male lambs, or of the goats.
verses.textEn: Each bull or ram, each lamb or young goat, is to be prepared in this manner.

verses.textZh: 照着你们预备的数目，每只都要这样办理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照着你们预备的数目，每只都要这样办理。
verses.textZhCuv: 照你们所预备的数目，按着只数都要这样办理。
verses.textEnNiv: Do this for each one, for as many as you prepare.
verses.textEnEsv: As many as you offer, so shall you do with each one, as many as there are.
verses.textEnNkjv: According to the number that you prepare, so you shall do with everyone according to their number.
verses.textEnNlt: Follow these instructions with each offering you present.
verses.textEnNasb: According to the number that you prepare, so you shall do for each one according to their number.
verses.textEn: Do this for each one, for as many as you prepare.

verses.textZh: 本地人献馨香的火祭给耶和华，都要这样办理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 本地人献馨香的火祭给耶和华，都要这样办理。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡本地人将馨香的火祭献给耶和华，都要这样办理。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Everyone who is native-born must do these things in this way when they present a food offering as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Every native Israelite shall do these things in this way, in offering a food offering, with a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: All who are native-born shall do these things in this manner, in presenting an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: All of you native-born Israelites must follow these instructions when you offer a special gift as a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Everyone who is a native shall do these things in this way, in presenting an offering by fire as a soothing aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEn: " ‘Everyone who is native-born must do these things in this way when they present a food offering as an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 如果有外人与你们同住，或有人世世代代住在你们中间的，要献馨香的火祭给耶和华；你们怎样办理，他也要怎样办理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有外人与你们同住，或有人世世代代住在你们中间的，要献馨香的火祭给耶和华；你们怎样办理，他也要怎样办理。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有外人和你们同居，或有人世世代代住在你们中间，愿意将馨香的火祭献给耶和华，你们怎样办理，他也要照样办理。
verses.textEnNiv: For the generations to come, whenever a foreigner or anyone else living among you presents a food offering as an aroma pleasing to the Lord , they must do exactly as you do.
verses.textEnEsv: And if a stranger is sojourning with you, or anyone is living permanently among you, and he wishes to offer a food offering, with a pleasing aroma to the Lord , he shall do as you do.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if a stranger dwells with you, or whoever is among you throughout your generations, and would present an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the Lord, just as you do, so shall he do.
verses.textEnNlt: And if any foreigners visit you or live among you and want to present a special gift as a pleasing aroma to the Lord , they must follow these same procedures.
verses.textEnNasb: Now if a stranger resides among you, or one who may be among you throughout your generations, and he wants to make an offering by fire, as a soothing aroma to the Lord, just as you do so shall he do.
verses.textEn: For the generations to come, whenever a foreigner or anyone else living among you presents a food offering as an aroma pleasing to the Lord , they must do exactly as you do.

verses.textZh: 至于会众，无论是你们，或是与你们同住的外人，都一样的规例，作你们世世代代永远的规例；在耶和华面前，你们怎样，寄居的人也怎样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于会众，无论是你们，或是与你们同住的外人，都一样的规例，作你们世世代代永远的规例；在耶和华面前，你们怎样，寄居的人也怎样。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于会众，你们和同居的外人都归一例，作为你们世世代代永远的定例，在耶和华面前，你们怎样，寄居的也要怎样。
verses.textEnNiv: The community is to have the same rules for you and for the foreigner residing among you; this is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come. You and the foreigner shall be the same before the Lord :
verses.textEnEsv: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who sojourns with you, a statute forever throughout your generations. You and the sojourner shall be alike before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: One ordinance shallbe for you of the assembly and for the stranger who dwells withyou, an ordinance forever throughout your generations; as you are, so shall the stranger be before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Native-born Israelites and foreigners are equal before the Lord and are subject to the same decrees. This is a permanent law for you, to be observed from generation to generation.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who resides among you, a permanent statute throughout your generations; as you are, so shall the stranger be before the Lord.
verses.textEn: The community is to have the same rules for you and for the foreigner residing among you; this is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come. You and the foreigner shall be the same before the Lord :

verses.textZh: 你们和住在你们中间的外人，都只有一样的法规，一样的典章。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们和住在你们中间的外人，都只有一样的法规，一样的典章。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们并与你们同居的外人当有一样的条例，一样的典章。」
verses.textEnNiv: The same laws and regulations will apply both to you and to the foreigner residing among you.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: One law and one rule shall be for you and for the stranger who sojourns with you."
verses.textEnNkjv: One law and one custom shall be for you and for the stranger who dwells with you.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: The same instructions and regulations will apply both to you and to the foreigners living among you."
verses.textEnNasb: There is to be one law and one ordinance for you and for the stranger who resides with you.’ "
verses.textEn: The same laws and regulations will apply both to you and to the foreigner residing among you.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Again the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉以色列人：你们到了我领你们进去的那地，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉以色列人：你们到了我领你们进去的那地，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你晓谕以色列人说：你们到了我所领你们进去的那地，
verses.textEnNiv: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you enter the land to which I am taking you
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel and say to them, When you come into the land to which I bring you
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘When you come into the land to which I bring you,
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. "When you arrive in the land where I am taking you,
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘When you enter the land where I am bringing you,
