verses.textEn: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you enter the land to which I am taking you

verses.textZh: 吃那地的粮食的时候，就要把举祭献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吃那地的粮食的时候，就要把举祭献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 吃那地的粮食，就要把举祭献给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: and you eat the food of the land, present a portion as an offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: and when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall present a contribution to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: then it will be, when you eat of the bread of the land, that you shall offer up a heave offering to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: and you eat the crops that grow there, you must set some aside as a sacred offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: then it shall be, that when you eat from the food of the land, you shall lift up an offering to the Lord.
verses.textEn: and you eat the food of the land, present a portion as an offering to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们要用初熟的麦面作饼当举祭献上，你们献时，好象献上禾场的举祭一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要用初熟的麦面作饼当举祭献上，你们献时，好象献上禾场的举祭一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要用初熟的麦子磨面，做饼当举祭奉献；你们举上，好像举禾场的举祭一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Present a loaf from the first of your ground meal and present it as an offering from the threshing floor.
verses.textEnEsv: Of the first of your dough you shall present a loaf as a contribution; like a contribution from the threshing floor, so shall you present it.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall offer up a cake of the first of your ground meal as a heave offering; as a heave offering of the threshing floor, so shall you offer it up.
verses.textEnNlt: Present a cake from the first of the flour you grind, and set it aside as a sacred offering, as you do with the first grain from the threshing floor.
verses.textEnNasb: Of the first of your dough you shall lift up a loaf as an offering; as an offering of the threshing floor, so you shall lift it up.
verses.textEn: Present a loaf from the first of your ground meal and present it as an offering from the threshing floor.

verses.textZh: 你们世世代代要把初熟的麦面作举祭献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们世世代代要把初熟的麦面作举祭献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们世世代代要用初熟的麦子磨面，当举祭献给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Throughout the generations to come you are to give this offering to the Lord from the first of your ground meal.
verses.textEnEsv: Some of the first of your dough you shall give to the Lord as a contribution throughout your generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the first of your ground meal you shall give to the Lord a heave offering throughout your generations.
verses.textEnNlt: Throughout the generations to come, you are to present a sacred offering to the Lord each year from the first of your ground flour.
verses.textEnNasb: From the first of your dough you shall give to the Lord an offering throughout your generations.
verses.textEn: Throughout the generations to come you are to give this offering to the Lord from the first of your ground meal.

verses.textZh: "如果你们作错了事，没有守耶和华吩咐摩西的这一切命令，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你们作错了事，没有守耶和华吩咐摩西的这一切命令，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们有错误的时候，不守耶和华所晓谕摩西的这一切命令，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Now if you as a community unintentionally fail to keep any of these commands the Lord gave Moses—
verses.textEnEsv: "But if you sin unintentionally, and do not observe all these commandments that the Lord has spoken to Moses,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If you sin unintentionally, and do not observe all these commandments which the Lord has spoken to Moses—
verses.textEnNlt: "But suppose you unintentionally fail to carry out all these commands that the Lord has given you through Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘But when you unintentionally do wrong and fail to comply with all these commandments which the Lord has spoken to Moses,
verses.textEn: " ‘Now if you as a community unintentionally fail to keep any of these commands the Lord gave Moses—

verses.textZh: 就是耶和华藉摩西吩咐你们的一切事，从耶和华吩咐的那一天起，直到你们的世世代代；
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是耶和华藉摩西吩咐你们的一切事，从耶和华吩咐的那一天起，直到你们的世世代代；
verses.textZhCuv: 就是耶和华藉摩西一切所吩咐你们的，自那日以至你们的世世代代，
verses.textEnNiv: any of the Lord ’s commands to you through him, from the day the Lord gave them and continuing through the generations to come—
verses.textEnEsv: all that the Lord has commanded you by Moses, from the day that the Lord gave commandment, and onward throughout your generations,
verses.textEnNkjv: all that the Lord has commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day the Lord gave commandment and onward throughout your generations—
verses.textEnNlt: And suppose your descendants in the future fail to do everything the Lord has commanded through Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: that is, all that the Lord has commanded you through Moses from the day that the Lord gave commandments and onward, throughout your generations,
verses.textEn: any of the Lord ’s commands to you through him, from the day the Lord gave them and continuing through the generations to come—

verses.textZh: 如果有无心之失，是会众不知道的，全体会众就要把一头公牛犊作燔祭，作为献给耶和华馨香的祭，并且照着规章把素祭和奠祭一同献上，又献一只公山羊作赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有无心之失，是会众不知道的，全体会众就要把一头公牛犊作燔祭，作为献给耶和华馨香的祭，并且照着规章把素祭和奠祭一同献上，又献一只公山羊作赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有误行，是会众所不知道的，后来全会众就要将一只公牛犊作燔祭，并照典章把素祭和奠祭一同献给耶和华为馨香之祭，又献一只公山羊作赎罪祭。
verses.textEnNiv: and if this is done unintentionally without the community being aware of it, then the whole community is to offer a young bull for a burnt offering as an aroma pleasing to the Lord , along with its prescribed grain offering and drink offering, and a male goat for a sin offering.
verses.textEnEsv: then if it was done unintentionally without the knowledge of the congregation, all the congregation shall offer one bull from the herd for a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma to the Lord , with its grain offering and its drink offering, according to the rule, and one male goat for a sin offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: then it will be, if it is unintentionally committed, without the knowledge of the congregation, that the whole congregation shall offer one young bull as a burnt offering, as a sweet aroma to the Lord, with its grain offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one kid of the goats as a sin offering.
verses.textEnNlt: If the mistake was made unintentionally, and the community was unaware of it, the whole community must present a young bull for a burnt offering as a pleasing aroma to the Lord . It must be offered along with its prescribed grain offering and liquid offering and with one male goat for a sin offering.
verses.textEnNasb: then it shall be, if it is done unintentionally, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one bull as a burnt offering, as a soothing aroma to the Lord, with its grain offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one male goat as a sin offering.
verses.textEn: and if this is done unintentionally without the community being aware of it, then the whole community is to offer a young bull for a burnt offering as an aroma pleasing to the Lord , along with its prescribed grain offering and drink offering, and a male goat for a sin offering.

verses.textZh: 祭司要为以色列全体会众赎罪，他们就必蒙赦免；因为这是无心之失，他们又因自己的无心之失，把供物，就是献给耶和华的火祭和赎罪祭，一起奉到耶和华面前，
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要为以色列全体会众赎罪，他们就必蒙赦免；因为这是无心之失，他们又因自己的无心之失，把供物，就是献给耶和华的火祭和赎罪祭，一起奉到耶和华面前，
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要为以色列全会众赎罪，他们就必蒙赦免，因为这是错误。他们又因自己的错误，把供物，就是向耶和华献的火祭和赎罪祭，一并奉到耶和华面前。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest is to make atonement for the whole Israelite community, and they will be forgiven, for it was not intentional and they have presented to the Lord for their wrong a food offering and a sin offering.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the people of Israel, and they shall be forgiven, because it was a mistake, and they have brought their offering, a food offering to the Lord , and their sin offering before the Lord for their mistake.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the priest shall make atonement for the whole congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them, for it was unintentional; they shall bring their offering, an offering made by fire to the Lord, and their sin offering before the Lord, for their unintended sin.
verses.textEnNlt: With it the priest will purify the whole community of Israel, making them right with the Lord , and they will be forgiven. For it was an unintentional sin, and they have corrected it with their offerings to the Lord —the special gift and the sin offering.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the sons of Israel, and they will be forgiven; for it was an unintentional wrong, and they have brought their offering, an offering by fire to the Lord, and their sin offering before the Lord, for their unintentional wrong.
verses.textEn: The priest is to make atonement for the whole Israelite community, and they will be forgiven, for it was not intentional and they have presented to the Lord for their wrong a food offering and a sin offering.

verses.textZh: 以色列全体会众和寄居在他们中间的外人，就必蒙赦免，因为全体人民都犯了无心之失。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列全体会众和寄居在他们中间的外人，就必蒙赦免，因为全体人民都犯了无心之失。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列全会众和寄居在他们中间的外人就必蒙赦免，因为这罪是百姓误犯的。
verses.textEnNiv: The whole Israelite community and the foreigners residing among them will be forgiven, because all the people were involved in the unintentional wrong.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the congregation of the people of Israel shall be forgiven, and the stranger who sojourns among them, because the whole population was involved in the mistake.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be forgiven the whole congregation of the children of Israel and the stranger who dwells among them, because all the people didit unintentionally.
verses.textEnNlt: The whole community of Israel will be forgiven, including the foreigners living among you, for all the people were involved in the sin.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the congregation of the sons of Israel will be forgiven, as well as the stranger who resides among them, for guilt was attributed to all the people through an unintentional wrong.
verses.textEn: The whole Israelite community and the foreigners residing among them will be forgiven, because all the people were involved in the unintentional wrong.

verses.textZh: "如果一个人误犯了罪，他就要献一只一岁的母山羊作赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果一个人误犯了罪，他就要献一只一岁的母山羊作赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 「若有一个人误犯了罪，他就要献一岁的母山羊作赎罪祭。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But if just one person sins unintentionally, that person must bring a year-old female goat for a sin offering.
verses.textEnEsv: "If one person sins unintentionally, he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And if a person sins unintentionally, then he shall bring a female goat in its first year as a sin offering.
verses.textEnNlt: "If one individual commits an unintentional sin, the guilty person must bring a one-year-old female goat for a sin offering.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Also, if one person sins unintentionally, then he shall offer a one-year-old female goat as a sin offering.
verses.textEn: " ‘But if just one person sins unintentionally, that person must bring a year-old female goat for a sin offering.

verses.textZh: 祭司要在耶和华面前为那误犯的人赎罪，因为他犯罪是出于无心；祭司为他赎罪，他就必蒙赦免。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要在耶和华面前为那误犯的人赎罪，因为他犯罪是出于无心；祭司为他赎罪，他就必蒙赦免。
verses.textZhCuv: 那误行的人犯罪的时候，祭司要在耶和华面前为他赎罪，他就必蒙赦免。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest is to make atonement before the Lord for the one who erred by sinning unintentionally, and when atonement has been made, that person will be forgiven.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall make atonement before the Lord for the person who makes a mistake, when he sins unintentionally, to make atonement for him, and he shall be forgiven.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the priest shall make atonement for the person who sins unintentionally, when he sins unintentionally before the Lord, to make atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will sacrifice it to purify the guilty person before the Lord , and that person will be forgiven.
verses.textEnNasb: And the priest shall make atonement before the Lord for the person who goes astray by an unintentional sin, making atonement for him so that he may be forgiven.
verses.textEn: The priest is to make atonement before the Lord for the one who erred by sinning unintentionally, and when atonement has been made, that person will be forgiven.

verses.textZh: 对于犯了无心之失的人，无论是本地人或是寄居在他们中间的外人，都有一样的法例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对于犯了无心之失的人，无论是本地人或是寄居在他们中间的外人，都有一样的法例。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列中的本地人和寄居在他们中间的外人，若误行了什么事，必归一样的条例。
verses.textEnNiv: One and the same law applies to everyone who sins unintentionally, whether a native-born Israelite or a foreigner residing among you.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall have one law for him who does anything unintentionally, for him who is native among the people of Israel and for the stranger who sojourns among them.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall have one law for him who sins unintentionally, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel and for the stranger who dwells among them.
verses.textEnNlt: These same instructions apply both to native-born Israelites and to the foreigners living among you.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall have one law for the native among the sons of Israel and for the stranger who resides among them, for one who does anything wrong unintentionally.
verses.textEn: One and the same law applies to everyone who sins unintentionally, whether a native-born Israelite or a foreigner residing among you.

verses.textZh: 但那胆大妄为的人，无论是本地人或是寄居的，亵渎了耶和华，那人总要从民间剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但那胆大妄为的人，无论是本地人或是寄居的，亵渎了耶和华，那人总要从民间剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 但那擅敢行事的，无论是本地人是寄居的，他亵渎了耶和华，必从民中剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But anyone who sins defiantly, whether native-born or foreigner, blasphemes the Lord and must be cut off from the people of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: But the person who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native or a sojourner, reviles the Lord , and that person shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘But the person who does anything presumptuously, whetherheis native-born or a stranger, that one brings reproach on the Lord, and he shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.textEnNlt: "But those who brazenly violate the Lord ’s will, whether native-born Israelites or foreigners, have blasphemed the Lord , and they must be cut off from the community.
verses.textEnNasb: But the person who does wrong defiantly, whether he is a native or a stranger, that one is blaspheming the Lord; and that person shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.textEn: " ‘But anyone who sins defiantly, whether native-born or foreigner, blasphemes the Lord and must be cut off from the people of Israel.

verses.textZh: 因为他藐视耶和华的话，违犯耶和华的命令，那人必被剪除；他的罪孽要归到他身上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他藐视耶和华的话，违犯耶和华的命令，那人必被剪除；他的罪孽要归到他身上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因他藐视耶和华的言语，违背耶和华的命令，那人总要剪除；他的罪孽要归到他身上。」
verses.textEnNiv: Because they have despised the Lord ’s word and broken his commands, they must surely be cut off; their guilt remains on them.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Because he has despised the word of the Lord and has broken his commandment, that person shall be utterly cut off; his iniquity shall be on him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Because he has despised the word of the Lord, and has broken His commandment, that person shall be completely cut off; his guilt shallbe upon him.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Since they have treated the Lord ’s word with contempt and deliberately disobeyed his command, they must be completely cut off and suffer the punishment for their guilt."
verses.textEnNasb: Since he has despised the word of the Lord and has broken His commandment, that person shall be completely cut off; his guilt will be on him.’ "
verses.textEn: Because they have despised the Lord ’s word and broken his commands, they must surely be cut off; their guilt remains on them.’ "

verses.textZh: 以色列人在旷野的时候，有一个人在安息日捡柴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人在旷野的时候，有一个人在安息日捡柴。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人在旷野的时候，遇见一个人在安息日捡柴。
verses.textEnNiv: While the Israelites were in the wilderness, a man was found gathering wood on the Sabbath day.
verses.textEnEsv: While the people of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.
verses.textEnNlt: One day while the people of Israel were in the wilderness, they discovered a man gathering wood on the Sabbath day.
verses.textEnNasb: Now while the sons of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering wood on the Sabbath day.
verses.textEn: While the Israelites were in the wilderness, a man was found gathering wood on the Sabbath day.

verses.textZh: 遇见他捡柴的人，就把他带到摩西、亚伦和全体会众那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 遇见他捡柴的人，就把他带到摩西、亚伦和全体会众那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 遇见他捡柴的人，就把他带到摩西、亚伦并全会众那里，
verses.textEnNiv: Those who found him gathering wood brought him to Moses and Aaron and the whole assembly,
verses.textEnEsv: And those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron and to all the congregation.
verses.textEnNkjv: And those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.
verses.textEnNlt: The people who found him doing this took him before Moses, Aaron, and the rest of the community.
verses.textEnNasb: And those who found him gathering wood brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation;
verses.textEn: Those who found him gathering wood brought him to Moses and Aaron and the whole assembly,

verses.textZh: 他们把他收在监里，因为要怎样办他，还未明朗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把他收在监里，因为要怎样办他，还未明朗。
verses.textZhCuv: 将他收在监内；因为当怎样办他，还没有指明。
verses.textEnNiv: and they kept him in custody, because it was not clear what should be done to him.
verses.textEnEsv: They put him in custody, because it had not been made clear what should be done to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: They put him under guard, because it had not been explained what should be done to him.
verses.textEnNlt: They held him in custody because they did not know what to do with him.
verses.textEnNasb: and they placed him in custody, because it had not been decided what should be done to him.
verses.textEn: and they kept him in custody, because it was not clear what should be done to him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："那人必须处死，全体会众要在营外用石头把他打死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："那人必须处死，全体会众要在营外用石头把他打死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「总要把那人治死；全会众要在营外用石头把他打死。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "The man must die. The whole assembly must stone him outside the camp."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "The man shall be put to death; all the congregation shall stone him with stones outside the camp."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "The man must surely be put to death; all the congregation shall stone him with stones outside the camp."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses, "The man must be put to death! The whole community must stone him outside the camp."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, "The man must be put to death; all the congregation shall stone him with stones outside the camp."
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "The man must die. The whole assembly must stone him outside the camp."

verses.textZh: 于是全体会众把他拉出营外，用石头把他打死，正如耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是全体会众把他拉出营外，用石头把他打死，正如耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是全会众将他带到营外，用石头打死他，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.textEnNiv: So the assembly took him outside the camp and stoned him to death, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the congregation brought him outside the camp and stoned him to death with stones, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: So, as the Lord commanded Moses, all the congregation brought him outside the camp and stoned him with stones, and he died.
verses.textEnNlt: So the whole community took the man outside the camp and stoned him to death, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the congregation brought him outside the camp and stoned him to death with stones, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: So the assembly took him outside the camp and stoned him to death, as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNkjv: Again the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord also spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉以色列人，叫他们世世代代在自己衣服的边上作繸子，又在繸子上，钉上一根蓝色的细带子；
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉以色列人，叫他们世世代代在自己衣服的边上作繸子，又在繸子上，钉上一根蓝色的细带子；
verses.textZhCuv: 「你吩咐以色列人，叫他们世世代代在衣服边上做䍁子，又在底边的䍁子上钉一根蓝细带子。
verses.textEnNiv: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘Throughout the generations to come you are to make tassels on the corners of your garments, with a blue cord on each tassel.
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel, and tell them to make tassels on the corners of their garments throughout their generations, and to put a cord of blue on the tassel of each corner.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel: Tell them to make tassels on the corners of their garments throughout their generations, and to put a blue thread in the tassels of the corners.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel: Throughout the generations to come you must make tassels for the hems of your clothing and attach them with a blue cord.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel and tell them that they shall make for themselves tassels on the corners of their garments throughout their generations, and that they shall put on the tassel of each corner a violet thread.
verses.textEn: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘Throughout the generations to come you are to make tassels on the corners of your garments, with a blue cord on each tassel.

verses.textZh: 这要作你们的繸子，叫你们一看见，就记得耶和华的一切命令，并且遵行；不随从自己的心意和眼目乱跑，像你们素常乱跑行淫一样，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这要作你们的繸子，叫你们一看见，就记得耶和华的一切命令，并且遵行；不随从自己的心意和眼目乱跑，像你们素常乱跑行淫一样，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们佩带这䍁子，好叫你们看见就记念遵行耶和华一切的命令，不随从自己的心意、眼目行邪淫，像你们素常一样；
verses.textEnNiv: You will have these tassels to look at and so you will remember all the commands of the Lord , that you may obey them and not prostitute yourselves by chasing after the lusts of your own hearts and eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: And it shall be a tassel for you to look at and remember all the commandments of the Lord , to do them, not to follow after your own heart and your own eyes, which you are inclined to whore after.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall have the tassel, that you may look upon it and remember all the commandments of the Lord and do them, and that you may not follow the harlotry to which your own heart and your own eyes are inclined,
verses.textEnNlt: When you see the tassels, you will remember and obey all the commands of the Lord instead of following your own desires and defiling yourselves, as you are prone to do.
verses.textEnNasb: It shall be a tassel for you to look at and remember all the commandments of the Lord, so that you will do them and not follow your own heart and your own eyes, which led you to prostitute yourselves,
verses.textEn: You will have these tassels to look at and so you will remember all the commands of the Lord , that you may obey them and not prostitute yourselves by chasing after the lusts of your own hearts and eyes.

verses.textZh: 好使你们记得，并且遵行我的一切命令，又使你们成为圣洁，归给你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好使你们记得，并且遵行我的一切命令，又使你们成为圣洁，归给你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 使你们记念遵行我一切的命令，成为圣洁，归与你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Then you will remember to obey all my commands and will be consecrated to your God.
verses.textEnEsv: So you shall remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: and that you may remember and do all My commandments, and be holy for your God.
verses.textEnNlt: The tassels will help you remember that you must obey all my commands and be holy to your God.
verses.textEnNasb: so that you will remember and do all My commandments and be holy to your God.
verses.textEn: Then you will remember to obey all my commands and will be consecrated to your God.

verses.textZh: 我是耶和华你们的神，曾把你们从埃及地领出来，为要作你们的神；我是耶和华你们的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是耶和华你们的神，曾把你们从埃及地领出来，为要作你们的神；我是耶和华你们的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「我是耶和华－你们的神，曾把你们从埃及地领出来，要作你们的神。我是耶和华－你们的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt to be your God. I am the Lord your God.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God: I am the Lord your God."
verses.textEnNkjv: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the Lord your God."
verses.textEnNlt: I am the Lord your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt that I might be your God. I am the Lord your God!"
verses.textEnNasb: I am the Lord your God who brought you out from the land of Egypt to be your God; I am the Lord your God."
verses.textEn: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt to be your God. I am the Lord your God.’ "

verses.textZh: 利未的曾孙、哥辖的孙子、以斯哈的儿子可拉，和流本子孙中以利押的儿子大坍、亚比兰，与比勒的儿子安，带着人来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未的曾孙、哥辖的孙子、以斯哈的儿子可拉，和流本子孙中以利押的儿子大坍、亚比兰，与比勒的儿子安，带着人来，
verses.textZhCuv: 利未的曾孙、哥辖的孙子、以斯哈的儿子可拉，和吕便子孙中以利押的儿子大坍、亚比兰，与比勒的儿子安，
verses.textEnNiv: Korah son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and certain Reubenites—Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, and On son of Peleth—became insolent
verses.textEnEsv: Now Korah the son of Izhar, son of Kohath, son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram the sons of Eliab, and On the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Korah the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram the sons of Eliab, and On the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men;
verses.textEnNlt: One day Korah son of Izhar, a descendant of Kohath son of Levi, conspired with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On son of Peleth, from the tribe of Reuben.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Korah the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men,
verses.textEn: Korah son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and certain Reubenites—Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, and On son of Peleth—became insolent

verses.textZh: 反抗摩西，还有以色列人中的二百五十个人，就是会众的领袖；会众中被选出有名望的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 反抗摩西，还有以色列人中的二百五十个人，就是会众的领袖；会众中被选出有名望的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 并以色列会中的二百五十个首领，就是有名望选入会中的人，在摩西面前一同起来，
verses.textEnNiv: and rose up against Moses. With them were 250 Israelite men, well-known community leaders who had been appointed members of the council.
verses.textEnEsv: And they rose up before Moses, with a number of the people of Israel, 250 chiefs of the congregation, chosen from the assembly, well-known men.
verses.textEnNkjv: and they rose up before Moses with some of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty leaders of the congregation, representatives of the congregation, men of renown.
verses.textEnNlt: They incited a rebellion against Moses, along with 250 other leaders of the community, all prominent members of the assembly.
verses.textEnNasb: and they stood before Moses, together with some of the sons of Israel, 250 leaders of the congregation chosen in the assembly, men of renown.
verses.textEn: and rose up against Moses. With them were 250 Israelite men, well-known community leaders who had been appointed members of the council.

verses.textZh: 他们聚集起来反抗摩西和亚伦，对他们说："你们太过分了，全体会众个个都是圣洁的，耶和华也在他们中间，你们为甚么高抬自己，超过耶和华的会众呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们聚集起来反抗摩西和亚伦，对他们说："你们太过分了，全体会众个个都是圣洁的，耶和华也在他们中间，你们为甚么高抬自己，超过耶和华的会众呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 聚集攻击摩西、亚伦，说：「你们擅自专权！全会众个个既是圣洁，耶和华也在他们中间，你们为什么自高，超过耶和华的会众呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: They came as a group to oppose Moses and Aaron and said to them, "You have gone too far! The whole community is holy, every one of them, and the Lord is with them. Why then do you set yourselves above the Lord ’s assembly?"
verses.textEnEsv: They assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron and said to them, "You have gone too far! For all in the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the Lord is among them. Why then do you exalt yourselves above the assembly of the Lord ?"
verses.textEnNkjv: They gathered together against Moses and Aaron, and said to them, "You take too much upon yourselves, for all the congregation is holy, every one of them, and the Lordis among them. Why then do you exalt yourselves above the assembly of the Lord?"
verses.textEnNlt: They united against Moses and Aaron and said, "You have gone too far! The whole community of Israel has been set apart by the Lord , and he is with all of us. What right do you have to act as though you are greater than the rest of the Lord ’s people?"
verses.textEnNasb: They assembled together against Moses and Aaron, and said to them, " You have gone far enough! For all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the Lord is in their midst; so why do you exalt yourselves above the assembly of the Lord?"
verses.textEn: They came as a group to oppose Moses and Aaron and said to them, "You have gone too far! The whole community is holy, every one of them, and the Lord is with them. Why then do you set yourselves above the Lord ’s assembly?"

verses.textZh: 摩西听见了，就脸伏于地，
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西听见了，就脸伏于地，
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西听见这话就俯伏在地，
verses.textEnNiv: When Moses heard this, he fell facedown.
verses.textEnEsv: When Moses heard it, he fell on his face,
verses.textEnNkjv: So when Moses heard it, he fell on his face;
verses.textEnNlt: When Moses heard what they were saying, he fell face down on the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: When Moses heard this, he fell on his face;
verses.textEn: When Moses heard this, he fell facedown.

verses.textZh: 对可拉和他的同党说："到了早晨，耶和华就要使人知道谁是属他的；谁是圣洁的，就叫谁亲近他；谁是他拣选的，就叫谁亲近他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对可拉和他的同党说："到了早晨，耶和华就要使人知道谁是属他的；谁是圣洁的，就叫谁亲近他；谁是他拣选的，就叫谁亲近他。
verses.textZhCuv: 对可拉和他一党的人说：「到了早晨，耶和华必指示谁是属他的，谁是圣洁的，就叫谁亲近他；他所拣选的是谁，必叫谁亲近他。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to Korah and all his followers: "In the morning the Lord will show who belongs to him and who is holy, and he will have that person come near him. The man he chooses he will cause to come near him.
verses.textEnEsv: and he said to Korah and all his company, "In the morning the Lord will show who is his, and who is holy, and will bring him near to him. The one whom he chooses he will bring near to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: and he spoke to Korah and all his company, saying, "Tomorrow morning the Lord will show who is His and whois holy, and will cause him to come near to Him. That one whom He chooses He will cause to come near to Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to Korah and his followers, "Tomorrow morning the Lord will show us who belongs to him and who is holy. The Lord will allow only those whom he selects to enter his own presence.
verses.textEnNasb: and he spoke to Korah and all his group, saying, "Tomorrow morning the Lord will make known who is His, and who is holy, and will bring that one near to Himself; indeed, the one whom He will choose, He will bring near to Himself.
verses.textEn: Then he said to Korah and all his followers: "In the morning the Lord will show who belongs to him and who is holy, and he will have that person come near him. The man he chooses he will cause to come near him.

verses.textZh: 你们要这样作：可拉和你的同党，你们要拿香炉来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要这样作：可拉和你的同党，你们要拿香炉来；
verses.textZhCuv: 可拉啊，你们要这样行，你和你的一党要拿香炉来。
verses.textEnNiv: You, Korah, and all your followers are to do this: Take censers
verses.textEnEsv: Do this: take censers, Korah and all his company;
verses.textEnNkjv: Do this: Take censers, Korah and all your company;
verses.textEnNlt: Korah, you and all your followers must prepare your incense burners.
verses.textEnNasb: Do this: take censers for yourselves, Korah and your whole group,
verses.textEn: You, Korah, and all your followers are to do this: Take censers

verses.textZh: 明天你们要在耶和华面前，把火盛在炉中，把香放在上面；耶和华拣选谁，谁就是圣洁的，你们利未人太过分了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 明天你们要在耶和华面前，把火盛在炉中，把香放在上面；耶和华拣选谁，谁就是圣洁的，你们利未人太过分了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 明日，在耶和华面前，把火盛在炉中，把香放在其上。耶和华拣选谁，谁就为圣洁。你们这利未的子孙擅自专权了！」
verses.textEnNiv: and tomorrow put burning coals and incense in them before the Lord . The man the Lord chooses will be the one who is holy. You Levites have gone too far!"
verses.textEnEsv: put fire in them and put incense on them before the Lord tomorrow, and the man whom the Lord chooses shall be the holy one. You have gone too far, sons of Levi!"
verses.textEnNkjv: put fire in them and put incense in them before the Lord tomorrow, and it shall be that the man whom the Lord chooses is the holy one. Youtake too much upon yourselves, you sons of Levi!"
verses.textEnNlt: Light fires in them tomorrow, and burn incense before the Lord . Then we will see whom the Lord chooses as his holy one. You Levites are the ones who have gone too far!"
verses.textEnNasb: and put fire in them, and place incense upon them in the presence of the Lord tomorrow; and the man whom the Lord chooses shall be the one who is holy. You have gone far enough, you sons of Levi!"
verses.textEn: and tomorrow put burning coals and incense in them before the Lord . The man the Lord chooses will be the one who is holy. You Levites have gone too far!"

verses.textZh: 摩西又对可拉说："利未人哪，请听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西又对可拉说："利未人哪，请听。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西又对可拉说：「利未的子孙哪，你们听我说！
verses.textEnNiv: Moses also said to Korah, "Now listen, you Levites!
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses said to Korah, "Hear now, you sons of Levi:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses said to Korah, "Hear now, you sons of Levi:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses spoke again to Korah: "Now listen, you Levites!
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses said to Korah, "Hear now, you sons of Levi:
verses.textEn: Moses also said to Korah, "Now listen, you Levites!

verses.textZh: 以色列的神把你们从以色列会众中分别出来，使你们亲近他，办理耶和华帐幕的事务，又站在会众面前替他们供职；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的神把你们从以色列会众中分别出来，使你们亲近他，办理耶和华帐幕的事务，又站在会众面前替他们供职；
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列的神从以色列会中将你们分别出来，使你们亲近他，办耶和华帐幕的事，并站在会众面前替他们当差。
verses.textEnNiv: Isn’t it enough for you that the God of Israel has separated you from the rest of the Israelite community and brought you near himself to do the work at the Lord ’s tabernacle and to stand before the community and minister to them?
verses.textEnEsv: is it too small a thing for you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do service in the tabernacle of the Lord and to stand before the congregation to minister to them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Isit a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to Himself, to do the work of the tabernacle of the Lord, and to stand before the congregation to serve them;
verses.textEnNlt: Does it seem insignificant to you that the God of Israel has chosen you from among all the community of Israel to be near him so you can serve in the Lord ’s Tabernacle and stand before the people to minister to them?
verses.textEnNasb: Is it too small an honor for you that the God of Israel has singled you out from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to Himself, to perform the service of the tabernacle of the Lord, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them;
verses.textEn: Isn’t it enough for you that the God of Israel has separated you from the rest of the Israelite community and brought you near himself to do the work at the Lord ’s tabernacle and to stand before the community and minister to them?

verses.textZh: 耶和华又使你和你所有的兄弟，就是利未的子孙，一同亲近他，这在你们看来是小事吗？你们还要寻求祭司职分吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又使你和你所有的兄弟，就是利未的子孙，一同亲近他，这在你们看来是小事吗？你们还要寻求祭司职分吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又使你和你一切弟兄－利未的子孙－一同亲近他，这岂为小事？你们还要求祭司的职任吗？
verses.textEnNiv: He has brought you and all your fellow Levites near himself, but now you are trying to get the priesthood too.
verses.textEnEsv: and that he has brought you near him, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? And would you seek the priesthood also?
verses.textEnNkjv: and that He has brought you near toHimself, you and all your brethren, the sons of Levi, with you? And are you seeking the priesthood also?
verses.textEnNlt: Korah, he has already given this special ministry to you and your fellow Levites. Are you now demanding the priesthood as well?
verses.textEnNasb: and that He has brought you near, Korah, and all your brothers, sons of Levi, with you? But are you seeking the priesthood as well?
verses.textEn: He has brought you and all your fellow Levites near himself, but now you are trying to get the priesthood too.

verses.textZh: 所以你和你的同党聚集起来反抗耶和华；亚伦算甚么呢？你们竟向他发怨言。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你和你的同党聚集起来反抗耶和华；亚伦算甚么呢？你们竟向他发怨言。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你和你一党的人聚集是要攻击耶和华。亚伦算什么，你们竟向他发怨言呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: It is against the Lord that you and all your followers have banded together. Who is Aaron that you should grumble against him?"
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore it is against the Lord that you and all your company have gathered together. What is Aaron that you grumble against him?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you and all your company are gathered together against the Lord. And what is Aaron that you complain against him?"
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is the one you and your followers are really revolting against! For who is Aaron that you are complaining about him?"
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore you and your whole group are the ones gathered together against the Lord; but as for Aaron, who is he, that you grumble against him?"
verses.textEn: It is against the Lord that you and all your followers have banded together. Who is Aaron that you should grumble against him?"

verses.textZh: 摩西派人去把以利押的儿子大坍和亚比兰叫来；他们说："我们不上去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西派人去把以利押的儿子大坍和亚比兰叫来；他们说："我们不上去。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西打发人去召以利押的儿子大坍、亚比兰。他们说：「我们不上去！
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses summoned Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab. But they said, "We will not come!
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram the sons of Eliab, and they said, "We will not come up.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram the sons of Eliab, but they said, "We will not come up!
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses summoned Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, but they replied, "We refuse to come before you!
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses sent a summons to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; but they said, "We will not come up.
verses.textEn: Then Moses summoned Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab. But they said, "We will not come!

verses.textZh: 你把我们从流奶与蜜的地带上来，要在旷野杀死我们，这算小事吗？你还要自立为王管辖我们吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你把我们从流奶与蜜的地带上来，要在旷野杀死我们，这算小事吗？你还要自立为王管辖我们吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你将我们从流奶与蜜之地领上来，要在旷野杀我们，这岂为小事？你还要自立为王辖管我们吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Isn’t it enough that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey to kill us in the wilderness? And now you also want to lord it over us!
verses.textEnEsv: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, that you must also make yourself a prince over us?
verses.textEnNkjv: Isit a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, that you should keep acting like a prince over us?
verses.textEnNlt: Isn’t it enough that you brought us out of Egypt, a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us here in this wilderness, and that you now treat us like your subjects?
verses.textEnNasb: Is it not enough that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey to have us die in the wilderness, but you would also appoint yourself as master over us?
verses.textEn: Isn’t it enough that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey to kill us in the wilderness? And now you also want to lord it over us!

verses.textZh: 况且你没有把我们领到流奶与蜜的地，也没有把田地和葡萄园给我们作产业。难道你要把这些人的眼睛剜出来吗？我们不上去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 况且你没有把我们领到流奶与蜜的地，也没有把田地和葡萄园给我们作产业。难道你要把这些人的眼睛剜出来吗？我们不上去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 并且你没有将我们领到流奶与蜜之地，也没有把田地和葡萄园给我们为业。难道你要剜这些人的眼睛吗？我们不上去！」
verses.textEnNiv: Moreover, you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey or given us an inheritance of fields and vineyards. Do you want to treat these men like slaves ? No, we will not come!"
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, you have not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We will not come up."
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover you have not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We will not come up!"
verses.textEnNlt: What’s more, you haven’t brought us into another land flowing with milk and honey. You haven’t given us a new homeland with fields and vineyards. Are you trying to fool these men? We will not come."
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, you have not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor have you given us an inheritance of fields and vineyards. Would you gouge out the eyes of these men? We will not come up!"
verses.textEn: Moreover, you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey or given us an inheritance of fields and vineyards. Do you want to treat these men like slaves ? No, we will not come!"

verses.textZh: 于是摩西大怒，对耶和华说："求你不要悦纳他们的礼物，我没有夺过他们一头驴，也没有害过他们一个人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是摩西大怒，对耶和华说："求你不要悦纳他们的礼物，我没有夺过他们一头驴，也没有害过他们一个人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西就甚发怒，对耶和华说：「求你不要享受他们的供物。我并没有夺过他们一匹驴，也没有害过他们一个人。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses became very angry and said to the Lord , "Do not accept their offering. I have not taken so much as a donkey from them, nor have I wronged any of them."
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses was very angry and said to the Lord , "Do not respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, and I have not harmed one of them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses was very angry, and said to the Lord, "Do not respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, nor have I hurt one of them."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses became very angry and said to the Lord , "Do not accept their grain offerings! I have not taken so much as a donkey from them, and I have never hurt a single one of them."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses became very angry and said to the Lord, "Pay no attention to their offering! I have not taken a single donkey from them, nor have I done harm to any of them."
verses.textEn: Then Moses became very angry and said to the Lord , "Do not accept their offering. I have not taken so much as a donkey from them, nor have I wronged any of them."

verses.textZh: 摩西对可拉说："明天你和你的同党，以及亚伦，都要站在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对可拉说："明天你和你的同党，以及亚伦，都要站在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对可拉说：「明天，你和你一党的人，并亚伦，都要站在耶和华面前；
verses.textEnNiv: Moses said to Korah, "You and all your followers are to appear before the Lord tomorrow—you and they and Aaron.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses said to Korah, "Be present, you and all your company, before the Lord , you and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said to Korah, "Tomorrow, you and all your company be present before the Lord—you and they, as well as Aaron.
verses.textEnNlt: And Moses said to Korah, "You and all your followers must come here tomorrow and present yourselves before the Lord . Aaron will also be here.
verses.textEnNasb: Moses said to Korah, "You and all your group be present before the Lord tomorrow, you and they along with Aaron.
verses.textEn: Moses said to Korah, "You and all your followers are to appear before the Lord tomorrow—you and they and Aaron.

verses.textZh: 你们各人要拿着自己的香炉，把香盛在上面；你们各人要把自己的香炉带到耶和华面前，共二百五十个香炉；你和亚伦也各人拿着自己的香炉。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们各人要拿着自己的香炉，把香盛在上面；你们各人要把自己的香炉带到耶和华面前，共二百五十个香炉；你和亚伦也各人拿着自己的香炉。"
verses.textZhCuv: 各人要拿一个香炉，共二百五十个，把香放在上面，到耶和华面前。你和亚伦也各拿自己的香炉。」
verses.textEnNiv: Each man is to take his censer and put incense in it—250 censers in all—and present it before the Lord . You and Aaron are to present your censers also."
verses.textEnEsv: And let every one of you take his censer and put incense on it, and every one of you bring before the Lord his censer, 250 censers; you also, and Aaron, each his censer."
verses.textEnNkjv: Let each take his censer and put incense in it, and each of you bring his censer before the Lord, two hundred and fifty censers; both you and Aaron, each with his censer."
verses.textEnNlt: You and each of your 250 followers must prepare an incense burner and put incense on it, so you can all present them before the Lord . Aaron will also bring his incense burner."
verses.textEnNasb: And each of you take his censer and put incense on it, and each of you bring his censer before the Lord, 250 censers; also you and Aaron shall each bring his censer."
verses.textEn: Each man is to take his censer and put incense in it—250 censers in all—and present it before the Lord . You and Aaron are to present your censers also."

verses.textZh: 于是，他们各人拿着自己的香炉，盛上火，加上香，与摩西和亚伦一同站在会幕门口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，他们各人拿着自己的香炉，盛上火，加上香，与摩西和亚伦一同站在会幕门口。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是他们各人拿一个香炉，盛上火，加上香，同摩西、亚伦站在会幕门前。
verses.textEnNiv: So each of them took his censer, put burning coals and incense in it, and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: So every man took his censer and put fire in them and laid incense on them and stood at the entrance of the tent of meeting with Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnNkjv: So every man took his censer, put fire in it, laid incense on it, and stood at the door of the tabernacle of meeting with Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnNlt: So each of these men prepared an incense burner, lit the fire, and placed incense on it. Then they all stood at the entrance of the Tabernacle with Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnNasb: So they took, each one his own censer, and put fire on it, and placed incense on it; and they stood at the entrance of the tent of meeting, with Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEn: So each of them took his censer, put burning coals and incense in it, and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 可拉召聚了全体会众到会幕门口，来攻击摩西和亚伦，耶和华的荣光就向全体会众显现。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可拉召聚了全体会众到会幕门口，来攻击摩西和亚伦，耶和华的荣光就向全体会众显现。
verses.textZhCuv: 可拉招聚全会众到会幕门前，要攻击摩西、亚伦；耶和华的荣光就向全会众显现。
verses.textEnNiv: When Korah had gathered all his followers in opposition to them at the entrance to the tent of meeting, the glory of the Lord appeared to the entire assembly.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Korah assembled all the congregation against them at the entrance of the tent of meeting. And the glory of the Lord appeared to all the congregation.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them at the door of the tabernacle of meeting. Then the glory of the Lord appeared to all the congregation.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Korah had stirred up the entire community against Moses and Aaron, and they all gathered at the Tabernacle entrance. Then the glorious presence of the Lord appeared to the whole community,
verses.textEnNasb: So Korah assembled all the congregation against them at the entrance of the tent of meeting. And the glory of the Lord appeared to all the congregation.
verses.textEn: When Korah had gathered all his followers in opposition to them at the entrance to the tent of meeting, the glory of the Lord appeared to the entire assembly.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西、亚伦说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: and the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

verses.textZh: "你们要离开这会众，我好在眨眼间把他们吞灭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要离开这会众，我好在眨眼间把他们吞灭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们离开这会众，我好在转眼之间把他们灭绝。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Separate yourselves from this assembly so I can put an end to them at once."
verses.textEnEsv: "Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment."
verses.textEnNlt: "Get away from all these people so that I may instantly destroy them!"
verses.textEnNasb: "Separate yourselves from among this congregation, so that I may consume them instantly."
verses.textEn: "Separate yourselves from this assembly so I can put an end to them at once."

verses.textZh: 摩西和亚伦就俯伏在地，说："神啊，万人之灵的神啊，一人犯罪，你就要向全体会众发怒吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和亚伦就俯伏在地，说："神啊，万人之灵的神啊，一人犯罪，你就要向全体会众发怒吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西、亚伦就俯伏在地，说：「神，万人之灵的神啊，一人犯罪，你就要向全会众发怒吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: But Moses and Aaron fell facedown and cried out, "O God, the God who gives breath to all living things, will you be angry with the entire assembly when only one man sins?"
verses.textEnEsv: And they fell on their faces and said, "O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry with all the congregation?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they fell on their faces, and said, "O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and You be angry with all the congregation?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Moses and Aaron fell face down on the ground. "O God," they pleaded, "you are the God who gives breath to all creatures. Must you be angry with all the people when only one man sins?"
verses.textEnNasb: But they fell on their faces and said, "God, the God of the spirits of humanity, when one person sins, will You be angry with the entire congregation?"
verses.textEn: But Moses and Aaron fell facedown and cried out, "O God, the God who gives breath to all living things, will you be angry with the entire assembly when only one man sins?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要吩咐会众说：‘你们要离开可拉、大坍、亚比兰帐幕的四周。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要吩咐会众说：‘你们要离开可拉、大坍、亚比兰帐幕的四周。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你吩咐会众说：『你们离开可拉、大坍、亚比兰帐棚的四围。』」
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to the assembly, ‘Move away from the tents of Korah, Dathan and Abiram.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "Say to the congregation, Get away from the dwelling of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Then tell all the people to get away from the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram."
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from the areas around the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.’ "
verses.textEn: "Say to the assembly, ‘Move away from the tents of Korah, Dathan and Abiram.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是摩西起来，到大坍和亚比兰那里去；以色列的长老也随着他去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是摩西起来，到大坍和亚比兰那里去；以色列的长老也随着他去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西起来，往大坍、亚比兰那里去；以色列的长老也随着他去。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the elders of Israel followed him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses rose and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the elders of Israel followed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses rose and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the elders of Israel followed him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses got up and rushed over to the tents of Dathan and Abiram, followed by the elders of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses arose and went to Dathan and Abiram, with the elders of Israel following him,
verses.textEn: Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the elders of Israel followed him.

verses.textZh: 摩西告诉会众："你们要远离这些恶人的帐幕，凡是他们的东西，你们都不可摸，免得你们因他们的一切罪恶同遭毁灭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西告诉会众："你们要远离这些恶人的帐幕，凡是他们的东西，你们都不可摸，免得你们因他们的一切罪恶同遭毁灭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他吩咐会众说：「你们离开这恶人的帐棚吧，他们的物件，什么都不可摸，恐怕你们陷在他们的罪中，与他们一同消灭。」
verses.textEnNiv: He warned the assembly, "Move back from the tents of these wicked men! Do not touch anything belonging to them, or you will be swept away because of all their sins."
verses.textEnEsv: And he spoke to the congregation, saying, "Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be swept away with all their sins."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he spoke to the congregation, saying, "Depart now from the tents of these wicked men! Touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins."
verses.textEnNlt: "Quick!" he told the people. "Get away from the tents of these wicked men, and don’t touch anything that belongs to them. If you do, you will be destroyed for their sins."
verses.textEnNasb: and he spoke to the congregation, saying, "Get away now from the tents of these wicked men, and do not touch anything that belongs to them, or you will be swept away in all their sin!"
verses.textEn: He warned the assembly, "Move back from the tents of these wicked men! Do not touch anything belonging to them, or you will be swept away because of all their sins."

verses.textZh: 于是，众人离开了可拉、大坍、亚比兰帐幕的四周；大坍、亚比兰就带着妻子、儿女和小孩出来，站在自己的帐幕门口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，众人离开了可拉、大坍、亚比兰帐幕的四周；大坍、亚比兰就带着妻子、儿女和小孩出来，站在自己的帐幕门口。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是众人离开可拉、大坍、亚比兰帐棚的四围。大坍、亚比兰带着妻子、儿女、小孩子，都出来，站在自己的帐棚门口。
verses.textEnNiv: So they moved away from the tents of Korah, Dathan and Abiram. Dathan and Abiram had come out and were standing with their wives, children and little ones at the entrances to their tents.
verses.textEnEsv: So they got away from the dwelling of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram. And Dathan and Abiram came out and stood at the door of their tents, together with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they got away from around the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram; and Dathan and Abiram came out and stood at the door of their tents, with their wives, their sons, and their little children.
verses.textEnNlt: So all the people stood back from the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram. Then Dathan and Abiram came out and stood at the entrances of their tents, together with their wives and children and little ones.
verses.textEnNasb: So they moved away from the areas around the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram; and Dathan and Abiram came out and stood at the entrances of their tents, along with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.
verses.textEn: So they moved away from the tents of Korah, Dathan and Abiram. Dathan and Abiram had come out and were standing with their wives, children and little ones at the entrances to their tents.

verses.textZh: 摩西说："由此你们可以知道，我作这一切事，是耶和华派我作的，并不是出于我自己的心意。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西说："由此你们可以知道，我作这一切事，是耶和华派我作的，并不是出于我自己的心意。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西说：「我行的这一切事本不是凭我自己心意行的，乃是耶和华打发我行的，必有证据使你们知道。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses said, "This is how you will know that the Lord has sent me to do all these things and that it was not my idea:
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses said, "Hereby you shall know that the Lord has sent me to do all these works, and that it has not been of my own accord.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said: "By this you shall know that the Lord has sent me to do all these works, for Ihave not donethem of my own will.
verses.textEnNlt: And Moses said, "This is how you will know that the Lord has sent me to do all these things that I have done—for I have not done them on my own.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses said, "By this you shall know that the Lord has sent me to do all these deeds; for it is not my doing.
verses.textEn: Then Moses said, "This is how you will know that the Lord has sent me to do all these things and that it was not my idea:

verses.textZh: 如果这些人死亡像一般人死亡一样，或是他们所遭遇的像一般人的遭遇一样，那么就不是耶和华派我来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果这些人死亡像一般人死亡一样，或是他们所遭遇的像一般人的遭遇一样，那么就不是耶和华派我来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人死若与世人无异，或是他们所遭的与世人相同，就不是耶和华打发我来的。
verses.textEnNiv: If these men die a natural death and suffer the fate of all mankind, then the Lord has not sent me.
verses.textEnEsv: If these men die as all men die, or if they are visited by the fate of all mankind, then the Lord has not sent me.
verses.textEnNkjv: If these men die naturally like all men, or if they are visited by the common fate of all men, then the Lord has not sent me.
verses.textEnNlt: If these men die a natural death, or if nothing unusual happens, then the Lord has not sent me.
verses.textEnNasb: If these men die the death of all mankind, or if they suffer the fate of all mankind, then the Lord has not sent me.
verses.textEn: If these men die a natural death and suffer the fate of all mankind, then the Lord has not sent me.

verses.textZh: 如果耶和华作一件新事，使地开口，把他们和他们所有的都吞下去，叫他们活活地下到阴间，这样你们就知道这些人是藐视耶和华了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果耶和华作一件新事，使地开口，把他们和他们所有的都吞下去，叫他们活活地下到阴间，这样你们就知道这些人是藐视耶和华了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若耶和华创作一件新事，使地开口，把他们和一切属他们的都吞下去，叫他们活活地坠落阴间，你们就明白这些人是藐视耶和华了。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if the Lord brings about something totally new, and the earth opens its mouth and swallows them, with everything that belongs to them, and they go down alive into the realm of the dead, then you will know that these men have treated the Lord with contempt."
verses.textEnEsv: But if the Lord creates something new, and the ground opens its mouth and swallows them up with all that belongs to them, and they go down alive into Sheol, then you shall know that these men have despised the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: But if the Lord creates a new thing, and the earth opens its mouth and swallows them up with all that belongs to them, and they go down alive into the pit, then you will understand that these men have rejected the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: But if the Lord does something entirely new and the ground opens its mouth and swallows them and all their belongings, and they go down alive into the grave, then you will know that these men have shown contempt for the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: But if the Lord brings about an entirely new thing and the ground opens its mouth and swallows them with everything that is theirs, and they descend alive into Sheol, then you will know that these men have been disrespectful to the Lord."
verses.textEn: But if the Lord brings about something totally new, and the earth opens its mouth and swallows them, with everything that belongs to them, and they go down alive into the realm of the dead, then you will know that these men have treated the Lord with contempt."

verses.textZh: 摩西说完了这一切话，他们脚下的地就裂开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西说完了这一切话，他们脚下的地就裂开。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西刚说完了这一切话，他们脚下的地就开了口，
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as he finished saying all this, the ground under them split apart
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as he had finished speaking all these words, the ground under them split apart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, as he finished speaking all these words, that the ground split apart under them,
verses.textEnNlt: He had hardly finished speaking the words when the ground suddenly split open beneath them.
verses.textEnNasb: And as he finished speaking all these words, the ground that was under them split open;
verses.textEn: As soon as he finished saying all this, the ground under them split apart

verses.textZh: 地开了口，把他们和他们的家眷，以及一切属可拉的人和财物，都吞了下去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地开了口，把他们和他们的家眷，以及一切属可拉的人和财物，都吞了下去。
verses.textZhCuv: 把他们和他们的家眷，并一切属可拉的人丁、财物，都吞下去。
verses.textEnNiv: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and their households, and all those associated with Korah, together with their possessions.
verses.textEnEsv: And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households and all the people who belonged to Korah and all their goods.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households and all the men with Korah, with all their goods.
verses.textEnNlt: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed the men, along with their households and all their followers who were standing with them, and everything they owned.
verses.textEnNasb: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them, their households, and all the people who belonged to Korah with all their possessions.
verses.textEn: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and their households, and all those associated with Korah, together with their possessions.

verses.textZh: 这样，他们和一切属他们的，都活活地下到阴间，地在他们上面合闭，他们就从会众中灭亡了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，他们和一切属他们的，都活活地下到阴间，地在他们上面合闭，他们就从会众中灭亡了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，他们和一切属他们的，都活活地坠落阴间；地口在他们上头照旧合闭，他们就从会中灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: They went down alive into the realm of the dead, with everything they owned; the earth closed over them, and they perished and were gone from the community.
verses.textEnEsv: So they and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol, and the earth closed over them, and they perished from the midst of the assembly.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they and all those with them went down alive into the pit; the earth closed over them, and they perished from among the assembly.
verses.textEnNlt: So they went down alive into the grave, along with all their belongings. The earth closed over them, and they all vanished from among the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: So they and all that belonged to them went down alive to Sheol; and the earth closed over them, and they perished from the midst of the assembly.
verses.textEn: They went down alive into the realm of the dead, with everything they owned; the earth closed over them, and they perished and were gone from the community.

verses.textZh: 在他们四周的以色列众人，听见他们的呼叫，就都逃跑，说："恐怕地也把我们吞下去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他们四周的以色列众人，听见他们的呼叫，就都逃跑，说："恐怕地也把我们吞下去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在他们四围的以色列众人听他们呼号，就都逃跑，说：「恐怕地也把我们吞下去。」
verses.textEnNiv: At their cries, all the Israelites around them fled, shouting, "The earth is going to swallow us too!"
verses.textEnEsv: And all Israel who were around them fled at their cry, for they said, "Lest the earth swallow us up!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all Israel who were around them fled at their cry, for they said, "Lest the earth swallow us up also!"
verses.textEnNlt: All the people around them fled when they heard their screams. "The earth will swallow us, too!" they cried.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all Israel who were around them fled at their outcry, for they said, "The earth might swallow us!"
verses.textEn: At their cries, all the Israelites around them fled, shouting, "The earth is going to swallow us too!"

verses.textZh: 又有火从耶和华那里出来，把那献香的二百五十个人吞灭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有火从耶和华那里出来，把那献香的二百五十个人吞灭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有火从耶和华那里出来，烧灭了那献香的二百五十个人。
verses.textEnNiv: And fire came out from the Lord and consumed the 250 men who were offering the incense.
verses.textEnEsv: And fire came out from the Lord and consumed the 250 men offering the incense.
verses.textEnNkjv: And a fire came out from the Lord and consumed the two hundred and fifty men who were offering incense.
verses.textEnNlt: Then fire blazed forth from the Lord and burned up the 250 men who were offering incense.
verses.textEnNasb: Fire also came out from the Lord and consumed the 250 men who were offering the incense.
verses.textEn: And fire came out from the Lord and consumed the 250 men who were offering the incense.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要吩咐亚伦祭司的儿子以利亚撒，叫他把那些香炉从火中拾起来，把火撒在别处，因为那些香炉是圣的；
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要吩咐亚伦祭司的儿子以利亚撒，叫他把那些香炉从火中拾起来，把火撒在别处，因为那些香炉是圣的；
verses.textZhCuv: 「你吩咐祭司亚伦的儿子以利亚撒从火中捡起那些香炉来，把火撒在别处，因为那些香炉是圣的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Tell Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, to remove the censers from the charred remains and scatter the coals some distance away, for the censers are holy—
verses.textEnEsv: "Tell Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest to take up the censers out of the blaze. Then scatter the fire far and wide, for they have become holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Tell Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, to pick up the censers out of the blaze, for they are holy, and scatter the fire some distance away.
verses.textEnNlt: "Tell Eleazar son of Aaron the priest to pull all the incense burners from the fire, for they are holy. Also tell him to scatter the burning coals.
verses.textEnNasb: "Tell Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, that he shall pick up the censers from the midst of the burned area, because they are holy; and you are to scatter the burning coals farther away.
verses.textEn: "Tell Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, to remove the censers from the charred remains and scatter the coals some distance away, for the censers are holy—

verses.textZh: 那些犯罪而自害己命的人的香炉也是圣的，你们要把它们锤成薄片，用来包盖祭坛；那些香炉本是他们在耶和华面前献过的，所以已经成为圣的，并且可以给以色列作鉴戒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些犯罪而自害己命的人的香炉也是圣的，你们要把它们锤成薄片，用来包盖祭坛；那些香炉本是他们在耶和华面前献过的，所以已经成为圣的，并且可以给以色列作鉴戒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 把那些犯罪、自害己命之人的香炉，叫人锤成片子，用以包坛。那些香炉本是他们在耶和华面前献过的，所以是圣的，并且可以给以色列人作记号。」
verses.textEnNiv: the censers of the men who sinned at the cost of their lives. Hammer the censers into sheets to overlay the altar, for they were presented before the Lord and have become holy. Let them be a sign to the Israelites."
verses.textEnEsv: As for the censers of these men who have sinned at the cost of their lives, let them be made into hammered plates as a covering for the altar, for they offered them before the Lord , and they became holy. Thus they shall be a sign to the people of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: The censers of these men who sinned against their own souls, let them be made into hammered plates as a covering for the altar. Because they presented them before the Lord, therefore they are holy; and they shall be a sign to the children of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: Take the incense burners of these men who have sinned at the cost of their lives, and hammer the metal into a thin sheet to overlay the altar. Since these burners were used in the Lord ’s presence, they have become holy. Let them serve as a warning to the people of Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: As for the censers of these men who have sinned at the cost of their own lives, have them made into hammered sheets as plating for the altar, since they did present them before the Lord and they are holy; and they shall serve as a sign to the sons of Israel."
verses.textEn: the censers of the men who sinned at the cost of their lives. Hammer the censers into sheets to overlay the altar, for they were presented before the Lord and have become holy. Let them be a sign to the Israelites."

verses.textZh: 于是，以利亚撒祭司把被火焚烧的人献过的铜香炉拿起来，叫人锤成薄片，用来包盖祭坛，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，以利亚撒祭司把被火焚烧的人献过的铜香炉拿起来，叫人锤成薄片，用来包盖祭坛，
verses.textZhCuv: 于是祭司以利亚撒将被烧之人所献的铜香炉拿来，人就锤出来，用以包坛，
verses.textEnNiv: So Eleazar the priest collected the bronze censers brought by those who had been burned to death, and he had them hammered out to overlay the altar,
verses.textEnEsv: So Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers, which those who were burned had offered, and they were hammered out as a covering for the altar,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers, which those who were burned up had presented, and they were hammered out as a covering on the altar,
verses.textEnNlt: So Eleazar the priest collected the 250 bronze incense burners that had been used by the men who died in the fire, and the bronze was hammered into a thin sheet to overlay the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: So the priest Eleazar took the bronze censers which the men who were burned had offered, and they hammered them out as plating for the altar,
verses.textEn: So Eleazar the priest collected the bronze censers brought by those who had been burned to death, and he had them hammered out to overlay the altar,

verses.textZh: 给以色列人作鉴戒，叫不是亚伦子孙的外人，不可近前来，在耶和华面前烧香，免得他像可拉和他的同党有一样的遭遇；这是照着耶和华藉摩西吩咐以利亚撒的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 给以色列人作鉴戒，叫不是亚伦子孙的外人，不可近前来，在耶和华面前烧香，免得他像可拉和他的同党有一样的遭遇；这是照着耶和华藉摩西吩咐以利亚撒的。
verses.textZhCuv: 给以色列人作纪念，使亚伦后裔之外的人不得近前来在耶和华面前烧香，免得他遭可拉和他一党所遭的。这乃是照耶和华藉着摩西所吩咐的。
verses.textEnNiv: as the Lord directed him through Moses. This was to remind the Israelites that no one except a descendant of Aaron should come to burn incense before the Lord , or he would become like Korah and his followers.
verses.textEnEsv: to be a reminder to the people of Israel, so that no outsider, who is not of the descendants of Aaron, should draw near to burn incense before the Lord , lest he become like Korah and his company—as the Lord said to him through Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: tobe a memorial to the children of Israel that no outsider, who is not a descendant of Aaron, should come near to offer incense before the Lord, that he might not become like Korah and his companions, just as the Lord had said to him through Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: This would warn the Israelites that no unauthorized person—no one who was not a descendant of Aaron—should ever enter the Lord ’s presence to burn incense. If anyone did, the same thing would happen to him as happened to Korah and his followers. So the Lord ’s instructions to Moses were carried out.
verses.textEnNasb: as a reminder to the sons of Israel so that no layman, anyone who was not of the descendants of Aaron, would approach to burn incense before the Lord; then he would not become like Korah and his group—just as the Lord had spoken to him through Moses.
verses.textEn: as the Lord directed him through Moses. This was to remind the Israelites that no one except a descendant of Aaron should come to burn incense before the Lord , or he would become like Korah and his followers.

verses.textZh: 第二天，以色列全体会众都向摩西和亚伦发怨言，说："你们害死了耶和华的子民。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，以色列全体会众都向摩西和亚伦发怨言，说："你们害死了耶和华的子民。"
verses.textZhCuv: 第二天，以色列全会众都向摩西、亚伦发怨言说：「你们杀了耶和华的百姓了。」
verses.textEnNiv: The next day the whole Israelite community grumbled against Moses and Aaron. "You have killed the Lord ’s people," they said.
verses.textEnEsv: But on the next day all the congregation of the people of Israel grumbled against Moses and against Aaron, saying, "You have killed the people of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: On the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel complained against Moses and Aaron, saying, "You have killed the people of the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: But the very next morning the whole community of Israel began muttering again against Moses and Aaron, saying, "You have killed the Lord ’s people!"
verses.textEnNasb: But on the next day all the congregation of the sons of Israel grumbled against Moses and Aaron, saying, "You are the ones who have caused the death of the Lord’s people!"
verses.textEn: The next day the whole Israelite community grumbled against Moses and Aaron. "You have killed the Lord ’s people," they said.

verses.textZh: 会众聚集攻击摩西和亚伦的时候，他们转身向会幕观看，见有云彩遮盖会幕，耶和华的荣光显现出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 会众聚集攻击摩西和亚伦的时候，他们转身向会幕观看，见有云彩遮盖会幕，耶和华的荣光显现出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 会众聚集攻击摩西、亚伦的时候，向会幕观看，不料，有云彩遮盖了，耶和华的荣光显现。
verses.textEnNiv: But when the assembly gathered in opposition to Moses and Aaron and turned toward the tent of meeting, suddenly the cloud covered it and the glory of the Lord appeared.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the congregation had assembled against Moses and against Aaron, they turned toward the tent of meeting. And behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the Lord appeared.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, when the congregation had gathered against Moses and Aaron, that they turned toward the tabernacle of meeting; and suddenly the cloud covered it, and the glory of the Lord appeared.
verses.textEnNlt: As the community gathered to protest against Moses and Aaron, they turned toward the Tabernacle and saw that the cloud had covered it, and the glorious presence of the Lord appeared.
verses.textEnNasb: It came about, however, when the congregation had assembled against Moses and Aaron, that they turned toward the tent of meeting, and behold, the cloud covered it and the glory of the Lord appeared.
verses.textEn: But when the assembly gathered in opposition to Moses and Aaron and turned toward the tent of meeting, suddenly the cloud covered it and the glory of the Lord appeared.

verses.textZh: 摩西和亚伦就来到会幕前面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和亚伦就来到会幕前面。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西、亚伦就来到会幕前。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses and Aaron went to the front of the tent of meeting,
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses and Aaron came to the front of the tent of meeting,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses and Aaron came and stood in front of the Tabernacle,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses and Aaron came to the front of the tent of meeting,
verses.textEn: Then Moses and Aaron went to the front of the tent of meeting,

verses.textZh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: and the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: and the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: and the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: and the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: and the Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你们要离开这会众，我好在眨眼间把他们消灭。"他们二人就俯伏在地。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要离开这会众，我好在眨眼间把他们消灭。"他们二人就俯伏在地。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们离开这会众，我好在转眼之间把他们灭绝。」他们二人就俯伏于地。
verses.textEnNiv: "Get away from this assembly so I can put an end to them at once." And they fell facedown.
verses.textEnEsv: "Get away from the midst of this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment." And they fell on their faces.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment." And they fell on their faces.
verses.textEnNlt: "Get away from all these people so that I can instantly destroy them!" But Moses and Aaron fell face down on the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: "Get away from among this congregation so that I may consume them instantly." Then they fell on their faces.
verses.textEn: "Get away from this assembly so I can put an end to them at once." And they fell facedown.

verses.textZh: 摩西对亚伦说："你要拿着香炉，把坛上的火盛在里头，又加上香，快快带到会众那里去，为他们赎罪，因为有震怒从耶和华面前出来，瘟疫已经开始了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对亚伦说："你要拿着香炉，把坛上的火盛在里头，又加上香，快快带到会众那里去，为他们赎罪，因为有震怒从耶和华面前出来，瘟疫已经开始了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对亚伦说：「拿你的香炉，把坛上的火盛在其中，又加上香，快快带到会众那里，为他们赎罪；因为有忿怒从耶和华那里出来，瘟疫已经发作了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses said to Aaron, "Take your censer and put incense in it, along with burning coals from the altar, and hurry to the assembly to make atonement for them. Wrath has come out from the Lord ; the plague has started."
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses said to Aaron, "Take your censer, and put fire on it from off the altar and lay incense on it and carry it quickly to the congregation and make atonement for them, for wrath has gone out from the Lord ; the plague has begun."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses said to Aaron, "Take a censer and put fire in it from the altar, put incense onit, and take it quickly to the congregation and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from the Lord. The plague has begun."
verses.textEnNlt: And Moses said to Aaron, "Quick, take an incense burner and place burning coals on it from the altar. Lay incense on it, and carry it out among the people to purify them and make them right with the Lord . The Lord ’s anger is blazing against them—the plague has already begun."
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses said to Aaron, "Take your censer and put fire in it from the altar, and place incense on it; then bring it quickly to the congregation and make atonement for them, for wrath has gone out from the Lord, the plague has begun!"
verses.textEn: Then Moses said to Aaron, "Take your censer and put incense in it, along with burning coals from the altar, and hurry to the assembly to make atonement for them. Wrath has come out from the Lord ; the plague has started."

verses.textZh: 亚伦照着摩西吩咐的把香炉拿来，跑到会众中间，果然，瘟疫已经在人民中间开始了；他就加上香，为人民赎罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦照着摩西吩咐的把香炉拿来，跑到会众中间，果然，瘟疫已经在人民中间开始了；他就加上香，为人民赎罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦照着摩西所说的拿来，跑到会中，不料，瘟疫在百姓中已经发作了。他就加上香，为百姓赎罪。
verses.textEnNiv: So Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the midst of the assembly. The plague had already started among the people, but Aaron offered the incense and made atonement for them.
verses.textEnEsv: So Aaron took it as Moses said and ran into the midst of the assembly. And behold, the plague had already begun among the people. And he put on the incense and made atonement for the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Aaron took it as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the assembly; and already the plague had begun among the people. So he put in the incense and made atonement for the people.
verses.textEnNlt: Aaron did as Moses told him and ran out among the people. The plague had already begun to strike down the people, but Aaron burned the incense and purified the people.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Aaron took it just as Moses had spoken, and he ran into the midst of the assembly; and behold, the plague had begun among the people. So he put on the incense and made atonement for the people.
verses.textEn: So Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the midst of the assembly. The plague had already started among the people, but Aaron offered the incense and made atonement for them.

verses.textZh: 他站在死人与活人中间，瘟疫就止住了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他站在死人与活人中间，瘟疫就止住了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他站在活人死人中间，瘟疫就止住了。
verses.textEnNiv: He stood between the living and the dead, and the plague stopped.
verses.textEnEsv: And he stood between the dead and the living, and the plague was stopped.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he stood between the dead and the living; so the plague was stopped.
verses.textEnNlt: He stood between the dead and the living, and the plague stopped.
verses.textEnNasb: And he took his stand between the dead and the living, so that the plague was brought to a halt.
verses.textEn: He stood between the living and the dead, and the plague stopped.

verses.textZh: 除了因可拉事件死亡的以外，因瘟疫死亡的有一万四千七百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 除了因可拉事件死亡的以外，因瘟疫死亡的有一万四千七百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 除了因可拉事情死的以外，遭瘟疫死的，共有一万四千七百人。
verses.textEnNiv: But 14,700 people died from the plague, in addition to those who had died because of Korah.
verses.textEnEsv: Now those who died in the plague were 14,700, besides those who died in the affair of Korah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now those who died in the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, besides those who died in the Korah incident.
verses.textEnNlt: But 14,700 people died in that plague, in addition to those who had died in the affair involving Korah.
verses.textEnNasb: But those who died by the plague were 14,700 in number, besides those who died on account of Korah.
verses.textEn: But 14,700 people died from the plague, in addition to those who had died because of Korah.

verses.textZh: 亚伦回到会幕门口摩西那里，瘟疫已经止住了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦回到会幕门口摩西那里，瘟疫已经止住了。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦回到会幕门口，到摩西那里，瘟疫已经止住了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance to the tent of meeting, for the plague had stopped.
verses.textEnEsv: And Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance of the tent of meeting, when the plague was stopped.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Aaron returned to Moses at the door of the tabernacle of meeting, for the plague had stopped.
verses.textEnNlt: Then because the plague had stopped, Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance of the tent of meeting, for the plague had been brought to a halt.
verses.textEn: Then Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance to the tent of meeting, for the plague had stopped.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要吩咐以色列人，要从他们手中取杖，按着父家每支派一根，从他们所有的领袖，按着他们的父家，共取十二根杖，你要把各人的名字写在各人的杖上；
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要吩咐以色列人，要从他们手中取杖，按着父家每支派一根，从他们所有的领袖，按着他们的父家，共取十二根杖，你要把各人的名字写在各人的杖上；
verses.textZhCuv: 「你晓谕以色列人，从他们手下取杖，每支派一根；从他们所有的首领，按着支派，共取十二根。你要将各人的名字写在各人的杖上，
