verses.textEnNiv: "Speak to the Israelites and get twelve staffs from them, one from the leader of each of their ancestral tribes. Write the name of each man on his staff.
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel, and get from them staffs, one for each fathers’ house, from all their chiefs according to their fathers’ houses, twelve staffs. Write each man’s name on his staff,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, and get from them a rod from each father’s house, all their leaders according to their fathers’ houses—twelve rods. Write each man’s name on his rod.
verses.textEnNlt: "Tell the people of Israel to bring you twelve wooden staffs, one from each leader of Israel’s ancestral tribes, and inscribe each leader’s name on his staff.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel, and obtain from them a staff for each father’s household: twelve staffs, from all their leaders for their fathers’ households. You shall write each man’s name on his staff,
verses.textEn: "Speak to the Israelites and get twelve staffs from them, one from the leader of each of their ancestral tribes. Write the name of each man on his staff.

verses.textZh: 又要把亚伦的名字写在利未的杖上，因为照着他们父家各族长必有一根杖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又要把亚伦的名字写在利未的杖上，因为照着他们父家各族长必有一根杖。
verses.textZhCuv: 并要将亚伦的名字写在利未的杖上，因为各族长必有一根杖。
verses.textEnNiv: On the staff of Levi write Aaron’s name, for there must be one staff for the head of each ancestral tribe.
verses.textEnEsv: and write Aaron’s name on the staff of Levi. For there shall be one staff for the head of each fathers’ house.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall write Aaron’s name on the rod of Levi. For there shall be one rod for the head of each father’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: Inscribe Aaron’s name on the staff of the tribe of Levi, for there must be one staff for the leader of each ancestral tribe.
verses.textEnNasb: and write Aaron’s name on the staff of Levi; for there is to be one staff for the head of each of their fathers’ households.
verses.textEn: On the staff of Levi write Aaron’s name, for there must be one staff for the head of each ancestral tribe.

verses.textZh: 你要把这些杖放在会幕里约柜前，就是我和你们相会的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把这些杖放在会幕里约柜前，就是我和你们相会的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要把这些杖存在会幕内法柜前，就是我与你们相会之处。
verses.textEnNiv: Place them in the tent of meeting in front of the ark of the covenant law, where I meet with you.
verses.textEnEsv: Then you shall deposit them in the tent of meeting before the testimony, where I meet with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall place them in the tabernacle of meeting before the Testimony, where I meet with you.
verses.textEnNlt: Place these staffs in the Tabernacle in front of the Ark containing the tablets of the Covenant, where I meet with you.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall then leave them in the tent of meeting in front of the testimony, where I meet with you.
verses.textEn: Place them in the tent of meeting in front of the ark of the covenant law, where I meet with you.

verses.textZh: 我拣选的那人，他的杖必发芽；这样，我就必使以色列人向你们所发的怨言止息，不再达到我耳中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我拣选的那人，他的杖必发芽；这样，我就必使以色列人向你们所发的怨言止息，不再达到我耳中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 后来我所拣选的那人，他的杖必发芽。这样，我必使以色列人向你们所发的怨言止息，不再达到我耳中。」
verses.textEnNiv: The staff belonging to the man I choose will sprout, and I will rid myself of this constant grumbling against you by the Israelites."
verses.textEnEsv: And the staff of the man whom I choose shall sprout. Thus I will make to cease from me the grumblings of the people of Israel, which they grumble against you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be that the rod of the man whom I choose will blossom; thus I will rid Myself of the complaints of the children of Israel, which they make against you."
verses.textEnNlt: Buds will sprout on the staff belonging to the man I choose. Then I will finally put an end to the people’s murmuring and complaining against you."
verses.textEnNasb: And it will come about that the staff of the man whom I choose will sprout. So I will relieve Myself of the grumblings of the sons of Israel, who are grumbling against you."
verses.textEn: The staff belonging to the man I choose will sprout, and I will rid myself of this constant grumbling against you by the Israelites."

verses.textZh: 于是摩西吩咐以色列人，他们所有的领袖都把杖交给他，按着他们的父家，每个领袖一根杖，共有十二根杖；亚伦的杖也在其中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是摩西吩咐以色列人，他们所有的领袖都把杖交给他，按着他们的父家，每个领袖一根杖，共有十二根杖；亚伦的杖也在其中。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是摩西晓谕以色列人，他们的首领就把杖交给他，按着支派，每首领一根，共有十二根；亚伦的杖也在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses spoke to the Israelites, and their leaders gave him twelve staffs, one for the leader of each of their ancestral tribes, and Aaron’s staff was among them.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses spoke to the people of Israel. And all their chiefs gave him staffs, one for each chief, according to their fathers’ houses, twelve staffs. And the staff of Aaron was among their staffs.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses spoke to the children of Israel, and each of their leaders gave him a rod apiece, for each leader according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods; and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses gave the instructions to the people of Israel, and each of the twelve tribal leaders, including Aaron, brought Moses a staff.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses spoke to the sons of Israel, and all their leaders gave him a staff, one for each leader, for their fathers’ households, twelve staffs in all, with the staff of Aaron among their staffs.
verses.textEn: So Moses spoke to the Israelites, and their leaders gave him twelve staffs, one for the leader of each of their ancestral tribes, and Aaron’s staff was among them.

verses.textZh: 摩西就把杖放在约柜的会幕里，在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西就把杖放在约柜的会幕里，在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西就把杖存在法柜的帐幕内，在耶和华面前。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses placed the staffs before the Lord in the tent of the covenant law.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses deposited the staffs before the Lord in the tent of the testimony.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses placed the rods before the Lord in the tabernacle of witness.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses placed the staffs in the Lord ’s presence in the Tabernacle of the Covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses left the staffs before the Lord in the tent of the testimony.
verses.textEn: Moses placed the staffs before the Lord in the tent of the covenant law.

verses.textZh: 第二天，摩西进约柜的会幕去，不料，利未家亚伦的杖已经发了芽，生了花苞，开了花，结了熟杏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，摩西进约柜的会幕去，不料，利未家亚伦的杖已经发了芽，生了花苞，开了花，结了熟杏。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二天，摩西进法柜的帐幕去。谁知利未族亚伦的杖已经发了芽，生了花苞，开了花，结了熟杏。
verses.textEnNiv: The next day Moses entered the tent and saw that Aaron’s staff, which represented the tribe of Levi, had not only sprouted but had budded, blossomed and produced almonds.
verses.textEnEsv: On the next day Moses went into the tent of the testimony, and behold, the staff of Aaron for the house of Levi had sprouted and put forth buds and produced blossoms, and it bore ripe almonds.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass on the next day that Moses went into the tabernacle of witness, and behold, the rod of Aaron, of the house of Levi, had sprouted and put forth buds, had produced blossoms and yielded ripe almonds.
verses.textEnNlt: When he went into the Tabernacle of the Covenant the next day, he found that Aaron’s staff, representing the tribe of Levi, had sprouted, budded, blossomed, and produced ripe almonds!
verses.textEnNasb: Now on the next day Moses went into the tent of the testimony; and behold, Aaron’s staff for the house of Levi had sprouted and produced buds and bloomed with blossoms, and it yielded ripe almonds.
verses.textEn: The next day Moses entered the tent and saw that Aaron’s staff, which represented the tribe of Levi, had not only sprouted but had budded, blossomed and produced almonds.

verses.textZh: 摩西就把所有的杖，从耶和华面前带出来，给以色列众人看；他们看见了，各人就把自己的杖拿了去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西就把所有的杖，从耶和华面前带出来，给以色列众人看；他们看见了，各人就把自己的杖拿了去。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西就把所有的杖从耶和华面前拿出来，给以色列众人看；他们看见了，各首领就把自己的杖拿去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses brought out all the staffs from the Lord ’s presence to all the Israelites. They looked at them, and each of the leaders took his own staff.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses brought out all the staffs from before the Lord to all the people of Israel. And they looked, and each man took his staff.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses brought out all the rods from before the Lord to all the children of Israel; and they looked, and each man took his rod.
verses.textEnNlt: When Moses brought all the staffs out from the Lord ’s presence, he showed them to the people. Each man claimed his own staff.
verses.textEnNasb: Moses then brought out all the staffs from the presence of the Lord to all the sons of Israel; and they looked, and each man took his staff.
verses.textEn: Then Moses brought out all the staffs from the Lord ’s presence to all the Israelites. They looked at them, and each of the leaders took his own staff.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："把亚伦的杖放回约柜前，给那些背叛的人留作证据，这样你就使他们向我发的怨言止息，免得他们死亡。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："把亚伦的杖放回约柜前，给那些背叛的人留作证据，这样你就使他们向我发的怨言止息，免得他们死亡。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「把亚伦的杖还放在法柜前，给这些背叛之子留作记号。这样，你就使他们向我发的怨言止息，免得他们死亡。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses, "Put back Aaron’s staff in front of the ark of the covenant law, to be kept as a sign to the rebellious. This will put an end to their grumbling against me, so that they will not die."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Put back the staff of Aaron before the testimony, to be kept as a sign for the rebels, that you may make an end of their grumblings against me, lest they die."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Bring Aaron’s rod back before the Testimony, to be kept as a sign against the rebels, that you may put their complaints away from Me, lest they die."
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said to Moses: "Place Aaron’s staff permanently before the Ark of the Covenant to serve as a warning to rebels. This should put an end to their complaints against me and prevent any further deaths."
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord said to Moses, "Put the staff of Aaron back in front of the testimony to be kept as a sign against the rebels, so that you may put an end to their grumblings against Me and they do not die."
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses, "Put back Aaron’s staff in front of the ark of the covenant law, to be kept as a sign to the rebellious. This will put an end to their grumbling against me, so that they will not die."

verses.textZh: 摩西就这样行了，耶和华怎样吩咐他，他就怎样行了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西就这样行了，耶和华怎样吩咐他，他就怎样行了。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西就这样行。耶和华怎样吩咐他，他就怎样行了。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses did just as the Lord commanded him.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus did Moses; as the Lord commanded him, so he did.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus did Moses; just as the Lord had commanded him, so he did.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses did as the Lord commanded him.
verses.textEnNasb: Moses did so; just as the Lord had commanded him, so he did.
verses.textEn: Moses did just as the Lord commanded him.

verses.textZh: 以色列人对摩西说："我们要死了，我们灭亡了，我们都灭亡了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人对摩西说："我们要死了，我们灭亡了，我们都灭亡了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人对摩西说：「我们死啦！我们灭亡啦！都灭亡啦！
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites said to Moses, "We will die! We are lost, we are all lost!
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel said to Moses, "Behold, we perish, we are undone, we are all undone.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, "Surely we die, we perish, we all perish!
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people of Israel said to Moses, "Look, we are doomed! We are dead! We are ruined!
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, "Behold, we are passing away, we are perishing, we are all perishing!
verses.textEn: The Israelites said to Moses, "We will die! We are lost, we are all lost!

verses.textZh: 走近耶和华帐幕的，都必定死；难道我们都要死吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 走近耶和华帐幕的，都必定死；难道我们都要死吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡挨近耶和华帐幕的是必死的。我们都要死亡吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who even comes near the tabernacle of the Lord will die. Are we all going to die?"
verses.textEnEsv: Everyone who comes near, who comes near to the tabernacle of the Lord , shall die. Are we all to perish?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever even comes near the tabernacle of the Lord must die. Shall we all utterly die?"
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone who even comes close to the Tabernacle of the Lord dies. Are we all doomed to die?"
verses.textEnNasb: Everyone who comes near, who comes near to the tabernacle of the Lord, must die. Are we to perish completely?"
verses.textEn: Anyone who even comes near the tabernacle of the Lord will die. Are we all going to die?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华对亚伦说："你和你的儿子，以及你父家的人，要与你一同担当干犯圣所的罪孽，你和你的儿子要与你一同担当干犯祭司职任的罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对亚伦说："你和你的儿子，以及你父家的人，要与你一同担当干犯圣所的罪孽，你和你的儿子要与你一同担当干犯祭司职任的罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对亚伦说：「你和你的儿子，并你本族的人，要一同担当干犯圣所的罪孽。你和你的儿子也要一同担当干犯祭司职任的罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Aaron, "You, your sons and your family are to bear the responsibility for offenses connected with the sanctuary, and you and your sons alone are to bear the responsibility for offenses connected with the priesthood.
verses.textEnEsv: So the Lord said to Aaron, "You and your sons and your father’s house with you shall bear iniquity connected with the sanctuary, and you and your sons with you shall bear iniquity connected with your priesthood.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Aaron: "You and your sons and your father’s house with you shall bear the iniquity relatedto the sanctuary, and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity associatedwith your priesthood.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Aaron: "You, your sons, and your relatives from the tribe of Levi will be held responsible for any offenses related to the sanctuary. But you and your sons alone will be held responsible for violations connected with the priesthood.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord said to Aaron, "You, your sons, and your father’s household with you shall bear the guilt in connection with the sanctuary, and you and your sons with you shall bear the guilt in connection with your priesthood.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Aaron, "You, your sons and your family are to bear the responsibility for offenses connected with the sanctuary, and you and your sons alone are to bear the responsibility for offenses connected with the priesthood.

verses.textZh: 你要带着你的亲族利未支派的人，就是你祖宗支派的人，与你一同前来，使他们与你联合，并且服事你；只是你和你的儿子要与你一同在约柜的会幕前供职。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要带着你的亲族利未支派的人，就是你祖宗支派的人，与你一同前来，使他们与你联合，并且服事你；只是你和你的儿子要与你一同在约柜的会幕前供职。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要带你弟兄利未人，就是你祖宗支派的人前来，使他们与你联合，服事你，只是你和你的儿子，要一同在法柜的帐幕前供职。
verses.textEnNiv: Bring your fellow Levites from your ancestral tribe to join you and assist you when you and your sons minister before the tent of the covenant law.
verses.textEnEsv: And with you bring your brothers also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, that they may join you and minister to you while you and your sons with you are before the tent of the testimony.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also bring with you your brethren of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, that they may be joined with you and serve you while you and your sons are with you before the tabernacle of witness.
verses.textEnNlt: "Bring your relatives of the tribe of Levi—your ancestral tribe—to assist you and your sons as you perform the sacred duties in front of the Tabernacle of the Covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: But also bring your brothers with you, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, so that they may join you and serve you, while you and your sons with you are before the tent of the testimony.
verses.textEn: Bring your fellow Levites from your ancestral tribe to join you and assist you when you and your sons minister before the tent of the covenant law.

verses.textZh: 他们要守你所吩咐的，和会幕里的一切事，只是不可走近圣所的器具和祭坛，免得他们和你们都死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要守你所吩咐的，和会幕里的一切事，只是不可走近圣所的器具和祭坛，免得他们和你们都死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要守所吩咐你的，并守全帐幕，只是不可挨近圣所的器具和坛，免得他们和你们都死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: They are to be responsible to you and are to perform all the duties of the tent, but they must not go near the furnishings of the sanctuary or the altar. Otherwise both they and you will die.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall keep guard over you and over the whole tent, but shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary or to the altar lest they, and you, die.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall attend to your needs and all the needs of the tabernacle; but they shall not come near the articles of the sanctuary and the altar, lest they die—they and you also.
verses.textEnNlt: But as the Levites go about all their assigned duties at the Tabernacle, they must be careful not to go near any of the sacred objects or the altar. If they do, both you and they will die.
verses.textEnNasb: And they shall perform duties for you and the duties of the whole tent, but they shall not come near the furnishings of the sanctuary and the altar, or both they and you will die.
verses.textEn: They are to be responsible to you and are to perform all the duties of the tent, but they must not go near the furnishings of the sanctuary or the altar. Otherwise both they and you will die.

verses.textZh: 他们要与你联合，也要守会幕的本分，办理会幕的一切事务；只是外人不可走近你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要与你联合，也要守会幕的本分，办理会幕的一切事务；只是外人不可走近你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要与你联合，也要看守会幕，办理帐幕一切的事，只是外人不可挨近你们。
verses.textEnNiv: They are to join you and be responsible for the care of the tent of meeting—all the work at the tent—and no one else may come near where you are.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall join you and keep guard over the tent of meeting for all the service of the tent, and no outsider shall come near you.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall be joined with you and attend to the needs of the tabernacle of meeting, for all the work of the tabernacle; but an outsider shall not come near you.
verses.textEnNlt: The Levites must join you in fulfilling their responsibilities for the care and maintenance of the Tabernacle, but no unauthorized person may assist you.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall join you and perform the duties of the tent of meeting, for all the service of the tent; but an unauthorized person shall not come near you.
verses.textEn: They are to join you and be responsible for the care of the tent of meeting—all the work at the tent—and no one else may come near where you are.

verses.textZh: 你们要看守圣所和祭坛，免得震怒再临到以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要看守圣所和祭坛，免得震怒再临到以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要看守圣所和坛，免得忿怒再临到以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: "You are to be responsible for the care of the sanctuary and the altar, so that my wrath will not fall on the Israelites again.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall keep guard over the sanctuary and over the altar, that there may never again be wrath on the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall attend to the duties of the sanctuary and the duties of the altar, that there may be no more wrath on the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "You yourselves must perform the sacred duties inside the sanctuary and at the altar. If you follow these instructions, the Lord ’s anger will never again blaze against the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall perform the duties of the sanctuary and the duties of the altar, so that there will no longer be wrath on the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: "You are to be responsible for the care of the sanctuary and the altar, so that my wrath will not fall on the Israelites again.

verses.textZh: 我已经把你们的亲族利未人，从以色列人中拣选出来，给你们作礼物献与耶和华，为要办理会幕的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我已经把你们的亲族利未人，从以色列人中拣选出来，给你们作礼物献与耶和华，为要办理会幕的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 我已将你们的弟兄利未人从以色列人中拣选出来归耶和华，是给你们为赏赐的，为要办理会幕的事。
verses.textEnNiv: I myself have selected your fellow Levites from among the Israelites as a gift to you, dedicated to the Lord to do the work at the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, I have taken your brothers the Levites from among the people of Israel. They are a gift to you, given to the Lord , to do the service of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I Myself have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel; theyare a gift to you, given by the Lord, to do the work of the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: I myself have chosen your fellow Levites from among the Israelites to be your special assistants. They are a gift to you, dedicated to the Lord for service in the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I Myself have taken your fellow Levites from among the sons of Israel; they are a gift to you, dedicated to the Lord, to perform the service for the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: I myself have selected your fellow Levites from among the Israelites as a gift to you, dedicated to the Lord to do the work at the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 你和你的儿子，要与你一同守你们祭司的职分，办理一切属祭坛和幔子内的事；你们要这样供职。我把祭司的职分赐给你们作服事我的赏赐；外人若是近前来，必被处死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你和你的儿子，要与你一同守你们祭司的职分，办理一切属祭坛和幔子内的事；你们要这样供职。我把祭司的职分赐给你们作服事我的赏赐；外人若是近前来，必被处死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你和你的儿子要为一切属坛和幔子内的事一同守祭司的职任。你们要这样供职；我将祭司的职任给你们当作赏赐事奉我。凡挨近的外人必被治死。」
verses.textEnNiv: But only you and your sons may serve as priests in connection with everything at the altar and inside the curtain. I am giving you the service of the priesthood as a gift. Anyone else who comes near the sanctuary is to be put to death."
verses.textEnEsv: And you and your sons with you shall guard your priesthood for all that concerns the altar and that is within the veil; and you shall serve. I give your priesthood as a gift, and any outsider who comes near shall be put to death."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you and your sons with you shall attend to your priesthood for everything at the altar and behind the veil; and you shall serve. I give your priesthood toyou as a gift for service, but the outsider who comes near shall be put to death."
verses.textEnNlt: But you and your sons, the priests, must personally handle all the priestly rituals associated with the altar and with everything behind the inner curtain. I am giving you the priesthood as your special privilege of service. Any unauthorized person who comes too near the sanctuary will be put to death."
verses.textEnNasb: But you and your sons with you shall attend to your priesthood for everything that concerns the altar and inside the veil, and you are to perform service. I am giving you the priesthood as a service that is a gift, and the unauthorized person who comes near shall be put to death."
verses.textEn: But only you and your sons may serve as priests in connection with everything at the altar and inside the curtain. I am giving you the service of the priesthood as a gift. Anyone else who comes near the sanctuary is to be put to death."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对亚伦说："我已经把保留归我的举祭，就是以色列人一切分别为圣的物，都赐给你和你的子孙，作为永远应得的分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对亚伦说："我已经把保留归我的举祭，就是以色列人一切分别为圣的物，都赐给你和你的子孙，作为永远应得的分。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕亚伦说：「我已将归我的举祭，就是以色列人一切分别为圣的物，交给你经管；因你受过膏，把这些都赐给你和你的子孙，当作永得的分。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Aaron, "I myself have put you in charge of the offerings presented to me; all the holy offerings the Israelites give me I give to you and your sons as your portion, your perpetual share.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord spoke to Aaron, "Behold, I have given you charge of the contributions made to me, all the consecrated things of the people of Israel. I have given them to you as a portion and to your sons as a perpetual due.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Aaron: "Here, I Myself have also given you charge of My heave offerings, all the holy gifts of the children of Israel; I have given them as a portion to you and your sons, as an ordinance forever.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gave these further instructions to Aaron: "I myself have put you in charge of all the holy offerings that are brought to me by the people of Israel. I have given all these consecrated offerings to you and your sons as your permanent share.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Aaron, "Now behold, I Myself have put you in charge of My offerings, all the holy gifts of the sons of Israel I have given to you as a portion and to your sons as a permanent allotment.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Aaron, "I myself have put you in charge of the offerings presented to me; all the holy offerings the Israelites give me I give to you and your sons as your portion, your perpetual share.

verses.textZh: 以色列人所献一切不经过火、至圣的供物，就是一切素祭、一切赎罪祭和一切赎愆祭，都要作至圣的物，归给你和你的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人所献一切不经过火、至圣的供物，就是一切素祭、一切赎罪祭和一切赎愆祭，都要作至圣的物，归给你和你的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人归给我至圣的供物，就是一切的素祭、赎罪祭、赎愆祭，其中所有存留不经火的，都为至圣之物，要归给你和你的子孙。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to have the part of the most holy offerings that is kept from the fire. From all the gifts they bring me as most holy offerings, whether grain or sin or guilt offerings, that part belongs to you and your sons.
verses.textEnEsv: This shall be yours of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every offering of theirs, every grain offering of theirs and every sin offering of theirs and every guilt offering of theirs, which they render to me, shall be most holy to you and to your sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: This shall be yours of the most holy things reserved from the fire: every offering of theirs, every grain offering and every sin offering and every trespass offering which they render to Me, shallbe most holy for you and your sons.
verses.textEnNlt: You are allotted the portion of the most holy offerings that is not burned on the fire. This portion of all the most holy offerings—including the grain offerings, sin offerings, and guilt offerings—will be most holy, and it belongs to you and your sons.
verses.textEnNasb: This shall be yours from the most holy gifts reserved from the fire; every offering of theirs, namely every grain offering, every sin offering, and every guilt offering, with which they shall make restitution to Me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.
verses.textEn: You are to have the part of the most holy offerings that is kept from the fire. From all the gifts they bring me as most holy offerings, whether grain or sin or guilt offerings, that part belongs to you and your sons.

verses.textZh: 你要在至圣的地方吃，凡是男的都可以吃；你要以此物为圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要在至圣的地方吃，凡是男的都可以吃；你要以此物为圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要拿这些当至圣物吃；凡男丁都可以吃。你当以此物为圣。
verses.textEnNiv: Eat it as something most holy; every male shall eat it. You must regard it as holy.
verses.textEnEsv: In a most holy place shall you eat it. Every male may eat it; it is holy to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: In a most holy place you shall eat it; every male shall eat it. It shall be holy to you.
verses.textEnNlt: You must eat it as a most holy offering. All the males may eat of it, and you must treat it as most holy.
verses.textEnNasb: As the most holy gifts you shall eat it; every male shall eat it. It shall be holy to you.
verses.textEn: Eat it as something most holy; every male shall eat it. You must regard it as holy.

verses.textZh: 以色列人礼物中的举祭，与他们的摇祭，都是你的；我已经给了你和你的儿女，作为永远应得的分；在你家中洁净的人都可以吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人礼物中的举祭，与他们的摇祭，都是你的；我已经给了你和你的儿女，作为永远应得的分；在你家中洁净的人都可以吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人所献的举祭并摇祭都是你的；我已赐给你和你的儿女，当作永得的分；凡在你家中的洁净人都可以吃。
verses.textEnNiv: "This also is yours: whatever is set aside from the gifts of all the wave offerings of the Israelites. I give this to you and your sons and daughters as your perpetual share. Everyone in your household who is ceremonially clean may eat it.
verses.textEnEsv: This also is yours: the contribution of their gift, all the wave offerings of the people of Israel. I have given them to you, and to your sons and daughters with you, as a perpetual due. Everyone who is clean in your house may eat it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "This also is yours: the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel; I have given them to you, and your sons and daughters with you, as an ordinance forever. Everyone who is clean in your house may eat it.
verses.textEnNlt: "All the sacred offerings and special offerings presented to me when the Israelites lift them up before the altar also belong to you. I have given them to you and to your sons and daughters as your permanent share. Any member of your family who is ceremonially clean may eat of these offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: This also is yours, the offering of their gift, that is, all the wave offerings of the sons of Israel; I have given them to you and to your sons and daughters with you as a permanent allotment. Everyone of your household who is clean may eat it.
verses.textEn: "This also is yours: whatever is set aside from the gifts of all the wave offerings of the Israelites. I give this to you and your sons and daughters as your perpetual share. Everyone in your household who is ceremonially clean may eat it.

verses.textZh: 最好的油、最好的新酒和五谷，就是以色列人献给耶和华的初熟的物，我都赐给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 最好的油、最好的新酒和五谷，就是以色列人献给耶和华的初熟的物，我都赐给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡油中、新酒中、五谷中至好的，就是以色列人所献给耶和华初熟之物，我都赐给你。
verses.textEnNiv: "I give you all the finest olive oil and all the finest new wine and grain they give the Lord as the firstfruits of their harvest.
verses.textEnEsv: All the best of the oil and all the best of the wine and of the grain, the firstfruits of what they give to the Lord , I give to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "All the best of the oil, all the best of the new wine and the grain, their firstfruits which they offer to the Lord, I have given them to you.
verses.textEnNlt: "I also give you the harvest gifts brought by the people as offerings to the Lord —the best of the olive oil, new wine, and grain.
verses.textEnNasb: All the best of the fresh oil and all the best of the fresh wine and of the grain, the first fruits of what they give to the Lord, I have given them to you.
verses.textEn: "I give you all the finest olive oil and all the finest new wine and grain they give the Lord as the firstfruits of their harvest.

verses.textZh: 从他们地上带来给耶和华的初熟的物，都要归给你们；在你家中洁净的人，都可以吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从他们地上带来给耶和华的初熟的物，都要归给你们；在你家中洁净的人，都可以吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡从他们地上所带来给耶和华初熟之物也都要归与你。你家中的洁净人都可以吃。
verses.textEnNiv: All the land’s firstfruits that they bring to the Lord will be yours. Everyone in your household who is ceremonially clean may eat it.
verses.textEnEsv: The first ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to the Lord , shall be yours. Everyone who is clean in your house may eat it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whatever first ripe fruit is in their land, which they bring to the Lord, shall be yours. Everyone who is clean in your house may eat it.
verses.textEnNlt: All the first crops of their land that the people present to the Lord belong to you. Any member of your family who is ceremonially clean may eat this food.
verses.textEnNasb: The first ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to the Lord, shall be yours; everyone of your household who is clean may eat it.
verses.textEn: All the land’s firstfruits that they bring to the Lord will be yours. Everyone in your household who is ceremonially clean may eat it.

verses.textZh: 以色列中一切永献的物，都必归给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列中一切永献的物，都必归给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列中一切永献的都必归与你。
verses.textEnNiv: "Everything in Israel that is devoted to the Lord is yours.
verses.textEnEsv: Every devoted thing in Israel shall be yours.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Every devoted thing in Israel shall be yours.
verses.textEnNlt: "Everything in Israel that is specially set apart for the Lord also belongs to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Everything banned from secular use in Israel shall be yours.
verses.textEn: "Everything in Israel that is devoted to the Lord is yours.

verses.textZh: 有血肉生命头生的，无论是人或是牲畜，就是他们献给耶和华的，都必归给你；只是人类头生的，你总要赎出来；不洁净牲畜头生的，也要赎出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有血肉生命头生的，无论是人或是牲畜，就是他们献给耶和华的，都必归给你；只是人类头生的，你总要赎出来；不洁净牲畜头生的，也要赎出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们所有奉给耶和华的，连人带牲畜，凡头生的，都要归给你；只是人头生的，总要赎出来；不洁净牲畜头生的，也要赎出来。
verses.textEnNiv: The first offspring of every womb, both human and animal, that is offered to the Lord is yours. But you must redeem every firstborn son and every firstborn male of unclean animals.
verses.textEnEsv: Everything that opens the womb of all flesh, whether man or beast, which they offer to the Lord , shall be yours. Nevertheless, the firstborn of man you shall redeem, and the firstborn of unclean animals you shall redeem.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Everything that first opens the womb of all flesh, which they bring to the Lord, whether man or beast, shall be yours; nevertheless the firstborn of man you shall surely redeem, and the firstborn of unclean animals you shall redeem.
verses.textEnNlt: "The firstborn of every mother, whether human or animal, that is offered to the Lord will be yours. But you must always redeem your firstborn sons and the firstborn of ceremonially unclean animals.
verses.textEnNasb: Every firstborn of the womb of all flesh, whether human or animal, which they offer to the Lord, shall be yours; however you must redeem the human firstborn, and the firstborn of unclean animals you shall redeem.
verses.textEn: The first offspring of every womb, both human and animal, that is offered to the Lord is yours. But you must redeem every firstborn son and every firstborn male of unclean animals.

verses.textZh: 关于他们的赎价，一个月以上的，你要照你估定的价，按着圣所的秤，就是按照圣所的标准重量 ，用五十七克银子赎出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 关于他们的赎价，一个月以上的，你要照你估定的价，按着圣所的秤，就是按照圣所的标准重量 ，用五十七克银子赎出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中在一月之外所当赎的，要照你所估定的价，按圣所的平，用银子五舍客勒赎出来（一舍客勒是二十季拉）。
verses.textEnNiv: When they are a month old, you must redeem them at the redemption price set at five shekels of silver, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs.
verses.textEnEsv: And their redemption price (at a month old you shall redeem them) you shall fix at five shekels in silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.
verses.textEnNkjv: And those redeemed of the devoted things you shall redeem when one month old, according to your valuation, for five shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.
verses.textEnNlt: Redeem them when they are one month old. The redemption price is five pieces of silver (as measured by the weight of the sanctuary shekel, which equals twenty gerahs).
verses.textEnNasb: As to their redemption price, from a month old you shall redeem them, by your assessment, five shekels in silver by the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.
verses.textEn: When they are a month old, you must redeem them at the redemption price set at five shekels of silver, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs.

verses.textZh: 只是头生的牛、头生的绵羊，或是头生的山羊，你不可赎出来；牠们都是圣的。你要把牠们的血洒在祭坛上，把牠们的脂油焚烧，作为献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是头生的牛、头生的绵羊，或是头生的山羊，你不可赎出来；牠们都是圣的。你要把牠们的血洒在祭坛上，把牠们的脂油焚烧，作为献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是头生的牛，或是头生的绵羊和山羊，必不可赎，都是圣的，要把它的血洒在坛上，把它的脂油焚烧，当作馨香的火祭献给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: "But you must not redeem the firstborn of a cow, a sheep or a goat; they are holy. Splash their blood against the altar and burn their fat as a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: But the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat, you shall not redeem; they are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar and shall burn their fat as a food offering, with a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: But the firstborn of a cow, the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat you shall not redeem; they are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar, and burn their fat as an offering made by fire for a sweet aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "However, you may not redeem the firstborn of cattle, sheep, or goats. They are holy and have been set apart for the Lord . Sprinkle their blood on the altar, and burn their fat as a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: But the firstborn of an ox, the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat, you shall not redeem; they are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar and offer up their fat in smoke as an offering by fire, for a soothing aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEn: "But you must not redeem the firstborn of a cow, a sheep or a goat; they are holy. Splash their blood against the altar and burn their fat as a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 牠们的肉却要归给你，像摇过的胸和右腿要归给你一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠们的肉却要归给你，像摇过的胸和右腿要归给你一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 它的肉必归你，像被摇的胸、被举的右腿归你一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Their meat is to be yours, just as the breast of the wave offering and the right thigh are yours.
verses.textEnEsv: But their flesh shall be yours, as the breast that is waved and as the right thigh are yours.
verses.textEnNkjv: And their flesh shall be yours, just as the wave breast and the right thigh are yours.
verses.textEnNlt: The meat of these animals will be yours, just like the breast and right thigh that are presented by lifting them up as a special offering before the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: However, their meat shall be yours; it shall be yours like the breast of a wave offering and like the right thigh.
verses.textEn: Their meat is to be yours, just as the breast of the wave offering and the right thigh are yours.

verses.textZh: 以色列人奉献给耶和华圣物中的举祭，我都赐给了你和与你在一起的儿女，作永远应得的分；这是在耶和华面前给你和与你在一起的后裔作永远的盐约。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人奉献给耶和华圣物中的举祭，我都赐给了你和与你在一起的儿女，作永远应得的分；这是在耶和华面前给你和与你在一起的后裔作永远的盐约。"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡以色列人所献给耶和华圣物中的举祭，我都赐给你和你的儿女，当作永得的分。这是给你和你的后裔、在耶和华面前作为永远的盐约 。」
verses.textEnNiv: Whatever is set aside from the holy offerings the Israelites present to the Lord I give to you and your sons and daughters as your perpetual share. It is an everlasting covenant of salt before the Lord for both you and your offspring."
verses.textEnEsv: All the holy contributions that the people of Israel present to the Lord I give to you, and to your sons and daughters with you, as a perpetual due. It is a covenant of salt forever before the Lord for you and for your offspring with you."
verses.textEnNkjv: "All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer to the Lord, I have given to you and your sons and daughters with you as an ordinance forever; it is a covenant of salt forever before the Lord with you and your descendants with you."
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I am giving you all these holy offerings that the people of Israel bring to the Lord . They are for you and your sons and daughters, to be eaten as your permanent share. This is an eternal and unbreakable covenant between the Lord and you, and it also applies to your descendants."
verses.textEnNasb: All the offerings of the holy gifts, which the sons of Israel offer to the Lord, I have given to you and your sons and your daughters with you, as a permanent allotment. It is a permanent covenant of salt before the Lord to you and your descendants with you."
verses.textEn: Whatever is set aside from the holy offerings the Israelites present to the Lord I give to you and your sons and daughters as your perpetual share. It is an everlasting covenant of salt before the Lord for both you and your offspring."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对亚伦说："你在以色列人的地不可有产业，在他们中间也不可有分；在以色列人中间，我就是你的分，是你的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对亚伦说："你在以色列人的地不可有产业，在他们中间也不可有分；在以色列人中间，我就是你的分，是你的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对亚伦说：「你在以色列人的境内不可有产业，在他们中间也不可有分。我就是你的分，是你的产业。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Aaron, "You will have no inheritance in their land, nor will you have any share among them; I am your share and your inheritance among the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Aaron, "You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Aaron: "You shall have no inheritance in their land, nor shall you have any portion among them; I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said to Aaron, "You priests will receive no allotment of land or share of property among the people of Israel. I am your share and your allotment.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Aaron, "You shall have no inheritance in their land nor own any portion among them; I am your portion and your inheritance among the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Aaron, "You will have no inheritance in their land, nor will you have any share among them; I am your share and your inheritance among the Israelites.

verses.textZh: "至于利未的子孙，我已经把以色列中所有的十分之一，赐给了他们作产业，这是为酬报他们在会幕里办理的事务。
verses.textZhCnvs: "至于利未的子孙，我已经把以色列中所有的十分之一，赐给了他们作产业，这是为酬报他们在会幕里办理的事务。
verses.textZhCuv: 「凡以色列中出产的十分之一，我已赐给利未的子孙为业；因他们所办的是会幕的事，所以赐给他们为酬他们的劳。
verses.textEnNiv: "I give to the Levites all the tithes in Israel as their inheritance in return for the work they do while serving at the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: "To the Levites I have given every tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in return for their service that they do, their service in the tent of meeting,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tithes in Israel as an inheritance in return for the work which they perform, the work of the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: As for the tribe of Levi, your relatives, I will compensate them for their service in the Tabernacle. Instead of an allotment of land, I will give them the tithes from the entire land of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: "To the sons of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithe in Israel as an inheritance, in return for their service which they perform, the service of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: "I give to the Levites all the tithes in Israel as their inheritance in return for the work they do while serving at the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 从今以后，以色列人不可走近会幕，免得他们负罪而死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从今以后，以色列人不可走近会幕，免得他们负罪而死。
verses.textZhCuv: 从今以后，以色列人不可挨近会幕，免得他们担罪而死。
verses.textEnNiv: From now on the Israelites must not go near the tent of meeting, or they will bear the consequences of their sin and will die.
verses.textEnEsv: so that the people of Israel do not come near the tent of meeting, lest they bear sin and die.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hereafter the children of Israel shall not come near the tabernacle of meeting, lest they bear sin and die.
verses.textEnNlt: "From now on, no Israelites except priests or Levites may approach the Tabernacle. If they come too near, they will be judged guilty and will die.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Israel shall not come near the tent of meeting again, or they will bring sin on themselves and die.
verses.textEn: From now on the Israelites must not go near the tent of meeting, or they will bear the consequences of their sin and will die.

verses.textZh: 唯独利未人要办理会幕的事，要担当他们的罪孽，这要作你们世世代代永远的条例；在以色列人中，他们不可有产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯独利未人要办理会幕的事，要担当他们的罪孽，这要作你们世世代代永远的条例；在以色列人中，他们不可有产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独利未人要办会幕的事，担当罪孽；这要作你们世世代代永远的定例。他们在以色列人中不可有产业；
verses.textEnNiv: It is the Levites who are to do the work at the tent of meeting and bear the responsibility for any offenses they commit against it. This is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come. They will receive no inheritance among the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Levites shall do the service of the tent of meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity. It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations, and among the people of Israel they shall have no inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Levites shall perform the work of the tabernacle of meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity; itshallbe a statute forever, throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: Only the Levites may serve at the Tabernacle, and they will be held responsible for any offenses against it. This is a permanent law for you, to be observed from generation to generation. The Levites will receive no allotment of land among the Israelites,
verses.textEnNasb: Only the Levites shall perform the service of the tent of meeting, and they shall bear their own guilt; it shall be a permanent statute throughout your generations, and among the sons of Israel they shall have no inheritance.
verses.textEn: It is the Levites who are to do the work at the tent of meeting and bear the responsibility for any offenses they commit against it. This is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come. They will receive no inheritance among the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 因为以色列人献给耶和华为举祭的十分之一，我已经赐给了利未人作产业；所以我对他们说：在以色列人中，他们不可有产业。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为以色列人献给耶和华为举祭的十分之一，我已经赐给了利未人作产业；所以我对他们说：在以色列人中，他们不可有产业。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为以色列人中出产的十分之一，就是献给耶和华为举祭的，我已赐给利未人为业。所以我对他们说：『在以色列人中不可有产业。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Instead, I give to the Levites as their inheritance the tithes that the Israelites present as an offering to the Lord . That is why I said concerning them: ‘They will have no inheritance among the Israelites.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: For the tithe of the people of Israel, which they present as a contribution to the Lord , I have given to the Levites for an inheritance. Therefore I have said of them that they shall have no inheritance among the people of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: For the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer up as a heave offering to the Lord, I have given to the Levites as an inheritance; therefore I have said to them, ‘Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: because I have given them the Israelites’ tithes, which have been presented as sacred offerings to the Lord . This will be the Levites’ share. That is why I said they would receive no allotment of land among the Israelites."
verses.textEnNasb: For the tithe of the sons of Israel, which they offer as an offering to the Lord, I have given to the Levites as an inheritance; therefore I have said concerning them, ‘They shall have no inheritance among the sons of Israel.’ "
verses.textEn: Instead, I give to the Levites as their inheritance the tithes that the Israelites present as an offering to the Lord . That is why I said concerning them: ‘They will have no inheritance among the Israelites.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord also told Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要告诉利未人：你们既然从以色列人手中，取得了我赐给你们作产业的十分之一，你们就要从这十分之一中，取出十分之一，献给耶和华作为举祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉利未人：你们既然从以色列人手中，取得了我赐给你们作产业的十分之一，你们就要从这十分之一中，取出十分之一，献给耶和华作为举祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你晓谕利未人说：你们从以色列人中所取的十分之一，就是我给你们为业的，要再从那十分之一中取十分之一作为举祭献给耶和华，
verses.textEnNiv: "Speak to the Levites and say to them: ‘When you receive from the Israelites the tithe I give you as your inheritance, you must present a tenth of that tithe as the Lord ’s offering.
verses.textEnEsv: "Moreover, you shall speak and say to the Levites, ‘When you take from the people of Israel the tithe that I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall present a contribution from it to the Lord , a tithe of the tithe.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak thus to the Levites, and say to them: ‘When you take from the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them as your inheritance, then you shall offer up a heave offering of it to the Lord, a tenth of the tithe.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give these instructions to the Levites: When you receive from the people of Israel the tithes I have assigned as your allotment, give a tenth of the tithes you receive—a tithe of the tithe—to the Lord as a sacred offering.
verses.textEnNasb: "Moreover, you shall speak to the Levites and say to them, ‘When you take from the sons of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall present an offering from it to the Lord, a tithe of the tithe.
verses.textEn: "Speak to the Levites and say to them: ‘When you receive from the Israelites the tithe I give you as your inheritance, you must present a tenth of that tithe as the Lord ’s offering.

verses.textZh: 这要算为你们的举祭，好象禾场上的五谷，又像榨酒池中满满的酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这要算为你们的举祭，好象禾场上的五谷，又像榨酒池中满满的酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 这举祭要算为你们场上的谷，又如满酒榨的酒。
verses.textEnNiv: Your offering will be reckoned to you as grain from the threshing floor or juice from the winepress.
verses.textEnEsv: And your contribution shall be counted to you as though it were the grain of the threshing floor, and as the fullness of the winepress.
verses.textEnNkjv: And your heave offering shall be reckoned to you as though itwere the grain of the threshing floor and as the fullness of the winepress.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will consider this offering to be your harvest offering, as though it were the first grain from your own threshing floor or wine from your own winepress.
verses.textEnNasb: Your offering shall be credited to you like the grain from the threshing floor or the full produce from the wine vat.
verses.textEn: Your offering will be reckoned to you as grain from the threshing floor or juice from the winepress.

verses.textZh: 这样，你们也要把从以色列人取得的十分之一，作举祭献给耶和华；你们要把献给耶和华的举祭，归给亚伦祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，你们也要把从以色列人取得的十分之一，作举祭献给耶和华；你们要把献给耶和华的举祭，归给亚伦祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，你们从以色列人中所得的十分之一也要作举祭献给耶和华，从这十分之一中，将所献给耶和华的举祭归给祭司亚伦。
verses.textEnNiv: In this way you also will present an offering to the Lord from all the tithes you receive from the Israelites. From these tithes you must give the Lord ’s portion to Aaron the priest.
verses.textEnEsv: So you shall also present a contribution to the Lord from all your tithes, which you receive from the people of Israel. And from it you shall give the Lord ’s contribution to Aaron the priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus you shall also offer a heave offering to the Lord from all your tithes which you receive from the children of Israel, and you shall give the Lord’s heave offering from it to Aaron the priest.
verses.textEnNlt: You must present one-tenth of the tithe received from the Israelites as a sacred offering to the Lord . This is the Lord ’s sacred portion, and you must present it to Aaron the priest.
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall also present an offering to the Lord from all your tithes, which you receive from the sons of Israel; and from it you shall give the Lord’s offering to Aaron the priest.
verses.textEn: In this way you also will present an offering to the Lord from all the tithes you receive from the Israelites. From these tithes you must give the Lord ’s portion to Aaron the priest.

verses.textZh: 从你们得的一切礼物中，要把最好的，分别为圣，献给耶和华为举祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从你们得的一切礼物中，要把最好的，分别为圣，献给耶和华为举祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 奉给你们的一切礼物，要从其中将至好的，就是分别为圣的，献给耶和华为举祭。
verses.textEnNiv: You must present as the Lord ’s portion the best and holiest part of everything given to you.’
verses.textEnEsv: Out of all the gifts to you, you shall present every contribution due to the Lord ; from each its best part is to be dedicated.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Of all your gifts you shall offer up every heave offering due to the Lord, from all the best of them, the consecrated part of them.’
verses.textEnNlt: Be sure to give to the Lord the best portions of the gifts given to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Out of all your gifts you shall present every offering due to the Lord, from all the best of them, the sacred part from them.’
verses.textEn: You must present as the Lord ’s portion the best and holiest part of everything given to you.’

verses.textZh: 所以你要对利未人说：‘如果你们把最好的献上，这就算为你们禾场上的粮和榨酒池中的酒了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你要对利未人说：‘如果你们把最好的献上，这就算为你们禾场上的粮和榨酒池中的酒了。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你要对利未人说：你们从其中将至好的举起，这就算为你们场上的粮，又如酒榨的酒。
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to the Levites: ‘When you present the best part, it will be reckoned to you as the product of the threshing floor or the winepress.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore you shall say to them, ‘When you have offered from it the best of it, then the rest shall be counted to the Levites as produce of the threshing floor, and as produce of the winepress.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you shall say to them: ‘When you have lifted up the best of it, then therest shall be accounted to the Levites as the produce of the threshing floor and as the produce of the winepress.
verses.textEnNlt: "Also, give these instructions to the Levites: When you present the best part as your offering, it will be considered as though it came from your own threshing floor or winepress.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall say to them, ‘When you have offered from it the best of it, then the rest shall be credited to the Levites like the product of the threshing floor, and like the product of the wine vat.
verses.textEn: "Say to the Levites: ‘When you present the best part, it will be reckoned to you as the product of the threshing floor or the winepress.

verses.textZh: 你们和你们的家人，随处都可以吃，因为这是你们的工价，是你们在会幕里办事的报酬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们和你们的家人，随处都可以吃，因为这是你们的工价，是你们在会幕里办事的报酬。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们和你们家属随处可以吃；这原是你们的赏赐，是酬你们在会幕里办事的劳。
verses.textEnNiv: You and your households may eat the rest of it anywhere, for it is your wages for your work at the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: And you may eat it in any place, you and your households, for it is your reward in return for your service in the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNkjv: You may eat it in any place, you and your households, for it is your reward for your work in the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: You Levites and your families may eat this food anywhere you wish, for it is your compensation for serving in the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: You may eat it anywhere, you and your households, for it is your compensation in return for your service in the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: You and your households may eat the rest of it anywhere, for it is your wages for your work at the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 如果你们把最好的献上，就不致因此担罪。以色列人的圣物，你们不可亵渎，免得你们死亡。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们把最好的献上，就不致因此担罪。以色列人的圣物，你们不可亵渎，免得你们死亡。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们从其中将至好的举起，就不至因这物担罪。你们不可亵渎以色列人的圣物，免得死亡。」
verses.textEnNiv: By presenting the best part of it you will not be guilty in this matter; then you will not defile the holy offerings of the Israelites, and you will not die.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have contributed the best of it. But you shall not profane the holy things of the people of Israel, lest you die.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall bear no sin because of it, when you have lifted up the best of it. But you shall not profane the holy gifts of the children of Israel, lest you die.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: You will not be considered guilty for accepting the Lord ’s tithes if you give the best portion to the priests. But be careful not to treat the holy gifts of the people of Israel as though they were common. If you do, you will die."
verses.textEnNasb: And you will bring on yourselves no sin by reason of it when you have offered the best of it. But you shall not profane the sacred gifts of the sons of Israel, so that you do not die.’ "
verses.textEn: By presenting the best part of it you will not be guilty in this matter; then you will not defile the holy offerings of the Israelites, and you will not die.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西、亚伦说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron:
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Lord spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron:

verses.textZh: "耶和华所定的律法的条例是这样说：你要吩咐以色列人，把一头完全、没有残疾、未曾负过轭的红母牛，牵到你这里来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华所定的律法的条例是这样说：你要吩咐以色列人，把一头完全、没有残疾、未曾负过轭的红母牛，牵到你这里来。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华命定律法中的一条律例乃是这样说：你要吩咐以色列人，把一只没有残疾、未曾负轭、纯红的母牛牵到你这里来，
verses.textEnNiv: "This is a requirement of the law that the Lord has commanded: Tell the Israelites to bring you a red heifer without defect or blemish and that has never been under a yoke.
verses.textEnEsv: "This is the statute of the law that the Lord has commanded: Tell the people of Israel to bring you a red heifer without defect, in which there is no blemish, and on which a yoke has never come.
verses.textEnNkjv: "This is the ordinance of the law which the Lord has commanded, saying: ‘Speak to the children of Israel, that they bring you a red heifer without blemish, in which there is no defect and on which a yoke has never come.
verses.textEnNlt: "Here is another legal requirement commanded by the Lord : Tell the people of Israel to bring you a red heifer, a perfect animal that has no defects and has never been yoked to a plow.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is the statute of the law which the Lord has commanded, saying, ‘Speak to the sons of Israel that they bring you an unblemished red heifer in which there is no defect and on which a yoke has never been mounted.
verses.textEn: "This is a requirement of the law that the Lord has commanded: Tell the Israelites to bring you a red heifer without defect or blemish and that has never been under a yoke.

verses.textZh: 你们要把牛交给以利亚撒祭司，他就要把牛牵到营外，在他面前把牛宰了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要把牛交给以利亚撒祭司，他就要把牛牵到营外，在他面前把牛宰了。
verses.textZhCuv: 交给祭司以利亚撒；他必牵到营外，人就把牛宰在他面前。
verses.textEnNiv: Give it to Eleazar the priest; it is to be taken outside the camp and slaughtered in his presence.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall give it to Eleazar the priest, and it shall be taken outside the camp and slaughtered before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall give it to Eleazar the priest, that he may take it outside the camp, and it shall be slaughtered before him;
verses.textEnNlt: Give it to Eleazar the priest, and it will be taken outside the camp and slaughtered in his presence.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall give it to Eleazar the priest, and it shall be brought outside the camp and be slaughtered in his presence.
verses.textEn: Give it to Eleazar the priest; it is to be taken outside the camp and slaughtered in his presence.

verses.textZh: 以利亚撒祭司要用指头蘸牛血，向会幕前面洒七次。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚撒祭司要用指头蘸牛血，向会幕前面洒七次。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司以利亚撒要用指头蘸这牛的血，向会幕前面弹七次。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Eleazar the priest is to take some of its blood on his finger and sprinkle it seven times toward the front of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: And Eleazar the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, and sprinkle some of its blood toward the front of the tent of meeting seven times.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Eleazar the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, and sprinkle some of its blood seven times directly in front of the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: Eleazar will take some of its blood on his finger and sprinkle it seven times toward the front of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: And Eleazar the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger and sprinkle some of its blood toward the front of the tent of meeting seven times.
verses.textEn: Then Eleazar the priest is to take some of its blood on his finger and sprinkle it seven times toward the front of the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 然后，在他面前把牛焚烧，牛的皮、肉、血和粪，都要焚烧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后，在他面前把牛焚烧，牛的皮、肉、血和粪，都要焚烧。
verses.textZhCuv: 人要在他眼前把这母牛焚烧；牛的皮、肉、血、粪都要焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: While he watches, the heifer is to be burned—its hide, flesh, blood and intestines.
verses.textEnEsv: And the heifer shall be burned in his sight. Its skin, its flesh, and its blood, with its dung, shall be burned.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the heifer shall be burned in his sight: its hide, its flesh, its blood, and its offal shall be burned.
verses.textEnNlt: As Eleazar watches, the heifer must be burned—its hide, meat, blood, and dung.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the heifer shall be burned in his sight; its hide, its flesh, and its blood, with its refuse, shall be burned.
verses.textEn: While he watches, the heifer is to be burned—its hide, flesh, blood and intestines.

verses.textZh: 祭司要把香柏木、牛膝草、朱红色线，都丢在烧牛的火中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要把香柏木、牛膝草、朱红色线，都丢在烧牛的火中。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要把香柏木、牛膝草、朱红色线都丢在烧牛的火中。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest is to take some cedar wood, hyssop and scarlet wool and throw them onto the burning heifer.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest shall take cedarwood and hyssop and scarlet yarn, and throw them into the fire burning the heifer.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priest shall take cedar wood and hyssop and scarlet, and cast them into the midst of the fire burning the heifer.
verses.textEnNlt: Eleazar the priest must then take a stick of cedar, a hyssop branch, and some scarlet yarn and throw them into the fire where the heifer is burning.
verses.textEnNasb: And the priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet material, and throw it into the midst of the burning heifer.
verses.textEn: The priest is to take some cedar wood, hyssop and scarlet wool and throw them onto the burning heifer.

verses.textZh: 祭司要洗自己的衣服，并用水洗身，然后才可以进营；但祭司必不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要洗自己的衣服，并用水洗身，然后才可以进营；但祭司必不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司必不洁净到晚上，要洗衣服，用水洗身，然后可以进营。
verses.textEnNiv: After that, the priest must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water. He may then come into the camp, but he will be ceremonially unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the priest shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and afterward he may come into the camp. But the priest shall be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, he shall bathe in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp; the priest shall be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then the priest must wash his clothes and bathe himself in water. Afterward he may return to the camp, though he will remain ceremonially unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: The priest shall then wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and afterward come into the camp; but the priest will be unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: After that, the priest must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water. He may then come into the camp, but he will be ceremonially unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 那烧牛的人也要用水洗自己的衣服，并用水洗身，也必不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那烧牛的人也要用水洗自己的衣服，并用水洗身，也必不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 烧牛的人必不洁净到晚上，也要洗衣服，用水洗身。
verses.textEnNiv: The man who burns it must also wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he too will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: The one who burns the heifer shall wash his clothes in water and bathe his body in water and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the one who burns it shall wash his clothes in water, bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: The man who burns the animal must also wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and he, too, will remain unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who burns the heifer shall also wash his clothes in water and bathe his body in water, and will be unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: The man who burns it must also wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he too will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 要由一个洁净的人收起母牛的灰，安放在营外洁净的地方，为以色列会众留作除污秽的水，这是除罪的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要由一个洁净的人收起母牛的灰，安放在营外洁净的地方，为以色列会众留作除污秽的水，这是除罪的。
verses.textZhCuv: 必有一个洁净的人收起母牛的灰，存在营外洁净的地方，为以色列会众调做除污秽的水。这本是除罪的。
verses.textEnNiv: "A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer and put them in a ceremonially clean place outside the camp. They are to be kept by the Israelite community for use in the water of cleansing; it is for purification from sin.
verses.textEnEsv: And a man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer and deposit them outside the camp in a clean place. And they shall be kept for the water for impurity for the congregation of the people of Israel; it is a sin offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then a man whois clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and store them outside the camp in a clean place; and they shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for the water of purification; it is for purifying from sin.
verses.textEnNlt: Then someone who is ceremonially clean will gather up the ashes of the heifer and deposit them in a purified place outside the camp. They will be kept there for the community of Israel to use in the water for the purification ceremony. This ceremony is performed for the removal of sin.
verses.textEnNasb: Now a man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer and put them outside the camp in a clean place, and the congregation of the sons of Israel shall keep them for water to remove impurity; it is purification from sin.
verses.textEn: "A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer and put them in a ceremonially clean place outside the camp. They are to be kept by the Israelite community for use in the water of cleansing; it is for purification from sin.

verses.textZh: 那收起牛灰的人，要洗自己的衣服，必不洁净到晚上。这要给以色列人和寄居在他们中间的外人，作永远的定例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那收起牛灰的人，要洗自己的衣服，必不洁净到晚上。这要给以色列人和寄居在他们中间的外人，作永远的定例。
verses.textZhCuv: 收起母牛灰的人必不洁净到晚上，要洗衣服。这要给以色列人和寄居在他们中间的外人作为永远的定例。」
verses.textEnNiv: The man who gathers up the ashes of the heifer must also wash his clothes, and he too will be unclean till evening. This will be a lasting ordinance both for the Israelites and for the foreigners residing among them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the one who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening. And this shall be a perpetual statute for the people of Israel, and for the stranger who sojourns among them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the one who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until evening. It shall be a statute forever to the children of Israel and to the stranger who dwells among them.
verses.textEnNlt: The man who gathers up the ashes of the heifer must also wash his clothes, and he will remain ceremonially unclean until evening. This is a permanent law for the people of Israel and any foreigners who live among them.
verses.textEnNasb: And the one who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes and will be unclean until evening; and it shall be a permanent statute for the sons of Israel and for the stranger who resides among them.
verses.textEn: The man who gathers up the ashes of the heifer must also wash his clothes, and he too will be unclean till evening. This will be a lasting ordinance both for the Israelites and for the foreigners residing among them.

verses.textZh: "摸了任何人类尸体的，必不洁净七天。
verses.textZhCnvs: "摸了任何人类尸体的，必不洁净七天。
verses.textZhCuv: 「摸了人死尸的，就必七天不洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: "Whoever touches a human corpse will be unclean for seven days.
verses.textEnEsv: "Whoever touches the dead body of any person shall be unclean seven days.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘He who touches the dead body of anyone shall be unclean seven days.
verses.textEnNlt: "All those who touch a dead human body will be ceremonially unclean for seven days.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘The one who touches the dead body of any person will also be unclean for seven days.
verses.textEn: "Whoever touches a human corpse will be unclean for seven days.

verses.textZh: 那人在第三天要用这样除污秽的水洁净自己，到第七天他就洁净了；如果他在第三天不洁净自己，到第七天他就不洁净了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人在第三天要用这样除污秽的水洁净自己，到第七天他就洁净了；如果他在第三天不洁净自己，到第七天他就不洁净了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人到第三天要用这除污秽的水洁净自己，第七天就洁净了。他若在第三天不洁净自己，第七天就不洁净了。
verses.textEnNiv: They must purify themselves with the water on the third day and on the seventh day; then they will be clean. But if they do not purify themselves on the third and seventh days, they will not be clean.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall cleanse himself with the water on the third day and on the seventh day, and so be clean. But if he does not cleanse himself on the third day and on the seventh day, he will not become clean.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall purify himself with the water on the third day and on the seventh day; then he will be clean. But if he does not purify himself on the third day and on the seventh day, he will not be clean.
verses.textEnNlt: They must purify themselves on the third and seventh days with the water of purification; then they will be purified. But if they do not do this on the third and seventh days, they will continue to be unclean even after the seventh day.
verses.textEnNasb: That one shall purify himself with the water on the third day and on the seventh day, and then he will be clean; but if he does not purify himself on the third day and on the seventh day, he will not be clean.
verses.textEn: They must purify themselves with the water on the third day and on the seventh day; then they will be clean. But if they do not purify themselves on the third and seventh days, they will not be clean.

verses.textZh: 任何人摸了死人、死人的尸体，而不洁净自己的，就玷污了耶和华的帐幕，这人必要从以色列中剪除，因为这除污秽的水没有洒在他身上，所以他必不洁净；他的不洁还留在他身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 任何人摸了死人、死人的尸体，而不洁净自己的，就玷污了耶和华的帐幕，这人必要从以色列中剪除，因为这除污秽的水没有洒在他身上，所以他必不洁净；他的不洁还留在他身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡摸了人死尸、不洁净自己的，就玷污了耶和华的帐幕，这人必从以色列中剪除；因为那除污秽的水没有洒在他身上，他就为不洁净，污秽还在他身上。
verses.textEnNiv: If they fail to purify themselves after touching a human corpse, they defile the Lord ’s tabernacle. They must be cut off from Israel. Because the water of cleansing has not been sprinkled on them, they are unclean; their uncleanness remains on them.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of anyone who has died, and does not cleanse himself, defiles the tabernacle of the Lord , and that person shall be cut off from Israel; because the water for impurity was not thrown on him, he shall be unclean. His uncleanness is still on him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever touches the body of anyone who has died, and does not purify himself, defiles the tabernacle of the Lord. That person shall be cut off from Israel. He shall be unclean, because the water of purification was not sprinkled on him; his uncleanness is still on him.
verses.textEnNlt: All those who touch a dead body and do not purify themselves in the proper way defile the Lord ’s Tabernacle, and they will be cut off from the community of Israel. Since the water of purification was not sprinkled on them, their defilement continues.
verses.textEnNasb: Anyone who touches a dead body, the body of a person who has died, and does not purify himself, defiles the tabernacle of the Lord; and that person shall be cut off from Israel. Since the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he will be unclean; his uncleanness is still on him.
verses.textEn: If they fail to purify themselves after touching a human corpse, they defile the Lord ’s tabernacle. They must be cut off from Israel. Because the water of cleansing has not been sprinkled on them, they are unclean; their uncleanness remains on them.

verses.textZh: "如果人在会幕里死了，条例是这样的：进这会幕的和一切在会幕里的，都必不洁净七天。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果人在会幕里死了，条例是这样的：进这会幕的和一切在会幕里的，都必不洁净七天。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人死在帐棚里的条例乃是这样：凡进那帐棚的，和一切在帐棚里的，都必七天不洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is the law that applies when a person dies in a tent: Anyone who enters the tent and anyone who is in it will be unclean for seven days,
verses.textEnEsv: "This is the law when someone dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent and everyone who is in the tent shall be unclean seven days.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘This is the law when a man dies in a tent: All who come into the tent and all who are in the tent shall be unclean seven days;
verses.textEnNlt: "This is the ritual law that applies when someone dies inside a tent: All those who enter that tent and those who were inside when the death occurred will be ceremonially unclean for seven days.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is the law when a person dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent and everyone who is in the tent will be unclean for seven days.
verses.textEn: "This is the law that applies when a person dies in a tent: Anyone who enters the tent and anyone who is in it will be unclean for seven days,

verses.textZh: 一切敞口的器皿，就是没有盖上盖的，都是不洁净的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一切敞口的器皿，就是没有盖上盖的，都是不洁净的。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡敞口的器皿，就是没有扎上盖的，也是不洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: and every open container without a lid fastened on it will be unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: And every open vessel that has no cover fastened on it is unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: and every open vessel, which has no cover fastened on it, is unclean.
verses.textEnNlt: Any open container in the tent that was not covered with a lid is also defiled.
verses.textEnNasb: And every open container, which has no cover tied down on it, will be unclean.
verses.textEn: and every open container without a lid fastened on it will be unclean.

verses.textZh: 在田间摸了被刀杀死的，或是自己死的尸体，或是人的骨头，或是坟墓，就必不洁净七天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在田间摸了被刀杀死的，或是自己死的尸体，或是人的骨头，或是坟墓，就必不洁净七天。
verses.textZhCuv: 无论何人在田野里摸了被刀杀的，或是尸首，或是人的骨头，或是坟墓，就要七天不洁净。
verses.textEnNiv: "Anyone out in the open who touches someone who has been killed with a sword or someone who has died a natural death, or anyone who touches a human bone or a grave, will be unclean for seven days.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever in the open field touches someone who was killed with a sword or who died naturally, or touches a human bone or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain by a sword or who has died, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.textEnNlt: And if someone in an open field touches the corpse of someone who was killed with a sword or who died a natural death, or if someone touches a human bone or a grave, that person will be defiled for seven days.
verses.textEnNasb: Also, anyone who in the open field touches one who has been killed with a sword or one who has died naturally, or touches a human bone or a grave, will be unclean for seven days.
verses.textEn: "Anyone out in the open who touches someone who has been killed with a sword or someone who has died a natural death, or anyone who touches a human bone or a grave, will be unclean for seven days.

verses.textZh: 人要为这不洁净的人，拿些烧成的除罪灰，放在器皿里，倒上活水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人要为这不洁净的人，拿些烧成的除罪灰，放在器皿里，倒上活水。
verses.textZhCuv: 要为这不洁净的人拿些烧成的除罪灰放在器皿里，倒上活水。
verses.textEnNiv: "For the unclean person, put some ashes from the burned purification offering into a jar and pour fresh water over them.
verses.textEnEsv: For the unclean they shall take some ashes of the burnt sin offering, and fresh water shall be added in a vessel.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And for an unclean person they shall take some of the ashes of the heifer burnt for purification from sin, and running water shall be put on them in a vessel.
verses.textEnNlt: "To remove the defilement, put some of the ashes from the burnt purification offering in a jar, and pour fresh water over them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then for the unclean person they shall take some of the ashes of the burnt purification from sin and running water shall be added to them in a container.
verses.textEn: "For the unclean person, put some ashes from the burned purification offering into a jar and pour fresh water over them.

verses.textZh: 要由一个洁净的人，拿牛膝草蘸在这水里，把水洒在会幕上和一切器皿，以及在那里的众人身上，又洒在摸了骨头，或是摸了被杀死的，或是摸了自己死去的，或是摸了坟墓的人身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要由一个洁净的人，拿牛膝草蘸在这水里，把水洒在会幕上和一切器皿，以及在那里的众人身上，又洒在摸了骨头，或是摸了被杀死的，或是摸了自己死去的，或是摸了坟墓的人身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 必当有一个洁净的人拿牛膝草蘸在这水中，把水洒在帐棚上，和一切器皿并帐棚内的众人身上，又洒在摸了骨头，或摸了被杀的，或摸了自死的，或摸了坟墓的那人身上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to take some hyssop, dip it in the water and sprinkle the tent and all the furnishings and the people who were there. He must also sprinkle anyone who has touched a human bone or a grave or anyone who has been killed or anyone who has died a natural death.
verses.textEnEsv: Then a clean person shall take hyssop and dip it in the water and sprinkle it on the tent and on all the furnishings and on the persons who were there and on whoever touched the bone, or the slain or the dead or the grave.
verses.textEnNkjv: A clean person shall take hyssop and dip it in the water, sprinkle it on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, or on the one who touched a bone, the slain, the dead, or a grave.
verses.textEnNlt: Then someone who is ceremonially clean must take a hyssop branch and dip it into the water. That person must sprinkle the water on the tent, on all the furnishings in the tent, and on the people who were in the tent; also on the person who touched a human bone, or touched someone who was killed or who died naturally, or touched a grave.
verses.textEnNasb: And a clean person shall take hyssop and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, on all the furnishings, on the persons who were there, and on the one who touched the bone or the one who was killed or the one who died naturally, or the grave.
verses.textEn: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to take some hyssop, dip it in the water and sprinkle the tent and all the furnishings and the people who were there. He must also sprinkle anyone who has touched a human bone or a grave or anyone who has been killed or anyone who has died a natural death.

verses.textZh: 第三天和第七天，那洁净的人要洒水在不洁净的人身上，这样到第七天就使他洁净；他要洗自己的衣服，用水洗身，到晚上就洁净了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第三天和第七天，那洁净的人要洒水在不洁净的人身上，这样到第七天就使他洁净；他要洗自己的衣服，用水洗身，到晚上就洁净了。
verses.textZhCuv: 第三天和第七天，洁净的人要洒水在不洁净的人身上，第七天就使他成为洁净。那人要洗衣服，用水洗澡，到晚上就洁净了。
verses.textEnNiv: The man who is clean is to sprinkle those who are unclean on the third and seventh days, and on the seventh day he is to purify them. Those who are being cleansed must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and that evening they will be clean.
verses.textEnEsv: And the clean person shall sprinkle it on the unclean on the third day and on the seventh day. Thus on the seventh day he shall cleanse him, and he shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and at evening he shall be clean.
verses.textEnNkjv: The clean person shall sprinkle the unclean on the third day and on the seventh day; and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, wash his clothes, and bathe in water; and at evening he shall be clean.
verses.textEnNlt: On the third and seventh days the person who is ceremonially clean must sprinkle the water on those who are defiled. Then on the seventh day the people being cleansed must wash their clothes and bathe themselves, and that evening they will be cleansed of their defilement.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day and on the seventh day; and on the seventh day he shall purify him, and he shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and will be clean by evening.
verses.textEn: The man who is clean is to sprinkle those who are unclean on the third and seventh days, and on the seventh day he is to purify them. Those who are being cleansed must wash their clothes and bathe with water, and that evening they will be clean.

verses.textZh: "但那污秽而不洁净自己的，那人必从会众中被剪除，因为他玷污了耶和华的圣所；除污秽的水没有洒在他身上，他是不洁净的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "但那污秽而不洁净自己的，那人必从会众中被剪除，因为他玷污了耶和华的圣所；除污秽的水没有洒在他身上，他是不洁净的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「但那污秽而不洁净自己的，要将他从会中剪除，因为他玷污了耶和华的圣所。除污秽的水没有洒在他身上，他是不洁净的。
verses.textEnNiv: But if those who are unclean do not purify themselves, they must be cut off from the community, because they have defiled the sanctuary of the Lord . The water of cleansing has not been sprinkled on them, and they are unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: "If the man who is unclean does not cleanse himself, that person shall be cut off from the midst of the assembly, since he has defiled the sanctuary of the Lord . Because the water for impurity has not been thrown on him, he is unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘But the man who is unclean and does not purify himself, that person shall be cut off from among the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the Lord. The water of purification has not been sprinkled on him; he is unclean.
verses.textEnNlt: "But those who become defiled and do not purify themselves will be cut off from the community, for they have defiled the sanctuary of the Lord . Since the water of purification has not been sprinkled on them, they remain defiled.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘But the person who is unclean and does not purify himself, that person shall be cut off from the midst of the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the Lord; the water for impurity has not been sprinkled on him, so he is unclean.
