verses.textEn: But if those who are unclean do not purify themselves, they must be cut off from the community, because they have defiled the sanctuary of the Lord . The water of cleansing has not been sprinkled on them, and they are unclean.

verses.textZh: 这要给你们作永远的定例。那洒了除污秽水的人，要洗自己的衣服；那摸了除污秽水的，必不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这要给你们作永远的定例。那洒了除污秽水的人，要洗自己的衣服；那摸了除污秽水的，必不洁净到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 这要给你们作为永远的定例。并且那洒除污秽水的人要洗衣服。凡摸除污秽水的，必不洁净到晚上。
verses.textEnNiv: This is a lasting ordinance for them. "The man who sprinkles the water of cleansing must also wash his clothes, and anyone who touches the water of cleansing will be unclean till evening.
verses.textEnEsv: And it shall be a statute forever for them. The one who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and the one who touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be a perpetual statute for them. He who sprinkles the water of purification shall wash his clothes; and he who touches the water of purification shall be unclean until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: This is a permanent law for the people. Those who sprinkle the water of purification must afterward wash their clothes, and anyone who then touches the water used for purification will remain defiled until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: So it shall be a permanent statute for them. And the one who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and the one who touches the water for impurity will be unclean until evening.
verses.textEn: This is a lasting ordinance for them. "The man who sprinkles the water of cleansing must also wash his clothes, and anyone who touches the water of cleansing will be unclean till evening.

verses.textZh: 不洁净的人摸过的一切，必不洁净；摸了这物的人，也必不洁净到晚上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 不洁净的人摸过的一切，必不洁净；摸了这物的人，也必不洁净到晚上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 不洁净人所摸的一切物就不洁净；摸了这物的人必不洁净到晚上。」
verses.textEnNiv: Anything that an unclean person touches becomes unclean, and anyone who touches it becomes unclean till evening."
verses.textEnEsv: And whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean, and anyone who touches it shall be unclean until evening."
verses.textEnNkjv: Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the person who touches it shall be unclean until evening.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Anything and anyone that a defiled person touches will be ceremonially unclean until evening."
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, anything that the unclean person touches will be unclean; and the person who touches it will be unclean until evening.’ "
verses.textEn: Anything that an unclean person touches becomes unclean, and anyone who touches it becomes unclean till evening."

verses.textZh: 正月间，以色列全体会众到了寻的旷野，就住在加低斯；米利暗死在那里，也埋葬在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正月间，以色列全体会众到了寻的旷野，就住在加低斯；米利暗死在那里，也埋葬在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 正月间，以色列全会众到了寻的旷野，就住在加低斯。米利暗死在那里，就葬在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: In the first month the whole Israelite community arrived at the Desert of Zin, and they stayed at Kadesh. There Miriam died and was buried.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel, the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month, and the people stayed in Kadesh. And Miriam died there and was buried there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Israel, the whole congregation, came into the Wilderness of Zin in the first month, and the people stayed in Kadesh; and Miriam died there and was buried there.
verses.textEnNlt: In the first month of the year, the whole community of Israel arrived in the wilderness of Zin and camped at Kadesh. While they were there, Miriam died and was buried.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Israel, the whole congregation, came to the wilderness of Zin in the first month; and the people stayed at Kadesh. Now Miriam died there and was buried there.
verses.textEn: In the first month the whole Israelite community arrived at the Desert of Zin, and they stayed at Kadesh. There Miriam died and was buried.

verses.textZh: 会众没有水喝，就聚集攻击摩西和亚伦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 会众没有水喝，就聚集攻击摩西和亚伦。
verses.textZhCuv: 会众没有水喝，就聚集攻击摩西、亚伦。
verses.textEnNiv: Now there was no water for the community, and the people gathered in opposition to Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there was no water for the congregation. And they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was no water for the congregation; so they gathered together against Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnNlt: There was no water for the people to drink at that place, so they rebelled against Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnNasb: There was no water for the congregation, and they assembled against Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEn: Now there was no water for the community, and the people gathered in opposition to Moses and Aaron.

verses.textZh: 人民与摩西争闹，说："但愿我们的兄弟在耶和华面前死去的时候，我们也一同死去！
verses.textZhCnvs: 人民与摩西争闹，说："但愿我们的兄弟在耶和华面前死去的时候，我们也一同死去！
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓向摩西争闹说：「我们的弟兄曾死在耶和华面前，我们恨不得与他们同死。
verses.textEnNiv: They quarreled with Moses and said, "If only we had died when our brothers fell dead before the Lord !
verses.textEnEsv: And the people quarreled with Moses and said, "Would that we had perished when our brothers perished before the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: And the people contended with Moses and spoke, saying: "If only we had died when our brethren died before the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: The people blamed Moses and said, "If only we had died in the Lord ’s presence with our brothers!
verses.textEnNasb: Then the people argued with Moses and spoke, saying, "If only we had perished when our brothers perished before the Lord!
verses.textEn: They quarreled with Moses and said, "If only we had died when our brothers fell dead before the Lord !

verses.textZh: 你们为甚么把耶和华的会众领到这旷野来，使我们和我们的牲畜都死在这里呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们为甚么把耶和华的会众领到这旷野来，使我们和我们的牲畜都死在这里呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们为何把耶和华的会众领到这旷野、使我们和牲畜都死在这里呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Why did you bring the Lord ’s community into this wilderness, that we and our livestock should die here?
verses.textEnEsv: Why have you brought the assembly of the Lord into this wilderness, that we should die here, both we and our cattle?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why have you brought up the assembly of the Lord into this wilderness, that we and our animals should die here?
verses.textEnNlt: Why have you brought the congregation of the Lord ’s people into this wilderness to die, along with all our livestock?
verses.textEnNasb: Why then have you brought the Lord’s assembly into this wilderness, for us and our livestock to die here?
verses.textEn: Why did you bring the Lord ’s community into this wilderness, that we and our livestock should die here?

verses.textZh: 你们为甚么使我们出埃及，领我们到这坏地方来呢？这里不能撒种，没有无花果树、葡萄树、石榴树，也没有水喝。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们为甚么使我们出埃及，领我们到这坏地方来呢？这里不能撒种，没有无花果树、葡萄树、石榴树，也没有水喝。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们为何逼着我们出埃及、领我们到这坏地方呢？这地方不好撒种，也没有无花果树、葡萄树、石榴树，又没有水喝。」
verses.textEnNiv: Why did you bring us up out of Egypt to this terrible place? It has no grain or figs, grapevines or pomegranates. And there is no water to drink!"
verses.textEnEsv: And why have you made us come up out of Egypt to bring us to this evil place? It is no place for grain or figs or vines or pomegranates, and there is no water to drink."
verses.textEnNkjv: And why have you made us come up out of Egypt, to bring us to this evil place? It is not a place of grain or figs or vines or pomegranates; nor is there any water to drink."
verses.textEnNlt: Why did you make us leave Egypt and bring us here to this terrible place? This land has no grain, no figs, no grapes, no pomegranates, and no water to drink!"
verses.textEnNasb: Why did you make us come up from Egypt, to bring us into this wretched place? It is not a place of grain or figs or vines or pomegranates, nor is there water to drink!"
verses.textEn: Why did you bring us up out of Egypt to this terrible place? It has no grain or figs, grapevines or pomegranates. And there is no water to drink!"

verses.textZh: 摩西和亚伦于是离开会众，来到会幕门口，俯伏在地；耶和华的荣光向他们显现。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和亚伦于是离开会众，来到会幕门口，俯伏在地；耶和华的荣光向他们显现。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西、亚伦离开会众，到会幕门口，俯伏在地；耶和华的荣光向他们显现。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses and Aaron went from the assembly to the entrance to the tent of meeting and fell facedown, and the glory of the Lord appeared to them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the entrance of the tent of meeting and fell on their faces. And the glory of the Lord appeared to them,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the tabernacle of meeting, and they fell on their faces. And the glory of the Lord appeared to them.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses and Aaron turned away from the people and went to the entrance of the Tabernacle, where they fell face down on the ground. Then the glorious presence of the Lord appeared to them,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses and Aaron came in from the presence of the assembly to the entrance of the tent of meeting and fell on their faces. And the glory of the Lord appeared to them;
verses.textEn: Moses and Aaron went from the assembly to the entrance to the tent of meeting and fell facedown, and the glory of the Lord appeared to them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: and the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: and the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要拿着杖，和你的哥哥亚伦聚集会众，在他们眼前，吩咐盘石出水；这样你就可以使盘石流出水来，给会众和他们的牲畜喝。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要拿着杖，和你的哥哥亚伦聚集会众，在他们眼前，吩咐盘石出水；这样你就可以使盘石流出水来，给会众和他们的牲畜喝。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你拿着杖去，和你的哥哥亚伦招聚会众，在他们眼前吩咐磐石发出水来，水就从磐石流出，给会众和他们的牲畜喝。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Take the staff, and you and your brother Aaron gather the assembly together. Speak to that rock before their eyes and it will pour out its water. You will bring water out of the rock for the community so they and their livestock can drink."
verses.textEnEsv: "Take the staff, and assemble the congregation, you and Aaron your brother, and tell the rock before their eyes to yield its water. So you shall bring water out of the rock for them and give drink to the congregation and their cattle."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Take the rod; you and your brother Aaron gather the congregation together. Speak to the rock before their eyes, and it will yield its water; thus you shall bring water for them out of the rock, and give drink to the congregation and their animals."
verses.textEnNlt: "You and Aaron must take the staff and assemble the entire community. As the people watch, speak to the rock over there, and it will pour out its water. You will provide enough water from the rock to satisfy the whole community and their livestock."
verses.textEnNasb: "Take the staff; and you and your brother Aaron assemble the congregation and speak to the rock before their eyes, that it shall yield its water. So you shall bring water for them out of the rock, and have the congregation and their livestock drink."
verses.textEn: "Take the staff, and you and your brother Aaron gather the assembly together. Speak to that rock before their eyes and it will pour out its water. You will bring water out of the rock for the community so they and their livestock can drink."

verses.textZh: 于是，摩西照着耶和华吩咐他的，从耶和华面前拿了杖去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，摩西照着耶和华吩咐他的，从耶和华面前拿了杖去。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是摩西照耶和华所吩咐的，从耶和华面前取了杖去。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses took the staff from the Lord ’s presence, just as he commanded him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses took the staff from before the Lord , as he commanded him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses took the rod from before the Lord as He commanded him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses did as he was told. He took the staff from the place where it was kept before the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses took the staff from before the Lord, just as He had commanded him;
verses.textEn: So Moses took the staff from the Lord ’s presence, just as he commanded him.

verses.textZh: 摩西和亚伦聚集了会众到盘石面前；摩西对他们说："悖逆的人哪，你们要听，我们为你们使水从盘石中流出来吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和亚伦聚集了会众到盘石面前；摩西对他们说："悖逆的人哪，你们要听，我们为你们使水从盘石中流出来吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西、亚伦就招聚会众到磐石前。摩西说：「你们这些背叛的人听我说：我为你们使水从这磐石中流出来吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: He and Aaron gathered the assembly together in front of the rock and Moses said to them, "Listen, you rebels, must we bring you water out of this rock?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, "Hear now, you rebels: shall we bring water for you out of this rock?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock; and he said to them, "Hear now, you rebels! Must we bring water for you out of this rock?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then he and Aaron summoned the people to come and gather at the rock. "Listen, you rebels!" he shouted. "Must we bring you water from this rock?"
verses.textEnNasb: and Moses and Aaron summoned the assembly in front of the rock. And he said to them, "Listen now, you rebels; shall we bring water for you out of this rock?"
verses.textEn: He and Aaron gathered the assembly together in front of the rock and Moses said to them, "Listen, you rebels, must we bring you water out of this rock?"

verses.textZh: 摩西举手，用杖击打盘石两次，就有很多水流出来，会众和他们的牲畜都喝了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西举手，用杖击打盘石两次，就有很多水流出来，会众和他们的牲畜都喝了。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西举手，用杖击打磐石两下，就有许多水流出来，会众和他们的牲畜都喝了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses raised his arm and struck the rock twice with his staff. Water gushed out, and the community and their livestock drank.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses lifted up his hand and struck the rock with his staff twice, and water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their livestock.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses lifted his hand and struck the rock twice with his rod; and water came out abundantly, and the congregation and their animals drank.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses raised his hand and struck the rock twice with the staff, and water gushed out. So the entire community and their livestock drank their fill.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses raised his hand and struck the rock twice with his staff; and water came out abundantly, and the congregation and their livestock drank.
verses.textEn: Then Moses raised his arm and struck the rock twice with his staff. Water gushed out, and the community and their livestock drank.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西和亚伦说："因为你们不信我，不在以色列人眼前尊我为圣，所以你们必不得领这会众进入我赐给他们的地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西和亚伦说："因为你们不信我，不在以色列人眼前尊我为圣，所以你们必不得领这会众进入我赐给他们的地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西、亚伦说：「因为你们不信我，不在以色列人眼前尊我为圣，所以你们必不得领这会众进我所赐给他们的地去。」
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "Because you did not trust in me enough to honor me as holy in the sight of the Israelites, you will not bring this community into the land I give them."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "Because you did not believe in me, to uphold me as holy in the eyes of the people of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land that I have given them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, "Because you did not believe Me, to hallow Me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them."
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "Because you did not trust me enough to demonstrate my holiness to the people of Israel, you will not lead them into the land I am giving them!"
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "Since you did not trust in Me, to treat Me as holy in the sight of the sons of Israel, for that reason you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them."
verses.textEn: But the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "Because you did not trust in me enough to honor me as holy in the sight of the Israelites, you will not bring this community into the land I give them."

verses.textZh: 这就是米利巴水，因为以色列人在那里与耶和华争闹，耶和华在他们中间显为圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就是米利巴水，因为以色列人在那里与耶和华争闹，耶和华在他们中间显为圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 这水名叫米利巴水 ，是因以色列人向耶和华争闹，耶和华就在他们面前显为圣。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the waters of Meribah, where the Israelites quarreled with the Lord and where he was proved holy among them.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the waters of Meribah, where the people of Israel quarreled with the Lord , and through them he showed himself holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: This was the water of Meribah, because the children of Israel contended with the Lord, and He was hallowed among them.
verses.textEnNlt: This place was known as the waters of Meribah (which means "arguing") because there the people of Israel argued with the Lord , and there he demonstrated his holiness among them.
verses.textEnNasb: Those were called the waters of Meribah, because the sons of Israel argued with the Lord, and He proved Himself holy among them.
verses.textEn: These were the waters of Meribah, where the Israelites quarreled with the Lord and where he was proved holy among them.

verses.textZh: 摩西从加低斯派使者去见以东王说："你的兄弟以色列这样说：你知道我们遭遇的一切困难，
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西从加低斯派使者去见以东王说："你的兄弟以色列这样说：你知道我们遭遇的一切困难，
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西从加低斯差遣使者去见以东王，说：「你的弟兄以色列人这样说：『我们所遭遇的一切艰难，
verses.textEnNiv: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: "This is what your brother Israel says: You know about all the hardships that have come on us.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom: "Thus says your brother Israel: You know all the hardship that we have met:
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom. "Thus says your brother Israel: ‘You know all the hardship that has befallen us,
verses.textEnNlt: While Moses was at Kadesh, he sent ambassadors to the king of Edom with this message: "This is what your relatives, the people of Israel, say: You know all the hardships we have been through.
verses.textEnNasb: From Kadesh Moses then sent messengers to the king of Edom to say, "This is what your brother Israel has said: ‘You know all the hardship that has overtaken us;
verses.textEn: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: "This is what your brother Israel says: You know about all the hardships that have come on us.

verses.textZh: 就是我们的列祖下到埃及去，我们在埃及住了很多日子；埃及人恶待我们和我们的列祖；
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是我们的列祖下到埃及去，我们在埃及住了很多日子；埃及人恶待我们和我们的列祖；
verses.textZhCuv: 就是我们的列祖下到埃及，我们在埃及久住；埃及人恶待我们的列祖和我们，
verses.textEnNiv: Our ancestors went down into Egypt, and we lived there many years. The Egyptians mistreated us and our ancestors,
verses.textEnEsv: how our fathers went down to Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time. And the Egyptians dealt harshly with us and our fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: how our fathers went down to Egypt, and we dwelt in Egypt a long time, and the Egyptians afflicted us and our fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: Our ancestors went down to Egypt, and we lived there a long time, and we and our ancestors were brutally mistreated by the Egyptians.
verses.textEnNasb: that our fathers went down to Egypt, and we stayed in Egypt a long time, and the Egyptians treated us and our fathers badly.
verses.textEn: Our ancestors went down into Egypt, and we lived there many years. The Egyptians mistreated us and our ancestors,

verses.textZh: 我们向耶和华呼求，他就听了我们的声音，派使者把我们从埃及领出来；现在我们就在你边界上的城加低斯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们向耶和华呼求，他就听了我们的声音，派使者把我们从埃及领出来；现在我们就在你边界上的城加低斯。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们哀求耶和华的时候，他听了我们的声音，差遣使者把我们从埃及领出来。这事你都知道。如今，我们在你边界上的城加低斯。
verses.textEnNiv: but when we cried out to the Lord , he heard our cry and sent an angel and brought us out of Egypt. "Now we are here at Kadesh, a town on the edge of your territory.
verses.textEnEsv: And when we cried to the Lord , he heard our voice and sent an angel and brought us out of Egypt. And here we are in Kadesh, a city on the edge of your territory.
verses.textEnNkjv: When we cried out to the Lord, He heard our voice and sent the Angel and brought us up out of Egypt; now here we are in Kadesh, a city on the edge of your border.
verses.textEnNlt: But when we cried out to the Lord , he heard us and sent an angel who brought us out of Egypt. Now we are camped at Kadesh, a town on the border of your land.
verses.textEnNasb: But when we cried out to the Lord, He heard our voice and sent an angel, and brought us out from Egypt; now behold, we are at Kadesh, a town on the edge of your territory.
verses.textEn: but when we cried out to the Lord , he heard our cry and sent an angel and brought us out of Egypt. "Now we are here at Kadesh, a town on the edge of your territory.

verses.textZh: 求你容我们从你的地经过；我们不走过田地和葡萄园，也不喝井里的水，我们只走大路，不偏左也不偏右，直到走过了你的境地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你容我们从你的地经过；我们不走过田地和葡萄园，也不喝井里的水，我们只走大路，不偏左也不偏右，直到走过了你的境地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 求你容我们从你的地经过。我们不走田间和葡萄园，也不喝井里的水，只走大道 ，不偏左右，直到过了你的境界。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Please let us pass through your country. We will not go through any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will travel along the King’s Highway and not turn to the right or to the left until we have passed through your territory."
verses.textEnEsv: Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or vineyard, or drink water from a well. We will go along the King’s Highway. We will not turn aside to the right hand or to the left until we have passed through your territory."
verses.textEnNkjv: Please let us pass through your country. We will not pass through fields or vineyards, nor will we drink water from wells; we will go along the King’s Highway; we will not turn aside to the right hand or to the left until we have passed through your territory.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Please let us travel through your land. We will be careful not to go through your fields and vineyards. We won’t even drink water from your wells. We will stay on the king’s road and never leave it until we have passed through your territory."
verses.textEnNasb: Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or vineyard; we will not even drink water from a well. We will go along the king’s road, not turning to the right or left, until we pass through your territory.’ "
verses.textEn: Please let us pass through your country. We will not go through any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will travel along the King’s Highway and not turn to the right or to the left until we have passed through your territory."

verses.textZh: 以东王对使者说："你不可从我这里经过，免得我带着刀出来攻击你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以东王对使者说："你不可从我这里经过，免得我带着刀出来攻击你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以东王说：「你不可从我的地经过，免得我带刀出去攻击你。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Edom answered: "You may not pass through here; if you try, we will march out and attack you with the sword."
verses.textEnEsv: But Edom said to him, "You shall not pass through, lest I come out with the sword against you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Edom said to him, "You shall not pass through my land, lest I come out against you with the sword."
verses.textEnNlt: But the king of Edom said, "Stay out of my land, or I will meet you with an army!"
verses.textEnNasb: Edom, however, said to him, "You shall not pass through us, or I will come out with the sword against you."
verses.textEn: But Edom answered: "You may not pass through here; if you try, we will march out and attack you with the sword."

verses.textZh: 以色列人对他说："我们要走大路上去，我们和牲畜若是喝了你的水，我必照价付你；不求别的事，只求你容我们步行经过。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人对他说："我们要走大路上去，我们和牲畜若是喝了你的水，我必照价付你；不求别的事，只求你容我们步行经过。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人说：「我们要走大道上去；我们和牲畜若喝你的水，必给你价值。不求别的，只求你容我们步行过去。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites replied: "We will go along the main road, and if we or our livestock drink any of your water, we will pay for it. We only want to pass through on foot—nothing else."
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel said to him, "We will go up by the highway, and if we drink of your water, I and my livestock, then I will pay for it. Let me only pass through on foot, nothing more."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the children of Israel said to him, "We will go by the Highway, and if I or my livestock drink any of your water, then I will pay for it; let me only pass through on foot, nothing more."
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites answered, "We will stay on the main road. If our livestock drink your water, we will pay for it. Just let us pass through your country. That’s all we ask."
verses.textEnNasb: Again, the sons of Israel said to him, "We will go up by the road, and if I and my livestock do drink any of your water, then I will pay its price. Let me only pass through on my feet, nothing more."
verses.textEn: The Israelites replied: "We will go along the main road, and if we or our livestock drink any of your water, we will pay for it. We only want to pass through on foot—nothing else."

verses.textZh: 以东王说："你不可经过。"他就率领很多人出来，要用强硬的手攻击以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以东王说："你不可经过。"他就率领很多人出来，要用强硬的手攻击以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以东王说：「你们不可经过！」就率领许多人出来，要用强硬的手攻击以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: Again they answered: "You may not pass through." Then Edom came out against them with a large and powerful army.
verses.textEnEsv: But he said, "You shall not pass through." And Edom came out against them with a large army and with a strong force.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "You shall not pass through." So Edom came out against them with many men and with a strong hand.
verses.textEnNlt: But the king of Edom replied, "Stay out! You may not pass through our land." With that he mobilized his army and marched out against them with an imposing force.
verses.textEnNasb: But he said, "You shall not pass through." And Edom came out against him with a heavy force and a strong hand.
verses.textEn: Again they answered: "You may not pass through." Then Edom came out against them with a large and powerful army.

verses.textZh: 这样，以东王不肯让以色列人从他的境内经过，以色列人就离开他去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，以东王不肯让以色列人从他的境内经过，以色列人就离开他去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，以东王不肯容以色列人从他的境界过去。于是他们转去，离开他。
verses.textEnNiv: Since Edom refused to let them go through their territory, Israel turned away from them.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his territory, so Israel turned away from him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his territory; so Israel turned away from him.
verses.textEnNlt: Because Edom refused to allow Israel to pass through their country, Israel was forced to turn around.
verses.textEnNasb: So Edom refused to allow Israel to pass through his territory; then Israel turned away from him.
verses.textEn: Since Edom refused to let them go through their territory, Israel turned away from them.

verses.textZh: 以色列全体会众从加低斯起行，到了何珥山。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列全体会众从加低斯起行，到了何珥山。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列全会众从加低斯起行，到了何珥山。
verses.textEnNiv: The whole Israelite community set out from Kadesh and came to Mount Hor.
verses.textEnEsv: And they journeyed from Kadesh, and the people of Israel, the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the children of Israel, the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh and came to Mount Hor.
verses.textEnNlt: The whole community of Israel left Kadesh and arrived at Mount Hor.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when they set out from Kadesh, the sons of Israel, the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.
verses.textEn: The whole Israelite community set out from Kadesh and came to Mount Hor.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在以东地边界的何珥山对摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在以东地边界的何珥山对摩西和亚伦说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在附近以东边界的何珥山上晓谕摩西、亚伦说：
verses.textEnNiv: At Mount Hor, near the border of Edom, the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron at Mount Hor, on the border of the land of Edom,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor by the border of the land of Edom, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: There, on the border of the land of Edom, the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron at Mount Hor by the border of the land of Edom, saying,
verses.textEn: At Mount Hor, near the border of Edom, the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

verses.textZh: "亚伦要归到他本族人那里去，他必不得进入我赐给以色列人的那地，因为在米利巴水的事上，你们违背了我的吩咐。
verses.textZhCnvs: "亚伦要归到他本族人那里去，他必不得进入我赐给以色列人的那地，因为在米利巴水的事上，你们违背了我的吩咐。
verses.textZhCuv: 「亚伦要归到他列祖 那里。他必不得入我所赐给以色列人的地；因为在米利巴水，你们违背了我的命。
verses.textEnNiv: "Aaron will be gathered to his people. He will not enter the land I give the Israelites, because both of you rebelled against my command at the waters of Meribah.
verses.textEnEsv: "Let Aaron be gathered to his people, for he shall not enter the land that I have given to the people of Israel, because you rebelled against my command at the waters of Meribah.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Aaron shall be gathered to his people, for he shall not enter the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against My word at the water of Meribah.
verses.textEnNlt: "The time has come for Aaron to join his ancestors in death. He will not enter the land I am giving the people of Israel, because the two of you rebelled against my instructions concerning the water at Meribah.
verses.textEnNasb: "Aaron will be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter the land which I have given to the sons of Israel, because you rebelled against My command at the waters of Meribah.
verses.textEn: "Aaron will be gathered to his people. He will not enter the land I give the Israelites, because both of you rebelled against my command at the waters of Meribah.

verses.textZh: 你要带着亚伦和他的儿子以利亚撒，一同上何珥山去；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要带着亚伦和他的儿子以利亚撒，一同上何珥山去；
verses.textZhCuv: 你带亚伦和他的儿子以利亚撒上何珥山，
verses.textEnNiv: Get Aaron and his son Eleazar and take them up Mount Hor.
verses.textEnEsv: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son and bring them up to Mount Hor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;
verses.textEnNlt: Now take Aaron and his son Eleazar up Mount Hor.
verses.textEnNasb: Take Aaron and his son Eleazar, and bring them up to Mount Hor.
verses.textEn: Get Aaron and his son Eleazar and take them up Mount Hor.

verses.textZh: 把亚伦的衣服脱下来，给他儿子以利亚撒穿上；亚伦就归到他本族人那里去，死在山上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 把亚伦的衣服脱下来，给他儿子以利亚撒穿上；亚伦就归到他本族人那里去，死在山上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 把亚伦的圣衣脱下来，给他的儿子以利亚撒穿上；亚伦必死在那里，归他列祖。」
verses.textEnNiv: Remove Aaron’s garments and put them on his son Eleazar, for Aaron will be gathered to his people; he will die there."
verses.textEnEsv: And strip Aaron of his garments and put them on Eleazar his son. And Aaron shall be gathered to his people and shall die there."
verses.textEnNkjv: and strip Aaron of his garments and put them on Eleazar his son; for Aaron shall be gathered tohispeople and die there."
verses.textEnNlt: There you will remove Aaron’s priestly garments and put them on Eleazar, his son. Aaron will die there and join his ancestors."
verses.textEnNasb: Then strip Aaron of his garments and put them on his son Eleazar. So Aaron will be gathered to his people and will die there."
verses.textEn: Remove Aaron’s garments and put them on his son Eleazar, for Aaron will be gathered to his people; he will die there."

verses.textZh: 摩西就照着耶和华吩咐的行了，三人当着全体会众的眼前上了何珥山。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西就照着耶和华吩咐的行了，三人当着全体会众的眼前上了何珥山。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西就照耶和华所吩咐的行。三人当着会众的眼前上了何珥山。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses did as the Lord commanded: They went up Mount Hor in the sight of the whole community.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses did as the Lord commanded. And they went up Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses did just as the Lord commanded, and they went up to Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses did as the Lord commanded. The three of them went up Mount Hor together as the whole community watched.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses did just as the Lord had commanded, and they went up to Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
verses.textEn: Moses did as the Lord commanded: They went up Mount Hor in the sight of the whole community.

verses.textZh: 摩西把亚伦的衣服脱下来，给他的儿子以利亚撒穿上；亚伦就死在山顶那里。于是，摩西和以利亚撒从山上下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西把亚伦的衣服脱下来，给他的儿子以利亚撒穿上；亚伦就死在山顶那里。于是，摩西和以利亚撒从山上下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西把亚伦的圣衣脱下来，给他的儿子以利亚撒穿上，亚伦就死在山顶那里。于是摩西和以利亚撒下了山。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses removed Aaron’s garments and put them on his son Eleazar. And Aaron died there on top of the mountain. Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain,
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments and put them on Eleazar his son. And Aaron died there on the top of the mountain. Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments and put them on Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there on the top of the mountain. Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
verses.textEnNlt: At the summit, Moses removed the priestly garments from Aaron and put them on Eleazar, Aaron’s son. Then Aaron died there on top of the mountain, and Moses and Eleazar went back down.
verses.textEnNasb: And after Moses stripped Aaron of his garments and put them on his son Eleazar, Aaron died there on the mountain top. Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
verses.textEn: Moses removed Aaron’s garments and put them on his son Eleazar. And Aaron died there on top of the mountain. Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain,

verses.textZh: 全体会众见亚伦死了，以色列全家就为亚伦哀哭了三十天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全体会众见亚伦死了，以色列全家就为亚伦哀哭了三十天。
verses.textZhCuv: 全会众，就是以色列全家，见亚伦已经死了，便都为亚伦哀哭了三十天。
verses.textEnNiv: and when the whole community learned that Aaron had died, all the Israelites mourned for him thirty days.
verses.textEnEsv: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron had perished, all the house of Israel wept for Aaron thirty days.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, all the house of Israel mourned for Aaron thirty days.
verses.textEnNlt: When the people realized that Aaron had died, all Israel mourned for him thirty days.
verses.textEnNasb: When all the congregation saw that Aaron had died, the whole house of Israel wept for Aaron for thirty days.
verses.textEn: and when the whole community learned that Aaron had died, all the Israelites mourned for him thirty days.

verses.textZh: 住在南地的迦南人亚拉得王，听说以色列人从亚他林路来，就与以色列人交战，掳了他们几个人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 住在南地的迦南人亚拉得王，听说以色列人从亚他林路来，就与以色列人交战，掳了他们几个人。
verses.textZhCuv: 住南地的迦南人亚拉得王，听说以色列人从亚他林路来，就和以色列人争战，掳了他们几个人。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev, heard that Israel was coming along the road to Atharim, he attacked the Israelites and captured some of them.
verses.textEnEsv: When the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the Negeb, heard that Israel was coming by the way of Atharim, he fought against Israel, and took some of them captive.
verses.textEnNkjv: The king of Arad, the Canaanite, who dwelt in the South, heard that Israel was coming on the road to Atharim. Then he fought against Israel and took some of them prisoners.
verses.textEnNlt: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev, heard that the Israelites were approaching on the road through Atharim. So he attacked the Israelites and took some of them as prisoners.
verses.textEnNasb: When the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the Negev, heard that Israel was coming by the way of Atharim, he fought against Israel and took some of them captive.
verses.textEn: When the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev, heard that Israel was coming along the road to Atharim, he attacked the Israelites and captured some of them.

verses.textZh: 于是以色列人向耶和华许愿，说："如果你把这民交在我手里，我就必把他们的城尽行毁灭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以色列人向耶和华许愿，说："如果你把这民交在我手里，我就必把他们的城尽行毁灭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人向耶和华发愿说：「你若将这民交付我手，我就把他们的城邑尽行毁灭。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Israel made this vow to the Lord : "If you will deliver these people into our hands, we will totally destroy their cities."
verses.textEnEsv: And Israel vowed a vow to the Lord and said, "If you will indeed give this people into my hand, then I will devote their cities to destruction."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Israel made a vow to the Lord, and said, "If You will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people of Israel made this vow to the Lord : "If you will hand these people over to us, we will completely destroy all their towns."
verses.textEnNasb: So Israel made a vow to the Lord and said, "If You will indeed hand over this people to me, then I will utterly destroy their cities."
verses.textEn: Then Israel made this vow to the Lord : "If you will deliver these people into our hands, we will totally destroy their cities."

verses.textZh: 耶和华听了以色列人的祈求，就把迦南人交给他们，于是他们把迦南人和他们的城尽行毁灭；那地方的名就叫何珥玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华听了以色列人的祈求，就把迦南人交给他们，于是他们把迦南人和他们的城尽行毁灭；那地方的名就叫何珥玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华应允了以色列人，把迦南人交付他们，他们就把迦南人和迦南人的城邑尽行毁灭。那地方的名便叫何珥玛 。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord listened to Israel’s plea and gave the Canaanites over to them. They completely destroyed them and their towns; so the place was named Hormah.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord heeded the voice of Israel and gave over the Canaanites, and they devoted them and their cities to destruction. So the name of the place was called Hormah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord listened to the voice of Israel and delivered up the Canaanites, and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. So the name of that place was called Hormah.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord heard the Israelites’ request and gave them victory over the Canaanites. The Israelites completely destroyed them and their towns, and the place has been called Hormah ever since.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord heard the voice of Israel and turned over the Canaanites; then they utterly destroyed them and their cities. And the place was named Hormah.
verses.textEn: The Lord listened to Israel’s plea and gave the Canaanites over to them. They completely destroyed them and their towns; so the place was named Hormah.

verses.textZh: 他们从何珥山沿着到红海的路起行，要绕过以东地；众民因为这条路，心里烦躁，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从何珥山沿着到红海的路起行，要绕过以东地；众民因为这条路，心里烦躁，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们从何珥山起行，往红海那条路走，要绕过以东地。百姓因这路难行，心中甚是烦躁，
verses.textEnNiv: They traveled from Mount Hor along the route to the Red Sea, to go around Edom. But the people grew impatient on the way;
verses.textEnEsv: From Mount Hor they set out by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. And the people became impatient on the way.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they journeyed from Mount Hor by the Way of the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom; and the soul of the people became very discouraged on the way.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people of Israel set out from Mount Hor, taking the road to the Red Sea to go around the land of Edom. But the people grew impatient with the long journey,
verses.textEnNasb: Then they set out from Mount Hor by the way of the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom; and the people became impatient because of the journey.
verses.textEn: They traveled from Mount Hor along the route to the Red Sea, to go around Edom. But the people grew impatient on the way;

verses.textZh: 就反抗神和摩西，说："你们为甚么把我们从埃及领上来，使我们死在旷野呢？这里没有粮食，又没有水，我们的心厌恶这淡薄的食物。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就反抗神和摩西，说："你们为甚么把我们从埃及领上来，使我们死在旷野呢？这里没有粮食，又没有水，我们的心厌恶这淡薄的食物。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就怨神和摩西说：「你们为什么把我们从埃及领出来、使我们死在旷野呢？这里没有粮，没有水，我们的心厌恶这淡薄的食物。」
verses.textEnNiv: they spoke against God and against Moses, and said, "Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? There is no bread! There is no water! And we detest this miserable food!"
verses.textEnEsv: And the people spoke against God and against Moses, "Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no food and no water, and we loathe this worthless food."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the people spoke against God and against Moses: "Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For thereis no food and no water, and our soul loathes this worthless bread."
verses.textEnNlt: and they began to speak against God and Moses. "Why have you brought us out of Egypt to die here in the wilderness?" they complained. "There is nothing to eat here and nothing to drink. And we hate this horrible manna!"
verses.textEnNasb: So the people spoke against God and Moses: "Why have you brought us up from Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no food and no water, and we are disgusted with this miserable food."
verses.textEn: they spoke against God and against Moses, and said, "Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? There is no bread! There is no water! And we detest this miserable food!"

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华打发火蛇进入人民中间；蛇咬他们，许多以色列人就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华打发火蛇进入人民中间；蛇咬他们，许多以色列人就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是耶和华使火蛇进入百姓中间，蛇就咬他们。以色列人中死了许多。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord sent venomous snakes among them; they bit the people and many Israelites died.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people, so that many people of Israel died.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and many of the people of Israel died.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord sent poisonous snakes among the people, and many were bitten and died.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord sent fiery serpents among the people and they bit the people, so that many people of Israel died.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord sent venomous snakes among them; they bit the people and many Israelites died.

verses.textZh: 人民来见摩西，说："我们有罪了，因为我们出恶言攻击耶和华和你；求你向耶和华祷告，叫这些蛇离开我们。"于是摩西为众人祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人民来见摩西，说："我们有罪了，因为我们出恶言攻击耶和华和你；求你向耶和华祷告，叫这些蛇离开我们。"于是摩西为众人祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓到摩西那里，说：「我们怨耶和华和你，有罪了。求你祷告耶和华，叫这些蛇离开我们。」于是摩西为百姓祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: The people came to Moses and said, "We sinned when we spoke against the Lord and against you. Pray that the Lord will take the snakes away from us." So Moses prayed for the people.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people came to Moses and said, "We have sinned, for we have spoken against the Lord and against you. Pray to the Lord , that he take away the serpents from us." So Moses prayed for the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, "We have sinned, for we have spoken against the Lord and against you; pray to the Lord that He take away the serpents from us." So Moses prayed for the people.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people came to Moses and cried out, "We have sinned by speaking against the Lord and against you. Pray that the Lord will take away the snakes." So Moses prayed for the people.
verses.textEnNasb: So the people came to Moses and said, "We have sinned, because we have spoken against the Lord and against you; intercede with the Lord, that He will remove the serpents from us." And Moses interceded for the people.
verses.textEn: The people came to Moses and said, "We sinned when we spoke against the Lord and against you. Pray that the Lord will take the snakes away from us." So Moses prayed for the people.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："你要做一条火蛇，挂在杆上；被咬的，一看这蛇，就必得存活。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："你要做一条火蛇，挂在杆上；被咬的，一看这蛇，就必得存活。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「你制造一条火蛇，挂在杆子上；凡被咬的，一望这蛇，就必得活。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses, "Make a snake and put it up on a pole; anyone who is bitten can look at it and live."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses, "Make a fiery serpent and set it on a pole, and everyone who is bitten, when he sees it, shall live."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Make a fiery serpent, and set it on a pole; and it shall be that everyone who is bitten, when he looks at it, shall live."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord told him, "Make a replica of a poisonous snake and attach it to a pole. All who are bitten will live if they simply look at it!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Moses, " Make a fiery serpent, and put it on a flag pole; and it shall come about, that everyone who is bitten, and looks at it, will live."
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses, "Make a snake and put it up on a pole; anyone who is bitten can look at it and live."

verses.textZh: 摩西就做了一条铜蛇，挂在杆上；被蛇咬了的人，一望这铜蛇，就活了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西就做了一条铜蛇，挂在杆上；被蛇咬了的人，一望这铜蛇，就活了。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西便制造一条铜蛇，挂在杆子上；凡被蛇咬的，一望这铜蛇就活了。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses made a bronze snake and put it up on a pole. Then when anyone was bitten by a snake and looked at the bronze snake, they lived.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses made a bronze serpent and set it on a pole. And if a serpent bit anyone, he would look at the bronze serpent and live.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses made a bronze serpent, and put it on a pole; and so it was, if a serpent had bitten anyone, when he looked at the bronze serpent, he lived.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses made a snake out of bronze and attached it to a pole. Then anyone who was bitten by a snake could look at the bronze snake and be healed!
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses made a bronze serpent and put it on the flag pole; and it came about, that if a serpent bit someone, and he looked at the bronze serpent, he lived.
verses.textEn: So Moses made a bronze snake and put it up on a pole. Then when anyone was bitten by a snake and looked at the bronze snake, they lived.

verses.textZh: 以色列人又起行，在阿伯安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人又起行，在阿伯安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人起行，安营在阿伯。

verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites traveled next to Oboth and camped there.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the sons of Israel moved out and camped in Oboth.
verses.textEn: The Israelites moved on and camped at Oboth.

verses.textZh: 再从阿伯起行，在以耶．亚巴琳安营，就是摩押对面的旷野，向日出之地。

verses.textEnNiv: Then they set out from Oboth and camped in Iye Abarim, in the wilderness that faces Moab toward the sunrise.
verses.textEnEsv: And they set out from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim, in the wilderness that is opposite Moab, toward the sunrise.

verses.textEnNlt: Then they went on to Iye-abarim, in the wilderness on the eastern border of Moab.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they journeyed from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim, in the wilderness which is opposite Moab, to the east.
verses.textEn: Then they set out from Oboth and camped in Iye Abarim, in the wilderness that faces Moab toward the sunrise.

verses.textZh: 他们又从那里起行，在撒烈谷安营。

verses.textEnNkjv: From there they moved and camped in the Valley of Zered.
verses.textEnNlt: From there they traveled to the valley of Zered Brook and set up camp.
verses.textEnNasb: From there they set out and camped in Wadi Zered.
verses.textEn: From there they moved on and camped in the Zered Valley.

verses.textZh: 又从那里起行，在亚嫩河那边安营；这亚嫩河是在旷野，从亚摩利人的境内流出来；原来亚嫩河就是摩押的边界，在摩押与亚摩利人之间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从那里起行，在亚嫩河那边安营；这亚嫩河是在旷野，从亚摩利人的境内流出来；原来亚嫩河就是摩押的边界，在摩押与亚摩利人之间。
verses.textZhCuv: 从那里起行，安营在亚嫩河那边。这亚嫩河是在旷野，从亚摩利的境界流出来的；原来亚嫩河是摩押的边界，在摩押和亚摩利人搭界的地方。
verses.textEnNiv: They set out from there and camped alongside the Arnon, which is in the wilderness extending into Amorite territory. The Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
verses.textEnEsv: From there they set out and camped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness that extends from the border of the Amorites, for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
verses.textEnNkjv: From there they moved and camped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness that extends from the border of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they moved out and camped on the far side of the Arnon River, in the wilderness adjacent to the territory of the Amorites. The Arnon is the boundary line between the Moabites and the Amorites.
verses.textEnNasb: From there they journeyed and camped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness that comes out of the border of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
verses.textEn: They set out from there and camped alongside the Arnon, which is in the wilderness extending into Amorite territory. The Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

verses.textEnEsv: and the slope of the valleys that extends to the seat of Ar, and leans to the border of Moab."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the slope of the brooks That reaches to the dwelling of Ar, And lies on the border of Moab."
verses.textEnNlt: and the ravines that extend as far as the settlement of Ar on the border of Moab."
verses.textEnNasb: And the slope of the wadis That extends to the site of Ar, And leans to the border of Moab."
verses.textEn: and the slopes of the ravines that lead to the settlement of Ar and lie along the border of Moab."

verses.textZh: 以色列人又从那里到了比珥 ；从前耶和华对摩西说："你要聚集众民，我好把水给他们喝"，说的就是这个井。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人又从那里到了比珥 ；从前耶和华对摩西说："你要聚集众民，我好把水给他们喝"，说的就是这个井。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人从那里起行，到了比珥 。从前耶和华吩咐摩西说：「招聚百姓，我好给他们水喝」，说的就是这井。
verses.textEnNiv: From there they continued on to Beer, the well where the Lord said to Moses, "Gather the people together and I will give them water."
verses.textEnEsv: And from there they continued to Beer; that is the well of which the Lord said to Moses, "Gather the people together, so that I may give them water."
verses.textEnNkjv: From there theywent to Beer, which is the well where the Lord said to Moses, "Gather the people together, and I will give them water."
verses.textEnNlt: From there the Israelites traveled to Beer, which is the well where the Lord said to Moses, "Assemble the people, and I will give them water."
verses.textEnNasb: From there they continued to Beer, that is the well where the Lord said to Moses, "Assemble the people, that I may give them water."
verses.textEn: From there they continued on to Beer, the well where the Lord said to Moses, "Gather the people together and I will give them water."

verses.textZh: 那时，以色列人就唱了这首歌，说： "井啊，涌上水来。 你们要向这井歌唱。

verses.textEnNlt: There the Israelites sang this song: "Spring up, O well! Yes, sing its praises!
verses.textEnNasb: Then Israel sang this song: "Spring up, O well! Sing to it!
verses.textEn: Then Israel sang this song: "Spring up, O well! Sing about it,

verses.textZhCuv: 这井是首领和民中的尊贵人 用圭用杖所挖所掘的。 以色列人从旷野往玛他拿去，
verses.textEnNiv: about the well that the princes dug, that the nobles of the people sank— the nobles with scepters and staffs." Then they went from the wilderness to Mattanah,
verses.textEnEsv: the well that the princes made, that the nobles of the people dug, with the scepter and with their staffs." And from the wilderness they went on to Mattanah,
verses.textEnNkjv: The well the leaders sank, Dug by the nation’s nobles, By the lawgiver, with their staves." And from the wilderness theywent to Mattanah,
verses.textEnNlt: Sing of this well, which princes dug, which great leaders hollowed out with their scepters and staffs." Then the Israelites left the wilderness and proceeded on through Mattanah,
verses.textEnNasb: "The well, which the leaders dug, Which the nobles of the people hollowed out, With the scepter and with their staffs." And from the wilderness they continued to Mattanah,
verses.textEn: about the well that the princes dug, that the nobles of the people sank— the nobles with scepters and staffs." Then they went from the wilderness to Mattanah,

verses.textEnEsv: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel, and from Nahaliel to Bamoth,
verses.textEnNkjv: from Mattanah to Nahaliel, from Nahaliel to Bamoth,

verses.textEnNasb: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel, and from Nahaliel to Bamoth,
verses.textEn: from Mattanah to Nahaliel, from Nahaliel to Bamoth,

verses.textZh: 从巴末到摩押地的谷，又到了俯瞰荒野的毘斯迦山顶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从巴末到摩押地的谷，又到了俯瞰荒野的毘斯迦山顶。
verses.textZhCuv: 从巴末到摩押地的谷，又到那下望旷野之毗斯迦的山顶。
verses.textEnNiv: and from Bamoth to the valley in Moab where the top of Pisgah overlooks the wasteland.
verses.textEnEsv: and from Bamoth to the valley lying in the region of Moab by the top of Pisgah that looks down on the desert.
verses.textEnNkjv: and from Bamoth, in the valley that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah which looks down on the wasteland.
verses.textEnNlt: After that they went to the valley in Moab where Pisgah Peak overlooks the wasteland.
verses.textEnNasb: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the land of Moab, at the top of Pisgah, which overlooks the desert.
verses.textEn: and from Bamoth to the valley in Moab where the top of Pisgah overlooks the wasteland.

verses.textZh: 以色列人派使者去见亚摩利人的王西宏说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人派使者去见亚摩利人的王西宏说：
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人差遣使者去见亚摩利人的王西宏，说：
verses.textEnNiv: Israel sent messengers to say to Sihon king of the Amorites:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites sent ambassadors to King Sihon of the Amorites with this message:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Israel sent messengers to Sihon, king of the Amorites, saying,
verses.textEn: Israel sent messengers to say to Sihon king of the Amorites:

verses.textZh: "求你容我们从你的地经过；我们不偏入田间和葡萄园，也不喝井里的水；我们只走大路，直到过了你的境界。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "求你容我们从你的地经过；我们不偏入田间和葡萄园，也不喝井里的水；我们只走大路，直到过了你的境界。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「求你容我们从你的地经过；我们不偏入田间和葡萄园，也不喝井里的水，只走大道 ，直到过了你的境界。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Let us pass through your country. We will not turn aside into any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will travel along the King’s Highway until we have passed through your territory."
verses.textEnEsv: "Let me pass through your land. We will not turn aside into field or vineyard. We will not drink the water of a well. We will go by the King’s Highway until we have passed through your territory."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Let me pass through your land. We will not turn aside into fields or vineyards; we will not drink water from wells. We will go by the King’s Highway until we have passed through your territory."
verses.textEnNlt: "Let us travel through your land. We will be careful not to go through your fields and vineyards. We won’t even drink water from your wells. We will stay on the king’s road until we have passed through your territory."
verses.textEnNasb: "Let me pass through your land. We will not turn off into field or vineyard; we will not drink water from wells. We will go by the king’s road until we have passed through your border."
verses.textEn: "Let us pass through your country. We will not turn aside into any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will travel along the King’s Highway until we have passed through your territory."

verses.textZh: 西宏不容以色列人从他的境界经过，反而聚集了自己的人民，出到旷野去攻击以色列人，西宏到了雅杂，与以色列人交战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西宏不容以色列人从他的境界经过，反而聚集了自己的人民，出到旷野去攻击以色列人，西宏到了雅杂，与以色列人交战。
verses.textZhCuv: 西宏不容以色列人从他的境界经过，就招聚他的众民出到旷野，要攻击以色列人，到了雅杂与以色列人争战。
verses.textEnNiv: But Sihon would not let Israel pass through his territory. He mustered his entire army and marched out into the wilderness against Israel. When he reached Jahaz, he fought with Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: But Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his territory. He gathered all his people together and went out against Israel to the wilderness and came to Jahaz and fought against Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his territory. So Sihon gathered all his people together and went out against Israel in the wilderness, and he came to Jahaz and fought against Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: But King Sihon refused to let them cross his territory. Instead, he mobilized his entire army and attacked Israel in the wilderness, engaging them in battle at Jahaz.
verses.textEnNasb: But Sihon would not permit Israel to pass through his border. Instead, Sihon gathered all his people and went out against Israel in the wilderness, and came to Jahaz and fought against Israel.
verses.textEn: But Sihon would not let Israel pass through his territory. He mustered his entire army and marched out into the wilderness against Israel. When he reached Jahaz, he fought with Israel.

verses.textZh: 以色列人用刀击杀了他，占领了他的地，从亚嫩河到雅博河，直到亚扪人那里，因为雅谢是亚扪人的边界 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人用刀击杀了他，占领了他的地，从亚嫩河到雅博河，直到亚扪人那里，因为雅谢是亚扪人的边界 。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人用刀杀了他，得了他的地，从亚嫩河到雅博河，直到亚扪人的境界，因为亚扪人的境界多有坚垒。
verses.textEnNiv: Israel, however, put him to the sword and took over his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, but only as far as the Ammonites, because their border was fortified.
verses.textEnEsv: And Israel defeated him with the edge of the sword and took possession of his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, as far as to the Ammonites, for the border of the Ammonites was strong.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Israel defeated him with the edge of the sword, and took possession of his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, as far as the people of Ammon; for the border of the people of Ammon was fortified.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Israelites slaughtered them with their swords and occupied their land from the Arnon River to the Jabbok River. They went only as far as the Ammonite border because the boundary of the Ammonites was fortified.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and took possession of his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, as far as the sons of Ammon; for the border of the sons of Ammon was Jazer.
verses.textEn: Israel, however, put him to the sword and took over his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, but only as far as the Ammonites, because their border was fortified.

verses.textZh: 以色列人夺取了这一切城，也住在亚摩利人的各城，就是希实本，与属于希实本的一切村庄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人夺取了这一切城，也住在亚摩利人的各城，就是希实本，与属于希实本的一切村庄。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人夺取这一切的城邑，也住亚摩利人的城邑，就是希实本与希实本的一切乡村。
verses.textEnNiv: Israel captured all the cities of the Amorites and occupied them, including Heshbon and all its surrounding settlements.
verses.textEnEsv: And Israel took all these cities, and Israel settled in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Israel took all these cities, and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon and in all its villages.
verses.textEnNlt: So Israel captured all the towns of the Amorites and settled in them, including the city of Heshbon and its surrounding villages.
verses.textEnNasb: Israel took all these cities, and Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon and in all her villages.
verses.textEn: Israel captured all the cities of the Amorites and occupied them, including Heshbon and all its surrounding settlements.

verses.textZh: 这希实本是亚摩利人的王西宏的京城；西宏曾经与摩押以前的王交战，从他手中夺去了所有的地，直到亚嫩河。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这希实本是亚摩利人的王西宏的京城；西宏曾经与摩押以前的王交战，从他手中夺去了所有的地，直到亚嫩河。
verses.textZhCuv: 这希实本是亚摩利王西宏的京城；西宏曾与摩押的先王争战，从他手中夺取了全地，直到亚嫩河。
verses.textEnNiv: Heshbon was the city of Sihon king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab and had taken from him all his land as far as the Arnon.
verses.textEnEsv: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab and taken all his land out of his hand, as far as the Arnon.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and had taken all his land from his hand as far as the Arnon.
verses.textEnNlt: Heshbon had been the capital of King Sihon of the Amorites. He had defeated a former Moabite king and seized all his land as far as the Arnon River.
verses.textEnNasb: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab and had taken all his land out of his hand, as far as the Arnon.
verses.textEn: Heshbon was the city of Sihon king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab and had taken from him all his land as far as the Arnon.

verses.textZh: 因此诗人说： "你们来到希实本！ 愿西宏的城被重建， 愿西宏的城坚立。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此诗人说： "你们来到希实本！ 愿西宏的城被重建， 愿西宏的城坚立。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以那些作诗歌的说： 你们来到希实本； 愿西宏的城被修造，被建立。
verses.textEnNiv: That is why the poets say: "Come to Heshbon and let it be rebuilt; let Sihon’s city be restored.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the ballad singers say, "Come to Heshbon, let it be built; let the city of Sihon be established.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say: "Come to Heshbon, let it be built; Let the city of Sihon be repaired.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, the ancient poets wrote this about him: "Come to Heshbon and let it be rebuilt! Let the city of Sihon be restored.
verses.textEnNasb: For that reason those who use proverbs say, "Come to Heshbon! Let it be built! So let the city of Sihon be established.
verses.textEn: That is why the poets say: "Come to Heshbon and let it be rebuilt; let Sihon’s city be restored.

verses.textZh: 因为有火从希实本发出， 有火焰从西宏的城冒出， 吞灭了摩押的亚珥， 烧毁了亚嫩河的高冈 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为有火从希实本发出， 有火焰从西宏的城冒出， 吞灭了摩押的亚珥， 烧毁了亚嫩河的高冈 。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为有火从希实本发出， 有火焰出于西宏的城， 烧尽摩押的亚珥和亚嫩河邱坛的祭司 。
verses.textEnNiv: "Fire went out from Heshbon, a blaze from the city of Sihon. It consumed Ar of Moab, the citizens of Arnon’s heights.
verses.textEnEsv: For fire came out from Heshbon, flame from the city of Sihon. It devoured Ar of Moab, and swallowed the heights of the Arnon.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For fire went out from Heshbon, A flame from the city of Sihon; It consumed Ar of Moab, The lords of the heights of the Arnon.
verses.textEnNlt: A fire flamed forth from Heshbon, a blaze from the city of Sihon. It burned the city of Ar in Moab; it destroyed the rulers of the Arnon heights.
verses.textEnNasb: "For a fire spread from Heshbon, A flame from the town of Sihon; It devoured Ar of Moab, The dominant heights of the Arnon.
verses.textEn: "Fire went out from Heshbon, a blaze from the city of Sihon. It consumed Ar of Moab, the citizens of Arnon’s heights.

verses.textZh: 摩押啊，你有祸了， 基抹的民哪，你们灭亡了； 基抹使自己的男子逃亡， 使自己的女子被掳， 交给了亚摩利人的王西宏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押啊，你有祸了， 基抹的民哪，你们灭亡了； 基抹使自己的男子逃亡， 使自己的女子被掳， 交给了亚摩利人的王西宏。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押啊，你有祸了！ 基抹的民哪，你们灭亡了！ 基抹的男子逃奔， 女子被掳，交付亚摩利的王西宏。
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to you, Moab! You are destroyed, people of Chemosh! He has given up his sons as fugitives and his daughters as captives to Sihon king of the Amorites.
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to you, O Moab! You are undone, O people of Chemosh! He has made his sons fugitives, and his daughters captives, to an Amorite king, Sihon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to you, Moab! You have perished, O people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, And his daughters into captivity, To Sihon king of the Amorites.
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow awaits you, O people of Moab! You are finished, O worshipers of Chemosh! Chemosh has left his sons as refugees, his daughters as captives of Sihon, the Amorite king.
verses.textEnNasb: "Woe to you, Moab! You are destroyed, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, And his daughters into captivity, To an Amorite king, Sihon.
verses.textEn: Woe to you, Moab! You are destroyed, people of Chemosh! He has given up his sons as fugitives and his daughters as captives to Sihon king of the Amorites.

verses.textZh: 我们射击他们， 希实本就毁灭，直到底本。 我们使地荒凉，直到挪法， 挪法直伸到米底巴。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们射击他们， 希实本就毁灭，直到底本。 我们使地荒凉，直到挪法， 挪法直伸到米底巴。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们射了他们； 希实本直到底本尽皆毁灭。 我们使地变成荒场，直到挪法； 这挪法直延到米底巴。
verses.textEnNiv: "But we have overthrown them; Heshbon’s dominion has been destroyed all the way to Dibon. We have demolished them as far as Nophah, which extends to Medeba."
verses.textEnEsv: So we overthrew them; Heshbon, as far as Dibon, perished; and we laid waste as far as Nophah; fire spread as far as Medeba."
verses.textEnNkjv: "But we have shot at them; Heshbon has perished as far as Dibon. Then we laid waste as far as Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba."
verses.textEnNlt: We have utterly destroyed them, from Heshbon to Dibon. We have completely wiped them out as far away as Nophah and Medeba. "
verses.textEnNasb: "But we have shot them down with arrows, Heshbon is destroyed as far as Dibon, Then we have laid waste as far as Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba."
verses.textEn: "But we have overthrown them; Heshbon’s dominion has been destroyed all the way to Dibon. We have demolished them as far as Nophah, which extends to Medeba."

verses.textZh: 这样，以色列人就住在亚摩利人的地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，以色列人就住在亚摩利人的地。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，以色列人就住在亚摩利人之地。
verses.textEnNiv: So Israel settled in the land of the Amorites.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.
verses.textEnNlt: So the people of Israel occupied the territory of the Amorites.
verses.textEnNasb: So Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.
verses.textEn: So Israel settled in the land of the Amorites.

verses.textZh: 摩西派人去窥探雅谢，以色列人就占领了雅谢的村镇，把那里的亚摩利人赶走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西派人去窥探雅谢，以色列人就占领了雅谢的村镇，把那里的亚摩利人赶走。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西打发人去窥探雅谢，以色列人就占了雅谢的镇市，赶出那里的亚摩利人。
verses.textEnNiv: After Moses had sent spies to Jazer, the Israelites captured its surrounding settlements and drove out the Amorites who were there.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses sent to spy out Jazer, and they captured its villages and dispossessed the Amorites who were there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses sent to spy out Jazer; and they took its villages and drove out the Amorites who were there.
verses.textEnNlt: After Moses sent men to explore the Jazer area, they captured all the towns in the region and drove out the Amorites who lived there.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Moses sent men to spy out Jazer, and they captured its villages and dispossessed the Amorites who were there.
verses.textEn: After Moses had sent spies to Jazer, the Israelites captured its surrounding settlements and drove out the Amorites who were there.

verses.textZh: 以色列人回头，沿着到巴珊的路上走；巴珊王噩和他的众民都出来迎着以色列人，在以得来与他们交战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人回头，沿着到巴珊的路上走；巴珊王噩和他的众民都出来迎着以色列人，在以得来与他们交战。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人转回，向巴珊去。巴珊王噩和他的众民都出来，在以得来与他们交战。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they turned and went up along the road toward Bashan, and Og king of Bashan and his whole army marched out to meet them in battle at Edrei.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they turned and went up by the way to Bashan. And Og the king of Bashan came out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they turned and went up by the way to Bashan. So Og king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they turned and marched up the road to Bashan, but King Og of Bashan and all his people attacked them at Edrei.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they turned and went up by the way of Bashan, and Og the king of Bashan went out against them with all his people, for battle at Edrei.
verses.textEn: Then they turned and went up along the road toward Bashan, and Og king of Bashan and his whole army marched out to meet them in battle at Edrei.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说："不要怕他，因为我已经把他和他的众民，以及他的地都交在你手里；你要待他，像从前待那住在希实本的亚摩利人的王西宏一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："不要怕他，因为我已经把他和他的众民，以及他的地都交在你手里；你要待他，像从前待那住在希实本的亚摩利人的王西宏一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对摩西说：「不要怕他！因我已将他和他的众民，并他的地，都交在你手中；你要待他像从前待住希实本的亚摩利王西宏一般。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses, "Do not be afraid of him, for I have delivered him into your hands, along with his whole army and his land. Do to him what you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon."
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord said to Moses, "Do not fear him, for I have given him into your hand, and all his people, and his land. And you shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Do not fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, with all his people and his land; and you shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon."
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses, "Do not be afraid of him, for I have handed him over to you, along with all his people and his land. Do the same to him as you did to King Sihon of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon."
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord said to Moses, "Do not fear him, for I have handed him over to you, and all his people and his land; and you shall do to him as you did to Sihon, king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon."
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses, "Do not be afraid of him, for I have delivered him into your hands, along with his whole army and his land. Do to him what you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon."

verses.textZh: 于是，他们杀了噩和他的儿子，以及他的众民，没有留下一个，就占领了他的地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，他们杀了噩和他的儿子，以及他的众民，没有留下一个，就占领了他的地。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是他们杀了他和他的众子，并他的众民，没有留下一个，就得了他的地。
verses.textEnNiv: So they struck him down, together with his sons and his whole army, leaving them no survivors. And they took possession of his land.
verses.textEnEsv: So they defeated him and his sons and all his people, until he had no survivor left. And they possessed his land.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they defeated him, his sons, and all his people, until there was no survivor left him; and they took possession of his land.
verses.textEnNlt: And Israel killed King Og, his sons, and all his subjects; not a single survivor remained. Then Israel occupied their land.
verses.textEnNasb: So they killed him and his sons and all his people, until there was no survivor left; and they took possession of his land.
verses.textEn: So they struck him down, together with his sons and his whole army, leaving them no survivors. And they took possession of his land.

verses.textZh: 以色列人起行，在摩押平原安营，就是在约旦河东边，耶利哥的对面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人起行，在摩押平原安营，就是在约旦河东边，耶利哥的对面。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人起行，在摩押平原、约旦河东，对着耶利哥安营。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Israelites traveled to the plains of Moab and camped along the Jordan across from Jericho.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the people of Israel set out and camped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Israel moved, and camped in the plains of Moab on the side of the Jordan acrossfrom Jericho.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people of Israel traveled to the plains of Moab and camped east of the Jordan River, across from Jericho.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Israel journeyed on, and camped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan opposite Jericho.
verses.textEn: Then the Israelites traveled to the plains of Moab and camped along the Jordan across from Jericho.

verses.textEnNiv: and Moab was terrified because there were so many people. Indeed, Moab was filled with dread because of the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moab was in great dread of the people, because they were many. Moab was overcome with fear of the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moab was exceedingly afraid of the people because they were many, and Moab was sick with dread because of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: And when the people of Moab saw how many Israelites there were, they were terrified.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moab was in great fear because of the people, for they were numerous; and Moab was in dread of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: and Moab was terrified because there were so many people. Indeed, Moab was filled with dread because of the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 摩押人对米甸的长老说："现在这群人要吞并我们四周的一切，好象牛吞吃田间的草一样。"那时西拨的儿子巴勒，作摩押王；
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押人对米甸的长老说："现在这群人要吞并我们四周的一切，好象牛吞吃田间的草一样。"那时西拨的儿子巴勒，作摩押王；
verses.textZhCuv: 对米甸的长老说：「现在这众人要把我们四围所有的一概舔尽，就如牛舔尽田间的草一般。」那时西拨的儿子巴勒作摩押王。
verses.textEnNiv: The Moabites said to the elders of Midian, "This horde is going to lick up everything around us, as an ox licks up the grass of the field." So Balak son of Zippor, who was king of Moab at that time,

verses.textEnNkjv: So Moab said to the elders of Midian, "Now this company will lick up everything around us, as an ox licks up the grass of the field." And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.
verses.textEnNlt: The king of Moab said to the elders of Midian, "This mob will devour everything in sight, like an ox devours grass in the field!" So Balak, king of Moab,
verses.textEnNasb: Moab said to the elders of Midian, "Now this horde will eat up all that is around us, as the ox eats up the grass of the field!" And Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.

verses.textZh: 他就派使者到比珥的儿子巴兰那里去，就是到大河附近的毘夺，亚扪人的地那里，去叫巴兰来，说："你看，有一个民族从埃及出来，遮满了全地，如今住在我的对面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就派使者到比珥的儿子巴兰那里去，就是到大河附近的毘夺，亚扪人的地那里，去叫巴兰来，说："你看，有一个民族从埃及出来，遮满了全地，如今住在我的对面。
verses.textZhCuv: 他差遣使者往大河边的毗夺去，到比珥的儿子巴兰本乡那里，召巴兰来，说：「有一宗民从埃及出来，遮满地面，与我对居。
verses.textEnNiv: sent messengers to summon Balaam son of Beor, who was at Pethor, near the Euphrates River, in his native land. Balak said: "A people has come out of Egypt; they cover the face of the land and have settled next to me.
verses.textEnEsv: sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor at Pethor, which is near the River in the land of the people of Amaw, to call him, saying, "Behold, a people has come out of Egypt. They cover the face of the earth, and they are dwelling opposite me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor at Pethor, which is near the River in the land of the sons of his people, to call him, saying: "Look, a people has come from Egypt. See, they cover the face of the earth, and are settling next to me!
verses.textEnNlt: sent messengers to call Balaam son of Beor, who was living in his native land of Pethor near the Euphrates River. His message said: "Look, a vast horde of people has arrived from Egypt. They cover the face of the earth and are threatening me.
verses.textEnNasb: So he sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, at Pethor, which is near the Euphrates River, in the land of the sons of his people, to call for him, saying, "Behold, a people came out of Egypt; behold, they have covered the surface of the land, and they are living opposite me.
verses.textEn: sent messengers to summon Balaam son of Beor, who was at Pethor, near the Euphrates River, in his native land. Balak said: "A people has come out of Egypt; they cover the face of the land and have settled next to me.

verses.textZh: 现在请你来，替我咒诅这民，因为他们比我强盛，或者我能够击败他们，把他们从这地赶出去；因为我知道你给谁祝福，谁就得福；你咒诅谁，谁就受咒诅。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在请你来，替我咒诅这民，因为他们比我强盛，或者我能够击败他们，把他们从这地赶出去；因为我知道你给谁祝福，谁就得福；你咒诅谁，谁就受咒诅。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这民比我强盛，现在求你来为我咒诅他们，或者我能得胜，攻打他们，赶出此地。因为我知道，你为谁祝福，谁就得福；你咒诅谁，谁就受咒诅。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now come and put a curse on these people, because they are too powerful for me. Perhaps then I will be able to defeat them and drive them out of the land. For I know that whoever you bless is blessed, and whoever you curse is cursed."
verses.textEnEsv: Come now, curse this people for me, since they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I shall be able to defeat them and drive them from the land, for I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore please come at once, curse this people for me, for they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I shall be able to defeat them and drive them out of the land, for I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed."
verses.textEnNlt: Please come and curse these people for me because they are too powerful for me. Then perhaps I will be able to conquer them and drive them from the land. I know that blessings fall on any people you bless, and curses fall on people you curse."
verses.textEnNasb: Now, therefore, please come, curse this people for me since they are too mighty for me; perhaps I will be able to defeat them and drive them out of the land. For I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed."
verses.textEn: Now come and put a curse on these people, because they are too powerful for me. Perhaps then I will be able to defeat them and drive them out of the land. For I know that whoever you bless is blessed, and whoever you curse is cursed."

verses.textZh: 摩押的长老和米甸的长老，手里带着占卜的礼金去了；他们到了巴兰那里，把巴勒的话告诉他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押的长老和米甸的长老，手里带着占卜的礼金去了；他们到了巴兰那里，把巴勒的话告诉他。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押的长老和米甸的长老手里拿着卦金，到了巴兰那里，将巴勒的话都告诉了他。
verses.textEnNiv: The elders of Moab and Midian left, taking with them the fee for divination. When they came to Balaam, they told him what Balak had said.
verses.textEnEsv: So the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the fees for divination in their hand. And they came to Balaam and gave him Balak’s message.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the diviner’s fee in their hand, and they came to Balaam and spoke to him the words of Balak.
verses.textEnNlt: Balak’s messengers, who were elders of Moab and Midian, set out with money to pay Balaam to place a curse upon Israel. They went to Balaam and delivered Balak’s message to him.
verses.textEnNasb: So the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian left with the fees for divination in their hands; and they came to Balaam and repeated Balak’s words to him.
verses.textEn: The elders of Moab and Midian left, taking with them the fee for divination. When they came to Balaam, they told him what Balak had said.

verses.textZh: 巴兰对他们说："今夜你们留在这里，我必照着耶和华吩咐我的话答复你们。"于是，摩押的领袖就与巴兰同住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰对他们说："今夜你们留在这里，我必照着耶和华吩咐我的话答复你们。"于是，摩押的领袖就与巴兰同住。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴兰说：「你们今夜在这里住宿，我必照耶和华所晓谕我的回报你们。」摩押的使臣就在巴兰那里住下了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Spend the night here," Balaam said to them, "and I will report back to you with the answer the Lord gives me." So the Moabite officials stayed with him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Lodge here tonight, and I will bring back word to you, as the Lord speaks to me." So the princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to them, "Lodge here tonight, and I will bring back word to you, as the Lord speaks to me." So the princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.
verses.textEnNlt: "Stay here overnight," Balaam said. "In the morning I will tell you whatever the Lord directs me to say." So the officials from Moab stayed there with Balaam.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to them, "Spend the night here, and I will bring word back to you just as the Lord may speak to me." And the leaders of Moab stayed with Balaam.
verses.textEn: "Spend the night here," Balaam said to them, "and I will report back to you with the answer the Lord gives me." So the Moabite officials stayed with him.

verses.textZh: 神来到巴兰那里，说："与你在一起的这些人是谁？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神来到巴兰那里，说："与你在一起的这些人是谁？"
verses.textZhCuv: 神临到巴兰那里，说：「在你这里的人都是谁？」
verses.textEnNiv: God came to Balaam and asked, "Who are these men with you?"
verses.textEnEsv: And God came to Balaam and said, "Who are these men with you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God came to Balaam and said, "Who are these men with you?"
verses.textEnNlt: That night God came to Balaam and asked him, "Who are these men visiting you?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then God came to Balaam and said, "Who are these men with you?"
verses.textEn: God came to Balaam and asked, "Who are these men with you?"

verses.textZh: 巴兰对神说："是摩押王西拨的儿子巴勒派到我这里来的人，他们说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰对神说："是摩押王西拨的儿子巴勒派到我这里来的人，他们说：
verses.textZhCuv: 巴兰回答说：「是摩押王西拨的儿子巴勒打发人到我这里来，说：
verses.textEnNiv: Balaam said to God, "Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, sent me this message:
verses.textEnEsv: And Balaam said to God, "Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent to me, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Balaam said to God, "Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Balaam said to God, "Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent me this message:
verses.textEnNasb: Balaam said to God, "Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, sent word to me:
verses.textEn: Balaam said to God, "Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, sent me this message:

verses.textZh: ‘你看，从埃及出来的民族，遮满了全地；现在请你来，替我咒诅他们，或者我能够战胜他们，把他们赶走。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘你看，从埃及出来的民族，遮满了全地；现在请你来，替我咒诅他们，或者我能够战胜他们，把他们赶走。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 『从埃及出来的民遮满地面，你来为我咒诅他们，或者我能与他们争战，把他们赶出去。』」
verses.textEnNiv: ‘A people that has come out of Egypt covers the face of the land. Now come and put a curse on them for me. Perhaps then I will be able to fight them and drive them away.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Behold, a people has come out of Egypt, and it covers the face of the earth. Now come, curse them for me. Perhaps I shall be able to fight against them and drive them out.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Look, a people has come out of Egypt, and they cover the face of the earth. Come now, curse them for me; perhaps I shall be able to overpower them and drive them out.’ "
