verses.textEnNlt: ‘Look, a vast horde of people has arrived from Egypt, and they cover the face of the earth. Come and curse these people for me. Then perhaps I will be able to stand up to them and drive them from the land.’"
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Behold, there is a people who came out of Egypt, and they cover the surface of the land; now come, curse them for me; perhaps I will be able to fight against them and drive them out.’ "
verses.textEn: ‘A people that has come out of Egypt covers the face of the land. Now come and put a curse on them for me. Perhaps then I will be able to fight them and drive them away.’ "

verses.textZh: 神对巴兰说："你不可与他们同去，也不可咒诅那民，因为他们是蒙福的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神对巴兰说："你不可与他们同去，也不可咒诅那民，因为他们是蒙福的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神对巴兰说：「你不可同他们去，也不可咒诅那民，因为那民是蒙福的。」
verses.textEnNiv: But God said to Balaam, "Do not go with them. You must not put a curse on those people, because they are blessed."
verses.textEnEsv: God said to Balaam, "You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed."
verses.textEnNkjv: And God said to Balaam, "You shall not go with them; you shall not curse the people, for they are blessed."
verses.textEnNlt: But God told Balaam, "Do not go with them. You are not to curse these people, for they have been blessed!"
verses.textEnNasb: But God said to Balaam, "Do not go with them; you shall not curse the people, for they are blessed."
verses.textEn: But God said to Balaam, "Do not go with them. You must not put a curse on those people, because they are blessed."

verses.textZh: 巴兰早晨起来，对巴勒的领袖说："你们回本地去吧，因为耶和华不准我与你们同去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰早晨起来，对巴勒的领袖说："你们回本地去吧，因为耶和华不准我与你们同去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 巴兰早晨起来，对巴勒的使臣说：「你们回本地去吧，因为耶和华不容我和你们同去。」
verses.textEnNiv: The next morning Balaam got up and said to Balak’s officials, "Go back to your own country, for the Lord has refused to let me go with you."
verses.textEnEsv: So Balaam rose in the morning and said to the princes of Balak, "Go to your own land, for the Lord has refused to let me go with you."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Balaam rose in the morning and said to the princes of Balak, "Go back to your land, for the Lord has refused to give me permission to go with you."
verses.textEnNlt: The next morning Balaam got up and told Balak’s officials, "Go on home! The Lord will not let me go with you."
verses.textEnNasb: So Balaam got up in the morning and said to Balak’s representatives, "Go back to your land, for the Lord has refused to let me go with you."
verses.textEn: The next morning Balaam got up and said to Balak’s officials, "Go back to your own country, for the Lord has refused to let me go with you."

verses.textZh: 摩押的领袖起来，回到巴勒那里，说："巴兰不肯与我们同来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押的领袖起来，回到巴勒那里，说："巴兰不肯与我们同来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押的使臣就起来，回巴勒那里去，说：「巴兰不肯和我们同来。」
verses.textEnNiv: So the Moabite officials returned to Balak and said, "Balaam refused to come with us."
verses.textEnEsv: So the princes of Moab rose and went to Balak and said, "Balaam refuses to come with us."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the princes of Moab rose and went to Balak, and said, "Balaam refuses to come with us."
verses.textEnNlt: So the Moabite officials returned to King Balak and reported, "Balaam refused to come with us."
verses.textEnNasb: And the representatives from Moab got up and went to Balak, and said, "Balaam refused to come with us."
verses.textEn: So the Moabite officials returned to Balak and said, "Balaam refused to come with us."

verses.textZh: 于是，巴勒又派比先前更多、更尊贵的领袖去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，巴勒又派比先前更多、更尊贵的领袖去，
verses.textZhCuv: 巴勒又差遣使臣，比先前的又多又尊贵。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Balak sent other officials, more numerous and more distinguished than the first.
verses.textEnEsv: Once again Balak sent princes, more in number and more honorable than these.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Balak again sent princes, more numerous and more honorable than they.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Balak tried again. This time he sent a larger number of even more distinguished officials than those he had sent the first time.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Balak sent representatives once again, more numerous and more distinguished than the previous.
verses.textEn: Then Balak sent other officials, more numerous and more distinguished than the first.

verses.textZh: 他们来到巴兰那里，对他说："西拨的儿子巴勒这样说：‘求你不要推辞不到我这里来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们来到巴兰那里，对他说："西拨的儿子巴勒这样说：‘求你不要推辞不到我这里来，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们到了巴兰那里，对他说：「西拨的儿子巴勒这样说：『求你不容什么事拦阻你不到我这里来，
verses.textEnNiv: They came to Balaam and said: "This is what Balak son of Zippor says: Do not let anything keep you from coming to me,
verses.textEnEsv: And they came to Balaam and said to him, "Thus says Balak the son of Zippor: ‘Let nothing hinder you from coming to me,
verses.textEnNkjv: And they came to Balaam and said to him, "Thus says Balak the son of Zippor: ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me;
verses.textEnNlt: They went to Balaam and delivered this message to him: "This is what Balak son of Zippor says: Please don’t let anything stop you from coming to help me.
verses.textEnNasb: They came to Balaam and said to him, "This is what Balak the son of Zippor says: ‘I beg you, let nothing keep you from coming to me;
verses.textEn: They came to Balaam and said: "This is what Balak son of Zippor says: Do not let anything keep you from coming to me,

verses.textZh: 因为我必使你大得尊荣；你向我说甚么，我都照办；只求你替我咒诅这民。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我必使你大得尊荣；你向我说甚么，我都照办；只求你替我咒诅这民。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我必使你得极大的尊荣。你向我要什么，我就给你什么；只求你来为我咒诅这民。』」
verses.textEnNiv: because I will reward you handsomely and do whatever you say. Come and put a curse on these people for me."
verses.textEnEsv: for I will surely do you great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do. Come, curse this people for me.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: for I will certainly honor you greatly, and I will do whatever you say to me. Therefore please come, curse this people for me.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I will pay you very well and do whatever you tell me. Just come and curse these people for me!"
verses.textEnNasb: for I will indeed honor you richly, and I will do whatever you tell me. Please come then, curse this people for me.’ "
verses.textEn: because I will reward you handsomely and do whatever you say. Come and put a curse on these people for me."

verses.textZh: 巴兰回答巴勒的臣仆说："巴勒就算把他满屋的金银给我，但我不论作大事小事，也不能越过耶和华我神的命令。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰回答巴勒的臣仆说："巴勒就算把他满屋的金银给我，但我不论作大事小事，也不能越过耶和华我神的命令。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴兰回答巴勒的臣仆说：「巴勒就是将他满屋的金银给我，我行大事小事也不得越过耶和华－我神的命。
verses.textEnNiv: But Balaam answered them, "Even if Balak gave me all the silver and gold in his palace, I could not do anything great or small to go beyond the command of the Lord my God.
verses.textEnEsv: But Balaam answered and said to the servants of Balak, "Though Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not go beyond the command of the Lord my God to do less or more.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Balaam answered and said to the servants of Balak, "Though Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not go beyond the word of the Lord my God, to do less or more.
verses.textEnNlt: But Balaam responded to Balak’s messengers, "Even if Balak were to give me his palace filled with silver and gold, I would be powerless to do anything against the will of the Lord my God.
verses.textEnNasb: But Balaam replied to the servants of Balak, "Even if Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not do anything, either small or great, contrary to the command of the Lord my God.
verses.textEn: But Balaam answered them, "Even if Balak gave me all the silver and gold in his palace, I could not do anything great or small to go beyond the command of the Lord my God.

verses.textZh: 现在请你们今夜也住在这里，等我得知耶和华还要向我说甚么。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在请你们今夜也住在这里，等我得知耶和华还要向我说甚么。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我请你们今夜在这里住宿，等我得知耶和华还要对我说什么。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now spend the night here so that I can find out what else the Lord will tell me."
verses.textEnEsv: So you, too, please stay here tonight, that I may know what more the Lord will say to me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, please, you also stay here tonight, that I may know what more the Lord will say to me."
verses.textEnNlt: But stay here one more night, and I will see if the Lord has anything else to say to me."
verses.textEnNasb: Now please, you also stay here tonight, and I will find out what else the Lord will say to me."
verses.textEn: Now spend the night here so that I can find out what else the Lord will tell me."

verses.textZh: 当夜，神来到巴兰那里，对他说："这些人既然来请你，你就起程与他们同去，但是你只要遵行我吩咐你的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 当夜，神来到巴兰那里，对他说："这些人既然来请你，你就起程与他们同去，但是你只要遵行我吩咐你的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 当夜，神临到巴兰那里，说：「这些人若来召你，你就起来同他们去，你只要遵行我对你所说的话。」
verses.textEnNiv: That night God came to Balaam and said, "Since these men have come to summon you, go with them, but do only what I tell you."
verses.textEnEsv: And God came to Balaam at night and said to him, "If the men have come to call you, rise, go with them; but only do what I tell you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And God came to Balaam at night and said to him, "If the men come to call you, rise and go with them; but only the word which I speak to you—that you shall do."
verses.textEnNlt: That night God came to Balaam and told him, "Since these men have come for you, get up and go with them. But do only what I tell you to do."
verses.textEnNasb: And God came to Balaam at night and said to him, "If the men have come to call you, rise and go with them; but you shall do only the thing that I tell you."
verses.textEn: That night God came to Balaam and said, "Since these men have come to summon you, go with them, but do only what I tell you."

verses.textZh: 巴兰早晨起来，备上驴，与摩押的领袖一同去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰早晨起来，备上驴，与摩押的领袖一同去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴兰早晨起来，备上驴，和摩押的使臣一同去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Balaam got up in the morning, saddled his donkey and went with the Moabite officials.
verses.textEnEsv: So Balaam rose in the morning and saddled his donkey and went with the princes of Moab.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Balaam rose in the morning, saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.
verses.textEnNlt: So the next morning Balaam got up, saddled his donkey, and started off with the Moabite officials.
verses.textEnNasb: So Balaam arose in the morning, saddled his donkey, and went with the leaders of Moab.
verses.textEn: Balaam got up in the morning, saddled his donkey and went with the Moabite officials.

verses.textZh: 神因为巴兰去就发怒；耶和华的使者站在路上敌挡他。那时他骑着驴，有两个仆人同行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神因为巴兰去就发怒；耶和华的使者站在路上敌挡他。那时他骑着驴，有两个仆人同行。
verses.textZhCuv: 神因他去就发了怒；耶和华的使者站在路上敌挡他。他骑着驴，有两个仆人跟随他。
verses.textEnNiv: But God was very angry when he went, and the angel of the Lord stood in the road to oppose him. Balaam was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.
verses.textEnEsv: But God’s anger was kindled because he went, and the angel of the Lord took his stand in the way as his adversary. Now he was riding on the donkey, and his two servants were with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God’s anger was aroused because he went, and the Angel of the Lord took His stand in the way as an adversary against him. And he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.
verses.textEnNlt: But God was angry that Balaam was going, so he sent the angel of the Lord to stand in the road to block his way. As Balaam and two servants were riding along,
verses.textEnNasb: But God was angry that he was going, and the angel of the Lord took his stand in the road as an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.
verses.textEn: But God was very angry when he went, and the angel of the Lord stood in the road to oppose him. Balaam was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.

verses.textZh: 驴看见了耶和华的使者站在路上，手里拿着拔出来的刀，就转离正路，走入田中去；巴兰就打驴，要叫牠转回路上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 驴看见了耶和华的使者站在路上，手里拿着拔出来的刀，就转离正路，走入田中去；巴兰就打驴，要叫牠转回路上。
verses.textZhCuv: 驴看见耶和华的使者站在路上，手里有拔出来的刀，就从路上跨进田间，巴兰便打驴，要叫它回转上路。
verses.textEnNiv: When the donkey saw the angel of the Lord standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand, it turned off the road into a field. Balaam beat it to get it back on the road.
verses.textEnEsv: And the donkey saw the angel of the Lord standing in the road, with a drawn sword in his hand. And the donkey turned aside out of the road and went into the field. And Balaam struck the donkey, to turn her into the road.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the donkey saw the Angel of the Lord standing in the way with His drawn sword in His hand, and the donkey turned aside out of the way and went into the field. So Balaam struck the donkey to turn her back onto the road.
verses.textEnNlt: Balaam’s donkey saw the angel of the Lord standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand. The donkey bolted off the road into a field, but Balaam beat it and turned it back onto the road.
verses.textEnNasb: When the donkey saw the angel of the Lord standing in the road with his sword drawn in his hand, the donkey turned off from the road and went into the field; and Balaam struck the donkey to guide her back onto the road.
verses.textEn: When the donkey saw the angel of the Lord standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand, it turned off the road into a field. Balaam beat it to get it back on the road.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者站在葡萄园间的窄路上，两边都有围墙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者站在葡萄园间的窄路上，两边都有围墙。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者就站在葡萄园的窄路上；这边有墙，那边也有墙。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the angel of the Lord stood in a narrow path through the vineyards, with walls on both sides.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the angel of the Lord stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, with a wall on either side.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Angel of the Lord stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, with a wall on this side and a wall on that side.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the angel of the Lord stood at a place where the road narrowed between two vineyard walls.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the angel of the Lord stood in a narrow path of the vineyards, with a stone wall on this side and on that side.
verses.textEn: Then the angel of the Lord stood in a narrow path through the vineyards, with walls on both sides.

verses.textZh: 驴看见了耶和华的使者，就紧挤在墙上，把巴兰的脚挤伤了，巴兰又打驴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 驴看见了耶和华的使者，就紧挤在墙上，把巴兰的脚挤伤了，巴兰又打驴。
verses.textZhCuv: 驴看见耶和华的使者，就贴靠墙，将巴兰的脚挤伤了；巴兰又打驴。
verses.textEnNiv: When the donkey saw the angel of the Lord , it pressed close to the wall, crushing Balaam’s foot against it. So he beat the donkey again.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the donkey saw the angel of the Lord , she pushed against the wall and pressed Balaam’s foot against the wall. So he struck her again.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the donkey saw the Angel of the Lord, she pushed herself against the wall and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall; so he struck her again.
verses.textEnNlt: When the donkey saw the angel of the Lord , it tried to squeeze by and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall. So Balaam beat the donkey again.
verses.textEnNasb: When the donkey saw the angel of the Lord, she pressed herself against the wall and pressed Balaam’s foot against the wall, so he struck her again.
verses.textEn: When the donkey saw the angel of the Lord , it pressed close to the wall, crushing Balaam’s foot against it. So he beat the donkey again.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者又往前行，站在狭窄之处，左右都没有转身的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者又往前行，站在狭窄之处，左右都没有转身的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者又往前去，站在狭窄之处，左右都没有转折的地方。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the angel of the Lord moved on ahead and stood in a narrow place where there was no room to turn, either to the right or to the left.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the angel of the Lord went ahead and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right or to the left.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Angel of the Lord went further, and stood in a narrow place where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the angel of the Lord moved farther down the road and stood in a place too narrow for the donkey to get by at all.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the angel of the Lord went farther, and stood in a narrow place where there was no way to turn to the right or to the left.
verses.textEn: Then the angel of the Lord moved on ahead and stood in a narrow place where there was no room to turn, either to the right or to the left.

verses.textZh: 驴看见了耶和华的使者，就卧在巴兰身下；巴兰大怒，就用自己的杖打驴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 驴看见了耶和华的使者，就卧在巴兰身下；巴兰大怒，就用自己的杖打驴。
verses.textZhCuv: 驴看见耶和华的使者，就卧在巴兰底下，巴兰发怒，用杖打驴。
verses.textEnNiv: When the donkey saw the angel of the Lord , it lay down under Balaam, and he was angry and beat it with his staff.
verses.textEnEsv: When the donkey saw the angel of the Lord , she lay down under Balaam. And Balaam’s anger was kindled, and he struck the donkey with his staff.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the donkey saw the Angel of the Lord, she lay down under Balaam; so Balaam’s anger was aroused, and he struck the donkey with his staff.
verses.textEnNlt: This time when the donkey saw the angel, it lay down under Balaam. In a fit of rage Balaam beat the animal again with his staff.
verses.textEnNasb: When the donkey saw the angel of the Lord, she lay down under Balaam; so Balaam was angry and struck the donkey with his staff.
verses.textEn: When the donkey saw the angel of the Lord , it lay down under Balaam, and he was angry and beat it with his staff.

verses.textZh: 耶和华开了驴的口，驴就对巴兰说："我向你作了甚么，你竟打我这三次呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华开了驴的口，驴就对巴兰说："我向你作了甚么，你竟打我这三次呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华叫驴开口，对巴兰说：「我向你行了什么，你竟打我这三次呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord opened the donkey’s mouth, and it said to Balaam, "What have I done to you to make you beat me these three times?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, "What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, "What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord gave the donkey the ability to speak. "What have I done to you that deserves your beating me three times?" it asked Balaam.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, "What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?"
verses.textEn: Then the Lord opened the donkey’s mouth, and it said to Balaam, "What have I done to you to make you beat me these three times?"

verses.textZh: 巴兰对驴说："因为你作弄我。但愿我手中有刀，现在就把你杀死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰对驴说："因为你作弄我。但愿我手中有刀，现在就把你杀死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 巴兰对驴说：「因为你戏弄我，我恨不能手中有刀，把你杀了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Balaam answered the donkey, "You have made a fool of me! If only I had a sword in my hand, I would kill you right now."
verses.textEnEsv: And Balaam said to the donkey, "Because you have made a fool of me. I wish I had a sword in my hand, for then I would kill you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Balaam said to the donkey, "Because you have abused me. I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would kill you!"
verses.textEnNlt: "You have made me look like a fool!" Balaam shouted. "If I had a sword with me, I would kill you!"
verses.textEnNasb: And Balaam said to the donkey, "It is because you have made a mockery of me! If only there had been a sword in my hand! For I would have killed you by now!"
verses.textEn: Balaam answered the donkey, "You have made a fool of me! If only I had a sword in my hand, I would kill you right now."

verses.textZh: 驴对巴兰说："我不是你从起初一直所骑的驴吗？我曾惯常向你这样行过吗？"巴兰说："没有。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 驴对巴兰说："我不是你从起初一直所骑的驴吗？我曾惯常向你这样行过吗？"巴兰说："没有。"
verses.textZhCuv: 驴对巴兰说：「我不是你从小时直到今日所骑的驴吗？我素常向你这样行过吗？」巴兰说：「没有。」
verses.textEnNiv: The donkey said to Balaam, "Am I not your own donkey, which you have always ridden, to this day? Have I been in the habit of doing this to you?" "No," he said.
verses.textEnEsv: And the donkey said to Balaam, "Am I not your donkey, on which you have ridden all your life long to this day? Is it my habit to treat you this way?" And he said, "No."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the donkey said to Balaam, "Am I not your donkey on which you have ridden, ever since Ibecame yours, to this day? Was I ever disposed to do this to you?" And he said, "No."
verses.textEnNlt: "But I am the same donkey you have ridden all your life," the donkey answered. "Have I ever done anything like this before?" "No," Balaam admitted.
verses.textEnNasb: But the donkey said to Balaam, "Am I not your donkey on which you have ridden all your life to this day? Have I ever been in the habit of doing such a thing to you?" And he said, "No."
verses.textEn: The donkey said to Balaam, "Am I not your own donkey, which you have always ridden, to this day? Have I been in the habit of doing this to you?" "No," he said.

verses.textZh: 那时，耶和华开了巴兰的眼睛，他就看见耶和华的使者站在路上，手里拿着拔出来的刀，巴兰就低头俯伏在地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶和华开了巴兰的眼睛，他就看见耶和华的使者站在路上，手里拿着拔出来的刀，巴兰就低头俯伏在地。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时，耶和华使巴兰的眼目明亮，他就看见耶和华的使者站在路上，手里有拔出来的刀，巴兰便低头俯伏在地。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord opened Balaam’s eyes, and he saw the angel of the Lord standing in the road with his sword drawn. So he bowed low and fell facedown.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the Lord standing in the way, with his drawn sword in his hand. And he bowed down and fell on his face.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord opened Balaam’s eyes, and he saw the Angel of the Lord standing in the way with His drawn sword in His hand; and he bowed his head and fell flat on his face.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord opened Balaam’s eyes, and he saw the angel of the Lord standing in the roadway with a drawn sword in his hand. Balaam bowed his head and fell face down on the ground before him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord opened Balaam’s eyes, and he saw the angel of the Lord standing in the way with his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed all the way to the ground.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord opened Balaam’s eyes, and he saw the angel of the Lord standing in the road with his sword drawn. So he bowed low and fell facedown.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者对他说："你为甚么这三次打你的驴呢？看哪，是我来敌挡你，因为你走的路在我面前邪僻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者对他说："你为甚么这三次打你的驴呢？看哪，是我来敌挡你，因为你走的路在我面前邪僻。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者对他说：「你为何这三次打你的驴呢？我出来敌挡你，因你所行的，在我面前偏僻。
verses.textEnNiv: The angel of the Lord asked him, "Why have you beaten your donkey these three times? I have come here to oppose you because your path is a reckless one before me.
verses.textEnEsv: And the angel of the Lord said to him, "Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out to oppose you because your way is perverse before me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Angel of the Lord said to him, "Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out to stand against you, because your way is perverse before Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "Why did you beat your donkey those three times?" the angel of the Lord demanded. "Look, I have come to block your way because you are stubbornly resisting me.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the angel of the Lord said to him, "Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out as an adversary, because your way was reckless and contrary to me.
verses.textEn: The angel of the Lord asked him, "Why have you beaten your donkey these three times? I have come here to oppose you because your path is a reckless one before me.

verses.textZh: 驴看见了我，就三次从我面前转开；驴若是没有从我面前转开，我早已把你杀了，而留牠活着。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 驴看见了我，就三次从我面前转开；驴若是没有从我面前转开，我早已把你杀了，而留牠活着。"
verses.textZhCuv: 驴看见我就三次从我面前偏过去；驴若没有偏过去，我早把你杀了，留它存活。」
verses.textEnNiv: The donkey saw me and turned away from me these three times. If it had not turned away, I would certainly have killed you by now, but I would have spared it."
verses.textEnEsv: The donkey saw me and turned aside before me these three times. If she had not turned aside from me, surely just now I would have killed you and let her live."
verses.textEnNkjv: The donkey saw Me and turned aside from Me these three times. If she had not turned aside from Me, surely I would also have killed you by now, and let her live."
verses.textEnNlt: Three times the donkey saw me and shied away; otherwise, I would certainly have killed you by now and spared the donkey."
verses.textEnNasb: But the donkey saw me and turned away from me these three times. If she had not turned away from me, I certainly would have killed you just now, and let her live."
verses.textEn: The donkey saw me and turned away from me these three times. If it had not turned away, I would certainly have killed you by now, but I would have spared it."

verses.textZh: 巴兰对耶和华的使者说："我有罪了，我不知道是你站在路上阻挡我；现在你若是不喜欢我去，我就回去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰对耶和华的使者说："我有罪了，我不知道是你站在路上阻挡我；现在你若是不喜欢我去，我就回去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 巴兰对耶和华的使者说：「我有罪了。我不知道你站在路上阻挡我；你若不喜欢我去，我就转回。」
verses.textEnNiv: Balaam said to the angel of the Lord , "I have sinned. I did not realize you were standing in the road to oppose me. Now if you are displeased, I will go back."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Balaam said to the angel of the Lord , "I have sinned, for I did not know that you stood in the road against me. Now therefore, if it is evil in your sight, I will turn back."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Balaam said to the Angel of the Lord, "I have sinned, for I did not know You stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases You, I will turn back."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Balaam confessed to the angel of the Lord , "I have sinned. I didn’t realize you were standing in the road to block my way. I will return home if you are against my going."
verses.textEnNasb: So Balaam said to the angel of the Lord, "I have sinned, for I did not know that you were standing in the way against me. Now then, if it is displeasing to you, I will turn back."
verses.textEn: Balaam said to the angel of the Lord , "I have sinned. I did not realize you were standing in the road to oppose me. Now if you are displeased, I will go back."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者对巴兰说："你与这些人同去吧，但是你只要说我吩咐你的话。"于是巴兰与巴勒的领袖一同去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者对巴兰说："你与这些人同去吧，但是你只要说我吩咐你的话。"于是巴兰与巴勒的领袖一同去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者对巴兰说：「你同这些人去吧！你只要说我对你说的话。」于是巴兰同着巴勒的使臣去了。
verses.textEnNiv: The angel of the Lord said to Balaam, "Go with the men, but speak only what I tell you." So Balaam went with Balak’s officials.
verses.textEnEsv: And the angel of the Lord said to Balaam, "Go with the men, but speak only the word that I tell you." So Balaam went on with the princes of Balak.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Angel of the Lord said to Balaam, "Go with the men, but only the word that I speak to you, that you shall speak." So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
verses.textEnNlt: But the angel of the Lord told Balaam, "Go with these men, but say only what I tell you to say." So Balaam went on with Balak’s officials.
verses.textEnNasb: But the angel of the Lord said to Balaam, "Go with the men, but you shall speak only the word that I tell you." So Balaam went along with the representatives of Balak.
verses.textEn: The angel of the Lord said to Balaam, "Go with the men, but speak only what I tell you." So Balaam went with Balak’s officials.

verses.textZh: 巴勒听见巴兰来了，就出去到摩押的京城迎接他；这城是在亚嫩河旁，在边界的尽头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴勒听见巴兰来了，就出去到摩押的京城迎接他；这城是在亚嫩河旁，在边界的尽头。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴勒听见巴兰来了，就往摩押京城去迎接他；这城是在边界上，在亚嫩河旁。
verses.textEnNiv: When Balak heard that Balaam was coming, he went out to meet him at the Moabite town on the Arnon border, at the edge of his territory.
verses.textEnEsv: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him at the city of Moab, on the border formed by the Arnon, at the extremity of the border.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Balak heard that Balaam was coming, he went out to meet him at the city of Moab, which is on the border at the Arnon, the boundary of the territory.
verses.textEnNlt: When King Balak heard that Balaam was on the way, he went out to meet him at a Moabite town on the Arnon River at the farthest border of his land.
verses.textEnNasb: When Balak heard that Balaam was coming, he went out to meet him at the city of Moab, which is on the Arnon border, at the extreme end of the border.
verses.textEn: When Balak heard that Balaam was coming, he went out to meet him at the Moabite town on the Arnon border, at the edge of his territory.

verses.textZh: 巴勒对巴兰说："我不是急切地派人到你那里去请你吗？你为甚么不到我这里来呢？难道我不能使你得尊荣吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴勒对巴兰说："我不是急切地派人到你那里去请你吗？你为甚么不到我这里来呢？难道我不能使你得尊荣吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 巴勒对巴兰说：「我不是急急地打发人到你那里去召你吗？你为何不到我这里来呢？我岂不能使你得尊荣吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Balak said to Balaam, "Did I not send you an urgent summons? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I really not able to reward you?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Balak said to Balaam, "Did I not send to you to call you? Why did you not come to me? Am I not able to honor you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Did I not earnestly send to you, calling for you? Why did you not come to me? Am I not able to honor you?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Didn’t I send you an urgent invitation? Why didn’t you come right away?" Balak asked Balaam. "Didn’t you believe me when I said I would reward you richly?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Did I not urgently send word to you to call for you? Why did you not come to me? Am I really unable to honor you?"
verses.textEn: Balak said to Balaam, "Did I not send you an urgent summons? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I really not able to reward you?"

verses.textZh: 巴兰对巴勒说："看哪，我已经来到你这里，现在我怎能说甚么呢？神把甚么话放在我口里，我就说甚么。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰对巴勒说："看哪，我已经来到你这里，现在我怎能说甚么呢？神把甚么话放在我口里，我就说甚么。"
verses.textZhCuv: 巴兰说：「我已经到你这里来了！现在我岂能擅自说什么呢？神将什么话传给我，我就说什么。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Well, I have come to you now," Balaam replied. "But I can’t say whatever I please. I must speak only what God puts in my mouth."
verses.textEnEsv: Balaam said to Balak, "Behold, I have come to you! Have I now any power of my own to speak anything? The word that God puts in my mouth, that must I speak."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Balaam said to Balak, "Look, I have come to you! Now, have I any power at all to say anything? The word that God puts in my mouth, that I must speak."
verses.textEnNlt: Balaam replied, "Look, now I have come, but I have no power to say whatever I want. I will speak only the message that God puts in my mouth."
verses.textEnNasb: So Balaam said to Balak, "Behold, I have come to you now! Am I really able to speak anything? The word that God puts in my mouth, that only shall I speak."
verses.textEn: "Well, I have come to you now," Balaam replied. "But I can’t say whatever I please. I must speak only what God puts in my mouth."

verses.textZh: 巴兰与巴勒同行，来到基列．胡琐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰与巴勒同行，来到基列．胡琐。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴兰和巴勒同行，来到基列‧胡琐。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Balaam went with Balak to Kiriath Huzoth.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath-huzoth.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kirjath Huzoth.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Balaam accompanied Balak to Kiriath-huzoth,
verses.textEnNasb: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath-huzoth.
verses.textEn: Then Balaam went with Balak to Kiriath Huzoth.

verses.textZh: 巴勒宰了牛羊，送给巴兰和与他在一起的领袖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴勒宰了牛羊，送给巴兰和与他在一起的领袖。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴勒宰了 牛羊，送给巴兰和陪伴的使臣。
verses.textEnNiv: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and gave some to Balaam and the officials who were with him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Balak sacrificed oxen and sheep, and sent for Balaam and for the princes who were with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Balak offered oxen and sheep, and he sent some to Balaam and to the princes who were with him.
verses.textEnNlt: where the king sacrificed cattle and sheep. He sent portions of the meat to Balaam and the officials who were with him.
verses.textEnNasb: Balak sacrificed oxen and sheep, and sent some to Balaam and the leaders who were with him.
verses.textEn: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and gave some to Balaam and the officials who were with him.

verses.textZh: 到了早晨，巴勒带着巴兰上了巴力的高冈；巴兰就从那里观看以色列民的边界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了早晨，巴勒带着巴兰上了巴力的高冈；巴兰就从那里观看以色列民的边界。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了早晨，巴勒领巴兰到巴力的高处；巴兰从那里观看以色列营的边界。
verses.textEnNiv: The next morning Balak took Balaam up to Bamoth Baal, and from there he could see the outskirts of the Israelite camp.
verses.textEnEsv: And in the morning Balak took Balaam and brought him up to Bamoth-baal, and from there he saw a fraction of the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, the next day, that Balak took Balaam and brought him up to the high places of Baal, that from there he might observe the extent of the people.
verses.textEnNlt: The next morning Balak took Balaam up to Bamoth-baal. From there he could see some of the people of Israel spread out below him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it came about in the morning that Balak took Balaam and brought him up to the high places of Baal, and he saw from there a portion of the people.
verses.textEn: The next morning Balak took Balaam up to Bamoth Baal, and from there he could see the outskirts of the Israelite camp.

verses.textZh: 巴兰对巴勒说："你要在这里给我筑七座祭坛，给我预备七头公牛，七只公绵羊。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰对巴勒说："你要在这里给我筑七座祭坛，给我预备七头公牛，七只公绵羊。"
verses.textZhCuv: 巴兰对巴勒说：「你在这里给我筑七座坛，为我预备七只公牛，七只公羊。」
verses.textEnNiv: Balaam said, "Build me seven altars here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me."
verses.textEnEsv: And Balaam said to Balak, "Build for me here seven altars, and prepare for me here seven bulls and seven rams."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Balaam said to Balak, "Build seven altars for me here, and prepare for me here seven bulls and seven rams."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Balaam said to King Balak, "Build me seven altars here, and prepare seven young bulls and seven rams for me to sacrifice."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Balaam said to Balak, "Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here."
verses.textEn: Balaam said, "Build me seven altars here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me."

verses.textZh: 巴勒照着巴兰吩咐的行了；巴勒和巴兰在每座祭坛上献一头公牛和一只公绵羊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴勒照着巴兰吩咐的行了；巴勒和巴兰在每座祭坛上献一头公牛和一只公绵羊。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴勒照巴兰的话行了。巴勒和巴兰在每座坛上献一只公牛，一只公羊。
verses.textEnNiv: Balak did as Balaam said, and the two of them offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.textEnEsv: Balak did as Balaam had said. And Balak and Balaam offered on each altar a bull and a ram.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Balak did just as Balaam had spoken, and Balak and Balaam offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Balak followed his instructions, and the two of them sacrificed a young bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Balak did just as Balaam had spoken, and Balak and Balaam offered up a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.textEn: Balak did as Balaam said, and the two of them offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

verses.textZh: 巴兰对巴勒说："你要站在你的燔祭旁边，我要往前去，或者耶和华会来迎见我；他指示我甚么，我必告诉你。"于是巴兰上了一块高地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰对巴勒说："你要站在你的燔祭旁边，我要往前去，或者耶和华会来迎见我；他指示我甚么，我必告诉你。"于是巴兰上了一块高地。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴兰对巴勒说：「你站在你的燔祭旁边，我且往前去，或者耶和华来迎见我。他指示我什么，我必告诉你。」于是巴兰上一净光的高处。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Balaam said to Balak, "Stay here beside your offering while I go aside. Perhaps the Lord will come to meet with me. Whatever he reveals to me I will tell you." Then he went off to a barren height.
verses.textEnEsv: And Balaam said to Balak, "Stand beside your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps the Lord will come to meet me, and whatever he shows me I will tell you." And he went to a bare height,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Balaam said to Balak, "Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go; perhaps the Lord will come to meet me, and whatever He shows me I will tell you." So he went to a desolate height.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Balaam said to Balak, "Stand here by your burnt offerings, and I will go to see if the Lord will respond to me. Then I will tell you whatever he reveals to me." So Balaam went alone to the top of a bare hill,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Balaam said to Balak, "Stand beside your burnt offering, and I will go; perhaps the Lord will come to meet me, and whatever He shows me I will tell you." So he went to a bare hill.
verses.textEn: Then Balaam said to Balak, "Stay here beside your offering while I go aside. Perhaps the Lord will come to meet with me. Whatever he reveals to me I will tell you." Then he went off to a barren height.

verses.textZh: 神迎见巴兰；巴兰对神说："我已经预备了七座祭坛，在各座祭坛上献了一头公牛和一只公绵羊。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神迎见巴兰；巴兰对神说："我已经预备了七座祭坛，在各座祭坛上献了一头公牛和一只公绵羊。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神迎见巴兰；巴兰说：「我预备了七座坛，在每座坛上献了一只公牛，一只公羊。」
verses.textEnNiv: God met with him, and Balaam said, "I have prepared seven altars, and on each altar I have offered a bull and a ram."
verses.textEnEsv: and God met Balaam. And Balaam said to him, "I have arranged the seven altars and I have offered on each altar a bull and a ram."
verses.textEnNkjv: And God met Balaam, and he said to Him, "I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered on each altar a bull and a ram."
verses.textEnNlt: and God met him there. Balaam said to him, "I have prepared seven altars and have sacrificed a young bull and a ram on each altar."
verses.textEnNasb: Now God met with Balaam, and he said to Him, "I have set up the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on each altar."
verses.textEn: God met with him, and Balaam said, "I have prepared seven altars, and on each altar I have offered a bull and a ram."

verses.textZh: 耶和华把话传给巴兰，又说："你要回到巴勒那里去，要这样这样说。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华把话传给巴兰，又说："你要回到巴勒那里去，要这样这样说。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华将话传给巴兰，又说：「你回到巴勒那里，要如此如此说。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord put a word in Balaam’s mouth and said, "Go back to Balak and give him this word."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord put a word in Balaam’s mouth and said, "Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, "Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak."
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gave Balaam a message for King Balak. Then he said, "Go back to Balak and give him my message."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord put a word in Balaam’s mouth and said, "Return to Balak, and this is what you shall speak."
verses.textEn: The Lord put a word in Balaam’s mouth and said, "Go back to Balak and give him this word."

verses.textZh: 他就回到巴勒那里，见他和摩押所有的领袖都站在燔祭旁边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就回到巴勒那里，见他和摩押所有的领袖都站在燔祭旁边。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就回到巴勒那里，见他同摩押的使臣都站在燔祭旁边。
verses.textEnNiv: So he went back to him and found him standing beside his offering, with all the Moabite officials.
verses.textEnEsv: And he returned to him, and behold, he and all the princes of Moab were standing beside his burnt offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he returned to him, and there he was, standing by his burnt offering, he and all the princes of Moab.
verses.textEnNlt: So Balaam returned and found the king standing beside his burnt offerings with all the officials of Moab.
verses.textEnNasb: So he returned to him, and behold, he was standing beside his burnt offering, he and all the leaders of Moab.
verses.textEn: So he went back to him and found him standing beside his offering, with all the Moabite officials.

verses.textZh: 巴兰就作歌，说： "巴勒把我从亚兰领出来， 摩押王引我出东山，说： ‘来吧，为我咒骂雅各， 来啊，咒骂以色列。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰就作歌，说： "巴勒把我从亚兰领出来， 摩押王引我出东山，说： ‘来吧，为我咒骂雅各， 来啊，咒骂以色列。’
verses.textZhCuv: 巴兰便题起诗歌说： 巴勒引我出亚兰， 摩押王引我出东山，说： 来啊，为我咒诅雅各； 来啊，怒骂以色列。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Balaam spoke his message: "Balak brought me from Aram, the king of Moab from the eastern mountains. ‘Come,’ he said, ‘curse Jacob for me; come, denounce Israel.’
verses.textEnEsv: And Balaam took up his discourse and said, "From Aram Balak has brought me, the king of Moab from the eastern mountains: ‘Come, curse Jacob for me, and come, denounce Israel!’
verses.textEnNkjv: And he took up his oracle and said: "Balak the king of Moab has brought me from Aram, From the mountains of the east. ‘Come, curse Jacob for me, And come, denounce Israel!’
verses.textEnNlt: This was the message Balaam delivered: "Balak summoned me to come from Aram; the king of Moab brought me from the eastern hills. ‘Come,’ he said, ‘curse Jacob for me! Come and announce Israel’s doom.’
verses.textEnNasb: And he took up his discourse and said, "From Aram Balak has brought me, Moab’s king from the mountains of the East, saying, ‘Come, declare Jacob cursed for me, And come, curse Israel!’
verses.textEn: Then Balaam spoke his message: "Balak brought me from Aram, the king of Moab from the eastern mountains. ‘Come,’ he said, ‘curse Jacob for me; come, denounce Israel.’

verses.textZh: 神没有咒诅的，我怎能咒诅呢？ 耶和华没有咒骂的，我怎能咒骂呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 神没有咒诅的，我怎能咒诅呢？ 耶和华没有咒骂的，我怎能咒骂呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 神没有咒诅的，我焉能咒诅？ 耶和华没有怒骂的，我焉能怒骂？
verses.textEnNiv: How can I curse those whom God has not cursed? How can I denounce those whom the Lord has not denounced?
verses.textEnEsv: How can I curse whom God has not cursed? How can I denounce whom the Lord has not denounced?
verses.textEnNkjv: "How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? And how shall I denounce whom the Lord has not denounced?
verses.textEnNlt: But how can I curse those whom God has not cursed? How can I condemn those whom the Lord has not condemned?
verses.textEnNasb: "How am I to put a curse on him upon whom God has not put a curse? And how am I to curse him whom the Lord has not cursed?
verses.textEn: How can I curse those whom God has not cursed? How can I denounce those whom the Lord has not denounced?

verses.textZh: 我从高峰观看他们， 从山上眺望他们； 这是独居的民族， 不列在万国之中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我从高峰观看他们， 从山上眺望他们； 这是独居的民族， 不列在万国之中。
verses.textZhCuv: 我从高峰看他，从小山望他； 这是独居的民，不列在万民中。
verses.textEnNiv: From the rocky peaks I see them, from the heights I view them. I see a people who live apart and do not consider themselves one of the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: For from the top of the crags I see him, from the hills I behold him; behold, a people dwelling alone, and not counting itself among the nations!
verses.textEnNkjv: For from the top of the rocks I see him, And from the hills I behold him; There! A people dwelling alone, Not reckoning itself among the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: I see them from the cliff tops; I watch them from the hills. I see a people who live by themselves, set apart from other nations.
verses.textEnNasb: "For I see him from the top of the rocks, And I look at him from the hills; Behold, a people that lives in isolation, And does not consider itself to be among the nations.
verses.textEn: From the rocky peaks I see them, from the heights I view them. I see a people who live apart and do not consider themselves one of the nations.

verses.textZh: 谁能数算雅各的灰尘？ 谁能计算以色列的四分之一呢？ 愿我的死像正直人的死， 愿我之终如正直人之终。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁能数算雅各的灰尘？ 谁能计算以色列的四分之一呢？ 愿我的死像正直人的死， 愿我之终如正直人之终。"
verses.textZhCuv: 谁能数点雅各的尘土？ 谁能计算以色列的四分之一？ 我愿如义人之死而死； 我愿如义人之终而终。
verses.textEnNiv: Who can count the dust of Jacob or number even a fourth of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and may my final end be like theirs!"
verses.textEnEsv: Who can count the dust of Jacob or number the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the upright, and let my end be like his!"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Who can count the dust of Jacob, Or number one-fourth of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, And let my end be like his!"
verses.textEnNlt: Who can count Jacob’s descendants, as numerous as dust? Who can count even a fourth of Israel’s people? Let me die like the righteous; let my life end like theirs."
verses.textEnNasb: "Who has counted the dust of Jacob, Or the number of the fourth part of Israel? May I die the death of the upright, And may my end be like his!"
verses.textEn: Who can count the dust of Jacob or number even a fourth of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and may my final end be like theirs!"

verses.textZh: 巴勒对巴兰说："你向我作的是甚么事呢？我领你来咒诅我的仇敌，你反倒给他们祝福。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴勒对巴兰说："你向我作的是甚么事呢？我领你来咒诅我的仇敌，你反倒给他们祝福。"
verses.textZhCuv: 巴勒对巴兰说：「你向我做的是什么事呢？我领你来咒诅我的仇敌，不料，你竟为他们祝福。」
verses.textEnNiv: Balak said to Balaam, "What have you done to me? I brought you to curse my enemies, but you have done nothing but bless them!"
verses.textEnEsv: And Balak said to Balaam, "What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have done nothing but bless them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Balak said to Balaam, "What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and look, you have blessed them bountifully!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Balak demanded of Balaam, "What have you done to me? I brought you to curse my enemies. Instead, you have blessed them!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Balak said to Balaam, "What have you done to me? I took you to put a curse on my enemies, but behold, you have actually blessed them!"
verses.textEn: Balak said to Balaam, "What have you done to me? I brought you to curse my enemies, but you have done nothing but bless them!"

verses.textZh: 巴兰回答，说："耶和华传给我的话，我怎能不谨慎说呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰回答，说："耶和华传给我的话，我怎能不谨慎说呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他回答说：「耶和华传给我的话，我能不谨慎传说吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: He answered, "Must I not speak what the Lord puts in my mouth?"
verses.textEnEsv: And he answered and said, "Must I not take care to speak what the Lord puts in my mouth?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So he answered and said, "Must I not take heed to speak what the Lord has put in my mouth?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Balaam replied, "I will speak only the message that the Lord puts in my mouth."
verses.textEnNasb: He replied, "Must I not be careful to speak what the Lord puts in my mouth?"
verses.textEn: He answered, "Must I not speak what the Lord puts in my mouth?"

verses.textZh: 巴勒对巴兰说："请你与我到另一个地方去，从那里你可以看见他们；不过你不能看见他们全部，只能看见他们边界的一部分；在那里你要为我咒诅他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴勒对巴兰说："请你与我到另一个地方去，从那里你可以看见他们；不过你不能看见他们全部，只能看见他们边界的一部分；在那里你要为我咒诅他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 巴勒说：「求你同我往别处去，在那里可以看见他们；你不能全看见，只能看见他们边界上的人。在那里要为我咒诅他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Balak said to him, "Come with me to another place where you can see them; you will not see them all but only the outskirts of their camp. And from there, curse them for me."
verses.textEnEsv: And Balak said to him, "Please come with me to another place, from which you may see them. You shall see only a fraction of them and shall not see them all. Then curse them for me from there."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Balak said to him, "Please come with me to another place from which you may see them; you shall see only the outer part of them, and shall not see them all; curse them for me from there."
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Balak told him, "Come with me to another place. There you will see another part of the nation of Israel, but not all of them. Curse at least that many!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Balak said to him, "Please come with me to another place from where you may see them, although you will only see the extreme end of them and will not see all of them; and put a curse on them for me from there."
verses.textEn: Then Balak said to him, "Come with me to another place where you can see them; you will not see them all but only the outskirts of their camp. And from there, curse them for me."

verses.textZh: 于是巴勒带巴兰到了琐腓田，上了毘斯迦山顶，筑了七座祭坛，在每座祭坛上献了一头公牛和一只公绵羊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是巴勒带巴兰到了琐腓田，上了毘斯迦山顶，筑了七座祭坛，在每座祭坛上献了一头公牛和一只公绵羊。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是领巴兰到了琐腓田，上了毗斯迦山顶，筑了七座坛；每座坛上献一只公牛，一只公羊。
verses.textEnNiv: So he took him to the field of Zophim on the top of Pisgah, and there he built seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And he took him to the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he brought him to the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.textEnNlt: So Balak took Balaam to the plateau of Zophim on Pisgah Peak. He built seven altars there and offered a young bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.textEnNasb: So he took him to the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and he built seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.textEn: So he took him to the field of Zophim on the top of Pisgah, and there he built seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

verses.textZh: 巴兰对巴勒说："你要在这里站在你的燔祭旁边，等我到那边去迎见耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰对巴勒说："你要在这里站在你的燔祭旁边，等我到那边去迎见耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 巴兰对巴勒说：「你站在这燔祭旁边，等我往那边去迎见耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: Balaam said to Balak, "Stay here beside your offering while I meet with him over there."
verses.textEnEsv: Balaam said to Balak, "Stand here beside your burnt offering, while I meet the Lord over there."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to Balak, "Stand here by your burnt offering while I meet theLord over there."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Balaam said to the king, "Stand here by your burnt offerings while I go over there to meet the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to Balak, "Stand here beside your burnt offering while I myself meet the Lord over there."
verses.textEn: Balaam said to Balak, "Stay here beside your offering while I meet with him over there."

verses.textZh: 耶和华见了巴兰，把话传给他，说："你回到巴勒那里去，要这样这样说。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华见了巴兰，把话传给他，说："你回到巴勒那里去，要这样这样说。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华临到巴兰那里，将话传给他；又说：「你回到巴勒那里，要如此如此说。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord met with Balaam and put a word in his mouth and said, "Go back to Balak and give him this word."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord met Balaam and put a word in his mouth and said, "Return to Balak, and thus shall you speak."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, "Go back to Balak, and thus you shall speak."
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord met Balaam and gave him a message. Then he said, "Go back to Balak and give him my message."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord met Balaam and put a word in his mouth, and said, "Return to Balak, and this is what you shall speak."
verses.textEn: The Lord met with Balaam and put a word in his mouth and said, "Go back to Balak and give him this word."

verses.textZh: 巴兰回到巴勒那里，见他站在自己的燔祭旁边，摩押的领袖也与他在那里。巴勒问巴兰："耶和华说了甚么话呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰回到巴勒那里，见他站在自己的燔祭旁边，摩押的领袖也与他在那里。巴勒问巴兰："耶和华说了甚么话呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他就回到巴勒那里，见他站在燔祭旁边；摩押的使臣也和他在一处。巴勒问他说：「耶和华说了什么话呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: So he went to him and found him standing beside his offering, with the Moabite officials. Balak asked him, "What did the Lord say?"
verses.textEnEsv: And he came to him, and behold, he was standing beside his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said to him, "What has the Lord spoken?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So he came to him, and there he was, standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab were with him. And Balak said to him, "What has the Lord spoken?"
verses.textEnNlt: So Balaam returned and found the king standing beside his burnt offerings with all the officials of Moab. "What did the Lord say?" Balak asked eagerly.
verses.textEnNasb: So he came to him, and behold, he was standing beside his burnt offering, and the leaders of Moab with him. And Balak said to him, "What has the Lord spoken?"
verses.textEn: So he went to him and found him standing beside his offering, with the Moabite officials. Balak asked him, "What did the Lord say?"

verses.textZh: 巴兰作歌，说： "巴勒啊，要起来听； 西拨的儿子啊，侧耳听我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰作歌，说： "巴勒啊，要起来听； 西拨的儿子啊，侧耳听我。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴兰就题诗歌说： 巴勒，你起来听； 西拨的儿子，你听我言。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he spoke his message: "Arise, Balak, and listen; hear me, son of Zippor.
verses.textEnEsv: And Balaam took up his discourse and said, "Rise, Balak, and hear; give ear to me, O son of Zippor:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he took up his oracle and said: "Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, son of Zippor!
verses.textEnNlt: This was the message Balaam delivered: "Rise up, Balak, and listen! Hear me, son of Zippor.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he took up his discourse and said, "Arise, Balak, and hear; Listen to me, son of Zippor!
verses.textEn: Then he spoke his message: "Arise, Balak, and listen; hear me, son of Zippor.

verses.textZh: 神不是人，必不致说谎， 也不是人子，必不致后悔。 他说话，怎能不作？ 他发言，怎能不作成？
verses.textZhCnvs: 神不是人，必不致说谎， 也不是人子，必不致后悔。 他说话，怎能不作？ 他发言，怎能不作成？
verses.textZhCuv: 神非人，必不致说谎， 也非人子，必不致后悔。 他说话岂不照着行呢？ 他发言岂不要成就呢？
verses.textEnNiv: God is not human, that he should lie, not a human being, that he should change his mind. Does he speak and then not act? Does he promise and not fulfill?
verses.textEnEsv: God is not man, that he should lie, or a son of man, that he should change his mind. Has he said, and will he not do it? Or has he spoken, and will he not fulfill it?
verses.textEnNkjv: "God is not a man, that He should lie, Nor a son of man, that He should repent. Has He said, and will He not do? Or has He spoken, and will He not make it good?
verses.textEnNlt: God is not a man, so he does not lie. He is not human, so he does not change his mind. Has he ever spoken and failed to act? Has he ever promised and not carried it through?
verses.textEnNasb: "God is not a man, that He would lie, Nor a son of man, that He would change His mind; Has He said, and will He not do it? Or has He spoken, and will He not make it good?
verses.textEn: God is not human, that he should lie, not a human being, that he should change his mind. Does he speak and then not act? Does he promise and not fulfill?

verses.textZh: 我奉命来祝福；神要赐福，我不能改变。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我奉命来祝福；神要赐福，我不能改变。
verses.textZhCuv: 我奉命祝福；神也曾赐福，此事我不能翻转。
verses.textEnNiv: I have received a command to bless; he has blessed, and I cannot change it.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I received a command to bless: he has blessed, and I cannot revoke it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I have received acommand to bless; He has blessed, and I cannot reverse it.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen, I received a command to bless; God has blessed, and I cannot reverse it!
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I have received a command to bless; When He has blessed, I cannot revoke it.
verses.textEn: I have received a command to bless; he has blessed, and I cannot change it.

verses.textZh: 在雅各中不见罪孽， 在以色列中也不见患难； 耶和华他们的神与他们同在， 有君王欢呼的声音在他们中间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在雅各中不见罪孽， 在以色列中也不见患难； 耶和华他们的神与他们同在， 有君王欢呼的声音在他们中间。
verses.textZhCuv: 他未见雅各中有罪孽， 也未见以色列中有奸恶。 耶和华－他的神和他同在； 有欢呼王的声音在他们中间。
verses.textEnNiv: "No misfortune is seen in Jacob, no misery observed in Israel. The Lord their God is with them; the shout of the King is among them.
verses.textEnEsv: He has not beheld misfortune in Jacob, nor has he seen trouble in Israel. The Lord their God is with them, and the shout of a king is among them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "He has not observed iniquity in Jacob, Nor has He seen wickedness in Israel. The Lord his God is with him, And the shout of a King is among them.
verses.textEnNlt: No misfortune is in his plan for Jacob; no trouble is in store for Israel. For the Lord their God is with them; he has been proclaimed their king.
verses.textEnNasb: "He has not looked at misfortune in Jacob; Nor has He seen trouble in Israel; The Lord his God is with him, And the joyful shout of a king is among them.
verses.textEn: "No misfortune is seen in Jacob, no misery observed in Israel. The Lord their God is with them; the shout of the King is among them.

verses.textZh: 领他们出埃及的神， 对他们有如野牛的角。
verses.textZhCnvs: 领他们出埃及的神， 对他们有如野牛的角。
verses.textZhCuv: 神领他们出埃及； 他们似乎有野牛之力。
verses.textEnNiv: God brought them out of Egypt; they have the strength of a wild ox.
verses.textEnEsv: God brings them out of Egypt and is for them like the horns of the wild ox.
verses.textEnNkjv: God brings them out of Egypt; He has strength like a wild ox.
verses.textEnNlt: God brought them out of Egypt; for them he is as strong as a wild ox.
verses.textEnNasb: "God brings them out of Egypt, He is for them like the horns of the wild ox.
verses.textEn: God brought them out of Egypt; they have the strength of a wild ox.

verses.textZh: 在雅各中没有观兆的， 在以色列中也没有占卜； 到了适当的时候，必有话对雅各和以色列说： ‘神为他们行了何等的大事！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 在雅各中没有观兆的， 在以色列中也没有占卜； 到了适当的时候，必有话对雅各和以色列说： ‘神为他们行了何等的大事！’
verses.textZhCuv: 断没有法术可以害雅各， 也没有占卜可以害以色列。 现在必有人论及雅各，就是论及以色列说：神为他行了何等的大事！
verses.textEnNiv: There is no divination against Jacob, no evil omens against Israel. It will now be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘See what God has done!’
verses.textEnEsv: For there is no enchantment against Jacob, no divination against Israel; now it shall be said of Jacob and Israel, ‘What has God wrought!’
verses.textEnNkjv: "For thereis no sorcery against Jacob, Nor any divination against Israel. It now must be said of Jacob And of Israel, ‘Oh, what God has done!’
verses.textEnNlt: No curse can touch Jacob; no magic has any power against Israel. For now it will be said of Jacob, ‘What wonders God has done for Israel!’
verses.textEnNasb: "For there is no magic curse against Jacob, Nor is there any divination against Israel; At the proper time it shall be said to Jacob And to Israel, what God has done!
verses.textEn: There is no divination against Jacob, no evil omens against Israel. It will now be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘See what God has done!’

verses.textZh: 这民族起来有如母狮， 挺身好象公狮； 不吃下猎物，不喝被杀的人的血， 决不卧下。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这民族起来有如母狮， 挺身好象公狮； 不吃下猎物，不喝被杀的人的血， 决不卧下。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这民起来，仿佛母狮， 挺身，好像公狮， 未曾吃野食， 未曾喝被伤者之血，决不躺卧。
verses.textEnNiv: The people rise like a lioness; they rouse themselves like a lion that does not rest till it devours its prey and drinks the blood of its victims."
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, a people! As a lioness it rises up and as a lion it lifts itself; it does not lie down until it has devoured the prey and drunk the blood of the slain."
verses.textEnNkjv: Look, a people rises like a lioness, And lifts itself up like a lion; It shall not lie down until it devours the prey, And drinks the blood of the slain."
verses.textEnNlt: These people rise up like a lioness, like a majestic lion rousing itself. They refuse to rest until they have feasted on prey, drinking the blood of the slaughtered!"
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, a people rises like a lioness, And like a lion it raises itself; It will not lie down until it devours the prey, And drinks the blood of those slain."
verses.textEn: The people rise like a lioness; they rouse themselves like a lion that does not rest till it devours its prey and drinks the blood of its victims."

verses.textZh: 巴勒对巴兰说："你一点不要咒诅他们，也不要祝福他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴勒对巴兰说："你一点不要咒诅他们，也不要祝福他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 巴勒对巴兰说：「你一点不要咒诅他们，也不要为他们祝福。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Neither curse them at all nor bless them at all!"
verses.textEnEsv: And Balak said to Balaam, "Do not curse them at all, and do not bless them at all."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Fine, but if you won’t curse them, at least don’t bless them!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Do not curse them at all nor bless them at all!"
verses.textEn: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Neither curse them at all nor bless them at all!"

verses.textZh: 巴兰回答巴勒说："我不是告诉过你说：‘耶和华吩咐我的，我都必要遵行’吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰回答巴勒说："我不是告诉过你说：‘耶和华吩咐我的，我都必要遵行’吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 巴兰回答巴勒说：「我岂不是告诉你说『凡耶和华所说的，我必须遵行』吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Balaam answered, "Did I not tell you I must do whatever the Lord says?"
verses.textEnEsv: But Balaam answered Balak, "Did I not tell you, ‘All that the Lord says, that I must do’?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So Balaam answered and said to Balak, "Did I not tell you, saying, ‘All that the Lord speaks, that I must do’?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Balaam replied to Balak, "Didn’t I tell you that I can do only what the Lord tells me?"
verses.textEnNasb: But Balaam replied to Balak, "Did I not tell you, ‘ Whatever the Lord speaks, I must do’?"
verses.textEn: Balaam answered, "Did I not tell you I must do whatever the Lord says?"

verses.textZh: 巴勒对巴兰说："你来，我领你到另一个地方去，或者神喜欢你，你就可以在那里为我咒诅他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴勒对巴兰说："你来，我领你到另一个地方去，或者神喜欢你，你就可以在那里为我咒诅他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 巴勒对巴兰说：「来吧，我领你往别处去，或者神喜欢你在那里为我咒诅他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Come, let me take you to another place. Perhaps it will please God to let you curse them for me from there."
verses.textEnEsv: And Balak said to Balaam, "Come now, I will take you to another place. Perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Please come, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there."
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Balak said to Balaam, "Come, I will take you to one more place. Perhaps it will please God to let you curse them from there."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Please come, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will be agreeable with God that you curse them for me from there."
verses.textEn: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Come, let me take you to another place. Perhaps it will please God to let you curse them for me from there."

verses.textZh: 于是，巴勒领巴兰到了俯视旷野的毘珥山顶去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，巴勒领巴兰到了俯视旷野的毘珥山顶去。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴勒就领巴兰到那下望旷野的毗珥山顶上。
verses.textEnNiv: And Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, overlooking the wasteland.
verses.textEnEsv: So Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, which overlooks the desert.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that overlooks the wasteland.
verses.textEnNlt: So Balak took Balaam to the top of Mount Peor, overlooking the wasteland.
verses.textEnNasb: So Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, which overlooks the desert.
verses.textEn: And Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, overlooking the wasteland.

verses.textZh: 巴兰对巴勒说："你要在这里给我筑七座祭坛，也要为我预备七头公牛和七只公绵羊。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰对巴勒说："你要在这里给我筑七座祭坛，也要为我预备七头公牛和七只公绵羊。"
verses.textZhCuv: 巴兰对巴勒说：「你在这里为我筑七座坛，又在这里为我预备七只公牛，七只公羊。」
verses.textEnNiv: Balaam said, "Build me seven altars here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me."
verses.textEnEsv: And Balaam said to Balak, "Build for me here seven altars and prepare for me here seven bulls and seven rams."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Balaam said to Balak, "Build for me here seven altars, and prepare for me here seven bulls and seven rams."
verses.textEnNlt: Balaam again told Balak, "Build me seven altars, and prepare seven young bulls and seven rams for me to sacrifice."
verses.textEnNasb: And Balaam said to Balak, "Build seven altars for me here and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here."
verses.textEn: Balaam said, "Build me seven altars here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me."

verses.textZh: 巴勒就照着巴兰所说的行了，在每座祭坛上，献上一头公牛和一只公绵羊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴勒就照着巴兰所说的行了，在每座祭坛上，献上一头公牛和一只公绵羊。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴勒就照巴兰的话行，在每座坛上献一只公牛，一只公羊。
verses.textEnNiv: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bull and a ram on every altar.
verses.textEnNlt: So Balak did as Balaam ordered and offered a young bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Balak did just as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.textEn: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

verses.textZh: 巴兰见耶和华喜欢赐福以色列，就不再像前两次一样去求观兆的方法，却面向旷野。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰见耶和华喜欢赐福以色列，就不再像前两次一样去求观兆的方法，却面向旷野。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴兰见耶和华喜欢赐福与以色列，就不像前两次去求法术，却面向旷野。
verses.textEnNiv: Now when Balaam saw that it pleased the Lord to bless Israel, he did not resort to divination as at other times, but turned his face toward the wilderness.
verses.textEnEsv: When Balaam saw that it pleased the Lord to bless Israel, he did not go, as at other times, to look for omens, but set his face toward the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Balaam saw that it pleased the Lord to bless Israel, he did not go as at other times, to seek to use sorcery, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: By now Balaam realized that the Lord was determined to bless Israel, so he did not resort to divination as before. Instead, he turned and looked out toward the wilderness,
verses.textEnNasb: When Balaam saw that it pleased the Lord to bless Israel, he did not go as at other times to seek omens, rather he turned his attention toward the wilderness.
verses.textEn: Now when Balaam saw that it pleased the Lord to bless Israel, he did not resort to divination as at other times, but turned his face toward the wilderness.

verses.textZh: 巴兰举目，看见以色列人按着支派居住，神的灵就临到他身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰举目，看见以色列人按着支派居住，神的灵就临到他身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴兰举目，看见以色列人照着支派居住。神的灵就临到他身上，
verses.textEnNiv: When Balaam looked out and saw Israel encamped tribe by tribe, the Spirit of God came on him
verses.textEnEsv: And Balaam lifted up his eyes and saw Israel camping tribe by tribe. And the Spirit of God came upon him,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Balaam raised his eyes, and saw Israel encamped according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came upon him.
verses.textEnNlt: where he saw the people of Israel camped, tribe by tribe. Then the Spirit of God came upon him,
verses.textEnNasb: And Balaam raised his eyes and saw Israel camping tribe by tribe; and the Spirit of God came upon him.
verses.textEn: When Balaam looked out and saw Israel encamped tribe by tribe, the Spirit of God came on him

verses.textZh: 他就作歌，说： "比珥的儿子巴兰说： ‘有眼光的人说，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就作歌，说： "比珥的儿子巴兰说： ‘有眼光的人说，
verses.textZhCuv: 他便题起诗歌说： 比珥的儿子巴兰说， 眼目闭住 的人说，
verses.textEnNiv: and he spoke his message: "The prophecy of Balaam son of Beor, the prophecy of one whose eye sees clearly,
verses.textEnEsv: and he took up his discourse and said, "The oracle of Balaam the son of Beor, the oracle of the man whose eye is opened,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he took up his oracle and said: "The utterance of Balaam the son of Beor, The utterance of the man whose eyes are opened,
verses.textEnNlt: and this is the message he delivered: "This is the message of Balaam son of Beor, the message of the man whose eyes see clearly,
verses.textEnNasb: Then he took up his discourse and said, "The declaration of Balaam the son of Beor, And the declaration of the man whose eye is opened;
verses.textEn: and he spoke his message: "The prophecy of Balaam son of Beor, the prophecy of one whose eye sees clearly,

verses.textZh: 得听神的话语、 得见全能者的异象、 身体仆倒而眼目睁开的人说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 得听神的话语、 得见全能者的异象、 身体仆倒而眼目睁开的人说：
verses.textZhCuv: 得听神的言语， 得见全能者的异象， 眼目睁开而仆倒的人说：
verses.textEnNiv: the prophecy of one who hears the words of God, who sees a vision from the Almighty, who falls prostrate, and whose eyes are opened:
verses.textEnEsv: the oracle of him who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down with his eyes uncovered:
verses.textEnNkjv: The utterance of him who hears the words of God, Who sees the vision of the Almighty, Who falls down, with eyes wide open:
verses.textEnNlt: the message of one who hears the words of God, who sees a vision from the Almighty, who bows down with eyes wide open:
verses.textEnNasb: The declaration of him who hears the words of God, Who sees the vision of the Almighty, Falling down, yet having his eyes uncovered,
verses.textEn: the prophecy of one who hears the words of God, who sees a vision from the Almighty, who falls prostrate, and whose eyes are opened:

verses.textZh: 雅各啊，你的会幕多么佳美； 以色列啊，你的帐幕多么美好！
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各啊，你的会幕多么佳美； 以色列啊，你的帐幕多么美好！
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各啊，你的帐棚何等华美！ 以色列啊，你的帐幕何其华丽！
verses.textEnNiv: "How beautiful are your tents, Jacob, your dwelling places, Israel!
verses.textEnEsv: How lovely are your tents, O Jacob, your encampments, O Israel!
verses.textEnNkjv: "How lovely are your tents, O Jacob! Your dwellings, O Israel!
verses.textEnNlt: How beautiful are your tents, O Jacob; how lovely are your homes, O Israel!
verses.textEnNasb: How pleasant are your tents, Jacob, Your dwelling places, Israel!
verses.textEn: "How beautiful are your tents, Jacob, your dwelling places, Israel!

verses.textZh: 像扩展的棕林， 如河边的园子， 似耶和华栽种的沉香树， 又像水旁的香柏树。
verses.textZhCnvs: 像扩展的棕林， 如河边的园子， 似耶和华栽种的沉香树， 又像水旁的香柏树。
verses.textZhCuv: 如接连的山谷， 如河旁的园子， 如耶和华所栽的沉香树， 如水边的香柏木。
verses.textEnNiv: "Like valleys they spread out, like gardens beside a river, like aloes planted by the Lord , like cedars beside the waters.
verses.textEnEsv: Like palm groves that stretch afar, like gardens beside a river, like aloes that the Lord has planted, like cedar trees beside the waters.
verses.textEnNkjv: Like valleys that stretch out, Like gardens by the riverside, Like aloes planted by the Lord, Like cedars beside the waters.
verses.textEnNlt: They spread before me like palm groves, like gardens by the riverside. They are like tall trees planted by the Lord , like cedars beside the waters.
verses.textEnNasb: "Like valleys that stretch out, Like gardens beside a river, Like aloes planted by the Lord, Like cedars beside the waters.
verses.textEn: "Like valleys they spread out, like gardens beside a river, like aloes planted by the Lord , like cedars beside the waters.

verses.textZh: 必有水从他的桶中流出来， 他的后裔必在多水之处； 他的王必超过亚甲， 他的国度必被高举。
verses.textZhCnvs: 必有水从他的桶中流出来， 他的后裔必在多水之处； 他的王必超过亚甲， 他的国度必被高举。
verses.textZhCuv: 水要从他的桶里流出； 种子要撒在多水之处。 他的王必超过亚甲； 他的国必要振兴。
verses.textEnNiv: Water will flow from their buckets; their seed will have abundant water. "Their king will be greater than Agag; their kingdom will be exalted.
verses.textEnEsv: Water shall flow from his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters; his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall pour water from his buckets, And his seed shallbe in many waters. "His king shall be higher than Agag, And his kingdom shall be exalted.
verses.textEnNlt: Water will flow from their buckets; their offspring have all they need. Their king will be greater than Agag; their kingdom will be exalted.
verses.textEnNasb: "Water will flow from his buckets, And his seed will be by many waters, And his king shall be higher than Agag, And his kingdom shall be exalted.
verses.textEn: Water will flow from their buckets; their seed will have abundant water. "Their king will be greater than Agag; their kingdom will be exalted.

verses.textZh: 领他出埃及的神， 对他好象野牛的角； 他要吞吃敌国， 打碎他们的骨头， 用箭射透他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 领他出埃及的神， 对他好象野牛的角； 他要吞吃敌国， 打碎他们的骨头， 用箭射透他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 神领他出埃及； 他似乎有野牛之力。 他要吞吃敌国， 折断他们的骨头， 用箭射透他们。
verses.textEnNiv: "God brought them out of Egypt; they have the strength of a wild ox. They devour hostile nations and break their bones in pieces; with their arrows they pierce them.
verses.textEnEsv: God brings him out of Egypt and is for him like the horns of the wild ox; he shall eat up the nations, his adversaries, and shall break their bones in pieces and pierce them through with his arrows.
verses.textEnNkjv: "God brings him out of Egypt; He has strength like a wild ox; He shall consume the nations, his enemies; He shall break their bones And pierce them with his arrows.
verses.textEnNlt: God brought them out of Egypt; for them he is as strong as a wild ox. He devours all the nations that oppose him, breaking their bones in pieces, shooting them with arrows.
verses.textEnNasb: "God brings him out of Egypt, He is for him like the horns of the wild ox. He will devour the nations who are his adversaries, And will crush their bones, And smash them with his arrows.
verses.textEn: "God brought them out of Egypt; they have the strength of a wild ox. They devour hostile nations and break their bones in pieces; with their arrows they pierce them.

verses.textZh: 他蹲伏躺下，好象公狮， 又像母狮，谁敢使他起立呢？ 给你祝福的，愿他蒙福； 咒诅你的，愿他受咒诅。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他蹲伏躺下，好象公狮， 又像母狮，谁敢使他起立呢？ 给你祝福的，愿他蒙福； 咒诅你的，愿他受咒诅。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他蹲如公狮， 卧如母狮，谁敢惹他？ 凡给你祝福的，愿他蒙福； 凡咒诅你的，愿他受咒诅。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a lion they crouch and lie down, like a lioness—who dares to rouse them? "May those who bless you be blessed and those who curse you be cursed!"
verses.textEnEsv: He crouched, he lay down like a lion and like a lioness; who will rouse him up? Blessed are those who bless you, and cursed are those who curse you."
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘He bows down, he lies down as a lion; And as a lion, who shall rouse him?’ "Blessed is he who blesses you, And cursed is he who curses you."
verses.textEnNlt: Like a lion, Israel crouches and lies down; like a lioness, who dares to arouse her? Blessed is everyone who blesses you, O Israel, and cursed is everyone who curses you."
verses.textEnNasb: "He crouches, he lies down like a lion, And like a lioness, who dares to rouse him? Blessed is everyone who blesses you, And cursed is everyone who curses you."
verses.textEn: Like a lion they crouch and lie down, like a lioness—who dares to rouse them? "May those who bless you be blessed and those who curse you be cursed!"

verses.textZh: 巴勒向巴兰生气，就拍起手；巴勒对巴兰说："我请你来咒诅我的敌人，如今你反倒祝福他们这三次。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴勒向巴兰生气，就拍起手；巴勒对巴兰说："我请你来咒诅我的敌人，如今你反倒祝福他们这三次。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴勒向巴兰生气，就拍起手来，对巴兰说：「我召你来为我咒诅仇敌，不料，你这三次竟为他们祝福。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Balak’s anger burned against Balaam. He struck his hands together and said to him, "I summoned you to curse my enemies, but you have blessed them these three times.
verses.textEnEsv: And Balak’s anger was kindled against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. And Balak said to Balaam, "I called you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them these three times.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Balak’s anger was aroused against Balaam, and he struck his hands together; and Balak said to Balaam, "I called you to curse my enemies, and look, you have bountifully blessed them these three times!
verses.textEnNlt: King Balak flew into a rage against Balaam. He angrily clapped his hands and shouted, "I called you to curse my enemies! Instead, you have blessed them three times.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together; and Balak said to Balaam, "I called you to curse my enemies, but behold, you have persisted in blessing them these three times!
verses.textEn: Then Balak’s anger burned against Balaam. He struck his hands together and said to him, "I summoned you to curse my enemies, but you have blessed them these three times.

verses.textZh: 现在你逃回你的地方去吧；我说过我要大大地使你得尊荣，但是耶和华阻止你使你不得尊荣。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你逃回你的地方去吧；我说过我要大大地使你得尊荣，但是耶和华阻止你使你不得尊荣。"
verses.textZhCuv: 如今你快回本地去吧！我想使你得大尊荣，耶和华却阻止你不得尊荣。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now leave at once and go home! I said I would reward you handsomely, but the Lord has kept you from being rewarded."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore now flee to your own place. I said, ‘I will certainly honor you,’ but the Lord has held you back from honor."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, flee to your place. I said I would greatly honor you, but in fact, the Lord has kept you back from honor."
verses.textEnNlt: Now get out of here! Go back home! I promised to reward you richly, but the Lord has kept you from your reward."

verses.textEn: Now leave at once and go home! I said I would reward you handsomely, but the Lord has kept you from being rewarded."

verses.textZhCnvs: ‘就算巴勒把满屋的金银给我，我也不能越过耶和华的命令，随自己的心意行好行歹’吗？耶和华说甚么，我就说甚么。

verses.textEnNasb: ‘If Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not do anything contrary to the command of the Lord, either good or bad, of my own accord. What the Lord speaks, I will speak’?
verses.textEn: ‘Even if Balak gave me all the silver and gold in his palace, I could not do anything of my own accord, good or bad, to go beyond the command of the Lord —and I must say only what the Lord says’?

verses.textZh: 我看见他，却不是现在； 我望见他，却不是近处； 必有一星从雅各而出， 必有一杖从以色列兴起； 他必打碎摩押的额角， 粉碎一切舍特人的头顶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看见他，却不是现在； 我望见他，却不是近处； 必有一星从雅各而出， 必有一杖从以色列兴起； 他必打碎摩押的额角， 粉碎一切舍特人的头顶。
verses.textZhCuv: 我看他却不在现时； 我望他却不在近日。 有星要出于雅各，有杖要兴于以色列， 必打破摩押的四角，毁坏扰乱之子。
verses.textEnNiv: "I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob; a scepter will rise out of Israel. He will crush the foreheads of Moab, the skulls of all the people of Sheth.
verses.textEnEsv: I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near: a star shall come out of Jacob, and a scepter shall rise out of Israel; it shall crush the forehead of Moab and break down all the sons of Sheth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I see Him, but not now; I behold Him, but not near; A Star shall come out of Jacob; A Scepter shall rise out of Israel, And batter the brow of Moab, And destroy all the sons of tumult.
verses.textEnNlt: I see him, but not here and now. I perceive him, but far in the distant future. A star will rise from Jacob; a scepter will emerge from Israel. It will crush the heads of Moab’s people, cracking the skulls of the people of Sheth.
verses.textEnNasb: I see him, but not now; I look at him, but not near; A star shall appear from Jacob, A scepter shall rise from Israel, And shall smash the forehead of Moab, And overcome all the sons of Sheth.
verses.textEn: "I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob; a scepter will rise out of Israel. He will crush the foreheads of Moab, the skulls of all the people of Sheth.

verses.textEnNiv: Edom will be conquered; Seir, his enemy, will be conquered, but Israel will grow strong.

verses.textEnNasb: "And Edom shall be a possession, Seir, its enemies, also will be a possession, While Israel performs valiantly.
verses.textEn: Edom will be conquered; Seir, his enemy, will be conquered, but Israel will grow strong.

verses.textZhCnvs: 巴兰又作歌，说： "哀哉，神决定这事，谁能得活呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 巴兰又题起诗歌说： 哀哉！神行这事，谁能得活？

verses.textEn: Then he spoke his message: "Alas! Who can live when God does this?

verses.textEnNiv: who invited them to the sacrifices to their gods. The people ate the sacrificial meal and bowed down before these gods.

verses.textZh: 以色列人与巴力．毘珥连合，耶和华就向以色列人发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人与巴力．毘珥连合，耶和华就向以色列人发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人与巴力‧毗珥连合，耶和华的怒气就向以色列人发作。
verses.textEnNiv: So Israel yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor. And the Lord ’s anger burned against them.

verses.textEnNasb: So Israel became followers of Baal of Peor, and the Lord was angry with Israel.
verses.textEn: So Israel yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor. And the Lord ’s anger burned against them.

verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说："把人民的首领都捉来，在我耶和华面前对着太阳把他们悬挂起来，好使耶和华的烈怒可以转消，不向以色列人发作。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「将百姓中所有的族长在我面前对着日头悬挂，使我向以色列人所发的怒气可以消了。」

verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Take all the leaders of the people and hang the offenders before the Lord, out in the sun, that the fierce anger of the Lord may turn away from Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord issued the following command to Moses: "Seize all the ringleaders and execute them before the Lord in broad daylight, so his fierce anger will turn away from the people of Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to Moses, "Take all the leaders of the people and execute them in broad daylight before the Lord, so that the fierce anger of the Lord may turn away from Israel."
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses, "Take all the leaders of these people, kill them and expose them in broad daylight before the Lord , so that the Lord ’s fierce anger may turn away from Israel."
