verses.textEn: So Moses said to Israel’s judges, "Each of you must put to death those of your people who have yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor."

verses.textZh: 摩西和以色列全体会众在会幕门口哭泣的时候，以色列人中有一个人来，当着他们的面带了一个米甸女子到自己的兄弟那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和以色列全体会众在会幕门口哭泣的时候，以色列人中有一个人来，当着他们的面带了一个米甸女子到自己的兄弟那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西和以色列全会众正在会幕门前哭泣的时候，谁知，有以色列中的一个人，当他们眼前，带着一个米甸女人到他弟兄那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then an Israelite man brought into the camp a Midianite woman right before the eyes of Moses and the whole assembly of Israel while they were weeping at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, one of the people of Israel came and brought a Midianite woman to his family, in the sight of Moses and in the sight of the whole congregation of the people of Israel, while they were weeping in the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEnNkjv: And indeed, one of the children of Israel came and presented to his brethren a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping at the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
verses.textEnNlt: Just then one of the Israelite men brought a Midianite woman into his tent, right before the eyes of Moses and all the people, as everyone was weeping at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: Then behold, one of the sons of Israel came and brought to his relatives a Midianite woman, in the sight of Moses and in the sight of the whole congregation of the sons of Israel, while they were weeping at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.textEn: Then an Israelite man brought into the camp a Midianite woman right before the eyes of Moses and the whole assembly of Israel while they were weeping at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

verses.textZh: 亚伦祭司的孙子、以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈看见了，就从会众中起来，手里拿着枪，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦祭司的孙子、以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈看见了，就从会众中起来，手里拿着枪，
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司亚伦的孙子，以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈看见了，就从会中起来，手里拿着枪，
verses.textEnNiv: When Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, the priest, saw this, he left the assembly, took a spear in his hand
verses.textEnEsv: When Phinehas the son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose and left the congregation and took a spear in his hand
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Phinehas the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose from among the congregation and took a javelin in his hand;
verses.textEnNlt: When Phinehas son of Eleazar and grandson of Aaron the priest saw this, he jumped up and left the assembly. He took a spear
verses.textEnNasb: When Phinehas the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the midst of the congregation and took a spear in his hand,
verses.textEn: When Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, the priest, saw this, he left the assembly, took a spear in his hand

verses.textZh: 跟着那以色列人，进入卧室，把他们两人刺透，就是刺透那以色列人和那女子。枪刺进了那女子的肚腹。这样，在以色列人中的瘟疫才止住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 跟着那以色列人，进入卧室，把他们两人刺透，就是刺透那以色列人和那女子。枪刺进了那女子的肚腹。这样，在以色列人中的瘟疫才止住。
verses.textZhCuv: 跟随那以色列人进亭子里去，便将以色列人和那女人由腹中刺透。这样，在以色列人中瘟疫就止息了。
verses.textEnNiv: and followed the Israelite into the tent. He drove the spear into both of them, right through the Israelite man and into the woman’s stomach. Then the plague against the Israelites was stopped;
verses.textEnEsv: and went after the man of Israel into the chamber and pierced both of them, the man of Israel and the woman through her belly. Thus the plague on the people of Israel was stopped.
verses.textEnNkjv: and he went after the man of Israel into the tent and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stopped among the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: and rushed after the man into his tent. Phinehas thrust the spear all the way through the man’s body and into the woman’s stomach. So the plague against the Israelites was stopped,
verses.textEnNasb: and he went after the man of Israel into the inner room of the tent and pierced both of them, the man of Israel and the woman, through the abdomen. So the plague on the sons of Israel was brought to a halt.
verses.textEn: and followed the Israelite into the tent. He drove the spear into both of them, right through the Israelite man and into the woman’s stomach. Then the plague against the Israelites was stopped;

verses.textZh: 那时因瘟疫而死的，共有二万四千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时因瘟疫而死的，共有二万四千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时遭瘟疫死的，有二万四千人。
verses.textEnNiv: but those who died in the plague numbered 24,000.
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.
verses.textEnNkjv: And those who died in the plague were twenty-four thousand.
verses.textEnNlt: but not before 24,000 people had died.
verses.textEnNasb: But those who died from the plague were twenty-four thousand in number.
verses.textEn: but those who died in the plague numbered 24,000.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "亚伦祭司的孙子、以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈，使我的烈怒稍消，不向以色列人发作，因为他在他们中间以我忌邪的心为心，使我不因我忌邪的心把他们消灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: "亚伦祭司的孙子、以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈，使我的烈怒稍消，不向以色列人发作，因为他在他们中间以我忌邪的心为心，使我不因我忌邪的心把他们消灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 「祭司亚伦的孙子，以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈，使我向以色列人所发的怒消了；因他在他们中间，以我的忌邪为心，使我不在忌邪中把他们除灭。
verses.textEnNiv: "Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, the priest, has turned my anger away from the Israelites. Since he was as zealous for my honor among them as I am, I did not put an end to them in my zeal.
verses.textEnEsv: "Phinehas the son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, has turned back my wrath from the people of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I did not consume the people of Israel in my jealousy.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Phinehas the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned back My wrath from the children of Israel, because he was zealous with My zeal among them, so that I did not consume the children of Israel in My zeal.
verses.textEnNlt: "Phinehas son of Eleazar and grandson of Aaron the priest has turned my anger away from the Israelites by being as zealous among them as I was. So I stopped destroying all Israel as I had intended to do in my zealous anger.
verses.textEnNasb: "Phinehas the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has averted My wrath from the sons of Israel in that he was jealous with My jealousy among them, so that I did not destroy the sons of Israel in My jealousy.
verses.textEn: "Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, the priest, has turned my anger away from the Israelites. Since he was as zealous for my honor among them as I am, I did not put an end to them in my zeal.

verses.textZh: 因此你要说：‘现在我把平安之约赐给他，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此你要说：‘现在我把平安之约赐给他，
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，你要说：『我将我平安的约赐给他。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore tell him I am making my covenant of peace with him.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him My covenant of peace;
verses.textEnNlt: Now tell him that I am making my special covenant of peace with him.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I am giving him My covenant of peace;
verses.textEn: Therefore tell him I am making my covenant of peace with him.

verses.textZh: 要给他和他的后裔作为永远担当祭司职分的约，因为他为他的神有忌邪的心，为以色列人赎罪。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 要给他和他的后裔作为永远担当祭司职分的约，因为他为他的神有忌邪的心，为以色列人赎罪。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 这约要给他和他的后裔，作为永远当祭司职任的约；因他为神有忌邪的心，为以色列人赎罪。』」
verses.textEnNiv: He and his descendants will have a covenant of a lasting priesthood, because he was zealous for the honor of his God and made atonement for the Israelites."
verses.textEnEsv: and it shall be to him and to his descendants after him the covenant of a perpetual priesthood, because he was jealous for his God and made atonement for the people of Israel.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: and it shall be to him and his descendants after him a covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was zealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: In this covenant, I give him and his descendants a permanent right to the priesthood, for in his zeal for me, his God, he purified the people of Israel, making them right with me. "
verses.textEnNasb: and it shall be for him and for his descendants after him, a covenant of a permanent priesthood, because he was jealous for his God and made atonement for the sons of Israel.’ "
verses.textEn: He and his descendants will have a covenant of a lasting priesthood, because he was zealous for the honor of his God and made atonement for the Israelites."

verses.textZh: 那被杀的以色列人，就是与那米甸女子一同被杀的人，名叫心利，是撒路的儿子，是西缅支派中一个家族的领袖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那被杀的以色列人，就是与那米甸女子一同被杀的人，名叫心利，是撒路的儿子，是西缅支派中一个家族的领袖。
verses.textZhCuv: 那与米甸女人一同被杀的以色列人，名叫心利，是撒路的儿子，是西缅一个宗族的首领。
verses.textEnNiv: The name of the Israelite who was killed with the Midianite woman was Zimri son of Salu, the leader of a Simeonite family.
verses.textEnEsv: The name of the slain man of Israel, who was killed with the Midianite woman, was Zimri the son of Salu, chief of a father’s house belonging to the Simeonites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the name of the Israelite who was killed, who was killed with the Midianite woman, was Zimri the son of Salu, a leader of a father’s house among the Simeonites.
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelite man killed with the Midianite woman was named Zimri son of Salu, the leader of a family from the tribe of Simeon.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the name of the dead man of Israel who was killed with the Midianite woman, was Zimri the son of Salu, a leader of a father’s household among the Simeonites.
verses.textEn: The name of the Israelite who was killed with the Midianite woman was Zimri son of Salu, the leader of a Simeonite family.

verses.textZh: 那被杀的米甸女子，名叫哥斯比，是苏珥的女儿；这苏珥是米甸一个家族的族长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那被杀的米甸女子，名叫哥斯比，是苏珥的女儿；这苏珥是米甸一个家族的族长。
verses.textZhCuv: 那被杀的米甸女人，名叫哥斯比，是苏珥的女儿；这苏珥是米甸一个宗族的首领。
verses.textEnNiv: And the name of the Midianite woman who was put to death was Kozbi daughter of Zur, a tribal chief of a Midianite family.
verses.textEnEsv: And the name of the Midianite woman who was killed was Cozbi the daughter of Zur, who was the tribal head of a father’s house in Midian.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the name of the Midianite woman who was killed was Cozbi the daughter of Zur; he was head of the people of a father’s house in Midian.
verses.textEnNlt: The woman’s name was Cozbi; she was the daughter of Zur, the leader of a Midianite clan.
verses.textEnNasb: And the name of the Midianite woman who was killed was Cozbi the daughter of Zur, who was head of the people of a father’s household in Midian.
verses.textEn: And the name of the Midianite woman who was put to death was Kozbi daughter of Zur, a tribal chief of a Midianite family.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：

verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要扰害米甸人，打击他们；
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要扰害米甸人，打击他们；
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要扰害米甸人，击杀他们；
verses.textEnNiv: "Treat the Midianites as enemies and kill them.
verses.textEnEsv: "Harass the Midianites and strike them down,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Harass the Midianites, and attack them;
verses.textEnNlt: "Attack the Midianites and destroy them,
verses.textEnNasb: "Be hostile to the Midianites and attack them;
verses.textEn: "Treat the Midianites as enemies and kill them.

verses.textZh: 因为他们用诡计扰害你们；在毘珥的事上，和他们的姊妹，米甸领袖的女儿哥斯比的事上，用诡计欺骗了你们。"这哥斯比在瘟疫的日子，因毘珥的事被杀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们用诡计扰害你们；在毘珥的事上，和他们的姊妹，米甸领袖的女儿哥斯比的事上，用诡计欺骗了你们。"这哥斯比在瘟疫的日子，因毘珥的事被杀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们用诡计扰害你们，在毗珥的事上和他们的姊妹、米甸首领的女儿哥斯比的事上，用这诡计诱惑了你们；这哥斯比，当瘟疫流行的日子，因毗珥的事被杀了。」
verses.textEnNiv: They treated you as enemies when they deceived you in the Peor incident involving their sister Kozbi, the daughter of a Midianite leader, the woman who was killed when the plague came as a result of that incident."
verses.textEnEsv: for they have harassed you with their wiles, with which they beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of the chief of Midian, their sister, who was killed on the day of the plague on account of Peor."
verses.textEnNkjv: for they harassed you with their schemes by which they seduced you in the matter of Peor and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a leader of Midian, their sister, who was killed in the day of the plague because of Peor."
verses.textEnNlt: because they assaulted you with deceit and tricked you into worshiping Baal of Peor, and because of Cozbi, the daughter of a Midianite leader, who was killed at the time of the plague because of what happened at Peor."
verses.textEnNasb: for they have been hostile to you with their tricks, with which they have deceived you in the matter of Peor and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of the leader of Midian, their sister who was killed on the day of the plague because of Peor."
verses.textEn: They treated you as enemies when they deceived you in the Peor incident involving their sister Kozbi, the daughter of a Midianite leader, the woman who was killed when the plague came as a result of that incident."

verses.textZh: 瘟疫以后，耶和华对摩西和亚伦的儿子以利亚撒说：

verses.textEnNiv: After the plague the Lord said to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest,
verses.textEnEsv: After the plague, the Lord said to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron, the priest,
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, after the plague, that the Lord spoke to Moses and Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: After the plague had ended, the Lord said to Moses and to Eleazar son of Aaron the priest,
verses.textEnNasb: Then it came about after the plague, that the Lord spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
verses.textEn: After the plague the Lord said to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest,

verses.textZh: "你们要把以色列会众，从二十岁以上，在以色列中能出去打仗的，按着他们的父家，计算数目。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要把以色列会众，从二十岁以上，在以色列中能出去打仗的，按着他们的父家，计算数目。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们要将以色列全会众，按他们的宗族，凡以色列中从二十岁以外、能出去打仗的，计算总数。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Take a census of the whole Israelite community by families—all those twenty years old or more who are able to serve in the army of Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: "Take a census of all the congregation of the people of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all in Israel who are able to go to war."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel from twenty years old and above, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go to war in Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: "From the whole community of Israel, record the names of all the warriors by their families. List all the men twenty years old or older who are able to go to war."
verses.textEnNasb: "Take a census of all the congregation of the sons of Israel from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ households, whoever is able to go to war in Israel."
verses.textEn: "Take a census of the whole Israelite community by families—all those twenty years old or more who are able to serve in the army of Israel."

verses.textZh: 于是，摩西和以利亚撒祭司在摩押旷野，就是在耶利哥附近的约旦河边，告诉他们：
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，摩西和以利亚撒祭司在摩押旷野，就是在耶利哥附近的约旦河边，告诉他们：
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西和祭司以利亚撒在摩押平原与耶利哥相对的约旦河边向以色列人说：
verses.textEnNiv: So on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them and said,
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan, acrossfrom Jericho, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: So there on the plains of Moab beside the Jordan River, across from Jericho, Moses and Eleazar the priest issued these instructions to the leaders of Israel:
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
verses.textEn: So on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them and said,

verses.textZh: "从二十岁以上的，你们都要登记数目。"这是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。从埃及地出来的以色列人计有：
verses.textZhCnvs: "从二十岁以上的，你们都要登记数目。"这是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。从埃及地出来的以色列人计有：
verses.textZhCuv: 「将你们中间从二十岁以外的计算总数」；是照耶和华吩咐出埃及地的摩西和以色列人的话。
verses.textEnNiv: "Take a census of the men twenty years old or more, as the Lord commanded Moses." These were the Israelites who came out of Egypt:
verses.textEnEsv: "Take a census of the people, from twenty years old and upward," as the Lord commanded Moses. The people of Israel who came out of the land of Egypt were:
verses.textEnNkjv: "Takeacensusofthepeople from twenty years old and above, just as the Lord commanded Moses and the children of Israel who came out of the land of Egypt."
verses.textEnNlt: "List all the men of Israel twenty years old and older, just as the Lord commanded Moses." This is the record of all the descendants of Israel who came out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: "Take a census of the people from twenty years old and upward, as the Lord has commanded Moses." Now the sons of Israel who came out of the land of Egypt were as follows:
verses.textEn: "Take a census of the men twenty years old or more, as the Lord commanded Moses." These were the Israelites who came out of Egypt:

verses.textZh: 以色列的长子流本：流本的子孙，属哈诺的，有哈诺家族；属法路的，有法路家族；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的长子流本：流本的子孙，属哈诺的，有哈诺家族；属法路的，有法路家族；
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列的长子是吕便。吕便的众子：属哈诺的，有哈诺族；属法路的，有法路族；
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Reuben, the firstborn son of Israel, were: through Hanok, the Hanokite clan; through Pallu, the Palluite clan;
verses.textEnEsv: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the clan of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the clan of the Palluites;
verses.textEnNkjv: Reuben was the firstborn of Israel. The children of Reuben were: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;
verses.textEnNlt: These were the clans descended from the sons of Reuben, Jacob’s oldest son: The Hanochite clan, named after their ancestor Hanoch. The Palluite clan, named after their ancestor Pallu.
verses.textEnNasb: Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;
verses.textEn: The descendants of Reuben, the firstborn son of Israel, were: through Hanok, the Hanokite clan; through Pallu, the Palluite clan;

verses.textZh: 属希斯伦的，有希斯伦家族；属迦米的，有迦米家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属希斯伦的，有希斯伦家族；属迦米的，有迦米家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 属希斯伦的，有希斯伦族；属迦米的，有迦米族；
verses.textEnNiv: through Hezron, the Hezronite clan; through Karmi, the Karmite clan.
verses.textEnEsv: of Hezron, the clan of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the clan of the Carmites.
verses.textEnNkjv: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
verses.textEnNlt: The Hezronite clan, named after their ancestor Hezron. The Carmite clan, named after their ancestor Carmi.
verses.textEnNasb: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
verses.textEn: through Hezron, the Hezronite clan; through Karmi, the Karmite clan.

verses.textZh: 这些是流本的家族；他们被数点的，共有四万三千七百三十人。

verses.textZh: 法路的儿子是以利押；

verses.textEnNasb: The son of Pallu: Eliab.
verses.textEn: The son of Pallu was Eliab,

verses.textZh: 以利押的儿子是尼母利、大坍、亚比兰。这大坍和亚比兰原是从会众中选拔出来的，他们和可拉一党的人一起与耶和华争吵，也与摩西和亚伦争吵的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利押的儿子是尼母利、大坍、亚比兰。这大坍和亚比兰原是从会众中选拔出来的，他们和可拉一党的人一起与耶和华争吵，也与摩西和亚伦争吵的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 以利押的众子是尼母利、大坍、亚比兰。这大坍、亚比兰，就是从会中选召的，与可拉一党同向耶和华争闹的时候也向摩西、亚伦争闹；
verses.textEnNiv: and the sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan and Abiram. The same Dathan and Abiram were the community officials who rebelled against Moses and Aaron and were among Korah’s followers when they rebelled against the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are the Dathan and Abiram, chosen from the congregation, who contended against Moses and Aaron in the company of Korah, when they contended against the Lord
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are the Dathan and Abiram, representatives of the congregation, who contended against Moses and Aaron in the company of Korah, when they contended against the Lord;
verses.textEnNlt: and Eliab was the father of Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. This Dathan and Abiram are the same community leaders who conspired with Korah against Moses and Aaron, rebelling against the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are the Dathan and Abiram who were called by the congregation, who fought against Moses and against Aaron in the group of Korah, when they fought against the Lord,
verses.textEn: and the sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan and Abiram. The same Dathan and Abiram were the community officials who rebelled against Moses and Aaron and were among Korah’s followers when they rebelled against the Lord .

verses.textZh: 地开了口，把他们和可拉吞了下去；可拉与他的同党都死了，那时有火吞灭了二百五十个人，他们成了警戒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地开了口，把他们和可拉吞了下去；可拉与他的同党都死了，那时有火吞灭了二百五十个人，他们成了警戒。
verses.textZhCuv: 地便开口吞了他们，和可拉、可拉的党类一同死亡。那时火烧灭了二百五十个人；他们就作了警戒。
verses.textEnNiv: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them along with Korah, whose followers died when the fire devoured the 250 men. And they served as a warning sign.
verses.textEnEsv: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, when the fire devoured 250 men, and they became a warning.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died, when the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men; and they became a sign.
verses.textEnNlt: But the earth opened up its mouth and swallowed them with Korah, and fire devoured 250 of their followers. This served as a warning to the entire nation of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up along with Korah, when that group died, when the fire devoured 250 men, so that they became a warning sign.
verses.textEn: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them along with Korah, whose followers died when the fire devoured the 250 men. And they served as a warning sign.

verses.textZh: 但是，可拉的子孙却没有死亡。

verses.textEnEsv: But the sons of Korah did not die.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless the children of Korah did not die.
verses.textEnNlt: However, the sons of Korah did not die that day.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Korah, however, did not die.
verses.textEn: The line of Korah, however, did not die out.

verses.textZh: 这些就是西布伦的各家族，按着他们各家族被数点的，共有六万零五百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些就是西布伦的各家族，按着他们各家族被数点的，共有六万零五百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是西布伦的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有六万零五百名。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the clans of Zebulun; those numbered were 60,500.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the clans of the Zebulunites as they were listed, 60,500.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were numbered of them: sixty thousand five hundred.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the clans of Zebulun. Their registered troops numbered 60,500.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the families of the Zebulunites by those who were numbered of them, 60,500.
verses.textEn: These were the clans of Zebulun; those numbered were 60,500.

verses.textZh: 约瑟的儿子，按着家族，有玛拿西和以法莲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟的儿子，按着家族，有玛拿西和以法莲。
verses.textZhCuv: 按着家族，约瑟的儿子有玛拿西、以法莲。
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Joseph by their clans through Manasseh and Ephraim were:
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Joseph according to their clans: Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Joseph according to their families, by Manasseh and Ephraim, were:
verses.textEnNlt: Two clans were descended from Joseph through Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Joseph by their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.textEn: The descendants of Joseph by their clans through Manasseh and Ephraim were:

verses.textZh: 玛拿西的子孙，属玛吉的，有玛吉家族；玛吉生基列；属基列的，有基列家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西的子孙，属玛吉的，有玛吉家族；玛吉生基列；属基列的，有基列家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西的众子：属玛吉的，有玛吉族；玛吉生基列；属基列的，有基列族。
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Manasseh: through Makir, the Makirite clan (Makir was the father of Gilead); through Gilead, the Gileadite clan.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the clan of the Machirites; and Machir was the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the clan of the Gileadites.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir begot Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the clans descended from Manasseh: The Makirite clan, named after their ancestor Makir. The Gileadite clan, named after their ancestor Gilead, Makir’s son.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir fathered Gilead: of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.
verses.textEn: The descendants of Manasseh: through Makir, the Makirite clan (Makir was the father of Gilead); through Gilead, the Gileadite clan.

verses.textZh: 以下就是基列的子孙：属伊以谢的，有伊以谢家族；属希勒的，有希勒家族；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下就是基列的子孙：属伊以谢的，有伊以谢家族；属希勒的，有希勒家族；
verses.textZhCuv: 基列的众子：属伊以谢的，有伊以谢族；属希勒的，有希勒族；
verses.textEnNiv: These were the descendants of Gilead: through Iezer, the Iezerite clan; through Helek, the Helekite clan;
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the clan of the Iezerites; of Helek, the clan of the Helekites;
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;
verses.textEnNlt: These were the subclans descended from the Gileadites: The Iezerites, named after their ancestor Iezer. The Helekites, named after their ancestor Helek.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;
verses.textEn: These were the descendants of Gilead: through Iezer, the Iezerite clan; through Helek, the Helekite clan;

verses.textZh: 属亚斯列的，有亚斯列家族；属示剑的，有示剑家族；
verses.textZhCnvs: 属亚斯列的，有亚斯列家族；属示剑的，有示剑家族；
verses.textZhCuv: 属亚斯烈的，有亚斯烈族；属示剑的，有示剑族；
verses.textEnNiv: through Asriel, the Asrielite clan; through Shechem, the Shechemite clan;
verses.textEnEsv: and of Asriel, the clan of the Asrielites; and of Shechem, the clan of the Shechemites;
verses.textEnNkjv: of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;
verses.textEnNlt: The Asrielites, named after their ancestor Asriel. The Shechemites, named after their ancestor Shechem.
verses.textEnNasb: and of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;
verses.textEn: through Asriel, the Asrielite clan; through Shechem, the Shechemite clan;

verses.textZh: 属示米大的，有示米大家族；属希弗的，有希弗家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属示米大的，有示米大家族；属希弗的，有希弗家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 属示米大的，有示米大族；属希弗的，有希弗族。
verses.textEnNiv: through Shemida, the Shemidaite clan; through Hepher, the Hepherite clan.
verses.textEnEsv: and of Shemida, the clan of the Shemidaites; and of Hepher, the clan of the Hepherites.
verses.textEnNkjv: of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
verses.textEnNlt: The Shemidaites, named after their ancestor Shemida. The Hepherites, named after their ancestor Hepher.
verses.textEnNasb: and of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
verses.textEn: through Shemida, the Shemidaite clan; through Hepher, the Hepherite clan.

verses.textZh: 希弗的儿子西罗非哈没有儿子，只有女儿；西罗非哈的女儿名叫玛拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希弗的儿子西罗非哈没有儿子，只有女儿；西罗非哈的女儿名叫玛拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒。
verses.textZhCuv: 希弗的儿子：西罗非哈没儿子，只有女儿。西罗非哈女儿的名字就是玛拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒。
verses.textEnNiv: (Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons; he had only daughters, whose names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah and Tirzah.)
verses.textEnEsv: Now Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters. And the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters; and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.textEnNlt: (One of Hepher’s descendants, Zelophehad, had no sons, but his daughters’ names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.)
verses.textEnNasb: Now Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, only daughters; and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.textEn: (Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons; he had only daughters, whose names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah and Tirzah.)

verses.textZh: 这些就是玛拿西的各家族，他们被数点的，共有五万二千七百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些就是玛拿西的各家族，他们被数点的，共有五万二千七百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是玛拿西的各族；他们中间被数的，共有五万二千七百名。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the clans of Manasseh; those numbered were 52,700.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the clans of Manasseh, and those listed were 52,700.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the families of Manasseh; and those who were numbered of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the clans of Manasseh. Their registered troops numbered 52,700.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the families of Manasseh; and those who were numbered of them were 52,700.
verses.textEn: These were the clans of Manasseh; those numbered were 52,700.

verses.textZh: 以下就是以法莲的子孙：按着家族，属书提拉的，有书提拉家族；属比结的，有比结家族；属他罕的，有他罕家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下就是以法莲的子孙：按着家族，属书提拉的，有书提拉家族；属比结的，有比结家族；属他罕的，有他罕家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 按着家族，以法莲的众子：属书提拉的，有书提拉族；属比结的，有比结族；属他罕的，有他罕族。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the descendants of Ephraim by their clans: through Shuthelah, the Shuthelahite clan; through Beker, the Bekerite clan; through Tahan, the Tahanite clan.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Ephraim according to their clans: of Shuthelah, the clan of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the clan of the Becherites; of Tahan, the clan of the Tahanites.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the sons of Ephraim according to their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites; of Becher, the family of the Bachrites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the clans descended from the sons of Ephraim: The Shuthelahite clan, named after their ancestor Shuthelah. The Bekerite clan, named after their ancestor Beker. The Tahanite clan, named after their ancestor Tahan.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the sons of Ephraim by their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
verses.textEn: These were the descendants of Ephraim by their clans: through Shuthelah, the Shuthelahite clan; through Beker, the Bekerite clan; through Tahan, the Tahanite clan.

verses.textZh: 书提拉的子孙，属以兰的，有以兰家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 书提拉的子孙，属以兰的，有以兰家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 书提拉的众子：属以兰的，有以兰族。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the descendants of Shuthelah: through Eran, the Eranite clan.
verses.textEnEsv: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the clan of the Eranites.
verses.textEnNkjv: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
verses.textEnNlt: This was the subclan descended from the Shuthelahites: The Eranites, named after their ancestor Eran.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
verses.textEn: These were the descendants of Shuthelah: through Eran, the Eranite clan.

verses.textZh: 这些就是以法莲子孙的各家族，按着他们各家族被数点的，共有三万二千五百人。按着他们的家族，这些都是约瑟的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些就是以法莲子孙的各家族，按着他们各家族被数点的，共有三万二千五百人。按着他们的家族，这些都是约瑟的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是以法莲子孙的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有三万二千五百名。按着家族，这都是约瑟的子孙。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the clans of Ephraim; those numbered were 32,500. These were the descendants of Joseph by their clans.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the clans of the sons of Ephraim as they were listed, 32,500. These are the sons of Joseph according to their clans.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were numbered of them: thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph according to their families.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the clans of Ephraim. Their registered troops numbered 32,500. These clans of Manasseh and Ephraim were all descendants of Joseph.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim by those who were numbered of them, 32,500. These are the sons of Joseph by their families.
verses.textEn: These were the clans of Ephraim; those numbered were 32,500. These were the descendants of Joseph by their clans.

verses.textZh: 便雅悯的子孙，按着家族，属比拉的，有比拉家族；属亚实别的，有亚实别家族；属亚希兰的，有亚希兰家族；
verses.textZhCnvs: 便雅悯的子孙，按着家族，属比拉的，有比拉家族；属亚实别的，有亚实别家族；属亚希兰的，有亚希兰家族；
verses.textZhCuv: 按着家族，便雅悯的众子：属比拉的，有比拉族；属亚实别的，有亚实别族；属亚希兰的，有亚希兰族；
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Benjamin by their clans were: through Bela, the Belaite clan; through Ashbel, the Ashbelite clan; through Ahiram, the Ahiramite clan;
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Benjamin according to their clans: of Bela, the clan of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the clan of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the clan of the Ahiramites;
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Benjamin according to their families were: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;
verses.textEnNlt: These were the clans descended from the sons of Benjamin: The Belaite clan, named after their ancestor Bela. The Ashbelite clan, named after their ancestor Ashbel. The Ahiramite clan, named after their ancestor Ahiram.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Benjamin by their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;
verses.textEn: The descendants of Benjamin by their clans were: through Bela, the Belaite clan; through Ashbel, the Ashbelite clan; through Ahiram, the Ahiramite clan;

verses.textZh: 属书反的，有书反家族；属户反的，有户反家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属书反的，有书反家族；属户反的，有户反家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 属书反的，有书反族；属户反的，有户反族。
verses.textEnNiv: through Shupham, the Shuphamite clan; through Hupham, the Huphamite clan.
verses.textEnEsv: of Shephupham, the clan of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the clan of the Huphamites.
verses.textEnNkjv: of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
verses.textEnNlt: The Shuphamite clan, named after their ancestor Shupham. The Huphamite clan, named after their ancestor Hupham.
verses.textEnNasb: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
verses.textEn: through Shupham, the Shuphamite clan; through Hupham, the Huphamite clan.

verses.textZh: 比拉的众子是亚勒、乃幔；属亚勒的，有亚勒家族；属乃幔的，有乃幔家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 比拉的众子是亚勒、乃幔；属亚勒的，有亚勒家族；属乃幔的，有乃幔家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 比拉的众子是亚勒、乃幔。属亚勒的，有亚勒族；属乃幔的，有乃幔族。
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Bela through Ard and Naaman were: through Ard, the Ardite clan; through Naaman, the Naamite clan.
verses.textEnEsv: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the clan of the Ardites; of Naaman, the clan of the Naamites.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: ofArd, the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the subclans descended from the Belaites: The Ardites, named after their ancestor Ard. The Naamites, named after their ancestor Naaman.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
verses.textEn: The descendants of Bela through Ard and Naaman were: through Ard, the Ardite clan; through Naaman, the Naamite clan.

verses.textZh: 这些就是便雅悯的子孙，按着他们的家族，他们被数点的，共有四万五千六百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些就是便雅悯的子孙，按着他们的家族，他们被数点的，共有四万五千六百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 按着家族，这就是便雅悯的子孙，其中被数的，共有四万五千六百名。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the clans of Benjamin; those numbered were 45,600.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Benjamin according to their clans, and those listed were 45,600.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the sons of Benjamin according to their families; and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the clans of Benjamin. Their registered troops numbered 45,600.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the sons of Benjamin by their families; and those who were numbered of them were 45,600.
verses.textEn: These were the clans of Benjamin; those numbered were 45,600.

verses.textZh: 以下是但的子孙：按着家族，属书含的，有书含家族；按着家族，这些就是但的各家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是但的子孙：按着家族，属书含的，有书含家族；按着家族，这些就是但的各家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 按着家族，但的众子：属书含的，有书含族。按着家族，这就是但的各族。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the descendants of Dan by their clans: through Shuham, the Shuhamite clan. These were the clans of Dan:
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Dan according to their clans: of Shuham, the clan of the Shuhamites. These are the clans of Dan according to their clans.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the sons of Dan according to their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan according to their families.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the clans descended from the sons of Dan: The Shuhamite clan, named after their ancestor Shuham.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the sons of Dan by their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan by their families.
verses.textEn: These were the descendants of Dan by their clans: through Shuham, the Shuhamite clan. These were the clans of Dan:

verses.textZh: 书含所有的家族，被数点的，共有六万四千四百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 书含所有的家族，被数点的，共有六万四千四百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 照其中被数的，书含所有的各族，共有六万四千四百名。
verses.textEnNiv: All of them were Shuhamite clans; and those numbered were 64,400.
verses.textEnEsv: All the clans of the Shuhamites, as they were listed, were 64,400.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were numbered of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the Shuhamite clans of Dan. Their registered troops numbered 64,400.
verses.textEnNasb: All the families of the Shuhamites, by those who were numbered of them, were 64,400.
verses.textEn: All of them were Shuhamite clans; and those numbered were 64,400.

verses.textZh: 亚设的子孙，按着他们的家族，属音拿的，有音拿家族；属亦施苇的，有亦施苇家族；属比利亚的，有比利亚家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚设的子孙，按着他们的家族，属音拿的，有音拿家族；属亦施苇的，有亦施苇家族；属比利亚的，有比利亚家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 按着家族，亚设的众子：属音拿的，有音拿族；属亦施韦的，有亦施韦族；属比利亚的，有比利亚族。
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Asher by their clans were: through Imnah, the Imnite clan; through Ishvi, the Ishvite clan; through Beriah, the Beriite clan;
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Asher according to their clans: of Imnah, the clan of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the clan of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the clan of the Beriites.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Asher according to their families were: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites; of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites; of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the clans descended from the sons of Asher: The Imnite clan, named after their ancestor Imnah. The Ishvite clan, named after their ancestor Ishvi. The Beriite clan, named after their ancestor Beriah.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Asher by their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
verses.textEn: The descendants of Asher by their clans were: through Imnah, the Imnite clan; through Ishvi, the Ishvite clan; through Beriah, the Beriite clan;

verses.textZh: 比利亚的子孙，属希别的，有希别家族；属玛结的，有玛结家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 比利亚的子孙，属希别的，有希别家族；属玛结的，有玛结家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 比利亚的众子：属希别的，有希别族；属玛结的，有玛结族。
verses.textEnNiv: and through the descendants of Beriah: through Heber, the Heberite clan; through Malkiel, the Malkielite clan.
verses.textEnEsv: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the clan of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the clan of the Malchielites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the subclans descended from the Beriites: The Heberites, named after their ancestor Heber. The Malkielites, named after their ancestor Malkiel.
verses.textEnNasb: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
verses.textEn: and through the descendants of Beriah: through Heber, the Heberite clan; through Malkiel, the Malkielite clan.

verses.textZh: 亚设的女儿名叫西拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚设的女儿名叫西拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚设的女儿名叫西拉。
verses.textEnNiv: (Asher had a daughter named Serah.)
verses.textEnEsv: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
verses.textEnNlt: Asher also had a daughter named Serah.
verses.textEnNasb: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
verses.textEn: (Asher had a daughter named Serah.)

verses.textZh: 这些就是亚设子孙的各家族，按着他们各家族被数点的，共有五万三千四百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些就是亚设子孙的各家族，按着他们各家族被数点的，共有五万三千四百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是亚设子孙的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有五万三千四百名。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the clans of Asher; those numbered were 53,400.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the clans of the sons of Asher as they were listed, 53,400.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were numbered of them: fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the clans of Asher. Their registered troops numbered 53,400.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the families of the sons of Asher by those who were numbered of them, 53,400.
verses.textEn: These were the clans of Asher; those numbered were 53,400.

verses.textZh: 拿弗他利的子孙，按着家族，属雅薛的，有雅薛家族；属沽尼的，有沽尼家族；
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿弗他利的子孙，按着家族，属雅薛的，有雅薛家族；属沽尼的，有沽尼家族；
verses.textZhCuv: 按着家族，拿弗他利的众子：属雅薛的，有雅薛族；属沽尼的，有沽尼族；
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Naphtali by their clans were: through Jahzeel, the Jahzeelite clan; through Guni, the Gunite clan;
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Naphtali according to their clans: of Jahzeel, the clan of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the clan of the Gunites;
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Naphtali according to their families were: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;
verses.textEnNlt: These were the clans descended from the sons of Naphtali: The Jahzeelite clan, named after their ancestor Jahzeel. The Gunite clan, named after their ancestor Guni.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Naphtali by their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;
verses.textEn: The descendants of Naphtali by their clans were: through Jahzeel, the Jahzeelite clan; through Guni, the Gunite clan;

verses.textZh: 属耶色的，有耶色家族；属示冷的，有示冷家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属耶色的，有耶色家族；属示冷的，有示冷家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 属耶色的，有耶色族；属示冷的，有示冷族。
verses.textEnNiv: through Jezer, the Jezerite clan; through Shillem, the Shillemite clan.
verses.textEnEsv: of Jezer, the clan of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the clan of the Shillemites.
verses.textEnNkjv: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
verses.textEnNlt: The Jezerite clan, named after their ancestor Jezer. The Shillemite clan, named after their ancestor Shillem.
verses.textEnNasb: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
verses.textEn: through Jezer, the Jezerite clan; through Shillem, the Shillemite clan.

verses.textZh: 这些就是拿弗他利的各家族，按着他们各家族被数点的，共有四万五千四百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些就是拿弗他利的各家族，按着他们各家族被数点的，共有四万五千四百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 按着家族，这就是拿弗他利的各族；他们中间被数的，共有四万五千四百名。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the clans of Naphtali; those numbered were 45,400.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the clans of Naphtali according to their clans, and those listed were 45,400.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the clans of Naphtali. Their registered troops numbered 45,400.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the families of Naphtali by their families; and those who were numbered of them were 45,400.
verses.textEn: These were the clans of Naphtali; those numbered were 45,400.

verses.textZh: 以上就是以色列人被数点的，共有六十万零一千七百三十人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上就是以色列人被数点的，共有六十万零一千七百三十人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人中被数的，共有六十万零一千七百三十名。
verses.textEnNiv: The total number of the men of Israel was 601,730.
verses.textEnEsv: This was the list of the people of Israel, 601,730.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are those who were numbered of the children of Israel: six hundred and one thousand seven hundred and thirty.
verses.textEnNlt: In summary, the registered troops of all Israel numbered 601,730.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the ones who were numbered of the sons of Israel, 601,730.
verses.textEn: The total number of the men of Israel was 601,730.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要按着人名数目把地分配给他们作产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要按着人名数目把地分配给他们作产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要按着人名的数目将地分给这些人为业。
verses.textEnNiv: "The land is to be allotted to them as an inheritance based on the number of names.
verses.textEnEsv: "Among these the land shall be divided for inheritance according to the number of names.
verses.textEnNkjv: "To these the land shall be divided as an inheritance, according to the number of names.
verses.textEnNlt: "Divide the land among the tribes, and distribute the grants of land in proportion to the tribes’ populations, as indicated by the number of names on the list.
verses.textEnNasb: " Among these the land shall be divided as an inheritance according to the number of names.
verses.textEn: "The land is to be allotted to them as an inheritance based on the number of names.

verses.textZh: 人数多的，你要把产业多分给他们；人数少的，你要把产业少分给他们；要按着数点的人数，把产业分给各家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人数多的，你要把产业多分给他们；人数少的，你要把产业少分给他们；要按着数点的人数，把产业分给各家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 人多的，你要把产业多分给他们；人少的，你要把产业少分给他们；要照被数的人数，把产业分给各人。
verses.textEnNiv: To a larger group give a larger inheritance, and to a smaller group a smaller one; each is to receive its inheritance according to the number of those listed.
verses.textEnEsv: To a large tribe you shall give a large inheritance, and to a small tribe you shall give a small inheritance; every tribe shall be given its inheritance in proportion to its list.
verses.textEnNkjv: To a large tribe you shall give a larger inheritance, and to a small tribe you shall give a smaller inheritance. Each shall be given its inheritance according to those who were numbered of them.
verses.textEnNlt: Give the larger tribes more land and the smaller tribes less land, each group receiving a grant in proportion to the size of its population.
verses.textEnNasb: To a larger group you shall increase their inheritance, and to a smaller group you shall decrease their inheritance; each shall be given their inheritance corresponding to the total of those who were numbered of them.
verses.textEn: To a larger group give a larger inheritance, and to a smaller group a smaller one; each is to receive its inheritance according to the number of those listed.

verses.textZh: 虽然这样，地还是要借着抽签分配；他们要按着自己父家支派的名字，承受产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然这样，地还是要借着抽签分配；他们要按着自己父家支派的名字，承受产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 虽是这样，还要拈阄分地。他们要按着祖宗各支派的名字承受为业。
verses.textEnNiv: Be sure that the land is distributed by lot. What each group inherits will be according to the names for its ancestral tribe.
verses.textEnEsv: But the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the land shall be divided by lot; they shall inherit according to the names of the tribes of their fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: But you must assign the land by lot, and give land to each ancestral tribe according to the number of names on the list.
verses.textEnNasb: But the land shall be divided by lot. They shall receive their inheritance according to the names of the tribes of their fathers.
verses.textEn: Be sure that the land is distributed by lot. What each group inherits will be according to the names for its ancestral tribe.

verses.textZh: 你要按着所抽的签，照着人数的多少，把产业分配给他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要按着所抽的签，照着人数的多少，把产业分配给他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 要按着所拈的阄，看人数多，人数少，把产业分给他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: Each inheritance is to be distributed by lot among the larger and smaller groups."
verses.textEnEsv: Their inheritance shall be divided according to lot between the larger and the smaller."
verses.textEnNkjv: According to the lot their inheritance shall be divided between the larger and the smaller."
verses.textEnNlt: Each grant of land must be assigned by lot among the larger and smaller tribal groups."
verses.textEnNasb: Corresponding to the selection by lot, their inheritance shall be divided between the larger and the smaller groups."
verses.textEn: Each inheritance is to be distributed by lot among the larger and smaller groups."

verses.textZh: 以下是按着家族被数点的利未人：属革顺的，有革顺家族；属哥辖的，有哥辖家族；属米拉利的，有米拉利家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是按着家族被数点的利未人：属革顺的，有革顺家族；属哥辖的，有哥辖家族；属米拉利的，有米拉利家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人，按着他们的各族被数的：属革顺的，有革顺族；属哥辖的，有哥辖族；属米拉利的，有米拉利族。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the Levites who were counted by their clans: through Gershon, the Gershonite clan; through Kohath, the Kohathite clan; through Merari, the Merarite clan.
verses.textEnEsv: This was the list of the Levites according to their clans: of Gershon, the clan of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the clan of the Kohathites; of Merari, the clan of the Merarites.
verses.textEnNkjv: And these are those who were numbered of the Levites according to their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the record of the Levites who were counted according to their clans: The Gershonite clan, named after their ancestor Gershon. The Kohathite clan, named after their ancestor Kohath. The Merarite clan, named after their ancestor Merari.
verses.textEnNasb: These are those who were numbered of the Levites according to their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
verses.textEn: These were the Levites who were counted by their clans: through Gershon, the Gershonite clan; through Kohath, the Kohathite clan; through Merari, the Merarite clan.

verses.textZh: 这些就是利未的各家族：有立尼家族、希伯伦家族、玛利家族、母示家族、可拉家族。哥辖生暗兰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些就是利未的各家族：有立尼家族、希伯伦家族、玛利家族、母示家族、可拉家族。哥辖生暗兰。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未的各族有立尼族、希伯伦族、玛利族、母示族、可拉族。哥辖生暗兰。
verses.textEnNiv: These also were Levite clans: the Libnite clan, the Hebronite clan, the Mahlite clan, the Mushite clan, the Korahite clan. (Kohath was the forefather of Amram;
verses.textEnEsv: These are the clans of Levi: the clan of the Libnites, the clan of the Hebronites, the clan of the Mahlites, the clan of the Mushites, the clan of the Korahites. And Kohath was the father of Amram.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begot Amram.
verses.textEnNlt: The Libnites, the Hebronites, the Mahlites, the Mushites, and the Korahites were all subclans of the Levites. Now Kohath was the ancestor of Amram,
verses.textEnNasb: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath fathered Amram.
verses.textEn: These also were Levite clans: the Libnite clan, the Hebronite clan, the Mahlite clan, the Mushite clan, the Korahite clan. (Kohath was the forefather of Amram;

verses.textZh: 暗兰的妻子，名叫约基别，是利未的女儿，是利未在埃及所生的；她给暗兰生了亚伦、摩西和他们的姊姊米利暗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 暗兰的妻子，名叫约基别，是利未的女儿，是利未在埃及所生的；她给暗兰生了亚伦、摩西和他们的姊姊米利暗。
verses.textZhCuv: 暗兰的妻名叫约基别，是利未女子，生在埃及。她给暗兰生了亚伦、摩西，并他们的姊姊米利暗。
verses.textEnNiv: the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, a descendant of Levi, who was born to the Levites in Egypt. To Amram she bore Aaron, Moses and their sister Miriam.
verses.textEnEsv: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. And she bore to Amram Aaron and Moses and Miriam their sister.
verses.textEnNkjv: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt; and to Amram she bore Aaron and Moses and their sister Miriam.
verses.textEnNlt: and Amram’s wife was named Jochebed. She also was a descendant of Levi, born among the Levites in the land of Egypt. Amram and Jochebed became the parents of Aaron, Moses, and their sister, Miriam.
verses.textEnNasb: And the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt; and she bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and their sister Miriam.
verses.textEn: the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, a descendant of Levi, who was born to the Levites in Egypt. To Amram she bore Aaron, Moses and their sister Miriam.

verses.textZh: 亚伦生拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦生拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦生拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。
verses.textEnNiv: Aaron was the father of Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.textEnEsv: And to Aaron were born Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.textEnNkjv: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.textEnNlt: To Aaron were born Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.textEnNasb: And to Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.textEn: Aaron was the father of Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

verses.textZh: 拿答和亚比户在耶和华面前献凡火的时候，死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿答和亚比户在耶和华面前献凡火的时候，死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿答、亚比户在耶和华面前献凡火的时候就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: But Nadab and Abihu died when they made an offering before the Lord with unauthorized fire.)
verses.textEnEsv: But Nadab and Abihu died when they offered unauthorized fire before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And Nadab and Abihu died when they offered profane fire before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But Nadab and Abihu died when they burned before the Lord the wrong kind of fire, different than he had commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: But Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the Lord.
verses.textEn: But Nadab and Abihu died when they made an offering before the Lord with unauthorized fire.)

verses.textZh: 利未人中，从一个月以上被数点的所有男丁，共有二万三千人。在以色列人中没有数点他们，因为在以色列人中，没有把产业分给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人中，从一个月以上被数点的所有男丁，共有二万三千人。在以色列人中没有数点他们，因为在以色列人中，没有把产业分给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人中，凡一个月以外、被数的男丁，共有二万三千。他们本来没有数在以色列人中；因为在以色列人中，没有分给他们产业。
verses.textEnNiv: All the male Levites a month old or more numbered 23,000. They were not counted along with the other Israelites because they received no inheritance among them.
verses.textEnEsv: And those listed were 23,000, every male from a month old and upward. For they were not listed among the people of Israel, because there was no inheritance given to them among the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now those who were numbered of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and above; for they were not numbered among the other children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given to them among the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The men from the Levite clans who were one month old or older numbered 23,000. But the Levites were not included in the registration of the rest of the people of Israel because they were not given an allotment of land when it was divided among the Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who were numbered of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward, for they were not numbered among the sons of Israel since no inheritance was given to them among the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: All the male Levites a month old or more numbered 23,000. They were not counted along with the other Israelites because they received no inheritance among them.

verses.textZh: 以上的人就是被摩西和以利亚撒祭司数点的；他们是在摩押平原，耶利哥对面约旦河边数点以色列人的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上的人就是被摩西和以利亚撒祭司数点的；他们是在摩押平原，耶利哥对面约旦河边数点以色列人的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些就是被摩西和祭司以利亚撒所数的；他们在摩押平原与耶利哥相对的约旦河边数点以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the ones counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest when they counted the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
verses.textEnEsv: These were those listed by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who listed the people of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are those who were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan, acrossfrom Jericho.
verses.textEnNlt: So these are the results of the registration of the people of Israel as conducted by Moses and Eleazar the priest on the plains of Moab beside the Jordan River, across from Jericho.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the ones who were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the sons of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.textEn: These are the ones counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest when they counted the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.

verses.textZh: 这些人中间，没有一个是摩西和亚伦祭司从前在西奈旷野数点以色列人的时候，数点过的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人中间，没有一个是摩西和亚伦祭司从前在西奈旷野数点以色列人的时候，数点过的。
verses.textZhCuv: 但被数的人中，没有一个是摩西和祭司亚伦从前在西奈的旷野所数的以色列人，
verses.textEnNiv: Not one of them was among those counted by Moses and Aaron the priest when they counted the Israelites in the Desert of Sinai.
verses.textEnEsv: But among these there was not one of those listed by Moses and Aaron the priest, who had listed the people of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.textEnNkjv: But among these there was not a man of those who were numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest when they numbered the children of Israel in the Wilderness of Sinai.
verses.textEnNlt: Not one person on this list had been among those listed in the previous registration taken by Moses and Aaron in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.textEnNasb: But among these there was not a man of those who were numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest, who numbered the sons of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.textEn: Not one of them was among those counted by Moses and Aaron the priest when they counted the Israelites in the Desert of Sinai.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华论到他们曾经说过："他们必死在旷野。"所以除了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒和嫩的儿子约书亚以外，连一个也没有剩下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华论到他们曾经说过："他们必死在旷野。"所以除了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒和嫩的儿子约书亚以外，连一个也没有剩下。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华论到他们说：「他们必要死在旷野。」所以，除了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒和嫩的儿子约书亚以外，连一个人也没有存留。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord had told those Israelites they would surely die in the wilderness, and not one of them was left except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord had said of them, "They shall die in the wilderness." Not one of them was left, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord had said of them, "They shall surely die in the wilderness." So there was not left a man of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord had said of them, "They will all die in the wilderness." Not one of them survived except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord had said of them, "They shall certainly die in the wilderness." And not a man was left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.textEn: For the Lord had told those Israelites they would surely die in the wilderness, and not one of them was left except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

verses.textEnNkjv: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, from the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and these were the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.textEnNlt: One day a petition was presented by the daughters of Zelophehad—Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah. Their father, Zelophehad, was a descendant of Hepher son of Gilead, son of Makir, son of Manasseh, son of Joseph.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph, came forward; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.textEn: The daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, belonged to the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph. The names of the daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah and Tirzah. They came forward

verses.textZh: "我们的父亲死在旷野，他并不是在那聚集攻击耶和华的人之中，不属可拉一党的人；他死在自己的罪中，只是他没有儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我们的父亲死在旷野，他并不是在那聚集攻击耶和华的人之中，不属可拉一党的人；他死在自己的罪中，只是他没有儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我们的父亲死在旷野。他不与可拉同党聚集攻击耶和华，是在自己罪中死的；他也没有儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: "Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among Korah’s followers, who banded together against the Lord , but he died for his own sin and left no sons.
verses.textEnEsv: "Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against the Lord in the company of Korah, but died for his own sin. And he had no sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Our father died in the wilderness; but he was not in the company of those who gathered together against the Lord, in company with Korah, but he died in his own sin; and he had no sons.
verses.textEnNlt: "Our father died in the wilderness," they said. "He was not among Korah’s followers, who rebelled against the Lord ; he died because of his own sin. But he had no sons.
verses.textEnNasb: "Our father died in the wilderness, yet he was not among the group of those who gathered together against the Lord, in the group of Korah; but he died in his own sin, and he had no sons.
verses.textEn: "Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among Korah’s followers, who banded together against the Lord , but he died for his own sin and left no sons.

verses.textZh: 为甚么因为我们的父亲没有儿子，就把他的名从他的家族中除掉呢？求你在我们父亲的兄弟中，给我们产业。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 为甚么因为我们的父亲没有儿子，就把他的名从他的家族中除掉呢？求你在我们父亲的兄弟中，给我们产业。"
verses.textZhCuv: 为什么因我们的父亲没有儿子就把他的名从他族中除掉呢？求你们在我们父亲的弟兄中分给我们产业。」
verses.textEnNiv: Why should our father’s name disappear from his clan because he had no son? Give us property among our father’s relatives."
verses.textEnEsv: Why should the name of our father be taken away from his clan because he had no son? Give to us a possession among our father’s brothers."
verses.textEnNkjv: Why should the name of our father be removed from among his family because he had no son? Give us a possession among our father’s brothers."
verses.textEnNlt: Why should the name of our father disappear from his clan just because he had no sons? Give us property along with the rest of our relatives."
verses.textEnNasb: Why should the name of our father be withdrawn from among his family simply because he had no son? Give us property among our father’s brothers."
verses.textEn: Why should our father’s name disappear from his clan because he had no son? Give us property among our father’s relatives."

verses.textZh: "西罗非哈的女儿说得有理，你一定要在她们父亲的兄弟中，给她们产业，要把她们父亲的产业给她们。
verses.textZhCnvs: "西罗非哈的女儿说得有理，你一定要在她们父亲的兄弟中，给她们产业，要把她们父亲的产业给她们。
verses.textZhCuv: 「西罗非哈的女儿说得有理。你定要在她们父亲的弟兄中，把地分给她们为业；要将她们父亲的产业归给她们。
verses.textEnNiv: "What Zelophehad’s daughters are saying is right. You must certainly give them property as an inheritance among their father’s relatives and give their father’s inheritance to them.
verses.textEnEsv: "The daughters of Zelophehad are right. You shall give them possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers and transfer the inheritance of their father to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The daughters of Zelophehad speak whatis right; you shall surely give them a possession of inheritance among their father’s brothers, and cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.
verses.textEnNlt: "The claim of the daughters of Zelophehad is legitimate. You must give them a grant of land along with their father’s relatives. Assign them the property that would have been given to their father.
verses.textEnNasb: "The daughters of Zelophehad are right about their statements. You shall certainly give them hereditary property among their father’s brothers, and you shall transfer the inheritance of their father to them.
verses.textEn: "What Zelophehad’s daughters are saying is right. You must certainly give them property as an inheritance among their father’s relatives and give their father’s inheritance to them.

verses.textZh: 你也要告诉以色列人说：‘一个人死时，如果没有儿子，就要使他的产业归给他的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你也要告诉以色列人说：‘一个人死时，如果没有儿子，就要使他的产业归给他的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 你也要晓谕以色列人说：『人若死了没有儿子，就要把他的产业归给他的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to the Israelites, ‘If a man dies and leaves no son, give his inheritance to his daughter.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall speak to the people of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies and has no son, then you shall transfer his inheritance to his daughter.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying: ‘If a man dies and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.
verses.textEnNlt: "And give the following instructions to the people of Israel: If a man dies and has no son, then give his inheritance to his daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: Further, you shall speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies and has no son, then you shall transfer his inheritance to his daughter.
verses.textEn: "Say to the Israelites, ‘If a man dies and leaves no son, give his inheritance to his daughter.

verses.textZh: 如果他没有女儿，就要把他的产业给他的兄弟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他没有女儿，就要把他的产业给他的兄弟。
verses.textZhCuv: 他若没有女儿，就要把他的产业给他的弟兄。
verses.textEnNiv: If he has no daughter, give his inheritance to his brothers.
verses.textEnEsv: And if he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
verses.textEnNlt: And if he has no daughter either, transfer his inheritance to his brothers.
verses.textEnNasb: And if he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
verses.textEn: If he has no daughter, give his inheritance to his brothers.

verses.textZh: 如果他没有兄弟，就要把他的产业给他父系的兄弟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他没有兄弟，就要把他的产业给他父系的兄弟。
verses.textZhCuv: 他若没有弟兄，就要把他的产业给他父亲的弟兄。
verses.textEnNiv: If he has no brothers, give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
verses.textEnEsv: And if he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
verses.textEnNlt: If he has no brothers, give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
verses.textEnNasb: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
verses.textEn: If he has no brothers, give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

verses.textZh: 如果他父亲没有兄弟，你们就要把他的产业给他家族中最近的亲属，那人就要得他的产业。这要作以色列人的律例、典章，是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他父亲没有兄弟，你们就要把他的产业给他家族中最近的亲属，那人就要得他的产业。这要作以色列人的律例、典章，是照着耶和华吩咐摩西的。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他父亲若没有弟兄，就要把他的产业给他族中最近的亲属，他便要得为业。』这要作以色列人的律例典章，是照耶和华吩咐摩西的。」
verses.textEnNiv: If his father had no brothers, give his inheritance to the nearest relative in his clan, that he may possess it. This is to have the force of law for the Israelites, as the Lord commanded Moses.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And if his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to the nearest kinsman of his clan, and he shall possess it. And it shall be for the people of Israel a statute and rule, as the Lord commanded Moses.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And if his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to the relative closest to him in his family, and he shall possess it.’ " And it shall be to the children of Israel a statute of judgment, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: But if his father has no brothers, give his inheritance to the nearest relative in his clan. This is a legal requirement for the people of Israel, just as the Lord commanded Moses."
verses.textEnNasb: And if his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his nearest relative in his own family, and he shall take possession of it; and it shall be a statutory ordinance to the sons of Israel, just as the Lord has commanded Moses.’ "
verses.textEn: If his father had no brothers, give his inheritance to the nearest relative in his clan, that he may possess it. This is to have the force of law for the Israelites, as the Lord commanded Moses.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说："你要上这亚巴琳山去，看看我赐给以色列人的地。

verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go up this mountain in the Abarim Range and see the land I have given the Israelites.

verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go up this mountain in the Abarim Range and see the land I have given the Israelites.

verses.textZhCuv: 因为你们在寻的旷野，当会众争闹的时候，违背了我的命，没有在涌水之地、会众眼前尊我为圣。」（这水就是寻的旷野加低斯米利巴水。）
verses.textEnNiv: for when the community rebelled at the waters in the Desert of Zin, both of you disobeyed my command to honor me as holy before their eyes." (These were the waters of Meribah Kadesh, in the Desert of Zin.)
