verses.textEnNlt: Present him to Eleazar the priest before the whole community, and publicly commission him to lead the people.
verses.textEnNasb: and have him stand before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation, and commission him in their sight.
verses.textEn: Have him stand before Eleazar the priest and the entire assembly and commission him in their presence.

verses.textZh: 你要把你的尊荣给他几分，好叫以色列全体会众都听从他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把你的尊荣给他几分，好叫以色列全体会众都听从他。
verses.textZhCuv: 又将你的尊荣给他几分，使以色列全会众都听从他。
verses.textEnNiv: Give him some of your authority so the whole Israelite community will obey him.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall invest him with some of your authority, that all the congregation of the people of Israel may obey.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall give some of your authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.
verses.textEnNlt: Transfer some of your authority to him so the whole community of Israel will obey him.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall put some of your authority on him, so that all the congregation of the sons of Israel will obey him.
verses.textEn: Give him some of your authority so the whole Israelite community will obey him.

verses.textZh: 他要站在以利亚撒祭司面前，以利亚撒要借着乌陵的判断，在耶和华面前为他求问；他和以色列众人，就是全体会众，都要按着以利亚撒的命令出入。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要站在以利亚撒祭司面前，以利亚撒要借着乌陵的判断，在耶和华面前为他求问；他和以色列众人，就是全体会众，都要按着以利亚撒的命令出入。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他要站在祭司以利亚撒面前；以利亚撒要凭乌陵的判断，在耶和华面前为他求问。他和以色列全会众都要遵以利亚撒的命出入。」
verses.textEnNiv: He is to stand before Eleazar the priest, who will obtain decisions for him by inquiring of the Urim before the Lord . At his command he and the entire community of the Israelites will go out, and at his command they will come in."
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before the Lord . At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the people of Israel with him, the whole congregation."
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire before the Lord for him by the judgment of the Urim. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, he and all the children of Israel with him—all the congregation."
verses.textEnNlt: When direction from the Lord is needed, Joshua will stand before Eleazar the priest, who will use the Urim—one of the sacred lots cast before the Lord —to determine his will. This is how Joshua and the rest of the community of Israel will determine everything they should do."
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before the Lord. At his command they shall go out, and at his command they shall come in, both he and all the sons of Israel with him, all the congregation."
verses.textEn: He is to stand before Eleazar the priest, who will obtain decisions for him by inquiring of the Urim before the Lord . At his command he and the entire community of the Israelites will go out, and at his command they will come in."

verses.textZh: 于是，摩西照着耶和华吩咐他的去行；他把约书亚领来，叫他站在以利亚撒祭司和全体会众面前，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，摩西照着耶和华吩咐他的去行；他把约书亚领来，叫他站在以利亚撒祭司和全体会众面前，
verses.textZhCuv: 于是摩西照耶和华所吩咐的将约书亚领来，使他站在祭司以利亚撒和全会众面前，
verses.textEnNiv: Moses did as the Lord commanded him. He took Joshua and had him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole assembly.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses did as the Lord commanded him. He took Joshua and made him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole congregation,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses did as the Lord commanded him. He took Joshua and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses did as the Lord commanded. He presented Joshua to Eleazar the priest and the whole community.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses did just as the Lord commanded him; he took Joshua and had him stand before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.
verses.textEn: Moses did as the Lord commanded him. He took Joshua and had him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole assembly.

verses.textZh: 按手在他头上，委派他，是照着耶和华藉摩西吩咐的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 按手在他头上，委派他，是照着耶和华藉摩西吩咐的。
verses.textZhCuv: 按手在他头上，嘱咐他，是照耶和华藉摩西所说的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the Lord instructed through Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: and he laid his hands on him and commissioned him as the Lord directed through Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he laid his hands on him and inaugurated him, just as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses laid his hands on him and commissioned him to lead the people, just as the Lord had commanded through Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he laid his hands on him and commissioned him, just as the Lord had spoken through Moses.
verses.textEn: Then he laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the Lord instructed through Moses.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要吩咐以色列人说：‘你们应献给我的供物，就是献给我作馨香的火祭的食物，要小心按着日期献给我。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要吩咐以色列人说：‘你们应献给我的供物，就是献给我作馨香的火祭的食物，要小心按着日期献给我。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要吩咐以色列人说：『献给我的供物，就是献给我作馨香火祭的食物，你们要按日期献给我』；
verses.textEnNiv: "Give this command to the Israelites and say to them: ‘Make sure that you present to me at the appointed time my food offerings, as an aroma pleasing to me.’
verses.textEnEsv: "Command the people of Israel and say to them, ‘My offering, my food for my food offerings, my pleasing aroma, you shall be careful to offer to me at its appointed time.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Command the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘My offering, My food for My offerings made by fire as a sweet aroma to Me, you shall be careful to offer to Me at their appointed time.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Give these instructions to the people of Israel: The offerings you present as special gifts are a pleasing aroma to me; they are my food. See to it that they are brought at the appointed times and offered according to my instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: "Command the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘You shall be careful to present to Me My offering, My food for My offerings by fire, of a soothing aroma to Me, at their appointed time.’
verses.textEn: "Give this command to the Israelites and say to them: ‘Make sure that you present to me at the appointed time my food offerings, as an aroma pleasing to me.’

verses.textZh: 你又要对他们说：‘你们要献给耶和华的火祭是这样：没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔，每天两只，作为常献的燔祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你又要对他们说：‘你们要献给耶和华的火祭是这样：没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔，每天两只，作为常献的燔祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要对他们说：你们要献给耶和华的火祭，就是没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔，每日两只，作为常献的燔祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Say to them: ‘This is the food offering you are to present to the Lord : two lambs a year old without defect, as a regular burnt offering each day.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall say to them, This is the food offering that you shall offer to the Lord : two male lambs a year old without blemish, day by day, as a regular offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And you shall say to them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to the Lord: two male lambs in their first year without blemish, day by day, as a regular burnt offering.
verses.textEnNlt: "Say to the people: This is the special gift you must present to the Lord as your daily burnt offering. You must offer two one-year-old male lambs with no defects.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall say to them, ‘This is the offering by fire which you shall offer to the Lord: two male lambs one year old without defect as a continual burnt offering every day.
verses.textEn: Say to them: ‘This is the food offering you are to present to the Lord : two lambs a year old without defect, as a regular burnt offering each day.

verses.textZh: 早晨要献一只，黄昏献一只；
verses.textZhCnvs: 早晨要献一只，黄昏献一只；
verses.textZhCuv: 早晨要献一只，黄昏的时候要献一只；
verses.textEnNiv: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight,
verses.textEnEsv: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the other lamb you shall offer at twilight;
verses.textEnNkjv: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, the other lamb you shall offer in the evening,
verses.textEnNlt: Sacrifice one lamb in the morning and the other in the evening.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and the other lamb you shall offer at twilight;
verses.textEn: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight,

verses.textZh: 也要献一公斤细面，用捣成的油一公升调和，作为素祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也要献一公斤细面，用捣成的油一公升调和，作为素祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用细面伊法十分之一，并捣成的油一欣四分之一，调和作为素祭。
verses.textEnNiv: together with a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil from pressed olives.
verses.textEnEsv: also a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a grain offering, mixed with a quarter of a hin of beaten oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: and one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering mixed with one-fourth of a hin of pressed oil.
verses.textEnNlt: With each lamb you must offer a grain offering of two quarts of choice flour mixed with one quart of pure oil of pressed olives.
verses.textEnNasb: also a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with a fourth of a hin of pure oil.
verses.textEn: together with a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil from pressed olives.

verses.textZh: 这就是常献的燔祭，是在西奈山规定，作为献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就是常献的燔祭，是在西奈山规定，作为献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是西奈山所命定为常献的燔祭，是献给耶和华为馨香的火祭。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the regular burnt offering instituted at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: It is a regular burnt offering, which was ordained at Mount Sinai for a pleasing aroma, a food offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis a regular burnt offering which was ordained at Mount Sinai for a sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the regular burnt offering instituted at Mount Sinai as a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained on Mount Sinai as a soothing aroma, an offering by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEn: This is the regular burnt offering instituted at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 为每只公羊羔，要同献一公升作奠祭的酒；你要在圣所中把醇酒献给耶和华作奠祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为每只公羊羔，要同献一公升作奠祭的酒；你要在圣所中把醇酒献给耶和华作奠祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 为这一只羊羔，要同献奠祭的酒一欣四分之一。在圣所中，你要将醇酒奉给耶和华为奠祭。
verses.textEnNiv: The accompanying drink offering is to be a quarter of a hin of fermented drink with each lamb. Pour out the drink offering to the Lord at the sanctuary.
verses.textEnEsv: Its drink offering shall be a quarter of a hin for each lamb. In the Holy Place you shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And its drink offering shallbe one-fourth of a hin for each lamb; in a holy place you shall pour out the drink to the Lord as an offering.
verses.textEnNlt: Along with it you must present the proper liquid offering of one quart of alcoholic drink with each lamb, poured out in the Holy Place as an offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then the drink offering with it shall be a fourth of a hin for each lamb; in the Holy Place pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the Lord.
verses.textEn: The accompanying drink offering is to be a quarter of a hin of fermented drink with each lamb. Pour out the drink offering to the Lord at the sanctuary.

verses.textZh: 晚上你要献上另一只公羊羔，要照着早晨的素祭，和同献的奠祭献上，作馨香的火祭献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 晚上你要献上另一只公羊羔，要照着早晨的素祭，和同献的奠祭献上，作馨香的火祭献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 晚上，你要献那一只羊羔，必照早晨的素祭和同献的奠祭献上，作为馨香的火祭，献给耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: Offer the second lamb at twilight, along with the same kind of grain offering and drink offering that you offer in the morning. This is a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The other lamb you shall offer at twilight. Like the grain offering of the morning, and like its drink offering, you shall offer it as a food offering, with a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The other lamb you shall offer in the evening; as the morning grain offering and its drink offering, you shall offer it as an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Offer the second lamb in the evening with the same grain offering and liquid offering. It, too, is a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The other lamb you shall offer at twilight; as the grain offering of the morning and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering by fire, a soothing aroma to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Offer the second lamb at twilight, along with the same kind of grain offering and drink offering that you offer in the morning. This is a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord .

verses.textZh: "‘在安息日，要献两只没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔，也要献两公斤细面，用油调和作素祭；还有同献的奠祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘在安息日，要献两只没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔，也要献两公斤细面，用油调和作素祭；还有同献的奠祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 「当安息日，要献两只没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔，并用调油的细面伊法十分之二为素祭，又将同献的奠祭献上。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘On the Sabbath day, make an offering of two lambs a year old without defect, together with its drink offering and a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with olive oil.
verses.textEnEsv: "On the Sabbath day, two male lambs a year old without blemish, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a grain offering, mixed with oil, and its drink offering:
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And on the Sabbath day two lambs in their first year, without blemish, and two-tenths ofanephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, with its drink offering—
verses.textEnNlt: "On the Sabbath day, sacrifice two one-year-old male lambs with no defects. They must be accompanied by a grain offering of four quarts of choice flour moistened with olive oil, and a liquid offering.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Then on the Sabbath day two male lambs one year old without defect, and two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, and its drink offering:
verses.textEn: " ‘On the Sabbath day, make an offering of two lambs a year old without defect, together with its drink offering and a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with olive oil.

verses.textZh: 这是安息日献的燔祭；在那常献的燔祭和同献的奠祭以外。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是安息日献的燔祭；在那常献的燔祭和同献的奠祭以外。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是每安息日献的燔祭；那常献的燔祭和同献的奠祭在外。」
verses.textEnNiv: This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.textEnEsv: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: thisis the burnt offering for every Sabbath, besides the regular burnt offering with its drink offering.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the burnt offering to be presented each Sabbath day, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its accompanying liquid offering.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the burnt offering of every Sabbath in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.textEn: This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.

verses.textZh: "‘每月第一日，你们要把燔祭献给耶和华，就是两头公牛犊、一只公绵羊、七只没有残疾一岁的公羊羔。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘每月第一日，你们要把燔祭献给耶和华，就是两头公牛犊、一只公绵羊、七只没有残疾一岁的公羊羔。
verses.textZhCuv: 「每月朔，你们要将两只公牛犊，一只公绵羊，七只没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔，献给耶和华为燔祭。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘On the first of every month, present to the Lord a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.
verses.textEnEsv: "At the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to the Lord : two bulls from the herd, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without blemish;
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘At the beginnings of your months you shall present a burnt offering to the Lord: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year, without blemish;
verses.textEnNlt: "On the first day of each month, present an extra burnt offering to the Lord of two young bulls, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all with no defects.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Then at the beginning of each of your months you shall present a burnt offering to the Lord: two bulls and one ram, seven male lambs one year old without defect;
verses.textEn: " ‘On the first of every month, present to the Lord a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

verses.textZh: 为每头公牛，要献三公斤细面，用油调和作素祭；为每只公绵羊，要献两公斤细面，用油调和作素祭；
verses.textZhCnvs: 为每头公牛，要献三公斤细面，用油调和作素祭；为每只公绵羊，要献两公斤细面，用油调和作素祭；
verses.textZhCuv: 每只公牛要用调油的细面伊法十分之三作为素祭；那只公羊也用调油的细面伊法十分之二作为素祭；
verses.textEnNiv: With each bull there is to be a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil;
verses.textEnEsv: also three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a grain offering, mixed with oil, for each bull, and two tenths of fine flour for a grain offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;
verses.textEnNkjv: three-tenths ofanephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; two-tenths ofanephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;
verses.textEnNlt: These must be accompanied by grain offerings of choice flour moistened with olive oil—six quarts with each bull, four quarts with the ram,
verses.textEnNasb: and three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, for each bull; and two-tenths of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, for the one ram;
verses.textEn: With each bull there is to be a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil;

verses.textZh: 为每只公羊羔，要献一公斤细面，用油调和作素祭；这是馨香的燔祭，是献给耶和华的火祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为每只公羊羔，要献一公斤细面，用油调和作素祭；这是馨香的燔祭，是献给耶和华的火祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 每只羊羔要用调油的细面伊法十分之一作为素祭和馨香的燔祭，是献给耶和华的火祭。
verses.textEnNiv: and with each lamb, a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil. This is for a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: and a tenth of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering for every lamb; for a burnt offering with a pleasing aroma, a food offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: and one-tenth ofanephah of fine flour, mixed with oil, as a grain offering for each lamb, as a burnt offering of sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: and two quarts with each lamb. This burnt offering will be a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: and a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering for each lamb, as a burnt offering of a soothing aroma, an offering by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEn: and with each lamb, a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil. This is for a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, a food offering presented to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 每头公牛要献酒两公升作奠祭，每只公绵羊献酒一公升半，每只公羊羔献酒一公升。这是每月当献的燔祭，一年之中每个月都要这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每头公牛要献酒两公升作奠祭，每只公绵羊献酒一公升半，每只公羊羔献酒一公升。这是每月当献的燔祭，一年之中每个月都要这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 一只公牛要奠酒半欣，一只公羊要奠酒一欣三分之一，一只羊羔也奠酒一欣四分之一。这是每月的燔祭，一年之中要月月如此。
verses.textEnNiv: With each bull there is to be a drink offering of half a hin of wine; with the ram, a third of a hin ; and with each lamb, a quarter of a hin. This is the monthly burnt offering to be made at each new moon during the year.
verses.textEnEsv: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, a third of a hin for a ram, and a quarter of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of each month throughout the months of the year.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their drink offering shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, one-third of a hin for a ram, and one-fourth of a hin for a lamb; this is the burnt offering for each month throughout the months of the year.
verses.textEnNlt: You must also present a liquid offering with each sacrifice: two quarts of wine for each bull, a third of a gallon for the ram, and one quart for each lamb. Present this monthly burnt offering on the first day of each month throughout the year.
verses.textEnNasb: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull and a third of a hin for the ram and a fourth of a hin for a lamb; this is the burnt offering of each month throughout the months of the year.
verses.textEn: With each bull there is to be a drink offering of half a hin of wine; with the ram, a third of a hin ; and with each lamb, a quarter of a hin. This is the monthly burnt offering to be made at each new moon during the year.

verses.textZh: 又要把一只公山羊作赎罪祭献给耶和华，在那常献的燔祭和同献的奠祭以外。

verses.textEnNiv: Besides the regular burnt offering with its drink offering, one male goat is to be presented to the Lord as a sin offering.
verses.textEnEsv: Also one male goat for a sin offering to the Lord ; it shall be offered besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also one kid of the goats as a sin offering to the Lord shall be offered, besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.textEnNlt: "On the first day of each month, you must also offer one male goat for a sin offering to the Lord . This is in addition to the regular burnt offering and its accompanying liquid offering.
verses.textEnNasb: And one male goat as a sin offering to the Lord; it shall be offered with its drink offering in addition to the continual burnt offering.
verses.textEn: Besides the regular burnt offering with its drink offering, one male goat is to be presented to the Lord as a sin offering.

verses.textZh: "‘正月十四日，是耶和华的逾越节。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘正月十四日，是耶和华的逾越节。
verses.textZhCuv: 「正月十四日是耶和华的逾越节。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘On the fourteenth day of the first month the Lord ’s Passover is to be held.
verses.textEnEsv: "On the fourteenth day of the first month is the Lord ’s Passover,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘On the fourteenth day of the first month is the Passover of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "On the fourteenth day of the first month, you must celebrate the Lord ’s Passover.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘The Lord’s Passover shall be on the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.textEn: " ‘On the fourteenth day of the first month the Lord ’s Passover is to be held.

verses.textZh: 这月十五日是节期；要吃无酵饼七日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这月十五日是节期；要吃无酵饼七日。
verses.textZhCuv: 这月十五日是节期，要吃无酵饼七日。
verses.textEnNiv: On the fifteenth day of this month there is to be a festival; for seven days eat bread made without yeast.
verses.textEnEsv: and on the fifteenth day of this month is a feast. Seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
verses.textEnNkjv: And on the fifteenth day of this month is the feast; unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.
verses.textEnNlt: On the following day—the fifteenth day of the month—a joyous, seven-day festival will begin, but no bread made with yeast may be eaten.
verses.textEnNasb: On the fifteenth day of this month there shall be a feast; unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.
verses.textEn: On the fifteenth day of this month there is to be a festival; for seven days eat bread made without yeast.

verses.textZh: 第一日要有圣会，甚么劳碌的工都不可作，
verses.textZhCnvs: 第一日要有圣会，甚么劳碌的工都不可作，
verses.textZhCuv: 第一日当有圣会；什么劳碌的工都不可做。
verses.textEnNiv: On the first day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.
verses.textEnEsv: On the first day there shall be a holy convocation. You shall not do any ordinary work,
verses.textEnNkjv: On the first day youshallhave a holy convocation. You shall do no customary work.
verses.textEnNlt: The first day of the festival will be an official day for holy assembly, and no ordinary work may be done on that day.
verses.textEnNasb: On the first day there shall be a holy assembly; you shall do no laborious work.
verses.textEn: On the first day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.

verses.textZh: 只要献火祭给耶和华作燔祭，就是两头公牛犊、一只公绵羊和七只一岁的公羊羔，都要完全没有残疾的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只要献火祭给耶和华作燔祭，就是两头公牛犊、一只公绵羊和七只一岁的公羊羔，都要完全没有残疾的。
verses.textZhCuv: 当将公牛犊两只，公绵羊一只，一岁的公羊羔七只，都要没有残疾的，用火献给耶和华为燔祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Present to the Lord a food offering consisting of a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.
verses.textEnEsv: but offer a food offering, a burnt offering to the Lord : two bulls from the herd, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old; see that they are without blemish;
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall present an offering made by fire as a burnt offering to the Lord: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year. Be sure they are without blemish.
verses.textEnNlt: As a special gift you must present a burnt offering to the Lord —two young bulls, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all with no defects.
verses.textEnNasb: But you shall present an offering by fire, a burnt offering to the Lord: two bulls and one ram, and seven male lambs one year old, that you have without defect.
verses.textEn: Present to the Lord a food offering consisting of a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

verses.textZh: 同献的素祭，是用油调和的细面，为每头公牛犊要献三公斤；为每只公绵羊要献两公斤；

verses.textEnEsv: also their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil; three tenths of an ephah shall you offer for a bull, and two tenths for a ram;
verses.textEnNkjv: Their grain offering shall be of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths ofanephah you shall offer for a bull, and two-tenths for a ram;
verses.textEnNlt: These will be accompanied by grain offerings of choice flour moistened with olive oil—six quarts with each bull, four quarts with the ram,

verses.textEn: With each bull offer a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;

verses.textEnNkjv: you shall offer one-tenth ofanephah for each of the seven lambs;
verses.textEnNlt: and two quarts with each of the seven lambs.
verses.textEnNasb: A tenth of an ephah you shall offer for each of the seven lambs;
verses.textEn: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.

verses.textZhCuv: 并献一只公山羊作赎罪祭，为你们赎罪。

verses.textEnEsv: also one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: also one goat as a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
verses.textEnNlt: You must also offer a male goat as a sin offering to purify yourselves and make yourselves right with the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: and one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.
verses.textEn: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.

verses.textZh: 除了早晨的燔祭，就是常献的燔祭以外，还要把这些祭物献上。

verses.textEn: Offer these in addition to the regular morning burnt offering.

verses.textZh: 一连七日，每日都要献上这样的祭物，给耶和华作馨香火祭的食物，是在常献的燔祭和同献的奠祭以外的。

verses.textEnNiv: In this way present the food offering every day for seven days as an aroma pleasing to the Lord ; it is to be offered in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.textEnEsv: In the same way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of a food offering, with a pleasing aroma to the Lord . It shall be offered besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: In this manner you shall offer the food of the offering made by fire daily for seven days, as a sweet aroma to the Lord; it shall be offered besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.textEnNlt: On each of the seven days of the festival, this is how you must prepare the food offering that is presented as a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the Lord . These will be offered in addition to the regular burnt offerings and liquid offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: In this way you shall present daily, for seven days, the food of the offering by fire, of a soothing aroma to the Lord; it shall be presented with its drink offering in addition to the continual burnt offering.
verses.textEn: In this way present the food offering every day for seven days as an aroma pleasing to the Lord ; it is to be offered in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.

verses.textEnEsv: and one tenth for each of the seven lambs;
verses.textEnNkjv: and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs;

verses.textEnNkjv: also one kid of the goats as a sin offering, to make atonement for you;

verses.textEnNasb: and one male goat as a sin offering, to make atonement for you,
verses.textEn: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.

verses.textZh: 在月初的燔祭和同献的素祭、常献的燔祭和同献的素祭，以及照例同献的奠祭以外，还要献上这些给耶和华作馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在月初的燔祭和同献的素祭、常献的燔祭和同献的素祭，以及照例同献的奠祭以外，还要献上这些给耶和华作馨香的火祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些是在月朔的燔祭和同献的素祭，并常献的燔祭与同献的素祭，以及照例同献的奠祭以外，都作为馨香的火祭献给耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: These are in addition to the monthly and daily burnt offerings with their grain offerings and drink offerings as specified. They are food offerings presented to the Lord , a pleasing aroma.
verses.textEnEsv: besides the burnt offering of the new moon, and its grain offering, and the regular burnt offering and its grain offering, and their drink offering, according to the rule for them, for a pleasing aroma, a food offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: besides the burnt offering with its grain offering for the New Moon, the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, as a sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: These special sacrifices are in addition to your regular monthly and daily burnt offerings, and they must be given with their prescribed grain offerings and liquid offerings. These offerings are given as a special gift to the Lord , a pleasing aroma to him.
verses.textEnNasb: besides the burnt offering of the new moon and its grain offering, and the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a soothing aroma, an offering by fire to the Lord.
verses.textEn: These are in addition to the monthly and daily burnt offerings with their grain offerings and drink offerings as specified. They are food offerings presented to the Lord , a pleasing aroma.

verses.textZh: "‘在七月十日，你们要有圣会，刻苦己心，甚么都不可作，
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘在七月十日，你们要有圣会，刻苦己心，甚么都不可作，
verses.textZhCuv: 「七月初十日，你们当有圣会；要刻苦己心，什么工都不可做。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘On the tenth day of this seventh month hold a sacred assembly. You must deny yourselves and do no work.
verses.textEnEsv: "On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation and afflict yourselves. You shall do no work,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls; you shall not do any work.
verses.textEnNlt: "Ten days later, on the tenth day of the same month, you must call another holy assembly. On that day, the Day of Atonement, the people must go without food and must do no ordinary work.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Then on the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy assembly, and you shall humble yourselves; you shall not do any work.
verses.textEn: " ‘On the tenth day of this seventh month hold a sacred assembly. You must deny yourselves and do no work.

verses.textZh: 只要把燔祭作馨香的祭献给耶和华，就是一头公牛犊、一只公绵羊、七只一岁没有残疾的公羊羔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只要把燔祭作馨香的祭献给耶和华，就是一头公牛犊、一只公绵羊、七只一岁没有残疾的公羊羔。
verses.textZhCuv: 只要将公牛犊一只，公绵羊一只，一岁的公羊羔七只，都要没有残疾的，作为馨香的燔祭献给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Present as an aroma pleasing to the Lord a burnt offering of one young bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.
verses.textEnEsv: but you shall offer a burnt offering to the Lord , a pleasing aroma: one bull from the herd, one ram, seven male lambs a year old: see that they are without blemish.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall present a burnt offering to the Lordas a sweet aroma: one young bull, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year. Be sure they are without blemish.
verses.textEnNlt: You must present a burnt offering as a pleasing aroma to the Lord . It will consist of one young bull, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all with no defects.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall present a burnt offering to the Lordas a soothing aroma: one bull, one ram, and seven male lambs one year old, that you have without defect;
verses.textEn: Present as an aroma pleasing to the Lord a burnt offering of one young bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

verses.textZh: 同献的素祭，是用油调和的细面，为每头公牛要献三公斤；为每只公绵羊要献两公斤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 同献的素祭，是用油调和的细面，为每头公牛要献三公斤；为每只公绵羊要献两公斤。
verses.textZhCuv: 同献的素祭用调油的细面：为一只公牛要献伊法十分之三；为一只公羊要献伊法十分之二；
verses.textEnNiv: With the bull offer a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;
verses.textEnEsv: And their grain offering shall be of fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths of an ephah for the bull, two tenths for the one ram,
verses.textEnNkjv: Their grain offering shallbeof fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths ofanephah for the bull, two-tenths for the one ram,
verses.textEnNlt: These offerings must be accompanied by the prescribed grain offerings of choice flour moistened with olive oil—six quarts of choice flour with the bull, four quarts of choice flour with the ram,
verses.textEnNasb: and their grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for the bull, two-tenths for the one ram,
verses.textEn: With the bull offer a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of the finest flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;

verses.textEnNkjv: and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs;
verses.textEnNlt: and two quarts of choice flour with each of the seven lambs.
verses.textEnNasb: and a tenth for each of the seven lambs;
verses.textEn: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.

verses.textZh: 在为赎罪的赎罪祭、常献的燔祭和同献的素祭，以及同献的奠祭以外，还要献一只公山羊作赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在为赎罪的赎罪祭、常献的燔祭和同献的素祭，以及同献的奠祭以外，还要献一只公山羊作赎罪祭。

verses.textEnNiv: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering for atonement and the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: also one male goat for a sin offering, besides the sin offering of atonement, and the regular burnt offering and its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
verses.textEnNkjv: also one kid of the goats as a sin offering, besides the sin offering for atonement, the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.

verses.textEnNasb: one male goat as a sin offering, besides the sin offering of atonement and the continual burnt offering, and its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
verses.textEn: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering for atonement and the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.

verses.textZh: "‘七月十五日，你们要有圣会；甚么劳碌的工都不可作，要向耶和华守节七天；
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘七月十五日，你们要有圣会；甚么劳碌的工都不可作，要向耶和华守节七天；
verses.textZhCuv: 「七月十五日，你们当有圣会；什么劳碌的工都不可做，要向耶和华守节七日。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work. Celebrate a festival to the Lord for seven days.
verses.textEnEsv: "On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall not do any ordinary work, and you shall keep a feast to the Lord seven days.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no customary work, and you shall keep a feast to the Lord seven days.
verses.textEnNlt: "Five days later, on the fifteenth day of the same month, you must call another holy assembly of all the people, and you may do no ordinary work on that day. It is the beginning of the Festival of Shelters, a seven-day festival to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Then on the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy assembly; you shall do no laborious work, and you shall celebrate with a feast to the Lord for seven days.
verses.textEn: " ‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work. Celebrate a festival to the Lord for seven days.

verses.textZh: 你们要给耶和华献燔祭，作馨香的火祭，就是十三头公牛犊、两只公绵羊、十四只一岁没有残疾的公羊羔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要给耶和华献燔祭，作馨香的火祭，就是十三头公牛犊、两只公绵羊、十四只一岁没有残疾的公羊羔。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要将公牛犊十三只，公绵羊两只，一岁的公羊羔十四只，都要没有残疾的，用火献给耶和华为馨香的燔祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Present as an aroma pleasing to the Lord a food offering consisting of a burnt offering of thirteen young bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall offer a burnt offering, a food offering, with a pleasing aroma to the Lord , thirteen bulls from the herd, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old; they shall be without blemish;
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall present a burnt offering, an offering made by fire as a sweet aroma to the Lord: thirteen young bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs in their first year. They shall be without blemish.
verses.textEnNlt: On the first day of the festival, you must present a burnt offering as a special gift, a pleasing aroma to the Lord . It will consist of thirteen young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all with no defects.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall present a burnt offering, an offering by fire as a soothing aroma to the Lord: thirteen bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs one year old, which are without defect;
verses.textEn: Present as an aroma pleasing to the Lord a food offering consisting of a burnt offering of thirteen young bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

verses.textZh: 同献的素祭，是用油调和的细面，为那十三头公牛，每只要献三公斤；为那两只公绵羊，每只要献两公斤；

verses.textEnEsv: and their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths of an ephah for each of the thirteen bulls, two tenths for each of the two rams,

verses.textZh: "‘在那些为还愿或是甘心所献，作你们的燔祭、素祭、奠祭，或是平安祭的以外，这些是在你们规定的时期内，要献给耶和华的祭物。’"

verses.textEnNiv: " ‘In addition to what you vow and your freewill offerings, offer these to the Lord at your appointed festivals: your burnt offerings, grain offerings, drink offerings and fellowship offerings.’ "
