verses.textZhCuv: 人若向耶和华许愿或起誓，要约束自己，就不可食言，必要按口中所出的一切话行。
verses.textEnNiv: When a man makes a vow to the Lord or takes an oath to obligate himself by a pledge, he must not break his word but must do everything he said.
verses.textEnEsv: If a man vows a vow to the Lord , or swears an oath to bind himself by a pledge, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: If a man makes a vow to the Lord, or swears an oath to bind himself by some agreement, he shall not break his word; he shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: A man who makes a vow to the Lord or makes a pledge under oath must never break it. He must do exactly what he said he would do.
verses.textEnNasb: If a man makes a vow to the Lord, or takes an oath to put himself under a binding obligation, he shall not break his word; he shall act in accordance with everything that comes out of his mouth.
verses.textEn: When a man makes a vow to the Lord or takes an oath to obligate himself by a pledge, he must not break his word but must do everything he said.

verses.textZh: 女子年幼还在父家的时候，如果向耶和华许愿要约束自己，
verses.textZhCnvs: 女子年幼还在父家的时候，如果向耶和华许愿要约束自己，
verses.textZhCuv: 女子年幼、还在父家的时候，若向耶和华许愿，要约束自己，
verses.textEnNiv: "When a young woman still living in her father’s household makes a vow to the Lord or obligates herself by a pledge
verses.textEnEsv: "If a woman vows a vow to the Lord and binds herself by a pledge, while within her father’s house in her youth,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Or if a woman makes a vow to the Lord, and binds herself by some agreement while in her father’s house in her youth,
verses.textEnNlt: "If a young woman makes a vow to the Lord or a pledge under oath while she is still living at her father’s home,
verses.textEnNasb: "And if a woman makes a vow to the Lord, and puts herself under a binding obligation in her father’s house in her youth,
verses.textEn: "When a young woman still living in her father’s household makes a vow to the Lord or obligates herself by a pledge

verses.textZh: 她父亲若是听见她所许的愿和约束自己的话，却对她默不作声，她所许的一切愿和所说约束自己的话，就为有效。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她父亲若是听见她所许的愿和约束自己的话，却对她默不作声，她所许的一切愿和所说约束自己的话，就为有效。
verses.textZhCuv: 她父亲也听见她所许的愿并约束自己的话，却向她默默不言，她所许的愿并约束自己的话就都要为定。
verses.textEnNiv: and her father hears about her vow or pledge but says nothing to her, then all her vows and every pledge by which she obligated herself will stand.
verses.textEnEsv: and her father hears of her vow and of her pledge by which she has bound herself and says nothing to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge by which she has bound herself shall stand.
verses.textEnNkjv: and her father hears her vow and the agreement by which she has bound herself, and her father holds his peace, then all her vows shall stand, and every agreement with which she has bound herself shall stand.
verses.textEnNlt: and her father hears of the vow or pledge and does not object to it, then all her vows and pledges will stand.
verses.textEnNasb: and her father hears her vow and her obligation under which she has put herself, and her father says nothing to her, then all her vows shall remain valid and every binding obligation under which she has put herself shall remain valid.
verses.textEn: and her father hears about her vow or pledge but says nothing to her, then all her vows and every pledge by which she obligated herself will stand.

verses.textZh: 但是她父亲听见的时候，如果阻止她，她所许的愿和所说约束自己的话，就都为无效；耶和华也必赦免她，因为她父亲阻止她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是她父亲听见的时候，如果阻止她，她所许的愿和所说约束自己的话，就都为无效；耶和华也必赦免她，因为她父亲阻止她。
verses.textZhCuv: 但她父亲听见的日子若不应承她所许的愿和约束自己的话，就都不得为定；耶和华也必赦免她，因为她父亲不应承。
verses.textEnNiv: But if her father forbids her when he hears about it, none of her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand; the Lord will release her because her father has forbidden her.
verses.textEnEsv: But if her father opposes her on the day that he hears of it, no vow of hers, no pledge by which she has bound herself shall stand. And the Lord will forgive her, because her father opposed her.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if her father overrules her on the day that he hears, then none of her vows nor her agreements by which she has bound herself shall stand; and the Lord will release her, because her father overruled her.
verses.textEnNlt: But if her father refuses to let her fulfill the vow or pledge on the day he hears of it, then all her vows and pledges will become invalid. The Lord will forgive her because her father would not let her fulfill them.
verses.textEnNasb: But if her father expresses disapproval to her on the day he hears of it, none of her vows or her obligations under which she has put herself shall remain valid; and the Lord will forgive her because her father has expressed disapproval to her.
verses.textEn: But if her father forbids her when he hears about it, none of her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand; the Lord will release her because her father has forbidden her.

verses.textZh: "如果她已嫁了丈夫，她许愿或嘴里说冒失话约束自己的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果她已嫁了丈夫，她许愿或嘴里说冒失话约束自己的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 她若出了嫁，有愿在身，或是口中出了约束自己的冒失话，
verses.textEnNiv: "If she marries after she makes a vow or after her lips utter a rash promise by which she obligates herself
verses.textEnEsv: "If she marries a husband, while under her vows or any thoughtless utterance of her lips by which she has bound herself,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If indeed she takes a husband, while bound by her vows or by a rash utterance from her lips by which she bound herself,
verses.textEnNlt: "Now suppose a young woman makes a vow or binds herself with an impulsive pledge and later marries.
verses.textEnNasb: "However, if she happens to marry while under her vows or the impulsive statement of her lips by which she has obligated herself,
verses.textEn: "If she marries after she makes a vow or after her lips utter a rash promise by which she obligates herself

verses.textZh: 她丈夫听见了，但在听见的时候，默不作声，她所许的愿和约束自己的话，就为有效。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她丈夫听见了，但在听见的时候，默不作声，她所许的愿和约束自己的话，就为有效。
verses.textZhCuv: 她丈夫听见的日子，却向她默默不言，她所许的愿并约束自己的话就都要为定。
verses.textEnNiv: and her husband hears about it but says nothing to her, then her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand.
verses.textEnEsv: and her husband hears of it and says nothing to her on the day that he hears, then her vows shall stand, and her pledges by which she has bound herself shall stand.
verses.textEnNkjv: and her husband hears it, and makes no response to her on the day that he hears, then her vows shall stand, and her agreements by which she bound herself shall stand.
verses.textEnNlt: If her husband learns of her vow or pledge and does not object on the day he hears of it, her vows and pledges will stand.
verses.textEnNasb: and her husband hears of it and says nothing to her on the day he hears it, then her vows shall remain valid and her binding obligations under which she has put herself shall remain valid.
verses.textEn: and her husband hears about it but says nothing to her, then her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand.

verses.textZh: 但是她丈夫听见的时候，如果阻止她，就算废了她所许的愿和她嘴里所说约束自己的冒失话；耶和华也必赦免她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是她丈夫听见的时候，如果阻止她，就算废了她所许的愿和她嘴里所说约束自己的冒失话；耶和华也必赦免她。
verses.textZhCuv: 但她丈夫听见的日子，若不应承，就算废了她所许的愿和她出口约束自己的冒失话；耶和华也必赦免她。
verses.textEnNiv: But if her husband forbids her when he hears about it, he nullifies the vow that obligates her or the rash promise by which she obligates herself, and the Lord will release her.
verses.textEnEsv: But if, on the day that her husband comes to hear of it, he opposes her, then he makes void her vow that was on her, and the thoughtless utterance of her lips by which she bound herself. And the Lord will forgive her.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if her husband overrules her on the day that he hears it, he shall make void her vow which she took and what she uttered with her lips, by which she bound herself, and the Lord will release her.
verses.textEnNlt: But if her husband refuses to accept her vow or impulsive pledge on the day he hears of it, he nullifies her commitments, and the Lord will forgive her.
verses.textEnNasb: But if on the day her husband hears of it, he expresses disapproval to her, then he will annul her vow which she is under and the impulsive statement of her lips by which she has obligated herself; and the Lord will forgive her.
verses.textEn: But if her husband forbids her when he hears about it, he nullifies the vow that obligates her or the rash promise by which she obligates herself, and the Lord will release her.

verses.textZh: "寡妇，或是离了婚的妇人所许的愿，就是她所说约束自己的一切话，都为有效。
verses.textZhCnvs: "寡妇，或是离了婚的妇人所许的愿，就是她所说约束自己的一切话，都为有效。
verses.textZhCuv: 寡妇或是被休的妇人所许的愿，就是她约束自己的话，都要为定。
verses.textEnNiv: "Any vow or obligation taken by a widow or divorced woman will be binding on her.
verses.textEnEsv: (But any vow of a widow or of a divorced woman, anything by which she has bound herself, shall stand against her.)
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also any vow of a widow or a divorced woman, by which she has bound herself, shall stand against her.
verses.textEnNlt: If, however, a woman is a widow or is divorced, she must fulfill all her vows and pledges.
verses.textEnNasb: "But as for the vow of a widow or of a divorced woman, every binding obligation under which she has put herself, shall remain valid against her.
verses.textEn: "Any vow or obligation taken by a widow or divorced woman will be binding on her.

verses.textZh: 如果她在丈夫家里许了愿，或用誓言约束自己，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果她在丈夫家里许了愿，或用誓言约束自己，
verses.textZhCuv: 她若在丈夫家里许了愿或起了誓，约束自己，
verses.textEnNiv: "If a woman living with her husband makes a vow or obligates herself by a pledge under oath
verses.textEnEsv: And if she vowed in her husband’s house or bound herself by a pledge with an oath,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If she vowed in her husband’s house, or bound herself by an agreement with an oath,
verses.textEnNlt: "But suppose a woman is married and living in her husband’s home when she makes a vow or binds herself with a pledge.
verses.textEnNasb: However, if a married woman vowed in her husband’s house, or put herself under a binding obligation with an oath,
verses.textEn: "If a woman living with her husband makes a vow or obligates herself by a pledge under oath

verses.textZh: 她丈夫听见了，却默不作声，也没有阻止她，她所许的愿和所说一切约束自己的话，就为有效。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她丈夫听见了，却默不作声，也没有阻止她，她所许的愿和所说一切约束自己的话，就为有效。
verses.textZhCuv: 丈夫听见，却向她默默不言，也没有不应承，她所许的愿并约束自己的话就都要为定。
verses.textEnNiv: and her husband hears about it but says nothing to her and does not forbid her, then all her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand.
verses.textEnEsv: and her husband heard of it and said nothing to her and did not oppose her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge by which she bound herself shall stand.
verses.textEnNkjv: and her husband heard it, and made no response to her and did not overrule her, then all her vows shall stand, and every agreement by which she bound herself shall stand.
verses.textEnNlt: If her husband hears of it and does not object to it, her vow or pledge will stand.
verses.textEnNasb: and her husband heard it, but said nothing to her and did not express disapproval to her, then all her vows shall remain valid and every binding obligation under which she put herself shall remain valid.
verses.textEn: and her husband hears about it but says nothing to her and does not forbid her, then all her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand.

verses.textZh: 但是她丈夫听见的时候，如果把这两样都废了，妇人口中所说一切关于许愿的话和约束自己的话，都必无效；她丈夫已经把这两样都废了，耶和华也必赦免她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是她丈夫听见的时候，如果把这两样都废了，妇人口中所说一切关于许愿的话和约束自己的话，都必无效；她丈夫已经把这两样都废了，耶和华也必赦免她。
verses.textZhCuv: 丈夫听见的日子，若把这两样全废了，妇人口中所许的愿或是约束自己的话就都不得为定，因她丈夫已经把这两样废了；耶和华也必赦免她。
verses.textEnNiv: But if her husband nullifies them when he hears about them, then none of the vows or pledges that came from her lips will stand. Her husband has nullified them, and the Lord will release her.
verses.textEnEsv: But if her husband makes them null and void on the day that he hears them, then whatever proceeds out of her lips concerning her vows or concerning her pledge of herself shall not stand. Her husband has made them void, and the Lord will forgive her.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if her husband truly made them void on the day he heard them, then whatever proceeded from her lips concerning her vows or concerning the agreement binding her, it shall not stand; her husband has made them void, and the Lord will release her.
verses.textEnNlt: But if her husband refuses to accept it on the day he hears of it, her vow or pledge will be nullified, and the Lord will forgive her.
verses.textEnNasb: But if her husband actually annuls them on the day he hears them, then no utterance from her lips concerning her vows or the obligation she put on herself shall remain valid; her husband has annulled them, and the Lord will forgive her.
verses.textEn: But if her husband nullifies them when he hears about them, then none of the vows or pledges that came from her lips will stand. Her husband has nullified them, and the Lord will release her.

verses.textZh: "妇人所许的愿和刻苦约束自己所起的誓，她丈夫都可以确立，也可以废去。
verses.textZhCnvs: "妇人所许的愿和刻苦约束自己所起的誓，她丈夫都可以确立，也可以废去。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡她所许的愿和刻苦约束自己所起的誓，她丈夫可以坚定，也可以废去。
verses.textEnNiv: Her husband may confirm or nullify any vow she makes or any sworn pledge to deny herself.
verses.textEnEsv: Any vow and any binding oath to afflict herself, her husband may establish, or her husband may make void.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every vow and every binding oath to afflict her soul, her husband may confirm it, or her husband may make it void.
verses.textEnNlt: So her husband may either confirm or nullify any vows or pledges she makes to deny herself.
verses.textEnNasb: "Every vow and every binding oath to humble herself, her husband may confirm it or her husband may annul it.
verses.textEn: Her husband may confirm or nullify any vow she makes or any sworn pledge to deny herself.

verses.textZh: 如果她丈夫天天向她默不作声，那就算是确立她所许的愿和所说约束自己的一切话；因为丈夫在听见的日子，向她默不作声，就使这两样生效。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果她丈夫天天向她默不作声，那就算是确立她所许的愿和所说约束自己的一切话；因为丈夫在听见的日子，向她默不作声，就使这两样生效。
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若她丈夫天天向她默默不言，就算是坚定她所许的愿和约束自己的话；因丈夫听见的日子向她默默不言，就使这两样坚定。
verses.textEnNiv: But if her husband says nothing to her about it from day to day, then he confirms all her vows or the pledges binding on her. He confirms them by saying nothing to her when he hears about them.
verses.textEnEsv: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows or all her pledges that are upon her. He has established them, because he said nothing to her on the day that he heard of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now if her husband makes no response whatever to her from day to day, then he confirms all her vows or all the agreements that bind her; he confirms them, because he made no response to her on the day that he heard them.
verses.textEnNlt: But if he does not object on the day he hears of it, then he is agreeing to all her vows and pledges.
verses.textEnNasb: But if her husband in fact says nothing to her from day to day, then he confirms all her vows or all her binding obligations which are on her; he has confirmed them, because he said nothing to her on the day he heard them.
verses.textEn: But if her husband says nothing to her about it from day to day, then he confirms all her vows or the pledges binding on her. He confirms them by saying nothing to her when he hears about them.

verses.textZh: 但是，如果丈夫听了很久以后，才把这两样完全废去，他就要担当妻子的罪孽。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，如果丈夫听了很久以后，才把这两样完全废去，他就要担当妻子的罪孽。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但她丈夫听见以后，若使这两样全废了，就要担当妇人的罪孽。」
verses.textEnNiv: If, however, he nullifies them some time after he hears about them, then he must bear the consequences of her wrongdoing."
verses.textEnEsv: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard of them, then he shall bear her iniquity."
verses.textEnNkjv: But if he does make them void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her guilt."
verses.textEnNlt: If he waits more than a day and then tries to nullify a vow or pledge, he will be punished for her guilt."
verses.textEnNasb: However, if he actually annuls them after he has heard them, then he shall bear the responsibility for her guilt."
verses.textEn: If, however, he nullifies them some time after he hears about them, then he must bear the consequences of her wrongdoing."

verses.textZh: 以上是耶和华吩咐摩西的条例，是关于丈夫与妻子，父亲与女儿，女儿年幼在父家的时候的条例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上是耶和华吩咐摩西的条例，是关于丈夫与妻子，父亲与女儿，女儿年幼在父家的时候的条例。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是丈夫待妻子，父亲待女儿，女儿年幼、还在父家，耶和华所吩咐摩西的律例。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the regulations the Lord gave Moses concerning relationships between a man and his wife, and between a father and his young daughter still living at home.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the statutes that the Lord commanded Moses about a man and his wife and about a father and his daughter while she is in her youth within her father’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the statutes which the Lord commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, and between a father and his daughter in her youth in her father’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the regulations the Lord gave Moses concerning relationships between a man and his wife, and between a father and a young daughter who still lives at home.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the statutes which the Lord commanded Moses concerning matters between a man and his wife, and between a father and his daughter while she is in her youth in her father’s house.
verses.textEn: These are the regulations the Lord gave Moses concerning relationships between a man and his wife, and between a father and his young daughter still living at home.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要在米甸人身上报以色列人的仇，然后要归到你本族那里去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要在米甸人身上报以色列人的仇，然后要归到你本族那里去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要在米甸人身上报以色列人的仇，后来要归到你列祖 那里。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Take vengeance on the Midianites for the Israelites. After that, you will be gathered to your people."
verses.textEnEsv: "Avenge the people of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Take vengeance on the Midianites for the children of Israel. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people."
verses.textEnNlt: "On behalf of the people of Israel, take revenge on the Midianites for leading them into idolatry. After that, you will die and join your ancestors."
verses.textEnNasb: "Take vengeance on the Midianites for the sons of Israel; afterward you will be gathered to your people."
verses.textEn: "Take vengeance on the Midianites for the Israelites. After that, you will be gathered to your people."

verses.textZh: 摩西对人民说："要从你们中间使一些人武装起来去作战，攻击米甸人，好在米甸人身上为耶和华报仇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对人民说："要从你们中间使一些人武装起来去作战，攻击米甸人，好在米甸人身上为耶和华报仇。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西吩咐百姓说：「要从你们中间叫人带兵器出去攻击米甸，好在米甸人身上为耶和华报仇。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses said to the people, "Arm some of your men to go to war against the Midianites so that they may carry out the Lord ’s vengeance on them.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses spoke to the people, saying, "Arm men from among you for the war, that they may go against Midian to execute the Lord ’s vengeance on Midian.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses spoke to the people, saying, "Arm some of yourselves for war, and let them go against the Midianites to take vengeance for the Lord on Midian.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses said to the people, "Choose some men, and arm them to fight the Lord ’s war of revenge against Midian.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses spoke to the people, saying, "Arm men from among you for the war, so that they may go against Midian to execute the Lord’s vengeance on Midian.
verses.textEn: So Moses said to the people, "Arm some of your men to go to war against the Midianites so that they may carry out the Lord ’s vengeance on them.

verses.textZh: 你们要从以色列众支派中每支派打发一千人去打仗。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要从以色列众支派中每支派打发一千人去打仗。"
verses.textZhCuv: 从以色列众支派中，每支派要打发一千人去打仗。」
verses.textEnNiv: Send into battle a thousand men from each of the tribes of Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: You shall send a thousand from each of the tribes of Israel to the war."
verses.textEnNkjv: A thousand from each tribe of all the tribes of Israel you shall send to the war."
verses.textEnNlt: From each tribe of Israel, send 1,000 men into battle."
verses.textEnNasb: You shall send a thousand from each tribe of all the tribes of Israel to the war."
verses.textEn: Send into battle a thousand men from each of the tribes of Israel."

verses.textZh: 于是从以色列千万人中，每支派选出一千人，共有一万二千人，都武装起来去打仗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是从以色列千万人中，每支派选出一千人，共有一万二千人，都武装起来去打仗。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是从以色列千万人中，每支派交出一千人，共一万二千人，带着兵器预备打仗。
verses.textEnNiv: So twelve thousand men armed for battle, a thousand from each tribe, were supplied from the clans of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: So there were provided, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from each tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
verses.textEnNkjv: So there were recruited from the divisions of Israel one thousand from each tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
verses.textEnNlt: So they chose 1,000 men from each tribe of Israel, a total of 12,000 men armed for battle.
verses.textEnNasb: So there were selected from the thousands of Israel, a thousand from each tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
verses.textEn: So twelve thousand men armed for battle, a thousand from each tribe, were supplied from the clans of Israel.

verses.textZh: 摩西就打发每支派的一千人去打仗，并且派遣以利亚撒祭司的儿子非尼哈与他们一同去，非尼哈手里拿着圣所的器皿和吹大声的号筒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西就打发每支派的一千人去打仗，并且派遣以利亚撒祭司的儿子非尼哈与他们一同去，非尼哈手里拿着圣所的器皿和吹大声的号筒。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西就打发每支派的一千人去打仗，并打发祭司以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈同去；非尼哈手里拿着圣所的器皿和吹大声的号筒。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses sent them into battle, a thousand from each tribe, along with Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, who took with him articles from the sanctuary and the trumpets for signaling.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand from each tribe, together with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses sent them to the war, one thousand from each tribe; he sent them to the war with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, with the holy articles and the signal trumpets in his hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses sent them out, 1,000 men from each tribe, and Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest led them into battle. They carried along the holy objects of the sanctuary and the trumpets for sounding the charge.
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses sent them, a thousand from each tribe, to the war, and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war with them, and the holy implements and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.
verses.textEn: Moses sent them into battle, a thousand from each tribe, along with Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, who took with him articles from the sanctuary and the trumpets for signaling.

verses.textZh: 他们就照着耶和华吩咐摩西的，去与米甸人作战，杀死了所有的男人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就照着耶和华吩咐摩西的，去与米甸人作战，杀死了所有的男人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就照耶和华所吩咐摩西的，与米甸人打仗，杀了所有的男丁。
verses.textEnNiv: They fought against Midian, as the Lord commanded Moses, and killed every man.
verses.textEnEsv: They warred against Midian, as the Lord commanded Moses, and killed every male.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they warred against the Midianites, just as the Lord commanded Moses, and they killed all the males.
verses.textEnNlt: They attacked Midian as the Lord had commanded Moses, and they killed all the men.
verses.textEnNasb: So they made war against Midian, just as the Lord had commanded Moses, and they killed every male.
verses.textEn: They fought against Midian, as the Lord commanded Moses, and killed every man.

verses.textZh: 在那些被杀的人以外，还杀了米甸的五个王，就是以未、利金、苏珥、户珥和利巴；又用刀杀了比珥的儿子巴兰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那些被杀的人以外，还杀了米甸的五个王，就是以未、利金、苏珥、户珥和利巴；又用刀杀了比珥的儿子巴兰。
verses.textZhCuv: 在所杀的人中，杀了米甸的五王，就是以未、利金、苏珥、户珥、利巴，又用刀杀了比珥的儿子巴兰。
verses.textEnNiv: Among their victims were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur and Reba—the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. And they also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: They killed the kings of Midian with therestof those who were killed— Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. Balaam the son of Beor they also killed with the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: All five of the Midianite kings—Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba—died in the battle. They also killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword.
verses.textEnNasb: They killed the kings of Midian along with the rest of those killed: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.
verses.textEn: Among their victims were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur and Reba—the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword.

verses.textZh: 以色列人掳了米甸人的妇女、孩子；又掳掠了他们所有的牲畜、羊群和财物；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人掳了米甸人的妇女、孩子；又掳掠了他们所有的牲畜、羊群和财物；
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人掳了米甸人的妇女孩子，并将他们的牲畜、羊群，和所有的财物都夺了来，当作掳物，
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites captured the Midianite women and children and took all the Midianite herds, flocks and goods as plunder.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel took captive the women of Midian and their little ones, and they took as plunder all their cattle, their flocks, and all their goods.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Israel took the women of Midian captive, with their little ones, and took as spoil all their cattle, all their flocks, and all their goods.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Israelite army captured the Midianite women and children and seized their cattle and flocks and all their wealth as plunder.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Israel took captive the women of Midian and their little ones; and they plundered all their cattle, all their flocks, and all their property.
verses.textEn: The Israelites captured the Midianite women and children and took all the Midianite herds, flocks and goods as plunder.

verses.textZh: 并用火烧了他们所住地方的一切城市和营寨；
verses.textZhCnvs: 并用火烧了他们所住地方的一切城市和营寨；
verses.textZhCuv: 又用火焚烧他们所住的城邑和所有的营寨，
verses.textEnNiv: They burned all the towns where the Midianites had settled, as well as all their camps.
verses.textEnEsv: All their cities in the places where they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire,
verses.textEnNkjv: They also burned with fire all the cities where they dwelt, and all their forts.
verses.textEnNlt: They burned all the towns and villages where the Midianites had lived.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they burned all their cities where they lived and all their encampments.
verses.textEn: They burned all the towns where the Midianites had settled, as well as all their camps.

verses.textZh: 把一切夺来的和掳掠的，连人带牲畜都带走；
verses.textZhCnvs: 把一切夺来的和掳掠的，连人带牲畜都带走；
verses.textZhCuv: 把一切所夺的、所掳的，连人带牲畜都带了去，
verses.textEnNiv: They took all the plunder and spoils, including the people and animals,
verses.textEnEsv: and took all the spoil and all the plunder, both of man and of beast.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they took all the spoil and all the booty—of man and beast.
verses.textEnNlt: After they had gathered the plunder and captives, both people and animals,
verses.textEnNasb: And they took all the plunder and all the spoils, both of people and of livestock.
verses.textEn: They took all the plunder and spoils, including the people and animals,

verses.textZh: 他们把俘掳的人和掳来的，以及夺来的东西，都带到摩押平原，约旦河边，和耶利哥相对的营地那里，交给摩西和以利亚撒祭司，以及以色列的会众。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把俘掳的人和掳来的，以及夺来的东西，都带到摩押平原，约旦河边，和耶利哥相对的营地那里，交给摩西和以利亚撒祭司，以及以色列的会众。
verses.textZhCuv: 将所掳的人，所夺的牲畜、财物，都带到摩押平原，在约旦河边与耶利哥相对的营盘，交给摩西和祭司以利亚撒，并以色列的会众。
verses.textEnNiv: and brought the captives, spoils and plunder to Moses and Eleazar the priest and the Israelite assembly at their camp on the plains of Moab, by the Jordan across from Jericho.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they brought the captives and the plunder and the spoil to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the people of Israel, at the camp on the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they brought the captives, the booty, and the spoil to Moses, to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp in the plains of Moab by the Jordan, acrossfrom Jericho.
verses.textEnNlt: they brought them all to Moses and Eleazar the priest, and to the whole community of Israel, which was camped on the plains of Moab beside the Jordan River, across from Jericho.
verses.textEnNasb: They brought the captives and the spoils and the plunder to Moses, to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the sons of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab which are by the Jordan, opposite Jericho.
verses.textEn: and brought the captives, spoils and plunder to Moses and Eleazar the priest and the Israelite assembly at their camp on the plains of Moab, by the Jordan across from Jericho.

verses.textZh: 摩西和以利亚撒祭司，以及会众所有的领袖，都出到营外迎接他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西和以利亚撒祭司，以及会众所有的领袖，都出到营外迎接他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西和祭司以利亚撒，并会众一切的首领，都出到营外迎接他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses, Eleazar the priest and all the leaders of the community went to meet them outside the camp.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses and Eleazar the priest and all the chiefs of the congregation went to meet them outside the camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses, Eleazar the priest, and all the leaders of the congregation, went to meet them outside the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses, Eleazar the priest, and all the leaders of the community went to meet them outside the camp.
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses, Eleazar the priest, and all the leaders of the congregation went out to meet them outside the camp.
verses.textEn: Moses, Eleazar the priest and all the leaders of the community went to meet them outside the camp.

verses.textZh: 摩西对作战回来的军官，就是对千夫长和百夫长发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对作战回来的军官，就是对千夫长和百夫长发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西向打仗回来的军长，就是千夫长、百夫长，发怒，
verses.textEnNiv: Moses was angry with the officers of the army—the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds—who returned from the battle.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the commanders of thousands and the commanders of hundreds, who had come from service in the war.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Moses was angry with the officers of the army, with the captains over thousands and captains over hundreds, who had come from the battle.
verses.textEnNlt: But Moses was furious with all the generals and captains who had returned from the battle.
verses.textEnNasb: But Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the commanders of thousands and the commanders of hundreds, who had come from service in the war.
verses.textEn: Moses was angry with the officers of the army—the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds—who returned from the battle.

verses.textZh: 摩西对他们说："你们让这些妇女存活吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对他们说："你们让这些妇女存活吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 对他们说：「你们要存留这一切妇女的活命吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Have you allowed all the women to live?" he asked them.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses said to them, "Have you let all the women live?
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said to them: "Have you kept all the women alive?
verses.textEnNlt: "Why have you let all the women live?" he demanded.
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses said to them, "Have you spared all the women?
verses.textEn: "Have you allowed all the women to live?" he asked them.

verses.textZh: 看哪，这些妇女因巴兰的计谋，使以色列人在毘珥的事上，得罪耶和华，以致瘟疫临到耶和华的会众身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，这些妇女因巴兰的计谋，使以色列人在毘珥的事上，得罪耶和华，以致瘟疫临到耶和华的会众身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些妇女因巴兰的计谋，叫以色列人在毗珥的事上得罪耶和华，以致耶和华的会众遭遇瘟疫。
verses.textEnNiv: "They were the ones who followed Balaam’s advice and enticed the Israelites to be unfaithful to the Lord in the Peor incident, so that a plague struck the Lord ’s people.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, these, on Balaam’s advice, caused the people of Israel to act treacherously against the Lord in the incident of Peor, and so the plague came among the congregation of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Look, these women caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to trespass against the Lord in the incident of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "These are the very ones who followed Balaam’s advice and caused the people of Israel to rebel against the Lord at Mount Peor. They are the ones who caused the plague to strike the Lord ’s people.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, they caused the sons of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to be unfaithful to the Lord in the matter of Peor, so that the plague took place among the congregation of the Lord!
verses.textEn: "They were the ones who followed Balaam’s advice and enticed the Israelites to be unfaithful to the Lord in the Peor incident, so that a plague struck the Lord ’s people.

verses.textZh: 现在你们要把所有的男孩都杀了，也要杀死所有与男人发生过关系的妇人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们要把所有的男孩都杀了，也要杀死所有与男人发生过关系的妇人。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们要把一切的男孩和所有已嫁的女子都杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: Now kill all the boys. And kill every woman who has slept with a man,
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore, kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known a man intimately.
verses.textEnNlt: So kill all the boys and all the women who have had intercourse with a man.
verses.textEnNasb: Now therefore, kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known a man intimately.
verses.textEn: Now kill all the boys. And kill every woman who has slept with a man,

verses.textZh: 但女孩子中，没有与男人发生过关系的，你们都可以让她们活着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但女孩子中，没有与男人发生过关系的，你们都可以让她们活着。
verses.textZhCuv: 但女孩子中，凡没有出嫁的，你们都可以存留她的活命。
verses.textEnNiv: but save for yourselves every girl who has never slept with a man.
verses.textEnEsv: But all the young girls who have not known man by lying with him keep alive for yourselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: But keep alive for yourselves all the young girls who have not known a man intimately.
verses.textEnNlt: Only the young girls who are virgins may live; you may keep them for yourselves.
verses.textEnNasb: However, all the girls who have not known a man intimately, keep alive for yourselves.
verses.textEn: but save for yourselves every girl who has never slept with a man.

verses.textZh: 你们要在营外驻扎七天，杀过人的和摸过死尸的，第三日和第七日都要洁净自己，你们和你们掳来的人都要这样行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要在营外驻扎七天，杀过人的和摸过死尸的，第三日和第七日都要洁净自己，你们和你们掳来的人都要这样行。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要在营外驻扎七日；凡杀了人的，和一切摸了被杀的，并你们所掳来的人口，第三日，第七日，都要洁净自己，
verses.textEnNiv: "Anyone who has killed someone or touched someone who was killed must stay outside the camp seven days. On the third and seventh days you must purify yourselves and your captives.
verses.textEnEsv: Encamp outside the camp seven days. Whoever of you has killed any person and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves and your captives on the third day and on the seventh day.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as for you, remain outside the camp seven days; whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves and your captives on the third day and on the seventh day.
verses.textEnNlt: And all of you who have killed anyone or touched a dead body must stay outside the camp for seven days. You must purify yourselves and your captives on the third and seventh days.
verses.textEnNasb: And as for you, camp outside the camp for seven days; whoever has killed a person and whoever has touched anyone killed, purify yourselves, you and your captives, on the third day and on the seventh day.
verses.textEn: "Anyone who has killed someone or touched someone who was killed must stay outside the camp seven days. On the third and seventh days you must purify yourselves and your captives.

verses.textZh: 你们也要洁净一切衣服、皮具、山羊毛织的物和木器。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们也要洁净一切衣服、皮具、山羊毛织的物和木器。"
verses.textZhCuv: 也要因一切的衣服、皮物、山羊毛织的物，和各样的木器，洁净自己。」
verses.textEnNiv: Purify every garment as well as everything made of leather, goat hair or wood."
verses.textEnEsv: You shall purify every garment, every article of skin, all work of goats’ hair, and every article of wood."
verses.textEnNkjv: Purify every garment, everything made of leather, everything woven of goats’ hair, and everything made of wood."
verses.textEnNlt: Purify all your clothing, too, and everything made of leather, goat hair, or wood."
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall purify for yourselves every garment, every article of leather, every work of goats’ hair, and every article of wood."
verses.textEn: Purify every garment as well as everything made of leather, goat hair or wood."

verses.textZh: 以利亚撒祭司对打仗回来的兵丁说："这是耶和华吩咐摩西的律例：
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚撒祭司对打仗回来的兵丁说："这是耶和华吩咐摩西的律例：
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司以利亚撒对打仗回来的兵丁说：「耶和华所吩咐摩西律法中的条例乃是这样：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Eleazar the priest said to the soldiers who had gone into battle, "This is what is required by the law that the Lord gave Moses:
verses.textEnEsv: Then Eleazar the priest said to the men in the army who had gone to battle: "This is the statute of the law that the Lord has commanded Moses:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who had gone to the battle, "This is the ordinance of the law which the Lord commanded Moses:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Eleazar the priest said to the men who were in the battle, "The Lord has given Moses this legal requirement:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who had gone to battle, "This is the statute of the Law which the Lord has commanded Moses:
verses.textEn: Then Eleazar the priest said to the soldiers who had gone into battle, "This is what is required by the law that the Lord gave Moses:

verses.textZh: 金、银、铜、铁、锡、铅，
verses.textZhCnvs: 金、银、铜、铁、锡、铅，
verses.textZhCuv: 金、银、铜、铁、锡、铅，
verses.textEnNiv: Gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, lead
verses.textEnEsv: only the gold, the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
verses.textEnNkjv: Only the gold, the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
verses.textEnNlt: Anything made of gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, or lead—
verses.textEnNasb: only the gold and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
verses.textEn: Gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, lead

verses.textZh: 能够经火的东西，你们都要使它经火，它就洁净了，但还要用除污水洁净它；不能经火的，你们要使它经过水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 能够经火的东西，你们都要使它经火，它就洁净了，但还要用除污水洁净它；不能经火的，你们要使它经过水。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡能见火的，你们要叫它经火就为洁净，然而还要用除污秽的水洁净它；凡不能见火的，你们要叫它过水。
verses.textEnNiv: and anything else that can withstand fire must be put through the fire, and then it will be clean. But it must also be purified with the water of cleansing. And whatever cannot withstand fire must be put through that water.
verses.textEnEsv: everything that can stand the fire, you shall pass through the fire, and it shall be clean. Nevertheless, it shall also be purified with the water for impurity. And whatever cannot stand the fire, you shall pass through the water.
verses.textEnNkjv: everything that can endure fire, you shall put through the fire, and it shall be clean; and it shall be purified with the water of purification. But all that cannot endure fire you shall put through water.
verses.textEnNlt: that is, all metals that do not burn—must be passed through fire in order to be made ceremonially pure. These metal objects must then be further purified with the water of purification. But everything that burns must be purified by the water alone.
verses.textEnNasb: everything that can withstand the fire, you shall pass through the fire, and it will be clean, only it shall be purified with water for impurity. But whatever cannot withstand the fire you shall pass through the water.
verses.textEn: and anything else that can withstand fire must be put through the fire, and then it will be clean. But it must also be purified with the water of cleansing. And whatever cannot withstand fire must be put through that water.

verses.textZh: 第七日，你们要洗衣服，就为洁净；然后才可以进营。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 第七日，你们要洗衣服，就为洁净；然后才可以进营。"
verses.textZhCuv: 第七日，你们要洗衣服，就为洁净，然后可以进营。」
verses.textEnNiv: On the seventh day wash your clothes and you will be clean. Then you may come into the camp."
verses.textEnEsv: You must wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. And afterward you may come into the camp."
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall wash your clothes on the seventh day and be clean, and afterward you may come into the camp."
verses.textEnNlt: On the seventh day you must wash your clothes and be purified. Then you may return to the camp."
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall wash your clothes on the seventh day and you will be clean; and afterward you may enter the camp."
verses.textEn: On the seventh day wash your clothes and you will be clean. Then you may come into the camp."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你和以利亚撒祭司，以及会众的各族长，要计算俘掳的人和掠得的牲畜的总数。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你和以利亚撒祭司，以及会众的各族长，要计算俘掳的人和掠得的牲畜的总数。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你和祭司以利亚撒，并会众的各族长，要计算所掳来的人口和牲畜的总数。
verses.textEnNiv: "You and Eleazar the priest and the family heads of the community are to count all the people and animals that were captured.
verses.textEnEsv: "Take the count of the plunder that was taken, both of man and of beast, you and Eleazar the priest and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the congregation,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Count up the plunder that was taken—of man and beast—you and Eleazar the priest and the chief fathers of the congregation;
verses.textEnNlt: "You and Eleazar the priest and the family leaders of each tribe are to make a list of all the plunder taken in the battle, including the people and animals.
verses.textEnNasb: "You and Eleazar the priest and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation take a count of the spoils that were captured, both of people and of livestock;
verses.textEn: "You and Eleazar the priest and the family heads of the community are to count all the people and animals that were captured.

verses.textZh: 你要把掠夺得的分为两半，一半给出去打仗的人，一半给全体会众。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把掠夺得的分为两半，一半给出去打仗的人，一半给全体会众。
verses.textZhCuv: 把所掳来的分作两半：一半归与出去打仗的精兵，一半归与全会众。
verses.textEnNiv: Divide the spoils equally between the soldiers who took part in the battle and the rest of the community.
verses.textEnEsv: and divide the plunder into two parts between the warriors who went out to battle and all the congregation.
verses.textEnNkjv: and divide the plunder into two parts, between those who took part in the war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.
verses.textEnNlt: Then divide the plunder into two parts, and give half to the men who fought the battle and half to the rest of the people.
verses.textEnNasb: and divide the spoils between the warriors who went to battle and all the congregation.
verses.textEn: Divide the spoils equally between the soldiers who took part in the battle and the rest of the community.

verses.textZh: 你又要从出去打仗的人所得的，无论是人、牛、驴，或羊群之中，抽出五百分之一作贡物奉给耶和华；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你又要从出去打仗的人所得的，无论是人、牛、驴，或羊群之中，抽出五百分之一作贡物奉给耶和华；
verses.textZhCuv: 又要从出去打仗所得的人口、牛、驴、羊群中，每五百取一，作为贡物奉给耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: From the soldiers who fought in the battle, set apart as tribute for the Lord one out of every five hundred, whether people, cattle, donkeys or sheep.
verses.textEnEsv: And levy for the Lord a tribute from the men of war who went out to battle, one out of five hundred, of the people and of the oxen and of the donkeys and of the flocks.
verses.textEnNkjv: And levy a tribute for the Lord on the men of war who went out to battle: one of every five hundred of the persons, the cattle, the donkeys, and the sheep;
verses.textEnNlt: From the army’s portion, first give the Lord his share of the plunder—one of every 500 of the prisoners and of the cattle, donkeys, sheep, and goats.
verses.textEnNasb: Also, collect a tribute tax for the Lord from the men of war who went to battle, one in five hundred of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the sheep;
verses.textEn: From the soldiers who fought in the battle, set apart as tribute for the Lord one out of every five hundred, whether people, cattle, donkeys or sheep.

verses.textZh: 你们要从他们那一半中抽出，交给以利亚撒祭司，作耶和华的举祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要从他们那一半中抽出，交给以利亚撒祭司，作耶和华的举祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 从他们一半之中，要取出来交给祭司以利亚撒，作为耶和华的举祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Take this tribute from their half share and give it to Eleazar the priest as the Lord ’s part.
verses.textEnEsv: Take it from their half and give it to Eleazar the priest as a contribution to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest as a heave offering to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Give this share of the army’s half to Eleazar the priest as an offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: take it from their half and give it to Eleazar the priest, as an offering to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Take this tribute from their half share and give it to Eleazar the priest as the Lord ’s part.

verses.textZh: 从以色列人那一半中，无论是人、牛、驴、羊群，或是各样牲畜，都要抽出五十分之一，交给负责看守耶和华帐幕的利未人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 从以色列人那一半中，无论是人、牛、驴、羊群，或是各样牲畜，都要抽出五十分之一，交给负责看守耶和华帐幕的利未人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 从以色列人的一半之中，就是从人口、牛、驴、羊群、各样牲畜中，每五十取一，交给看守耶和华帐幕的利未人。」
verses.textEnNiv: From the Israelites’ half, select one out of every fifty, whether people, cattle, donkeys, sheep or other animals. Give them to the Levites, who are responsible for the care of the Lord ’s tabernacle."
verses.textEnEsv: And from the people of Israel’s half you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the people, of the oxen, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the cattle, and give them to the Levites who keep guard over the tabernacle of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: And from the children of Israel’s half you shall take one of every fifty, drawn from the persons, the cattle, the donkeys, and the sheep, from all the livestock, and give them to the Levites who keep charge of the tabernacle of the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: From the half that belongs to the people of Israel, take one of every fifty of the prisoners and of the cattle, donkeys, sheep, goats, and other animals. Give this share to the Levites, who are in charge of maintaining the Lord ’s Tabernacle."
verses.textEnNasb: And from the sons of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn from every fifty of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the sheep, from all the animals; and give them to the Levites who perform the duty of the tabernacle of the Lord."
verses.textEn: From the Israelites’ half, select one out of every fifty, whether people, cattle, donkeys, sheep or other animals. Give them to the Levites, who are responsible for the care of the Lord ’s tabernacle."

verses.textZh: 于是，摩西和以利亚撒祭司照着耶和华吩咐摩西的行了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，摩西和以利亚撒祭司照着耶和华吩咐摩西的行了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是摩西和祭司以利亚撒照耶和华所吩咐摩西的行了。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: Moses and Eleazar the priest did just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: So Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 掠得的东西，就是打仗的人所掳掠剩下来的，共有羊六十七万五千只，
verses.textZhCnvs: 掠得的东西，就是打仗的人所掳掠剩下来的，共有羊六十七万五千只，
verses.textZhCuv: 除了兵丁所夺的财物以外，所掳来的：羊六十七万五千只；
verses.textEnNiv: The plunder remaining from the spoils that the soldiers took was 675,000 sheep,
verses.textEnEsv: Now the plunder remaining of the spoil that the army took was 675,000 sheep,
verses.textEnNkjv: The booty remaining from the plunder, which the men of war had taken, was six hundred and seventy-five thousand sheep,
verses.textEnNlt: The plunder remaining from everything the fighting men had taken totaled 675,000 sheep and goats,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the spoils that remained from the plunder which the men of war had plundered was 675,000 sheep,
verses.textEn: The plunder remaining from the spoils that the soldiers took was 675,000 sheep,

verses.textZh: 牛七万二千头，
verses.textZhCnvs: 牛七万二千头，
verses.textZhCuv: 牛七万二千只；
verses.textEnNiv: 72,000 cattle,
verses.textEnEsv: 72,000 cattle,
verses.textEnNkjv: seventy-two thousand cattle,
verses.textEnNlt: 72,000 cattle,
verses.textEnNasb: seventy-two thousand cattle,

verses.textZhCnvs: 驴六万一千头，
verses.textZhCuv: 驴六万一千匹；
verses.textEnNiv: 61,000 donkeys
verses.textEnEsv: 61,000 donkeys,
verses.textEnNkjv: sixty-one thousand donkeys,
verses.textEnNlt: 61,000 donkeys,
verses.textEnNasb: sixty-one thousand donkeys,
verses.textEn: 61,000 donkeys

verses.textZh: 没有与男人发生过关系的妇人三万二千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有与男人发生过关系的妇人三万二千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 女人共三万二千口，都是没有出嫁的。
verses.textEnNiv: and 32,000 women who had never slept with a man.
verses.textEnEsv: and 32,000 persons in all, women who had not known man by lying with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of women who had not known a man intimately.
verses.textEnNlt: and 32,000 virgin girls.
verses.textEnNasb: and of captive people, of the women who had not known a man intimately, in all were thirty-two thousand people.
verses.textEn: and 32,000 women who had never slept with a man.

verses.textZh: 出去打仗的人的分，就是他们所得的那一半，羊共有三十三万七千五百只；

verses.textEn: The half share of those who fought in the battle was: 337,500 sheep,

verses.textZhCuv: 从其中归耶和华为贡物的，有六百七十五只；

verses.textEnEsv: and the Lord ’s tribute of sheep was 675.

verses.textEn: 30,500 donkeys, of which the tribute for the Lord was 61;

verses.textZh: 人口一万六千，归给耶和华作贡物的，有三十二人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人口一万六千，归给耶和华作贡物的，有三十二人。
verses.textZhCuv: 人一万六千口，从其中归耶和华的，有三十二口。
verses.textEnNiv: 16,000 people, of whom the tribute for the Lord was 32.
verses.textEnEsv: The persons were 16,000, of which the Lord ’s tribute was 32 persons.
verses.textEnNkjv: The persons were sixteen thousand, of which the Lord’s tribute was thirty-two persons.
verses.textEnNlt: and 16,000 virgin girls, of whom 32 were the Lord ’s share.
verses.textEnNasb: and the captive people were sixteen thousand, from whom the Lord’s tribute tax was thirty-two persons.
verses.textEn: 16,000 people, of whom the tribute for the Lord was 32.

verses.textZh: 摩西照着耶和华吩咐他的，把贡物，就是耶和华的举祭，交给以利亚撒祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西照着耶和华吩咐他的，把贡物，就是耶和华的举祭，交给以利亚撒祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西把贡物，就是归与耶和华的举祭，交给祭司以利亚撒，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。

verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses gave the tribute whichwas the Lord’s heave offering to Eleazar the priest, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses gave all the Lord ’s share to Eleazar the priest, just as the Lord had directed him.
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses gave the tribute tax, which was the Lord’s offering, to Eleazar the priest, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: Moses gave the tribute to Eleazar the priest as the Lord ’s part, as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 以色列人所得的那一半，就是摩西从打仗的人取来分给他们的 ；

verses.textEnNasb: As for the sons of Israel’s half, which Moses separated from the men who had gone to war—
verses.textEn: The half belonging to the Israelites, which Moses set apart from that of the fighting men—

verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西照着耶和华吩咐他的，从属于以色列人的那一半，无论是人口或是牲畜，都抽出五十分之一，交给负责看守耶和华帐幕的利未人。

verses.textZh: 摩西和以利亚撒祭司就收了他们的金子，就是各样金子做成的器皿。

verses.textEnNiv: From the Israelites’ half, Moses selected one out of every fifty people and animals, as the Lord commanded him, and gave them to the Levites, who were responsible for the care of the Lord ’s tabernacle.

verses.textEnNlt: So we are presenting the items of gold we captured as an offering to the Lord from our share of the plunder—armbands, bracelets, rings, earrings, and necklaces. This will purify our lives before the Lord and make us right with him. "

verses.textEn: The Lord ’s anger burned against Israel and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until the whole generation of those who had done evil in his sight was gone.

verses.textZh: 现在，你们这些罪人的族类，也来接替你们的先祖，增添耶和华对以色列的烈怒！
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，你们这些罪人的族类，也来接替你们的先祖，增添耶和华对以色列的烈怒！
verses.textZhCuv: 谁知，你们起来接续先祖，增添罪人的数目，使耶和华向以色列大发烈怒。
verses.textEnNiv: "And here you are, a brood of sinners, standing in the place of your fathers and making the Lord even more angry with Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, you have risen in your fathers’ place, a brood of sinful men, to increase still more the fierce anger of the Lord against Israel!
verses.textEnNkjv: And look! You have risen in your fathers’ place, a brood of sinful men, to increase still more the fierce anger of the Lord against Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: But here you are, a brood of sinners, doing exactly the same thing! You are making the Lord even angrier with Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, born of sinful men, to add still more to the burning anger of the Lord against Israel.
verses.textEn: "And here you are, a brood of sinners, standing in the place of your fathers and making the Lord even more angry with Israel.

verses.textZh: 如果你们转离，不跟从他，他再要把以色列人撇在旷野，这样，你们就要把整个民族都毁灭了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们转离，不跟从他，他再要把以色列人撇在旷野，这样，你们就要把整个民族都毁灭了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若退后不跟从他，他还要把以色列人撇在旷野，便是你们使这众民灭亡。」
verses.textEnNiv: If you turn away from following him, he will again leave all this people in the wilderness, and you will be the cause of their destruction."
verses.textEnEsv: For if you turn away from following him, he will again abandon them in the wilderness, and you will destroy all this people."
verses.textEnNkjv: For if you turn away from following Him, He will once again leave them in the wilderness, and you will destroy all these people."
verses.textEnNlt: If you turn away from him like this and he abandons them again in the wilderness, you will be responsible for destroying this entire nation!"
verses.textEnNasb: For if you turn away from following Him, He will once more leave them in the wilderness, and you will destroy all these people."
verses.textEn: If you turn away from following him, he will again leave all this people in the wilderness, and you will be the cause of their destruction."

verses.textZh: 两支派的人走到摩西跟前，对他说："我们要在这里给我们的牲畜筑羊圈，给我们的孩子建城邑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 两支派的人走到摩西跟前，对他说："我们要在这里给我们的牲畜筑羊圈，给我们的孩子建城邑。
verses.textZhCuv: 两支派的人挨近摩西，说：「我们要在这里为牲畜垒圈，为妇人孩子造城。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they came up to him and said, "We would like to build pens here for our livestock and cities for our women and children.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they came near to him and said, "We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they came near to him and said: "We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones,
verses.textEnNlt: But they approached Moses and said, "We simply want to build pens for our livestock and fortified towns for our wives and children.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they approached him and said, "We will build sheepfolds for our livestock here and cities for our little ones;
verses.textEn: Then they came up to him and said, "We would like to build pens here for our livestock and cities for our women and children.

verses.textZh: 我们自己却要武装起来，行在以色列人前头上阵，直到把他们领到他们自己的地方，但我们的孩子因为这地居民的缘故，要住在坚固的城里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们自己却要武装起来，行在以色列人前头上阵，直到把他们领到他们自己的地方，但我们的孩子因为这地居民的缘故，要住在坚固的城里。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们自己要带兵器行在以色列人的前头，好把他们领到他们的地方；但我们的妇人孩子，因这地居民的缘故，要住在坚固的城内。
verses.textEnNiv: But we will arm ourselves for battle and go ahead of the Israelites until we have brought them to their place. Meanwhile our women and children will live in fortified cities, for protection from the inhabitants of the land.
verses.textEnEsv: but we will take up arms, ready to go before the people of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. And our little ones shall live in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: but we ourselves will be armed, ready togo before the children of Israel until we have brought them to their place; and our little ones will dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Then we will arm ourselves and lead our fellow Israelites into battle until we have brought them safely to their land. Meanwhile, our families will stay in the fortified towns we build here, so they will be safe from any attacks by the local people.
verses.textEnNasb: but we ourselves will be armed, hurrying ahead of the sons of Israel, until we have brought them to their place, while our little ones live in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.textEn: But we will arm ourselves for battle and go ahead of the Israelites until we have brought them to their place. Meanwhile our women and children will live in fortified cities, for protection from the inhabitants of the land.

verses.textZh: 我们决不回家，直等到以色列人各自承受了产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们决不回家，直等到以色列人各自承受了产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们不回家，直等到以色列人各承受自己的产业。
verses.textEnNiv: We will not return to our homes until each of the Israelites has received their inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: We will not return to our homes until each of the people of Israel has gained his inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: We will not return to our homes until every one of the children of Israel has received his inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: We will not return to our homes until all the people of Israel have received their portions of land.
verses.textEnNasb: We will not return to our homes until every one of the sons of Israel has gained possession of his inheritance.
verses.textEn: We will not return to our homes until each of the Israelites has received their inheritance.

verses.textZh: 我们不与他们在约旦河西边之地同受产业，因为我们的产业是坐落在约旦河东边。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们不与他们在约旦河西边之地同受产业，因为我们的产业是坐落在约旦河东边。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们不和他们在约旦河那边一带之地同受产业，因为我们的产业是坐落在约旦河东边这里。」
verses.textEnNiv: We will not receive any inheritance with them on the other side of the Jordan, because our inheritance has come to us on the east side of the Jordan."
verses.textEnEsv: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan to the east."
verses.textEnNkjv: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has fallen to us on this eastern side of the Jordan."
verses.textEnNlt: But we do not claim any of the land on the other side of the Jordan. We would rather live here on the east side and accept this as our grant of land."
verses.textEnNasb: But we will not have an inheritance with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan toward the east."
verses.textEn: We will not receive any inheritance with them on the other side of the Jordan, because our inheritance has come to us on the east side of the Jordan."

verses.textZh: 摩西对他们说："如果你们这样行，在耶和华面前武装起来去作战，
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西对他们说："如果你们这样行，在耶和华面前武装起来去作战，
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西对他们说：「你们若这样行，在耶和华面前带着兵器出去打仗，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses said to them, "If you will do this—if you will arm yourselves before the Lord for battle
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses said to them, "If you will do this, if you will take up arms to go before the Lord for the war,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses said to them: "If you do this thing, if you arm yourselves before the Lord for the war,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses said, "If you keep your word and arm yourselves for the Lord ’s battles,
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses said to them, "If you will do this, if you will arm yourselves before the Lord for the war,
verses.textEn: Then Moses said to them, "If you will do this—if you will arm yourselves before the Lord for battle

verses.textZh: 你们所有武装起来的人，都要在耶和华面前过约旦河，直到他把他的仇敌从自己面前赶出去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们所有武装起来的人，都要在耶和华面前过约旦河，直到他把他的仇敌从自己面前赶出去，
verses.textZhCuv: 所有带兵器的人都要在耶和华面前过约旦河，等他赶出他的仇敌，
verses.textEnNiv: and if all of you who are armed cross over the Jordan before the Lord until he has driven his enemies out before him—
verses.textEnEsv: and every armed man of you will pass over the Jordan before the Lord , until he has driven out his enemies from before him
verses.textEnNkjv: and all your armed men cross over the Jordan before the Lord until He has driven out His enemies from before Him,
verses.textEnNlt: and if your troops cross the Jordan and keep fighting until the Lord has driven out his enemies,
verses.textEnNasb: and all of you armed men cross over the Jordan before the Lord until He has driven His enemies out from Him,
verses.textEn: and if all of you who are armed cross over the Jordan before the Lord until he has driven his enemies out before him—

verses.textZh: 直到那地在耶和华面前被征服了，然后才回家，这样你们对耶和华和对以色列就算无罪，这地也可以在耶和华面前归你们作产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 直到那地在耶和华面前被征服了，然后才回家，这样你们对耶和华和对以色列就算无罪，这地也可以在耶和华面前归你们作产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 那地被耶和华制伏了，然后你们可以回来，向耶和华和以色列才为无罪，这地也必在耶和华面前归你们为业。
verses.textEnNiv: then when the land is subdued before the Lord , you may return and be free from your obligation to the Lord and to Israel. And this land will be your possession before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: and the land is subdued before the Lord ; then after that you shall return and be free of obligation to the Lord and to Israel, and this land shall be your possession before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: and the land is subdued before the Lord, then afterward you may return and be blameless before the Lord and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: then you may return when the Lord has conquered the land. You will have fulfilled your duty to the Lord and to the rest of the people of Israel. And the land on the east side of the Jordan will be your property from the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: and the land is subdued before the Lord, then afterward you may return and be free of obligation toward the Lord and toward Israel, and this land shall be yours as property before the Lord.
verses.textEn: then when the land is subdued before the Lord , you may return and be free from your obligation to the Lord and to Israel. And this land will be your possession before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 如果你们不这样行，就得罪了耶和华；你们要知道你们的罪必追上你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们不这样行，就得罪了耶和华；你们要知道你们的罪必追上你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若你们不这样行，就得罪耶和华，要知道你们的罪必追上你们。
verses.textEnNiv: "But if you fail to do this, you will be sinning against the Lord ; and you may be sure that your sin will find you out.
verses.textEnEsv: But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against the Lord , and be sure your sin will find you out.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you do not do so, then take note, you have sinned against the Lord; and be sure your sin will find you out.
verses.textEnNlt: But if you fail to keep your word, then you will have sinned against the Lord , and you may be sure that your sin will find you out.
verses.textEnNasb: But if you do not do so, behold, you have sinned against the Lord, and be sure that your sin will find you out.
verses.textEn: "But if you fail to do this, you will be sinning against the Lord ; and you may be sure that your sin will find you out.

verses.textZh: 现在你们只管照你们口中所出的话去行，为你们的孩子建城，为你们的羊群筑圈。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们只管照你们口中所出的话去行，为你们的孩子建城，为你们的羊群筑圈。"
verses.textZhCuv: 如今你们口中所出的，只管去行，为你们的妇人孩子造城，为你们的羊群垒圈。」
verses.textEnNiv: Build cities for your women and children, and pens for your flocks, but do what you have promised."
verses.textEnEsv: Build cities for your little ones and folds for your sheep, and do what you have promised."
verses.textEnNkjv: Build cities for your little ones and folds for your sheep, and do what has proceeded out of your mouth."
verses.textEnNlt: Go ahead and build towns for your families and pens for your flocks, but do everything you have promised."
verses.textEnNasb: Build yourselves cities for your little ones, and sheepfolds for your sheep, and do what you have promised."
verses.textEn: Build cities for your women and children, and pens for your flocks, but do what you have promised."

verses.textZh: 迦得子孙和流本子孙告诉摩西："你仆人必照着我主吩咐的去行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦得子孙和流本子孙告诉摩西："你仆人必照着我主吩咐的去行。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦得子孙和吕便子孙对摩西说：「仆人要照我主所吩咐的去行。
verses.textEnNiv: The Gadites and Reubenites said to Moses, "We your servants will do as our lord commands.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Gad and the people of Reuben said to Moses, "Your servants will do as my lord commands.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying: "Your servants will do as my lord commands.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the men of Gad and Reuben replied, "We, your servants, will follow your instructions exactly.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, "Your servants will do just as my lord commands.
verses.textEn: The Gadites and Reubenites said to Moses, "We your servants will do as our lord commands.

verses.textZh: 我们的孩子、妻子、羊群和所有的牲畜，都要留在基列的各城；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的孩子、妻子、羊群和所有的牲畜，都要留在基列的各城；
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的妻子、孩子、羊群，和所有的牲畜都要留在基列的各城。
verses.textEnNiv: Our children and wives, our flocks and herds will remain here in the cities of Gilead.
verses.textEnEsv: Our little ones, our wives, our livestock, and all our cattle shall remain there in the cities of Gilead,
verses.textEnNkjv: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock will be there in the cities of Gilead;
verses.textEnNlt: Our children, wives, flocks, and cattle will stay here in the towns of Gilead.
verses.textEnNasb: Our little ones, our wives, our livestock, and all our cattle shall remain there in the cities of Gilead,
verses.textEn: Our children and wives, our flocks and herds will remain here in the cities of Gilead.

verses.textZh: 但你的仆人，所有武装起来预备打仗的，都要照着我主所说的，在耶和华面前过去作战。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你的仆人，所有武装起来预备打仗的，都要照着我主所说的，在耶和华面前过去作战。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但你的仆人，凡带兵器的，都要照我主所说的话，在耶和华面前过去打仗。」
verses.textEnNiv: But your servants, every man who is armed for battle, will cross over to fight before the Lord , just as our lord says."
verses.textEnEsv: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before the Lord to battle, as my lord orders."
verses.textEnNkjv: but your servants will cross over, every man armed for war, before the Lord to battle, just as my lord says."
verses.textEnNlt: But all who are able to bear arms will cross over to fight for the Lord , just as you have said."
verses.textEnNasb: while your servants, that is, everyone who is armed for war, cross over in the presence of the Lord to battle, just as my lord says."
verses.textEn: But your servants, every man who is armed for battle, will cross over to fight before the Lord , just as our lord says."

verses.textZh: 于是，摩西为了他们，嘱咐以利亚撒祭司和嫩的儿子约书亚，以及以色列众支派的族长，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，摩西为了他们，嘱咐以利亚撒祭司和嫩的儿子约书亚，以及以色列众支派的族长，
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，摩西为他们嘱咐祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列众支派的族长，说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses gave orders about them to Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun and to the family heads of the Israelite tribes.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moses gave command concerning them to Eleazar the priest and to Joshua the son of Nun and to the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses gave command concerning them to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses gave orders to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders of the clans of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses gave the command regarding them to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: Then Moses gave orders about them to Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun and to the family heads of the Israelite tribes.

verses.textZh: 对他们说："迦得的子孙和流本的子孙，所有武装起来，在耶和华面前预备去作战的人，如果与你们一同过约旦河，那地在你们面前被征服了，你们就要把基列地给他们作产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他们说："迦得的子孙和流本的子孙，所有武装起来，在耶和华面前预备去作战的人，如果与你们一同过约旦河，那地在你们面前被征服了，你们就要把基列地给他们作产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 「迦得子孙和吕便子孙，凡带兵器在耶和华面前去打仗的，若与你们一同过约旦河，那地被你们制伏了，你们就要把基列地给他们为业。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, "If the Gadites and Reubenites, every man armed for battle, cross over the Jordan with you before the Lord , then when the land is subdued before you, you must give them the land of Gilead as their possession.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses said to them, "If the people of Gad and the people of Reuben, every man who is armed to battle before the Lord , will pass with you over the Jordan and the land shall be subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses said to them: "If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben cross over the Jordan with you, every man armed for battle before the Lord, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead as a possession.
verses.textEnNlt: He said, "The men of Gad and Reuben who are armed for battle must cross the Jordan with you to fight for the Lord . If they do, give them the land of Gilead as their property when the land is conquered.
verses.textEnNasb: And Moses said to them, "If the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben, everyone who is armed for battle, cross with you over the Jordan in the presence of the Lord, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead as their property;
verses.textEn: He said to them, "If the Gadites and Reubenites, every man armed for battle, cross over the Jordan with you before the Lord , then when the land is subdued before you, you must give them the land of Gilead as their possession.

verses.textZh: 他们若是不武装起来，与你们一同过去，他们就要在迦南地在你们中间同得产业。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们若是不武装起来，与你们一同过去，他们就要在迦南地在你们中间同得产业。"
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若他们不带兵器和你们一同过去，就要在迦南地你们中间得产业。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if they do not cross over with you armed, they must accept their possession with you in Canaan."
verses.textEnEsv: However, if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan."
verses.textEnNkjv: But if they do not cross over armed with you, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan."
verses.textEnNlt: But if they refuse to arm themselves and cross over with you, then they must accept land with the rest of you in the land of Canaan."
verses.textEnNasb: but if they do not cross over with you armed, they shall instead be settled among you in the land of Canaan."
verses.textEn: But if they do not cross over with you armed, they must accept their possession with you in Canaan."

verses.textZh: 迦得的子孙和流本的子孙回答，说："耶和华怎样吩咐仆人，我们就怎样行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦得的子孙和流本的子孙回答，说："耶和华怎样吩咐仆人，我们就怎样行。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦得子孙和吕便子孙回答说：「耶和华怎样吩咐仆人，仆人就怎样行。
verses.textEnNiv: The Gadites and Reubenites answered, "Your servants will do what the Lord has said.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Gad and the people of Reuben answered, "What the Lord has said to your servants, we will do.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying: "As the Lord has said to your servants, so we will do.
verses.textEnNlt: The tribes of Gad and Reuben said again, "We are your servants, and we will do as the Lord has commanded!
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben answered, saying, "As the Lord has said to your servants, so we will do.
verses.textEn: The Gadites and Reubenites answered, "Your servants will do what the Lord has said.

verses.textZh: 我们要武装起来，在耶和华面前过河，到迦南地去；只是约旦河这边的地方，要归我们作产业。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们要武装起来，在耶和华面前过河，到迦南地去；只是约旦河这边的地方，要归我们作产业。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们要带兵器，在耶和华面前过去，进入迦南地，只是约旦河这边、我们所得为业之地仍归我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: We will cross over before the Lord into Canaan armed, but the property we inherit will be on this side of the Jordan."
verses.textEnEsv: We will pass over armed before the Lord into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan."
verses.textEnNkjv: We will cross over armed before the Lord into the land of Canaan, but the possession of our inheritance shallremain with us on this side of the Jordan."
verses.textEnNlt: We will cross the Jordan into Canaan fully armed to fight for the Lord , but our property will be here on this side of the Jordan."
verses.textEnNasb: We ourselves will cross over armed in the presence of the Lord into the land of Canaan, and the property of our inheritance shall remain with us across the Jordan."
verses.textEn: We will cross over before the Lord into Canaan armed, but the property we inherit will be on this side of the Jordan."

verses.textZh: 于是摩西把亚摩利王西宏的国，和巴珊王噩的国，连那地，和境内城市，以及那地周围的城市，都给了迦得的子孙、流本的子孙和约瑟的儿子玛拿西的半个支派。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是摩西把亚摩利王西宏的国，和巴珊王噩的国，连那地，和境内城市，以及那地周围的城市，都给了迦得的子孙、流本的子孙和约瑟的儿子玛拿西的半个支派。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西将亚摩利王西宏的国和巴珊王噩的国，连那地和周围的城邑，都给了迦得子孙和吕便子孙，并约瑟的儿子玛拿西半个支派。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moses gave to the Gadites, the Reubenites and the half-tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan—the whole land with its cities and the territory around them.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses gave to them, to the people of Gad and to the people of Reuben and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land and its cities with their territories, the cities of the land throughout the country.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses gave to the children of Gad, to the children of Reuben, and to half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land with its cities within the borders, the cities of the surrounding country.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses assigned land to the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph. He gave them the territory of King Sihon of the Amorites and the land of King Og of Bashan—the whole land with its cities and surrounding lands.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses gave to them, to the sons of Gad, the sons of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Joseph’s son Manasseh, the kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og, the king of Bashan, the land with its cities with their territories, the cities of the surrounding land.
verses.textEn: Then Moses gave to the Gadites, the Reubenites and the half-tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan—the whole land with its cities and the territory around them.

verses.textZh: 迦得的子孙修筑了底本、亚他录、亚罗珥、

verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Gad built Dibon and Ataroth and Aroer,
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Gad built the towns of Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
verses.textEn: The Gadites built up Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,

verses.textZh: 亚他录．朔反、雅谢、约比哈、
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚他录．朔反、雅谢、约比哈、
verses.textZhCuv: 亚他录‧朔反、雅谢、约比哈、

verses.textEnEsv: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
