verses.textEn: Atroth Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,

verses.textZh: 伯．宁拉、伯．哈兰这些坚固的城市和羊圈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 伯．宁拉、伯．哈兰这些坚固的城市和羊圈。
verses.textZhCuv: 伯‧宁拉、伯‧哈兰，都是坚固城。他们又垒羊圈。
verses.textEnNiv: Beth Nimrah and Beth Haran as fortified cities, and built pens for their flocks.
verses.textEnEsv: Beth-nimrah and Beth-haran, fortified cities, and folds for sheep.
verses.textEnNkjv: Beth Nimrah and Beth Haran, fortified cities, and folds for sheep.
verses.textEnNlt: Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran. These were all fortified towns with pens for their flocks.
verses.textEnNasb: Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran as fortified cities, and sheepfolds for sheep.
verses.textEn: Beth Nimrah and Beth Haran as fortified cities, and built pens for their flocks.

verses.textZh: 流本的子孙修筑了希实本、以利亚利、基列亭、
verses.textZhCnvs: 流本的子孙修筑了希实本、以利亚利、基列亭、
verses.textZhCuv: 吕便子孙建造希实本、以利亚利、基列亭、
verses.textEnNiv: And the Reubenites rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh and Kiriathaim,
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon and Elealeh and Kirjathaim,
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Reuben built the towns of Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
verses.textEn: And the Reubenites rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh and Kiriathaim,

verses.textZh: 尼波、巴力．免 、西比玛；又为他们修筑的城市起了别的名字。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼波、巴力．免 、西比玛；又为他们修筑的城市起了别的名字。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼波、巴力‧免、西比玛（尼波、巴力‧免，名字是改了的），又给他们所建造的城另起别名。
verses.textEnNiv: as well as Nebo and Baal Meon (these names were changed) and Sibmah. They gave names to the cities they rebuilt.
verses.textEnEsv: Nebo, and Baal-meon ( their names were changed), and Sibmah. And they gave other names to the cities that they built.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nebo and Baal Meon (their names being changed) and Shibmah; and they gave other names to the cities which they built.
verses.textEnNlt: Nebo, Baal-meon, and Sibmah. They changed the names of some of the towns they conquered and rebuilt.
verses.textEnNasb: Nebo, and Baal-meon—their names being changed—and Sibmah, and they gave other names to the cities which they built.
verses.textEn: as well as Nebo and Baal Meon (these names were changed) and Sibmah. They gave names to the cities they rebuilt.

verses.textZh: 玛拿西的儿子玛吉的子孙到基列去，攻取了那地，把住在那里的亚摩利人赶走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西的儿子玛吉的子孙到基列去，攻取了那地，把住在那里的亚摩利人赶走。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西的儿子玛吉，他的子孙往基列去，占了那地，赶出那里的亚摩利人。
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Makir son of Manasseh went to Gilead, captured it and drove out the Amorites who were there.
verses.textEnEsv: And the sons of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead and captured it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead and took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were in it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the descendants of Makir of the tribe of Manasseh went to Gilead and conquered it, and they drove out the Amorites living there.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead and took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were in it.
verses.textEn: The descendants of Makir son of Manasseh went to Gilead, captured it and drove out the Amorites who were there.

verses.textZh: 摩西把基列给了玛拿西的儿子玛吉，玛吉就住在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西把基列给了玛拿西的儿子玛吉，玛吉就住在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西将基列赐给玛拿西的儿子玛吉，他子孙就住在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: So Moses gave Gilead to the Makirites, the descendants of Manasseh, and they settled there.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh, and he settled in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh, and he dwelt in it.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses gave Gilead to the Makirites, descendants of Manasseh, and they settled there.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh, and he lived in it.
verses.textEn: So Moses gave Gilead to the Makirites, the descendants of Manasseh, and they settled there.

verses.textZh: 玛拿西的儿子睚珥，去攻取了亚摩利人的村庄，就把这些村庄叫作哈倭特．睚珥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西的儿子睚珥，去攻取了亚摩利人的村庄，就把这些村庄叫作哈倭特．睚珥。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西的子孙睚珥去占了基列的村庄，就称这些村庄为哈倭特‧睚珥。
verses.textEnNiv: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, captured their settlements and called them Havvoth Jair.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and captured their villages, and called them Havvoth-jair.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its small towns, and called them Havoth Jair.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Jair, another clan of the tribe of Manasseh, captured many of the towns in Gilead and changed the name of that region to the Towns of Jair.
verses.textEnNasb: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its towns, and called them Havvoth-jair.
verses.textEn: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, captured their settlements and called them Havvoth Jair.

verses.textZh: 挪巴去攻取了基纳和基纳的小村镇，就用自己的名字叫基纳为挪巴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 挪巴去攻取了基纳和基纳的小村镇，就用自己的名字叫基纳为挪巴。
verses.textZhCuv: 挪巴去占了基纳和基纳的乡村，就按自己的名称基纳为挪巴。
verses.textEnNiv: And Nobah captured Kenath and its surrounding settlements and called it Nobah after himself.
verses.textEnEsv: And Nobah went and captured Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and he called it Nobah, after his own name.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, a man named Nobah captured the town of Kenath and its surrounding villages, and he renamed that area Nobah after himself.
verses.textEnNasb: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and named it Nobah, after his own name.
verses.textEn: And Nobah captured Kenath and its surrounding settlements and called it Nobah after himself.

verses.textZh: 以下是以色列人按着他们的队伍，在摩西和亚伦的手下，从埃及地出来以后所行的路程。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是以色列人按着他们的队伍，在摩西和亚伦的手下，从埃及地出来以后所行的路程。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人按着军队，在摩西、亚伦的手下出埃及地所行的路程 记在下面。
verses.textEnNiv: Here are the stages in the journey of the Israelites when they came out of Egypt by divisions under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the stages of the people of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their companies under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, who went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the route the Israelites followed as they marched out of Egypt under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the journeys of the sons of Israel, by which they came out of the land of Egypt by their armies, under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEn: Here are the stages in the journey of the Israelites when they came out of Egypt by divisions under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.

verses.textZh: 摩西照着耶和华的命令，把他们出发的路程记下来，他们出发的路程是这样：
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西照着耶和华的命令，把他们出发的路程记下来，他们出发的路程是这样：
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西遵着耶和华的吩咐记载他们所行的路程，其路程乃是这样：
verses.textEnNiv: At the Lord ’s command Moses recorded the stages in their journey. This is their journey by stages:
verses.textEnEsv: Moses wrote down their starting places, stage by stage, by command of the Lord , and these are their stages according to their starting places.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Moses wrote down the starting points of their journeys at the command of the Lord. And these are their journeys according to their starting points:
verses.textEnNlt: At the Lord ’s direction, Moses kept a written record of their progress. These are the stages of their march, identified by the different places where they stopped along the way.
verses.textEnNasb: Moses recorded their starting places according to their journeys by the command of the Lord, and these are their journeys according to their starting places.
verses.textEn: At the Lord ’s command Moses recorded the stages in their journey. This is their journey by stages:

verses.textZh: 一月十五日，就是逾越节的次日，以色列人从兰塞起行，在所有埃及人眼前昂然无惧地出去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一月十五日，就是逾越节的次日，以色列人从兰塞起行，在所有埃及人眼前昂然无惧地出去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 正月十五日，就是逾越节的次日，以色列人从兰塞起行，在一切埃及人眼前昂然无惧地出去。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites set out from Rameses on the fifteenth day of the first month, the day after the Passover. They marched out defiantly in full view of all the Egyptians,
verses.textEnEsv: They set out from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month. On the day after the Passover, the people of Israel went out triumphantly in the sight of all the Egyptians,
verses.textEnNkjv: They departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the day after the Passover the children of Israel went out with boldness in the sight of all the Egyptians.
verses.textEnNlt: They set out from the city of Rameses in early spring—on the fifteenth day of the first month —on the morning after the first Passover celebration. The people of Israel left defiantly, in full view of all the Egyptians.
verses.textEnNasb: Now they journeyed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the day after the Passover the sons of Israel started out boldly in the sight of all the Egyptians,
verses.textEn: The Israelites set out from Rameses on the fifteenth day of the first month, the day after the Passover. They marched out defiantly in full view of all the Egyptians,

verses.textZh: 那时，埃及人正在埋葬他们的长子，就是耶和华在他们中间击杀的，耶和华也对他们的神施行审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，埃及人正在埋葬他们的长子，就是耶和华在他们中间击杀的，耶和华也对他们的神施行审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，埃及人正葬埋他们的长子，就是耶和华在他们中间所击杀的；耶和华也败坏他们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: who were burying all their firstborn, whom the Lord had struck down among them; for the Lord had brought judgment on their gods.
verses.textEnEsv: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom the Lord had struck down among them. On their gods also the Lord executed judgments.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom the Lord had killed among them. Also on their gods the Lord had executed judgments.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn sons, whom the Lord had killed the night before. The Lord had defeated the gods of Egypt that night with great acts of judgment!
verses.textEnNasb: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn whom the Lord had fatally struck among them. The Lord had also executed judgments against their gods.
verses.textEn: who were burying all their firstborn, whom the Lord had struck down among them; for the Lord had brought judgment on their gods.

verses.textZh: 以色列人从兰塞起行，在疏割安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人从兰塞起行，在疏割安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人从兰塞起行，安营在疏割。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites left Rameses and camped at Sukkoth.
verses.textEnEsv: So the people of Israel set out from Rameses and camped at Succoth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Israel moved from Rameses and camped at Succoth.
verses.textEnNlt: After leaving Rameses, the Israelites set up camp at Succoth.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Israel journeyed from Rameses and camped in Succoth.
verses.textEn: The Israelites left Rameses and camped at Sukkoth.

verses.textZh: 从疏割起行，在旷野边界的以倘安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从疏割起行，在旷野边界的以倘安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 从疏割起行，安营在旷野边的以倘。
verses.textEnNiv: They left Sukkoth and camped at Etham, on the edge of the desert.
verses.textEnEsv: And they set out from Succoth and camped at Etham, which is on the edge of the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: They departed from Succoth and camped at Etham, which is on the edge of the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they left Succoth and camped at Etham on the edge of the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: They journeyed from Succoth and camped in Etham, which is on the edge of the wilderness.
verses.textEn: They left Sukkoth and camped at Etham, on the edge of the desert.

verses.textZh: 从以倘起行，转到比哈．希录，是在巴力．洗分前面，就在密夺对面安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从以倘起行，转到比哈．希录，是在巴力．洗分前面，就在密夺对面安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 从以倘起行，转到比哈‧希录，是在巴力‧洗分对面，就在密夺安营。
verses.textEnNiv: They left Etham, turned back to Pi Hahiroth, to the east of Baal Zephon, and camped near Migdol.
verses.textEnEsv: And they set out from Etham and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, which is east of Baal-zephon, and they camped before Migdol.
verses.textEnNkjv: They moved from Etham and turned back to Pi Hahiroth, which is east of Baal Zephon; and they camped near Migdol.
verses.textEnNlt: They left Etham and turned back toward Pi-hahiroth, opposite Baal-zephon, and camped near Migdol.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they journeyed from Etham and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, which faces Baal-zephon; and they camped before Migdol.
verses.textEn: They left Etham, turned back to Pi Hahiroth, to the east of Baal Zephon, and camped near Migdol.

verses.textZh: 从比哈．希录起行，经过了海来到旷野，又在伊坦旷野走了三天的路程，就在玛拉安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从比哈．希录起行，经过了海来到旷野，又在伊坦旷野走了三天的路程，就在玛拉安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 从比哈‧希录对面起行，经过海中到了书珥旷野，又在伊坦的旷野走了三天的路程，就安营在玛拉。
verses.textEnNiv: They left Pi Hahiroth and passed through the sea into the desert, and when they had traveled for three days in the Desert of Etham, they camped at Marah.
verses.textEnEsv: And they set out from before Hahiroth and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and they went a three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham and camped at Marah.
verses.textEnNkjv: They departed from before Hahiroth and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, went three days’ journey in the Wilderness of Etham, and camped at Marah.
verses.textEnNlt: They left Pi-hahiroth and crossed the Red Sea into the wilderness beyond. Then they traveled for three days into the Etham wilderness and camped at Marah.
verses.textEnNasb: They journeyed from Pi-hahiroth and passed through the midst of the sea to the wilderness; and they went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham and camped at Marah.
verses.textEn: They left Pi Hahiroth and passed through the sea into the desert, and when they had traveled for three days in the Desert of Etham, they camped at Marah.

verses.textZh: 从玛拉起行，来到以琳；在以琳有十二股水泉，七十棵棕树；他们就在那里安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从玛拉起行，来到以琳；在以琳有十二股水泉，七十棵棕树；他们就在那里安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 从玛拉起行，来到以琳（以琳有十二股水泉，七十棵棕树），就在那里安营。
verses.textEnNiv: They left Marah and went to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.
verses.textEnEsv: And they set out from Marah and came to Elim; at Elim there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.
verses.textEnNkjv: They moved from Marah and came to Elim. At Elim were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees; so they camped there.
verses.textEnNlt: They left Marah and camped at Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees.
verses.textEnNasb: They journeyed from Marah and came to Elim; and in Elim there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.
verses.textEn: They left Marah and went to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.

verses.textZh: 从以琳起行，在红海边安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从以琳起行，在红海边安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 从以琳起行，安营在红海边。
verses.textEnNiv: They left Elim and camped by the Red Sea.
verses.textEnEsv: And they set out from Elim and camped by the Red Sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: They moved from Elim and camped by the Red Sea.
verses.textEnNlt: They left Elim and camped beside the Red Sea.
verses.textEnNasb: They journeyed from Elim and camped by the Red Sea.
verses.textEn: They left Elim and camped by the Red Sea.

verses.textZh: 从红海起行，在汛的旷野安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从红海起行，在汛的旷野安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 从红海边起行，安营在汛的旷野。
verses.textEnNiv: They left the Red Sea and camped in the Desert of Sin.
verses.textEnEsv: And they set out from the Red Sea and camped in the wilderness of Sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: They moved from the Red Sea and camped in the Wilderness of Sin.

verses.textZh: 以色列人从埃及地出来以后四十年，五月一日，亚伦祭司照着耶和华的吩咐，上了何珥山，就死在那里。

verses.textEnNiv: At the Lord ’s command Aaron the priest went up Mount Hor, where he died on the first day of the fifth month of the fortieth year after the Israelites came out of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: And Aaron the priest went up Mount Hor at the command of the Lord and died there, in the fortieth year after the people of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, on the first day of the fifth month.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Aaron the priest went up to Mount Hor at the command of the Lord, and died there in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, on the first day of the fifth month.
verses.textEnNlt: While they were at the foot of Mount Hor, Aaron the priest was directed by the Lord to go up the mountain, and there he died. This happened in midsummer, on the first day of the fifth month of the fortieth year after Israel’s departure from Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Aaron the priest went up to Mount Hor at the command of the Lord, and died there in the fortieth year after the sons of Israel had come from the land of Egypt, on the first day in the fifth month.
verses.textEn: At the Lord ’s command Aaron the priest went up Mount Hor, where he died on the first day of the fifth month of the fortieth year after the Israelites came out of Egypt.

verses.textEnNkjv: Now the king of Arad, the Canaanite, who dwelt in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev in the land of Canaan, heard that the people of Israel were approaching his land.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Canaanite, the king of Arad who lived in the Negev in the land of Canaan, heard about the coming of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev of Canaan, heard that the Israelites were coming.

verses.textZh: 以色列人从何珥山起行，在撒摩拿安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人从何珥山起行，在撒摩拿安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人从何珥山起行，安营在撒摩拿。
verses.textEnNiv: They left Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.
verses.textEnEsv: And they set out from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they departed from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the Israelites left Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they journeyed from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.
verses.textEn: They left Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.

verses.textZh: 从撒摩拿起行，在普嫩安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从撒摩拿起行，在普嫩安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 从撒摩拿起行，安营在普嫩。
verses.textEnNiv: They left Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
verses.textEnEsv: And they set out from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
verses.textEnNkjv: They departed from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they left Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
verses.textEnNasb: They journeyed from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
verses.textEn: They left Zalmonah and camped at Punon.

verses.textZh: 从普嫩起行，在阿伯安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从普嫩起行，在阿伯安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 从普嫩起行，安营在阿伯。
verses.textEnNiv: They left Punon and camped at Oboth.
verses.textEnEsv: And they set out from Punon and camped at Oboth.
verses.textEnNkjv: They departed from Punon and camped at Oboth.
verses.textEnNlt: They left Punon and camped at Oboth.
verses.textEnNasb: They journeyed from Punon and camped at Oboth.
verses.textEn: They left Punon and camped at Oboth.

verses.textZh: 从阿伯起行，在摩押边境的以耶．亚巴琳安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从阿伯起行，在摩押边境的以耶．亚巴琳安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 从阿伯起行，安营在以耶‧亚巴琳，摩押的边界。
verses.textEnNiv: They left Oboth and camped at Iye Abarim, on the border of Moab.
verses.textEnEsv: And they set out from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim, in the territory of Moab.
verses.textEnNkjv: They departed from Oboth and camped at Ije Abarim, at the border of Moab.
verses.textEnNlt: They left Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim on the border of Moab.
verses.textEnNasb: They journeyed from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim, at the border of Moab.
verses.textEn: They left Oboth and camped at Iye Abarim, on the border of Moab.

verses.textZh: 从以耶．亚巴琳起行，在底本．迦得安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从以耶．亚巴琳起行，在底本．迦得安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 从以耶‧亚巴琳起行，安营在底本‧迦得。
verses.textEnNiv: They left Iye Abarim and camped at Dibon Gad.
verses.textEnEsv: And they set out from Iyim and camped at Dibon-gad.
verses.textEnNkjv: They departed from Ijim and camped at Dibon Gad.
verses.textEnNlt: They left Iye-abarim and camped at Dibon-gad.
verses.textEnNasb: They journeyed from Iyim and camped at Dibon-gad.
verses.textEn: They left Iye Abarim and camped at Dibon Gad.

verses.textZh: 从底本．迦得起行，在亚门．低比拉太音安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从底本．迦得起行，在亚门．低比拉太音安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 从底本‧迦得起行，安营在亚门‧低比拉太音。
verses.textEnNiv: They left Dibon Gad and camped at Almon Diblathaim.
verses.textEnEsv: And they set out from Dibon-gad and camped at Almon-diblathaim.
verses.textEnNkjv: They moved from Dibon Gad and camped at Almon Diblathaim.
verses.textEnNlt: They left Dibon-gad and camped at Almon-diblathaim.
verses.textEnNasb: They journeyed from Dibon-gad and camped at Almon-diblathaim.
verses.textEn: They left Dibon Gad and camped at Almon Diblathaim.

verses.textZh: 从亚门．低比拉太音起行，在尼波前面的亚巴琳山安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从亚门．低比拉太音起行，在尼波前面的亚巴琳山安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 从亚门‧低比拉太音起行，安营在尼波对面的亚巴琳山里。
verses.textEnNiv: They left Almon Diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim, near Nebo.
verses.textEnEsv: And they set out from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
verses.textEnNkjv: They moved from Almon Diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
verses.textEnNlt: They left Almon-diblathaim and camped in the mountains east of the river, near Mount Nebo.
verses.textEnNasb: They journeyed from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
verses.textEn: They left Almon Diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim, near Nebo.

verses.textZh: 从亚巴琳山起行，在耶利哥对面，约旦河边的摩押平原安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从亚巴琳山起行，在耶利哥对面，约旦河边的摩押平原安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 从亚巴琳山起行，安营在摩押平原－约旦河边、耶利哥对面。
verses.textEnNiv: They left the mountains of Abarim and camped on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
verses.textEnEsv: And they set out from the mountains of Abarim and camped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho;
verses.textEnNkjv: They departed from the mountains of Abarim and camped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan, acrossfrom Jericho.
verses.textEnNlt: They left the mountains east of the river and camped on the plains of Moab beside the Jordan River, across from Jericho.
verses.textEnNasb: They journeyed from the mountains of Abarim and camped in the plains of Moab, by the Jordan opposite Jericho.
verses.textEn: They left the mountains of Abarim and camped on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.

verses.textZh: 他们在摩押平原，沿着约旦河边安营，从帕．耶施末直到亚伯．什亭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在摩押平原，沿着约旦河边安营，从帕．耶施末直到亚伯．什亭。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在摩押平原沿约旦河边安营，从伯‧耶施末直到亚伯‧什亭。
verses.textEnNiv: There on the plains of Moab they camped along the Jordan from Beth Jeshimoth to Abel Shittim.
verses.textEnEsv: they camped by the Jordan from Beth-jeshimoth as far as Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.
verses.textEnNkjv: They camped by the Jordan, from Beth Jesimoth as far as the Abel Acacia Grove in the plains of Moab.
verses.textEnNlt: Along the Jordan River they camped from Beth-jeshimoth as far as the meadows of Acacia on the plains of Moab.
verses.textEnNasb: They camped by the Jordan, from Beth-jeshimoth as far as Abel-shittim, in the plains of Moab.
verses.textEn: There on the plains of Moab they camped along the Jordan from Beth Jeshimoth to Abel Shittim.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在摩押平原约旦河边，耶利哥对面对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在摩押平原约旦河边，耶利哥对面对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在摩押平原－约旦河边、耶利哥对面晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan, acrossfrom Jericho, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: While they were camped near the Jordan River on the plains of Moab opposite Jericho, the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan opposite Jericho, saying,
verses.textEn: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho the Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要吩咐以色列说：‘你们过约旦河到了迦南地的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要吩咐以色列说：‘你们过约旦河到了迦南地的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你吩咐以色列人说：你们过约旦河进迦南地的时候，
verses.textEnNiv: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you cross the Jordan into Canaan,
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel and say to them, When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘When you have crossed the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel: When you cross the Jordan River into the land of Canaan,
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
verses.textEn: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you cross the Jordan into Canaan,

verses.textZh: 就要把所有的居民从你们面前赶出去，毁坏他们的一切雕像，以及一切铸像，又拆毁他们的一切邱坛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就要把所有的居民从你们面前赶出去，毁坏他们的一切雕像，以及一切铸像，又拆毁他们的一切邱坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 就要从你们面前赶出那里所有的居民，毁灭他们一切錾成的石像和他们一切铸成的偶像，又拆毁他们一切的邱坛。
verses.textEnNiv: drive out all the inhabitants of the land before you. Destroy all their carved images and their cast idols, and demolish all their high places.
verses.textEnEsv: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you and destroy all their figured stones and destroy all their metal images and demolish all their high places.
verses.textEnNkjv: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their engraved stones, destroy all their molded images, and demolish all their high places;
verses.textEnNlt: you must drive out all the people living there. You must destroy all their carved and molten images and demolish all their pagan shrines.
verses.textEnNasb: you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from you, and destroy all their idolatrous sculptures, destroy all their cast metal images, and eliminate all their high places;
verses.textEn: drive out all the inhabitants of the land before you. Destroy all their carved images and their cast idols, and demolish all their high places.

verses.textZh: 你们要占领那地，住在那里，因为我已经把那地赐给你们作产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要占领那地，住在那里，因为我已经把那地赐给你们作产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要夺那地，住在其中，因我把那地赐给你们为业。
verses.textEnNiv: Take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given you the land to possess.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given the land to you to possess it.
verses.textEnNkjv: you shall dispossess theinhabitantsof the land and dwell in it, for I have given you the land to possess.
verses.textEnNlt: Take possession of the land and settle in it, because I have given it to you to occupy.
verses.textEnNasb: and you shall take possession of the land and live in it, for I have given the land to you to possess it.
verses.textEn: Take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given you the land to possess.

verses.textZh: 你们要按着家族抽签承受那地作产业；人多的，要把产业多分给他们；人少的，要把产业少分给他们；抽签抽出那地归谁，就归谁；你们要按着宗族支派承受产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要按着家族抽签承受那地作产业；人多的，要把产业多分给他们；人少的，要把产业少分给他们；抽签抽出那地归谁，就归谁；你们要按着宗族支派承受产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要按家室拈阄，承受那地；人多的，要把产业多分给他们；人少的，要把产业少分给他们。拈出何地给何人，就要归何人。你们要按宗族的支派承受。
verses.textEnNiv: Distribute the land by lot, according to your clans. To a larger group give a larger inheritance, and to a smaller group a smaller one. Whatever falls to them by lot will be theirs. Distribute it according to your ancestral tribes.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your clans. To a large tribe you shall give a large inheritance, and to a small tribe you shall give a small inheritance. Wherever the lot falls for anyone, that shall be his. According to the tribes of your fathers you shall inherit.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall divide the land by lot as an inheritance among your families; to the larger you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance; there everyone’s inheritance shall be whatever falls to him by lot. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: You must distribute the land among the clans by sacred lot and in proportion to their size. A larger portion of land will be allotted to each of the larger clans, and a smaller portion will be allotted to each of the smaller clans. The decision of the sacred lot is final. In this way, the portions of land will be divided among your ancestral tribes.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall maintain the land as an inheritance by lot according to your families; to the larger you shall give more inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give less inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to anyone, that shall be his. You shall pass on land as an inheritance according to the tribes of your fathers.
verses.textEn: Distribute the land by lot, according to your clans. To a larger group give a larger inheritance, and to a smaller group a smaller one. Whatever falls to them by lot will be theirs. Distribute it according to your ancestral tribes.

verses.textZh: 如果你们不把那地的居民从你们面前赶出去，所留下的人就必成为你们眼中的刺，肋旁的荆棘，在你们所住的地方扰害你们；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们不把那地的居民从你们面前赶出去，所留下的人就必成为你们眼中的刺，肋旁的荆棘，在你们所住的地方扰害你们；
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若你们不赶出那地的居民，所容留的居民就必作你们眼中的刺，肋下的荆棘，也必在你们所住的地上扰害你们。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land, those you allow to remain will become barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will give you trouble in the land where you will live.
verses.textEnEsv: But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those of them whom you let remain shall be as barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides, and they shall trouble you in the land where you dwell.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then it shall be that those whom you let remain shallbe irritants in your eyes and thorns in your sides, and they shall harass you in the land where you dwell.
verses.textEnNlt: But if you fail to drive out the people who live in the land, those who remain will be like splinters in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will harass you in the land where you live.
verses.textEnNasb: But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from you, then it will come about that those whom you let remain of them will be like thorns in your eyes and like pricks in your sides, and they will trouble you in the land in which you live.
verses.textEn: " ‘But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land, those you allow to remain will become barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will give you trouble in the land where you will live.

verses.textZh: 并且我原计划怎样待他们，也要怎样待你们。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且我原计划怎样待他们，也要怎样待你们。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 而且我素常有意怎样待他们，也必照样待你们。」
verses.textEnNiv: And then I will do to you what I plan to do to them.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And I will do to you as I thought to do to them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover it shall be that I will do to you as I thought to do to them.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And I will do to you what I had planned to do to them."
verses.textEnNasb: And just as I plan to do to them, I will do to you.’ "
verses.textEn: And then I will do to you what I plan to do to them.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要吩咐以色列人说：‘你们进了迦南地的时候，归你们作产业的迦南地及它的四境就是以下这些地区。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要吩咐以色列人说：‘你们进了迦南地的时候，归你们作产业的迦南地及它的四境就是以下这些地区。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你吩咐以色列人说：你们到了迦南地，就是归你们为业的迦南四境之地，
verses.textEnNiv: "Command the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you enter Canaan, the land that will be allotted to you as an inheritance is to have these boundaries:
verses.textEnEsv: "Command the people of Israel, and say to them, When you enter the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, the land of Canaan as defined by its borders),
verses.textEnNkjv: "Command the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘When you come into the land of Canaan, this is the land that shall fall to you as an inheritance—the land of Canaan to its boundaries.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give these instructions to the Israelites: When you come into the land of Canaan, which I am giving you as your special possession, these will be the boundaries.
verses.textEnNasb: "Command the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘When you enter the land of Canaan, this is the land that shall fall to you as an inheritance, that is, the land of Canaan according to its borders.
verses.textEn: "Command the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you enter Canaan, the land that will be allotted to you as an inheritance is to have these boundaries:

verses.textZh: 你们南面的地区要从寻的旷野，贴着以东边界；你们的南界要从盐海东面的尽头起；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们南面的地区要从寻的旷野，贴着以东边界；你们的南界要从盐海东面的尽头起；
verses.textZhCuv: 南角要从寻的旷野，贴着以东的边界；南界要从盐海东头起，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Your southern side will include some of the Desert of Zin along the border of Edom. Your southern boundary will start in the east from the southern end of the Dead Sea,
verses.textEnEsv: your south side shall be from the wilderness of Zin alongside Edom, and your southern border shall run from the end of the Salt Sea on the east.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your southern border shall be from the Wilderness of Zin along the border of Edom; then your southern border shall extend eastward to the end of the Salt Sea;
verses.textEnNlt: The southern portion of your country will extend from the wilderness of Zin, along the edge of Edom. The southern boundary will begin on the east at the Dead Sea.
verses.textEnNasb: Your southern region shall extend from the wilderness of Zin along the side of Edom, and your southern border shall extend from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.
verses.textEn: " ‘Your southern side will include some of the Desert of Zin along the border of Edom. Your southern boundary will start in the east from the southern end of the Dead Sea,

verses.textZh: 你们的边界要转到亚克拉滨坡的南边，经过寻，直达加低斯．巴尼亚的南边，又出到哈萨．亚达，过到押们；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的边界要转到亚克拉滨坡的南边，经过寻，直达加低斯．巴尼亚的南边，又出到哈萨．亚达，过到押们；
verses.textZhCuv: 绕到亚克拉滨坡的南边，接连到寻，直通到加低斯‧巴尼亚的南边，又通到哈萨‧亚达，接连到押们，
verses.textEnNiv: cross south of Scorpion Pass, continue on to Zin and go south of Kadesh Barnea. Then it will go to Hazar Addar and over to Azmon,
verses.textEnEsv: And your border shall turn south of the ascent of Akrabbim, and cross to Zin, and its limit shall be south of Kadesh-barnea. Then it shall go on to Hazar-addar, and pass along to Azmon.
verses.textEnNkjv: your border shall turn from the southern side of the Ascent of Akrabbim, continue to Zin, and be on the south of Kadesh Barnea; then it shall go on to Hazar Addar, and continue to Azmon;
verses.textEnNlt: It will then run south past Scorpion Pass in the direction of Zin. Its southernmost point will be Kadesh-barnea, from which it will go to Hazar-addar, and on to Azmon.
verses.textEnNasb: Then your border shall change direction from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim and continue to Zin, and its termination shall be to the south of Kadesh-barnea; and it shall reach Hazaraddar and continue to Azmon.
verses.textEn: cross south of Scorpion Pass, continue on to Zin and go south of Kadesh Barnea. Then it will go to Hazar Addar and over to Azmon,

verses.textZh: 你们的边界要从押们转到埃及河，直达到海。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的边界要从押们转到埃及河，直达到海。
verses.textZhCuv: 从押们转到埃及小河，直通到海为止。
verses.textEnNiv: where it will turn, join the Wadi of Egypt and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
verses.textEnEsv: And the border shall turn from Azmon to the Brook of Egypt, and its limit shall be at the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: the border shall turn from Azmon to the Brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the Sea.
verses.textEnNlt: From Azmon the boundary will turn toward the Brook of Egypt and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
