verses.textEnNlt: These are the men the Lord has appointed to divide the grants of land in Canaan among the Israelites."
verses.textEnNasb: These are the ones whom the Lord commanded to apportion the inheritance to the sons of Israel in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEn: These are the men the Lord commanded to assign the inheritance to the Israelites in the land of Canaan.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在耶利哥对面，约旦河边的摩押平原，对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在耶利哥对面，约旦河边的摩押平原，对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在摩押平原－约旦河边、耶利哥对面晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan acrossfrom Jericho, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: While Israel was camped beside the Jordan on the plains of Moab across from Jericho, the Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab, by the Jordan opposite Jericho, saying,
verses.textEn: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, the Lord said to Moses,

verses.textZh: "你要吩咐以色列人，叫他们从所得为业的地中，把一些城给利未人居住，也把这些城周围的郊区给利未人。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要吩咐以色列人，叫他们从所得为业的地中，把一些城给利未人居住，也把这些城周围的郊区给利未人。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你吩咐以色列人，要从所得为业的地中把些城给利未人居住，也要把这城四围的郊野给利未人。
verses.textEnNiv: "Command the Israelites to give the Levites towns to live in from the inheritance the Israelites will possess. And give them pasturelands around the towns.
verses.textEnEsv: "Command the people of Israel to give to the Levites some of the inheritance of their possession as cities for them to dwell in. And you shall give to the Levites pasturelands around the cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Command the children of Israel that they give the Levites cities to dwell in from the inheritance of their possession, and you shall also give the Levites common-land around the cities.
verses.textEnNlt: "Command the people of Israel to give to the Levites from their property certain towns to live in, along with the surrounding pasturelands.
verses.textEnNasb: "Command the sons of Israel that they give to the Levites from the inheritance of their possession cities to live in; and you shall give to the Levites pasture lands around the cities.
verses.textEn: "Command the Israelites to give the Levites towns to live in from the inheritance the Israelites will possess. And give them pasturelands around the towns.

verses.textZh: 这些城要归他们居住，城的郊区可以牧放他们的牛羊和一切牲畜，也可以存放他们的财物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些城要归他们居住，城的郊区可以牧放他们的牛羊和一切牲畜，也可以存放他们的财物。
verses.textZhCuv: 这城邑要归他们居住，城邑的郊野可以牧养他们的牛羊和各样的牲畜，又可以安置他们的财物。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they will have towns to live in and pasturelands for the cattle they own and all their other animals.
verses.textEnEsv: The cities shall be theirs to dwell in, and their pasturelands shall be for their cattle and for their livestock and for all their beasts.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall have the cities to dwell in; and their common-land shall be for their cattle, for their herds, and for all their animals.
verses.textEnNlt: These towns will be for the Levites to live in, and the surrounding lands will provide pasture for their cattle, flocks, and other livestock.
verses.textEnNasb: The cities shall be theirs to live in; and their pasture lands shall be for their cattle and for their equipment and for all their other animals.
verses.textEn: Then they will have towns to live in and pasturelands for the cattle they own and all their other animals.

verses.textZh: "你们给利未人的城郊，要从城墙起，周围向外量四百五十公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们给利未人的城郊，要从城墙起，周围向外量四百五十公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们给利未人的郊野，要从城根起，四围往外量一千肘。
verses.textEnNiv: "The pasturelands around the towns that you give the Levites will extend a thousand cubits from the town wall.
verses.textEnEsv: The pasturelands of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city outward a thousand cubits all around.
verses.textEnNkjv: The common-land of the cities which you will give the Levites shallextend from the wall of the city outward a thousand cubits all around.
verses.textEnNlt: The pastureland assigned to the Levites around these towns will extend 1,500 feet from the town walls in every direction.
verses.textEnNasb: "The pasture lands of the cities which you are to give to the Levites shall extend from the wall of the city outward a thousand cubits around.
verses.textEn: "The pasturelands around the towns that you give the Levites will extend a thousand cubits from the town wall.

verses.textZh: 你们又要从城外，向东面量九百公尺，向南面量九百公尺，向西面量九百公尺，向北面量九百公尺，城在中间；这要归给他们作城外的郊区。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们又要从城外，向东面量九百公尺，向南面量九百公尺，向西面量九百公尺，向北面量九百公尺，城在中间；这要归给他们作城外的郊区。
verses.textZhCuv: 另外东量二千肘，南量二千肘，西量二千肘，北量二千肘，为边界，城在当中；这要归他们作城邑的郊野。
verses.textEnNiv: Outside the town, measure two thousand cubits on the east side, two thousand on the south side, two thousand on the west and two thousand on the north, with the town in the center. They will have this area as pastureland for the towns.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall measure, outside the city, on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the middle. This shall belong to them as pastureland for their cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall measure outside the city on the east side two thousand cubits, on the south side two thousand cubits, on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits. The city shallbe in the middle. This shall belong to them as common-land for the cities.
verses.textEnNlt: Measure off 3,000 feet outside the town walls in every direction—east, south, west, north—with the town at the center. This area will serve as the larger pastureland for the towns.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also measure outside the city on the east side two thousand cubits, on the south side two thousand cubits, on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits, with the city in the center. This shall become theirs as pasture lands for the cities.
verses.textEn: Outside the town, measure two thousand cubits on the east side, two thousand on the south side, two thousand on the west and two thousand on the north, with the town in the center. They will have this area as pastureland for the towns.

verses.textZh: 你们分给利未人的城，其中要有六座避难城，让误杀人的可以逃到那里去，此外还要给他们四十二座城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们分给利未人的城，其中要有六座避难城，让误杀人的可以逃到那里去，此外还要给他们四十二座城。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们给利未人的城邑，其中当有六座逃城，使误杀人的可以逃到那里。此外还要给他们四十二座城。
verses.textEnNiv: "Six of the towns you give the Levites will be cities of refuge, to which a person who has killed someone may flee. In addition, give them forty-two other towns.
verses.textEnEsv: "The cities that you give to the Levites shall be the six cities of refuge, where you shall permit the manslayer to flee, and in addition to them you shall give forty-two cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now among the cities which you will give to the Levites youshallappoint six cities of refuge, to which a manslayer may flee. And to these you shall add forty-two cities.
verses.textEnNlt: "Six of the towns you give the Levites will be cities of refuge, where a person who has accidentally killed someone can flee for safety. In addition, give them forty-two other towns.
verses.textEnNasb: The cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall provide for the one who commits manslaughter to flee to; and in addition to them you shall give forty-two cities.
verses.textEn: "Six of the towns you give the Levites will be cities of refuge, to which a person who has killed someone may flee. In addition, give them forty-two other towns.

verses.textZh: 这样，你们所要给利未人的城，共为四十八座，连城带城郊都要给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，你们所要给利未人的城，共为四十八座，连城带城郊都要给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要给利未人的城，共有四十八座，连城带郊野都要给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: In all you must give the Levites forty-eight towns, together with their pasturelands.
verses.textEnEsv: All the cities that you give to the Levites shall be forty-eight, with their pasturelands.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the cities you will give to the Levites shallbe forty-eight; these youshallgive with their common-land.
verses.textEnNlt: In all, forty-eight towns with the surrounding pastureland will be given to the Levites.
verses.textEnNasb: The total number of the cities which you are to give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities, together with their pasture lands.
verses.textEn: In all you must give the Levites forty-eight towns, together with their pasturelands.

verses.textZh: 从以色列人所得的地业中，你们要把一些城给利未人，人多的就要多给，人少的就要少给；每个支派要照着自己承受的产业，把城分给利未人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 从以色列人所得的地业中，你们要把一些城给利未人，人多的就要多给，人少的就要少给；每个支派要照着自己承受的产业，把城分给利未人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人所得的地业从中要把些城邑给利未人；人多的就多给，人少的就少给；各支派要按所承受为业之地把城邑给利未人。」
verses.textEnNiv: The towns you give the Levites from the land the Israelites possess are to be given in proportion to the inheritance of each tribe: Take many towns from a tribe that has many, but few from one that has few."
verses.textEnEsv: And as for the cities that you shall give from the possession of the people of Israel, from the larger tribes you shall take many, and from the smaller tribes you shall take few; each, in proportion to the inheritance that it inherits, shall give of its cities to the Levites."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the cities which you will give shallbe from the possession of the children of Israel; from the larger tribe you shall give many, from the smaller you shall give few. Each shall give some of its cities to the Levites, in proportion to the inheritance that each receives."
verses.textEnNlt: These towns will come from the property of the people of Israel. The larger tribes will give more towns to the Levites, while the smaller tribes will give fewer. Each tribe will give property in proportion to the size of its land."
verses.textEnNasb: As for the cities which you shall give them from the possession of the sons of Israel, you shall take more from the larger, and you shall take fewer from the smaller; each shall give some of his cities to the Levites in proportion to his inheritance which he possesses."
verses.textEn: The towns you give the Levites from the land the Israelites possess are to be given in proportion to the inheritance of each tribe: Take many towns from a tribe that has many, but few from one that has few."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对摩西说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Moses:
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Moses,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Moses:

verses.textZh: "你要吩咐以色列人说：‘你们过约旦河，进到迦南地的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要吩咐以色列人说：‘你们过约旦河，进到迦南地的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你吩咐以色列人说：你们过约旦河，进了迦南地，
verses.textEnNiv: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you cross the Jordan into Canaan,
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to the people of Israel and say to them, When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. "When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, ‘When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
verses.textEn: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you cross the Jordan into Canaan,

verses.textZh: 就要选择几座城，给你们作避难城，让误杀人的，就是无心杀死人的，可以逃到那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就要选择几座城，给你们作避难城，让误杀人的，就是无心杀死人的，可以逃到那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 就要分出几座城，为你们作逃城，使误杀人的可以逃到那里。
verses.textEnNiv: select some towns to be your cities of refuge, to which a person who has killed someone accidentally may flee.
verses.textEnEsv: then you shall select cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the manslayer who kills any person without intent may flee there.
verses.textEnNkjv: then you shall appoint cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the manslayer who kills any person accidentally may flee there.
verses.textEnNlt: designate cities of refuge to which people can flee if they have killed someone accidentally.
verses.textEnNasb: then you shall select for yourselves cities to be your cities of refuge, so that the one who commits manslaughter by killing a person unintentionally may flee there.
verses.textEn: select some towns to be your cities of refuge, to which a person who has killed someone accidentally may flee.

verses.textZh: 它们可以作你们逃避报仇者的避难城，使误杀人的不至于死，直到他站在会众面前受审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它们可以作你们逃避报仇者的避难城，使误杀人的不至于死，直到他站在会众面前受审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些城可以作逃避报仇人的城，使误杀人的不至于死，等他站在会众面前听审判。
verses.textEnNiv: They will be places of refuge from the avenger, so that anyone accused of murder may not die before they stand trial before the assembly.
verses.textEnEsv: The cities shall be for you a refuge from the avenger, that the manslayer may not die until he stands before the congregation for judgment.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall be cities of refuge for you from the avenger, that the manslayer may not die until he stands before the congregation in judgment.
verses.textEnNlt: These cities will be places of protection from a dead person’s relatives who want to avenge the death. The slayer must not be put to death before being tried by the community.
verses.textEnNasb: The cities shall serve you as a refuge from the avenger, so that the one who commits manslaughter does not die until he stands before the congregation for trial.
verses.textEn: They will be places of refuge from the avenger, so that anyone accused of murder may not die before they stand trial before the assembly.

verses.textZh: 你们指定的城，要给你们作六座避难城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们指定的城，要给你们作六座避难城。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们所分出来的城，要作六座逃城。
verses.textEnNiv: These six towns you give will be your cities of refuge.
verses.textEnEsv: And the cities that you give shall be your six cities of refuge.
verses.textEnNkjv: And of the cities which you give, you shall have six cities of refuge.
verses.textEnNlt: Designate six cities of refuge for yourselves,
verses.textEnNasb: So the cities which you are to provide shall be six cities of refuge for you.
verses.textEn: These six towns you give will be your cities of refuge.

verses.textZh: 在约旦河东面，你们要分出三座城；在迦南地，你们也要分出三座城，都要作避难城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在约旦河东面，你们要分出三座城；在迦南地，你们也要分出三座城，都要作避难城。
verses.textZhCuv: 在约旦河东要分出三座城，在迦南地也要分出三座城，都作逃城。
verses.textEnNiv: Give three on this side of the Jordan and three in Canaan as cities of refuge.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and three cities in the land of Canaan, to be cities of refuge.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall appoint three cities on this side of the Jordan, and three cities you shall appoint in the land of Canaan, which will be cities of refuge.
verses.textEnNlt: three on the east side of the Jordan River and three on the west in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall provide three cities across the Jordan, and three cities in the land of Canaan; they are to be cities of refuge.
verses.textEn: Give three on this side of the Jordan and three in Canaan as cities of refuge.

verses.textZh: 这六座城要给以色列人和外族人，以及他们中间居住的人作避难城，使无心杀人的人，都可以逃到那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这六座城要给以色列人和外族人，以及他们中间居住的人作避难城，使无心杀人的人，都可以逃到那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 这六座城要给以色列人和他们中间的外人，并寄居的，作为逃城，使误杀人的都可以逃到那里。
verses.textEnNiv: These six towns will be a place of refuge for Israelites and for foreigners residing among them, so that anyone who has killed another accidentally can flee there.
verses.textEnEsv: These six cities shall be for refuge for the people of Israel, and for the stranger and for the sojourner among them, that anyone who kills any person without intent may flee there.
verses.textEnNkjv: These six cities shall be for refuge for the children of Israel, for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them, that anyone who kills a person accidentally may flee there.
verses.textEnNlt: These cities are for the protection of Israelites, foreigners living among you, and traveling merchants. Anyone who accidentally kills someone may flee there for safety.
verses.textEnNasb: These six cities shall be a refuge for the sons of Israel, for the stranger, and for the foreign resident among them; so that anyone who kills a person unintentionally may flee there.
verses.textEn: These six towns will be a place of refuge for Israelites and for foreigners residing among them, so that anyone who has killed another accidentally can flee there.

verses.textZh: "‘如果人用铁器打人，以致把人打死，他就是故意杀人的；故意杀人的必被处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘如果人用铁器打人，以致把人打死，他就是故意杀人的；故意杀人的必被处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 「倘若人用铁器打人，以致打死，他就是故杀人的；故杀人的必被治死。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘If anyone strikes someone a fatal blow with an iron object, that person is a murderer; the murderer is to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: "But if he struck him down with an iron object, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘But if he strikes him with an iron implement, so that he dies, he is a murderer; the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: "But if someone strikes and kills another person with a piece of iron, it is murder, and the murderer must be executed.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘But if he struck him with an iron object, so that he died, he is a murderer; the murderer must be put to death.
verses.textEn: " ‘If anyone strikes someone a fatal blow with an iron object, that person is a murderer; the murderer is to be put to death.

verses.textZh: 如果人手里拿着可以打死人的石头打人，以致把人打死，他就是故意杀人的；故意杀人的必被处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果人手里拿着可以打死人的石头打人，以致把人打死，他就是故意杀人的；故意杀人的必被处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 若用可以打死人的石头打死了人，他就是故杀人的；故杀人的必被治死。
verses.textEnNiv: Or if anyone is holding a stone and strikes someone a fatal blow with it, that person is a murderer; the murderer is to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: And if he struck him down with a stone tool that could cause death, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if he strikes him with a stone in the hand, by which one could die, and he does die, he is a murderer; the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: Or if someone with a stone in his hand strikes and kills another person, it is murder, and the murderer must be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: And if he struck him with a stone in the hand, by which he would die, and as a result he did die, he is a murderer; the murderer must be put to death.
verses.textEn: Or if anyone is holding a stone and strikes someone a fatal blow with it, that person is a murderer; the murderer is to be put to death.

verses.textZh: 如果人手里拿着可以打死人的木器打人，以致把人打死，他就是故意杀人的；故意杀人的必被处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果人手里拿着可以打死人的木器打人，以致把人打死，他就是故意杀人的；故意杀人的必被处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 若用可以打死人的木器打死了人，他就是故杀人的；故杀人的必被治死。
verses.textEnNiv: Or if anyone is holding a wooden object and strikes someone a fatal blow with it, that person is a murderer; the murderer is to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: Or if he struck him down with a wooden tool that could cause death, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Or if he strikes him with a wooden hand weapon, by which one could die, and he does die, he is a murderer; the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: Or if someone strikes and kills another person with a wooden object, it is murder, and the murderer must be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: Or if he struck him with a wooden object in the hand, by which he would die, and as a result he did die, he is a murderer; the murderer must be put to death.
verses.textEn: Or if anyone is holding a wooden object and strikes someone a fatal blow with it, that person is a murderer; the murderer is to be put to death.

verses.textZh: 报血仇的，要亲自把那故意杀人的杀死；一遇见他，就可以杀死他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 报血仇的，要亲自把那故意杀人的杀死；一遇见他，就可以杀死他。
verses.textZhCuv: 报血仇的必亲自杀那故杀人的，一遇见就杀他。
verses.textEnNiv: The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death; when the avenger comes upon the murderer, the avenger shall put the murderer to death.
verses.textEnEsv: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death; when he meets him, he shall put him to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: The avenger of blood himself shall put the murderer to death; when he meets him, he shall put him to death.
verses.textEnNlt: The victim’s nearest relative is responsible for putting the murderer to death. When they meet, the avenger must put the murderer to death.
verses.textEnNasb: The blood avenger himself shall put the murderer to death; he himself shall put him to death when he meets him.
verses.textEn: The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death; when the avenger comes upon the murderer, the avenger shall put the murderer to death.

verses.textZh: 如果人因怀恨把人推倒，或是埋伏着向人扔东西，以致把人打死；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果人因怀恨把人推倒，或是埋伏着向人扔东西，以致把人打死；
verses.textZhCuv: 人若因怨恨把人推倒，或是埋伏往人身上扔物，以致于死，
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone with malice aforethought shoves another or throws something at them intentionally so that they die
verses.textEnEsv: And if he pushed him out of hatred or hurled something at him, lying in wait, so that he died,
verses.textEnNkjv: If he pushes him out of hatred or, while lying in wait, hurls something at him so that he dies,
verses.textEnNlt: So if someone hates another person and waits in ambush, then pushes him or throws something at him and he dies, it is murder.
verses.textEnNasb: Now if he pushed him in hatred, or he threw something at him with malicious intent, and as a result he died,
verses.textEn: If anyone with malice aforethought shoves another or throws something at them intentionally so that they die

verses.textZh: 或者因仇恨用手打人，以致把人打死；那打人的，必被处死，因为他是故意杀人的；报血仇的一遇见凶手，就可以杀死他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 或者因仇恨用手打人，以致把人打死；那打人的，必被处死，因为他是故意杀人的；报血仇的一遇见凶手，就可以杀死他。
verses.textZhCuv: 或是因仇恨用手打人，以致于死，那打人的必被治死。他是故杀人的；报血仇的一遇见就杀他。
verses.textEnNiv: or if out of enmity one person hits another with their fist so that the other dies, that person is to be put to death; that person is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when they meet.
verses.textEnEsv: or in enmity struck him down with his hand, so that he died, then he who struck the blow shall be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.
verses.textEnNkjv: or in enmity he strikes him with his hand so that he dies, the one who struck him shall surely be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.
verses.textEnNlt: Or if someone hates another person and hits him with a fist and he dies, it is murder. In such cases, the avenger must put the murderer to death when they meet.
verses.textEnNasb: or if he struck him with his hand with hostility, and as a result he died, the one who struck him must be put to death; he is a murderer. The blood avenger shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.
verses.textEn: or if out of enmity one person hits another with their fist so that the other dies, that person is to be put to death; that person is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when they meet.

verses.textZh: "‘但是，如果人没有仇恨，忽然把人推倒，或是无意向人投掷甚么器皿，
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘但是，如果人没有仇恨，忽然把人推倒，或是无意向人投掷甚么器皿，
verses.textZhCuv: 「倘若人没有仇恨，忽然将人推倒，或是没有埋伏把物扔在人身上，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But if without enmity someone suddenly pushes another or throws something at them unintentionally
verses.textEnEsv: "But if he pushed him suddenly without enmity, or hurled anything on him without lying in wait
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘However, if he pushes him suddenly without enmity, or throws anything at him without lying in wait,
verses.textEnNlt: "But suppose someone pushes another person without having shown previous hostility, or throws something that unintentionally hits another person,
verses.textEnNasb: ‘But if he pushed him suddenly, without hostility, or threw any object at him without malicious intent,
verses.textEn: " ‘But if without enmity someone suddenly pushes another or throws something at them unintentionally

verses.textZh: 或是因为没有看见，用任何可以打死人的石头，扔在人身上，以致把人打死，他本来与他无仇，也无意害他；
verses.textZhCnvs: 或是因为没有看见，用任何可以打死人的石头，扔在人身上，以致把人打死，他本来与他无仇，也无意害他；
verses.textZhCuv: 或是没有看见的时候用可以打死人的石头扔在人身上，以致于死，本来与他无仇，也无意害他。
verses.textEnNiv: or, without seeing them, drops on them a stone heavy enough to kill them, and they die, then since that other person was not an enemy and no harm was intended,
verses.textEnEsv: or used a stone that could cause death, and without seeing him dropped it on him, so that he died, though he was not his enemy and did not seek his harm,
verses.textEnNkjv: or uses a stone, by which a man could die, throwing it at him without seeing him, so that he dies, while he was not his enemy or seeking his harm,
verses.textEnNlt: or accidentally drops a huge stone on someone, though they were not enemies, and the person dies.
verses.textEnNasb: or had any deadly stone, and without looking he dropped it on him so that he died, while he was not his enemy nor was he seeking to harm him,
verses.textEn: or, without seeing them, drops on them a stone heavy enough to kill them, and they die, then since that other person was not an enemy and no harm was intended,

verses.textZh: 这样，会众就要照着典章，在打死人的和报血仇的人中间施行裁判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，会众就要照着典章，在打死人的和报血仇的人中间施行裁判。
verses.textZhCuv: 会众就要照典章，在打死人的和报血仇的中间审判。
verses.textEnNiv: the assembly must judge between the accused and the avenger of blood according to these regulations.
verses.textEnEsv: then the congregation shall judge between the manslayer and the avenger of blood, in accordance with these rules.
verses.textEnNkjv: then the congregation shall judge between the manslayer and the avenger of blood according to these judgments.
verses.textEnNlt: If this should happen, the community must follow these regulations in making a judgment between the slayer and the avenger, the victim’s nearest relative:
verses.textEnNasb: then the congregation shall judge between the one who fatally struck the victim and the blood avenger in accordance with these ordinances.
verses.textEn: the assembly must judge between the accused and the avenger of blood according to these regulations.

verses.textZh: 会众要把误杀人的，从报血仇的人手中救出来；把他送回他所逃到的避难城去，他要住在那里，直到受圣膏的大祭司死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 会众要把误杀人的，从报血仇的人手中救出来；把他送回他所逃到的避难城去，他要住在那里，直到受圣膏的大祭司死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 会众要救这误杀人的脱离报血仇人的手，也要使他归入逃城。他要住在其中，直等到受圣膏的大祭司死了。
verses.textEnNiv: The assembly must protect the one accused of murder from the avenger of blood and send the accused back to the city of refuge to which they fled. The accused must stay there until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.
verses.textEnEsv: And the congregation shall rescue the manslayer from the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge to which he had fled, and he shall live in it until the death of the high priest who was anointed with the holy oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the congregation shall deliver the manslayer from the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall return him to the city of refuge where he had fled, and he shall remain there until the death of the high priest who was anointed with the holy oil.
verses.textEnNlt: The community must protect the slayer from the avenger and must escort the slayer back to live in the city of refuge to which he fled. There he must remain until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the sacred oil.
verses.textEnNasb: And the congregation shall save the one who committed manslaughter from the hand of the blood avenger, and the congregation shall return him to his city of refuge to which he fled; and he shall live in it until the death of the high priest who was anointed with the holy oil.
verses.textEn: The assembly must protect the one accused of murder from the avenger of blood and send the accused back to the city of refuge to which they fled. The accused must stay there until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

verses.textZh: 但误杀人的，若是出了他逃进的避难城的境界，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但误杀人的，若是出了他逃进的避难城的境界，
verses.textZhCuv: 但误杀人的，无论什么时候，若出了逃城的境外，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But if the accused ever goes outside the limits of the city of refuge to which they fled
verses.textEnEsv: But if the manslayer shall at any time go beyond the boundaries of his city of refuge to which he fled,
verses.textEnNkjv: But if the manslayer at any time goes outside the limits of the city of refuge where he fled,
verses.textEnNlt: "But if the slayer ever leaves the limits of the city of refuge,
verses.textEnNasb: But if at any time he goes beyond the border of his city of refuge to which he flees,
verses.textEn: " ‘But if the accused ever goes outside the limits of the city of refuge to which they fled

verses.textZh: 报血仇的在避难城境外遇着他，把他杀了，报血仇的就没有犯流人血的罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 报血仇的在避难城境外遇着他，把他杀了，报血仇的就没有犯流人血的罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 报血仇的在逃城境外遇见他，将他杀了，报血仇的就没有流血之罪。
verses.textEnNiv: and the avenger of blood finds them outside the city, the avenger of blood may kill the accused without being guilty of murder.
verses.textEnEsv: and the avenger of blood finds him outside the boundaries of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the manslayer, he shall not be guilty of blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the avenger of blood finds him outside the limits of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the manslayer, he shall not be guilty of blood,
verses.textEnNlt: and the avenger finds him outside the city and kills him, it will not be considered murder.
verses.textEnNasb: and the blood avenger finds him outside the border of his city of refuge, and the blood avenger kills him, he will not be guilty of bloodshed,
verses.textEn: and the avenger of blood finds them outside the city, the avenger of blood may kill the accused without being guilty of murder.

verses.textZh: 因为那误杀人的应该住在避难城中，直到大祭司死了；大祭司死了以后，那误杀人的才可以回到他自己地业去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为那误杀人的应该住在避难城中，直到大祭司死了；大祭司死了以后，那误杀人的才可以回到他自己地业去。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为误杀人的该住在逃城里，等到大祭司死了。大祭司死了以后，误杀人的才可以回到他所得为业之地。
verses.textEnNiv: The accused must stay in the city of refuge until the death of the high priest; only after the death of the high priest may they return to their own property.
verses.textEnEsv: For he must remain in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest, but after the death of the high priest the manslayer may return to the land of his possession.
verses.textEnNkjv: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest the manslayer may return to the land of his possession.
verses.textEnNlt: The slayer should have stayed inside the city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest, the slayer may return to his own property.
verses.textEnNasb: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest the one who committed manslaughter may return to the land of his property.
verses.textEn: The accused must stay in the city of refuge until the death of the high priest; only after the death of the high priest may they return to their own property.

verses.textZh: "‘这在你们一切居住的地方，要作你们世世代代的律例典章。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘这在你们一切居住的地方，要作你们世世代代的律例典章。
verses.textZhCuv: 这在你们一切的住处，要作你们世世代代的律例典章。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is to have the force of law for you throughout the generations to come, wherever you live.
verses.textEnEsv: And these things shall be for a statute and rule for you throughout your generations in all your dwelling places.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And these things shall be a statute of judgment to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.textEnNlt: These are legal requirements for you to observe from generation to generation, wherever you may live.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘These things shall be a statutory ordinance for you throughout your generations in all your dwelling places.
verses.textEn: " ‘This is to have the force of law for you throughout the generations to come, wherever you live.

verses.textZh: 杀人的，要凭着几个见证人的口供，才可以把他处死；如果只有一个见证人，就不能指证把人处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 杀人的，要凭着几个见证人的口供，才可以把他处死；如果只有一个见证人，就不能指证把人处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 「无论谁故杀人，要凭几个见证人的口把那故杀人的杀了，只是不可凭一个见证的口叫人死。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Anyone who kills a person is to be put to death as a murderer only on the testimony of witnesses. But no one is to be put to death on the testimony of only one witness.
verses.textEnEsv: "If anyone kills a person, the murderer shall be put to death on the evidence of witnesses. But no person shall be put to death on the testimony of one witness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever kills a person, the murderer shall be put to death on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness is not sufficient testimony against a person for the death penalty.
verses.textEnNlt: "All murderers must be put to death, but only if evidence is presented by more than one witness. No one may be put to death on the testimony of only one witness.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘If anyone kills a person, the murderer shall be put to death on the testimony of witnesses, but no person shall be put to death on the testimony of only one witness.
verses.textEn: " ‘Anyone who kills a person is to be put to death as a murderer only on the testimony of witnesses. But no one is to be put to death on the testimony of only one witness.

verses.textZh: 犯了死罪，故意杀人的，你们不可收取赎价代他赎命，因为他必被处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犯了死罪，故意杀人的，你们不可收取赎价代他赎命，因为他必被处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 故杀人、犯死罪的，你们不可收赎价代替他的命；他必被治死。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not accept a ransom for the life of a murderer, who deserves to die. They are to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, you shall accept no ransom for the life of a murderer, who is guilty of death, but he shall be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death, but he shall surely be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: Also, you must never accept a ransom payment for the life of someone judged guilty of murder and subject to execution; murderers must always be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, you shall not accept a ransom for the life of a murderer who is condemned to death, but he must be put to death.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not accept a ransom for the life of a murderer, who deserves to die. They are to be put to death.

verses.textZh: 逃到避难城的人，你们也不可收取他的赎价，使他在大祭司未死以前回到本地居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 逃到避难城的人，你们也不可收取他的赎价，使他在大祭司未死以前回到本地居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 那逃到逃城的人，你们不可为他收赎价，使他在大祭司未死以先再来住在本地。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not accept a ransom for anyone who has fled to a city of refuge and so allow them to go back and live on their own land before the death of the high priest.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall accept no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge, that he may return to dwell in the land before the death of the high priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge, that he may return to dwell in the land before the death of the priest.
verses.textEnNlt: And never accept a ransom payment from someone who has fled to a city of refuge, allowing a slayer to return to his property before the death of the high priest.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall not accept a ransom for one who has fled to his city of refuge, so that he may return to live in the land before the death of the priest.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not accept a ransom for anyone who has fled to a city of refuge and so allow them to go back and live on their own land before the death of the high priest.

verses.textZh: 这样，你们就没有玷污你们所在之地，因为血能玷污地；在地上如果有流人血的，除非流那故意杀人者的血，那地的血就不能得赎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，你们就没有玷污你们所在之地，因为血能玷污地；在地上如果有流人血的，除非流那故意杀人者的血，那地的血就不能得赎。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，你们就不污秽所住之地，因为血是污秽地的；若有在地上流人血的，非流那杀人者的血，那地就不得洁净 。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Do not pollute the land where you are. Bloodshed pollutes the land, and atonement cannot be made for the land on which blood has been shed, except by the blood of the one who shed it.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not pollute the land in which you live, for blood pollutes the land, and no atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it, except by the blood of the one who shed it.
verses.textEnNkjv: So you shall not pollute the land where you are; for blood defiles the land, and no atonement can be made for the land, for the blood that is shed on it, except by the blood of him who shed it.
verses.textEnNlt: This will ensure that the land where you live will not be polluted, for murder pollutes the land. And no sacrifice except the execution of the murderer can purify the land from murder.
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall not defile the land in which you live; for blood defiles the land, and no atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed on it, except by the blood of the one who shed it.
verses.textEn: " ‘Do not pollute the land where you are. Bloodshed pollutes the land, and atonement cannot be made for the land on which blood has been shed, except by the blood of the one who shed it.

verses.textZh: 你们不可玷污你所住的地，就是我居住的地，因为我耶和华是居住在以色列人中间的。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不可玷污你所住的地，就是我居住的地，因为我耶和华是居住在以色列人中间的。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不可玷污所住之地，就是我住在其中之地，因为我－耶和华住在以色列人中间。」
verses.textEnNiv: Do not defile the land where you live and where I dwell, for I, the Lord , dwell among the Israelites.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not defile the land in which you live, in the midst of which I dwell, for I the Lord dwell in the midst of the people of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore do not defile the land which you inhabit, in the midst of which I dwell; for I the Lord dwell among the children of Israel.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: You must not defile the land where you live, for I live there myself. I am the Lord , who lives among the people of Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: So you shall not defile the land in which you live, in the midst of which I dwell; for I the Lord am dwelling in the midst of the sons of Israel.’ "
verses.textEn: Do not defile the land where you live and where I dwell, for I, the Lord , dwell among the Israelites.’ "

verses.textZh: 约瑟后裔的家族中，有玛拿西的孙子、玛吉的儿子基列的子孙，他们族中的首领都前来，在摩西面前，在各家族作首领的领袖面前，和在以色列人面前说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟后裔的家族中，有玛拿西的孙子、玛吉的儿子基列的子孙，他们族中的首领都前来，在摩西面前，在各家族作首领的领袖面前，和在以色列人面前说：
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟的后裔，玛拿西的孙子，玛吉的儿子基列，他子孙中的诸族长来到摩西和作首领的以色列人族长面前，说：
verses.textEnNiv: The family heads of the clan of Gilead son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, who were from the clans of the descendants of Joseph, came and spoke before Moses and the leaders, the heads of the Israelite families.
verses.textEnEsv: The heads of the fathers’ houses of the clan of the people of Gilead the son of Machir, son of Manasseh, from the clans of the people of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the chiefs, the heads of the fathers’ houses of the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the leaders, the chief fathers of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the heads of the clans of Gilead—descendants of Makir, son of Manasseh, son of Joseph—came to Moses and the family leaders of Israel with a petition.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came forward and spoke before Moses and before the leaders, the heads of the fathers’ households of the sons of Israel,
verses.textEn: The family heads of the clan of Gilead son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, who were from the clans of the descendants of Joseph, came and spoke before Moses and the leaders, the heads of the Israelite families.

verses.textZh: "耶和华曾经吩咐我主要凭抽签把地分给以色列人为业；我主也受了耶和华的吩咐，要把我们兄弟西罗非哈的产业分给他的众女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华曾经吩咐我主要凭抽签把地分给以色列人为业；我主也受了耶和华的吩咐，要把我们兄弟西罗非哈的产业分给他的众女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华曾吩咐我主拈阄分地给以色列人为业，我主也受了耶和华的吩咐将我们兄弟西罗非哈的产业分给他的众女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: They said, "When the Lord commanded my lord to give the land as an inheritance to the Israelites by lot, he ordered you to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: They said, "The Lord commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the people of Israel, and my lord was commanded by the Lord to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said: "The Lord commanded my lord Moses to give the land as an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel, and my lord was commanded by the Lord to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: They said, "Sir, the Lord instructed you to divide the land by sacred lot among the people of Israel. You were told by the Lord to give the grant of land owned by our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: and they said, "The Lord commanded my lord to give the land by lot to the sons of Israel as an inheritance, and my lord was commanded by the Lord to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.
verses.textEn: They said, "When the Lord commanded my lord to give the land as an inheritance to the Israelites by lot, he ordered you to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.

verses.textZh: 但是，如果她们嫁给以色列中别的支派的人，她们的产业就必从我们祖宗的产业中被取去，加在他们丈夫支派的产业上；这样，我们抽签所得的产业就失去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，如果她们嫁给以色列中别的支派的人，她们的产业就必从我们祖宗的产业中被取去，加在他们丈夫支派的产业上；这样，我们抽签所得的产业就失去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 她们若嫁以色列别支派的人，就必将我们祖宗所遗留的产业加在她们丈夫支派的产业中。这样，我们拈阄所得的产业就要减少了。
verses.textEnNiv: Now suppose they marry men from other Israelite tribes; then their inheritance will be taken from our ancestral inheritance and added to that of the tribe they marry into. And so part of the inheritance allotted to us will be taken away.
verses.textEnEsv: But if they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the people of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken from the inheritance of our fathers and added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they marry. So it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now if they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and it will be added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they marry; so it will be taken from the lot of our inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: But if they marry men from another tribe, their grants of land will go with them to the tribe into which they marry. In this way, the total area of our tribal land will be reduced.
verses.textEnNasb: But if they marry one of the sons of the other tribes of the sons of Israel, their inheritance will be withdrawn from the inheritance of our fathers and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they belong; so it will be withdrawn from our allotted inheritance.
verses.textEn: Now suppose they marry men from other Israelite tribes; then their inheritance will be taken from our ancestral inheritance and added to that of the tribe they marry into. And so part of the inheritance allotted to us will be taken away.

verses.textZh: 到了以色列人的禧年，她们的产业就要加在她们丈夫支派的产业上；这样，她们的产业就要从我们祖宗支派的产业中被拿去了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了以色列人的禧年，她们的产业就要加在她们丈夫支派的产业上；这样，她们的产业就要从我们祖宗支派的产业中被拿去了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到了以色列人的禧年，这女儿的产业就必加在她们丈夫支派的产业上。这样，我们祖宗支派的产业就减少了。」
verses.textEnNiv: When the Year of Jubilee for the Israelites comes, their inheritance will be added to that of the tribe into which they marry, and their property will be taken from the tribal inheritance of our ancestors."
verses.textEnEsv: And when the jubilee of the people of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they marry, and their inheritance will be taken from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the Jubilee of the children of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they marry; so their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers."
verses.textEnNlt: Then when the Year of Jubilee comes, their portion of land will be added to that of the new tribe, causing it to be lost forever to our ancestral tribe."
verses.textEnNasb: And when the jubilee of the sons of Israel takes place, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they belong; so their inheritance will be withdrawn from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers."
verses.textEn: When the Year of Jubilee for the Israelites comes, their inheritance will be added to that of the tribe into which they marry, and their property will be taken from the tribal inheritance of our ancestors."

verses.textZh: 摩西照着耶和华的话，吩咐以色列说："约瑟支派的人说得对。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西照着耶和华的话，吩咐以色列说："约瑟支派的人说得对。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西照耶和华的话吩咐以色列人说：「约瑟支派的人说得有理。
verses.textEnNiv: Then at the Lord ’s command Moses gave this order to the Israelites: "What the tribe of the descendants of Joseph is saying is right.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses commanded the people of Israel according to the word of the Lord , saying, "The tribe of the people of Joseph is right.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the Lord, saying: "What the tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks is right.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moses gave the Israelites this command from the Lord : "The claim of the men of the tribe of Joseph is legitimate.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Moses commanded the sons of Israel in accordance with the word of the Lord, saying, "The tribe of the sons of Joseph is right in its statements.
verses.textEn: Then at the Lord ’s command Moses gave this order to the Israelites: "What the tribe of the descendants of Joseph is saying is right.

verses.textZh: 论到西罗非哈的众女儿，耶和华吩咐的话是这样：‘她们可以随意嫁自己喜欢的人，但是，只能嫁给同族同支派的人作妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到西罗非哈的众女儿，耶和华吩咐的话是这样：‘她们可以随意嫁自己喜欢的人，但是，只能嫁给同族同支派的人作妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到西罗非哈的众女儿，耶和华这样吩咐说：她们可以随意嫁人，只是要嫁同宗支派的人。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord commands for Zelophehad’s daughters: They may marry anyone they please as long as they marry within their father’s tribal clan.
verses.textEnEsv: This is what the Lord commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad: ‘Let them marry whom they think best, only they shall marry within the clan of the tribe of their father.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is what the Lord commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them marry whom they think best, but they may marry only within the family of their father’s tribe.’
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad: Let them marry anyone they like, as long as it is within their own ancestral tribe.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord has commanded regarding the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them marry whomever they wish; only they must marry within the family of the tribe of their father.’
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord commands for Zelophehad’s daughters: They may marry anyone they please as long as they marry within their father’s tribal clan.

verses.textZh: 这样，以色列人的产业，就不会从一个支派转到另一个支派去；因为以色列人要各自守住自己祖宗支派的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，以色列人的产业，就不会从一个支派转到另一个支派去；因为以色列人要各自守住自己祖宗支派的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，以色列人的产业就不从这支派归到那支派，因为以色列人要各守各祖宗支派的产业。
verses.textEnNiv: No inheritance in Israel is to pass from one tribe to another, for every Israelite shall keep the tribal inheritance of their ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: The inheritance of the people of Israel shall not be transferred from one tribe to another, for every one of the people of Israel shall hold on to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the inheritance of the children of Israel shall not change hands from tribe to tribe, for every one of the children of Israel shall keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: None of the territorial land may pass from tribe to tribe, for all the land given to each tribe must remain within the tribe to which it was first allotted.
verses.textEnNasb: So no inheritance of the sons of Israel will be transferred from tribe to tribe, for the sons of Israel shall each retain possession of the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
verses.textEn: No inheritance in Israel is to pass from one tribe to another, for every Israelite shall keep the tribal inheritance of their ancestors.

verses.textZh: 从以色列支派中得了产业的女子，要嫁给自己祖宗支派的人作妻子，好使以色列人可以各自承受自己祖宗的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从以色列支派中得了产业的女子，要嫁给自己祖宗支派的人作妻子，好使以色列人可以各自承受自己祖宗的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡在以色列支派中得了产业的女子必作同宗支派人的妻，好叫以色列人各自承受他祖宗的产业。
verses.textEnNiv: Every daughter who inherits land in any Israelite tribe must marry someone in her father’s tribal clan, so that every Israelite will possess the inheritance of their ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: And every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the people of Israel shall be wife to one of the clan of the tribe of her father, so that every one of the people of Israel may possess the inheritance of his fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be the wife of one of the family of her father’s tribe, so that the children of Israel each may possess the inheritance of his fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: The daughters throughout the tribes of Israel who are in line to inherit property must marry within their tribe, so that all the Israelites will keep their ancestral property.
verses.textEnNasb: And every daughter who comes into possession of an inheritance of any tribe of the sons of Israel shall marry one of the family of the tribe of her father, so that the sons of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers.
verses.textEn: Every daughter who inherits land in any Israelite tribe must marry someone in her father’s tribal clan, so that every Israelite will possess the inheritance of their ancestors.

verses.textZh: 这样，以色列人的产业，就不会从一个支派转到另一个支派去；因为以色列人的支派要各自守住自己的产业。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，以色列人的产业，就不会从一个支派转到另一个支派去；因为以色列人的支派要各自守住自己的产业。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，他们的产业就不从这支派归到那支派，因为以色列支派的人要各守各的产业。」
verses.textEnNiv: No inheritance may pass from one tribe to another, for each Israelite tribe is to keep the land it inherits."
verses.textEnEsv: So no inheritance shall be transferred from one tribe to another, for each of the tribes of the people of Israel shall hold on to its own inheritance.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus no inheritance shall change hands from one tribe to another, but every tribe of the children of Israel shall keep its own inheritance."
verses.textEnNlt: No grant of land may pass from one tribe to another; each tribe of Israel must keep its allotted portion of land."
verses.textEnNasb: So no inheritance will be transferred from one tribe to another tribe, for the tribes of the sons of Israel shall each retain possession of its own inheritance."
verses.textEn: No inheritance may pass from one tribe to another, for each Israelite tribe is to keep the land it inherits."

verses.textZh: 耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，西罗非哈的众女儿就怎样行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，西罗非哈的众女儿就怎样行。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，西罗非哈的众女儿就怎样行。
verses.textEnNiv: So Zelophehad’s daughters did as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: The daughters of Zelophehad did as the Lord commanded Moses,
verses.textEnNkjv: Just as the Lord commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad;
verses.textEnNlt: The daughters of Zelophehad did as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: Just as the Lord had commanded Moses, so the daughters of Zelophehad did:
verses.textEn: So Zelophehad’s daughters did as the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 西罗非哈的女儿玛拉、得撒、曷拉、密迦、挪阿，都嫁给了自己叔伯的儿子作妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西罗非哈的女儿玛拉、得撒、曷拉、密迦、挪阿，都嫁给了自己叔伯的儿子作妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 西罗非哈的女儿玛拉、得撒、曷拉、密迦、挪阿都嫁了他们伯叔的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Zelophehad’s daughters—Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milkah and Noah—married their cousins on their father’s side.
verses.textEnEsv: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to sons of their father’s brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to the sons of their father’s brothers.
verses.textEnNlt: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah all married cousins on their father’s side.
verses.textEnNasb: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad married their uncles’ sons.
verses.textEn: Zelophehad’s daughters—Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milkah and Noah—married their cousins on their father’s side.

verses.textZh: 她们嫁给了约瑟的儿子玛拿西子孙家族的人作妻子；她们的产业仍然留在自己的支派中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她们嫁给了约瑟的儿子玛拿西子孙家族的人作妻子；她们的产业仍然留在自己的支派中。
verses.textZhCuv: 她们嫁入约瑟儿子、玛拿西子孙的族中；她们的产业仍留在同宗支派中。
verses.textEnNiv: They married within the clans of the descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in their father’s tribe and clan.
verses.textEnEsv: They were married into the clans of the people of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of their father’s clan.
verses.textEnNkjv: They were married into the families of the children of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of their father’s family.
verses.textEnNlt: They married into the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph. Thus, their inheritance of land remained within their ancestral tribe.
verses.textEnNasb: They married those from the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained with the tribe of the family of their father.
verses.textEn: They married within the clans of the descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in their father’s tribe and clan.

verses.textZh: 这是耶和华在耶利哥对面，约旦河边的摩押平原，借着摩西向以色列人吩咐的命令和典章。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是耶和华在耶利哥对面，约旦河边的摩押平原，借着摩西向以色列人吩咐的命令和典章。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是耶和华在摩押平原－约旦河边、耶利哥对面－藉着摩西所吩咐以色列人的命令典章。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the commands and regulations the Lord gave through Moses to the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the commandments and the rules that the Lord commanded through Moses to the people of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the commandments and the judgments which the Lord commanded the children of Israel by the hand of Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan, acrossfrom Jericho.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the commands and regulations that the Lord gave to the people of Israel through Moses while they were camped on the plains of Moab beside the Jordan River, across from Jericho.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the commandments and the ordinances which the Lord commanded to the sons of Israel through Moses in the plains of Moab, by the Jordan opposite Jericho.
verses.textEn: These are the commands and regulations the Lord gave through Moses to the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
